He turns for help to Yotsugi Ononoki, an expressionless doll who is herself an apparition, and her guardian Yozuru Kagenui, a specialist in fighting apparitions. Shaft aired the four episodes on New Year's Eve 2014, adapting the Yotsugi Doll story from Nisio Isin's novels. It contains some fan service.

nanatsu-no-taizai-kamigami-no-gekirin.summary: The Seven Deadly Sins, a band of knights led by the cheerful but immensely powerful Meliodas, have fought off the Ten Commandments, a group of ancient demons, but the conflict is not over. In this third season the Sins split up to go through trials that will make them strong enough to face the Commandments again, while some must confront painful memories. Along the way they learn more about an ancient war between the demon clan and the goddesses, and about the bond between Meliodas and Princess Elizabeth. Studio Deen took over production for the 24 episodes in 2019 and 2020, adapting Nakaba Suzuki's manga. It contains fantasy violence.

darker-than-black-ryuusei-no-gemini.summary: In a world changed by the appearance of Contractors, people who gain supernatural powers but must pay a strange price each time they use them, Suou Pavlichenko, a thirteen-year-old girl in Russia, lives a mostly normal school life. One night, as meteors fill the sky, her twin brother Shion becomes a Contractor. Soon afterward a masked man dressed in black storms into her home, her ordinary life falls apart, and Suou finds she carries dormant powers too. Pulled into a ruthless world of spies and killers, she ends up on the road with the man in black. Bones made the 12 episodes in 2009 as a sequel to Darker than Black, directed by Tensai Okamura. It contains graphic violence.

enen-no-shouboutai-ni-no-shou.summary: In a Tokyo where people can suddenly burst into flame and become fiery monsters called Infernals, special fire brigades exist to put them to rest. Shinra Kusakabe, a young firefighter with flaming feet, serves in Special Fire Force Company 8 and wants to be a hero who saves people. After a confrontation with his younger brother Sho, his goals are clear: find a way to turn Infernals back into people, uncover the truth about a shadowy figure called the Evangelist, and rescue his mother and brother. The Evangelist's followers are hunting people with a rare ability called Adolla Burst, and Shinra is one of them. David Production made the 24 episodes in 2020 from Atsushi Ohkubo's manga. It contains violence.

bokura-wa-minna-kawaisou.summary: When his parents are transferred for work, first-year high schooler Kazunari Usa finally gets to live on his own. He moves into the Kawai Complex, a boarding house that serves meals, and is delighted to find that Ritsu Kawai, the quiet, bookish upperclassman he admires, lives there too. The other tenants are less welcome: a masochistic roommate, a hard-drinking office worker who resents couples after endless bad luck with men, and an innocent-looking college student who enjoys leading men on. His hopes for a calm life and a chance with Ritsu keep colliding with their antics. Brain's Base adapted Ruri Miyahara's manga into 12 episodes in 2014. It is a comedy with a slow romance and some crude jokes.

mushoku-tensei-isekai-ittara-honki-dasu-.summary: Rudeus Greyrat is a man from modern Japan reborn in a world of magic, keeping his old memories and is determined to do better this time. After a mysterious magical disaster, he and his fiery student Eris Boreas Greyrat were teleported to the far-off Demon Continent. With their new companion Ruijerd Supardia, a warrior from a feared race, they form an adventuring party called Dead End and travel across the continent toward their home region of Fittoa. On the way, advice from the faceless god Hitogami leads Rudeus to a strange new power. Studio Bind made the 12 episodes in 2021 from Rifujin na Magonote's light novels. It contains sexual humour and nudity.

danna-ga-nani-wo-itteiru-ka-wakaranai-ke.summary: Kaoru is a hard-working office worker who is ordinary in most ways, apart from a habit of getting very drunk. Her husband Hajime is a dedicated otaku who stays at home and makes his living as a blogger, and much of what he says about anime, games and internet culture goes straight over her head. The series follows their daily married life in short comedic episodes, built around misunderstandings between them, Hajime's online habits, the odd people around them and the small affectionate moments that show why they work as a couple. Seven adapted Cool-kyou Shinja's four-panel manga into 13 short episodes in 2014, and a second season followed in 2015. It is a light domestic comedy.

durarara-x2-ten.summary: In Ikebukuro, a Tokyo district where gangs, information brokers and urban legends like the headless rider Celty Sturluson all cross paths, the lives of its residents keep getting tangled together. Mikado Ryugamine, the quiet student who founded the online gang the Dollars, has started to chase the excitement he always wanted, and with new influence on his side he begins trying to purge the Dollars from within and reshape them into his ideal. Outside forces keep interfering, an old friend of his resurfaces, and the information broker Izaya Orihara is still working on schemes of his own. Shuka made these 12 episodes in 2015, the second of three parts of Durarara!!x2, based on Ryohgo Narita's light novels. It contains violence.

hanasaku-iroha.summary: Ohana Matsumae, a lively sixteen-year-old raised in Tokyo by a free-spirited single mother, is left to fend for herself when her mother runs off with a boyfriend who is dodging debt collectors. Ohana is sent to the countryside to live with her estranged grandmother, who turns out to own Kissuiso, an old hot spring inn, and who puts her straight to work as a maid. Ohana clashes with the staff and her stern grandmother, but starts to find her footing at the inn and at her new school. P.A. Works produced the original 26-episode series in 2011 as its tenth anniversary project, written by Mari Okada and directed by Masahiro Ando. It is a coming-of-age drama with comedy.

sword-art-online-alicization-war-of-unde.summary: Inside Underworld, a virtual world whose people are artificial intelligences with real souls, Kirito and his allies have defeated Quinella, the ruler of the Axiom Church. But in the real world, the Ocean Turtle, the floating facility that runs Underworld, has been attacked by armed intruders, and the resulting power surge has damaged Kirito's mind and left him unresponsive. Alice, an Integrity Knight who now distrusts the Church, takes him back to her home village of Rulid, despite being banished from it, and lives quietly nearby hoping he will recover. Meanwhile, the armies of the Dark Territory are preparing to invade. A-1 Pictures made the 12 episodes in 2019 from Reki Kawahara's light novels. It contains violence.

free-eternal-summer.summary: A year after Haruka Nanase and his friends founded a swim club at Iwatobi High, nobody new has joined. Haruka and Makoto Tachibana are now in their final year, and with Nagisa Hazuki and Rei Ryugazaki they need to recruit members or the club will close once they graduate. Meanwhile Rin Matsuoka, Haruka's old friend and rival, is now captain of the Samezuka Academy swim team and certain he wants to swim professionally, while Haruka, who swims only because he loves the water, avoids thinking about what comes after school. Kyoto Animation and Animation Do made the 13 episodes in 2014, directed by Hiroko Utsumi. It is a sports drama about friendship and the future.

tensei-shitara-slime-datta-ken-2nd-seaso.summary: Satoru Mikami was reborn in a fantasy world as a slime, took the name Rimuru Tempest and built Tempest, a nation where monsters live together. In this second half of season two, Tempest is celebrating after surviving a surprise attack by the Kingdom of Falmuth and the Western Holy Church, and Rimuru meets its allies to decide what comes next. Several problems remain: the aftermath of the invasion, the odd behaviour of the Demon Lord Milim Nava, and the disappearance of another Demon Lord. Rimuru decides to move against Clayman, the Demon Lord he believes is behind it all. 8bit made the 12 episodes in 2021, based on Fuse's novels. It contains fantasy violence.

fate-stay-night-unlimited-blade-works-tv.summary: Every few decades, seven mages in Fuyuki City take part in the Holy Grail War, each summoning a heroic spirit as a Servant and fighting to the death for a Grail said to grant any wish. Rin Tohsaka, a gifted high school student and sole heir of the old Tohsaka family of mages, enters the fifth war determined to win and to live up to her late father. She has been preparing to summon Saber, the class said to be strongest, but a mistake leaves her with Archer instead, and a boy from her school soon gets caught up in the fighting. Ufotable aired this hour-long prologue in October 2014 to open its Unlimited Blade Works series. It contains violence.

zero-no-tsukaima-princesses-no-rondo.summary: Louise Francoise de La Valliere, a young noble mage, once could not cast a spell properly, until she summoned an ordinary Japanese teenager, Saito Hiraga, as her familiar and discovered a talent for Void, a rare and powerful kind of magic. After his bravery in the war with Albion, Saito has been knighted and given a noble's status, and Louise is not sure what that means for the two of them now that he is no longer just her familiar. Then a powerful mage named Sheffield ambushes Louise, and the fight suggests another Void user may be at work. J.C.Staff made this third season's 12 episodes in 2008 from Noboru Yamaguchi's light novels. It has frequent fan service.

pandora-hearts.summary: Oz Vessalius, the cheerful fifteen-year-old heir to one of the great ducal houses, has always thought of the Abyss as a story told to scare children. Then, during the ceremony marking his adulthood, hooded strangers called the Baskervilles declare that simply being alive is his crime and throw him into the Abyss, a strange prison dimension inhabited by monstrous beings called Chains. There he meets Alice, a fierce girl who is herself a powerful Chain known as the B-Rabbit, and the two form a contract to escape together. Xebec adapted Jun Mochizuki's manga into 25 episodes in 2009, directed by Takao Kato. It is a dark fantasy mystery.

bakuman-2.summary: Moritaka Mashiro, the artist, and Akito Takagi, the writer, are two high school students who work together as the manga duo Muto Ashirogi. Mashiro has promised to marry his sweetheart Miho Azuki, an aspiring voice actress, once one of their series is made into an anime with her in it. Now their detective manga has been picked up for serialisation in Weekly Shonen Jack, but keeping it there means surviving reader surveys every week, alongside rivals such as the eccentric genius Eiji Niizuma and the team of Yuriko Aoki and Takuro Nakai. J.C.Staff made the 25 episodes of this second season in 2011 and 2012, based on the manga by Tsugumi Ohba and Takeshi Obata.

sangatsu-no-lion-2.summary: Rei Kiriyama turned professional at shogi while still in middle school and has lived alone ever since. A second-year high school student now, he is slowly opening up thanks to the people around him: friends at the shogi hall, a club at school and the Kawamoto family, sisters Akari, Hinata and little Momo, who treat him as one of their own. Seeing that everyone carries burdens, he begins learning to lean on others and support them, while matches against strong opponents keep testing him as a player. Shaft made the 22 episodes of this second season in 2017 and 2018, directed by Akiyuki Shinbo and based on Chica Umino's manga. It includes a storyline about school bullying.

haikyuu-riku-vs-kuu.summary: This two-episode OVA focuses on the Tokyo qualifiers for the national high school volleyball tournament, where only three places remain and the city's strongest teams fight for them. It follows Nekoma High School, the defensive team that serves as Karasuno's rival and sparring partner in the main series, along with Fukurodani Academy, Nohebi Academy and the heavy favourites Itachiyama Academy. Nekoma is determined to prove it belongs at the national level, while each team has to deal with its own weaknesses on the court. Production I.G released the episodes in January 2020, directed by Masako Sato and based on Haruichi Furudate's manga. It is a sports story.

kekkai-sensen-beyond.summary: Three years ago, a gate to the Beyond opened over New York City, and the city was sealed inside a bubble where humans and otherworldly creatures now live side by side. Renamed Hellsalem's Lot, it is full of monsters, magic and everyday chaos. Leonardo Watch, a young photographer, came there after being given godlike all-seeing eyes at the cost of his little sister's sight, and joined Libra, a secret group of super-powered people that works to keep the balance between the two worlds. This second season continues their mostly episodic cases. Bones made the 12 episodes in 2017 from Yasuhiro Nightow's manga. It contains violence.

sekirei.summary: Minato Sahashi, 19, has just flunked his university entrance exams again. His luck changes when Musubi, a cheerful and extremely strong young woman, drops out of the sky and lands in his life. She is a Sekirei, one of 108 superhuman beings who bond with humans called Ashikabi through a kiss, and Minato turns out to be one. The bonded pairs are all drawn into the Sekirei Plan, a contest of elimination battles run by the corporation MBI and its eccentric head, and as more Sekirei join his household Minato has to protect them. Seven Arcs adapted Sakurako Gokurakuin's manga into 12 episodes in 2008. It contains heavy fan service and nudity.

bakuman-3.summary: Moritaka Mashiro and Akito Takagi, the high school manga duo known as Muto Ashirogi, have started their third series in the magazine Weekly Shonen Jack and are closer than ever to the anime adaptation that would let Mashiro marry Miho Azuki. The challenge is harder than ever, though. They must outrank the genius Eiji Niizuma within six months or face cancellation, while a crowd of rival creators, old and new, chases the same top spots in the weekly reader surveys. The season follows the pressure of deadlines, editor meetings and creative risks. J.C.Staff made the 25 episodes of this third and final season in 2012 and 2013, based on the manga by Tsugumi Ohba and Takeshi Obata.

durarara-x2-ketsu.summary: Ikebukuro is about to boil over again. Mikado Ryugamine has been steering the Dollars, the faceless online gang tied to his everyday life, in an increasingly hard-line direction, while his old friend Masaomi Kida rebuilds the Yellow Scarves in the hope of pulling him back. Anri Sonohara senses another power closing in, and in Shinra Kishitani's apartment Celty Sturluson, the headless rider who works as an underground courier, braces for news that could turn the city upside down. Ketsu is the third and closing cour of Durarara!!x2, made by studio Shuka from Ryohgo Narita's light novels. It ran for 12 episodes from January to March 2016. Contains violence.

high-school-dxd-hero.summary: Issei Hyodo, a shamelessly lecherous high schooler who became a devil in Rias Gremory's household and carries the power of the Red Dragon Emperor, is back to ordinary club life at Kuoh Academy. The second-years of the Occult Research Club head to Kyoto on a school trip, but sightseeing ends quickly when local youkai attack them, convinced the club is behind the disappearance of the fox spirit who guards the city. Meanwhile Rias, left behind in Tokyo, struggles with feelings she has not yet put into words. This fourth season, adapted from Ichiei Ishibumi's light novels, was made by Passione and broadcast between April and July 2018. Contains frequent nudity, sexual content and violence.

haiyore-nyaruko-san.summary: Mahiro Yasaka is an ordinary high school boy until a monstrous creature chases him down one night. His rescuer is a cheerful silver-haired girl who introduces herself as Nyaruko, the shapeshifting Nyarlathotep of H. P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu Mythos, working for a space defence agency. She explains that Lovecraft's horrors are really alien races, that Mahiro has been targeted by traffickers, and that she has come to guard him. She then moves into his house and declares her love, and more alien visitors follow. Xebec adapted Manta Aisora's light novels into this 12-episode parody comedy, broadcast from April to June 2012. Contains sexual humour.

kyoukai-no-kanata-movie-mirai-hen.summary: This film continues from the Beyond the Boundary TV series. Half-youmu high schooler Akihito Kanbara finds Mirai Kuriyama back in his life, but she has no memory of him, their friends or her old work as a Spirit World Warrior who hunts youmu. Seeing a chance for her to live an ordinary life, Akihito and the others agree to keep her past hidden and stay at arm's length, which hurts more than he expects. Then fragments of her memory start to return, and shadowy creatures appear in town searching for her. Kyoto Animation produced the film, directed by Taichi Ishidate, and it opened in April 2015 as the second part of I'll Be Here.

attack-on-titan-ova.summary: This set of three original video episodes fills in side stories from the world of Attack on Titan, where humanity survives behind giant walls against man-eating Titans. In the first, Squad Leader Hange rides off alone on an expedition, determined to capture a Titan for study, and comes across the notebook of a fallen scout named Ilse Langnar. The second follows cadet Jean Kirstein, his embarrassing home life and an escalating rivalry with Sasha Blouse during training. The third sends a squad of trainees led by Marco Bott into a forest exercise that goes wrong. Wit Studio released the episodes with manga volumes between December 2013 and August 2014. Contains graphic violence.

clannad-another-world-tomoyo-chapter.summary: This single episode imagines an alternate path for Clannad. Tomoya Okazaki, a cynical high school student with a reputation as a delinquent, is dating Tomoyo Sakagami, a strong-willed younger student. Tomoyo has just become student council president and wants to use the role to save the cherry trees along the school's hill from being cut down. Their relationship sets off gossip around campus, and Tomoya worries that his bad name will drag down her plans and her standing. Kyoto Animation made the episode, based on Key's visual novel, and released it on the eighth DVD volume of the Clannad TV series in July 2008.

kore-wa-zombie-desu-ka-of-the-dead.summary: Ayumu Aikawa is a high schooler who died and was brought back as a zombie by the silent necromancer Eucliwood Hellscythe. He also accidentally took the powers of Haruna, a loud magical girl, which means fighting monsters in her frilly outfit. Together with Eucliwood, Haruna and the vampire ninja Seraphim, who all live in his house, Ayumu keeps battling demons while trying to pass for a normal student. This second season picks up with the same chaotic household, offering more monster fights, school mischief and jokes about undead life, cross-dressing and magic. Studio Deen adapted Shinichi Kimura's light novels, airing 10 episodes from April to June 2012. Contains fan service and sexual humour.

arslan-senki-tv.summary: Arslan is the gentle fourteen-year-old crown prince of Pars, a kingdom modelled on ancient Persia and ruled by his fierce father, King Andragoras III. When Pars meets the invading army of Lusitania, the prince rides into his first battle, but betrayal from inside the king's own ranks turns it into a rout and the capital is threatened. Arslan escapes with the loyal knight Daryun and starts to gather a small band, including the strategist Narsus, to fight for his country. Liden Films and Sanzigen adapted Hiromu Arakawa's manga version of Yoshiki Tanaka's novels into 25 episodes, aired from April to September 2015. Contains war violence.

rosario-vampire-capu2.summary: Tsukune Aono, an ordinary human boy, starts his second year at Yokai Academy, a boarding school for monsters, still hiding what he is. His friends are a group of girls who all want his attention: the gentle vampire Moka Akashiya, whose fiercer side comes out when her rosary is removed, the succubus Kurumu, the young witch Yukari and the ice maiden Mizore. New trouble arrives with Kokoa Shuzen, Moka's combative younger sister, who wants the other Moka back. Gonzo produced this 13-episode second season, which aired from October to December 2008, based on Akihisa Ikeda's manga. Contains heavy fan service.

relife-kanketsu-hen.summary: This four-episode finale completes the ReLIFE story. Arata Kaizaki is a 27-year-old who quit a bad job and joined the ReLIFE programme, which made him look ten years younger and sent him back to high school for a year. That year has nearly run out. Arata has grown close to his classmates and has changed in ways he never expected, but his supervisor Ryo Yoake reminds him that when the experiment ends, his classmates will forget him. As graduation nears, Arata and his friends have to face what comes next. TMS Entertainment produced the episodes from Yayoiso's web manga, released together in March 2018.

baka-to-test-to-shoukanjuu-ni.summary: Fumizuki Academy ranks its students by exam scores, and students can summon small creatures whose strength matches their grades to fight over class privileges. Class F, at the bottom, is led by the scheming Yuji Sakamoto and full of hopeless cases, most of all Akihisa Yoshii, the school's best-known idiot. In this second season, the two boys are blackmailed by an unknown stalker who threatens to reveal embarrassing secrets, the girls around them push their own romantic plans, and the summoned creatures begin acting strangely. Silver Link produced 13 episodes, aired from July to September 2011, based on Kenji Inoue's light novels.

boruto-naruto-the-movie.summary: Years after the great ninja war, Naruto Uzumaki is the Seventh Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village, and he is so busy that his son Boruto hardly sees him. Boruto is talented but resentful. When he learns Naruto will watch the upcoming Chunin Exams, he decides to impress him and asks Sasuke Uchiha, his father's old rival and friend, to train him. He is also tempted by a new scientific ninja tool that could give him a shortcut. Studio Pierrot made the film, directed by Hiroyuki Yamashita, with a screenplay by series creator Masashi Kishimoto, and it opened in Japan in August 2015.

arifureta-shokugyou-de-sekai-saikyou.summary: Hajime Nagumo is a quiet otaku who gets pulled into a fantasy world along with his entire high school class and their teacher. His classmates receive powerful combat skills, but Hajime gets only basic transmutation, a craftsman's ability, and the others look down on him. During an expedition into a deep labyrinth, one of them betrays him and he falls to the bottom of the abyss. Alone and starving among monsters, he hardens into someone far colder and starts building guns and gear, determined to find a way home. White Fox and Asread adapted Ryo Shirakome's light novels into 13 episodes, broadcast between July and October 2019. Contains graphic violence and some fan service.

nodame-cantabile.summary: Shinichi Chiaki is the star student at a Tokyo music college: gifted on piano and violin, fluent in several languages and quietly set on becoming a conductor in Europe. A fear of flying keeps him stuck in Japan, and his patience is wearing thin. Then he meets his neighbour Megumi Noda, called Nodame, a piano student who lives in a wildly messy flat and plays by ear with startling talent but no discipline. Their odd partnership pulls Chiaki into the college's student orchestra and changes how both of them think about music. J.C.Staff adapted Tomoko Ninomiya's josei manga into 23 episodes, broadcast from January to June 2007 in Fuji TV's Noitamina slot.

arakawa-under-the-bridge.summary: Kou Ichinomiya has lived by one family rule his whole life: never owe anyone anything. Then he tumbles into the Arakawa River in Tokyo and is pulled out by Nino, a girl in a tracksuit who says she comes from Venus. Desperate to repay the debt, he lets her name the price, and she asks him to be her boyfriend. That means moving under the bridge, where a whole community of oddballs lives, led by a man in a kappa costume who gives Kou the nickname Recruit. Shaft adapted Hikaru Nakamura's manga into 13 episodes of absurd, deadpan comedy, aired from April to June 2010.

noragami-aragoto-ova.summary: These two episodes are side stories for Noragami, the series about Yato, a minor god without a shrine who takes odd jobs for five yen, his young weapon spirit Yukine, and Hiyori Iki, a schoolgirl whose soul tends to slip out of her body. In the first, Hiyori goes skiing with her parents and runs into Yato and Yukine, as well as a crowd of other gods on a company trip, before a plot to commit a crime targets Yato. In the second, Yato has money for once and treats Hiyori and Yukine to a day at an amusement park. Bones released the episodes with limited editions of the manga in 2015 and 2016.
noragami-aragoto-ova.notes: Episode premises come from MyAnimeList; AniList and Kitsu reuse the same MAL text. Studio, count and manga-bundle release confirmed by MAL, AniList and Kitsu notes.

outbreak-company.summary: Shinichi Kano is a shut-in otaku who answers a job advert looking for someone with deep knowledge of anime, manga and games. After the interview he is knocked out and wakes up in the Holy Eldant Empire, a fantasy land of elves, dwarves and dragons linked to Japan by a portal. The Japanese government wants him to spread otaku culture there as a kind of soft diplomacy. With a half-elf maid named Myucel, the young empress Petralka and his bodyguard Minori from the Self-Defense Forces, he sets out to open a shop and a school. Feel adapted Ichiro Sakaki's light novels into 12 episodes, aired from October to December 2013. Contains fan service.

b-gata-h-kei.summary: Yamada is a first-year high school girl who considers herself beautiful and has a bold goal: sleeping with a hundred men. The problem is that she has no experience at all and panics whenever things might go anywhere. Deciding her first partner should be just as inexperienced, she sets her sights on Takashi Kosuda, a plain, ordinary classmate. Her clumsy attempts at seduction keep backfiring, and she is caught off guard by real feelings for him. Hal Film Maker adapted Yoko Sanri's four-panel manga into a 12-episode sex comedy, broadcast from April to June 2010. Contains frequent sexual content, nudity and explicit humour.

tate-no-yuusha-no-nariagari-2.summary: Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero, was summoned to another world with three other heroes to fight the Waves, disasters that pour monsters into the land. With Raphtalia and Filo at his side, he is getting ready for the next Wave when the countdown suddenly freezes and creatures attack a village under his protection. The queen calls the four heroes together and links the disturbance to the Spirit Tortoise, a colossal beast that has woken from a long sleep. A plan is made to stop it, though Naofumi finds few willing allies. Kinema Citrus and DR Movie produced this 13-episode second season, broadcast between April and June 2022. Contains fantasy violence.

gokukoku-no-brynhildr.summary: As a child, Ryota Murakami went searching for proof of aliens with his friend Kuroneko, until an accident left him badly hurt and killed her. Ten years later he is a top student with a near-perfect memory, the only member of his school's astronomy club and still watching the sky to keep his promise to her. Then a new girl, Neko Kuroha, joins his class, looking just like Kuroneko but claiming not to know him. She soon turns out to be one of several girls with magical powers who escaped from a secret laboratory, and who are now being hunted. Arms adapted Lynn Okamoto's manga into 13 episodes in 2014. Contains graphic violence, gore and nudity.

hidan-no-aria.summary: Tokyo Butei High trains Butei, armed detectives licensed to carry weapons and arrest criminals. Kinji Toyama keeps a deliberately low profile to hide Hysteria Mode, an inherited state that makes him far stronger and sharper when he is sexually excited. His quiet routine ends when he is caught in a bomb attack on the way to school, the work of a criminal called the Butei Killer, and is rescued by Aria H. Kanzaki, a tiny, fiery S-rank transfer student descended from Sherlock Holmes, who decides she wants him as her partner. J.C.Staff adapted Chugaku Akamatsu's light novels into 12 episodes, aired from April to July 2011. Contains gun violence and fan service.

kaguya-sama-wa-kokurasetai-tensai-tachi-.summary: Shuchiin Academy's student council is back for a third season of mind games. Miyuki Shirogane, the council president, and Kaguya Shinomiya, his deputy, are clearly attracted to each other, but both are too proud to confess first, since in their eyes whoever admits it loses. As they realise their scheming is getting them nowhere, the school's cultural festival begins to look like the moment to finally settle it. Treasurer Yu Ishigami, secretary Chika Fujiwara and auditor Miko Iino get plenty of their own storylines along the way. A-1 Pictures adapted Aka Akasaka's manga into 13 episodes, aired from April to June 2022 under the subtitle Ultra Romantic.

doukyuusei-m.summary: Hikaru Kusakabe is a laid-back student at an all-boys high school who plays guitar in a band. Rihito Sajo is the quiet honour student with top grades who keeps to himself. When the class has to prepare for a choir festival, Kusakabe catches Sajo practising alone and struggling to sing, and he offers to help him learn the piece. The lessons turn into a gentle, slow-burning first romance between two boys who seem to have nothing in common. A-1 Pictures adapted the first volume of Asumiko Nakamura's manga as a film directed by Shoko Nakamura, released in Japanese cinemas in February 2016.

beck.summary: Yukio Tanaka, known as Koyuki, is a fourteen-year-old who feels his life is going nowhere. That changes when he saves a strange-looking dog called Beck from a group of kids and meets its owner, Ryusuke Minami, a sixteen-year-old guitarist who spent years living in New York. Ryusuke introduces Koyuki to Western rock music, and Koyuki starts learning guitar while also falling for Ryusuke's younger half-sister Maho, a talented singer. Soon Ryusuke is putting a new band together, and Koyuki is drawn into its ups and downs. Madhouse adapted Harold Sakuishi's manga into 26 episodes, directed by Osamu Kobayashi, broadcast between October 2004 and March 2005.

fullmetal-alchemist-brotherhood-specials.summary: These four short side episodes were released with Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood on home video and widen the world of Edward and Alphonse Elric, the two young alchemists at its centre. In The Blind Alchemist, the brothers follow rumours that someone has succeeded at human transmutation. Simple People looks at small moments in the lives of Winry Rockbell and Riza Hawkeye. The Tale of Teacher shows a young Izumi Curtis training in the icy north. Yet Another Man's Battlefield goes back to Roy Mustang's military academy days and his friendship with Maes Hughes. Bones released the episodes between August 2009 and August 2010, based on Hiromu Arakawa's manga.

kotoura-san.summary: Haruka Kotoura has been able to read minds since she was little, and growing up she kept blurting out what people were really thinking. Classmates, teachers and eventually her own family turned against her, and she ended up alone and withdrawn. When she starts at a new high school she expects more of the same, until Yoshihisa Manabe, a cheerful boy with a very dirty imagination, decides to befriend her and does not care that she can hear his thoughts. With his help she joins an ESP research club and slowly begins to open up. AIC Classic adapted Enokizu's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in early 2013. Contains bullying and emotional abuse.

isshuukan-friends.summary: Yuki Hase notices that Kaori Fujimiya, a pretty classmate, is always on her own and politely refuses every attempt at friendship. He keeps trying anyway, meeting her for lunch on the school roof, and gradually learns why she keeps her distance: every Monday, her memories of the friends she made that week disappear. Undeterred, Yuki decides to become her friend again each week, with help from his blunt best friend Shogo. The result is a quiet, gentle school story about patience and friendship. Brain's Base adapted Matcha Hazuki's manga into 12 episodes, aired from April to June 2014.

gintama-2017.summary: Edo, an alternate-history Japan ruled behind the scenes by alien Amanto, is in political turmoil, and Gintoki Sakata, Shinpachi Shimura and Kagura of the Yorozuya odd-jobs agency are lying low with Katsura's rebels. Members of the Kiheitai, the radical faction led by Gintoki's old comrade Shinsuke Takasugi, arrive with a request: Takasugi has disappeared after an attack by the Harusame space pirates, his former allies, and they want him found. The search takes the group to Rakuyo, Kagura's home planet, where rival factions are gathering. This 12-episode run from Bandai Namco Pictures, based on Hideaki Sorachi's manga, aired from January to March 2017. Contains violence.

one-punch-man-ova.summary: This single episode goes back to the days before Saitama became the bald hero who wins every fight with one punch. Back then he was still training hard and taking on monsters, and every battle shredded his tracksuit. A kindly local tailor kept patching it up for free, until the tailor tells him he has to close the shop because a gang has been leaning on him. Saitama decides to help and comes away with something more important than a repaired outfit. Madhouse produced the episode, based on ONE's webcomic and Yusuke Murata's manga, and it was packaged with the manga's tenth volume in December 2015.

mirai-nikki-redial.summary: This short epilogue to the Future Diary TV series follows Yuno Gasai in a world where she is an ordinary first-year high school student. She gets along with her parents, has a small group of friends and comes home happy from a seaside school outing, yet she cannot shake the feeling that someone vital is absent, a person she seems to have known in another existence. One night after the trip she begins hearing a voice that nobody else can hear. Asread produced the single episode, based on Sakae Esuno's spin-off manga; it streamed in June 2013 and came out on DVD with the manga that July.
mirai-nikki-redial.notes: Best watched after the Future Diary TV series, which it follows.

black-rock-shooter-tv.summary: On her first day of middle school, the outgoing Mato Kuroi meets Yomi Takanashi, a shy, guarded girl, and is set on befriending her. The two bond over a favourite picture book and quickly become close, but school life brings jealousy, misunderstandings and pressure from the people around them. In another world, a silent warrior girl named Black Rock Shooter fights a series of strange opponents in surreal, empty landscapes, and those battles seem tied to what the girls feel. Ordet and Sanzigen made this eight-episode series, written by Mari Okada and based on huke's illustrations, for Fuji TV's Noitamina in early 2012. Contains violence and dark psychological themes.

gin-no-saji.summary: Yugo Hachiken is a studious city boy worn down by exams and pressure at home. He enrols at Ooezo Agricultural High School, a rural boarding school in Hokkaido, mostly to get away, and assumes his good grades will make it easy. Instead he finds himself surrounded by classmates who grew up on farms, rising before dawn to tend animals and facing hard questions about where food comes from. Joining the equestrian club and befriending Aki Mikage, he slowly starts to work out what he actually wants. A-1 Pictures adapted Hiromu Arakawa's manga into 11 episodes, aired from July to September 2013.

5-toubun-no-hanayome-2.summary: Futaro Uesugi is a gifted but poor high school student taken on to tutor the Nakano quintuplets, five identical sisters with very different personalities and dreadful grades. Itsuki, Yotsuba, Miku, Nino and Ichika are making slow progress toward graduation, but lessons keep getting derailed by the sisters' own problems, and Futaro finds himself more and more involved in their lives. Several of the sisters' feelings toward him are deepening, and he begins to wonder about a link between them and a girl he met as a child. Bibury Animation Studios took over for this 12-episode second season of Negi Haruba's manga, broadcast between January and March 2021.

tokyo-magnitude-8-0.summary: Mirai Onozawa is a moody middle schooler who is fed up with her family and grudgingly takes her little brother Yuki to a robot exhibition in Odaiba on the first day of summer vacation. While they are there, a magnitude 8.0 earthquake strikes Tokyo. With phone lines down and much of the city damaged, the two set out on foot for home in Setagaya, helped by Mari, a motorcycle courier trying to get back to her own family. The series follows their journey across a city in crisis. Bones and Kinema Citrus produced the 11-episode original anime, directed by Masaki Tachibana, for Noitamina in 2009. Contains disaster imagery and scenes of injury and loss.

kara-no-kyoukai-5-mujun-rasen.summary: In late 1998, a teenager named Tomoe Enjo flees after what he believes was the killing of his parents in a newly built apartment block. Strangely, no police come after him and no news reports mention it. After Shiki Ryougi, a young woman with the power to see the lines of death in all things, rescues him from a street fight, she lets him hide out in her flat. Days later Tomoe finds evidence that his mother is still alive, and Shiki, her friend Mikiya Kokutou and the magus Touko Aozaki start to suspect the building itself. Ufotable adapted this chapter of Kinoko Nasu's novel as a film released in August 2008. Contains graphic violence and disturbing scenes.

aho-girl.summary: Yoshiko Hanabatake is a high school girl who is spectacularly stupid. She scores zero on her tests, is obsessed with bananas and treats every situation with a cheerful lack of sense that has exhausted even her own mother. The only person willing to rein her in is her childhood friend and neighbour Akuru Akutsu, called A-kun, a serious student who answers her antics with blunt and often violent retorts. Classmate Sayaka Sumino and a growing cast of oddballs get dragged into the chaos. Diomedea adapted Hiroyuki's four-panel manga into 12 short gag episodes, aired from July to September 2017. Contains slapstick violence and crude humour.

jigoku-shoujo.summary: A rumour says that at midnight a website called Hell Correspondence appears, and anyone who types in the name of a person they hate will be visited by Ai Enma, the Hell Girl. She offers a straw doll with a red string around its neck: pulling it sends the target straight to hell. The price is that the person who made the request will also go to hell when they die. Each episode follows someone pushed to breaking point by bullying, abuse or betrayal and asks whether revenge is worth it. Studio Deen produced this 26-episode original series, aired from October 2005 to April 2006. Contains disturbing themes, abuse and violence.

zero-no-tsukaima-f.summary: Saito Hiraga is a Japanese teenager who was summoned to the magical land of Halkeginia as the familiar of Louise, a hot-tempered noble girl whose spells used to blow up in her face, and he has since become her devoted protector. In this final season the two are caught up in growing conflict between kingdoms, with a confrontation looming involving King Joseph of Gallia and the Holy City of Romalia. Others who wield the rare void magic come into play, an ancient threat begins to wake, and the pair's relationship is pushed further. J.C.Staff produced these 12 episodes from Noboru Yamaguchi's light novels, aired from January to March 2012. Contains fan service.

tengen-toppa-gurren-lagann-movie-lagann-.summary: This is the second of two films that retell the Gurren Lagann TV series with new footage and changes. Simon, once a timid digger from an underground village, and his comrades are now living through seven years of peace and rapid growth after humanity has won back the surface of the Earth. That comfort leaves them unprepared when a mysterious and overwhelming enemy called the Anti-Spiral appears, and the threat soon grows far beyond anything they have faced, pushing the mecha battles to a cosmic scale. Gainax produced the film, which covers the latter half of the series and opened in Japan in April 2009. Contains action violence.
tengen-toppa-gurren-lagann-movie-lagann-.notes: Film retelling of the second half of the TV series with substantial new animation and changes rather than a clip compilation; kept and labelled as a retelling.

attack-on-titan-lost-girls.summary: These three episodes adapt a spin-off novel about two of Attack on Titan's most formidable soldiers. In Wall Sina, Goodbye, told across two parts, Military Police recruit Annie Leonhart needs her comrade Hitch to cover for an unexplained absence. Hitch agrees on one condition: Annie must solve the missing-person case of Carly Stratmann, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, and she has just one day to do it. Lost in the Cruel World turns to Mikasa Ackerman and imagines a version of her life in which her family was never torn apart. Wit Studio released the episodes between December 2017 and August 2018, based on Hiroshi Seko's novel. Contains violence.

fullmetal-alchemist-the-conqueror-of-sha.summary: This film is the direct sequel to and conclusion of the 2003 Fullmetal Alchemist TV series. Edward Elric has been stranded for two years in a world without alchemy: our own Earth, in Munich in the uneasy 1920s. With his powers gone, he studies rocketry alongside Alfons Heiderich, whose face is uncannily like his brother's, hoping science can carry him home. Meanwhile Alphonse is searching for a way to reach him from the other side, and Edward's research gets him noticed by the Thule Society, a group that sees his homeworld as a source of power. Bones produced the film, directed by Seiji Mizushima, released in July 2005. Contains violence.
fullmetal-alchemist-the-conqueror-of-sha.notes: Follows the 2003 Fullmetal Alchemist anime, not Brotherhood.

dragon-ball-kai.summary: Five years after the original Dragon Ball, Goku is a grown man with a wife, Chi-Chi, and a young son, Gohan. A reunion with his old friends is interrupted when Raditz, a powerful alien warrior, arrives with startling news about Goku's origins and kidnaps Gohan. To rescue his son, Goku must join forces with Piccolo, his old enemy, and before long even stronger fighters are heading for Earth in pursuit of the wish-granting Dragon Balls. Toei Animation made Kai for Dragon Ball Z's 20th anniversary as a recut, remastered version that re-records the dialogue and trims most anime-only filler. Its first run aired for 97 episodes from 2009 to 2011. Contains martial arts violence.

c-the-money-of-soul-and-possibility-cont.summary: In a Japan battered by recession, Kimimaro Yoga is a 19-year-old economics student on a scholarship who wants nothing more than a stable, ordinary life and spends his time working part-time jobs. One night a strange man in a top hat called Masakaki proposes to hand him a big pile of cash if he will put up his future as collateral. Accepting makes Kimimaro an Entre in the Financial District, a hidden realm where people fight weekly money battles using creatures called Assets. His partner is Mashu, a horned girl who fights with fire. Tatsunoko Production made this 11-episode original series, directed by Kenji Nakamura, for Fuji TV's Noitamina in 2011.

denpa-onna-to-seishun-otoko.summary: Makoto Niwa likes to keep score of his teenage life, adding up good and bad youthful experiences as if grading himself. When his parents leave Japan for work, he moves to a provincial town and in with his aunt, Meme Towa, hoping for a fresh start. He had no idea he had a cousin, but Erio lives there too: a strange girl who wraps herself in a futon, rarely speaks sense and claims to be an alien. Determined to coax her back into the world, Makoto also meets other unusual girls in town. Shaft adapted Hitoma Iruma's light novels into 12 episodes of quirky slice of life, aired in spring 2011 under director Akiyuki Shinbo.

little-busters.summary: After losing his parents as a child, Riki Naoe sank into despair until a group of kids pulled him into their gang, the Little Busters. Led by the energetic Kyousuke Natsume, with the muscle-bound Masato, the serious swordsman Kengo and Kyousuke's shy sister Rin, they shared a childhood of games and small adventures. Now in high school, Riki also lives with narcolepsy, and the friends are still together. Kyousuke decides the group should form a baseball team, which leaves Riki the job of recruiting new members, and each girl he approaches has her own worries. J.C.Staff adapted Key's visual novel into 26 episodes, aired from October 2012 to April 2013.

digimon-adventure.summary: At summer camp, seven children are caught in a sudden, impossible snowfall. Strange devices fall from the sky, and the kids are swept into the Digital World, a land inhabited by Digital Monsters, or Digimon. Each child is paired with a Digimon partner that can transform into stronger forms, and together they look for a way home while dangerous Digimon hunt them. Tai and the others gradually learn that they may have been chosen to save this world. Toei Animation's original series spanned 54 episodes on Fuji TV from March 1999 to March 2000 and was the first anime in the Digimon franchise.

natsume-yuujinchou-shi.summary: Takashi Natsume, a gentle teenage boy who has always been able to see yokai, still keeps the Book of Friends that he inherited from his grandmother Reiko, a book full of the names of spirits she bound. He goes on returning those names to their owners with help from Nyanko-sensei, a proud and greedy spirit who usually looks like a round lucky cat. In this fourth season, alongside new encounters with spirits both kind and dangerous, Natsume starts to face more of his own past, including the years he spent passed between relatives. Brain's Base adapted Yuki Midorikawa's manga into 13 episodes, aired from January to March 2012.

phantom-requiem-for-the-phantom.summary: While travelling in the United States, a Japanese teenager stumbles onto a murder committed by Phantom, the top assassin of a secret crime syndicate called Inferno. He is caught, his memories are wiped and he is given a choice between dying and joining them. Renamed Zwei, he is trained by the assassin Ein, a silent, emotionless girl, and drawn into mob politics and killing in America's criminal underworld while trying to hold on to his humanity. Bee Train adapted Nitroplus's visual novel, written by Gen Urobuchi, into 26 episodes directed by Koichi Mashimo, broadcast from April to September 2009. Contains graphic violence and some sexual content.

is-infinite-stratos-2.summary: Infinite Stratos are powerful exoskeletons that only women can pilot, until Ichika Orimura becomes the one known exception and is enrolled at IS Academy, a school full of girls training to use them. In this second season he is still caught between five rival pilots who all have feelings for him: his childhood friends Houki and Lingyin, plus Cecilia, Charlotte and Laura from abroad. New pressure comes from the Sarashiki sisters, including the playful student council president Tatenashi, and a group of enemy pilots armed with stolen units. 8bit produced the 12 episodes from Izuru Yumizuru's light novels, broadcast between October and December 2013. Contains fan service.

zoku-natsume-yuujinchou.summary: Takashi Natsume is a gentle teenager who has always been able to see yokai, the spirits of Japanese folklore, which made his childhood lonely. He has inherited the Book of Friends from his grandmother Reiko, a record of the names of spirits she defeated, and he is working to give those names back. With Nyanko-sensei, a powerful spirit in the shape of a chubby cat, acting as his reluctant bodyguard, he meets spirits who are friendly, mischievous or out for his life. This second season continues the gentle, episodic stories. Brain's Base adapted Yuki Midorikawa's manga into 13 episodes, aired from January to March 2009.

campione.summary: In this world the gods of myth are real, and when a rogue god walks the Earth, people experience it as a natural disaster. Godou Kusanagi, a sixteen-year-old former baseball player, travels to Sardinia to hand back a stone tablet on his grandfather's behalf. There he meets Erica Blandelli, a proud knight and magician, and gets caught up in a clash with the war god Verethragna. Godou unexpectedly comes out of it as a Campione, a god-slayer obliged to face other renegade gods, and he soon has several young women at his side. Diomedea adapted Jo Taketsuki's light novels into 13 episodes, aired from July to September 2012. Contains fan service.

mononoke.summary: In late Edo-era Japan, a mysterious wanderer called simply the Medicine Seller hunts mononoke, spirits that cling to the living through human grudges and emotion. He can only draw his exorcism sword once he has learned the spirit's Form, Truth and Reason, so each case is a supernatural investigation into the secrets and sins of the people around it. The series is told in short arcs, with a highly stylised visual design. Toei Animation produced the 12 episodes, directed by Kenji Nakamura, as a spin-off of Ayakashi: Samurai Horror Tales, airing in 2007. Contains disturbing imagery, violence and themes of abuse.

one-piece-episode-of-nami-koukaishi-no-n.summary: This TV special retells the Arlong Park arc of One Piece in a single feature with new animation. Monkey D. Luffy, a rubber-bodied young pirate, has started gathering a crew, and Nami, a sharp navigator and thief, has joined him. Then she suddenly makes off with the crew's ship and treasure and heads to her home island, now ruled by Arlong, a brutal fish-man pirate who has bribed the Navy to look away. Luffy and the others follow her to find out why. Toei Animation produced the special, which aired in August 2012 and is based on Eiichiro Oda's manga. Contains violence.
one-piece-episode-of-nami-koukaishi-no-n.notes: Newly animated condensed retelling of the Arlong Park arc rather than a clip compilation; kept and labelled as a retelling.

sakasama-no-patema.summary: Patema is a curious girl from an underground community that lives in a maze of tunnels and keeps its people out of forbidden areas. Inspired by a friend who vanished, she keeps exploring until a sudden scare sends her falling down a shaft and out into the open sky above. To her, the surface world is upside down: gravity pulls her up, and she could fall into the sky forever. Eiji, a boy from the strictly controlled society of Aiga, catches her, and the two have to help each other while authorities hunt her. Yasuhiro Yoshiura wrote and directed this original science fiction film, released in Japan in November 2013.

acchi-kocchi.summary: Tsumiki Miniwa is a small, quiet high school girl who is very much in love with her calm, kind classmate Io Otonashi. She cannot bring herself to tell him, and Io, though plainly fond of her, never quite seems to notice. Their friends, the teasing Mayoi, the cheerful Hime and the easygoing Sakaki, can see exactly how the two feel and keep trying to nudge them together during everyday school life, holidays and outings. Their relationship stays somewhere between friendship and romance, and much of the comedy comes from Tsumiki's flustered reactions. AIC adapted Ishiki's four-panel manga into 12 episodes, aired from April to June 2012.

aldnoah-zero-2.summary: In this alternate history, settlers on Mars used ancient alien technology called Aldnoah to found the Vers Empire, and its Orbital Knights went to war with Earth. The second season opens nineteen months after the fighting of the first appeared to stop, when the Vers princess publicly denounces Earth and calls on the knights to take up arms again. Inaho Kaizuka, a calm and analytical young pilot, rejoins the Earth forces aboard the warship Deucalion, while Slaine Troyard, an Earth-born boy raised among the Martians, now stands on the other side. A-1 Pictures and Troyca produced the 12 episodes, created by Gen Urobuchi, aired from January to March 2015. Contains war violence.

mushishi-zoku-shou.summary: Mushi are the most basic forms of life, simple beings that most people cannot see but whose presence can cause strange illnesses, odd weather and impossible events. Ginko is a mushishi, a quiet, white-haired wanderer who travels through rural Japan in an imagined era bridging the Edo and Meiji periods, investigating these cases and trying to help people live alongside the mushi rather than simply destroy them. Each episode is a self-contained story, calm and meditative in tone. Artland returned to Yuki Urushibara's manga for this 10-episode second series, directed by Hiroshi Nagahama and aired from April to June 2014, eight years after the first.

natsume-yuujinchou-san.summary: Takashi Natsume is a kind-hearted teenager who can see yokai, the spirits of Japanese folklore, a gift that left him isolated as a child. He has inherited the Book of Friends from his grandmother Reiko, which holds the names of spirits she bound to her, and he is returning those names one by one. His bodyguard is Nyanko-sensei, a powerful spirit who usually passes as a fat, sake-loving cat. In this third season Natsume grows more at ease with his ability and with the people and spirits who now matter to him, while new encounters test him. Brain's Base adapted Yuki Midorikawa's manga into 13 episodes, aired from July to September 2011.

gintama-kanketsu-hen-yorozuya-yo-eien-na.summary: Gintoki Sakata, the lazy samurai who runs the Yorozuya odd-jobs business in an alien-occupied Edo, is working at a cinema when he tackles a man filming the screen with a camera for a head. The camera pulls him into the future: five years on, Edo is a ruined wasteland swept by a disease called the White Plague, and Gintoki himself is said to be dead. His old partners Shinpachi and Kagura have drifted apart, and Gintoki sets out, in disguise, to find out what happened. Sunrise produced the film, directed by Yoichi Fujita from a story by Hideaki Sorachi, and it opened in Japan in July 2013. Contains violence.

ano-hi-mita-hana-no-namae-wo-bokutachi-w.summary: This sequel film to the Anohana TV series is set one year after the summer when the ghost of Meiko Honma, known as Menma, appeared to her childhood friend Jinta Yadomi and brought their old group back together in Chichibu. Jinta and the rest of their old gang, the Super Peace Busters, each set out to write Menma a letter, and while they do so each of them looks back on the time they spent with her, both as children and during that summer. Much of the film revisits events from the series through the different friends' points of view, framed by new scenes. A-1 Pictures produced it, directed by Tatsuyuki Nagai, and it opened in Japan in August 2013.
ano-hi-mita-hana-no-namae-wo-bokutachi-w.notes: Largely retells the TV series through the friends' memories, framed by new scenes set a year later; best watched after the series.

seto-no-hanayome.summary: On summer vacation by the Seto Inland Sea, middle schooler Nagasumi Michishio gets a cramp while swimming and nearly drowns, until a mermaid named Sun Seto saves him. Under mermaid law, though, a human who learns a mermaid's secret must die, or she must. The way out is for the two to marry, and since Sun's family happens to run a mermaid yakuza clan, her furious father Gozaburo is not happy about it. Soon Nagasumi has a gangster fiancee, her father's henchmen trying to get rid of him and a steady stream of rivals. Gonzo and AIC adapted Tahiko Kimura's manga into 26 episodes of fast-paced parody comedy, aired from April to October 2007.

school-rumble.summary: Tenma Tsukamoto is a cheerful, scatterbrained second-year who is desperate to confess to Oji Karasuma, a strange, quiet classmate who seems to notice almost nothing. Kenji Harima is a fearsome delinquent with a soft heart, and the girl he loves is Tenma herself. As both of them try and fail to get their feelings across, misunderstandings pile up and pull in their friends, rivals and classmates, often in absurd directions. The romantic comedy freely sets realism aside for gags, parodies and sudden changes of genre. Studio Comet adapted Jin Kobayashi's manga into 26 episodes, broadcast on TV Tokyo from October 2004 to March 2005.

kamisama-no-memochou.summary: Narumi Fujishima is a gloomy high school student who has moved schools so often that he never fits in anywhere. When his classmate Ayaka Shinozaki pulls him into the gardening club, he is introduced to Alice, a young genius hacker who never leaves her room above Hanamaru, the noodle restaurant where Ayaka has a part-time job. Alice runs a detective agency staffed by NEETs, a crew of unemployed misfits with odd skills, and she takes on Narumi as her assistant. Together they investigate cases around the city, some of them dangerous. J.C.Staff adapted Hikaru Sugii's light novels into 12 episodes, aired from July to September 2011. Contains violence and drug-related themes.

full-metal-panic-fumoffu.summary: Sousuke Sagara is a teenage soldier from a secret mercenary group who has been posted undercover at Jindai High School in Tokyo to guard his classmate Kaname Chidori. Having grown up on battlefields, he treats ordinary school life like a war zone: love letters look like bomb threats, rival students look like enemy agents and almost any problem can be solved with explosives. Kaname, the student council vice president, does her best to keep him under control, while Sousuke turns a theme-park mascot costume called Bonta-kun into combat gear. Set apart from the main story's mecha battles, this spin-off is pure comedy. Kyoto Animation produced the 12 episodes from Shoji Gatoh's light novels, airing in 2003.

ben-to.summary: You Sato is an ordinary high school student who stops at a supermarket one evening to grab a discounted bento box. Before he can reach it, he is beaten to the floor. He soon learns that when the store's half-price stickers go on, the food aisle becomes a battleground where skilled fighters, known as Wolves, brawl for the best meals under an unspoken code of honour. Recruited by the cool and formidable Sen Yarizui into the Half-Pricers' club, You starts learning to fight for his dinner. David Production adapted Asaura's light novels into 12 episodes, aired from October to December 2011. Contains comic violence and fan service.

chaos-head.summary: Shibuya is gripped by grisly killings dubbed the New Generation Madness, but Takumi Nishijo barely cares. He is a reclusive high school otaku who lives alone in a cargo container on a rooftop, prefers online games to real people and often slips into delusions. Then a user called Shogun sends him a photo of a body pinned up with stakes, and soon after Takumi seems to witness that very killing, with a pink-haired girl at the scene calling his name. Sure the killer is after him, he can no longer tell what is real. Madhouse adapted the visual novel by Nitroplus and 5pb. into 12 episodes, aired from October to December 2008. Contains graphic violence and disturbing imagery.

kobayashi-san-chi-no-maid-dragon-S.summary: Kobayashi is an office worker in Tokyo who shares her flat with Tohru, a dragon from another world who took human form to work as her devoted maid, and Kanna, a young dragon now happily attending elementary school. Their days are full of small domestic chaos. That changes when a huge landslide appears on the hill where Kobayashi first met Tohru, and the dragon behind it turns up: Ilulu, a hostile dragon from the Chaos faction who objects to Tohru living with a human and is set on breaking up the household. Kyoto Animation adapted Coolkyoushinja's manga for this 12-episode second season, aired from July to September 2021.

death-billiards.summary: An elderly man and a young man find themselves in a dim, stylish bar called Quindecim, with no idea how they got there. A white-haired bartender greets them and explains that they must play a game chosen by roulette, in this case billiards, and that they cannot leave until it is finished. He also asks them to play as though their lives depend on it. As the match goes on, tension rises and the two strangers reveal more about who they are. Madhouse made this short film, which Yuzuru Tachikawa wrote and directed, for the Anime Mirai 2013 young animator training project, and it later inspired the series Death Parade. Contains violence.

boku-no-hero-academia-6th-season.summary: In a world where most people are born with superpowers called Quirks, Izuku Midoriya is training at U.A. High School to become a professional hero. The villains have grown into a vast organised force, the Paranormal Liberation Front, led by Tomura Shigaraki. Using intelligence from Hawks, a hero working undercover inside the group, the pro heroes plan a surprise strike on the villains' bases, and Izuku and his classmates are called up to support them. The result is an all-out conflict that shakes the whole of society. Bones adapted Kohei Horikoshi's manga for this 25-episode sixth season, aired from October 2022 to March 2023. Contains graphic violence.

angel-beats-specials.summary: These two bonus episodes return to the afterlife school of Angel Beats!, where the rebellious Afterlife Battlefront, led by Yuri Nakamura, refuses to quietly pass on and resists Kanade Tachibana, the student council president they call Angel. In Stairway to Heaven, Yuri launches Operation High Tension Syndrome, a scheme to trick Kanade into believing the members are ready to move on, with a week of food at stake. The second episode, Hell's Kitchen, was released years later. P.A. Works made both specials, which were not broadcast: the first came with the seventh home video volume in December 2010 and the second with the Blu-ray box set in June 2015.
angel-beats-specials.notes: Best watched after the Angel Beats! TV series.

ginga-eiyuu-densetsu.summary: For around 150 years, the authoritarian Galactic Empire and the democratic Free Planets Alliance have been fighting an exhausting war across the stars. Two young commanders begin to change that. Reinhard von Lohengramm is a brilliant, ambitious imperial officer who rises through the ranks with his childhood friend Siegfried Kircheis, determined to bring down the decaying dynasty that took his sister. Yang Wen-li is an Alliance officer who would rather be a historian but keeps proving to be a superb strategist. Their parallel stories mix fleet battles with politics and philosophy. Kitty Film produced the 110-episode OVA series from Yoshiki Tanaka's novels between 1988 and 1997. Contains war violence.

gantz.summary: Teenagers Kei Kurono and Masaru Kato are hit and killed by a subway train after jumping down to rescue a drunken homeless man who has fallen onto the tracks. Instead of an afterlife, they wake up in a bare Tokyo apartment with other people who have just died, facing a large black sphere called Gantz. The sphere hands out strange weapons and black suits and orders the group to hunt down aliens hidden in the city, and the missions turn out to be brutally real. Gonzo adapted Hiroya Oku's manga into this 13-episode first season, directed by Ichiro Itano, aired in 2004. Contains extreme violence, gore and nudity.

unbreakable-machine-doll.summary: In an alternate early 20th century, a fusion of science and sorcery called Machinart brings mechanical dolls to life and gives them minds, and these automatons have become weapons. Raishin Akabane travels from Japan to Walpurgis Royal Academy in Liverpool, the leading school for the puppeteers who control them. With Yaya, his devoted and very affectionate automaton, he enters the academy's fierce competition to earn the title of Wiseman, while secretly hunting the man who destroyed his family. Lerche adapted Reiji Kaito's light novels into 12 episodes, aired from October to December 2013. Contains violence and fan service.

gakusen-toshi-asterisk-2nd-season.summary: After a meteor disaster gave some humans superhuman powers, Asterisk is a floating academy city where these Genestella students fight in televised tournaments. Ayato Amagiri attends Seidoukan Academy and fights alongside Julis-Alexia von Riessfeld, a fiery princess, in the Phoenix, a tag-team competition. In this second season the pair are pushing through the later rounds, but word has spread that Ayato's full strength is held back by a seal, which leaves them at a disadvantage against tougher opponents. Other teams from his circle chase their own goals too. A-1 Pictures adapted Yu Miyazaki's light novels into 12 episodes, aired from April to June 2016. Contains fan service.

to-love-ru-darkness.summary: Rito Yuki is a shy, clumsy high school boy who has a knack for falling into compromising situations with girls. He shares his home with Lala, a runaway alien princess from the planet Deviluke, and now her younger twin sisters Nana and Momo as well. Momo has fallen for Rito too, but instead of competing with her sister, she plots to surround him with a harem so that everyone can be with him. Meanwhile Golden Darkness, an alien assassin who has settled on Earth, struggles with her past as new arrivals stir trouble. Xebec adapted Saki Hasemi and Kentaro Yabuki's manga into 12 episodes in late 2012. Contains explicit fan service and nudity.

mushishi-zoku-shou-2.summary: Mushi are primitive, ghostly forms of life that most people cannot perceive, yet they can cause strange illnesses, distorted time, living shadows and other uncanny effects in the human world. Ginko, a soft-spoken, white-haired mushishi, continues his travels through the mountains and villages of an imagined old Japan, looking into these cases, explaining what he can and deciding how people and mushi might coexist. As before, each episode tells a separate, quiet story with no overarching plot. Artland and director Hiroshi Nagahama produced these 10 episodes, the second half of the second Mushishi series based on Yuki Urushibara's manga, aired from October to December 2014.

shokugeki-no-souma-shin-no-sara.summary: Soma Yukihira is a young cook from a family diner who has fought his way up at Totsuki Culinary Academy, an elite school where disputes are settled through cooking duels judged on taste. The academy is now in the middle of a team battle that will decide its future: Soma, Erina Nakiri and their allies have challenged the ruling Elite Ten council in a series of high-stakes cook-offs. Having won the first round, the rebels still face the council's strongest chefs and must push their skills further than ever. J.C.Staff adapted Yuto Tsukuda and Shun Saeki's manga for this 12-episode fourth season, aired from October to December 2019. Contains fan service.

air-gear.summary: Air Treks are motorised inline skates that have become a craze among young people, and daring riders known as Storm Riders form teams that battle in the streets for parts and pride. Itsuki Minami, called Ikki, is a brash middle schooler who rules his local turf in fist fights. He lives with four sisters who took him in as a child, and he soon discovers that they are members of a notorious Air Treks team called Sleeping Forest. Strapping on a pair himself, Ikki finds he has a gift for riding and sets out to climb to the top. Toei Animation adapted Oh! great's manga into 25 episodes in 2006. Contains violence and fan service.

tales-of-zestiria-the-x.summary: In the world of Glenwood, invisible spirits called Seraphim can bless the land, and the rare humans who can see and work with them are known as Shepherds. Sorey is a cheerful young man who grew up among Seraphim in a hidden village, alongside his close friend Mikleo, a water Seraph, and dreams of exploring ancient ruins. While exploring ruins with Mikleo, Sorey meets Alisha, a princess and knight who is searching for a Shepherd to save a land sinking into darkness, and he decides to help her. Ufotable adapted the Bandai Namco game, directed by Haruo Sotozaki, as this first season, aired from July to September 2016. Contains fantasy violence.

pokemon-the-first-movie.summary: Scientists working for the criminal group Team Rocket create Mewtwo, a powerful clone of the Mythical Pokemon Mew. Mewtwo rejects the purpose it was made for, turns against the humans who made it and resolves to prove itself stronger than any natural Pokemon. It then sends out invitations to the world's top trainers to meet it on a remote island. Ash Ketchum, along with his friends Misty and Brock and his partner Pikachu, accepts the challenge without knowing what Mewtwo is planning. Directed by Kunihiko Yuyama and animated by OLM, the film opened in Japan in July 1998 as the first Pokemon feature. Contains some action violence.

one-punch-man-specials.summary: These six short episodes were included with the home video releases of One-Punch Man's first season. They follow Saitama, a hero so strong that any fight ends with one punch, and the people around him in comic side stories written by series creator ONE. In the first, Genos, his cyborg disciple, secretly tails Saitama hoping to discover how his master became so strong, while someone with a grudge watches them both. Others put the spotlight on characters such as the ninja Sonic, the elderly martial artist Bang and a pair of sisters, and one revolves around a seemingly impossible murder. Madhouse produced them, released from December 2015 to May 2016.
one-punch-man-specials.notes: Episode list and first-episode premise from AniList and ANN; the subjects of later episodes are inferred from their official titles.

kokoro-connect-michi-random.summary: These four episodes form the final arc of the Kokoro Connect anime. Yui, Taichi, Himeko, Iori and Yoshifumi are the five members of their school's Cultural Research Club, and a mysterious being calling itself Heartseed has already put them through strange phenomena to test their friendship. Now a new one begins: their unspoken thoughts and feelings are randomly transmitted to one another, with no control over who hears what or when. As private feelings leak out, the group's bonds come under strain, while their club adviser may have to step down. Silver Link produced the episodes from Sadanatsu Anda's light novels, released at the end of 2012.

shouwa-genroku-rakugo-shinjuu-tv.summary: Fresh out of prison, a former petty gangster arrives at the door of Yakumo Yurakutei, the most celebrated rakugo storyteller in Japan, whose performance moved him while he was inside. Rakugo is a traditional comic art in which a lone performer kneels on stage and acts out every role in a story. The stern Yakumo unexpectedly accepts him as an apprentice and names him Yotaro. Yakumo's ward Konatsu, the daughter of his late rival and friend Sukeroku, is also part of the household, and much of the season looks back on Yakumo's youth and his bond with Sukeroku. Studio Deen adapted Haruko Kumota's josei manga into 13 episodes, aired in early 2016.

witch-craft-works.summary: Honoka Takamiya is an ordinary high school boy whose seat happens to be next to Ayaka Kagari, the beautiful and aloof idol of the school, which earns him trouble from her devoted fans. Then one day a school building comes hurtling through the air toward him, and he is saved by Ayaka, who turns out to be a powerful witch. She explains that she is assigned to protect him, because something inside Honoka makes him a target for a rival group called the Tower Witches. Before long, Honoka is surrounded by magical battles and eccentric witches. J.C.Staff adapted Ryu Mizunagi's manga into 12 episodes, broadcast in early 2014.

bungou-stray-dogs-hitori-ayumu.summary: In Yokohama, the Armed Detective Agency takes on cases too dangerous for the police, and its members have supernatural abilities named after famous writers. This single episode centres on Doppo Kunikida, the agency's stern idealist, who plans his days strictly by the notebook he always carries. While the others debate who would make the best second-in-command, Kunikida sets out on routine errands, only to be caught up in a bombing incident that forces him to weigh one life against hundreds and tests the principles he lives by. Bones produced the episode, released in August 2017 with a limited edition of the 13th manga volume by Kafka Asagiri and Sango Harukawa.
bungou-stray-dogs-hitori-ayumu.notes: Episode premise comes from the MyAnimeList synopsis (AniList reuses it); release and studio confirmed by Wikipedia, AniList and ANN.

chihayafuru-2.summary: Chihaya Ayase lives for competitive karuta, a fast, physical card game built around a classic anthology of one hundred Japanese poems. In this second season she and her friends from the Mizusawa High School karuta club, including her childhood friend Taichi Mashima, begin their second year. They need to recruit new members, keep their small club together and train for the national team championship at Omi Jingu, while Chihaya still dreams of becoming the Queen, Japan's top female player. Their other childhood friend Arata Wataya is pursuing the game on his own path. Madhouse adapted Yuki Suetsugu's josei manga into 25 episodes, broadcast between January and June 2013.

hamatora-the-animation.summary: Some people are born with a single superpower called a Minimum, and those Minimum Holders are trained at a special academy. Nice, a carefree young man, runs a small detective agency in Yokohama called Hamatora with his blunt partner Murasaki, and their office is just a table at Cafe Nowhere, where their friends also hang around waiting for work. Business picks up when someone starts murdering Minimum Holders in grisly ways, and the duo are pulled into the investigation. NAZ produced this 12-episode series, part of an original multimedia project, broadcast on TV Tokyo from January to March 2014. Contains violence.

one-piece-episode-of-merry-mou-hitori-no.summary: This TV special retells part of One Piece through the eyes of the Straw Hat Pirates' first real ship, the Going Merry. When the musician Brook asks where the crew's small boat got its name, Usopp and Chopper look back on the Merry's voyages with Captain Monkey D. Luffy and the others, a ship the crew treated as a friend and companion. The memories carry them through a turbulent stretch in which the crew is divided, Usopp falls out with Luffy over the ship and Robin is taken by government agents. Toei Animation produced the special, based on Eiichiro Oda's manga, which aired in August 2013. Contains violence.
one-piece-episode-of-merry-mou-hitori-no.notes: Newly animated condensed retelling of the Water 7 and Enies Lobby events with a new framing story; kept and labelled as a retelling.

dungeon-ni-deai-wo-motomeru-no-wa-machig.summary: In Orario, gods live among mortals and lead adventurer guilds called Familia that explore a vast, monster-filled Dungeon beneath the city. This spin-off of Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? follows the powerful Loki Familia rather than Bell Cranel. Its focus is Ais Wallenstein, the quiet swordswoman known as the Sword Princess, and Lefiya Viridis, a young elf mage who admires her and badly wants to stop being a burden in battle. During their expeditions they run into a new and unusual threat in the Dungeon. J.C.Staff adapted Fujino Omori's light novels into 12 episodes, aired from April to July 2017. Contains fantasy violence and some fan service.

wolf-s-rain.summary: Legend says that when the world ends, a Paradise will appear, and only wolves will know the way. Wolves were supposedly wiped out two centuries ago, but some survive by using illusions to look human. Kiba, a wounded white wolf, follows the trail of the Lunar Flower's scent to Freeze City, a cold and impoverished northern settlement, and meets three other wolves living there in disguise: the hardened Tsume, the easygoing Hige and the young Toboe. Together they set out across a dying world, pursued by humans who want them gone. Bones produced this original series, created by Keiko Nobumoto and directed by Tensai Okamura, which aired in 2003. Contains violence and death.

freezing.summary: In 2065, Earth is under attack by the Nova, deadly extra-dimensional beings. To fight them, the military trains Pandoras, young women whose implanted Stigmata give them superhuman strength and weapons, alongside male partners called Limiters, who can slow enemies with a freezing field. Kazuya Aoi, a newly arrived Limiter who lost his sister, herself a Pandora, comes to at West Genetics Academy and on his first day crosses paths with Satellizer el Bridget, a fearsome Pandora nicknamed the Untouchable Queen because she cannot bear physical contact. Their meeting sets off a chain of brutal duels. A.C.G.T. adapted Dall-Young Lim and Kwang-Hyun Kim's manga into 12 episodes in early 2011. Contains graphic violence, nudity and heavy fan service.

ef-a-tale-of-memories.summary: On Christmas Eve, Hiro Hirono, a high schooler, has his bicycle taken by Miyako Miyamura, an impulsive girl chasing a purse snatcher. The two end up spending the evening together, and Miyako begins to pull Hiro into her life, much to the distress of his childhood friend Kei Shindo. Meanwhile, Renji Aso befriends Chihiro Shindo, Kei's twin sister, a quiet girl at a disused train station whose memory lasts only thirteen hours. She hopes to write a novel one day, and Renji offers to help. Shaft adapted minori's visual novel into 12 episodes, with director Shin Oonuma, aired from October to December 2007.

air-tv.summary: Yukito Kunisaki is a poor drifter who makes a living with a small street puppet show. He is searching for a girl said to be waiting in the sky, a story his mother passed down to him. Stopping in a quiet seaside town in the heat of summer, he meets Misuzu Kamio, a cheerful, lonely girl who invites him to stay at her home, and he soon gets to know other girls in town who carry their own burdens. Kyoto Animation adapted Key's visual novel into this TV series, directed by Tatsuya Ishihara and broadcast from January to March 2005.

high-school-of-the-dead-drifters-of-the-.summary: This single original episode takes a break from the zombie apocalypse of Highschool of the Dead. Takashi Komuro and the other survivors of the outbreak, a band of teenage students and their school nurse, escape the mainland and wash up on a small, secluded island. With no zombies around, they spend the day gathering food, swimming and cooking on the beach, but a strange haze drifting from their campfire soon makes everyone behave very oddly. The episode is mainly a comedic holiday story. Madhouse produced it in April 2011, based on the manga by Daisuke Sato and Shoji Sato. Contains heavy fan service, nudity and sexual humour.
high-school-of-the-dead-drifters-of-the-.notes: Premise detail beyond the island setting is from the MyAnimeList synopsis; ANN confirms the island setting.
