shakugan-no-shana-ii-second.summary: Yuji Sakai was an ordinary student until he learned that beings from the Crimson Realm secretly consume people's existences, leaving behind Torches, fading stand-ins that vanish unnoticed. Yuji himself turned out to be one of them, and he now fights alongside Shana, a fierce, red-haired Flame Haze sworn to hunt these Denizens. In this second season, Shana's attention is focused on Yuji more than ever, while their classmate Kazumi Yoshida is competing for his feelings too. Meanwhile new Denizens are stirring in Misaki City, and the battles keep growing. J.C.Staff adapted Yashichiro Takahashi's light novels into 24 episodes, aired from October 2007 to March 2008. Contains fantasy violence.

made-in-abyss-fukaki-tamashii-no-reimei.summary: Riko is a young cave raider-in-training from the town of Orth, which surrounds the Abyss, a giant, unexplored pit full of relics and deadly creatures whose curse grows harsher the deeper one goes. She is descending in search of her mother with Reg, a robot boy, and Nanachi, who has joined them on their journey. This sequel film to the first TV season follows them into the fifth layer, a depth from which the curse makes any return perilous, where they encounter Bondrewd, a famed explorer who runs a research outpost there. Kinema Citrus produced the film, released in January 2020. Contains graphic violence, gore and disturbing scenes of cruelty.

kono-subarashii-sekai-ni-shukufuku-wo-ov.summary: Kazuma Sato is a Japanese shut-in who died and was reborn in a fantasy world, where he now leads a dysfunctional adventuring party: Aqua, a vain and useless goddess, Megumin, a young mage obsessed with explosions, and Darkness, a crusader who enjoys getting hurt. While browsing the shop of the lich Wiz, Kazuma tries on a choker said to grant the wearer's wish. Then he learns it will strangle him within days unless that wish comes true, and he has no idea what it is. The others agree to do whatever he asks. Studio Deen produced this single episode, released in June 2016 with the ninth volume of Natsume Akatsuki's light novels. Contains sexual humour.

naruto-shippuden-movie-6-road-to-ninja.summary: After a mission, the young ninja of the Hidden Leaf Village return home to proud families. Naruto Uzumaki, who grew up an orphan, quietly envies them, while Sakura Haruno is embarrassed by her own parents and wishes they would leave her alone. Then the masked leader of the Akatsuki appears and traps both of them inside a different version of the village, where everyone they know has a different personality and their family situations are reversed. Naruto has to decide how much this other world means to him. Studio Pierrot made the film, directed by Hayato Date, with story and character designs by Masashi Kishimoto, and it opened in July 2012.

evangelion-3-0-1-0.summary: This film concludes the four-part Rebuild of Evangelion series, continuing directly from Evangelion: 3.0 You Can (Not) Redo. Shinji Ikari, numb and withdrawn after the catastrophe of the previous film, crosses a ruined landscape with Asuka Langley Shikinami and a version of Rei Ayanami until they reach Village 3, a settlement of survivors. There Shinji meets old acquaintances and begins, slowly, to live again, while the Wille organisation prepares for a final confrontation with NERV and his father Gendo. Studio Khara produced the film, written and chief-directed by Hideaki Anno, and it opened in Japan in March 2021. Contains violence and disturbing imagery.

honey-and-clover.summary: Yuta Takemoto is a second-year student at an art college, living in a cheap apartment block beside two older classmates: Shinobu Morita, an unpredictable genius who rarely attends class, and Takumi Mayama, the sensible one who keeps an eye on everyone. Their routine changes when Hagumi Hanamoto, a tiny, shy painter with startling talent, comes to study at the school under the care of her relative, Professor Shuji Hanamoto. Takemoto falls for her almost at once, and he is not alone. The potter Ayumi Yamada is quietly in love with Mayama, whose heart is set on an older woman. J.C.Staff adapted Chica Umino's manga into 24 episodes in 2005, a gentle drama about one-sided love and uncertain futures.

clannad-another-world-kyou-chapter.summary: This single episode imagines a different path through Clannad's school days, in which Tomoya Okazaki's story centres on the Fujibayashi twins rather than Nagisa Furukawa. Shy Ryou, helped along by her bold older sister Kyou, finally works up the nerve to confess to Tomoya one rainy day, and the two start going out. Kyou, though, has feelings for Tomoya that she has kept to herself, and once rumours begin linking her name with his, all three are pulled into a painful love triangle that tests the sisters' bond. Kyoto Animation made the episode in 2009 as an extra on the final Clannad After Story DVD volume, adapting a route from Key's visual novel.

kanon-2006.summary: Seven years after his last visit, high schooler Yuichi Aizawa moves to a snowbound northern town to live with his aunt Akiko and his cousin Nayuki Minase. He remembers almost nothing about the winters he spent there as a child. Before long he meets several girls: Ayu Tsukimiya, who crashes into him while fleeing a taiyaki stall; Makoto Sawatari, an amnesiac who seems to bear him a grudge; the fragile Shiori Misaka; and Mai Kawasumi, who stands guard in the school at night holding a sword. Each is tied to what he has forgotten. Kyoto Animation adapted Key's visual novel into 24 episodes in 2006 and 2007, the second anime version after Toei's 2002 series.

saiki-kusuo-no-nan-kanketsu-hen.summary: This one-off special adapts the closing chapters of Shuichi Aso's comedy manga about Kusuo Saiki, a high schooler with nearly limitless psychic powers who wants nothing more than a quiet, unremarkable life. A huge volcano threatens to erupt and bury Japan under lava and ash, a disaster Saiki has been quietly undoing again and again with his abilities. Now he decides to stop it once and for all, which turns out to be hard even for him, especially while his oblivious friends keep dragging him into their usual nonsense and chatting about what they want to do with their futures. J.C.Staff and Egg Firm produced the special, which aired in December 2018 after the second TV season.

corpse-party-tortured-souls-bougyakusare.summary: Late one night, a group of friends gathers at Kisaragi Academy to say goodbye to a classmate who is moving away. To keep their friendship alive forever, they perform a charm ritual using small paper dolls. The ritual goes badly wrong: the group is pulled into Heavenly Host Elementary, a decaying school haunted by the vengeful spirits of murdered children, and scattered across its corridors in twos and threes. Trapped in a building that should not exist, they must look for one another and a way out. Asread produced this four-episode OVA in 2013, based on the Corpse Party horror video game. Contains extremely graphic gore, violent deaths and disturbing horror imagery.

kuroko-no-basket-last-game.summary: Jabberwock, an American street basketball team that plays at near-professional level, visits Japan for an exhibition game against a squad of retiring third-year high school stars and wins with ease. Afterwards their captain, Nash Gold Jr., openly insults Japanese basketball. Outraged, coach Kagetora Aida arranges a rematch and assembles a team strong enough to face them: the Generation of Miracles, together with Tetsuya Kuroko and Taiga Kagami, playing on the same side for the first time as Vorpal Swords. Production I.G released this film in 2017, based on Tadatoshi Fujimaki's Kuroko's Basketball manga, and most of it is built around a single match.

kiss-x-sis.summary: When Keita Suminoe's father remarried, Keita gained two older stepsisters, the twins Ako and Riko, and the three have been together since kindergarten. Ako is gentle and motherly, while Riko is sporty and cool on the surface, but both are openly set on becoming Keita's girlfriend, and their parents seem fine with it. Now in his final year of middle school, Keita is trying to study for the entrance exam to his sisters' high school while dodging their increasingly bold advances. Studio feel. released 12 OVA episodes between 2008 and 2015, alongside a separate TV series, based on the manga by Bow Ditama. Contains frequent explicit sexual content, nudity and romantic situations between stepsiblings.

seirei-tsukai-no-blade-dance.summary: Only maidens can form contracts with spirits, so Kamito Kazehaya is a rarity: a boy who can wield elemental power. Summoned to Areishia Spirit Academy, a school for girls training as elementalists, he stumbles on Claire Rouge as she prepares to bind a fierce spirit, and ends up claiming it himself. Furious, Claire insists he become her contracted partner instead. Kamito is dragged into the academy's rivalries as students prepare for the Blade Dance, a contest held to crown the strongest elementalist, and he has his own reasons for agreeing to compete. TNK adapted Yu Shimizu's light novels into 12 episodes in 2014. Contains fan service and nudity.

yuusha-ni-narenakatta-ore-wa-shibushibu-.summary: Raul Chaser trained for years to become a hero who would defeat the Demon King, but the Demon King was beaten before he got the chance, and the hero programme was shut down. Two years on, Raul works at a branch of Leon, a shop selling magical household appliances, resigned to life in retail. His routine is upended when a striking new part-timer, Fino Bloodstone, applies for a job, and Raul learns she is the child of the defeated Demon King, now hoping to make her own way in the human world. Assigned to train her, he finds work far livelier than before. Asread adapted Jun Sakyou's light novels into 12 episodes in 2013. Contains frequent fan service and nudity.

persona-4-the-animation.summary: Yu Narukami moves from the city to the quiet country town of Inaba to spend a year with his uncle Ryotaro Dojima, a police detective, and his young cousin Nanako. Soon after he arrives, bodies start turning up in strange circumstances, and students whisper about the Midnight Channel, a programme that supposedly appears on switched-off TVs on rainy nights. Yu discovers he can step through a television screen into a fog-filled world, where he awakens a power called a Persona. With classmates Yosuke, Chie and Yukiko, he forms a team to investigate the killings. AIC ASTA adapted Atlus's role-playing game into 25 episodes in 2011 and 2012, directed by Seiji Kishi. Contains violence and murder themes.

ookami-san-to-shichinin-no-nakama-tachi.summary: Otogi High School has an unusual club, the Otogi Bank, which solves students' problems in exchange for a favour to be repaid later. Its enforcer is Ryoko Ookami, a tough, sharp-tongued girl who settles things with her fists, usually alongside her small, sweet friend Ringo Akai. Ryoshi Morino is a timid boy so afraid of being looked at that he can barely meet anyone's eyes, yet he confesses to Ryoko and promptly ends up recruited into the club. The jobs that follow, many styled loosely on familiar fairy tales and commented on by a chatty narrator, range from small favours to real fights. J.C.Staff adapted the light novels into 12 episodes in 2010. Contains mild fan service.

flying-witch.summary: In her family's tradition, a witch who turns fifteen must leave home to train on her own. Makoto Kowata, a gentle and rather absent-minded apprentice, moves from Yokohama to rural Aomori to live with her second cousin Kei Kuramoto and his younger sister Chinatsu, taking along her black cat Chito. There she settles into country life, starting high school, tending the garden and introducing her new family to the small wonders of witchcraft, from broom flights to strange spring spirits. The show is a slow, relaxing slice of life with little conflict. J.C.Staff adapted Chihiro Ishizuka's manga into 12 episodes in 2016.

xxxholic.summary: High schooler Kimihiro Watanuki is cursed with the ability to see spirits and odd creatures, which trail after him and make his life miserable. One day, fleeing a group of them, he is drawn into an odd house that most people never notice. Its owner, Yuko Ichihara, is a mysterious woman who grants wishes, always for a fitting price. She offers to free Watanuki of his sight, and to pay for it he becomes her part-time servant, cooking, cleaning and running errands into the supernatural. Each job brings him into contact with people whose wishes come with strange and sometimes frightening costs. Production I.G adapted CLAMP's manga into 24 episodes in 2006. Contains some eerie horror elements.

oda-nobuna-no-yabou.summary: High school student Yoshiharu Sagara, whose knowledge of Japanese history comes almost entirely from strategy video games, wakes up in the middle of a Sengoku-era battlefield. A foot soldier who saves him dies in the process, and Yoshiharu soon realises the man was the future Toyotomi Hideyoshi, meaning history has already gone off course. Worse, many of the famous warlords here are girls, including the fiery Oda Nobuna, who dreams of uniting the land. Yoshiharu joins her service and tries to use what he remembers to keep her alive. Madhouse and Studio Gokumi adapted Mikage Kasuga's light novels into 12 episodes in 2012. Contains battle violence and some fan service.

psycho-pass-movie.summary: The Sibyl System, which reads a person's mental state to predict crime, has made Japan peaceful enough that the government begins exporting it overseas. Its first trial abroad is in the South East Asia Union, a war-torn coalition hoping the technology can bring order. When armed infiltrators from that region slip into Japan, Inspector Akane Tsunemori of the Public Safety Bureau finds clues that point to someone from her past, and she travels to the Union's showcase city, Shambala Float, to find the truth. Production I.G released this film in 2015, set after the second TV season and written by Gen Urobuchi with Makoto Fukami. Contains graphic gun violence.

naruto-the-movie-ninja-clash-in-the-land.summary: Team 7, made up of Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno, is given an unusual job: protect a film crew travelling to the frozen Land of Snow to shoot a new movie. Naruto is thrilled to discover that the star is Yukie Fujikaze, a famous actress, but she turns out to be cold, moody and determined not to go anywhere near the place. As the crew nears its destination, ninja from the Land of Snow attack, and it becomes clear that Yukie's reluctance has a reason. The first Naruto feature film, it was released in 2004 and produced by Studio Pierrot, with an original story set during the first series based on Masashi Kishimoto's manga. Contains action violence.

black-lagoon-roberta-s-blood-trail.summary: Roberta, the Lovelace family's polite, bespectacled maid and a former guerrilla killer, comes back to the lawless port city of Roanapur after her master is assassinated, and she sets out after the American operatives responsible. This time she has abandoned the restraint she once showed, and the city's crime syndicates brace for what she might do. Her young master, Garcia Lovelace, follows her with the maid Fabiola, hoping to bring her home before she destroys herself. Rock and Revy of the Lagoon Company soon find themselves caught between all sides. Madhouse released this five-episode OVA between 2010 and 2011, continuing the TV series based on Rei Hiroe's manga. Contains graphic violence, gore and strong language.

gankutsuou.summary: In the year 5053, young Viscount Albert de Morcerf and his friend Baron Franz d'Epinay travel to the Carnival on the lunar city of Luna in search of excitement. There Albert meets a pale, enormously wealthy stranger with impeccable manners and an air of menace, who goes by the title Count of Monte Cristo. Charmed, Albert introduces him to Parisian high society, unaware that the Count has carefully planned his arrival and has old ties to several of the families he is now befriending. Told largely from Albert's point of view, this science-fiction retelling of Alexandre Dumas's novel ran for 24 episodes in 2004 and 2005. Gonzo produced it under director Mahiro Maeda, with a striking textured visual style.

dimension-w.summary: In the near future, scientists have tapped a hidden fourth dimension for almost unlimited energy, delivered to every home and car through devices called coils. By 2071 one corporation, New Tesla Energy, controls the system, and unregistered coils are banned. Kyoma Mabuchi is a collector, a bounty hunter who tracks down illegal coils, though he hates coils and refuses to rely on them himself. During a job he crosses paths with Mira Yurizaki, a strikingly human-like robot, and the two end up working together, uncovering trouble far bigger than a few black-market devices. Orange and Studio 3Hz adapted Yuji Iwahara's manga into 12 episodes in 2016. Contains action violence.

special-a.summary: At the age of six, Hikari Hanazono, the daughter of a carpenter, lost a wrestling match to Kei Takishima, heir to a powerful business group. She has been trying to beat him at something ever since. Now both attend Hakusenkan, an elite school for the wealthy, where the seven top students form the Special A class, and Hikari is permanently ranked second behind Kei. Her obsession with their rivalry keeps her from noticing what everyone around them can see: Kei has feelings for her. Their classmates in S.A, a group of wealthy, eccentric overachievers, add plenty of comedy. Gonzo and AIC adapted Maki Minami's shojo manga into 24 episodes in 2008.

darker-than-black-kuro-no-keiyakusha-gai.summary: These four specials fill in part of the gap between the two Darker than Black TV seasons, following the Contractor Hei and the Doll Yin while they are on the run. To stay out of sight, the pair check into a quiet inn posing as a married couple and try to live something close to an ordinary life. Hei gets to know the other guests, but one of them is also a Contractor, and the peace does not last. The episodes also show how Hei's situation moves towards the start of the second season. Bones produced them in 2010 for the home video release of Darker than Black: Gemini of the Meteor. Contains violence.

amaama-to-inazuma.summary: High school maths teacher Kohei Inuzuka has been raising his young daughter Tsumugi alone since his wife died, and with little time or skill in the kitchen, the two mostly eat convenience-store meals. Kotori Iida, a student in his class, invites them to her family's restaurant, which is often closed because her mother is away for work. Kotori, who usually eats alone, ends up sharing the kitchen with them, and the three begin cooking proper home meals together, one simple recipe at a time. Each episode centres on a dish and on the small ups and downs of a grieving family. TMS Entertainment adapted Gido Amagakure's manga into 12 episodes in 2016.

sakura-trick.summary: Haruka Takayama and Yu Sonoda have been inseparable since their middle school days and enrol together at Misato West High School, a school set to close once their year graduates. To their dismay, they end up seated far apart in class. Afraid of drifting apart, the two decide to do something special that only they share, and seal it with a kiss in an empty classroom. Before long they are sneaking kisses whenever they can while trying to keep it hidden from friends, family and classmates. Studio Deen adapted Tachi's four-panel comic manga into 12 episodes in 2014, a light school comedy about a budding romance between two girls. Contains frequent kissing and mild fan service.

madan-no-ou-to-vanadis.summary: Tigrevurmud Vorn, called Tigre, is the young lord of Alsace, a small territory in the kingdom of Brune, and an unusually skilled archer. When Brune goes to war with neighbouring Zhcted, Tigre's side is crushed and he is captured by Eleonora Viltaria, one of the Vanadis, warrior maidens who rule Zhcted's regions with weapons said to be carved from dragons. Instead of finishing him off, Elen spares him and claims him as her own, and Tigre is soon caught up in the conspiracies of a Brune on the edge of civil war. Satelight adapted Tsukasa Kawaguchi's light novels into 13 episodes in 2014. Contains battle violence and fan service.

naruto-shippuden-movie-1.summary: Naruto Uzumaki is assigned to protect Shion, a shrine maiden who alone can seal away an ancient demon that a group of ninja want to revive. Shion has an unsettling gift: she can foresee people's deaths. Soon after meeting Naruto she tells him plainly that she has seen his, and urges him to keep away. Naruto, being Naruto, has no intention of letting a prophecy decide anything for him, and he joins Shion's escort as her enemies close in. The first film of the Shippuden era, it was released in 2007, directed by Hajime Kamegaki at Studio Pierrot, with an original story set in Masashi Kishimoto's world. Contains action violence.

quan-zhi-gao-shou.summary: Ye Xiu is a legend in Glory, a hugely popular online multiplayer game, known among players as a master tactician and one of its earliest professional stars. When his team forces him into retirement, he leaves the professional scene behind and takes a job at an internet cafe. When Glory opens its tenth server, he starts again from scratch with a new character, Lord Grim, quietly working his way back towards the top using the experience no newcomer has. This Chinese animated web series, based on Hu Dielan's web novel, was released as 12 episodes in 2017.

full-metal-panic-the-second-raid.summary: Sergeant Sousuke Sagara of Mithril, a secret mercenary force, is still posing as a high school student in Tokyo to protect Kaname Chidori, a girl whose mind holds knowledge certain organisations would kill for. He remains hopeless at ordinary school life, and his military reflexes keep causing chaos in class. But this season leans away from comedy: a series of operations goes wrong, and a powerful new enemy organisation starts targeting Mithril, putting Sousuke's two worlds at odds. Kyoto Animation produced the 13 episodes in 2005, continuing the adaptation of Shoji Gatoh's light novels after the earlier Full Metal Panic! and Fumoffu series. Contains military violence.

planetes.summary: By 2075 people live and work in orbit and on the Moon, but decades of space travel have left Earth's orbit full of junk that can wreck a ship on impact. Ai Tanabe, an idealistic new hire at the Technora Corporation, is assigned to its Debris Section, an underfunded team that collects that junk. The section works out of a battered ship nicknamed the Toy Box, and her crewmates include the hot-headed Hachirota 'Hachimaki' Hoshino, who dreams of owning a spaceship of his own. The series balances workplace comedy with grounded hard science fiction about life in space and the politics around it. Sunrise adapted Makoto Yukimura's manga into 26 episodes, which aired from 2003 to 2004.

code-breaker.summary: Sakura Sakurakoji looks delicate but is a trained martial artist with an unshakable sense of right and wrong. Riding a bus home one evening, she sees a boy burn a group of thugs alive with blue flames, yet when she reports it, the police find no trace of the bodies. The next day that same boy, Rei Ogami, transfers into her class, smiling as if nothing happened. Rei is a Code:Breaker, a member of a hidden group that eliminates criminals the law cannot touch, and Sakura, who refuses to accept killing in the name of justice, makes it her mission to stop him. Kinema Citrus adapted Akimine Kamijyo's manga into 13 episodes in 2012. Contains graphic violence.

mysterious-girlfriend-x.summary: Akira Tsubaki is an ordinary high school boy who knows almost nothing about girls. His new classmate, Mikoto Urabe, is withdrawn and odd: she sleeps through breaks, rarely speaks and carries a pair of scissors she can draw with startling speed. After school one day Akira finds her asleep at her desk and, on an impulse, tastes the drool she has left behind. The next day he comes down with a fever that only Mikoto can cure, and from then on a daily exchange of saliva becomes the strange bond at the heart of their relationship. Hoods Entertainment adapted Riichi Ueshiba's manga into 13 episodes in 2012. Contains fetish-themed scenes and some nudity.

noragami-ova.summary: These two short side stories return to the cast of Noragami, the series about Yato, a minor god who takes any job for five yen, his sword spirit Yukine and the high schooler Hiyori Iki. In the first, Hiyori is about to begin high school with her two friends from middle school and badly wants her first day to go smoothly, which is hard with Yato around. In the second, she organises a cherry blossom viewing party and invites a crowd of gods and companions, including Bishamon, the war god who has a long feud with Yato, and the drinking soon gets out of hand. Bones produced both episodes in 2014, bundled with limited editions of Adachitoka's manga.

haikyuu-vs-akaten.summary: Just before the volleyball team from Karasuno High School heads to Tokyo for a training camp, its two most important first-years, the small, jumpy spiker Shoyo Hinata and the genius setter Tobio Kageyama, both fail their end-of-term exams. The make-up tests fall on the same days as the trip, and pleading with the vice principal gets them nowhere. With the rest of the club unwilling to leave its best duo behind, teammates and friends pitch in with tutoring and other, less conventional ideas to get them through. This short comedy episode, set between the first and second TV seasons, was made by Production I.G and later bundled with a volume of Haruichi Furudate's manga.

kono-subarashii-sekai-ni-shukufuku-wo-2-.summary: With his debts finally paid off, Kazuma Sato is enjoying an easy life in the town of Axel when a rookie adventurer named Ran approaches him at the guild and introduces herself as his fan. Determined to look like the heroic adventurer she imagines, Kazuma agrees to a quest from the guild receptionist to destroy a golem guarding some ancient ruins, dragging along Aqua, Megumin and Darkness. The trip goes better than expected, so when another job sends them back to the same ruins, Kazuma's showing off leads him into something far more embarrassing. Studio Deen made this one-episode comedy in 2017, bundled with a volume of Natsume Akatsuki's light novels. Contains fan service.

seikon-no-qwaser.summary: At Saint Mikhailov Academy, gentle Tomo Yamanobe and the fierce Mafuyu Oribe, who looks out for her like an older sister, are picked on at school while rumours spread of attacks on female students. Tomo's father, the former headmaster, vanished and left behind only a sacred icon that others covet. One night the girls are rescued by Alexander Nikolaevich Hell, called Sasha, a silver-haired boy able to manipulate iron. He is a Qwaser, one of a group of fighters who each command an element, powered by a substance called Soma that is obtained through breastfeeding. Hoods Entertainment adapted the manga by Hiroyuki Yoshino and Kenetsu Sato into 24 episodes in 2010. Contains explicit sexual content, frequent nudity and graphic violence.

kara-no-kyoukai-3-tsuukaku-zanryuu.summary: In July 1998, a young woman named Fujino Asagami is held and abused by a street gang in an abandoned bar, staring back at them without any reaction. The next day several members of the gang are found dead in the building, their bodies twisted apart in ways no ordinary person could manage. Touko Aozaki, a mage who runs a small agency, sends Shiki Ryougi, a girl who can see the lines of death in things, to deal with the culprit, while Mikiya Kokutou investigates by his own means. The third chapter of The Garden of Sinners, it is a 2008 ufotable film based on Kinoko Nasu's novel. Contains sexual assault, graphic violence and gore.

jinrui-wa-suitai-shimashita.summary: Humanity's population has been shrinking for generations, and the few people left live quietly among the remains of a more advanced age. Earth now effectively belongs to the fairies: tiny, cheerful beings with impossibly advanced technology, a passion for sweets and no sense of danger. A young woman, never named and known only as the narrator, returns to her village after finishing school and takes a job as a United Nations mediator between humans and fairies, working with her grandfather. Her assignments regularly spiral into absurd, satirical adventures. AIC ASTA adapted Romeo Tanaka's light novels into 12 episodes in 2012, mostly as two-part stories.

shuffle.summary: Now that the doors to the realms of gods and demons have opened, both peoples live openly alongside humans. Rin Tsuchimi is an ordinary student at Verbena Academy who lives with his childhood friend Kaede Fuyou, who devotedly takes care of him. His quiet life ends when the King of Gods and the King of Demons move in next door with their families. Their daughters, the cheerful Sia and the reserved Nerine, have both decided they want to marry Rin, apparently because of meetings he does not remember. With his sharp-tongued senior Asa and the quiet Primula also around, Rin's life gets crowded. Asread adapted Navel's adult visual novel into 24 episodes in 2005 and 2006. Contains fan service.

kara-no-kyoukai-2-satsujin-kousatsu-part.summary: On a snowy night in 1995, Mikiya Kokutou walks past a girl in a white kimono who catches his attention. That spring he finds her, Shiki Ryougi, at his new high school, and despite her cold manner they gradually become friends, mostly through Mikiya's persistence. Shiki is the heir of an old family and has two distinct personalities sharing one body. When a string of brutal murders hits their town, Mikiya begins to fear that Shiki may be connected. This second chapter of The Garden of Sinners is the earliest in the story's timeline, a 2007 film by ufotable based on Kinoko Nasu's novel. Contains graphic violence and gore.

working-2.summary: The staff of a branch of Wagnaria, a family restaurant chain, return for a second season of workplace comedy. High school student Sota Takanashi, who adores small and cute things, still works the floor alongside the tiny senior Popura Taneshima, the sword-carrying manager Yachiyo Todoroki and Mahiru Inami, who is so afraid of men that she reflexively punches them, mostly Sota. This season brings new faces to the restaurant, including Haruna, the long-missing wife of store manager Hyougo Otoo, who cannot go anywhere without losing her way. A-1 Pictures produced the 13 episodes in 2011, based on Karino Takatsu's four-panel comic manga.

shaman-king.summary: Every five hundred years, shamans, people who can see and command spirits, fight in a tournament called the Shaman Fight, and the winner becomes the Shaman King, gaining the power to remake the world. During a late-night walk, a small, studious boy named Manta Oyamada runs into his easygoing classmate Yoh Asakura, who invites him to go stargazing with friends who are, it turns out, the ghosts of a nearby cemetery. Yoh is a shaman, and with Amidamaru, the spirit of a legendary samurai, at his side, he means to win the tournament. Xebec adapted Hiroyuki Takei's manga into 64 episodes between 2001 and 2002. Contains battle violence.

onii-chan-dakedo-ai-sae-areba-kankeinai-.summary: After their parents died, Akito and Akiko Himenokoji were raised by separate families and spent six years apart. Now in high school, the siblings are finally living together again, and Akiko makes no secret that her feelings for her brother go well beyond family affection, while Akito sees her only as his little sister. Her plans for a life alone with him are quickly ruined when three other girls from school, Anastasia Nasuhara, Arashi Nikaido and Ginbei Haruomi Sawatari, come to live with them, each with her own interest in Akito. Silver Link adapted Daisuke Suzuki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2012. Contains frequent sexual humour, nudity and incest themes.

vampire-knight-guilty.summary: This second season of Vampire Knight continues directly from the first. Cross Academy still keeps its secret: its elite Night Class is made up of vampires, while the Day Class is human. Yuki Cross, who guards the boundary between the two, is relieved when Zero Kiryu, the vampire-hating guardian who has been missing, returns to school, but he has changed and is troubled by strange visions. Yuki, meanwhile, is pursued by her own recurring visions of blood and a past she cannot recall, and the pureblood vampire Kaname Kuran seems to know more than he says. Studio Deen produced the 13 episodes in 2008, adapting Matsuri Hino's manga. Contains blood and violence.

soredemo-sekai-wa-utsukushii.summary: In the Rain Dukedom, people can call down rain with their singing voices, and Nike Lemercier, the duke's fourth daughter, is as stubborn as she is talented. When the mighty Sun Kingdom, ruled by a king who conquered the known world within three years, demands a bride from the Dukedom, Nike goes in place of her older sisters. She expects a fearsome tyrant, but King Livius turns out to be a boy younger than she is, spoiled and coldly calculating. Bound together for reasons of state, the two slowly begin to understand each other. Studio Pierrot adapted Dai Shiina's shojo manga into 12 episodes in 2014.

motto-to-love-ru.summary: High schooler Rito Yuki is still caught between two girls: his longtime crush Haruna Sairenji and Lala, the alien princess who crash-landed in his life and announced she would marry him. In this second season his house gets busier, as Momo and Nana, Lala's twin younger sisters, arrive from space to size up their sister's fiancé and end up moving in. Meanwhile Yami, the living-weapon assassin hired to kill Rito, is still around, and Rito keeps stumbling into embarrassing accidents with the girls around him. Xebec produced the 12 episodes in 2010, based on the manga by Saki Hasemi and Kentaro Yabuki. Contains heavy fan service, nudity and sexual humour.

saiki-kusuo-no-nan-shidou-hen.summary: Kusuo Saiki can read minds, teleport, move objects and do almost anything else, but all he wants is a quiet, ordinary school life, which his ridiculous classmates, his hopeless father and his own powers never let him have. This six-episode follow-up returns to his everyday comedy in short, separate stories. Five of the episodes are set before the closing events of the 2018 special, filling in more school days, while the last picks up after it. J.C.Staff and Egg Firm produced it for Netflix, which released all episodes in December 2019, adapting more of Shuichi Aso's manga.

fate-kaleid-liner-prisma-illya.summary: Illyasviel von Einzbern, known as Illya, is a cheerful elementary school girl in an ordinary town who loves magical girl anime. Her life changes when Ruby, a talking and very mischievous magical stick, abandons its previous owner, the mage Rin Tohsaka, and chooses Illya instead. Before she knows it, Illya has become a real magical girl, ordered to collect seven Class Cards, objects containing the power of legendary heroes, from a hidden mirror world. Rin's rival Luvia has a stick of her own, Sapphire, which picks a quiet new transfer student named Miyu. Silver Link adapted Hiroshi Hiroyama's spin-off manga of Fate/stay night into 10 episodes in 2013. Contains fan service involving child characters.

shinmai-maou-no-testament-burst.summary: This second season continues the story of Basara Toujou, a former member of a hero clan who now lives with his stepsisters Mio and Maria Naruse, a demon girl with an inherited power many want to seize and her succubus companion. Bound to them by a master and servant contract, Basara has sworn to protect them, but political tension in the demon realm is rising. When a messenger arrives summoning Mio to the demon world, she and her friends decide to go despite the danger, and Basara must grow strong enough to protect everyone on hostile ground. Production IMS produced the 10 episodes in 2015, based on Tetsuto Uesu's light novels. Contains explicit sexual content, frequent nudity and violence.

kuragehime.summary: Tsukimi Kurashita has loved jellyfish ever since a childhood trip to the aquarium with her late mother, and at nineteen she dreams of becoming an illustrator. She lives in an old boarding house shared with other single otaku women, each obsessed with her own hobby and all terrified of fashionable people. One night Tsukimi tries to rescue a jellyfish from a pet shop and gets help from a glamorous, confident woman, who turns out to be Kuranosuke Koibuchi, a young man from a political family who dresses as a woman. He keeps coming back, and the boarding house's residents soon face a threat to their home. Brain's Base adapted Akiko Higashimura's manga into 11 episodes in 2010.

kara-no-kyoukai-7-satsujin-kousatsu-part.summary: In February 1999, a new series of murders breaks out in the city, and the killings closely resemble those of 1995, the winter when Shiki Ryougi and Mikiya Kokutou first met. Shiki, who has sensed a hunger for killing inside herself ever since, is drawn back into the case and comes under suspicion once again, while Mikiya refuses to believe she is responsible and sets out to find the real culprit himself. This seventh chapter of The Garden of Sinners directly continues the events of the second film, which is best watched first. ufotable released it in 2009, adapting the novel by Kinoko Nasu of Type-Moon. Contains graphic violence, gore and drug use.

gatchaman-crowds.summary: Hajime Ichinose is a relentlessly cheerful high school girl. One day a mysterious being named J.J. Robinson gives her a small notebook called a NOTE, which transforms her into a Gatchaman, one of the secret protectors of Tachikawa City. Her serious new teammate Sugane Tachibana insists the group must stay hidden, and their panda-like alien leader Paiman explains that their job is to stop dangerous alien threats called MESS. Hajime, though, questions every rule, including the way the Gatchaman operate. Tatsunoko Production made this 12-episode series in 2013 as a new entry in its Gatchaman franchise, directed by Kenji Nakamura.

shijou-saikyou-no-deshi-kenichi.summary: Kenichi Shirahama is a weak, timid high schooler who gets beaten up in his school's karate club and fills his bag with self-help books. One morning he startles a new transfer student, Miu Furinji, who instinctively throws him to the ground. Following her home, he discovers the Ryozanpaku, a run-down dojo where six of the world's greatest masters of different martial arts live together. Wanting to become strong enough to protect himself and the people he cares about, Kenichi becomes their only disciple and survives a brutal training regime while fighting the delinquent gangs at his school. TMS Entertainment adapted Syun Matsuena's manga into 50 episodes in 2006 and 2007. Contains martial arts violence and fan service.

kamisama-no-inai-nichiyoubi.summary: God turned away from the world fifteen years ago. Since then no one has truly died and no new children have been born; the dead keep moving, and only gravekeepers, beings God left behind as a last gift, can lay them to rest with a proper burial. Ai, a twelve-year-old girl and one of the very last children ever born, has taken over as her small village's gravekeeper after her mother's death. Her quiet routine ends when a gun-carrying stranger named Hampnie Hambart arrives, and soon Ai leaves home to travel with him, learning more about the strange, broken world beyond her village. Madhouse adapted Kimihito Irie's light novels into 12 episodes in 2013. Contains violence and themes of death.

heaven-s-lost-property-forte.summary: In this second season, Tomoki Sakurai, a boy who wants nothing but a peaceful life, has settled into a noisy household with two angeloids, Ikaros and Nymph, artificial beings from the sky who have become part of his family. When Tomoki starts having strange dreams, his friends try to investigate using one of Nymph's devices. Soon afterwards, something crashes into the hill where he first met Ikaros, and a new angeloid armed with a huge sword emerges with orders concerning Tomoki. AIC ASTA produced the 12 episodes in 2010, based on Suu Minazuki's manga. Contains heavy fan service, nudity and sexual humour.

angel-beats-another-epilogue.summary: This short special takes place after the TV series of Angel Beats!, in the same afterlife high school where young people who died with regrets go before being reborn. During a test, a frustrated new student makes a scene in class, refusing to believe that following the rules and doing well at school could ever lead anywhere. He is then taken aside by the school's current student council president, someone viewers will recognise, who knows what rebellion in this world leads to. The episode is best watched after the series, since its premise depends on the finale. P.A. Works produced it in 2010 as an extra on the home video release, from a story by Jun Maeda.

nejimaki-seirei-senki-tenkyou-no-alderam.summary: Ikta Solork wants only two things from life: pretty women and long naps. But the Katjvarna Empire and the Republic of Kioka are at war, and he reluctantly sits the higher military officer exam alongside his childhood friend Yatorishino Igsem, a gifted swordswoman. On the voyage to the exam they meet three other candidates, and when their ship goes down in a storm, the group washes up near enemy territory, where they find the empire's young princess, Chamille, in danger. Ikta's laziness hides a brilliant tactical mind that the army will soon start relying on. Madhouse adapted Bokuto Uno's light novels into 13 episodes in 2016. Contains war violence.

maji-de-watashi-ni-koi-shinasai.summary: Kawakami City takes pride in its samurai heritage, and at Kawakami Academy fighting spirit is part of daily school life, with duels used to settle disputes. Yamato Naoe, a scheming student who acts as the strategist of a close-knit band of childhood friends, spends his days with the group of three boys and three girls, joining in exams, sports and the city's traditions. The balance they have kept for years is thrown off when two new girls join the group, bringing fresh rivalries and plenty of romantic distractions. Lerche adapted Minato Soft's adult visual novel into 12 episodes in 2011. Contains fan service and nudity.

diabolik-lovers.summary: On her father's instructions, high school student Yui Komori moves into a remote mansion that she soon learns is the home of six vampire brothers: Shu, Reiji, Ayato, Kanato, Laito and Subaru Sakamaki. Each brother is cruel or unstable in his own way, and they treat her as a sacrificial bride, someone whose blood they can drink whenever they like. Yui tries to work out why she was sent there and what her father knew, while enduring the brothers' attentions in a house she cannot easily leave. Zexcs adapted Rejet's otome game into 12 short episodes in 2013. Contains repeated blood-drinking, physical and psychological abuse, and sexual harassment.

hundred.summary: Alien creatures called Savages have attacked humanity, and the only weapons that work against them are the Hundred, which only rare people can use. Hayato Kisaragi, who survived a Savage attack, shows the highest compatibility ever recorded, earning him a place at Little Garden, an academy built on a giant ship that trains Hundred users called Slayers. On arrival he discovers that his roommate, Emil Crossford, seems to know him from somewhere, and he is quickly challenged to a duel by Claire Harvey, the academy's top-ranked student. Production IMS adapted Jun Misaki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2016. Contains fan service and action violence.

akuma-no-riddle.summary: Tokaku Azuma, a quiet girl from a family of assassins, transfers into Class Black at Myojo Academy, an exclusive girls' boarding school. Twelve of her classmates are, like her, professional killers, all competing for the same target: Haru Ichinose, a cheerful classmate with a mysterious background. Whoever succeeds will be granted any wish. But Tokaku, after meeting Haru, decides to protect her instead, and soon the other assassins begin making their moves one by one, each with her own reasons and methods. Diomedea adapted the manga written by Yun Kouga and drawn by Sunao Minakata into 12 episodes in 2014. Contains violence and some fan service.

berserk-2016.summary: Marked with a brand that draws demons to him every night, the lone swordsman Guts travels with a huge blade called the Dragonslayer, hunting the former comrade he holds responsible for a terrible betrayal. Along the way he reluctantly picks up unlikely companions who insist on following him, including the tiny elf Puck and Isidro, a boy thief eager to learn the sword. Continuing from the Golden Age film trilogy, this 12-episode series aired in 2016, produced by Millepensee and GEMBA and adapting the Conviction arc of Kentaro Miura's manga. Contains extreme gore, sexual violence and disturbing imagery.

mangaka-san-to-assistant-san-to-the-anim.summary: Yuki Aito is a working manga artist with a serialised comedy, a big imagination and a total lack of shame. He is fixated on drawing panties, and constantly asks his female assistants to model for reference, earning him plenty of slaps in return. Yet he also cares about his work and the people around him, and can be surprisingly kind when it counts. Each short episode follows the daily routine of his small studio: deadlines, sleepless nights, pushy editors and Aito's endless distractions, seen through the eyes of the assistants who put up with him. Zexcs adapted Hiroyuki's four-panel comic manga into 12 short episodes in 2014. Contains frequent sexual humour and fan service.

hajime-no-ippo-new-challenger.summary: This second TV series picks up years after the first. Ippo Makunouchi, once a bullied boy who discovered boxing, is now Japan's featherweight champion and has been defending his title against a stream of challengers. His longtime rival Ichiro Miyata, meanwhile, returns to Japan chasing the Oriental and Pacific featherweight belt, and Ippo's gym-mates Takamura, Aoki and Kimura each pursue their own ambitions. Between bouts, the Kamogawa gym's usual banter and training continue. Madhouse produced the 26 episodes in 2009, based on George Morikawa's long-running manga, as the follow-up to its first TV series. Contains boxing violence and injuries.

fate-stay-night-movie-heaven-s-feel-2.summary: The second of three films adapting the Heaven's Feel route of Type-Moon's visual novel picks up directly after the first. The Fifth Holy Grail War, a secret battle between mages and their summoned heroic spirits, has spun out of control, as a mysterious black shadow devours people across Fuyuki City. Shirou Emiya refuses to step away from the fighting, determined to protect Sakura Matou, the gentle girl who has long looked after his home, from both the war and her cruel brother Shinji. As the remaining Masters close in, secrets about the Matou family start coming to light. ufotable released the film in January 2019. Contains graphic violence, gore, sexual content and abuse.

sword-art-online-alicization-war-of-unde.summary: The second half of War of Underworld continues the battle inside the Underworld, a virtual world populated by artificial intelligences. Fighting between the forces of the Human Empire and the armies of the Dark Territory has escalated as huge numbers of real-world players, misled into thinking it is just a game, flood into the servers. Asuna Yuuki and her friends fight to protect their new allies, while the knight Alice Zuberg heads for the distant World's End Altar, pursued by the ruthless Gabriel Miller. Kirito still lies unresponsive, his mind damaged. A-1 Pictures produced these 11 episodes in 2020, completing the Alicization arc of Reki Kawahara's light novels. Contains graphic violence and disturbing scenes.

re-zero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu-me.summary: This light-hearted side story takes place during a peaceful stretch at Roswaal's mansion, where Subaru Natsuki, the boy transported from Japan into a fantasy world, has some rare free time. He uses it to plan the perfect date with Emilia, the half-elf he adores, scouting the nearby village for the ideal spot with help from the local children. On the big day, however, a sudden and unnatural cold snap hits the mansion and the surrounding area, forcing the date to be postponed, and the temperature keeps dropping. White Fox produced it as an OVA released in October 2018, based on Tappei Nagatsuki's light novels.

saenai-heroine-no-sodatekata-flat.summary: Otaku high schooler Tomoya Aki runs Blessing Software, a small group making a dating-sim visual novel for the Comiket fan convention. His chosen inspiration for the heroine is Megumi Kato, a classmate so low-key that people forget she is in the room. The second season follows the team as the real work begins: writer Utaha Kasumigaoka, artist Eriri Spencer Sawamura and musician Michiru Hyodo battle deadlines, rewrites and their own feelings about Tomoya, while Megumi quietly becomes more important to the project. A-1 Pictures produced the 2017 season of 11 episodes plus a prologue episode, based on Fumiaki Maruto's light novels. Contains mild fan service.

akatsuki-no-yona-ova.summary: These three episodes add side stories to Yona of the Dawn, about a princess on the run who gathers the four legendary dragon warriors with her bodyguard Hak. The first takes the group to a hot spring inn, where Jae-ha teases the White Dragon, Kija, and finds a mark that makes Kija remember his father, the previous White Dragon, and his childhood in the village that raised him. The other two follow Zeno, the cheerful Yellow Dragon, who drifts into dreams of his distant past during a drinking contest. Studio Pierrot produced them between 2015 and 2016, bundled with volumes of Mizuho Kusanagi's manga. Contains some violence.

taimadou-gakuen-35-shiken-shoutai.summary: The Anti-Magic Academy trains inquisitors, agents who hunt down witches and illegal magic, and divides its students into small platoons. The 35th Test Platoon is the lowest of them, nicknamed the small fry, and its captain Takeru Kusanagi stubbornly fights with a sword in a school built around guns. Their already shaky team is tested further when Ouka Ohtori, an elite marksman demoted after breaking the rules on a mission, is assigned to them. Ouka hates witches with a passion and clashes with nearly everyone, especially Takeru. Silver Link adapted Toki Yanagimi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2015. Contains fan service and action violence.

punch-line.summary: Yuta Iridatsu is rescued from a bus hijacking by a masked heroine, but the incident knocks his soul out of his body. Now a ghost, he is looked after by Chiranosuke, a lecherous cat spirit, and drifts around Korai House, the apartment building where he lives with four women: an inventor, a pop idol, a reclusive gamer and a spirit medium. Chiranosuke explains that seeing panties gives Yuta enormous power, but if it happens too often before he returns to his body, an asteroid will strike the Earth. Yuta must get his body back while uncovering a plot to end the world. MAPPA produced this 12-episode original series in 2015. Contains fan service.

ga-rei-zero.summary: Japan's Supernatural Disaster Countermeasures Division is a secret government agency that destroys spirits and monsters before the public notices them. After losing her mother, young Kagura Tsuchimiya was taken in by the Isayama family, and she and their daughter Yomi, a skilled exorcist several years older, grew as close as sisters while training to fight for the agency. As they grow up, the pressures of their work and of their families' politics slowly begin to strain that bond. The series is a prequel to Hajime Segawa's Ga-Rei manga, and its first episodes deliberately start in an unexpected place. AIC Spirits and Asread produced the 12 episodes in 2008. Contains graphic violence and gore.

kampfer.summary: High schooler Natsuru Senou wakes up one morning to find he has turned into a girl. A talking stuffed tiger informs him that he has become a Kampfer, one of a group of chosen fighters who must battle each other, and who can only fight in female form. Natsuru has no idea why he was picked or who is behind the battles, and school gets complicated fast: his childhood friend develops a crush on his female self, he ends up enrolled in both the boys' and girls' sections, and other Kampfers turn out to be classmates. Nomad adapted Toshihiko Tsukiji's light novels into 12 episodes in 2009. Contains fan service and nudity.

tonari-no-seki-kun.summary: Rumi Yokoi just wants to pay attention in class, but she sits next to Toshinari Seki, a silent boy who never studies and instead spends every lesson building elaborate projects on his desk: domino runs, miniature battles with shogi pieces, tiny robot families and much more. Each time Yokoi gets sucked into watching, and often reacting, she ends up being the one the teacher scolds. The episodes are short and self-contained, with almost all of the comedy happening between two desks while Seki never says a word. Shin-Ei Animation adapted Takuma Morishige's manga into 21 short episodes in 2014.

tiger-bunny.summary: In Stern Bild City, people born with special powers, called NEXT, can become superheroes, and the best of them compete on Hero TV, a reality show where catching criminals earns points and keeps corporate sponsors happy. Veteran hero Kotetsu T. Kaburagi, who fights as Wild Tiger, cares more about helping people than ratings, which leaves him low on points and in trouble with his sponsors. His new company forces him to team up with Barnaby Brooks Jr., a cool, calculating rookie with the same power as his, and the mismatched partners struggle to work together. Sunrise produced this original 25-episode series in 2011, directed by Keiichi Sato, with characters designed by Masakazu Katsura.

the-cat-returns.summary: High school student Haru Yoshioka feels her life is going nowhere, until she saves a cat carrying a gift box from being hit by a truck, and the cat stands up and thanks her. He is Lune, prince of the Cat Kingdom, and his grateful father begins sending Haru strange presents, then decides she should marry the prince. Unable to make the cats understand her, Haru seeks help from the Cat Bureau, run by the elegant cat figurine known as the Baron and his grumpy friend Muta, before she is carried off to the Cat Kingdom. Studio Ghibli released the film in 2002, directed by Hiroyuki Morita and based on a manga by Aoi Hiiragi.

densetsu-no-yuusha-no-densetsu.summary: Ryner Lute is a lazy, sleep-loving mage who carries the Alpha Stigma, rare eyes that can see through any spell but are feared as a curse. He survived the brutal military academy of the Roland Empire alongside his best friend Sion Astal, who has since become king and wants to remake the country. Sion sends Ryner on a mission to search for the relics of ancient legendary heroes, pairing him with Ferris Eris, a beautiful, deadpan swordswoman with a habit of beating him up. Their journey takes them across rival nations and closer to the secrets of his eyes. Zexcs adapted Takaya Kagami's light novels into 24 episodes in 2010. Contains violence.

one-piece-stampede.summary: The Straw Hat Pirates, led by Monkey D. Luffy, set sail for the Pirates Festival, the largest gathering of pirates anywhere, organised by the showman Buena Festa. Its main event is a treasure hunt for a prize said to have been left by Gol D. Roger, the late Pirate King, and it draws dozens of famous crews, warlords and the Navy. Luffy throws himself into the race, but the festival hides a dangerous plan, and the sudden arrival of an unexpected pirate turns the contest upside down. Toei Animation released the film in 2019, directed by Takashi Otsuka, to mark the 20th anniversary of the TV anime based on Eiichiro Oda's manga. Contains action violence.

pokemon-the-origin.summary: This four-part special retells the original Pokemon Red and Green games. Professor Oak, who has devoted his life to studying Pokemon, gives two boys from Pallet Town a Pokemon and a Pokedex, a digital encyclopedia, and asks them to record every species in the Kanto region. One is Green, a cocky, talented boy related to the professor; the other is Red, an eager newcomer who starts out with a Charmander. Red sets off to fill the Pokedex, challenge the Gym Leaders and reach the Pokemon League, learning how much he still has to understand, and running into the criminal Team Rocket. OLM, Production I.G and Xebec made the special, which aired in Japan in October 2013.

yahari-ore-no-seishun-love-comedy-wa-mac.summary: One morning, cynical loner Hachiman Hikigaya finds himself grumbling about how marriage is sold as the road to happiness. Unluckily for him, the Volunteer Service Club, where he and Yukino Yukinoshita and Yui Yuigahama take on other students' problems, is soon asked to help a local magazine write a feature promoting marriage to young people. With a week until the deadline and nobody in the club, including their unmarried adviser Shizuka Hiratsuka, knowing much about the subject, the research quickly turns into a contest over who would make the best wife, with Hachiman's sister Komachi joining in. Brain's Base made this single comedy episode in 2013, based on Wataru Watari's light novels.

boku-no-hero-academia-the-movie-2.summary: Izuku Midoriya and the rest of Class 1-A from U.A. High School are sent to Nabu Island, a quiet, remote island with almost no crime, to run a hero agency on their own as part of a trial programme. Their days are mostly spent on small jobs for the friendly locals, such as finding lost pets and fixing things. The calm ends when a powerful villain called Nine and his gang arrive on the island hunting for something, and with no professional heroes nearby, the students must defend the islanders themselves. Bones released this second My Hero Academia film in 2019 under director Kenji Nagasaki, telling a new story with the characters of Kohei Horikoshi's manga. Contains action violence.

k-2015.summary: In a world where seven Kings with supernatural powers lead their own clans, the balance between them has been shaken. With the old order disrupted, the Green King, Nagare Hisui, and his clan Jungle make a move for the Dresden Slate, the mysterious source of every King's power. Standing in their way are the Blue King's Scepter 4, the Red clan HOMRA and the small Silver clan, whose members include the swordsman Kuroh and the cat-like girl Neko, each side with its own stake in the struggle. This second season of the original anime by GoHands ran for 13 episodes in 2015, directed by Shingo Suzuki. Contains action violence.

uchuu-kyoudai.summary: One summer night in 2006, two young brothers, Mutta and Hibito Nanba, saw what they believed was a UFO and promised each other they would both become astronauts. Nineteen years later, Hibito has kept that promise and is about to become the first Japanese person to walk on the Moon, while Mutta, the elder, has just lost his job at a car company. Encouraged by his brother, Mutta decides it is not too late and enters Japan's astronaut selection process, facing tough tests alongside other candidates. A-1 Pictures adapted Chuya Koyama's manga into 99 episodes between 2012 and 2014.

robotics-notes.summary: On the island of Tanegashima, home to Japan's space centre, Akiho Senomiya is the energetic head of her high school's robotics club, determined to finish the GunPro-1, a full-size giant robot from a famous anime that earlier members started building. The only other member is her childhood friend Kaito Yashio, who would rather play his fighting game than help. Their club is short of money and members, but Kaito's chance discovery of a hidden document points to a conspiracy far larger than a school project. Production I.G adapted the visual novel from 5pb. into 22 episodes in 2012 and 2013.

medaka-box.summary: Medaka Kurokami is beautiful, brilliant, athletic and supremely confident, and she wins the student council presidency at Hakoniwa Academy with 98 percent of the vote as a first-year. Her first act is to set up a suggestion box, promising to solve any problem a student brings, no matter how small. She drags along her childhood friend Zenkichi Hitoyoshi, a tough but reluctant boy who has followed her since they were small, and the two take on requests from clubs and students, gradually recruiting others to the council. Gainax adapted the manga by Nisio Isin and Akira Akatsuki into 12 episodes in 2012. Contains martial arts violence and some fan service.

devil-may-cry.summary: Dante, a laid-back half-demon with a big sword and two pistols, runs Devil May Cry, a one-man business taking odd jobs and, above all, hunting demons, though he is constantly broke. His broker Morrison brings him an unusual request: protect Patty Lowell, a young girl from an orphanage who may be the heir to a rich family's fortune, and deliver her to her relatives. Patty quickly attaches herself to Dante and refuses to leave his office, and each episode brings a new case involving demons, humans and Dante's own background. Madhouse adapted Capcom's video game series into 12 episodes in 2007, directed by Shin Itagaki. Contains violence and gore.

chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-kirameki-n.summary: This extra episode takes place right after the first season of Love, Chunibyo and Other Delusions. Yuta Togashi and Rikka Takanashi, a girl who lives inside her own fantasy world, are officially a couple now, but neither has any idea how to move things forward. Rikka asks classmate Shinka Nibutani for advice and is told Christmas is the perfect chance to get closer. At Makoto Isshiki's suggestion, the group throws a Christmas party, hosted at Sanae Dekomori's home, and partway through the evening Yuta notices that Rikka has disappeared. Kyoto Animation made the episode in 2013 for the final home video volume, based on Torako's light novels.

ryuugajou-nanana-no-maizoukin-tv.summary: Nanae Island is an artificial island in the Pacific, built so that young people could pursue their ambitions. Disowned by his father, high schooler Jugo Yama moves into a suspiciously cheap apartment there, and finds it already occupied by Nanana Ryugajo, the carefree ghost of a girl. Nanana was one of the island's founders, and before she was murdered ten years ago she hid a set of mysterious items across the island, now known as the Nanana Collection. Jugo joins the hunt for them, teaming up with Tensai Ikkyu, a self-proclaimed great detective, and running into rival treasure hunters. A-1 Pictures adapted Kazuma Otorino's light novels into 11 episodes in 2014.

the-place-promised-in-our-early-days.summary: In an alternate history of postwar Japan, the country is split in two, and Hokkaido, under the control of the Union, holds a tower so tall it seems to reach the sky. In 1996, two ninth-graders in Aomori, Hiroki Fujisawa and Takuya Shirakawa, spend their free time building a small aeroplane from a crashed drone, planning to fly across the strait to reach the tower. When they share their secret with classmate Sayuri Sawatari, they promise to take her there too. But the summer passes, and the promise is left hanging, as life and politics pull the three apart. Makoto Shinkai wrote and directed this 2004 film, produced by CoMix Wave.

the-legend-of-korra-book-3-change.summary: Two weeks after the events of Book Two, the world is still adjusting to the changes that swept through it. One surprise is that ordinary people across the nations have suddenly gained the power to bend air, a skill that had almost vanished. Avatar Korra, along with Tenzin, Mako, Bolin and Asami, sets out to find these new airbenders and help rebuild the Air Nation, though not everyone wants to join. At the same time, a secret group of dangerous anarchists emerges, with plans to topple the world's governments that put Korra herself in their sights. This third season, or Book, of the American animated series aired in 2014 and runs for 13 episodes. Contains action violence.
the-legend-of-korra-book-3-change.notes: No MyAnimeList or AniList entry (American series); sources are Wikipedia and Kitsu.

oku-sama-ga-seito-kaichou.summary: Hayato Izumi, a serious and rather shy high school student, runs for student council president but loses to Ui Wakana, an energetic girl whose campaign promises a much more open attitude to love and sex education. Settling for vice president, Hayato is shocked to come home and find Ui there, because their parents arranged long ago for the two to marry, and she is moving in as his wife. Keeping the arrangement secret at school while living together proves difficult. Seven adapted Yumi Nakata's manga into 12 short episodes in 2015. Contains explicit sexual content and frequent nudity.

fruits-basket-the-final.summary: The third and final season of the remake of Fruits Basket picks up the story of Tohru Honda, a kind-hearted orphan living with members of the Sohma family, several of whom are possessed by the spirits of the Chinese zodiac and change into animals when hugged by someone of the opposite sex. Tohru has resolved to break the curse that binds them to Akito, the clan's volatile head, while Kyo and Yuki struggle with their own pasts. As long-hidden truths about the Sohma family come out, each member faces questions about the bonds holding them together. TMS Entertainment produced the 13 episodes in 2021, completing the adaptation of Natsuki Takaya's manga. Contains emotional and physical abuse.

sidonia-no-kishi.summary: Centuries after an alien race called the Gauna destroyed Earth, the remnants of humanity drift through space aboard giant seed ships. On one of them, the Sidonia, Nagate Tanikaze has spent his whole life hidden deep in the ship's lowest levels. When hunger finally drives him to the surface in the year 3394, he is taken in and trained as a pilot of the giant mechs called Gardes that defend the ship. Thrown into combat against the Gauna, he must adjust to a society he barely understands. Polygon Pictures adapted Tsutomu Nihei's manga into 12 episodes in 2014. Contains violence and gore.

kara-no-kyoukai-4-garan-no-dou.summary: In June 1998, Shiki Ryougi wakes from a two-year coma that followed a car accident. She has lost her memories and feels strangely empty, as if she is not truly alive. Even worse, she now sees dark lines running across people and objects, and touching them breaks things apart, an ability called the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception. Her friend Mikiya Kokutou visits her often, and Touko Aozaki, a mage who runs an office known as Garan no Dou, offers to help her understand her new eyes as strange beings start coming after her. ufotable released this fourth chapter of The Garden of Sinners in 2008, based on Kinoko Nasu's novel. Contains violence and disturbing imagery.

nyan-koi.summary: Junpei Kosaka is a high school boy with a serious cat allergy, which makes it unfortunate that his family, his childhood friend and his crush, Kaede Mizuno, all adore cats. One day on the way home, Junpei kicks an empty can that knocks the head off a roadside statue of a cat guardian deity. From then on he can understand what cats say, and his family's cat Nyamsus explains the price: he must grant one hundred wishes from cats, or he will turn into one himself. Keeping it secret, he takes on feline requests while juggling a growing list of girls in his life. AIC adapted Sato Fujiwara's manga into 12 episodes in 2009. Contains fan service.

ao-no-exorcist-movie.summary: True Cross Academy is getting ready for a grand festival that comes around only once every eleven years, and the exorcists and their trainees are on duty to keep demons away from the celebrations. Rin Okumura, a son of Satan training as an exorcist, is sent with Shiemi Moriyama and his twin brother Yukio to deal with the Phantom Train, a demon that devours souls. During the mission the train breaks loose and tears through the academy, and in the chaos Rin meets a demon who looks like a small child and quickly becomes attached to him. A-1 Pictures released this film in 2012, based on Kazue Kato's manga. Contains action violence.

baccano-specials.summary: These three extra episodes of Baccano! take place in 1932, after the main series. Graham Specter, a wrench-wielding gang leader with a talent for long, odd monologues, has been devoted to the murderer Ladd Russo ever since Ladd spared his life. When Graham learns how things turned out for his idol aboard the transcontinental train, the Flying Pussyfoot, he plans a twisted tribute that starts with kidnapping Eve Genoard, a young heiress, and going after Jacuzzi Splot's gang. Several familiar faces are pulled into the scheme, and the episodes also tie up loose ends from the series. Brain's Base produced them in 2008 for the DVD release, based on Ryohgo Narita's light novels. Contains graphic violence.

high-school-dxd-ova.summary: These two extra episodes continue High School DxD, the comedy about Issei Hyodo, a lecherous high schooler reborn as a devil and serving the beautiful Rias Gremory in the Occult Research Club. The first follows the club investigating a rumour that girls at school vanish and return sick, with their breasts shrunken. In the second, Issei and Asia accompany Rias to check whether a coffin is cursed, and Issei ends up possessed by an ancient Egyptian magician just as perverted as he is. TNK released them in 2012 and 2013 as episodes 13 and 14, based on Ichiei Ishibumi's light novels. Contains explicit sexual content and frequent nudity.

oreimo-specials.summary: Kyosuke Kosaka spent most of the first season of OreImo helping his little sister Kirino, a model student and fashion model who secretly loves otaku media, especially games about little sisters. These four web episodes branch off after episode 11 of the TV series and offer an alternative final stretch, replacing the ending written for the broadcast with one that follows Tsukasa Fushimi's original light novels more closely. In this version, a sudden change in Kirino's plans shakes up the household, leaving Kyosuke and the friends she has made through her hobby to deal with the fallout. AIC Build released the episodes online in 2011.

binbougami-ga.summary: Ichiko Sakura is a high school girl blessed with almost absurd good fortune: she is beautiful, smart, rich and popular, because she unconsciously drains luck from the people around her. To restore the balance, the heavens send Momiji Binboda, a goddess of poverty, to take Ichiko's excess fortune back. Ichiko has no intention of giving it up, and the two settle into a running war of insults, schemes and slapstick fights, with a growing crowd of gods and humans getting caught in the middle. Sunrise adapted Yoshiaki Sukeno's manga into 13 episodes in 2012. Contains fan service and slapstick violence.

maken-ki.summary: Takeru Ohyama, an energetic and openly perverted teenager, picks his new high school because it requires no entrance exam and has just gone co-ed. He soon learns the school is far from ordinary: its students wield Maken, special weapons that channel their spiritual power, and conflicts are regularly settled through combat. Surrounded by strong-willed girls and with no Maken of his own at first, Takeru is quickly drawn into duels, rivalries and the dangers hidden around campus. AIC Spirits adapted Hiromitsu Takeda's manga into 12 episodes in 2011. Contains heavy fan service, nudity and action violence.

code-geass-fukkatsu-no-lelouch.summary: A year after the great war that reshaped the world, a fragile peace holds under the United Federation of Nations. That calm breaks when Nunnally, the former Britannian princess, is abducted together with Suzaku Kururugi, and suspicion falls on Zilkhstan, a small kingdom whose economy depends on hiring out its soldiers as mercenaries. Kallen Stadtfeld and a handful of old allies slip across the border on a covert rescue mission, and inside the country they cross paths with the immortal C.C., who is pursuing a purpose of her own. Sunrise released the film in 2019, directed by Goro Taniguchi. It continues directly from the three compilation films that retold the TV series, not from the original broadcast.

seiken-tsukai-no-world-break.summary: At Akane Academy, teenagers who have woken up with memories of earlier lives are trained as Saviors to fight the Metaphysicals, monsters that attack people without warning. Saviors normally fall into one of two camps, fighters who summon weapons and casters who use dark magic, but new student Moroha Haimura remembers two past lives, a swordsman prince and a sorcerer king, and can do both. On his first day he meets Satsuki Ranjou, who insists she was his sister in a former life, and the quiet Shizuno Urushibara, who claims an even closer bond from another one, and the pair begin competing for him. Diomedea adapted Akamitsu Awamura's light novels into 12 episodes in 2015. The series includes fan service.

skip-beat.summary: Kyoko Mogami left school in Kyoto to follow her childhood friend Sho Fuwa to Tokyo, where she works several jobs to support him while he rises as a pop idol. When she overhears him say that he only keeps her around as a live-in maid, her devotion turns to fury, and she vows to beat him at his own game by becoming a bigger star. Show business proves tougher than she expects, not least because the leading actor Ren Tsuruga disapproves of anyone who takes up acting for such a petty reason. Along the way, she begins to find out what she wants for herself. HAL Film Maker adapted Yoshiki Nakamura's shoujo manga into 25 episodes in 2008 and 2009.

taboo-tattoo.summary: Seigi Akatsuka is an ordinary middle schooler apart from his training in his family's style of jujitsu and a firm habit of stepping in to protect people. After he rescues a homeless old man from a gang of thugs, the stranger thanks him by leaving an odd tattoo on the palm of his hand. The mark turns out to be a source of supernatural power, and it quickly draws the attention of other tattoo bearers, including Izzy, a formidable girl who serves in a secret U.S. Army unit tasked with recovering the tattoos in Japan. J.C.Staff adapted Shinjiro's manga into 12 episodes in 2016. It contains action violence and some fan service.

amnesia.summary: A young woman collapses at the maid cafe where she works part-time and wakes up with no memory of who she is or of anyone around her. A small spirit called Orion, whom no one else can see or hear, explains that his arrival in her world knocked her memories loose, and he promises to help her get them back. Not wanting to worry anyone, she hides her condition while trying to work out her ties to several young men who clearly know her well, including the blunt Shin, the protective Toma and the charming Ikki. Brain's Base adapted Idea Factory's otome visual novel into 12 episodes in 2013.

kyousougiga-tv.summary: Long ago a monk named Myoue, whose drawings came to life, fled with his wife, a black rabbit who had taken human shape, and their three children, into a world he had drawn himself: a mirror version of Kyoto. When the parents vanished, the children were left to run the city, the eldest, Yakushimaru, taking on his father's name and duties while Kurama and Yase settled into their own roles. Years later a hyperactive girl named Koto, who fights with a giant hammer, finds her way into the city and starts looking for a way home and for clues about her own family. Toei Animation's 10-episode original series, directed by Rie Matsumoto, aired in 2013 after earlier web episodes.

bungou-stray-dogs-dead-apple.summary: In Yokohama, the Armed Detective Agency is a group of investigators with supernatural abilities who take on cases too dangerous for the police. In this film, set after the second TV season, the agency is asked to look into a wave of apparent suicides among ability users around the world, each one following the arrival of a strange fog. The trail leads to a man who calls himself the Collector, and when the fog rolls over Yokohama itself, Atsushi Nakajima and Kyoka Izumi are caught up in it, and the agency is pushed into an uneasy alliance with the Port Mafia. Bones produced the 2018 film, directed by Takuya Igarashi and co-written by original author Kafka Asagiri. It contains violence.

bleach-memories-of-nobody.summary: Ichigo Kurosaki is a teenager in Karakura Town who has taken on the powers of a Soul Reaper, fighting Hollows, the corrupted spirits that prey on the living and the dead. In this first Bleach film, he and Rukia Kuchiki come across strange white spirits that a mysterious Soul Reaper girl named Senna destroys before refusing to explain herself. While Ichigo follows the cheerful, evasive Senna around town, Rukia heads back to the Soul Society to find out why reflections of the human world have started appearing there. Studio Pierrot released the film in Japan in December 2006, directed by Noriyuki Abe and based on Tite Kubo's manga. It contains sword-fighting violence.

little-witch-academia-2.summary: At Luna Nova, an old academy for witches, Atsuko 'Akko' Kagari has big dreams of dazzling people with magic, though her spells rarely go to plan. After one disaster too many, Akko and her friends Lotte and Sucy face being expelled, and the one way to avoid that is to organise the school's yearly parade through a nearby town. When Akko learns what the parade was first meant to commemorate, she decides to turn it into a show that will change how people see witches, which proves hard to pull off with a reluctant team, prankish local boys and an ancient threat in the way. Trigger released this follow-up to the 2013 short in 2015, partly funded through Kickstarter.

love-hina.summary: As a small boy, Keitaro Urashima promised a girl that they would get into Tokyo University together, but he has long since forgotten her name. Now twenty, he has failed the entrance exam twice and his parents have stopped supporting him, so he heads to his grandmother's inn hoping for a place to stay and study. He finds that it has become a dormitory for girls, and after a disastrous first impression he is made the building's manager, living alongside residents such as the hot-tempered Naru Narusegawa, who is also aiming for Tokyo University. Xebec adapted Ken Akamatsu's manga into 24 episodes in 2000. The series includes fan service and slapstick violence.

white-album-2.summary: Haruki Kitahara is a third-year student and amateur guitarist whose band club has fallen apart just before the school festival, after the members they gathered all quit. Practising alone, he finds his playing joined by a voice and a piano from somewhere nearby. The singer is Setsuna Ogiso, the cheerful school idol who dreams of singing, and the pianist is Kazusa Touma, a gifted but withdrawn classmate who keeps everyone at a distance. Haruki sets out to bring both of them into the band in time for the festival, and as the three grow close over rehearsals, their friendship turns into a tangled romance. Satelight adapted Leaf's visual novel into 13 episodes in 2013.

eve-no-jikan.summary: In a future Japan where household androids are as ordinary as any appliance, high school student Rikuo Sakisaka has always treated them as machines.
