Then he notices that his family's android, Sammy, has been leaving the apartment on her own, and he finds a strange phrase recorded in her activity log. With his friend Masakazu Masaki he follows her trail to a small hidden cafe called the Time of Eve, which has one house rule: humans and androids must be treated exactly alike. Since no one inside reveals what they are, Rikuo starts talking with the regulars without knowing which of them are human. Yasuhiro Yoshiura created the six-episode web series, released by Studio Rikka between 2008 and 2009.
eve-no-jikan.notes: No AniList record was returned; facts checked against MAL and Wikipedia.

shoujo-kakumei-utena.summary: When Utena Tenjou was a sad little girl, a travelling prince comforted her and gave her a ring engraved with a rose, promising that they would meet again. Inspired, she resolved to grow up into a prince herself. Now a student at the exclusive Ohtori Academy who wears a boys' uniform, she is drawn into a series of sword duels fought by the Student Council, whose members wear rings just like hers. The winner of each duel becomes engaged to Anthy Himemiya, a quiet girl called the Rose Bride, who is said to hold the power to revolutionise the world. J.C.Staff produced the 39-episode original series in 1997, directed by Kunihiko Ikuhara.
shoujo-kakumei-utena.notes: No AniList record was returned; facts checked against MAL and Wikipedia.

black-cat.summary: Train Heartnet is the most feared assassin of Chronos, a secret organisation that wields enormous power behind the scenes, and in the underworld he is known simply as the Black Cat. He carries out his orders with cold efficiency until a chance meeting with Saya Minatsuki, a carefree bounty hunter, leaves him questioning the life he has chosen. The series follows his turn away from killing toward a freer life as a Sweeper, a licensed bounty hunter, working alongside his partner Sven Vollfied, though his old employers and a dangerous former colleague are not ready to let him go. Gonzo adapted Kentaro Yabuki's manga for television in 2005 and 2006. It contains gun violence.

servant-x-service.summary: At a ward office in the city of Mitsuba, Hokkaido, three new recruits begin life as civil servants. Lucy Yamagami took the job for a strange reason: her parents could not settle on one name, so she was registered with an absurdly long one, and she wants to find the official who approved it. She is joined by Yutaka Hasebe, an easygoing type always looking for a chance to skip work, and Saya Miyoshi, an anxious newcomer to the workforce, under Taishi Ichimiya, an eight-year veteran with no idea how to train anyone. Episodes follow their working days, from angry visitors to odd colleagues. A-1 Pictures adapted Karino Takatsu's comedy manga into 13 episodes in 2013.

slam-dunk.summary: Hanamichi Sakuragi is a towering, red-haired delinquent who has been turned down by fifty girls in a row by the time he starts at Shohoku High School. When the kind-hearted Haruko Akagi asks him whether he likes basketball, he falls for her on the spot and says yes, even though he has never played and has nothing but contempt for the sport. To impress her, he joins the school team, where he must deal with Haruko's brother, the stern captain Takenori Akagi, and the cool star rookie Kaede Rukawa, whom he instantly sees as a rival. Toei Animation adapted Takehiko Inoue's manga into 101 episodes, airing from 1993 to 1996.

seirei-no-moribito.summary: Balsa is a wandering spear fighter who works as a bodyguard for hire. While passing through the Shin Yogo Empire, she rescues the young Prince Chagum from danger and is asked to protect him from an unexpected enemy: his own father, the Mikado, who has ordered his death. Chagum has become host to a mysterious water spirit, and the court sees it as a threat to the realm. Balsa takes the boy on the run, and the two must learn to rely on each other while the emperor's men hunt for them. Production I.G adapted the first of Nahoko Uehashi's fantasy novels into 26 episodes in 2007, directed by Kenji Kamiyama.

k-missing-kings.summary: A year after a crisis that left Shiro, the Silver King, missing, his clansmen Kuroh Yatogami and Neko are still searching for him without any luck. Their hunt takes a turn when they come across Rikio Kamamoto and Anna Kushina of the Red Clan, HOMRA, being chased through the city by members of the Green Clan, who want Anna's unusual power for themselves. To protect Anna, Kuroh and Neko find themselves working alongside Scepter 4, while the Green Clan threatens the domain of the Gold King. GoHands produced the film in 2014 as a sequel to the original K television series.

nurarihyon-no-mago.summary: Rikuo Nura looks like a normal middle schooler, but he is part yokai and heir to the Nura Clan, a household of monsters he shares with his grandfather, Nurarihyon, who expect him to become its third head. Having grown up surrounded by friendly monsters, he was hurt to learn that other people fear yokai as bloodthirsty creatures, so he wants to live as an ordinary human. That is difficult when his yokai attendant attends school disguised as a classmate, his friend Kiyotsugu runs a club that hunts for yokai, and his own yokai blood awakens at night. Studio Deen adapted Hiroshi Shiibashi's manga into 24 episodes in 2010, and a second season followed in 2011.

gochuumon-wa-usagi-desu-ka.summary: Cocoa Hoto moves to a European-style town to attend high school and walks into the Rabbit House cafe expecting rabbits to cuddle. What she finds instead is her new lodgings, run by the family of Chino Kafuu, a quiet, serious girl who wears a fluffy rabbit named Tippy on her head. Working at the cafe to pay for her room, the cheerful Cocoa decides to act as Chino's big sister and makes friends with the military-minded Rize, the easygoing Chiya from a traditional sweets cafe, and the hard-up Sharo, who carries herself with an air of nobility. White Fox adapted Koi's four-panel comedy manga into 12 episodes in 2014.

naruto-shippuden-movie-2-kizuna.summary: Flying ninja from the Land of Sky launch a sudden attack on the Hidden Leaf Village, seeking revenge for an old war. As the village counts the damage, Naruto Uzumaki is tied up helping Shinno, a wandering doctor, and meets Amaru, a fierce young ninja from a nearby village who has come looking for Shinno's help. Tsunade sends a small team to strike at the invaders' base, while Naruto, Sakura and Hinata escort Amaru and the doctor home, a journey that soon crosses paths with Sasuke, now under Orochimaru's command. Studio Pierrot released the second Shippuden film in 2008, directed by Hajime Kamegaki. It contains ninja combat violence.

kono-bijutsubu-ni-wa-mondai-ga-aru.summary: Mizuki Usami is the only member of her middle school's art club who actually wants to make art. The club president sleeps through almost every meeting, another member rarely turns up at all, and Subaru Uchimaki, who has genuine artistic talent, spends all his effort trying to paint his ideal two-dimensional wife. Usami acts as the group's straight man, trying to steer them toward proper club activities, but she is also nursing a crush on Uchimaki that she refuses to admit and he never seems to notice. Feel adapted Imigimuru's comedy manga into 12 episodes in 2016.

aoi-bungaku-series.summary: Aoi Bungaku Series is an anthology that adapts six classics of modern Japanese literature, each given two to four episodes and its own creative team. It opens with Osamu Dazai's No Longer Human, about a young man so alienated from others that he slides into self-destruction, and continues with Ango Sakaguchi's In the Forest, Under Cherries in Full Bloom, Natsume Soseki's Kokoro, Dazai's Run, Melos!, and two stories by Ryunosuke Akutagawa, The Spider's Thread and Hell Screen. Manga artists Takeshi Obata, Tite Kubo and Takeshi Konomi designed the characters, and actor Masato Sakai narrates. Madhouse produced the 12 episodes in 2009. It deals with suicide, addiction and violence.

love-live-school-idol-project-2nd-season.summary: The second season picks up with the nine members of mu's, the school idol group formed to draw attention to Otonokizaka High School, as a new and larger edition of the Love Live! school idol tournament is announced. Honoka Kosaka, the group's impulsive and upbeat founder, and her friends throw themselves into new songs and performances to take on rival groups from other schools. Hanging over everything is the approaching graduation of the three third-year members, which forces the group to think about what comes after the tournament. Sunrise produced the 13 episodes, which aired in 2014, as part of the multimedia Love Live! project.
love-live-school-idol-project-2nd-season.notes: No AniList record was returned; facts checked against MAL and Wikipedia.

juuni-taisen.summary: Every twelve years, twelve of the world's deadliest fighters, each named after and modelled on an animal of the Chinese zodiac, meet for the Zodiac War, a battle royale whose last survivor is granted any single wish. The twelfth war is held in a city whose population has been emptied out, and before it begins, every warrior is made to swallow a poisoned gem that will kill them within twelve hours unless the winner collects all twelve. The fighters, mostly hardened mercenaries, bring very different reasons and methods to the contest. Graphinica adapted Nisio Isin's novel, illustrated by Hikaru Nakamura, into 12 episodes in 2017. It contains graphic violence and gore.
juuni-taisen.notes: No AniList record was returned; facts checked against MAL and Wikipedia.

kantai-collection.summary: The seas have been overrun by the Abyssal Fleet, a hostile force of mysterious enemy ships, and humanity's defence rests on the kanmusu, girls who carry the spirits of historical warships and fight wearing weaponised rigging. Fubuki, a shy and inexperienced destroyer, arrives at a naval base as a new recruit and is placed straight into a frontline torpedo squadron, where she struggles to keep up with her more seasoned comrades. The series follows her training, the friendships she makes with the other girls at the base, and their missions out at sea. Diomedea adapted Kadokawa Games' browser game into 12 episodes in 2015.

fuuka.summary: Yuu Haruna has just moved to Tokyo with his sisters after his father was posted overseas, and he spends most of his time glued to social media on his phone. On his first evening out, a girl crashes into him, assumes he was trying to photograph up her skirt, smashes his phone and leaves. She turns out to be Fuuka Akitsuki, a classmate at his new school who has no phone of her own and still listens to music on a CD player. As the two get to know each other, Fuuka talks Yuu into forming a band with their friends. Diomedea adapted Kouji Seo's manga into 12 episodes in 2017.

one-piece-3d2y-special.summary: This TV special is set during the two-year break that follows the war at Marineford, while Monkey D. Luffy trains on the dangerous island of Rusukaina to master Haki, the fighting energy that can boost a warrior's abilities. His training is interrupted when his ally Boa Hancock's two sisters, Sandersonia and Marigold, are abducted by an escaped pirate whose freedom traces back to Luffy's own actions. With Hancock's help, Luffy sets out to rescue them, testing his new skills while looking toward reuniting with his crew. Toei Animation aired the special on Fuji TV in 2014. It assumes viewers have seen the Marineford arc.

yowamushi-pedal.summary: Sakamichi Onoda is a cheerful, scrawny anime fan who starts at Sohoku High School hoping to revive its defunct anime club and finally make some friends. He has been riding a bulky old city bike all the way to Akihabara and back every week since primary school, a trip of around 90 kilometres. When the driven cyclist Shunsuke Imaizumi spots him pedalling up a steep hill near the school with ease, he challenges Onoda to a race, and the shy otaku begins to find out what kind of rider he could become, and where he might fit in. TMS Entertainment adapted Wataru Watanabe's road-racing manga into 38 episodes, airing from 2013 to 2014.

fate-stay-night-unlimited-blade-works.summary: In Fuyuki City, seven mages called Masters summon heroic spirits known as Servants and fight to the death in the Holy Grail War, with the Grail, said to grant any wish, as the prize. Rin Tohsaka, a high school student and talented mage, has prepared her whole life for the fifth war and enters it with her Servant, Archer. When her classmate Shirou Emiya stumbles into the war and ends up as a Master himself, she offers him a temporary alliance, and the two learn more about each other's ideals as the fighting grows more dangerous. Studio Deen's 2010 film, directed by Yuji Yamaguchi, condenses the second route of Type-Moon's visual novel. It contains violence.

sakurako-san-no-ashimoto-ni-wa-shitai-ga.summary: High schooler Shoutarou Tatewaki's first encounter with Sakurako Kujou happens under suspicious circumstances, but she turns out to be an eccentric osteologist who lives for bones. Her home is full of carefully reassembled animal skeletons, and she makes no secret of wanting more human ones. Shoutarou ends up as her reluctant assistant, and because she has a habit of stumbling onto bodies and remains, he is soon helping her piece together the stories behind them, one case at a time, while a larger mystery takes shape in the background. Troyca adapted Shiori Ota's mystery novels into 12 episodes in 2015. It shows corpses and skeletal remains.

given-movie.summary: This film continues the story of the 2019 TV series. The band 'given', made up of high schoolers Ritsuka Uenoyama and Mafuyu Sato and college students Haruki Nakayama and Akihiko Kaji, now stands in the final round of an amateur contest judged on live shows, and they are worried that they have only one original song. While Mafuyu searches for ways to write new music, the focus shifts to Akihiko, the band's drummer, who is caught between bassist Haruki and his complicated history with the violinist Ugetsu Murata. Lerche released the film in 2020, based on Natsuki Kizu's boys' love manga.

one-piece-film-gold.summary: Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates arrive at Gran Tesoro, a gigantic ship that is also an independent nation and the world's largest entertainment city, ruled by the gold-obsessed Gild Tesoro. Treated as VIPs and handed piles of money to gamble with, the crew go on a lucky streak at the casinos until Tesoro himself invites them to a high-stakes game. When that game goes badly wrong and Zoro is taken prisoner, the Straw Hats plan a heist against the city's ruler with the help of some unlikely allies. Toei Animation released the film in 2016, directed by Hiroaki Miyamoto and based on Eiichiro Oda's manga.

canaan.summary: Maria Oosawa, a young Japanese photographer, comes to Shanghai with her colleague Minoru Minorikawa to report on an international anti-terrorism conference. At a local festival, the pair are caught between masked gunmen and a white-haired woman, and Maria is pulled out of danger by Canaan, a skilled mercenary she once knew, whose synesthesia lets her read a battlefield in colours. Their reunion draws Maria into a conflict involving Canaan's rival Alphard, a terrorist group called Snake and a dangerous virus. P.A. Works produced the 13 episodes in 2009, based on a scenario Type-Moon's Kinoko Nasu and Takashi Takeuchi wrote for the game 428: Shibuya Scramble. It contains gun violence.

aku-no-hana.summary: Takao Kasuga is a bookish middle schooler in a small town in Gunma who idolises the poet Charles Baudelaire. One evening, after returning to his empty classroom for a forgotten book, he gives in to impulse and steals the gym clothes of Nanako Saeki, the classmate he worships from afar. He is soon horrified to learn that he was seen by Sawa Nakamura, an abrasive, friendless classmate, and she uses his secret to drag him into a twisted 'contract' that pushes him further out of his comfort zone. Zexcs adapted Shuzo Oshimi's manga into 13 episodes in 2013, using rotoscoped animation. It deals with disturbing psychological themes.

kanokon.summary: Kouta Oyamada grew up in the countryside and has moved to the city to live with his grandmother and start high school. His hopes of fitting in quietly are dashed when Chizuru Minamoto, a striking second-year, confesses her love on his first day and then flirts with him openly in front of everyone. Chizuru is in fact a fox spirit, and she is not the only supernatural being interested in the bewildered Kouta: a wolf spirit named Nozomu soon arrives as a rival, along with other yokai. Xebec adapted Katsumi Nishino's light novels into 12 episodes in 2008. The series features heavy sexual fan service.

servamp.summary: Mahiru Shirota is a high school student who likes to keep life simple, but he cannot bring himself to walk past a stray black cat, so he takes it home and names it Kuro. The next day he finds a strange young man in his place: Kuro is really one of seven vampires tied to the Seven Deadly Sins, a sloth-loving shut-in who turns into a cat in sunlight. By naming him and giving him a bell, Mahiru has accidentally bound himself to Kuro as his master, which pulls the pair into a conflict between the other vampires and their human partners. Brain's Base and Platinum Vision adapted Strike Tanaka's manga into 12 episodes in 2016.

magical-warfare.summary: Takeshi Nanase is a high school student with a troubled past who practises kendo. On his way to practice one summer morning he finds a girl collapsed by the road, wearing an unfamiliar school uniform, and looks after her until she recovers. Her name is Mui Aiba, and she accidentally turns him into a magician, exposing him to a hidden world of magic users. Most of them want to live quietly alongside ordinary people, but not all, and Takeshi soon enrols at the Subaru Magic Academy, where magicians learn to control their powers. Madhouse adapted Hisashi Suzuki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2014.

squid-girl.summary: Fed up with humans polluting the oceans, a girl from the sea with blue tentacles for hair, who can spit squid ink, comes ashore to begin her conquest of humanity. Her first target is the Lemon, a small beach house restaurant run by the Aizawa siblings, which she plans to use as her base. Instead, she damages the building on arrival and is put to work as a waitress to pay for the repairs. Squid Girl's grand plans keep getting sidetracked by the beach, the customers and the everyday pleasures of human life. Diomedea adapted Masahiro Anbe's comedy manga into 12 episodes in 2010, and a second season followed in 2011.

dungeon-ni-deai-o-motomeru-no-wa-machiga.summary: In the labyrinth city of Orario, Bell Cranel leads the small Hestia Familia as he keeps pushing deeper into the vast Dungeon beneath the city. The third season begins with an encounter that makes no sense to him: a Vouivre, a species of monster with a fearsome reputation, takes the form of a frightened girl who is in tears and running from a group of adventurers. Bell decides on the spot to hide and protect her, an act of kindness that sets off consequences rippling through the whole city. J.C.Staff produced the 12 episodes in 2020, adapting Fujino Omori's light novels. It contains fantasy violence.

children-who-chase-lost-voices.summary: Asuna Watase is a self-reliant schoolgirl who looks after the house while her mother, a nurse, works long shifts. Her favourite escape is a hideout in the hills, where she listens to a crystal radio that her late father gave her. One day she picks up a haunting melody she has never heard before, and soon after she is rescued from a monstrous creature by Shun, a mysterious boy from a distant land. That meeting leads her, together with her substitute teacher, on a journey into Agartha, a hidden underground world out of legend. Makoto Shinkai wrote and directed the film, released by CoMix Wave Films in 2011.

seitokai-yakuindomo-2nd-season.summary: The second season returns to Ousai Private Academy, a former girls' school that recently went co-ed, where Takatoshi Tsuda serves as vice president on a student council made up of girls. A year has passed and the senior members are now in their final year, but little has changed: president Shino Amakusa still peppers every conversation with dirty jokes, the wealthy Aria Shichijou matches her, and the tiny treasurer Suzu Hagimura is still sensitive about her height, which leaves Tsuda as the group's exhausted straight man. GoHands adapted Tozen Ujiie's four-panel manga into 13 episodes in 2014. The humour relies heavily on sexual innuendo.

michiko-to-hatchin.summary: In Diamandra, a fictional South American country with a strong Brazilian flavour, Michiko Malandro is a free-spirited criminal who breaks out of a supposedly escape-proof prison fortress. She heads straight for Hana Morenos, a girl being mistreated by her foster family, and announces that she is Hana's mother. Hana, nicknamed Hatchin, is far from convinced, but she runs away with Michiko on a stolen motorbike, and the mismatched pair set out across the country to find a man from Michiko's past while the police and gangsters chase after them. Manglobe produced the 22-episode original series in 2008 and 2009, directed by Sayo Yamamoto. It contains violence and child abuse.

mobile-suit-gundam-00.summary: In 2307 AD, fossil fuels have run out and the world depends on vast solar power systems controlled by three rival superpower blocs, while nations left behind sink into poverty and war. Into this tense balance steps Celestial Being, a secretive private army that declares it will end all war through armed intervention, using four Gundams far more advanced than any other mobile suits. Setsuna F. Seiei, a taciturn teenage pilot who grew up in a war-torn country, is one of its Gundam Meisters, and the group's attacks soon turn the whole world against it. Sunrise produced the 25-episode first season in 2007 and 2008, directed by Seiji Mizushima. It contains war violence.

porco-rosso.summary: In the Adriatic of the late 1920s, a former Italian World War I ace named Marco Pagot makes his living as a bounty hunter, chasing down bands of air pirates in his red seaplane. For reasons never fully explained, he has been turned into a pig and now goes by Porco Rosso. When the pirates hire Donald Curtis, a brash American pilot, to bring him down, Porco has to get his plane rebuilt in Milan, where the job falls to Fio Piccolo, the mechanic's young granddaughter. Meanwhile his old friend Gina waits for him at her hotel. Hayao Miyazaki wrote and directed the 1992 Studio Ghibli film, based on his own manga.

shakugan-no-shana-iii-final.summary: The final season of the series continues the story of Shana, a Flame Haze who hunts the Crimson Denizens, beings from another world who feed on the existence of humans, and Yuji Sakai, the boy whose ordinary life she upended. It picks up after Yuji vanishes on the night he was due to make an important choice. When he reappears, he has taken an unexpected place among the Denizens and set out on a plan he claims will bring peace, and Shana and Flame Hazes from around the world gather for a war over the future of both worlds. J.C.Staff produced the 24 episodes in 2011 and 2012, based on Yashichiro Takahashi's light novels.

mahouka-koukou-no-rettousei-movie-hoshi-.summary: Tatsuya Shiba and his sister Miyuki have completed their first year at First High, a school for magicians, and spend spring break at their family's villa in the Ogasawara Islands. The quiet holiday does not last: a young woman named Kokoa, who has fled a naval base, appears and asks Tatsuya to help her with a single wish. The film tells a new story written by the series' creator, Tsutomu Sato, rather than adapting a novel. 8bit produced it as a follow-up to the 2014 TV series, and it opened in Japanese cinemas in June 2017.

uchouten-kazoku.summary: In modern Kyoto, tanuki who can shapeshift and tengu who can fly live alongside humans, who have no idea they are there. Yasaburou Shimogamo, the carefree third son of a respected tanuki family, spends his days looking after Professor Akadama, his grumpy old tengu teacher, and avoiding Benten, a beautiful human woman whom Akadama taught to fly. The Shimogamo brothers and their mother are still coping with the death of their father, and Benten belongs to the Friday Fellows, a club of humans who end each year with a tanuki hot pot. P.A. Works adapted Tomihiko Morimi's novel into 13 episodes in 2013.

chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-take-on-me.summary: Rikka Takanashi is in her final year of high school and is still a chuunibyou, acting out fantasies of secret powers, while her relationship with Yuta Togashi has barely moved forward in half a year. With entrance exams approaching, the two hope to attend the same college, but Rikka's strict older sister Toka announces that she has found work in Italy and plans to take Rikka with her. Unwilling to be separated, the couple turn to their friends for help and settle on a drastic plan. Kyoto Animation released the film in January 2018, directed by Tatsuya Ishihara. It is set after the second season and serves as the anime's finale.

gunslinger-girl.summary: In modern Italy, the Social Welfare Agency presents itself as a charity, but behind closed doors it is an arm of the government. It takes in girls who have suffered severe trauma or injury, rebuilds their bodies with cybernetic implants and conditions them to work as assassins against terrorists. Each girl is paired with an adult handler, and the pair is known as a fratello. The series follows several of these girls, chiefly Henrietta and her handler Jose, as they carry out missions while still behaving like children who long for affection. Madhouse adapted Yu Aida's manga into 13 episodes in 2003 and 2004. It contains violence and disturbing themes.

jitsu-wa-watashi-wa.summary: Asahi Kuromine is an honest high school boy whose every thought shows on his face, which makes him famously bad at keeping secrets. When he finally works up the nerve to confess to his classmate and crush, Youko Shiragami, he sees her spread a large pair of wings and learns that she is a vampire. She can only stay at an ordinary school as long as nobody finds out, so Asahi promises to keep quiet, a task made harder as more classmates with unusual secrets of their own turn up around him. TMS Entertainment and 3xCube adapted Eiji Masuda's manga, published in English as My Monster Secret, into 13 episodes in 2015.

durarara-specials.summary: These two bonus episodes, released on home video, return to the crowded streets of Ikebukuro, where a headless dullahan named Celty Sturluson works as an underground courier on a black motorbike, and where the city's eccentric residents keep colliding with one another. Episode 12.5 slots between episodes 12 and 13 of the TV series and follows Celty through a delivery job and a rumoured UFO sighting that stir up the neighbourhood. Episode 25 takes place after the series' final episode, when the actor Yuhei Hanejima, brother of the short-tempered Shizuo Heiwajima, comes to town to host a TV special and his safety is put at risk. Brain's Base produced both episodes, released in 2010 and 2011.
durarara-specials.notes: Wikipedia does not describe the specials; episode content rests on MAL and AniList, which each describe episode 12.5 differently (courier job vs UFO rumour), so both are mentioned only briefly.

hayate-no-gotoku-1.summary: On Christmas Eve, hard-working teenager Hayate Ayasaki learns that his feckless parents have run off and left him a debt of more than 150 million yen, and that the yakuza they borrowed from plan to sell him to cover it. Desperate, he decides to kidnap a rich-looking girl he runs into that night and hold her for ransom, but his clumsy words come out sounding like a love confession. The girl is Nagi Sanzenin, the young heiress of an extremely wealthy family, and after Hayate rescues her from real kidnappers she takes him on as her personal butler. SynergySP adapted Kenjiro Hata's comedy manga into 52 episodes from 2007 to 2008, full of parodies and fourth-wall jokes.

kamisama-hajimemashita-ova.summary: Nanami Momozono is a high school girl who unexpectedly became the land god of a small shrine, served by Tomoe, a sharp-tongued fox spirit who acts as her familiar. These two OVA episodes came packaged with volume 16 of Julietta Suzuki's manga. In the first, Nanami is thrown when Tomoe receives a mysterious black box and declares he no longer needs her, and she sets out to discover what is inside. In the second, stung by a remark from her other familiar, Mizuki, that she relies on Tomoe too much, Nanami sets out to prove she can manage on her own during a trip to a hot spring inn. TMS Entertainment produced the episodes in 2013.
kamisama-hajimemashita-ova.notes: Episode plots rest on the MAL synopsis only; AniList, Kitsu and ANN confirm the two-episode format and the manga volume bundle, and Wikipedia does not cover the OVA.

hetalia-axis-powers.summary: In Hetalia, countries are people. The series retells the World Wars and centuries of international history as a running gag comedy, with each nation personified as a character built on cultural stereotypes. Germany, stern and organised, finds himself allied with the cheerful, pasta-loving and hopelessly unreliable North Italy and the polite but baffling Japan, while the bickering Allies struggle to agree on anything. The short episodes jump between historical anecdotes and everyday national quirks. Studio Deen adapted Hidekaz Himaruya's webcomic into 52 short web episodes released from 2009 to 2010. Its humour relies on national stereotypes.

mm.summary: High schooler Taro Sado has a secret he desperately wants rid of: he is a masochist. Hoping to be cured, he turns to the Second Volunteer Club, a school club that promises to help students with their problems. Its president, the self-proclaimed goddess Mio Isurugi, agrees to 'fix' him, but the club's members and adviser have issues of their own, from Mio's fear of cats to Arashiko Yuuno's severe fear of men, and Taro's best friend Tatsukichi Hayama, who dresses as a girl, only adds to the chaos. Xebec adapted Akinari Matsuno's light novels into 12 episodes in 2010. The comedy is built on sexual humour and fan service.

working-3.summary: Souta Takanashi is a high school student with an obsession for small, cute things who works part-time at Wagnaria, a family restaurant in Hokkaido staffed by eccentrics. His co-workers include the tiny senior Popura Taneshima, the katana-carrying chief Yachiyo Todoroki and Mahiru Inami, who punches any man who comes near her. In this third and final season, the staff's long-running threads come to the fore, from awkward romances and a search for a missing spouse to uncomfortable family reunions, while the restaurant's daily chaos carries on. A-1 Pictures adapted Karino Takatsu's four-panel manga into 13 episodes in 2015. It follows the 2010 and 2011 seasons.

love-lab.summary: Fujisaki Girls Academy is famous for its proper, elegant students, and none is more admired than student council president Natsuo Maki. Riko Kurahashi, popular for her bold, tomboyish manner, gets a shock when she walks into the council room and catches Maki practising kissing on a pillow. Maki turns out to be desperate for romance despite having no experience of it, and because Riko is rumoured to be experienced in love, she is recruited into the council to help, even though she has no more experience than Maki. Together they start the 'Love Lab' to rehearse romantic scenarios such as holding hands. Doga Kobo adapted Ruri Miyahara's four-panel manga into 13 episodes in 2013.

handa-kun.summary: Sei Handa is a gifted high school calligrapher who is convinced that everyone at school hates him. In reality he is the most admired student on campus, worshipped for his talent, looks and aloof manner, and the constant attention he takes for bullying is really fan devotion. Each of his attempts to keep his classmates at arm's length only produces more misunderstandings and wins him even more admirers, including some who first approach him as rivals. The series is a spin-off of Barakamon set during Handa's school days. Diomedea adapted Satsuki Yoshino's manga into 12 episodes in 2016.

naruto-movie-2-daigekitotsu-maboroshi-no.summary: Mysterious armoured warriors land on a beach in the Land of Wind, where Gaara and the Sand ninja drive them back. Soon afterwards, while Naruto Uzumaki, Sakura Haruno and Shikamaru Nara are on a simple mission to recover a lost pet ferret, the same soldiers attack, led by the knight Temujin, and Naruto's fight with him ends with both of them going over a cliff. As Sakura and Shikamaru search for him, a vast moving fortress appears, and the trail leads to a legendary power known as the Stone of Gelel. Studio Pierrot released the second Naruto film in Japan in August 2005, written by Hirotsugu Kawasaki and Yuka Miyata. It contains ninja combat violence.

plastic-nee-san.summary: Iroe Genma, nicknamed Neesan or 'Elder Sister' despite being short, is a troublemaking third-year who presides over the model-building club at her high school, where members assemble plastic kits of cars, ships, robots and more. Her two juniors, the hot-headed Hazuki 'Okappa' Okamoto and the level-headed Makina 'Makimaki' Sakamaki, try to keep club activities on track, but the three are constantly sidetracked by pranks, fights and odd schemes. Each short episode is a quick burst of absurd school comedy. TYO Animations adapted Cha Kurii's manga, published in English as +Tic Elder Sister, into 12 web episodes from 2011 to 2012, directed by Tsutomu Mizushima.

naruto-shippuden-movie-4-the-lost-tower.summary: Captain Yamato leads Naruto Uzumaki, Sakura Haruno and Sai to hunt down the rogue ninja Mukade, who wants to seize the Ryumyaku, an ancient chakra flowing beneath the ruins of the desert city of Loran. They fail to stop him from breaking the seal over it, and a burst of light swallows Naruto and Yamato. Naruto wakes up in Loran as it was twenty years earlier, when the city was flourishing under its young queen, Sara, and finds himself working with a team of Hidden Leaf ninja on a secret mission there. Studio Pierrot released the fourth Shippuden film in 2010, directed by Masahiko Murata. It contains ninja combat violence.

kill-la-kill-special.summary: This is a follow-up to the Kill la Kill TV series, which followed transfer student Ryuko Matoi's fight against Satsuki Kiryuin, who rules Honnouji Academy as its iron-fisted student council head, and the battle suits made from Life Fibers. This OVA, released on home video as a 25th episode, is set two weeks after the series' final battle. Honnouji Academy is about to close, and its graduation ceremony is interrupted by copies of Satsuki and her Elite Four in their old uniforms, forcing Ryuko and the real council members back into action one more time. Trigger produced it in 2014. It assumes viewers have finished the series and includes the show's frequent fan service.
kill-la-kill-special.notes: The premise necessarily reveals that the TV series' final battle has ended.

ishuzoku-reviewers.summary: In a fantasy world where many humanoid races live side by side and prostitution is legal, every species has its own brothels. The human adventurer Stunk and his elf friend Zel decide to settle their arguments about which are best by writing reviews of their visits and posting them in their local tavern, where the scores become popular with other customers. They are soon joined by Crimvael, an angel who has lost part of their halo and cannot return to Heaven without it. Passione adapted the manga by Amahara and masha into 12 episodes in 2020. The series is a sex comedy built almost entirely on explicit sexual content.

mayoiga.summary: Thirty young men and women board a bus bound for Nanaki Village, a place that, according to urban legend, lets people leave their old lives behind and start over. Each has a reason to run, from the timid Mitsumune, desperate to escape an overbearing mother, to Masaki, a mysterious girl he decides to look out for. After a bumpy journey they reach the village, only to find it deserted and slowly falling apart, and the group's excitement quickly turns to suspicion and unease as strange things begin to happen. Diomedea produced the 12-episode original series in 2016, directed by Tsutomu Mizushima and written by Mari Okada. It contains some violence and disturbing scenes.

hibike-euphonium-2.summary: The second season returns to the concert band of Kitauji High School in Uji, Kyoto, which has started to improve under its strict new adviser, Noboru Taki. Having made it through to the Kansai regional competition, the band spends its summer at a training camp, coached by Taki and professional musicians he knows, as it aims for a gold award. Euphonium player Kumiko Oumae finds herself caught up in other people's problems again when a former member who quit the year before asks to rejoin, stirring up painful memories among the second-years. Kyoto Animation adapted Ayano Takeda's novels into 13 episodes in 2016.

sket-dance.summary: At Kaimei High School, the SKET Brigade is a three-person club set up to help students and teachers with any problem, though most people treat it as an odd-jobs service. Its leader, Yusuke 'Bossun' Fujisaki, can focus to an extraordinary degree when he puts on his goggles; Hime 'Himeko' Onizuka is a former delinquent who swings a hockey stick; and Kazuyoshi 'Switch' Usui is a computer-savvy otaku who speaks only through a speech synthesiser. Between real requests, they spend a lot of time bickering in their clubroom, and most episodes mix comedy with the occasional serious story. Tatsunoko Production adapted Kenta Shinohara's manga into 77 episodes, airing from 2011 to 2012.

one-outs.summary: The Saitama Lycaons are the weakest team in Japanese professional baseball, and their veteran star hitter Hiromichi Kojima is running out of time to win a championship. At a training camp in Okinawa he meets Toua Tokuchi, a pitcher with no obvious talent who has never lost at One Outs, a street gambling game in which a pitcher and a batter face off one-on-one for money. Kojima persuades the cool, calculating Tokuchi to join the Lycaons, and Tokuchi strikes an unusual pay deal with the team's greedy owner, in which every out earns him money and every run costs him. Madhouse adapted Shinobu Kaitani's manga into 25 episodes in 2008 and 2009, directed by Yuzo Sato.

ghost-hunt.summary: High school student Mai Taniyama is swapping ghost stories with friends when she gets involved with Shibuya Psychic Research, an investigation agency run by Kazuya Shibuya, a cool-headed seventeen-year-old she nicknames 'Naru' for his narcissism. After a mishap at an allegedly haunted old school building, Mai ends up working for him as an assistant. Alongside a team of spiritualists, including a monk, a shrine maiden, a priest and a medium, they investigate hauntings across Japan with cameras and scientific equipment as well as traditional exorcisms, while Mai discovers latent psychic abilities of her own. J.C.Staff adapted Fuyumi Ono's novels into 25 episodes in 2006 and 2007. It contains horror imagery.

magi-sinbad-no-bouken.summary: Long before the events of Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic, mysterious towers called Dungeons have begun appearing around the world, and no one who has entered one has come back out. In a Parthevian port town, a good-natured, adventurous boy named Sinbad meets Yunan, a carefree traveller whose easygoing manner hides great power, and learns he may have what it takes to become a king. Encouraged, Sinbad sets out to conquer the first Dungeon and change the world. Lay-duce produced these five OVA episodes from 2014 to 2015, based on the spin-off prequel manga written by Shinobu Ohtaka and illustrated by Yoshifumi Ohtera.

ore-ga-ojou-sama-gakkou-ni-shomin-sample.summary: Kimito Kagurazaka, an average teenage boy, is abducted and enrolled at Seikain Academy, an elite school for wealthy young ladies who have been sheltered from the outside world. The academy wants him as a 'commoner sample', so its students can learn about ordinary people, and men, before they graduate. Staff believe he is only interested in men, which is the only reason they think he is safe, and he is told that if he shows any interest in the girls the consequences will be severe. Kimito keeps up the act while the curious students bombard him with questions about commoner life. Silver Link adapted Takafumi Nanatsuki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2015. It includes sexual humour.

itazura-na-kiss.summary: Kotoko Aihara is a clumsy third-year student in the lowest class at her high school, and when she finally hands a love letter to Naoki Irie, the school's top student, he turns her down on the spot. Days later, her family's brand-new house collapses in a minor earthquake, and she and her father move in with an old friend of his, who turns out to be Naoki's father. Living under the same roof as the boy who turned her down, with his mother eagerly trying to bring them together, Kotoko refuses to give up on winning him over. TMS Entertainment adapted Kaoru Tada's manga into 25 episodes in 2008.

hajime-no-ippo-rising.summary: The third season of Hajime no Ippo follows Ippo Makunouchi, a once-bullied boy who found his calling in boxing at the Kamogawa Gym, as he defends his title as Japanese featherweight champion. His powerful signature move, the Dempsey Roll, has carried him through fight after fight, but new challengers are lining up with their own ideas for how to beat it, and Ippo has to keep evolving. Meanwhile, his gym mates have their own goals, including the comic Masaru Aoki, who is chasing a lightweight title. Madhouse and MAPPA adapted George Morikawa's manga into 25 episodes in 2013 and 2014. It contains boxing violence.

mob-psycho-100-iii.summary: Shigeo 'Mob' Kageyama is a quiet middle schooler with immense psychic powers, who tries hard to keep his emotions in check because of what his abilities can do. In the third season he is back to ordinary concerns, starting with a career-path form he does not know how to fill in, while still working at the spirit consultation office of his mentor, Arataka Reigen, alongside new staff member Katsuya Serizawa. As Mob tries to become more independent and connect with the people around him, new cases and personal problems test him. Bones produced the 12 episodes in 2022, adapting ONE's web manga.

naruto-shippuden-movie-5-blood-prison.summary: The Fourth Raikage of the Hidden Cloud Village is attacked during a meeting, and to everyone's shock the attacker appears to be Naruto Uzumaki. Accused of that and other crimes he insists he did not commit, Naruto is sent by Tsunade to Hozuki Castle, a maximum-security prison for criminal ninja, to avoid a diplomatic crisis while the case is investigated. Inside, the warden Mui seals away his chakra, and Naruto has to survive among dangerous inmates while working out who framed him and what the prison is hiding. Studio Pierrot released the fifth Shippuden film in 2011, directed by Masahiko Murata. It contains ninja combat violence.

non-non-biyori-repeat.summary: Asahigaoka is a sleepy rural village with one bus route, one sweets shop and a tiny school with only five pupils. The second season goes back over the year in the life of its handful of pupils, starting as the youngest, Renge Miyauchi, gets ready to begin first grade. Renge spends her days with the energetic Natsumi Koshigaya, her older sister Komari and Hotaru Ichijo, a transfer student from Tokyo. The episodes follow them gently through the seasons of country life, from rice fields to summer festivals. Silver Link adapted Atto's manga into 12 episodes in 2015.

the-legend-of-korra-book-1-air.summary: Seventy years after Avatar: The Last Airbender, Korra, a hot-headed seventeen-year-old from the Southern Water Tribe, has mastered water, earth and fire, and is the new Avatar, the one person who can bend all four elements. To learn airbending she moves to Republic City, a bustling, industrialised metropolis, to study under Tenzin, the son of Avatar Aang. There she joins a pro-bending sports team with the brothers Mako and Bolin and befriends the heiress Asami Sato, while a masked revolutionary named Amon leads the Equalists, a movement against benders. The 12-episode first season, created by Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko for Nickelodeon, aired in 2012.
the-legend-of-korra-book-1-air.notes: American series with no MyAnimeList or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia.

steins-gate-episode-23.summary: This entry is a reworked take on episode 23 of Steins;Gate, produced to lead into the sequel Steins;Gate 0. The series follows Rintaro Okabe, a self-proclaimed mad scientist whose small lab stumbles on a way to send messages into the past. In this version, a worn-out Okabe refuses to keep helping the time traveller Suzuha Amane with her mission, and the story branches away from the broadcast version. He drops his mad-scientist act to live as an ordinary university student, though his childhood friend Mayuri Shiina senses something still weighs on him. White Fox produced the episode, which aired in December 2015 during a rebroadcast of the series. It is meant for viewers who have seen the first 22 episodes.
steins-gate-episode-23.notes: Premise necessarily departs from the TV series' late episodes; kept vague.

kara-no-kyoukai-6-boukyaku-rokuon.summary: The sixth Garden of Sinners film is set in January 1999, during the winter break at Reien Girls' Academy, a school where strange things are happening: fairies are stealing students' memories. Azaka Kokutou, a student there and the younger sister of Mikiya, is also an apprentice mage under Touko Aozaki, who orders her to investigate. The fairies are invisible even to Azaka, so Touko sends Shiki Ryougi, whose special eyes let her see what others cannot, to help. The two do not get along, since Azaka sees Shiki as a rival for her brother's affection. Ufotable released the film in December 2008, directed by Takahiro Miura and based on Kinoko Nasu's novels.

millennium-actress.summary: As the old Ginei film studio is about to be demolished, documentary maker Genya Tachibana sets out to interview Chiyoko Fujiwara, the studio's greatest star, who walked away from acting decades earlier and has lived in seclusion ever since. Genya, a devoted fan, arrives at her mountain home with his sceptical cameraman Kyoji Ida and hands her a small box holding an old key. The key sets Chiyoko reminiscing about her life, and as she talks, her memories and the roles she played across Japan's history begin to merge, with the two visitors finding themselves inside the story. Satoshi Kon directed the Madhouse film, first shown in 2001.

eden-of-the-east-movie-i-the-king-of-ede.summary: The first of two films that continue the Eden of the East TV series picks up six months after its final episode. Akira Takizawa, the amnesiac young man who was drawn into a game played by twelve people handed billions of yen and told to save Japan, has vanished, leaving behind only his phone and a cryptic message. Saki Morimi, the university graduate who met him outside the White House, follows the trail to New York to find him, while rumours about Akira spread at home and the other players in the game make their own moves. Production I.G released the film in November 2009, written and directed by Kenji Kamiyama.

ajin-2nd-season.summary: Ajin are rare humans who cannot die: whatever kills them, they revive, and governments have captured them for brutal experiments. The second season continues the story of Kei Nagai, a high school student who discovered he was an Ajin, as he and his new ally Kou Nakano prepare to stand against Satou, a ruthless Ajin waging a campaign of terror and public killings against the government. To stop him, Kei reluctantly joins forces with former enemies: the government official Yuu Tosaki, who has studied Ajin for years, and his Ajin aide Izumi Shimomura. Polygon Pictures produced the 13 episodes in 2016 in 3D CG, adapting Gamon Sakurai's manga. It contains graphic violence and gore.

kareshi-kanojo-no-jijou.summary: Yukino Miyazawa is the model student everyone admires: top of her class, athletic, kind and graceful. In private she is intensely vain and works herself to the bone to keep up the act, because what she lives for is praise. Then, on entering high school, she is knocked from first place by Soichiro Arima, a handsome classmate who seems genuinely perfect, and she vows to beat him. When Arima discovers her true nature, the rivalry starts to turn into something else. Gainax and J.C.Staff adapted the first seven volumes of Masami Tsuda's shoujo manga into 26 episodes from 1998 to 1999, directed by Hideaki Anno.

koi-to-senkyo-to-chocolate.summary: Yuuki Oojima belongs to the Food Research Club at his school, which mostly spends its budget on snacks for its members to eat. That comfortable life is threatened when the student council election comes around and Satsuki Shinonome, a strong candidate who runs the school's finance committee, campaigns to scrap clubs that do nothing useful and redirect their funding. Its president, Yuuki's childhood friend Chisato Sumiyoshi, vows to save it, and the club goes looking for a way to fight back through the election itself. AIC Build adapted Sprite's visual novel into 12 episodes in 2012.

diamond-no-ace.summary: Eijun Sawamura is a loud, determined pitcher who loses his final middle school game on a wild pitch. Soon afterwards, a scout who saw promise in his unusual pitching style invites him to Seido High School, a baseball powerhouse in Tokyo. Encouraged by his teammates back home, he accepts, only to find himself one of many talented players competing for a spot, with the gifted catcher Kazuya Miyuki and a rival first-year pitcher, Satoru Furuya, setting the standard he has to reach. Madhouse and Production I.G adapted Yuji Terajima's manga into 75 episodes, airing from 2013 to 2015.

yuru-yuri-2.summary: The second season of YuruYuri returns to the Amusement Club, a club of four girls at Nanamori Middle School whose only real purpose is to keep its members entertained. Its members are the hyperactive Kyouko Toshinou, her level-headed friend Yui Funami, the kind Akari Akaza, whom everyone tends to forget is there, and Chinatsu Yoshikawa, who wandered in looking for the real tea ceremony club. Their days are spent killing time together, crossing paths with the student council, and enjoying trips such as a visit to a hot spring, with plenty of light romantic crushes between the girls. Doga Kobo adapted Namori's manga into 12 episodes in 2012.

rail-wars.summary: In an alternate Japan where the national railway was never privatised, Japan National Railways is still a huge government-run organisation, and Naoto Takayama, a train-loving high school student, wants to join it for a safe, stable career. During his training placement he is assigned to a railway security unit alongside the athletic and fight-ready Aoi Sakurai and other trainees with strong personalities, and the cautious Naoto, who would rather avoid risks, soon finds himself facing an extremist group that is fighting to privatise the railways. Passione adapted Takumi Toyoda's light novels into 12 episodes in 2014. It includes fan service.

love-stage.summary: Izumi Sena comes from a family of entertainers, with an actress mother, a producer father and a rock star brother, yet his only ambition is to draw manga for a living, and he spends his time immersed in a magical girl anime. His only time in the spotlight was a wedding commercial he filmed as a child, in a girl's role. A decade later the advert is remade with the original cast, reuniting him with Ryouma Ichijou, who has since become a popular actor and who has loved Izumi ever since because he thought Izumi was a girl. J.C.Staff adapted Eiki Eiki and Taishi Zaou's boys' love manga into 10 episodes in 2014. It includes sexual situations.

kiniro-mosaic.summary: Shinobu Oomiya once spent a homestay in England and grew very close to her host family's daughter, Alice Cartelet, even though neither could speak the other's language. Five years later, Shinobu, now in high school, receives a letter from Alice saying that she is coming to Japan to stay with her and attend her school. Alice arrives speaking fluent Japanese, and soon another English girl, the energetic half-Japanese Karen Kujou, joins them. The series follows the girls and their classmates through everyday school life, cultural mix-ups and Shinobu's obsession with blonde hair. Studio Gokumi adapted Yui Hara's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in 2013.

kaguya-hime-no-monogatari.summary: Deep in the countryside, an old bamboo cutter finds a tiny girl inside a glowing bamboo shoot and, believing her to be a gift from heaven, takes her home to raise with his wife. The child grows at a startling rate and spends a happy, free childhood with the village children in the hills. When the bamboo cutter also discovers gold and fine cloth in the bamboo, he becomes convinced she is destined to be a noble princess and moves the family to a grand house in the capital, where Kaguya is pressed into the life of a noble lady. Isao Takahata directed the 2013 Studio Ghibli film, based on the 10th-century tale The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter.

hyouka-motsubeki-mono-wa.summary: Houtarou Oreki, a high schooler who lives by the motto of saving energy, is enjoying another idle day at home when his sister Tomoe drags him into a lifeguard shift at a local swimming pool. There he runs into his fellow Classics Club members, and the endlessly curious Eru Chitanda soon spots a small puzzle: a white object she saw on a woman's ear earlier has disappeared. Oreki is pulled, as usual, into working out what happened. This single OVA episode, a bonus set during summer, was released alongside the Hyouka TV series in 2012 and packaged with volume three of the manga. Kyoto Animation produced it, directed by Yasuhiro Takemoto.
hyouka-motsubeki-mono-wa.notes: Plot rests on the MAL synopsis (reproduced on AniList); Wikipedia lists the OVA but does not describe it.

new-game-2.summary: A year after joining the game company Eagle Jump, Aoba Suzukaze and her coworkers in the character design team have just finished their latest game. As the next project begins, the company holds a contest to choose its character designs, and Aoba's entry wins, making her the lead character designer, with her mentor Kou Yagami now in a supporting role. The promotion brings extra work and new responsibilities, longer hours and doubts about whether she is right for the role, as the team starts work on a cute new game called Peco. Doga Kobo produced the 12 episodes of the second season in 2017, based on Shotaro Tokuno's four-panel manga.

tsubasa-chronicle.summary: In the desert kingdom of Clow, the young archaeologist Syaoran shares a close bond with his childhood friend Sakura, the kingdom's princess. When Sakura appears before him in a daze, with wings sprouting from her back, the wings dissolve into feathers holding her memories and scatter across other worlds, and she will not survive without them. Syaoran turns to Yuuko Ichihara, the Dimensional Witch, who agrees to help at a steep price, and sends him across dimensions with Sakura, the gruff ninja Kurogane, the cheerful magician Fai D. Flowright and a small creature named Mokona. Bee Train adapted CLAMP's manga into 26 episodes in 2005, and a second season followed in 2006.

naruto-movie-3-dai-koufun-mikazuki-jima-.summary: Kakashi Hatake leads Naruto Uzumaki, Sakura Haruno and Rock Lee on a mission to escort Prince Michiru, heir to the wealthy Land of the Moon, and his spoiled son Hikaru home from a long journey abroad. The task gets messy when the extravagant prince decides to buy an entire travelling circus, mainly because Hikaru wants its sabre-toothed tiger. When the convoy finally reaches the island kingdom, the ninja discover that something has gone badly wrong at home, and their escort mission becomes a fight to protect the royal family. Studio Pierrot released the third Naruto film in 2006, the last one set during the original series. It contains ninja combat violence.

shokugeki-no-souma-gou-no-sara.summary: Food Wars! follows Souma Yukihira, the son of a diner owner, through Tootsuki Culinary Academy, an elite cooking school where students settle disputes in high-stakes cooking duels. In this fifth and final season, the academy has settled down after a period of upheaval, and Souma and his friends turn their attention to the BLUE, an invitation-only international competition for young chefs hoping to make their names. Standing in their way is Asahi Saiba, leader of a group of underground 'dark chefs', who once beat Souma's father in a cooking duel. J.C.Staff produced the 13 episodes in 2020, based on the manga by Yuto Tsukuda and Shun Saeki. It includes the series' recurring food-reaction fan service.

true-tears.summary: Shinichiro Nakagami is a high school boy with a talent for drawing who is working on a picture book in his spare time. He shares his family home with Hiromi Yuasa, a childhood friend who moved in after her father died a year earlier; at school she is popular and always smiling, but at home she has grown cold and distant, and he cannot bring himself to talk to her about it. At school he also meets Noe Isurugi, an odd girl who puts a curse on him after he teases her. P.A. Works produced the 13-episode original series in 2008, directed by Junji Nishimura. It shares only its title with the earlier visual novel.
true-tears.notes: No AniList record was returned; facts checked against MAL and Wikipedia.

grisaia-no-meikyuu.summary: This hour-long TV special follows Yuuji Kazami, who has spent about a year at Mihama Academy, a school with only five students, all girls with difficult circumstances of their own. When Yuuji suddenly decides to seek a promotion at CIRS, the secret agency he works for, he goes through his file with his handler JB to decide whether he is fit for the job. Meanwhile, the girls find torn documents in his room, piece them together and start learning about the childhood that shaped him. 8bit produced the special in 2015 as part of the adaptation of Frontwing's Grisaia visual novels. It deals with child abuse, violence and sexual themes.
grisaia-no-meikyuu.notes: Premise rests on the MAL synopsis (reproduced on AniList, which also confirms the 60-minute special format); Wikipedia covers the franchise but not this special's plot.

genshiken.summary: Kanji Sasahara starts university quietly curious about anime and manga but not ready to admit it. When he wanders into the Society for the Study of Modern Visual Culture, nicknamed Genshiken, he finds a cramped clubroom full of students who spend their days arguing about anime, playing games, building models and queuing at fan conventions. Senior member Harunobu Madarame is the club's loudest voice, while easygoing Makoto Kousaka loves it all without a hint of embarrassment, to the frustration of his girlfriend Saki Kasukabe, who hangs around the club hoping to pull him back to ordinary life. Palm Studio adapted Shimoku Kio's manga into 12 episodes in 2004, a low-key comedy about otaku hobbies and campus friendship.

bleach-the-diamonddust-rebellion.summary: Squad 10 of the Gotei 13 is guarding a procession carrying the Ouin, a royal treasure, through the human world when attackers strike and take it. Captain Toshiro Hitsugaya chases the thieves alone and disappears, and Soul Society soon treats his absence as desertion and orders his capture. Ichigo Kurosaki, a teenager who works as a Soul Reaper, finds the wounded captain before he slips away again, and sets out with Rukia Kuchiki, Renji Abarai and Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto to learn what really happened, while Hitsugaya's own past turns out to be tangled up in the attack. Studio Pierrot released this second Bleach film in December 2007, an original story directed by Noriyuki Abe using Tite Kubo's characters.

aoharu-x-kikanjuu.summary: Hotaru Tachibana is a high school student with a fierce sense of justice who dresses like a boy, and most people assume she is one. When she hears that a host at a local club has taken advantage of her best friend, she storms in to confront him. The host, Masamune Matsuoka, settles things with an airsoft duel, and the fight wrecks enough of the club that Hotaru ends up owing him. To pay it off she has to join Toy Gun Gun, his survival game team, alongside its prickly third member, Tooru Yukimura, and she soon finds herself enjoying the matches more than she expected. Brain's Base adapted NAOE's manga into 12 episodes in 2015.

the-legend-of-korra-book-4-balance.summary: Balance is the closing season of The Legend of Korra, its fourth. Three years have passed since the previous book, and Avatar Korra, the young master of all four elements, has been away from Republic City, still struggling to recover in body and mind from her last fight. In her absence Kuvira, a gifted metalbender who once served Suyin Beifong, has been reuniting the fractured Earth Kingdom by military force and shows no sign of giving up power. Mako, Bolin, Asami and Tenzin's family each have to decide where they stand, while Korra searches for a way back. Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko created the series, Studio Mir animated it, and Nickelodeon released these 13 episodes online in 2014.
the-legend-of-korra-book-4-balance.notes: Kitsu entry has no MyAnimeList mapping (American series); Kitsu and Wikipedia used as sources.

dance-in-the-vampire-bund.summary: Mina Tepes, sovereign of the vampire race, goes on live Japanese television to announce that her kind is real. She has paid off a huge share of Japan's national debt, and in return she has been allowed to build the Bund, a special district off the coast of Tokyo where vampires can live openly. Mina looks like a young girl but holds enormous power, and many humans and rival vampires want her plan to fail. High school student Akira Kaburagi Regendorf, who has gaps in his memory, learns that he is bound to serve as her protector. Shaft adapted Nozomu Tamaki's manga into 12 episodes in 2010. It has bloody violence and sexualised scenes involving a childlike character.

ookami-to-koushinryou-ii-ookami-to-kohak.summary: The Wolf and the Amber Melancholy is a single Spice and Wolf OVA episode, which came out in April 2009 ahead of the second TV season. Travelling merchant Kraft Lawrence and Holo, a centuries-old wolf deity who usually takes the form of a young woman with wolf ears and a tail, share a dinner with Norah Arendt, the shepherd girl they worked with during an earlier business venture. Holo does not enjoy the evening, partly because of Norah's line of work and partly because of how friendly she is with Lawrence. Later Holo falls ill and Lawrence looks after her while she thinks back over their journey together. Brain's Base and Marvy Jack made it from Isuna Hasekura's light novels.

tsuritama.summary: Yuki Sanada panics so badly around other people that his face twists into a frightening grimace, and constantly moving house with his grandmother has never helped. Their latest stop is the island of Enoshima, where a strange transfer student named Haru announces that he is an alien, carries a water pistol that makes people do what he says, and declares that Yuki is now his friend. Haru insists that Yuki must learn to fish and drags him to Natsuki Usami, a moody local expert, while a boy from India with a pet duck watches them closely. A-1 Pictures made this original 12-episode series in 2012, directed by Kenji Nakamura.

komi-san-wa-komyushou-desu-2.summary: Shoko Komi is a striking, widely admired high school student whose severe communication disorder makes speaking to people almost impossible, so she mostly talks by writing in a notebook. Her classmate Hitohito Tadano, an ordinary boy who noticed how badly she wants to connect, became her first friend and is helping her toward her goal of making a hundred. This second season carries on through their school year, with new friendships, school events and fresh classmates for Komi to approach, while her bond with Tadano slowly starts to change. OLM produced these 12 episodes in 2022 from Tomohito Oda's manga.

natsume-yuujinchou-go.summary: Takashi Natsume is a high school boy who has always been able to see yokai, the spirits and creatures most people cannot. He lives with his kind foster family, the Fujiwaras, and spends his spare time with Nyanko-sensei, a powerful yokai disguised as a plump lucky-cat figure, returning the names his late grandmother Reiko collected in the Book of Friends. In this fifth season Natsume keeps helping the spirits who come to him, while the Matoba exorcist clan pushes harder to recruit him and its head, Seiji Matoba, pressures him into attending a meeting of exorcist families. Shuka produced the 11 episodes in 2016, adapting Yuki Midorikawa's manga. The tone stays quiet and gentle.

sekirei-pure-engagement.summary: In the city of Shinto Teito, 108 superpowered beings called Sekirei are paired with human partners known as Ashikabi and made to fight in the Sekirei Plan, a contest run by the MBI corporation and its eccentric president, Hiroto Minaka. Minato Sahashi, a gentle young man who has failed his university entrance exams twice, has become the Ashikabi of several Sekirei, including the cheerful fighter Musubi, and they all lodge at the Izumo Inn. This second season begins as the contest moves into its next stage: the city is sealed, the rules change and stronger opponents step in. Seven Arcs made the 13 episodes in 2010 from Sakurako Gokurakuin's manga. It contains frequent nudity and fan service.

ranma-nettou-hen.summary: Ranma Saotome is a teenage martial artist who, during a training trip in China with his father Genma, fell into a cursed spring at Jusenkyo. Now cold water turns him into a girl and hot water changes him back, while his father becomes a giant panda. Back in Japan, Ranma learns that Genma has promised him in marriage to one of the daughters of his old friend Soun Tendo, and the choice falls on Akane, a short-tempered martial artist who wants nothing to do with boys. Rivals, suitors and other cursed fighters soon follow Ranma around. Studio Deen's TV adaptation of Rumiko Takahashi's manga ran from 1989 to 1992 across 161 episodes, a fast slapstick comedy.
ranma-nettou-hen.notes: Kitsu slug ranma-nettou-hen maps to the combined 161-episode TV run (MAL 210): the original 18-episode series plus the 143-episode Nettou-hen continuation.

joker-game.summary: In 1937, as war approaches, the Imperial Japanese Army quietly sets up a spy training unit known as the D Agency under the soft-spoken but formidable Lieutenant Colonel Yuuki. His recruits are civilians rather than career soldiers, trained to switch identities, read people and blend in, and told to avoid killing or dying whenever they can. Lieutenant Sakuma, a rigid army officer assigned to work with them, is unsettled by their methods. From there the series follows different agents on separate missions in different countries, mostly as standalone stories with a cool, cerebral tone. Production I.G adapted Koji Yanagi's spy novels into 12 episodes in 2016.

chrno-crusade.summary: In 1920s America, demons have become a real threat, and the Order of Magdalene in New York sends out its sisters to deal with them. Sister Rosette Christopher is one of its most reckless exorcists, a teenager who wrecks almost as much as she saves, and her partner Chrono is a demon who looks like a young boy and fights at her side under a contract binding the two of them. Rosette is searching for her younger brother Joshua, who was taken years ago by a demon named Aion, someone Chrono knows from his own past. Gonzo adapted Daisuke Moriyama's manga into 24 episodes in 2003 and 2004. It includes violence and some disturbing scenes.

naruto-shippuden-movie-3-hi-no-ishi-wo-t.summary: Four ninja with rare inherited abilities, one from each of four great nations, have gone missing, and suspicion falls on the Hidden Leaf Village because the man behind the kidnappings, Hiruko, was once one of its own. Hiruko means to absorb one more bloodline ability and use the combined power to start a war, and the other nations give Lady Tsunade an ultimatum. Kakashi Hatake proposes a plan that puts his own life on the line, but Naruto Uzumaki refuses to accept it and sets out with Sakura and Sai to find another way. Studio Pierrot released this third Naruto Shippuden film in 2009, an original story directed by Masahiko Murata.

so-ra-no-wo-to.summary: Kanata Sorami joins the army of Helvetia for an unusual reason: she wants to learn to play the bugle. She is posted to the 1121st Platoon, a handful of young women stationed at an old clocktower fortress in the quiet border town of Seize, where duties often mean festivals, chores and bugle calls. Sergeant Major Rio Kazumiya becomes her music teacher, and the rest of the unit includes mechanic Noel Kannagi, hot-headed private Kureha Suminoya and their easygoing commander, Captain Filicia Heideman. Beyond the town lie the ruins of an older civilisation and an uneasy truce with a neighbouring empire. A-1 Pictures made this original 12-episode series in 2010, a gentle slice of life with a war-weary backdrop.

kono-naka-ni-hitori-imouto-ga-iru.summary: When his father dies, high school student Shogo Mikadono becomes heir to the Mikadono Group, a large business empire, on one condition: he must choose a girl he loves and be ready to marry her by graduation. After transferring to Miryuin Private Academy he meets several candidates, among them friendly class representative Konoe Suruma, standoffish Miyabi Kannagi, student council members Rinka Kunitachi and Mana Tendou, and Mei Sagara, who runs a café on campus. The catch is that a younger half-sister he has never met is one of the girls around him, and he has no way of telling which. Studio Gokumi adapted Hajime Taguchi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2012. It has fan service and incest-themed romance.

danna-ga-nani-wo-itteiru-ka-wakaranai-ke.summary: Kaoru Tsunashi is a hardworking office employee, and her husband Hajime is a cheerful otaku who stays home and talks almost entirely in internet slang, though he is more thoughtful than he first appears. This second season of short comedy episodes carries on with their everyday married life, their quirks and the eccentric friends and relatives around them, while news that Kaoru is expecting a baby pushes Hajime to try harder as a husband and a future father. Other episodes look back at how the couple met and what drew them together in the first place. Seven made the 13 short episodes in 2015, based on Cool-kyou Shinja's four-panel manga, and the tone stays light and affectionate.

omamori-himari.summary: Yuto Amakawa lost his parents young and lives an ordinary life next door to his childhood friend Rinko, with a cat allergy as his biggest problem. On his sixteenth birthday a supernatural creature called an ayakashi attacks him, and he is rescued by Himari, a sword-wielding cat spirit in the form of a young woman. She tells him that he is the heir of a long line of demon slayers, that a protective charm had kept him out of sight until now, and that she has sworn to guard him. More girls with supernatural ties soon join his household. Zexcs adapted Milan Matra's manga into 12 episodes in 2010. It has frequent fan service.

isekai-quartet.summary: A mysterious red button suddenly appears in front of the casts of four isekai series: KonoSuba, Overlord, Re:Zero and The Saga of Tanya the Evil. Someone presses it, and Kazuma and his party, Ainz Ooal Gown and his servants, Subaru with Emilia and the twin maids, and Tanya with her soldiers all land in the same unfamiliar world, where they find themselves enrolled in one school class together. From there it becomes a crossover comedy of homeroom life, school events and clashing personalities, drawn in a small chibi style and built on in-jokes from each show. Studio PuYUKAI produced the 12 short episodes in 2019, and the series later returned for more seasons.

masou-gakuen-hxh.summary: Kizuna Hida transfers to Ataraxia, an academy that trains pilots of Heart Hybrid Gear, armoured suits used to defend Earth against invaders from another world. His own aptitude is unremarkable, but his older sister has brought him there for another reason: intimate contact with Kizuna can sharply boost the power of the girls who fight in the gear. That places him in the middle of the academy's squad of female pilots, who are not all pleased with the arrangement, while attacks from the other side keep coming. Production IMS adapted Masamune Kuji's light novels into 12 episodes in 2016. It contains heavy sexual content and nudity.

dennou-coil.summary: In the near future, children grow up wearing internet-connected glasses that lay a virtual world over the real one, complete with digital pets, glitches and hidden spaces. Yuko Okonogi, known as Yasako, relocates to Daikoku City with her family, a place where the virtual layer is full of old, unstable corners. Her grandmother, Mega-baa, runs a shop selling unofficial digital tools and leads a small children's detective club called Coil, and Yasako is soon caught up in its hunts alongside the bold Fumie. Another girl also named Yuko, a sharp, secretive hacker nicknamed Isako, arrives with plans of her own. Madhouse produced the 26 episodes in 2007, an original series created and directed by Mitsuo Iso.

dragon-ball-z-movie-14-kami-to-kami.summary: Years after the last great battle of Dragon Ball Z, Goku and his friends are enjoying peaceful lives on Earth. Far away, Beerus, the God of Destruction, wakes from a very long sleep after dreaming of a being called the Super Saiyan God, and sets off with his attendant Whis to find a worthy opponent. His search leads to Earth, where Bulma's birthday party is in full swing, and to Goku, who has never heard of such a form and is eager to test himself. Toei Animation released this 2013 film, directed by Masahiro Hosoda, with creator Akira Toriyama closely involved in the story. It mixes large-scale fights with plenty of party comedy.

gintama-shirogane-no-tamashii-hen.summary: The Silver Soul Arc begins Gintama's final story. Edo, an alien-occupied version of Japan where Gintoki Sakata runs the odd-jobs Yorozuya with Shinpachi and Kagura, becomes the front line of an interplanetary war as a vast army of vengeful aliens descends on Earth. With the government in disarray, Gintoki and his allies, from the Shinsengumi to old comrades and longtime rivals, have to decide how to defend their city. As usual it swings between all-out action and comedy. Bandai Namco Pictures produced these 12 episodes in 2018, adapting Hideaki Sorachi's manga, and the arc continues in a second part.

yahari-ore-no-seishun-love-comedy-wa-mac.summary: This single OVA accompanies the second season of My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU, which follows Hachiman Hikigaya, a cynical loner who belongs to the Service Club with Yukino Yukinoshita and Yui Yuigahama. Here Iroha Isshiki, the first-year student council president who keeps pulling Hachiman into her plans, talks him into spending a weekend helping her prepare the perfect date with the popular Hayato Hayama, and the two wander around Chiba trying out spots. Their unplanned outing gives Hachiman time to think about what he wants from the people around him and from the club. Feel. produced the episode in 2016, based on Wataru Watari's light novel series.

tokyo-esp.summary: Rinka Urushiba is a high school student who works part time to support her unemployed father, and money is her biggest worry until the day she sees a penguin flying over Tokyo. Chasing it to a rooftop, she finds glowing fish drifting through the air and a classmate, Kyotaro Azuma, who can see them too. After one of the fish passes through her, Rinka wakes up able to move through solid objects, and her hair turns white whenever she uses the power. Others in the city have gained powers too, some with violent plans, so she and Kyotaro start using theirs to protect people. Xebec adapted Hajime Segawa's manga into 12 episodes in 2014.

kakumeiki-valvrave.summary: In True Era 71, humanity lives across space colonies and the world is split between two superpowers, ARUS and Dorssia, with the small nation of JIOR staying neutral. Haruto Tokishima is a 17-year-old student on a JIOR colony when a Dorssian fleet attacks, searching for the Valvraves, powerful mecha hidden beneath his school. In the chaos Haruto climbs into one of them and accepts a strange contract to pilot it, a bargain with consequences for his own body. Soon he and his classmates have to work out how to survive without anyone's protection. Sunrise made this original 12-episode first season in 2013, with character designs by Katsura Hoshino. It has war violence.

devils-line.summary: In modern Tokyo, vampires live hidden among ordinary people. They do not need blood to survive, but strong emotions can set off a craving that makes them dangerous. University student Tsukasa Taira, 22, discovers this when someone she knows turns out to be one of them, and she is rescued by Yuki Anzai, a half-vampire who works with a police unit that handles vampire crimes. Drawn to each other, the two begin a cautious romance made harder by Anzai's fear of his own urges, while violent incidents and anti-vampire groups put pressure on the city. Platinum Vision adapted Ryo Hanada's manga into 12 episodes in 2018. It has bloody violence and sexual content.

zero-kara-hajimeru-mahou-no-sho.summary: In a land where witches and humans are at war, the beastfallen, people born with the head and strength of an animal, are feared by both sides, and many earn their living hunting witches. One of them, a beastfallen mercenary who dreams of becoming human, crosses paths with Zero, a carefree witch who offers to give him a human body if he agrees to protect her. She is searching for a stolen spellbook, the Grimoire of Zero, which could cause disaster in the wrong hands, and the young sorcerer Albus soon falls in with them. White Fox adapted Kakeru Kobashiri's light novels into 12 episodes in 2017, a fantasy road story. It has some violence.

aria-the-animation.summary: On the terraformed planet Aqua, once called Mars, the city of Neo-Venezia is built as a copy of Venice, and visitors tour its canals in gondolas steered by guides called Undines. Akari Mizunashi has come from Earth, now known as Manhome, to train as an Undine at the small Aria Company, where she works under the graceful Alicia and lives with the company's president, a chubby blue-eyed cat. Each episode is a slow, warm slice of life: practice on the water, time with fellow trainees Aika and Alice, and small discoveries around the city. Hal Film Maker adapted Kozue Amano's manga into 13 episodes in 2005, the first of three Aria TV seasons.

seitokai-no-ichizon.summary: At Hekiyou Academy, the student council is picked by popularity vote, which is why it is run by four pretty girls, plus one extra seat reserved for the student with the best exam results.
