Ken Sugisaki studied hard to win that seat, with the openly stated goal of turning the council into his personal harem. Instead, his tiny, childish president Kurimu Sakurano, the sharp-witted Chizuru Akaba and the Shiina sisters, Minatsu and Mafuyu, spend their meetings shooting him down, while the group chats, bickers and debates whatever topic the president raises that day. Most of it happens in the council room, with plenty of parody. Studio Deen adapted Sekina Aoi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2009.

carnival-phantasm.summary: Carnival Phantasm gathers characters from Type-Moon's Fate/stay night, Tsukihime and related titles into a gag anthology that treats them with no reverence at all. Some sketches follow the Fate servants and masters through a wish-granting contest that keeps going off the rails, others put Shiki Tohno and the Tsukihime cast through classroom farce and romantic chaos, and side characters, mascots and wildly out-of-character versions of serious heroes turn up throughout. Most jokes assume viewers already know the original works. Lerche produced the 12 OVA episodes in 2011 to mark Type-Moon's tenth anniversary, directed by Seiji Kishi and based on Eri Takenashi's comedy manga.

youjo-senki-movie.summary: This film continues the story of the Saga of Tanya the Evil TV series. Tanya Degurechaff, a ruthless salaryman reborn as a small girl in a militaristic Empire, commands the 203rd Aerial Mage Battalion, and the war is finally turning her country's way. Recalled from the southern front, she and her unit are sent to watch the Empire's frontier with the Russy Federation, a communist state that may be about to join the fighting. On the other side is Mary Sioux, a young volunteer mage from the Allied nations who carries a personal grudge against the Empire. Studio Nut released the film in 2019, directed by Yutaka Uemura and based on Carlo Zen's light novels. It has heavy war violence.

grancrest-senki.summary: On a war-torn continent, lords bear Crests, holy symbols that give them the power to push back Chaos, a force that warps the land and summons monsters. Instead of using that power to protect people, the nobles mostly turn it on each other, split between two rival alliances. Siluca Meletes, a gifted mage who scorns the lords, meets Theo Cornaro, a wandering knight with a small Crest who wants to free his home town from a tyrant. She binds herself to him by contract as his advisor, gambling that he could become the kind of ruler the continent needs. A-1 Pictures adapted Ryo Mizuno's light novels into 24 episodes in 2018. It has war violence.

soul-eater-not.summary: Set a year before the main Soul Eater story, this spin-off takes place at the Death Weapon Meister Academy in Death City, where people who can turn into weapons pair up with the Meisters who wield them. Tsugumi Harudori discovers she can become a halberd and enrols, but in the NOT class, meant for students who mainly need to learn to control their powers rather than fight. There she makes two friends, the sheltered noble Anya Hepburn and the drowsy, kind-hearted Meme Tatane, both of whom want her as their partner, and she cannot choose between them. The tone is lighter than the original. Bones made the 12 episodes in 2014 from Atsushi Ohkubo's manga.

koyomimonogatari.summary: Koyomimonogatari is a set of twelve short, mostly standalone stories, one for each month of a school year, following Koyomi Araragi, a high school boy left with traces of vampirism, as the girls around him bring him small puzzles. A rumour about a stone shrine, a strange tree, a game of hide-and-seek and similar oddities lead to long, talky conversations with Hanekawa, Senjougahara, Kanbaru, Sengoku and others, and the episodes slot in between earlier parts of the Monogatari series. Shaft produced the 12 episodes as weekly online releases in 2016, adapting a NISIOISIN novel. They are best suited to viewers already familiar with the franchise.

colorful-movie.summary: A soul that did something terrible in its past life is told it has been given another chance. It is placed inside Makoto Kobayashi, a boy of fourteen who has just taken his own life, and given six months to work out what its earlier wrongdoing was. Living as Makoto, the soul has to deal with a family it barely knows, a school where Makoto had almost no friends, and the reasons the boy was so unhappy, with a cheerful guide named Purapura checking in now and then. Sunrise and Ascension produced this 2010 film, directed by Keiichi Hara from Eto Mori's novel. It deals with suicide, family conflict and teenage sexuality.

shingeki-no-bahamut-virgin-soul.summary: A decade after humans, gods and demons united against the dragon Bahamut, the human kingdom of Anatae is thriving under King Charioce XVII, who has seized the gods' power and lets demons in the capital be kept as slaves. Nina Drango, a cheerful country girl, arrives in the capital to earn a living with a secret of her own: when her heart races, she turns into a huge red dragon. Her life there becomes tangled with Charioce, with the Rag Demon who leads the demons' resistance, and with Kaisar Lidfard, a knight torn between his ideals and his duty. MAPPA produced the 24 episodes in 2017 as a sequel to Genesis. It has war violence and depictions of slavery.

adventure-time-1.summary: Finn is a human boy who lives for adventure, and Jake, his closest friend and adopted brother, is a dog with magical powers that let him stretch and change his shape and size. Together they roam the Land of Ooo, a bright, strange world built on the ruins of an older one, fighting monsters, rescuing princesses from the bumbling Ice King and helping Princess Bubblegum of the Candy Kingdom. Along the way they meet odd friends such as Lumpy Space Princess, Marceline the Vampire Queen and their living game console, BMO. This first season of Pendleton Ward's American animated series aired on Cartoon Network from April to September 2010, with 26 short, mostly standalone episodes full of surreal comedy.
adventure-time-1.notes: Kitsu entry has no MyAnimeList mapping (American series); Kitsu and Wikipedia used as sources.

pupa.summary: Brother and sister Utsutsu and Yume Hasegawa grew up depending only on each other after an abusive childhood. When red butterflies begin appearing around the city, Yume is infected by a mysterious virus called Pupa and turns into a monstrous creature with a craving for human flesh. Utsutsu has been affected too, but in his case it lets him regenerate from any wound, so he resolves to let his sister feed on his own body to keep her from hunting other people, while a shadowy organisation watches them both. Studio Deen adapted Sayaka Mogi's manga into 12 very short episodes in 2014. It contains graphic gore, cannibalism and themes of child abuse.

flip-flappers.summary: Cocona is a quiet middle school girl who lives with her grandmother and has no idea what she wants to do with her life. Then she meets Papika, a reckless, energetic stranger who pulls her into Pure Illusion, a shifting, dreamlike dimension, to search for mysterious crystal fragments on behalf of an organisation called Flip Flap. Each trip drops them into a different world, where the two transform into costumed heroines, and a rival team of girls working for another group is chasing the same fragments. Studio 3Hz made this original 13-episode series in 2016, directed by Kiyotaka Oshiyama, with a visual style that changes from one world to the next.

kuusen-madoushi-kouhosei-no-kyoukan.summary: Long after giant magical insects drove humanity off the ground, people live in floating cities defended by academies of sky wizards. Kanata Age was once a celebrated swordsman, but a past incident has left him scorned as a traitor. He is offered a way back by coaching Team E601, three struggling students: the determined Misora Whitale, the timid Lecty Eisenach and the sleepy Rico Flamel. Their results are poor and his reputation only adds to the hostility around them, but he starts training them to fly and fight as a unit. Diomedéa adapted the light novel series into 12 episodes in 2015, a school action show with regular fan service.

yu-gi-oh.summary: Yugi Mutou is a small, shy high school student who loves games, and his most precious possession is the Millennium Puzzle, an old Egyptian relic that came from his grandfather's game shop. When he finally completes it, a second, far bolder personality awakens inside him. Whenever someone threatens Yugi or his friends Jonouchi, Honda and Anzu, this other self takes over and challenges the wrongdoer to a Shadow Game with dangerous stakes for the loser. Unlike later adaptations, this first series covers many kinds of games, not just the trading card game. Toei Animation produced the 27 episodes in 1998, adapting the early chapters of Kazuki Takahashi's manga. Its punishments lean towards mild horror.

mobile-suit-gundam-iron-blooded-orphans.summary: Some three hundred years after a devastating war between Earth and its space colonies, Earth is divided among four economic blocs and policed by the military organisation Gjallarhorn, while Mars remains poor and dependent. Kudelia Aina Bernstein, a well-born girl campaigning for Martian independence, hires the security company CGS to escort her to Earth. The job falls to its Third Group, child soldiers led by the sharp Orga Itsuka and including Mikazuki Augus, a quiet pilot who ends up fighting in an old Gundam called Barbatos. When Gjallarhorn attacks, the boys have to fend for themselves. Sunrise produced these 25 episodes in 2015 and 2016, directed by Tatsuyuki Nagai. It has heavy war violence.

eleven-eyes.summary: Kakeru Satsuki lost his sister years ago and grew up in an orphanage alongside his close friend Yuka Minase. One day the sky suddenly turns blood red, everyone else vanishes and monsters appear, until the world snaps back to normal. This Red Night keeps returning, and Kakeru and Yuka are drawn into it again and again along with other students who have unusual powers, including their senior Misuzu Kusakabe, a sword-wielding girl. They learn that a girl sealed inside a crystal lies at the centre of it all, and that they will have to fight to survive. Doga Kobo adapted Lass's visual novel into 12 episodes in 2009. It has violence, gore and fan service.

hitsugi-no-chaika-avenging-battle.summary: This is the second season of Chaika: The Coffin Princess. Toru Acura, a former saboteur struggling to find a purpose in peacetime, and his adoptive sister Akari travel with Chaika Trabant, a silver-haired girl who carries a large magic rifle in a coffin, gathering the scattered remains of her father, the late Emperor Arthur Gaz. Fredrica, a shape-shifting dragoon, rides along. Other girls calling themselves Chaika and the Gillette Corps, a unit sent to stop her, are on the same trail, and old secrets from the end of the war start to surface. Bones made these 10 episodes in 2014, based on Ichiro Sakaki's light novels. It has fantasy violence.

gj-bu.summary: Kyoya Shinomiya, nicknamed Kyoro, is the only boy in the GJ Club, a small school club with no clear purpose beyond spending time in its room. The other members are its tiny, temperamental president Mao Amatsuka, who bites him when she is upset; her calm, motherly younger sister Megumi, who keeps everyone supplied with tea and snacks; the quiet chess genius Shion Sumeragi; and Kirara Bernstein, a cat-like girl who loves meat. Episodes are built from short sketches about small everyday moments in the clubroom, with gentle comedy and a little romance. Doga Kobo adapted Shin Araki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2013.

casshern-sins.summary: In a ruined future, humanity is almost gone and the robots left behind are slowly rusting away from a blight called the Ruin, which began when a being named Luna was killed. Rumour says that eating Casshern, the robot held responsible, will grant immortality, so many come after him. Casshern himself remembers nothing of his past, and he wanders the wasteland trying to learn who he is and what he did, cutting down those who attack him while meeting robots who face their own end in very different ways. Madhouse produced the 24 episodes in 2008 and 2009, a reimagining of Tatsunoko's Casshan directed by Shigeyasu Yamauchi. It has violence and a bleak, melancholy tone.

umineko-no-naku-koro-ni.summary: In October 1986 the wealthy Ushiromiya family gathers for its yearly meeting on Rokkenjima, a private island they own. Kinzo, the ailing head of the family, cares little about who inherits his fortune and is instead obsessed with Beatrice, the Golden Witch said to haunt the island, while his children argue over money and a legend about hidden gold. Battler Ushiromiya, an irreverent grandson attending for the first time in years, flatly refuses to believe in witches. When a typhoon cuts the island off and people start dying in ways that seem impossible, he insists there must be a human culprit. Studio Deen adapted Ryukishi07's visual novels into 26 episodes in 2009. It contains graphic gore and violence.

last-exile.summary: On the world of Prester, people travel by air, and the skies are controlled by the Guild, a mysterious organisation that supplies the engines and referees the long-running war between Anatoray and Disith. Claus Valca and his navigator Lavie Head are teenage couriers who fly a small two-seat vanship and dream of crossing the Grand Stream, the violent air current that defeated their fathers. Taking on a risky delivery, they must carry a young girl, Alvis Hamilton, to the Silvana, a battleship commanded by the cold, mysterious Alex Row, and the job pulls them into the war itself. Gonzo produced this original 26-episode series in 2003, directed by Koichi Chigira. It has war violence.

ushio-to-tora-tv.summary: Ushio Aotsuki, a stubborn middle schooler, lives at a temple run by his father and dismisses all talk of monsters. While cleaning the basement he finds a huge, fearsome yokai pinned to the wall by an ancient weapon called the Beast Spear, where it has been trapped for five hundred years. Ushio refuses to free it, until other yokai begin flocking to town and he needs its strength. He pulls the spear out and the creature, which he names Tora, becomes his unwilling companion, threatening to eat him while the two fight off monsters together. MAPPA and Studio VOLN produced these 26 episodes in 2015, the first part of an adaptation of Kazuhiro Fujita's manga. It has monster violence.

tensei-shitara-slime-datta-ken-ova.summary: These five OVA episodes are light side stories about Rimuru Tempest, a man reborn in another world as a slime who now leads a nation of monsters. In the first, Rimuru decides Tempest needs more fun and holds a sumo tournament that everyone from Benimaru to Shuna and Shion enters with gusto. In the second, he sets out to make a cushion shaped like his own slime body, and his hunt for the right material turns into an outing that Milim crashes. The last three follow Rimuru as a teacher in Ingrassia during his class's outdoor training event. 8bit produced them in 2019 and 2020, bundled with volumes 12 to 16 of the manga.

persona-5-the-animation.summary: Ren Amamiya is sent to Tokyo on probation after a false assault charge, and lives under the care of Sojiro Sakura, a family friend who runs a small café. At his new school, Shujin Academy, rumours about his record follow him, until an app appears on his phone that takes him into the Metaverse, a world shaped by the distorted desires of corrupt adults. There he awakens a Persona, a power drawn from his own rebellious spirit, and together with other misfits from school he starts the Phantom Thieves, who force wrongdoers to confess by stealing their hearts. CloverWorks adapted Atlus's game into 26 episodes in 2018. It deals with abuse and violence.

baki-ona.summary: Baki Hanma is a high school student who has already beaten the best fighters in Tokyo's secret underground arena, though his real goal is to surpass his father, Yujiro, the strongest man alive. Then five of the world's most dangerous death row inmates break out of prisons in different countries on the same day and head to Tokyo, each one looking for someone strong enough to beat them. Baki and the arena's other champions become targets, and brutal street fights break out across the city. TMS Entertainment produced these 26 episodes in 2018, streamed on Netflix outside Japan, adapting the death row convicts arc of Keisuke Itagaki's manga. It contains extreme and graphic violence.

bokurano.summary: Fifteen children on a seaside summer camp explore a seaside cave and find a strange man there who goes by the name Kokopelli. He invites them to play a game in which they will take turns piloting a giant robot to protect Earth from invading enemies, and thinking it is a computer game, most of them sign up. That night a towering black robot appears off the coast and the children are pulled inside its cockpit for its first fight. They soon realise the battles are real and that the contract's rules are far crueller than they were told. Gonzo adapted Mohiro Kitoh's manga into 24 episodes in 2007. It deals with death, grief and bleak themes.

big-order-tv.summary: Ten years ago a being called Daisy appeared to a young boy, Eiji Hoshimiya, and granted him one wish. Whatever he asked for coincided with the Great Destruction, a disaster that wrecked the world and killed huge numbers of people, and Eiji has never been sure what he wished for. Now in high school, he cares mostly about his sick younger sister, but he is one of many Orders, people who received a wish-born power, and others want revenge on him. When assassins come for him, Eiji learns that his own ability lets him control anything within a certain space. Asread adapted Sakae Esuno's manga into 10 episodes in 2016. It contains violence and sexual content.

gintama-benizakura-arc-a-new-retelling.summary: In an Edo taken over by aliens, the samurai Gintoki Sakata runs the odd-jobs Yorozuya with Shinpachi and Kagura. When rebel leader Katsura, an old comrade of Gintoki's, goes missing after an attack by a mysterious swordsman, Shinpachi and Kagura start looking for him. Meanwhile Gintoki is hired by the blacksmith siblings Tetsuya and Tetsuko to recover Benizakura, a sinister stolen sword, and the two jobs lead back to Takasugi, Gintoki's former ally and now a dangerous extremist. Sunrise released this 2010 film, directed by Shinji Takamatsu, as a newly animated retelling of the Benizakura arc from Hideaki Sorachi's manga and the TV series. It mixes comedy with sword fights.

promare.summary: Thirty years ago, people began spontaneously bursting into flame across the world, and the mutants who can control fire, called the Burnish, were blamed for a disaster that burned half the planet. In the city of Promepolis, Galo Thymos is a loud, idealistic new member of Burning Rescue, a firefighting squad that uses mecha and gadgets to put out Burnish fires. His hero is Kray Foresight, the governor who saved his life as a child. When Burning Rescue clashes with Mad Burnish, a militant group led by Lio Fotia, Galo begins to learn more than he expected about the Burnish. Trigger released this original 2019 film, with Hiroyuki Imaishi directing from a script by Kazuki Nakashima.

date-a-live-III.summary: Shido Itsuka is a high school student with a strange ability: he can seal the destructive power of Spirits, girls from another world whose appearances cause disasters called spacequakes, by winning their affection and kissing them. Backed by the secret organisation Ratatoskr, led by his younger sister Kotori, he has already brought several Spirits into a peaceful life. This third season brings new Spirits and harder trials for Shido, while bigger questions begin to emerge about where the Spirits come from in the first place. J.C.Staff produced the 12 episodes in 2019, adapting Koushi Tachibana's light novels. It has fan service and action violence.

fate-stay-night-movie-heaven-s-feel-3.summary: Spring Song is the last of three films adapting the Heaven's Feel route of Type-Moon's visual novel Fate/stay night. In Fuyuki City, the Fifth Holy Grail War, a secret battle between mages and their summoned Servants, has been warped by a shadow that consumes people, and Shirou Emiya has chosen to protect Sakura Matou, the quiet girl who has long been part of his life. With the war in chaos and old alliances shifting, Shirou, Rin Tohsaka and Illyasviel von Einzbern are forced into a final confrontation. Ufotable released the film in 2020, directed by Tomonori Sudo. It contains graphic violence, body horror and themes of sexual abuse.

little-busters-refrain.summary: Refrain is the second season of Little Busters!, which follows Riki Naoe and his childhood friends, led by the fearless Kyousuke Natsume and including Kyousuke's shy sister Rin, as they form a baseball team and help new members with their personal troubles. After the team's first game, life seems to carry on in its usual cheerful way, with Riki still supporting each of his friends. But odd occurrences begin piling up, and Riki and Rin start to suspect that their everyday world hides a secret. J.C.Staff produced these 13 episodes in 2013, adapting Key's visual novel, and the tone shifts from comedy towards drama. It touches on grief and trauma.

karneval-tv.summary: Nai is a gentle boy searching for Karoku, the person who looked after him, with only a bracelet as a clue. He falls into the clutches of a woman who turns out to be a varuga, a monster that preys on humans, but escapes with the help of Gareki, a sharp-tongued young thief robbing her house. The two are soon picked up by Circus, a government defence agency that hunts varuga and investigates the mysterious organisation Kafka. Hoping it will lead him to Karoku, Nai stays with Circus, and Gareki reluctantly goes along. Manglobe adapted Touya Mikanagi's manga into 13 episodes in 2013. It has some violence and monster horror.

mnemosyne-mnemosyne-no-musume-tachi.summary: Rin Asougi runs a small detective agency in Shinjuku with her assistant Mimi, and she cannot die: however she is killed, she always comes back. The six episodes jump forward through time, from 1990 to 2025, following Rin's cases as she crosses paths with people drawn into the secret of a giant tree called Yggdrasil and the immortal women connected to it, while dangerous men hunt them. Her first case, finding a lost cat, brings her to Koki Maeno, a man whose memories do not add up. Xebec produced this original series in 2008 as six feature-length episodes. It contains extreme graphic violence, torture and explicit sexual content, and is meant for adults.

papa-no-iukoto-wo-kikinasai.summary: Yuta Segawa has just started university when his older sister Yuri, who brought him up once they were orphaned, asks him to babysit her young daughter Hina and her two stepdaughters, Sora and Miu, during a trip abroad with her husband. Then the couple's plane goes missing. To keep the girls from being split up among relatives, Yuta takes all three into his cramped one-room apartment and tries to balance his studies with raising a teenager, a schoolgirl and a toddler. His university friends and odd club members pitch in when they can. Feel. adapted Tomohiro Matsu's light novels into 12 episodes in 2012, a family comedy with occasional heavier moments and some fan service.

the-idolm-ster.summary: 765 Production is a small, struggling talent agency in Tokyo with thirteen idols on its books and little money or fame. A rookie producer joins to manage them, and the series follows his efforts to get the girls noticed, from cheerful Haruka Amami and the quiet singer Chihaya Kisaragi to the experienced Iori, Ritsuko, Yukiho and the rest. Early episodes focus on small jobs, TV spots and live shows, and as their careers grow the group has to deal with busy schedules, rival agency 961 Production and keeping their bonds strong. A-1 Pictures adapted Bandai Namco's idol-raising game into 25 episodes in 2011, directed by Atsushi Nishigori.

devil-survivor-2-the-animation.summary: A website called Nicaea, which shows its users how people close to them will die, has become a craze. Then, during an earthquake, Hibiki Kuze and his friend Daichi Shijima escape a deadly subway crash by making contracts with demons, just as Japan comes under attack from the Septentriones, monstrous invaders who strike day after day with a seven-day deadline. Hibiki, Daichi and their classmate Io Nitta are recruited by JP's, a secret government agency headed by the cold, ambitious Yamato Hotsuin, and join other demon summoners trying to hold back the attacks. Bridge adapted Atlus's game into 13 episodes in 2013, directed by Seiji Kishi. It has violence and many character deaths.

to-love-ru-darkness-2nd.summary: This is the second season of To Love Ru Darkness. High school student Rito Yuuki lives with Lala, an alien princess who wants to marry him, and her sisters, including Momo, who is quietly scheming to make Rito the centre of a harem so every girl who likes him can be with him. Rito himself still cannot work up the nerve to confess to his crush, Haruna. Meanwhile the alien assassin Golden Darkness, called Yami, is dealing with Mea, a girl with similar powers, and the shadowy Nemesis, who wants to pull Yami back into her old life. Xebec produced the 12 TV episodes in 2015, from Saki Hasemi and Kentaro Yabuki's manga. It contains heavy sexual content and nudity.

kujira-no-kora-wa-sajou-ni-utau.summary: On a world buried under a vast ocean of sand, a giant drifting island called the Mud Whale carries a small community. Most of its people are Marked, born with the power to move objects with their minds but destined to die young, while the few Unmarked without powers lead the island. Fourteen-year-old Chakuro is the island's archivist, recording everyday life. When the Mud Whale passes another island, he joins the expedition and finds a girl, Lykos, who comes from somewhere beyond their world and seems to feel no emotions. Her arrival changes the islanders' lives. J.C.Staff adapted Abi Umeda's manga into 12 episodes in 2017. It has violence and some disturbing scenes.

bleach-sennen-kessen-hen.summary: Thousand-Year Blood War is the final arc of Bleach, returning a decade after the original TV series ended. Ichigo Kurosaki, a teenager who works as a substitute Soul Reaper, is still protecting Karakura Town from Hollows with his friends Orihime, Chad and Uryu when Hollows start vanishing and residents of Soul Society begin dying in mysterious ways. Behind it is the Wandenreich, an army of Quincy, the ancient enemies of the Soul Reapers, led by Yhwach, who declares war on Soul Society. Studio Pierrot produced this first part of 13 episodes in 2022, adapting the last arc of Tite Kubo's manga, and the arc continues in later parts. It contains graphic violence.

karakai-jouzu-no-takagi-san-2.summary: Middle schooler Nishikata sits next to Takagi, a classmate who teases him constantly and always seems to know exactly what he is thinking. He has sworn to get back at her one day by making her blush, and in this second season he keeps trying, with contests, pranks, tests of courage and elaborate schemes that nearly always backfire. Meanwhile the time they spend together, at school, on the way home and around their small town, keeps quietly adding up, and their classmates have started to notice. Shin-Ei Animation produced these 12 episodes in 2019, adapting Soichiro Yamamoto's manga. The tone is gentle romantic comedy built from small everyday moments.

glasslip.summary: Toko Fukami is the daughter of a glassmaking family in Fukui and hopes to become a glass artist herself. She spends her summers with a close group of friends at the café Kazemichi, and sometimes catches odd glimpses of what look like scenes from the future. In her last summer of high school a transfer student, Kakeru Okikura, joins the group, saying that he hears voices from the future and that they led him to her. His arrival stirs up the friendships and unspoken crushes within the group of six. P.A. Works produced this original 13-episode series in 2014, directed by Junji Nishimura, a quiet drama about friendship and first love.

rewrite.summary: Kotaro Tennouji is a high school student in Kazamatsuri, a city full of greenery, with a hidden power to alter his own body so he becomes stronger or faster. Fascinated by the supernatural, he decides to revive the school's Occult Research Club, led by Akane Senri, a girl rumoured to be a witch. He recruits his eccentric childhood friend Kotori Kanbe, the clumsy transfer student Chihaya Ohtori, the strict class representative Lucia Konohana and the quiet Shizuru Nakatsu, and their investigations into strange happenings begin to point to secrets each of them is keeping. 8bit adapted Key's visual novel into 13 episodes in 2016, the first of two seasons. It has some violence.

princess-tutu.summary: In a fairy-tale town where cats and other animals talk and go about their lives, a little duck is turned into a girl named Ahiru by a mysterious storyteller called Drosselmeyer. Ahiru is a clumsy student at the town's ballet academy, and she adores Mytho, a gentle prince who seems to feel nothing because his heart was shattered long ago to seal away an evil Raven. With a magic pendant she can become Princess Tutu, a graceful dancer able to return the fragments of his heart, but Mytho's protective friend Fakir and the elegant Rue have their own ideas about him. Hal Film Maker made this original 38-episode series in 2002 and 2003, directed by Junichi Sato.

yuragi-sou-no-yuuna-san.summary: Kogarashi Fuyuzora is a penniless high school student with strong spiritual powers who needs somewhere cheap to live. He finds Yuragi-sou, a former hot spring inn turned boarding house with incredibly low rent, supposedly because a ghost scares off every tenant. The ghost turns out to be Yuuna, a cheerful girl who cannot remember anything of her life except her name, and the other residents, from a ninja to a demon-slaying shrine maiden, have unusual abilities of their own. Kogarashi decides to help Yuuna find a way to pass on peacefully. Xebec adapted Tadahiro Miura's manga into 12 episodes in 2018. It contains heavy fan service and nudity.

shingeki-no-kyojin-the-final-season-part.summary: Final Chapters Part 1 is the first of two special episodes that conclude Attack on Titan, aired as a television special in March 2023. It picks up immediately after the previous part of The Final Season, with Eren Yeager's actions threatening everyone outside the island of Paradis. His childhood friends Mikasa and Armin, the remaining Survey Corps soldiers and a group of their former enemies from Marley set aside their differences and set out to stop him before it is too late, while Eren himself wrestles with the path he has chosen. MAPPA produced it, directed by Yuichiro Hayashi, from Hajime Isayama's manga. It contains graphic violence and mass death.

beastars-2nd-season.summary: In a world of anthropomorphic animals, Cherryton Academy brings carnivores and herbivores together, but the killing of an alpaca student on campus has left the school tense and distrustful. Legoshi, a tall, introverted grey wolf in the drama club, is determined to find the culprit himself and starts investigating, while trying to understand his feelings for Haru, a small white rabbit. Old tensions between predators and prey keep surfacing, and new characters bring their own secrets. Orange produced these 12 episodes in 2021 in 3D CG, continuing its adaptation of Paru Itagaki's manga, and Netflix distributed it outside Japan. It contains violence and sexual themes.

nande-koko-ni-sensei-ga.summary: Ichiro Sato is an ordinary second-year high school student, and Kana Kojima is his Japanese teacher, a woman so strict that even the school's delinquents call her a demon. Then a chance collision in an unlikely place leaves them in an awkward, compromising position, and similar embarrassing accidents keep happening wherever they go, from a bus to a hot spring. Away from the classroom, Kojima turns out to be far more flustered and lonely than her reputation suggests, and the two grow closer with each encounter. Tear Studio adapted Soborou's manga into 12 short episodes in 2019. It is an ecchi comedy with constant sexual content and nudity.

boku-no-kanojo-ga-majimesugiru-sho-bitch.summary: Haruka Shinozaki has had a crush on his class representative, Akiho Kosaka, since his first year of high school, and when he finally confesses, she says yes. Akiho is beautiful, athletic and a model student, but she has no dating experience at all, and she approaches romance as seriously as her studies, researching ways to please her boyfriend with a dedication that leaves Haruka mortified. While he tries to slow her down, other girls around them complicate things further. Diomedéa and Studio Blanc adapted Namiru Matsumoto's web manga into 10 episodes in 2017. It is a romantic comedy built around frequent sexual content.

horizon-in-the-middle-of-nowhere.summary: In the far future, humanity has returned to an Earth where only a version of Japan is habitable, and the world's nations live in pocket dimensions while re-enacting human history step by step according to a holy text, the Testament. By Testament Era 1648, the displaced Japanese live aboard Musashi, a huge flying city-ship. When the history books stop describing anything beyond that year, the nations prepare for the end of the world. Toori Aoi, student council president of Musashi Ariadust Academy, sees the crisis as a chance and leads his classmates into it, hoping to change their people's fate. Sunrise adapted Minoru Kawakami's light novels into 13 episodes in 2011. It has fan service.

ladies-versus-butlers.summary: Akiharu Hino lost his parents as a child and, not wanting to be a burden on the uncle who took him in, enrols in the servant training course at Hakureiryou Academy, a boarding school where most of the students are young ladies. His tough, delinquent-like face frightens many of the girls, and he soon catches the attention of Selnia Iori Flameheart, a haughty student from the ladies' side. Also at the academy is Tomomi Saikyo, a girl he knew as a child. Xebec adapted Tsukasa Kouzuki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2010, a school comedy about the clash between the two courses. It contains heavy fan service and nudity.

gugure-kokkuri-san.summary: Kohina Ichimatsu is a young girl who lives alone, insists she is a doll and eats nothing but cup noodles. When she tries a kokkuri-san ritual, she summons a fox spirit who is supposed to answer questions but has become useless now that nobody believes in him. Alarmed by how she lives, Kokkuri decides to stay and look after her, cooking, cleaning and nagging her to eat properly. Before long a dog spirit infatuated with Kohina and a lazy tanuki spirit move in too, and the household turns into a chaotic, oddly sweet family. TMS Entertainment adapted Midori Endo's manga into 12 episodes in 2014, a deadpan comedy with occasional heartfelt moments.

strike-witches.summary: In an alternate 1944, Earth is under attack by the Neuroi, mysterious invaders that have overrun much of Europe. Humanity's best defence is young women called Witches, who fly into battle using Striker Units, mechanical leg-mounted engines that amplify their magic. Yoshika Miyafuji is a girl from Fuso, a country modelled on Japan, with strong healing magic and no wish to fight, but she sets out to learn what happened to her father and ends up joining the 501st Joint Fighter Wing, the Strike Witches. Gonzo produced these 12 episodes in 2008, based on Humikane Shimada's concept. It has aerial action and constant fan service.

nourin.summary: Kosaku Hata is a student at a rural agricultural high school and a devoted fan of the idol Yuka Kusakabe. When she suddenly retires, he is crushed, until a new girl transfers into his class under the name Ringo Kinoshita and turns out to be Yuka herself. Kosaku sets out to win her over while learning farming, to the frustration of his childhood friend Minori, who has feelings for him, and his friends at the school. Silver Link adapted Shirow Shiratori's light novels into 12 episodes in 2014, a fast parody-filled comedy that also teaches a surprising amount about agriculture. It contains crude sexual humour and fan service.

black-rock-shooter-ova.summary: On her first day of middle school, outgoing Mato Kuroi befriends the reserved Yomi Takanashi and gives her a blue star phone charm that matches her own. A year later they end up in different classes, Mato makes new friends through the basketball club and the two start drifting apart, until Yomi disappears. Meanwhile, in a stark otherworld, a silent black-clad gunslinger called Black Rock Shooter fights a figure called Dead Master, and the two stories mirror each other. Ordet produced this single 50-minute OVA in 2010, directed by Shinobu Yoshioka, based on huke's illustration and the song by ryo of supercell. It has stylised violence.

bleach-fade-to-black-kimi-no-na-wo-yobu.summary: While Rukia Kuchiki is in Soul Society, a mysterious pair attacks her and wipes her memory. Back in Karakura Town, Ichigo Kurosaki, the teenager who became a Soul Reaper because of her, suddenly cannot remember her either, until his modified soul Kon jogs his memory. With Kisuke Urahara's help, Ichigo crosses into Soul Society, only to find that the Soul Reapers he once fought beside no longer remember him at all and treat him as an intruder. He and Kon have to find Rukia and the people responsible before things get worse. Studio Pierrot released this third Bleach film in December 2008, an original story directed by Noriyuki Abe using Tite Kubo's characters.

ef-a-tale-of-melodies.summary: A Tale of Melodies is the second season of ef, set in the same town of Otowa as the first and following two couples linked to its earlier story. Years in the past, top student Yu Himura meets Yuko Amamiya, a girl who apparently remembers him from a childhood he would rather forget. In the present, Shuichi Kuze, a violinist who keeps everyone at arm's length, is pursued by the bright, persistent Mizuki Hayama after she hears him play, though he hides a serious reason for his distance. Shaft adapted minori's visual novel into 12 episodes in 2008, directed by Shin Oonuma, with a strongly stylised look. It deals with serious illness and painful pasts.

berserk-ougon-jidaihen-iii-kourin.summary: The Advent is the third and final film in The Golden Age Arc trilogy. A year has passed since the mercenary Guts walked away from the Band of the Hawk to find his own path, and the band, once heroes of the kingdom of Midland, is now being hunted. Their leader Griffith has been imprisoned, and Casca, who now commands what remains of the band, is planning a rescue. When Guts hears what has happened, he rides back to rejoin his old comrades. Studio 4°C released the film in 2013, adapting Kentaro Miura's manga. It contains extreme graphic violence, torture and sexual violence, and is meant for adult viewers.

voices-of-a-distant-star.summary: In 2046, middle schoolers Mikako Nagamine and Noboru Terao are close friends with unspoken feelings for each other when Mikako is chosen to join a United Nations space fleet sent out after the Tarsians, an alien race first encountered on Mars. As her ship travels deeper into space, the two keep in touch through text messages on their mobile phones, but every message takes longer to arrive, stretching from days to months and then years while Noboru grows up on Earth. Makoto Shinkai directed this short OVA, released in 2002, and it is quiet and melancholic, focused on distance, time and longing rather than on the battles in space.

princess-principal.summary: In an alternate 19th-century London, the discovery of a substance called Cavorite has transformed military technology, and Albion has been divided in two, with a great wall running through the city between the Kingdom and the Commonwealth. The two sides now fight a quiet war of espionage. Five students at Queen's Mayfair, an exclusive school, secretly work as spies for the Commonwealth, among them the cool, inventive liar Ange, the experienced driver Dorothy, the voice-mimicking Beatrice and Chise, a skilled samurai. Episodes jump around in time as the team takes on infiltration jobs. Actas and Studio 3Hz made this original 12-episode series in 2017. It has violence.

asobi-ni-iku-yo.summary: Kio Kakazu is an easygoing high school student in Okinawa whose life changes when a girl with cat ears and a tail, Eris, turns up at a family memorial gathering. She is an alien from the planet Catia, sent to make contact with Earth and study its people, and she cheerfully moves into Kio's house. Her arrival draws in secret agencies, rival factions and other aliens, including agents connected to Kio's own childhood friend Manami Kinjo, and Kio finds himself trying to keep Eris safe while making sure first contact goes well. AIC Plus+ adapted Okina Kamino's light novels into 12 episodes in 2010, a science fiction romantic comedy. It contains heavy fan service and nudity.

mirai-nikki-pilot.summary: This very short OVA is an early animated take on Sakae Esuno's Future Diary manga, made before the TV series. Yukiteru Amano is a lonely middle school student who records everything around him in a diary on his phone, and confides in an imaginary friend, Deus Ex Machina, whom he pictures as the lord of time and space. Deus turns out to be real, and he changes Yukiteru's diary so that its entries describe the near future, pulling him into a deadly game against other diary holders in which the winner will succeed Deus as god. Asread produced the roughly nine-minute episode in 2010, bundled with a limited edition of the manga's eleventh volume. It contains violence.
mirai-nikki-pilot.notes: No Wikipedia page covers this 2010 OVA; MyAnimeList and Anime News Network used. ANN gives only the series premise, so how much of the story this short covers is not confirmed.

digimon-adventure-02.summary: Some years after the first Digimon Adventure, the original DigiDestined have moved on to middle school when trouble returns to the Digital World in the form of the Digimon Emperor, a boy who enslaves Digimon with dark rings and stops them from digivolving. Takeru and Hikari from the first group team up with three younger children who receive new Digivices: hot-headed Daisuke Motomiya, energetic computer fan Miyako Inoue and the serious, polite Iori Hida. With their partner Digimon and the help of special Digi-Eggs, they cross into the Digital World through computers to fight back. Toei Animation produced the 50 episodes in 2000 and 2001 as the sequel to Digimon Adventure.

final-fantasy-vii-advent-children.summary: Two years on from the events of the game Final Fantasy VII, survivors of the ruined city of Midgar have built a new town called Edge, but a mysterious illness called Geostigma is spreading, especially among children. Cloud Strife, the former mercenary who helped save the planet, now runs a courier service with his childhood friend Tifa Lockhart, and the two look after the orphan Denzel and Barret's adopted daughter Marlene. When three silver-haired men led by Kadaj start abducting sick children for reasons of their own, Cloud is pushed to act. Square Enix released this fully computer-animated film in 2005, directed by Tetsuya Nomura. It has stylised action violence.

isekai-shokudou.summary: Western Restaurant Nekoya is an ordinary diner in a Tokyo shopping street, serving Western-style dishes adapted for Japanese tastes. It is closed on Saturdays, or so its regular customers believe: once a week a door to the restaurant appears in a fantasy world, and elves, dragons, lizardmen, knights and adventurers come in to eat. The quiet owner and chef, known only as Master, cooks for all of them without fuss, whoever they are and wherever they come from. Each episode focuses on a few guests and the dishes they love, from beef stew to fried shrimp. Silver Link adapted Junpei Inuzuka's light novels into 12 episodes in 2017, a relaxed, food-centred fantasy.

fullmetal-alchemist-the-sacred-star-of-m.summary: Edward and Alphonse Elric, brothers searching for a way to restore their bodies after a disastrous alchemy experiment, chase an escaped prisoner with unusual alchemical powers to Table City, near the border with the country of Creta. There they meet the Milos, a people living in a deep valley under foreign rule and preparing to take back their homeland. A young Milos alchemist, Julia Crichton, draws the brothers into the struggle, and talk of a Philosopher's Stone soon surfaces. Bones released this original film in 2011, directed by Kazuya Murata and set during the timeline of Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, based on Hiromu Arakawa's manga. It has violence.

minami-ke.summary: The three Minami sisters live together with no parents around. Haruka, the eldest and a high school student, runs the household with calm efficiency; Kana, the middle sister, is loud, impulsive and always plotting something; and Chiaki, the youngest, is a deadpan elementary schooler with a sharp tongue who adores Haruka. Episodes follow their ordinary days at home and school, along with classmates such as Fujioka, a boy whose love letter to Kana she mistakes for a challenge to fight, and the misunderstandings that keep piling up around them. Daume adapted Coharu Sakuraba's manga into 13 episodes in 2007, the first of several seasons of low-key slice-of-life comedy.

terra-formars.summary: In the 21st century, scientists tried to make Mars habitable by seeding it with moss and cockroaches. Five centuries later a deadly disease is spreading on Earth, and the key to a cure may lie on Mars, where the cockroaches have evolved into huge, intelligent humanoids known as Terraformars. A hundred crew members of the Annex I mission are sent to the planet, each surgically given the abilities of a different insect or animal so they can fight. Among them are Akari Hizamaru, a young man with silkmoth powers, and the squad leader Michelle K. Davis. LIDENFILMS adapted Yu Sasuga and Kenichi Tachibana's manga into 13 episodes in 2014. It contains extreme gore and violence.

toradora-bentou-no-gokui.summary: This single bonus episode of Toradora! never aired on television; it was included with the series' Blu-ray box set in December 2011. It drops back into ordinary school days, when Ryuji's best friend Yusaku Kitamura arrives with a lavish lunch box to share with everyone. Ryuji Takasu, who quietly prides himself on his cooking, feels outclassed and becomes fixated on beating it, turning each day's lunch into a bigger and more ridiculous project while Taiga Aisaka and the rest of the class look on. It is a light, standalone comedy best watched after the TV series. J.C.Staff animated it, as with the main show, adapting Yuyuko Takemiya's light novels.

tari-tari.summary: Konatsu Miyamoto is a third-year at Shirahamazaka High School who badly wants to sing on stage before she graduates, but after a mistake at last year's recital the vice principal keeps her out of the choir. Refusing to give up, she starts her own club and talks a mismatched group into joining: Sawa Okita, a cheerful girl devoted to archery and horses; Wakana Sakai, a music student who has stopped making music; Taichi Tanaka, the lone member of the badminton club; and Wien, a returnee from Austria. Tari Tari is an original 13-episode series from P.A. Works, directed by Masakazu Hashimoto and broadcast in 2012, mixing seaside small-town life, music and quiet family drama.

fairy-tail-houou-no-miko.summary: The first Fairy Tail film sends Natsu, Lucy and their guildmates on a self-contained side adventure. They cross paths with Eclair, a guarded young woman who has lost her memories and remembers only one task: she must carry two Phoenix Stones to a certain place. Fairy Tail's wizards take on the job of escorting her, while others are after the stones and the ancient power said to sleep inside them. The 2012 film was animated by A-1 Pictures and is based on Hiro Mashima's manga. It works best for viewers who already know the guild's main members from the TV series.

princess-lover.summary: After a car accident leaves him an orphan, ordinary teenager Teppei Arima goes to live with his grandfather Isshin, the head of an enormously wealthy business group. Teppei is moved into a world of mansions, butlers and high-society parties, sent to an exclusive school, and told he is expected to inherit the family's empire. That new status quickly brings him into contact with a run of young women from powerful families, including a princess from a small European country, and he ends up at the centre of rivalries, sword fights and arranged-marriage politics. GoHands produced the 12-episode series in 2009, adapting Ricotta's visual novel. The anime contains frequent fan service and nudity.

tokyo-ghoul-jack.summary: This one-episode OVA is a prequel set years before Ken Kaneki's story, adapting Sui Ishida's spin-off. Taishi Fura, a former baseball player who has drifted into delinquency, sees a ghoul known as Lantern attack people close to him. His classmate Kisho Arima turns out to be an undercover agent of the anti-ghoul agency, the CCG, and the two teenagers end up investigating the case together, with Fura pulled into a world he knew nothing about. Studio Pierrot, which made the Tokyo Ghoul TV series, released it in 2015. It gives an early look at a major figure from the main series without needing much background. Expect bloody violence typical of the franchise.

castlevania.summary: This first season of Netflix's Castlevania covers four episodes released in July 2017. In Wallachia, the vampire Dracula turns his fury on humanity after the church executes the woman he loves, and an army of demons begins tearing through the country. Trevor Belmont, the drunken, cynical last member of a disgraced family of monster hunters, drifts into the besieged city of Gresit and reluctantly gets involved, meeting a group of wandering scholars called the Speakers. Written by Warren Ellis, the American series draws on Konami's video game Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse. It contains graphic violence, gore and strong language.
castlevania.notes: American Netflix series with no MyAnimeList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia. Kitsu slug covers season 1 (4 episodes, 2017).

subete-ga-f-ni-naru.summary: Associate professor Sohei Saikawa and his student Moe Nishinosono travel to a remote island that houses a private research institute. They hope to meet Shiki Magata, a brilliant programmer who has lived shut away inside its walls for years and almost never sees outsiders. Their visit coincides with a death inside a sealed room, and the pair find themselves trying to work out how a seemingly impossible crime happened. The Perfect Insider is a calm, talk-heavy mystery that leans on logic and character study rather than action. A-1 Pictures adapted Hiroshi Mori's 1996 novel into an 11-episode series in 2015. It deals with murder and some unsettling psychological themes.

jormungand-perfect-order.summary: The second season of Jormungand picks up directly after the first, with arms dealer Koko Hekmatyar and her squad of ex-soldier bodyguards still selling weapons around the world. Jonah, the quiet former child soldier who hates arms dealers yet travels with her, remains part of the team as jobs take them into clashes with rival dealers, intelligence agencies and private armies. Alongside the gunfights, Koko's long-term plans begin to come into focus, and tensions rise inside her own group. White Fox animated the 12-episode season in 2012, adapting Keitaro Takahashi's manga. Watch the first season first. It contains frequent gun violence and killing.

pop-team-epic.summary: Popuko, short and quick to explode, and Pipimi, tall and unflappable, are two schoolgirls who star in a rapid-fire chain of absurd sketches. Pop Team Epic has no real plot: each episode jumps between parodies of anime, games and films, deliberately crude animation, stop-motion segments, fake commercials and running gags, often switching visual styles within minutes. Much of the humour relies on Japanese pop culture and internet references, so some jokes land differently for viewers outside Japan. Kamikaze Douga produced the 12-episode series in 2018, based on Bkub Okawa's four-panel comic. It is a gag show aimed at viewers who enjoy anarchic, nonsensical comedy.

elfen-lied-special.summary: This single special episode of Elfen Lied takes place during the later part of the TV series, at the Kaede House where Kohta and Yuka live. Nana, a young girl with the same horned Diclonius powers as the others, has just been taken in, and she is trying hard to be useful around the house, without much success. She is also uneasy about Nyu, the childlike resident she only knows as the dangerous Lucy. Released in 2005, it was animated by Arms like the TV series and is based on Lynn Okamoto's manga. It is a quieter, character-focused side story meant for viewers who have seen the series. The franchise contains graphic violence and nudity.

shingeki-kyojin-chuugakkou.summary: Attack on Titan: Junior High takes the cast of Attack on Titan and drops them into a school comedy. On his first day at junior high, Eren Yeager watches a titan steal his beloved cheeseburger lunch, and he swears revenge on every titan in the school. With his adoptive sister Mikasa and his friend Armin, he throws himself into ridiculous plans, while familiar characters such as Levi, Jean and Sasha turn up in classroom and club roles. The jokes play on the original series' famous scenes and character quirks. Production I.G made the 12-episode series in 2015, based on the spin-off manga by Saki Nakagawa. It is a light parody best enjoyed by fans.

date-a-live-ova.summary: This one-episode OVA is a comedy side story from Date A Live, released in December 2013. Origami Tobiichi, the classmate who is fiercely devoted to Shido Itsuka, demands that he take her on a date. Shido sees a chance to finally make her lose interest, and with the Ratatoskr crew on board the Fraxinus feeding him advice, he tries to make the outing as unpleasant as possible. Origami, however, takes every awkward request in stride, while Tohka is busy figuring out the new phone Kotori has given her. AIC Plus+ produced it, based on Koushi Tachibana's light novels. It is meant for viewers familiar with the first season and includes fan service.

myself-yourself.summary: Sana Hidaka spent his early childhood in the quiet town of Sakuranomori before his family left for Tokyo. He returns five years on to start high school, expecting to pick up where he left off with his old friends. Instead he finds that time has changed them: Nanaka Yatsushiro, Aoi Oribe and the Wakatsuki twins are no longer quite who they were, and several carry worries they do not talk about. As Sana tries to reconnect, the story becomes a drama about growing up and the things people hide. Doga Kobo animated the 13-episode series in 2007, based on Regista's visual novel. Later episodes deal with heavy family and emotional trauma.

occultic-nine.summary: Yuta Gamon, a high schooler in Kichijoji, runs an occult news blog he hopes will earn him money, often accompanied by his bubbly friend Ryoka Narusawa. When a bizarre incident shakes the area, Yuta finds himself tangled up with a group of strangers: a fortune-telling schoolgirl, a hard-headed student who rejects the supernatural, a reporter, a nun, a police detective and more. Each has their own reason for being involved, and the story jumps quickly between them with dense, rapid dialogue. A-1 Pictures adapted Chiyomaru Shikura's light novel, part of the Science Adventure series, into 12 episodes in 2016. It includes disturbing imagery and fan service.

high-school-dxd-specials.summary: These six short specials, each only a few minutes long, were bundled with the DVD and Blu-ray releases of the first High School DxD season in 2012. They are standalone comedy vignettes that sit outside the main plot, following Issei Hyodo and the girls of the Occult Research Club through situations such as a beach trip and a private magic lesson from Akeno. The shorts mainly exist to extend the series' fan service, with little story development. TNK, the studio behind the TV series, produced them, based on Ichiei Ishibumi's light novels. They are intended for viewers who have watched the first season. The specials contain explicit nudity and sexual humour.

samurai-flamenco.summary: Masayoshi Hazama makes a living as a fashion model, but he has idolised costumed superheroes since childhood and never grew out of it. At night he puts on a homemade suit and patrols the streets as Samurai Flamenco, trying to stop real crimes even though he has no powers, training or gadgets. A chance meeting with Hidenori Goto, a tired young police officer, leaves Goto as the one person who knows his secret and keeps getting pulled into his heroics. The show starts as a grounded comedy about what being a hero would really mean. Manglobe produced the 22-episode original series, directed by Takahiro Omori, which aired from 2013 to 2014.

eden-of-the-east-movie-ii-paradise-lost.summary: Paradise Lost is the second Eden of the East film and the final part of the story that began in the 2009 TV series and continued in The King of Eden. Akira Takizawa, one of twelve people handed a phone loaded with billions of yen and told to save Japan, returns home from America having declared he will become the country's king. Saki Morimi and her friends in the Eden of the East group stay by his side as the authorities close in and the other phone holders press their own plans. Production I.G released it in 2010, with Kenji Kamiyama writing and directing. Watch the TV series and the first film beforehand.

gin-no-saji-2nd-season.summary: The second season of Silver Spoon follows Yugo Hachiken, a city student who enrolled at Ooezo Agricultural High School in rural Hokkaido to escape the pressure of his old exam-focused life. Now settled in, he is busier than ever with the equestrian club, part-time farm work and the steady stream of practical problems his classmates bring him. As the school year moves on, he starts thinking more seriously about money, family expectations and what he wants for his own future. A-1 Pictures animated the 11 episodes, broadcast in early 2014, based on Hiromu Arakawa's manga. It continues straight from the first season, keeping the same mix of farming facts, comedy and gentle growing-up drama.

seikoku-no-dragonar.summary: At Ansarivan Dragonar Academy, students learn to ride and command the dragons bound to them. Ash Blake is a first-year with a huge star-shaped mark that should make him a strong dragon rider, but no partner has ever appeared, and classmates treat him as a joke. When his dragon, Eco, finally shows up, she takes the form of a proud, short-tempered girl who refuses to obey him. Ash also attracts the attention of Princess Silvia Lautreamont and other students, adding school-rivalry and harem comedy to the fantasy setting. C-Station adapted Shiki Mizuchi's light novels into a 12-episode series in 2014. It contains frequent fan service and nudity.

space-dandy-2nd-season.summary: The second season of Space Dandy keeps the same formula as the first. Dandy, a pompadoured alien hunter who considers himself the coolest man in the galaxy, flies around space looking for undiscovered species to register for prize money, accompanied by the outdated robot QT and the lazy cat-like alien Meow. Episodes are mostly standalone and swing between comedy, music, romance, horror and philosophy, often with different directors and art styles bringing their own take. Bones produced its 13 episodes in 2014 as an original series, with Shinichiro Watanabe as chief director. New viewers can start here, though the first season introduces the crew and the rival Gogol Empire.

ghost-in-the-shell-2-innocence.summary: Innocence is set in 2032, a few years after the 1995 Ghost in the Shell film. With Major Motoko Kusanagi gone, the heavily cyborged agent Batou of Public Security Section 9 is paired with the more human Togusa to investigate a series of killings carried out by malfunctioning gynoids, lifelike androids built as companions. Their search leads into corporate secrets and organised crime, while the film dwells on questions about dolls, memory and what separates humans from machines. Mamoru Oshii wrote and directed the 2004 film at Production I.G, drawing on Masamune Shirow's manga. It is slow and philosophical. It contains violence and some disturbing imagery.

kimi-to-boku.summary: Kimi to Boku follows four boys who have been friends since kindergarten and are now second-years at high school: the gentle, kind Shun Matsuoka, the hot-headed Kaname Tsukahara, and the twin brothers Asaba, responsible Yuta and sleepy, unbothered Yuki. Their quiet routine changes when Chizuru Tachibana, a loud and energetic transfer student, attaches himself to the group. Episodes move between everyday school scenes, small misunderstandings, memories of childhood and the occasional bit of romance. Nothing dramatic happens, and the series is built around gentle humour and friendship. J.C.Staff adapted Kiichi Hotta's manga into a 13-episode series in 2011, and a second season followed in 2012.

dog-days.summary: Flonyard is a world where people look human but have animal ears and tails. The dog-eared Republic of Biscotti keeps losing battles to the cat-eared Galette Leo Knights, so Princess Millhiore summons a hero from another world: Shinku Izumi, an athletic Japanese schoolboy. Shinku soon learns that wars in Flonyard are run like televised sports festivals, with protective magic so that nobody gets seriously hurt, and he throws himself into the fights with enthusiasm. The show is a bright, light-hearted fantasy adventure. Seven Arcs produced the 13-episode original series in 2011, created by Masaki Tsuzuki of Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha. Two more seasons followed.

kono-sekai-no-katasumi-ni.summary: Suzu Urano is a dreamy, kind-hearted girl from the edge of Hiroshima who loves to draw. In 1944, still young, she marries Shusaku Hojo, a man she barely knows, and moves to the naval port town of Kure to live with his family. The film follows her daily life closely: learning to run a household with scarce rations, finding her place with her in-laws, and holding on to small joys as the war reaches closer to home. Sunao Katabuchi directed the 2016 film at MAPPA, adapting Fumiyo Kono's manga. It is gentle and detailed in tone. It depicts wartime bombing and its effects on civilians.

rozen-maiden.summary: Jun Sakurada stopped going to school and now spends his days shut in his room, ordering items online and returning them before the trial period ends. One day a note asks whether he will wind something, and he carelessly circles yes. A case arrives containing Shinku, a proud living doll in Victorian dress, who promptly bosses Jun around. Shinku is one of the Rozen Maidens, a set of dolls who must fight one another in the Alice Game, and Jun is drawn into those clashes while slowly being forced to face the outside world. Nomad adapted Peach-Pit's manga into a 12-episode series in 2004, mixing gothic fantasy, comedy and drama.

sirius-the-jaeger.summary: In 1930, Tokyo is quietly being preyed on by vampires, and the authorities bring in the Jaegers, a small international team of hunters who carry their weapons in musical-instrument cases. Their sharpest fighter is Yuliy, a young man with werewolf blood who lost his home village to a vampire attack and has little patience for anything except the hunt. Officially the Jaegers are helping the police, but both they and the vampires are also searching for a mysterious relic known as the Ark of Sirius. P.A. Works produced the 12-episode original series in 2018, directed by Masahiro Ando, with action set in early Showa-era Tokyo. It includes bloody fight scenes.

hack-sign.summary: .hack//Sign takes place almost entirely inside The World, a hugely popular online fantasy game. A player character called Tsukasa, a wavemaster, finds that he cannot log out and has no clear memory of who he is in the real world. Other players react in different ways: the Crimson Knights who police the game suspect him of hacking, while Mimiru, the veteran Bear, the leader Subaru and others try to work out what is happening to him. The series is slow and talk-driven, focused on loneliness and identity more than on battles. Bee Train produced its 26 episodes in 2002, directed by Koichi Mashimo, as an original part of the multimedia .hack project.

haiyore-nyaruko-san-w.summary: The second season of Nyaruko: Crawling with Love! continues the chaotic home life of high schooler Mahiro Yasaka. His house is still occupied by Nyaruko, a hyperactive alien of the Nyarlathotep race who insists she is his devoted bride, along with the fiery Cuko, who is fixated on Nyaruko, and the timid Hasta. Mahiro's mother Yoriko takes it all in stride, while Mahiro mostly wants peace and keeps a fork close at hand to fend off advances. Episodes mix romantic comedy with nonstop anime and tokusatsu parodies and gags built on H. P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu Mythos. Xebec animated the 12 episodes in 2013, adapting Manta Aisora's light novels. It includes fan service.

knights-and-magic.summary: Tsubasa Kurata, a programmer and devoted giant-robot fan, is killed in a traffic accident and opens his eyes as a baby in the Fremmevilla Kingdom, a fantasy realm where huge piloted mechs called Silhouette Knights defend people against monstrous beasts. Now Ernesti Echevarria, son of a noble household, a small and cheerful boy, he keeps all of his old knowledge and enthusiasm. From childhood he sets out to become a Knight Runner pilot and to design machines better than anything his new world has built, with help from friends such as the twins Archid and Adeltrude. 8bit adapted Hisago Amazake-no's light novels into a 13-episode series in 2017, focusing on engineering and mech battles.

isekai-no-seikishi-monogatari.summary: Kenshi Masaki, whose older half-brother is Tenchi Masaki of Tenchi Muyo!, is pulled out of Earth and into Geminar, a world where giant bio-mechanical suits called Sacred Mechanoids are piloted by a privileged few. His captors tell him he can only go home if he pilots one in an attack on young empress Lashara Aasu XXVIII. When that plan collapses, Kenshi ends up working as Lashara's servant at an academy for Mechanoid pilots, where his many unusual skills attract attention from a crowd of girls and nobles. AIC Spirits produced the 13-episode OVA series from 2009 to 2010, created by Masaki Kajishima as a Tenchi Muyo! spin-off. It includes fan service.

cross-ange-tenshi-to-ryuu-no-rinbu.summary: Angelise Ikaruga Misurugi is the proud first princess of the Misurugi Empire, a nation where people use a light-based power called Mana for almost everything. Those born unable to use Mana, known as Norma, are treated as less than human. When Angelise's own status is exposed in public, she loses her title, her family and her name, and is sent to Arzenal, a remote island base where Norma girls pilot transforming mechs called Para-mails against dragons that pour out of rifts in space. Renamed Ange, she has to survive a brutal new life. Sunrise produced the 25-episode original series from 2014 to 2015. It contains violence, sexual content, nudity and abuse.

from-up-on-poppy-hill.summary: In 1963 Yokohama, as Japan prepares for the Tokyo Olympics, high schooler Umi Matsuzaki helps run her family's hillside boarding house and raises a set of signal flags over the harbour every morning. At school she meets Shun Kazama, a bold member of the newspaper club, who is campaigning with other students to save the Latin Quarter, a crumbling old clubhouse that is due to be torn down. Umi joins the effort to clean it up, and the two grow closer as the film explores the past of their families. Studio Ghibli released the 2011 film, directed by Goro Miyazaki and co-written by Hayao Miyazaki, based on the manga by Tetsuro Sayama and Chizuru Takahashi.

c.summary: Haruaki Yachi is a high school boy with an unusual trait: curses do not affect him. His father, who travels the world collecting cursed objects, mails him an odd black cube, and that night Haruaki finds a naked girl in his kitchen. She is Fear, the cube itself, a cursed object with a human form and a dark history, who wants to become a normal girl. Haruaki takes her in, alongside Konoha, a girl who has long lived at the Yachi house, and they soon find themselves facing groups who hunt such objects. Silver Link adapted Hazuki Minase's light novels into a 12-episode series in 2011. It contains bloody violence and fan service.

pokemon-maboroshi-no-pokemon-lugia-bakut.summary: The second Pokemon film is set during Ash's travels in the Orange Islands. A wealthy collector, Lawrence III, flies an airship over the islands to capture the legendary birds Moltres, Zapdos and Articuno, hoping to draw out Lugia, the sea's legendary protector, as the final prize. Removing the birds throws the world's weather into chaos. Ash, Misty and Tracey are stranded on Shamouti Island, where a local festival and an ancient legend suggest that a chosen one must step in to restore balance. OLM animated the 1999 film, directed by Kunihiko Yuyama, released in English as Pokemon: The Movie 2000. It is family-friendly and standalone for anyone who knows the basics.

code-geass-akito-the-exiled-1.summary: The Wyvern Arrives is the first of five episodes of Code Geass: Akito the Exiled, a spin-off set in Europe rather than Japan. In 2017 of the series' timeline, the Holy Britannian Empire is pushing deep into the continent, and the European forces create W-0, or Wyvern, a special unit whose Knightmare Frame pilots are sent on near-suicidal missions. Its commander is Leila Malcal, an idealistic young officer, and its most dangerous pilot is the quiet, distant Akito Hyuga. Sunrise released this part in 2012, directed by Kazuki Akane. It can be followed without the main series, though knowing Code Geass helps. It contains war violence.

higurashi-no-naku-koro-ni-rei.summary: Rei is a five-episode OVA continuation of Higurashi When They Cry, released in 2009 after the Kai season, so it should only be watched once the earlier series are finished. Its centre is a three-part story in which Rika Furude, after an accident, wakes up in a version of Hinamizawa where her life looks almost perfect, and she has to decide what she is willing to give up to get back. It is framed by two standalone episodes that are much lighter and more comedic in tone. Studio Deen produced it, directed by Toshifumi Kawase and based on Ryukishi07's visual novels. Like the franchise, it contains violence and disturbing scenes.

detroit-metal-city.summary: Soichi Negishi is a gentle young man from the countryside who moves to Tokyo dreaming of singing soft, stylish pop songs. Instead, he ends up as Johannes Krauser II, the face-painted frontman of Detroit Metal City, an outrageous death metal band whose fans believe he is a demon from hell. Soichi hates the act, yet his on-stage persona keeps getting more popular, and he struggles to keep the two lives apart, especially around Yuri, a girl from his college days who loves his kind of music. Studio 4°C produced the 12 short OVA episodes in 2008, adapting Kiminori Wakasugi's manga. It is full of crude sexual jokes, profanity and violent slapstick.

un-go.summary: In a near-future Tokyo recovering from war and terror attacks, Shinjuro Yuki solves crimes that the official story has already explained away. He is nicknamed the Defeated Detective, because the celebrated sleuth Rinroku Kaisho usually announces a neat solution first, while Shinjuro digs up the less convenient truth. He works alongside Inga, a strange companion who can appear as a boy or a grown woman and who holds a power linked to the truth people hide. Bones produced the 11-episode series, which aired in 2011 on Fuji TV's Noitamina block, directed by Seiji Mizushima. It loosely draws on Ango Sakaguchi's detective stories. It deals with murder and dark themes.

busou-renkin.summary: Kazuki Muto is a kind, impulsive high schooler who dies trying to save a girl from a monster, then wakes up alive again. The girl turns out to be Tokiko Tsumura, an alchemist warrior who hunts homunculi, man-eating creatures that hide among humans, and she has replaced his heart with a kakugane, an alchemical device that transforms into a weapon matching its user's nature. Kazuki's becomes a lance, and he insists on joining Tokiko's fight to protect his town and friends. Xebec adapted Nobuhiro Watsuki's manga, from the creator of Rurouni Kenshin, into a 26-episode series from 2006 to 2007. It is classic shonen action with comedy and some violence.

selector-infected-wixoss.summary: Ruko Kominato is a quiet girl who drifts through life without strong wishes of her own. Her brother hands her a starter deck for the trading card game WIXOSS, and she finds that its main card holds a living girl, Tama, who speaks and moves. That makes Ruko a Selector, one of a group of girls who battle each other with their living cards, with the promise that winning enough will grant their deepest wish. As she meets other Selectors, the game turns out to carry serious costs. J.C.Staff produced the 12-episode series in 2014, directed by Takuya Sato with scripts by Mari Okada, as a tie-in to Takara Tomy's card game. It has a dark psychological tone.

another-the-other-inga.summary: This single OVA episode is a prequel to the horror series Another, set in the last days of summer before Mei Misaki starts her troubled school year in Yomiyama. Mei spends the holiday with a girl close to her, wandering around town, visiting a shopping centre and an amusement park, and talking about the class she is about to join, which has a reputation for being cursed. As the light outing goes on, Mei's unusual sight begins to warn her that something terrible is coming. P.A. Works released it in 2012, based on Yukito Ayatsuji's novel. It touches on a reveal from the TV series, so it is best watched afterwards. It contains horror violence and death.

nanatsu-no-taizai-ban-no-bangaihen.summary: This pair of OVA episodes from The Seven Deadly Sins was released with limited editions of the manga's 15th and 16th volumes in 2015. The first episode is a side story about Ban, the immortal Fox's Sin of Greed, and shows part of his past before he joined the other Sins. The other gathers short comedy and slice-of-life skits starring Meliodas, Elizabeth, Hawk and the rest of the cast in lighter situations than the main plot. A-1 Pictures produced both, following the first TV season and Nakaba Suzuki's manga. They are best watched after the first season. They are light extras rather than essential story, with some violence in the Ban episode.

kanojo-ga-flag-wo-oraretara.summary: Sota Hatate can see flags floating over people's heads, the kind of signals that mark turning points in a visual novel, from romance to approaching death, and he can break them to change what happens. Ever since surviving an accident that others did not, he has believed he brings misfortune and has kept people at arm's length. That gets much harder after he transfers to a new school and moves into a dormitory where Nanami Knight Bladefield, a foreign princess, and a growing crowd of other girls take an interest in him and his strange power. Hoods Entertainment adapted Toka Takei's light novels into a 13-episode series in 2014, directed by Ayumu Watanabe.

nijiiro-days.summary: Rainbow Days follows four high school friends with very different personalities. Natsuki Hashiba is a sweet, easily flustered romantic who falls for Anna Kobayakawa, a quiet girl he meets just after being dumped at Christmas. Tomoya Matsunaga is a smooth-talking flirt, Keiichi Katakura is a cheerful sadist who never goes anywhere without a whip, and Tsuyoshi Naoe is an otaku devoted to his girlfriend and his cosplay hobby. Together they muddle through crushes, misunderstandings, school events and friendship troubles. The comedy is told mostly from the boys' side. Ashi Productions, now known as Production Reed, adapted Minami Mizuno's shojo manga into 24 short episodes in 2016.

bokura-ga-ita.summary: Nanami Takahashi starts high school hoping to make lots of new friends. She soon hears about Motoharu Yano, a charming, popular boy in her class who seems to win everyone over, though her new friend Yuri Yamamoto wants nothing to do with him because he once dated her older sister. Nanami is drawn to Yano despite herself, and as they grow closer she slowly learns that his easy smile hides old wounds he has never let go of. Artland adapted Yuki Obata's shojo manga into a 26-episode series in 2006. It is a slow, emotional teen romance focused on jealousy, grief and trust.

shugo-chara.summary: Amu Hinamori is an elementary school girl whom classmates see as cool and rebellious, an image that comes mostly from shyness and the way she dresses. Secretly wishing she could be braver and more honest, she wakes up to find three eggs in her bed. They hatch into Ran, Miki and Su, small guardian characters who each represent part of the person she might become. Her new companions draw her into the Guardians, the student council of Seiyo Academy, who protect people's hidden dreams from a company called Easter. Satelight adapted Peach-Pit's manga into a 51-episode series from 2007 to 2008, followed by the sequel Shugo Chara!! Doki.

free-starting-days.summary: Starting Days is a prequel film to the Free! TV series, set when Haruka Nanase and Makoto Tachibana begin middle school. Makoto settles in easily and is keen to keep swimming, but Haruka, who only cares about the water itself, keeps others at a distance and is reluctant to join the school swim club. On the team they meet new faces, including the competitive Asahi Shiina and the reserved Ikuya Kirishima, whose older brother Natsuya is the club captain. The story focuses on friendship and learning to swim as a team in a relay. Kyoto Animation released the 2015 film, directed by Yasuhiro Takemoto and based on Koji Oji's novel High Speed!

pokemon-kesshoutou-no-teiou-entei.summary: In the third Pokemon film, a young girl named Molly Hale is left alone when her father, a researcher, disappears while studying the mysterious Unown. When she plays with a set of tiles he left behind, the Unown answer her wishes, encasing her mansion and the town of Greenfield in spreading crystal and creating an Entei to serve as her father. Things become personal for Ash when Molly's wish for a mother pulls his own mother, Delia, into the crystal world, and he, Misty and Brock set out to bring her back. OLM animated the 2000 film, directed by Kunihiko Yuyama, released in English as Pokemon 3: The Movie. It is family-friendly.

maria-holic.summary: Kanako Miyamae breaks out in hives whenever a boy touches her, so she transfers to Ame no Kisaki, a Catholic girls' school where her parents once met, hoping to find a girlfriend of her own. On her first day she is struck by Mariya Shido, a beautiful, gentle student admired by the whole school.
