Mariya, however, is a sadistic boy attending in disguise as part of a bid to win the school's chairmanship, and he blackmails Kanako into keeping his secret while making her daily life miserable. The comedy runs on Kanako's wild inner monologue and Mariya's cruelty. Shaft adapted Minari Endo's manga into a 12-episode series in 2009, directed by Akiyuki Shinbo. It contains crude and sexual humour.

oreimo-2-specials.summary: These three episodes are the finale of Oreimo's second season, streamed online in August 2013 after the 13 broadcast episodes ended. They bring Kyosuke Kosaka's story to a close, picking up from the season's end as he deals with his feelings for the girls around him and with Kirino, the outwardly perfect younger sister whose secret love of anime and adult games turned his life upside down. Because they complete the adaptation of Tsukasa Fushimi's light novels, they should be watched immediately after the season, not as optional extras. A-1 Pictures produced them as part of the second season. The series includes fan service and themes of sibling romance.

arcana-famiglia.summary: The island of Regalo is protected by the Arcana Famiglia, a mafia-style family whose members have made contracts with tarot cards and gained special powers from them. When the boss, known as Papa, announces his retirement, he declares a tournament, the Arcana Duello, among the card holders: the winner will become the new leader and also marry his daughter, Felicita. Felicita, a capable fighter herself, refuses to be treated as a prize and decides to fight for her own future, with her childhood friends Liberta and Nova among the other contestants. J.C.Staff adapted the otome visual novel by HuneX and Comfort into a 12-episode series in 2012, mixing action, comedy and light romance.

trigun-badlands-rumble.summary: Badlands Rumble is a standalone Trigun film that follows Vash the Stampede, the cheerful gunslinger with a huge price on his head, on the desert planet Gunsmoke. Twenty years earlier Vash crossed paths with Gasback, a notorious bank robber, and now Gasback has returned, apparently set on revenge against the mayor of a desert town. A crowd of bounty hunters gathers to collect the reward on Gasback, while Vash meets a young woman named Amelia and insurance agents Meryl and Milly also arrive in town. Madhouse released the 2010 film, directed by Satoshi Nishimura and based on Yasuhiro Nightow's manga. It works for newcomers and fans alike.

denpa-teki-na-kanojo.summary: Juu Juzawa is a high school delinquent who prefers to keep everyone at a distance. One day Ame Ochibana, a quiet girl with long hair covering one eye, approaches him and announces that they were bound together in a previous life and that she intends to be his loyal knight. Juu thinks she is out of her mind, but after a classmate is killed and a string of violent incidents shakes the town, he reluctantly accepts her help in finding out who is responsible. Brain's Base adapted Kentaro Katayama's light novels into two OVA episodes released in 2009. It is a dark mystery with a cynical tone. It contains violence and disturbing crimes.

bokusatsu-tenshi-dokuro-chan.summary: Sakura Kusakabe is an ordinary middle school boy until Dokuro-chan, an angel from the future, moves in with him. She explains that in years to come Sakura will invent a way to stop girls from ageing past twelve, and she has been sent to kill him before that happens. Instead she decides to stay, and in her clumsy, jealous outbursts she kills him again and again with her spiked club Excalibolg, bringing him back to life every time with a silly magic chant. The OVA is a deliberately absurd comedy with no restraint. Hal Film Maker produced four episodes in 2005, based on Masaki Okayu's light novels. It contains cartoonish gore and sexual humour.

junjou-romantica.summary: Misaki Takahashi is a high school student about to sit his university entrance exams, and after failing his practice tests he needs a tutor. His older brother arranges help from his best friend Akihiko Usami, a famous novelist, and Misaki soon finds himself the focus of Akihiko's very personal attention. The series follows their stormy relationship, alongside two other couples: an assistant professor and a younger man who loves him, and a literature professor pursued by a student. Studio Deen adapted Shungiku Nakamura's boys' love manga into a 12-episode series in 2008. It contains sexual content, some of it with questionable consent.

hyakka-ryouran-samurai-girls.summary: Samurai Girls is set in Great Japan, an alternate version of the country where the Tokugawa shogunate never ended and the nation has stayed largely closed to the world. Muneakira Yagyu, the young head of a dojo, comes to Buou Academy at the foot of Mount Fuji, a school where children of military families train as samurai and where a powerful student council keeps order. A girl calling herself Jubei Yagyu literally falls into his arms, and a kiss awakens her as a Master Samurai, pulling Muneakira into power struggles with rival factions. Arms adapted Akira Suzuki's light novels into a 12-episode series in 2010. It contains heavy fan service and nudity.

the-boondocks.summary: The Boondocks follows the Freemans, a Black family who move from Chicago to Woodcrest, a quiet, mostly white suburb. Ten-year-old Huey is a serious, politically radical thinker who comments on everything around him; his eight-year-old brother Riley idolises gangster culture and rap; and their cranky grandfather Robert just wants to enjoy his retirement. Episodes satirise race, politics, celebrity and American culture through absurd storylines and martial-arts action sequences. Created by Aaron McGruder from his comic strip, the American series ran on Adult Swim from 2005 to 2014 across four seasons and 55 episodes. It contains strong language, racial slurs, violence and sexual references.
the-boondocks.notes: American series with no MyAnimeList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia.

outlaw-star.summary: Gene Starwind dreams of flying through space, but for now he runs a small handyman business on the backwater planet Sentinel III with his young partner, the clever Jim Hawking. A bodyguard job for a mysterious woman named Hilda changes everything: the pair end up with an advanced prototype starship they name the Outlaw Star and with Melfina, a gentle bio-android found in a suitcase who is the only one able to interface with it. Pursued by space pirates and others, they head out across the galaxy, where Gene finds himself searching for a legendary treasure. Sunrise produced the series in 1998, based on Takehiko Ito's manga. It contains violence and some fan service.

sekai-seifuku-bouryaku-no-zvezda.summary: Asuta Jimon, a middle schooler who has run away from home, meets a little girl collapsed on the street one night. She is Kate Hoshimiya, better known as Lady Venera, the leader of Zvezda, a small secret organisation that sincerely intends to conquer the world. After he shares a little food with her, she recruits him on the spot, and Asuta soon finds himself living with her odd group of henchmen and joining their schemes. Standing in their way is White Light, a team contracted by the Japanese government to bring Zvezda down. A-1 Pictures produced the 12-episode original series in 2014, directed by Tensai Okamura, mixing comedy, action and parody of villain stories.

ousama-game-the-animation.summary: Nobuaki Kanazawa transfers to a new school and makes it clear he wants nothing to do with his classmates. The reason becomes clear when the whole class receives a text message from someone calling themselves the King, setting out the rules of a game and an order that must be obeyed within a day. Anyone who refuses or fails is punished, and the commands soon turn cruel. Nobuaki recognises what is happening and tries to warn his classmates as their trust in each other falls apart. Studio Seven adapted Nobuaki Kanazawa's mobile phone novel into a 12-episode series in 2017, directed by Noriyoshi Sasaki. It contains graphic violence, gore and frequent character deaths.

chrome-shelled-regios.summary: In a world devastated by giant monsters, people survive inside Regios, enormous mobile cities that walk across the ruined land. Layfon Alseif arrives at Zuellni, an academic city run entirely by students, hoping to leave martial arts behind and study something ordinary. His hidden skill is quickly noticed by student council president Kalian Loss and by Nina Antalk, the determined captain of the 17th Platoon, and he is pushed into joining her squad of military arts students who defend the city. The series follows his school life, his squad's struggles and flashbacks to his past in another city. Zexcs adapted Shusuke Amagi's light novels into a 24-episode series in 2009.

jin-roh-the-wolf-brigade.summary: Jin-Roh takes place in an alternate postwar Japan where a heavily armoured police unit, the Kerberos Panzer Cops, fights an armed underground resistance in the sewers and streets of Tokyo. During one operation, Kazuki Fuse hesitates before firing on a teenage girl carrying explosives, and he watches her set off the bomb. Shaken and placed under review, he visits her grave and meets Kei Amemiya, a young woman who says she is the girl's sister, while rival security agencies circle around him. Production I.G's film, with Hiroyuki Okiura directing from Mamoru Oshii's script, premiered in 1999. It is slow and bleak, built around the Little Red Riding Hood fable. It contains graphic violence.

aggressive-retsuko-ona.summary: Retsuko is a 25-year-old red panda working in the accounting department of a big trading company. She is polite and hard-working, but her boss, Ton, is a chauvinistic pig who dumps work on her, some co-workers only care about pleasing him, and the office grind never lets up. Her outlet is a nightly visit to a karaoke booth, where she screams her frustrations out as death metal. With a few friends from work, she tries to make sense of office life, dating and her own future. Fanworks produced this first season of 10 short episodes, which Netflix released globally in April 2018, based on the Sanrio character created by the designer Yeti.

natsume-yuujinchou-roku.summary: The sixth season of Natsume's Book of Friends continues the quiet, episodic story of Takashi Natsume, a high schooler who can see yokai. He carries the Book of Friends, inherited from his grandmother Reiko, which holds the names of spirits she bound by defeating them, and he spends his time returning those names, accompanied by his bodyguard, the cat-shaped spirit Nyanko-sensei. This season brings more encounters with lonely or troubled spirits, his friends at school and the exorcists who see the book as a tool. Shuka animated the 11 episodes in 2017, adapting Yuki Midorikawa's manga. It is gentle and reflective, and best watched after the earlier five seasons.

berserk-ougon-jidaihen-i-haou-no-tamago.summary: The Egg of the King is the first film in a trilogy adapting the Golden Age arc of Kentaro Miura's dark fantasy manga Berserk. Guts is a lone mercenary with an enormous sword who fights from one battlefield to the next without any direction. That changes when he meets Griffith, the charismatic young leader of the Band of the Hawk, who defeats him in a duel and takes him into the band, alongside the fierce swordswoman Casca. As the Hawks win battles for the Kingdom of Midland, Griffith's ambitions begin to draw attention at court. Studio 4°C released the 2012 film, directed by Toshiyuki Kubooka. It contains graphic violence.

fairy-tail-ova.summary: These five Fairy Tail OVA episodes were released from 2011 to 2013, bundled with special editions of the manga. Each is a standalone side story away from the main plot. Lucy investigates a strange job request involving Fairy Hills, the guild's women's dormitory; the cast is dropped into a school-life parody; Natsu, Lucy, Happy, Gray and Erza are sent into the past by a magic book in a story storyboarded by Hiro Mashima; and the guild heads to a training camp before the Grand Magic Games. They are best watched alongside the TV series, since they assume knowledge of the cast. The episodes are light, comedic and include fan service.

kobayashi-san-chi-no-maid-dragon-ova.summary: This single bonus episode of Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid, released in September 2017, is a light standalone side story. With Valentine's Day coming, Tohru, the dragon who works as Kobayashi's maid, mixes a homemade love potion into chocolates, hoping to win her employer over. Kobayashi sees through the plan quickly, but the day goes in unexpected directions anyway, and later Kobayashi and the dragons head off to the hot springs together. Kanna and the other dragons are part of the fun. Kyoto Animation produced it, based on Coolkyousinnjya's manga. It is a relaxed comedy with mild fan service, best enjoyed after the TV series.

k-on-live-house.summary: Live House! is a single bonus episode of K-On!, released in early 2010 after the first season. As the year draws to a close, a middle school friend of drummer Ritsu invites the light music club's band, Ho-kago Tea Time, to perform at a live music venue on New Year's Eve. Yui, Mio, Ritsu, Tsumugi and Azusa find themselves preparing for a real live venue, meeting other bands and getting nervous about whether they belong there. Kyoto Animation produced it, based on Kakifly's four-panel manga. It is a cosy, music-focused slice-of-life story for viewers who have finished the first season.

kaiba.summary: In Kaiba's world, memories are stored on chips and can be bought, sold, stolen and moved into new bodies, so the rich can live on indefinitely while the poor often sell their bodies to get by. A young man comes to in a bare room, his memory gone, a gaping wound through the chest, plus a pendant holding a photo of an unfamiliar woman. Calling himself Kaiba, he escapes an attack and begins a journey across strange worlds, hoping to learn who he is. The rounded, simple art style contrasts with often sad and unsettling stories. Masaaki Yuasa created and directed the 12-episode original series at Madhouse in 2008. It contains nudity and disturbing themes.

joshiraku.summary: Joshiraku centres on five young women who perform rakugo, the traditional Japanese art of comic storytelling, and spend their time backstage chatting. Marii, Tetora, Kigurumi, Gankyo and Kukuru bounce off each other in rapid conversations about whatever comes up, from everyday annoyances and Japanese customs to politics, celebrity news and manga, with occasional trips around Tokyo. There is almost no plot; the humour comes from wordplay, satire and the girls' contrasting personalities. Much of it depends on Japanese culture and topical references. J.C.Staff adapted the manga by Koji Kumeta and illustrator Yasu into a 13-episode series in 2012, directed by Tsutomu Mizushima.

boku-no-hero-academia-ova.summary: Save! Rescue Training! is a single OVA of My Hero Academia, set early in the story after the villain attack on Class 1-A's training session. With U.A. High School trying to restore public trust, Izuku Midoriya and his classmates return to the job of learning how to save people, working through a rescue exercise at one of the school's training grounds. During the drill, a masked figure is spotted roaming the training ground, raising fears that villains have come back. Bones produced it; it was first screened at Jump Festa 2016 and released with the 13th volume of Kohei Horikoshi's manga in April 2017. It is light action and best watched after the first season.

ghost-stories.summary: Satsuki Miyanoshita moves with her father and little brother Keiichiro to the hometown of her late mother. On the first day at her new school, she and a few new friends, including neighbour Hajime Aoyama, the paranormal fan Leo Kakinoki and older student Momoko Koigakubo, explore an abandoned school building rumoured to be haunted, and discover the rumours are true. Satsuki learns that her mother once sealed away the ghosts plaguing the town, and that they are now breaking free, so she must use a book her mother left behind to stop them. Studio Pierrot produced the 19-episode series from 2000 to 2001. Its English dub is known for replacing the script with irreverent comedy.

aoki-hagane-no-arpeggio-ars-nova.summary: With sea levels risen and coastlines lost, humanity's navies were swept aside by the Fleet of Fog, a mysterious armada of warships that now blockades the oceans. Each Fog vessel has a Mental Model, a human-shaped avatar with its own personality. Seventeen years into the blockade, Gunzo Chihaya, a graduate of Japan's marine academy, finds the submarine I-401, whose Mental Model Iona has chosen to side with humans and accept him as captain. With a small crew of friends calling themselves the Blue Steel, he sets off on a risky mission across Fog-controlled waters. Sanzigen produced the 12-episode series in 2013 almost entirely in 3DCG, directed by Seiji Kishi, based on Ark Performance's manga.

sabagebu.summary: Momoka Sonokawa transfers to a new school and is rescued from a groper on the train by an older girl wielding two pistols. Her rescuer is Miou Otori, a rich third-year who heads the school's survival game club, who sees potential in Momoka and drags her into the club's airsoft battles. Momoka is no sweet heroine, though: she is selfish, petty and quick to pull a trigger, and the comedy relies on her outrageous behaviour and the club's absurd matches and fantasies. Each episode mixes gun battles, parody and slapstick. Pierrot Plus, now Studio Signpost, adapted Hidekichi Matsumoto's manga into a 12-episode series in 2014. It includes cartoonish violence and dark humour.

shuumatsu-no-izetta.summary: In an alternate 1939, the empire of Germania has started a war across Europe and is closing in on Eylstadt, a small Alpine country with a tiny army. Its heir, Princess Fine, tries to secure help abroad, and on the way she is reunited with Izetta, a girl she befriended as a child. Izetta is the last living witch, able to fly on an object such as a rifle and to control things she touches, and she decides to use her forbidden power to protect Fine and Eylstadt. The series mixes World War II-style military drama with fantasy and a close friendship. Ajia-do produced the 12-episode original series in 2016, directed by Masaya Fujimori. It contains war violence.

paradise-kiss.summary: Yukari Hayasaka is a third-year at an elite prep school, worn down by her mother's demands that she study hard for university entrance exams. One day she is approached by a group of flamboyant fashion students from the Yazawa School of Arts: Miwako, Arashi, Isabella and their leader, George. They run a label called Paradise Kiss and want her to model their design for the school's fashion show. Yukari refuses at first, but their world of sewing, style and freedom pulls her in, along with a complicated attraction to George. Madhouse adapted Ai Yazawa's manga into a 12-episode series in 2005, directed by Osamu Kobayashi. It contains sexual themes.

kannagi.summary: Jin Mikuriya, a high school boy in the art club, carves a statue from the wood of a sacred tree that has been cut down. Soon after, the statue becomes a girl who calls herself Nagi, a goddess of the land the tree stood on. Proud, bossy and fond of television and junk food, Nagi decides to live with Jin and enroll at his school, saying she must cleanse the impurities that have spread through the town. Jin is stuck explaining her to friends, including his childhood friend Tsugumi Aoba. A-1 Pictures adapted Eri Takenashi's manga into a 13-episode series in 2008, directed by Yutaka Yamamoto. It is mostly comedy with everyday school life.

seiren.summary: Shoichi Kamita is a high school student at Kibito High who is starting to think about university and his future, while also discovering what it is like to fall for someone. Seiren is told as an anthology. It is split into three four-episode stories, each set in its own continuity and following Shoichi as he grows close to a different girl, while the same classmates appear throughout. The first arc pairs him with Hikari Tsuneki, a popular girl who hides a competitive streak. Studio Gokumi and AXsiZ produced the 12-episode original series in 2017, directed by Tomoki Kobayashi, with characters by Kisai Takayama of Amagami. It is a low-key romantic comedy.

kingdom.summary: During China's Warring States period, two orphan boys, Xin and Piao, work as servants in a poor village in the state of Qin. They spar every day, dreaming of rising through the ranks to become great generals. When Piao is taken away to serve at the royal palace, events throw Xin into the middle of a fight for the throne, and he meets Ying Zheng, the young king of Qin, whose ambition is to unite the warring states. Studio Pierrot adapted Yasuhisa Hara's manga into a 38-episode first season from 2012 to 2013, directed by Jun Kamiya, with large battles rendered partly in 3DCG. Many more seasons followed. It contains frequent war violence and death.

yuuki-yuuna-wa-yuusha-de-aru.summary: Yuna Yuki is a cheerful second-year at Sanshu Middle School and a member of its Hero Club, a group of girls who volunteer to help anyone who needs it. One ordinary day, Yuna and her clubmates Mimori Togo, Fu Inubozaki and Fu's younger sister Itsuki are swept into a strange world of light, where monsters called Vertex are advancing to destroy the Shinju, the divine tree that protects their world. Using an app on their phones, the girls transform into heroes to fight back. The bright, cute look hides a more serious story. Studio Gokumi produced the 12-episode original series in 2014, created by Takahiro and directed by Seiji Kishi. It touches on heavy and distressing themes.

zutto-mae-kara-suki-deshita-kokuhaku-jik.summary: Natsuki Enomoto, a high school student, finally works up the nerve to tell her childhood friend Yu Setoguchi how she feels. At the last second she panics and insists it was only a practice confession, leaving Yu confused and herself frustrated. With help from her friends Akari Hayasaka and Mio Aida, who have their own romantic worries, Natsuki keeps trying to tell him the truth, while Yu struggles with his own feelings. The film interweaves several high school love stories and is built around HoneyWorks' popular songs about confessions. Qualia Animation released it in 2016, directed by Tetsuya Yanagisawa, as part of the Kokuhaku Jikko Iinkai series. It is a light romance.

gungrave.summary: Gungrave centres on Brandon Heat and Harry MacDowell, two young friends who grow up as small-time hoodlums in a run-down city, taking odd jobs and getting into street fights. When their world is turned upside down, they join Millennion, a powerful crime syndicate, and the story traces their rise through its ranks over many years, testing their loyalty to each other, to the organisation and to the people they love. The first episode opens with a strange, grim future before jumping back to their youth. Madhouse produced the 26-episode series from 2003 to 2004, based on the video game with character designs by Yasuhiro Nightow. It contains heavy violence and gun battles.

sekaiichi-hatsukoi.summary: Ritsu Onodera is a literary editor tired of colleagues who claim he only succeeds because of his father, who owns the publishing house where he works. Determined to prove himself, he quits and joins Marukawa Publishing, only to be assigned, to his dismay, to the shojo manga department. His new boss, the demanding editor-in-chief Masamune Takano, turns out to be the older schoolmate Ritsu fell for and confessed to in high school, now going by a different surname. Takano tells him plainly that he intends to make Ritsu fall for him again, while Ritsu insists he wants nothing of the sort. Studio Deen adapted Shungiku Nakamura's boys' love manga into a 12-episode series in 2011. It contains sexual content.

mahou-shoujo-site.summary: Aya Asagiri is a high school student who is bullied mercilessly at school and abused at home by her older brother, and she has come to wish she were dead. One night her screen suddenly shows a strange page called the Magical Girl Site, and the next day she finds she has been given a magic wand in the form of a small pistol. With it she is pulled into a world of other girls who have received similar powers from the site, each with their own suffering, and learns that the gift comes at a terrible cost. production doA adapted Kentaro Sato's manga into a 12-episode series in 2018. It contains graphic violence, abuse, suicide and sexual assault themes.

youkoso-jitsuryoku-shijou-shugi-no-kyous.summary: The second season of Classroom of the Elite resumes directly after the island survival exam, back aboard the cruise ship returning the first-years of Advanced Nurturing High School to the mainland. At this government school, where class rankings and points decide students' futures, Class D is still at the bottom, and a new special exam begins almost immediately. Kiyotaka Ayanokoji continues to manipulate events from the shadows while Suzune Horikita tries to lead the class, as the aggressive Kakeru Ryuen of Class C, angry about the last exam, sets out to beat every other class by any means. Lerche produced the 13 episodes in 2022, adapting Shogo Kinugasa's light novels. Watch the first season beforehand.

osomatsu-san.summary: The Matsuno brothers are identical sextuplets who first appeared as mischievous children in Fujio Akatsuka's 1962 manga Osomatsu-kun. Mr. Osomatsu catches up with them as adults in their twenties, and the six of them are still living with their parents, unemployed, single and in no hurry to change any of that. Osomatsu, Karamatsu, Choromatsu, Ichimatsu, Jyushimatsu and Todomatsu each have their own exaggerated personality, and the episodes are made of comedy sketches that parody other anime, poke fun at modern life and throw them into absurd situations. Studio Pierrot produced the 25-episode first season from 2015 to 2016, directed by Yoichi Fujita, for Akatsuka's 80th anniversary. Its humour is often crude.

seven-ghost.summary: Teito Klein is a top student at the Barsburg Empire's military academy, where cadets fight with a supernatural force called Zaiphon. He is also a former slave who cannot remember his early childhood, mocked by other students and close only to his friend Mikage. Just before graduation, Teito learns something about his past that leads him to act against a powerful officer, and he ends up a fugitive sheltering in a church in the empire's 7th District, protected by a group of unusual bishops including the rough Frau. Studio Deen adapted the manga by Yuki Amemiya and Yukino Ichihara into a 25-episode series in 2009. It mixes fantasy action with religious imagery and contains violence.

vinland-saga-season-2.summary: The second season of Vinland Saga changes setting and pace from the first. Thorfinn, the young warrior who spent his childhood among Viking mercenaries, is now a slave sold to a wealthy Danish landowner named Ketil, put to work clearing forest for a new farm. There he is paired with Einar, an English farmer whose family and village were destroyed by raiders, and the two slowly build a working friendship. Away from battlefields, the story focuses on guilt, trauma and what it means to live peacefully, while tensions build around the farm. MAPPA produced its 24 episodes in 2023, taking over from Wit Studio, adapting Makoto Yukimura's manga. It contains violence and some brutal scenes.

himouto-umaru-chan-r.summary: The second season of Himouto! Umaru-chan returns to Umaru Doma, a high school girl everyone sees as beautiful, polite and brilliant. At home with her patient older brother Taihei, she pulls on a hamster-hood cloak and becomes a lazy, demanding otaku who lives on junk food, video games and anime. This season continues her days with her friends Nana Ebina, Kirie Motoba and Sylphynford Tachibana, who each know a different version of her, and adds a new girl who seems to know Umaru. Doga Kobo produced the 12 episodes in 2017, based on the manga by Sankakuhead. It is a light slice-of-life comedy best watched after the first season.

choujigen-game-neptune-the-animation.summary: Gamindustri is a world divided into four nations, Planeptune, Lastation, Lowee and Leanbox, each ruled by a goddess known as a CPU who draws strength from her people's faith. After years of fighting over that faith, the four goddesses have signed a friendship treaty, and Planeptune's goddess, the lazy and carefree Neptune, would rather play games than govern. Her younger sister Nepgear and the other nations' leaders worry about falling faith and new threats. The series is a playful parody of the video game industry, with each nation standing in for a console maker. David Production adapted the role-playing game series from Compile Heart and Idea Factory into 12 episodes in 2013. It includes fan service.

saikin-imouto-no-yousu-ga-chotto-okashii.summary: Mitsuki Kanzaki, a first-year in high school, is unhappy about her mother's remarriage, which brings a new stepfather and a stepbrother, Yuya, into her life. Old memories of unreliable father figures leave her cold toward both of them. After an accident, she finds herself possessed by Hiyori Kotobuki, the ghost of a girl who was in love with Yuya and cannot move on until those feelings are fulfilled. Hiyori starts using Mitsuki's body to pursue him, and Mitsuki has to help resolve the ghost's attachment, whatever that requires. Project No.9 adapted Mari Matsuzawa's manga into a 12-episode series in 2014. It contains heavy fan service, nudity and sexual situations.

bleach-jigokuhen.summary: Hell Verse is the fourth Bleach film, a standalone story about the underworld reserved for souls too sinful to be reborn. Masked beings called Sinners escape from Hell and attack Ichigo Kurosaki, the substitute Soul Reaper, and his friends at school. In the chaos, his younger sister Yuzu is taken, and Ichigo resolves to enter Hell itself to bring her back, guided by a mysterious Sinner named Kokuto, while the Soul Society opposes the attempt. Studio Pierrot released the 2010 film, directed by Noriyuki Abe, with manga author Tite Kubo overseeing production. It is best suited to viewers familiar with the TV series. It contains intense fighting and violence.

digimon-tamers.summary: Digimon Tamers is the third Digimon TV series and starts afresh in a world where Digimon are a popular card game and TV franchise. Takato Matsuda, a shy boy who loves the game, swipes a strange blue card through his reader, turning it into a digital device that brings to life a Digimon he invented in his own drawings: Guilmon. Soon he meets other children with real Digimon partners, including the cool, competitive Rika Nonaka with Renamon and the thoughtful Henry Wong with Terriermon, as wild Digimon begin appearing in Tokyo. Toei Animation produced the 51-episode series from 2001 to 2002, with Chiaki J. Konaka as head writer. It grows more serious as it goes on.

high-score-girl.summary: In 1991, arcade fighting games are booming, and sixth-grader Haruo Yaguchi spends every spare moment in arcades, where his skill makes him something of a local hero. His pride takes a hit when Akira Ono, a quiet rich girl from his class who barely speaks, starts beating him at Street Fighter II. Their rivalry becomes an awkward friendship told through real arcade and console games of the 1990s, as the story follows them through their school years. J.C.Staff adapted Rensuke Oshikiri's manga into a 12-episode series in 2018, using 3DCG for its characters and directed by Yoshinobu Yamakawa. It is a nostalgic coming-of-age comedy with gentle romance.

rokujouma-no-shinryakusha-tv.summary: Koutarou Satomi, a first-year high school student living on his own, is thrilled to find Room 106 of Corona House for only five thousand yen a month. The low rent turns out to have a reason. One after another, unusual girls arrive to claim the small six-mat room: the ghost Sanae, who already haunts it; the clumsy magical girl Yurika; Theia, a proud alien princess; and Kiriha, a member of an underground civilisation. None of them will leave, so they agree to settle ownership through games and contests while sharing the tiny space. Silver Link adapted Takehaya's light novels into a 12-episode series in 2014. It is a harem comedy with occasional action.

mushishi-special-hihamukage.summary: Hihamukage is a one-hour Mushishi special broadcast in January 2014, shortly before the series' second season. A rare solar eclipse is due, and people across the countryside gather to watch, but in one area the sun stays dark long after the eclipse should have ended, threatening the crops. Ginko, the wandering expert in mushi, the primitive life forms that most humans cannot see, comes to find out why, and the trail leads to a pair of twin girls living nearby. Artland produced it with director Hiroshi Nagahama, adapting a story from Yuki Urushibara's manga. Like the TV series, it is quiet, atmospheric and can be watched on its own.

escaflowne.summary: Hitomi Kanzaki is a fifteen-year-old track runner with a habit of reading tarot cards. During an evening on the school track, Van Fanel, a boy locked in battle with a dragon, bursts out of a column of light, and soon afterwards Hitomi is pulled with him to Gaea, a world whose people see Earth in their sky as the Mystic Moon. Van is the young king of Fanelia and pilots Escaflowne, an ancient armoured machine, as the Zaibach Empire begins a campaign of conquest. Hitomi's visions of the future make her valuable to both sides. Sunrise produced the 26-episode original series in 1996, created by Shoji Kawamori and directed by Kazuki Akane. It contains war violence.

toaru-majutsu-no-index-iii.summary: The third season of A Certain Magical Index picks up as the long-running tension between Academy City's science side and the world's magic side boils over into open conflict on a global scale. Toma Kamijo, the unlucky high schooler whose right hand cancels supernatural powers, once again ends up in the middle of it, while separate storylines follow the powerful esper Accelerator and others, each fighting for the people they want to protect. The season moves fast and covers a large amount of the light novels. J.C.Staff produced its 26 episodes from 2018 to 2019, directed by Hiroshi Nishikiori, adapting Kazuma Kamachi's novels. Watch the earlier seasons first. It contains action violence.

kami-nomi-zo-shiru-sekai-tenri-hen.summary: The Tenri Arc is a two-part OVA of The World God Only Knows, released in two parts in late 2012. During summer break, Keima Katsuragi, a gamer who has sworn off real girls, plans to do nothing but play dating sims. His plans are interrupted when Tenri Ayukawa, a shy girl he knew as a child, moves in next door, and it turns out there may be something living inside her. Keima and the demon Elsie have to work out the secrets she is holding. Manglobe produced it, based on Tamiki Wakaki's manga. It is best watched after the first two seasons, since it relies on knowing the cast and the series' premise.

asu-no-yoichi.summary: Yoichi Karasuma has spent seventeen years training in swordsmanship in the mountains with his father, and he has learned everything his teacher can show him. He is sent to the city to continue his training with the Ikaruga family, whose dojo is run by four sisters led by the serious Ibuki. Yoichi knows a great deal about the sword and almost nothing about modern life. He speaks and dresses like an old-fashioned samurai, misunderstands ordinary situations and keeps landing in embarrassing ones with the sisters, while rival martial arts schools come after him. AIC adapted Yu Minamoto's manga into a 12-episode series in 2009. It is a harem comedy with frequent fan service.

clannad-movie.summary: Clannad is a 2007 film adaptation of Key's visual novel, made separately from Kyoto Animation's better-known TV series. Tomoya Okazaki is a high school senior who has stopped caring about school and avoids his home because of his difficult relationship with his father. He meets Nagisa Furukawa, a shy, sickly girl repeating her final year who wants to revive her school's drama club, and he starts helping her. The film focuses on their story and reinterprets events in its own way, with a different visual style and tone. Toei Animation produced it, directed by Osamu Dezaki. It is a quiet family and romance drama with emotional themes.

boogiepop-wa-warawanai.summary: Among the students of Shinyo Academy, girls whisper about Boogiepop, a figure in a black cloak and tall hat said to appear when a person is at their most beautiful. Boogiepop is real: an automatic being that surfaces from an ordinary girl, Touka Miyashita, whenever something threatens the world. The 2019 series adapts several of Kouhei Kadono's light novels in separate arcs, told out of order from many points of view, in which Boogiepop confronts man-eating creatures, people with strange abilities and dangers that slip past ordinary notice. Madhouse produced the 18 episodes, directed by Shingo Natsume. It is a slow-burning mystery. It contains violence and disturbing scenes.

prince-of-stride-alternative.summary: Stride is a team sport that combines relay running with parkour through city streets, with one member, the relationer, guiding the runners. First-year Nana Sakurai enrolls at Honan Academy because she was captivated by its stride team, and so does the enthusiastic Takeru Fujiwara. They discover the club has nearly disappeared for lack of members and is surviving as part of the shogi club. Together with the fast and easily distracted Riku Yagami, they set out to rebuild the team and aim for the End of Summer tournament. Madhouse produced the 12-episode series in 2016, directed by Atsuko Ishizuka, based on an ASCII Media Works multimedia project.

coppelion.summary: Twenty years after a nuclear disaster contaminated Tokyo, the city stands empty and closed off, and by 2036 it is a radioactive ghost town. When a distress signal comes from inside, the Ground Self-Defense Force sends in three high school girls from a special unit called Coppelion: Ibara Naruse, Aoi Fukasaku and Taeko Nomura. Genetically engineered to be immune to radiation, they walk the ruined streets in school uniforms to search for and rescue anyone still living there, and soon discover the city is not as empty as believed. GoHands adapted Tomonori Inoue's manga into a 13-episode series in 2013, directed by Shingo Suzuki. It contains violence and themes of disaster.

romeo-x-juliet.summary: On Neo Verona, a floating continent, Leontes Montague seizes power in a bloody coup and has the ruling Capulet family killed. The young heiress Juliet is smuggled out and raised in hiding, disguised as a boy. Now sixteen, she fights the Montague regime as a masked vigilante known as the Red Whirlwind. At a festival she meets Romeo, the gentle son of Leontes, and the two fall for each other without knowing who the other really is. Gonzo produced the 24-episode series in 2007, directed by Fumitoshi Oizaki, loosely based on William Shakespeare's play and borrowing characters from his other works. It contains violence and some tragic drama.

ore-twintails-ni-narimasu.summary: Soji Mitsuka is a first-year in high school whose obsession with twin-tail hairstyles is so strong that he tries to start a club devoted to them. His passion attracts Twoearle, a girl from a parallel world, who gives him a device that powers up through love of twin tails. Using it, Soji transforms into Tail Red, a small, twin-tailed girl warrior, to fight the Ultimagil, monstrous aliens from another world who want to steal the attributes humans love most, beginning with twin tails. His childhood friend Aika soon joins the fight. Production IMS adapted Yume Mizusawa's light novels into a 12-episode series in 2014. It is an absurd parody and includes fan service.

rwby-iii.summary: The third volume of RWBY returns to Remnant, a world where trainees learn to become Huntsmen and Huntresses who protect people from the monsters called Grimm. At Beacon Academy, Ruby Rose, Weiss Schnee, Blake Belladonna and Yang Xiao Long compete with their friends in team JNPR during the Vytal Festival tournament, which brings students from rival academies together. While the matches play out, a group working in the shadows moves forward with its own plans for the kingdom of Vale. The American web series was produced by Rooster Teeth and created by Monty Oum, who died in 2015 during production of this volume. It is darker than earlier volumes and contains action violence.
rwby-iii.notes: American web series; no MyAnimeList entry. Sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia. Kitsu slug covers Volume 3 (12 chapters, 2015-2016).

mo-dao-zu-shi.summary: Wei Wuxian was once a celebrated cultivator who chose a forbidden path of demonic cultivation and became feared across the land as the Yiling Patriarch, before his death. Years later he is brought back to life in the body of an outcast young man who used a forbidden ritual to summon him. As he tries to keep a low profile, he crosses paths with Lan Wangji, a reserved and upright cultivator who knew him in his youth, and the two investigate a string of dark mysteries that are tied to the past. This Chinese animated series was made by Tencent Penguin Pictures together with B.C May Pictures, based on Mo Xiang Tong Xiu's novel. It contains violence and horror imagery.

bounen-no-xamdou.summary: Akiyuki Takehara lives with his mother on Sentan Island, a calm place largely untouched by the conflict pitting the Northern Government against the Southern Continent. His ordinary days end when a bus he is riding is attacked, and a mysterious girl named Hiruko causes something to be implanted in his arm. Akiyuki is transformed into a Xam'd, a powerful creature, and has to leave the island to avoid losing himself completely. Nakiami, a mysterious woman who knows more about what has happened to him, brings him aboard the airship Zanbani to learn to live with it. Bones produced the 26-episode original series, released on Sony's PlayStation Network from 2008 to 2009, directed by Masayuki Miyaji. It contains war violence.

dungeon-ni-deai-wo-motomeru-no-wa-machig.summary: Arrow of the Orion is an original side story set between the TV seasons of Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? During the Holy Moon Festival in the dungeon city of Orario, the young adventurer Bell Cranel pulls a spear from a crystal in a festival game hosted by the god Hermes. The prize leads him to the goddess Artemis, who calls him her Orion and asks for his help defeating a monster outside the city. Bell sets out with his goddess Hestia and his companions, with Artemis an old friend of Hestia's. J.C.Staff released the 2019 film, directed by Katsushi Sakurabi, with an original story by Fujino Omori. It includes light fan service.

junketsu-no-maria.summary: During the Hundred Years' War between England and France, Maria is a powerful witch living in the French countryside who cannot stand watching people die. She uses her magic, and her familiars, to break up battles and stop the fighting, which angers armies, the Church and Heaven alike. The archangel Michael forbids her from using magic openly and assigns an angel, Ezekiel, to watch her, with a warning that she will lose her powers if she loses her virginity. Maria refuses to back down. Production I.G adapted Masayuki Ishikawa's manga into a 12-episode series in 2015, directed by Goro Taniguchi. It contains sexual themes, crude humour and war violence.

darker-than-black-kuro-no-keiyakusha-spe.summary: This single special, released in 2008 and sometimes called Episode 26, is a side story set during the events of the first Darker than Black series. The Syndicate sends Hei, the Contractor codenamed BK-201, and his team, the blind Doll Yin, the talking cat Mao and their handler Huang, on a new job: a Contractor has died, and his body and belongings are rumoured to be buried under a cherry tree. The police are investigating the same rumour, and the case turns into another quiet, melancholy mystery. Bones produced it, with the series' creator Tensai Okamura. It is best watched after the TV series. It contains violence.

d-gray-man-hallow.summary: Hallow is the sequel to the 2006 D.Gray-man anime, continuing the story after a gap of several years. Allen Walker, a young exorcist of the Black Order who fights the demonic Akuma with a weapon made from the mysterious substance Innocence, is settling into the Order's new headquarters after a devastating attack. Before long the Central Agency, the Order's controlling body, treats him with deep suspicion because of a dark connection inside him, and Allen faces pressure from both his enemies and his own side. TMS Entertainment produced the 13 episodes in 2016, directed by Yoshiharu Ashino, based on Katsura Hoshino's manga. Watch the original series first. It contains violence.

sekaiichi-hatsukoi-2.summary: The second season of The World's Greatest First Love continues straight from the first. Ritsu Onodera is now settling in as a shojo manga editor at Marukawa Publishing, where he works under Masamune Takano, the strict editor-in-chief who was also the older schoolmate Ritsu fell for in high school. Takano is still openly determined to win him back, and Ritsu keeps insisting he has no interest, even as work deadlines throw them together constantly. The season also returns to the other couples linked to the editorial department. Studio Deen produced the 12 episodes in 2011, adapting Shungiku Nakamura's boys' love manga. Watch the first season beforehand. It contains sexual content.

joukamachi-no-dandelion.summary: The Sakurada family lives in an ordinary house in a small town, but their father is the king, and each of his nine children has a special power. Over two thousand security cameras watch over the town to protect them, and their every move is broadcast on a dedicated news channel. All nine siblings are candidates for the throne, with the next ruler chosen by public election. Akane Sakurada, the timid third daughter who can control gravity, hates being watched, so she decides to run for king herself in order to get the cameras taken down. Production IMS adapted Ayumu Kasuga's four-panel manga into a 12-episode series in 2015. It is a light family comedy.

uchuu-patrol-luluco.summary: Luluco is a middle school girl living in Ogikubo, the only area on Earth where aliens are allowed to settle, and all she wants is a normal life. One morning her father, an officer in the Space Patrol, accidentally swallows a sleep capsule and is frozen solid, and Luluco breaks him on the way to get help. To pay for repairs, his boss Over Justice signs her up as a temporary Space Patrol officer tasked with cracking down on crime at her school. Her partner is Alpha Omega Nova, a transfer student and fellow officer. Studio Trigger produced the 13 short episodes in 2016, created and directed by Hiroyuki Imaishi. It is a fast, colourful comedy.

dragon-crisis.summary: Ryuji Kisaragi is an ordinary high school boy until his second cousin Eriko returns to town. Eriko drags Ryuji along on a visit to a black-market group, and the two end up making off with a sealed box. Inside is Rose, a young red dragon in the form of a girl, who immediately becomes attached to Ryuji. Ryuji decides to protect her, which brings them into conflict with criminal organisations and other dragons who want Rose for their own purposes. Studio Deen adapted Kaya Kizaki's light novels into a 12-episode series in 2011. It mixes romantic comedy and action and includes fan service.

gyakkyou-burai-kaiji-hakairoku-hen.summary: Kaiji: Against All Rules is the second season of the Kaiji anime. Kaiji Ito has fallen deeper into debt after his earlier ordeals and is again tempted by the chance of wiping it all out through high-stakes gambling with the powerful Teiai Group. This time he is forced into labour in a massive underground construction site, where workers earn almost nothing and freedom is a distant dream, and he is told it will take fifteen years to earn his way out. Kaiji's only hope is to save enough for a single day above ground and gamble on it. Madhouse produced the 26 episodes in 2011, directed by Yuzo Sato, adapting Nobuyuki Fukumoto's manga. It contains psychological cruelty.

now-and-then-here-and-there.summary: Shu Matsutani is an energetic schoolboy who never gives up, even after losing a kendo match. Perched on top of a factory chimney at dusk, he meets Lala-Ru, a quiet girl with a strange pendant, just before soldiers arrive to seize her. In trying to help, Shu is pulled into a desolate future world with a dying sun, where a fortress ruled by the unstable Hamdo kidnaps children to fight as soldiers. Shu's optimism is tested against cruelty he never imagined. AIC produced the 13-episode original series from 1999 to 2000; Akitaro Daichi created and directed it, and Hideyuki Kurata wrote the scripts. It contains violence, war crimes, child soldiers and sexual assault.

86-part-2.summary: 86 Part 2 is the second half of the anime adaptation of Asato Asato's light novels, continuing straight from the first part. In the Republic of San Magnolia, the Eighty-Six, a minority stripped of their rights, are forced to fight the Legion's autonomous war machines in drones, while Republic officers command them from a distance. Major Vladilena Milize, nicknamed Lena, keeps working as a Handler for new squadrons in defiance of the system. Meanwhile, Shinei Nouzen and his comrades from the Spearhead Squadron find themselves in a different country with new choices about what to fight for. A-1 Pictures produced the 12 episodes from 2021 to 2022. It contains war violence and death.

itsudatte-bokura-no-koi-wa-10-centi-datt.summary: Miou Aida is a quiet member of her high school art club; Haruki Serizawa is the outgoing star of the film club, already winning awards as a director. They became friends after meeting at the school entrance ceremony and have stayed close ever since, though their friends cannot understand why they have never become a couple. In their final year, with graduation and university plans approaching, both have to decide whether to say what they feel before their paths split. Lay-duce produced the six-episode series in 2017, part of HoneyWorks' Kokuhaku Jikko Iinkai love-song franchise, and it sits alongside the film I've Always Liked You. It is a gentle school romance.

kobato.summary: Kobato Hanato is a cheerful, naive girl with one goal: to reach a certain place she longs to go. To get there, she must fill a small bottle by easing the pain of people with wounded hearts, and each heart she heals adds a sweet-like fragment to it. Guiding her, often impatiently, is Ioryogi, a gruff spirit trapped in the body of a blue stuffed dog. Kobato takes a job at a struggling kindergarten, where she gets to know its kind young owner, Sayaka, and Kiyokazu Fujimoto, a sharp-tongued student who helps out there. Madhouse adapted CLAMP's manga into a 24-episode series from 2009 to 2010, directed by Mitsuyuki Masuhara. It is gentle and sentimental.

nabari-no-ou.summary: Miharu Rokujo is a fourteen-year-old who seems indifferent to almost everything. Hidden inside him is the Shinrabansho, a forbidden secret technique said to grant whoever controls it the power to rule Nabari, a concealed world of ninja clans that exists alongside ordinary society. His classmate Koichi Aizawa and Thobari Durandal Kumohira, who teaches him English, are both secretly ninja who have sworn to protect him, and after a run of attacks Miharu reluctantly joins their small group. Among those hunting him is Yoite, a quiet member of the Grey Wolves with a deadly technique of his own. J.C.Staff adapted Yuhki Kamatani's manga into a 26-episode series in 2008. It contains violence.

no-game-no-life-specials.summary: These six short specials were released on the Blu-ray and DVD volumes of No Game No Life in 2014. They are small comedy extras rather than new story: brief scenes featuring Sora and Shiro, the shut-in gamer siblings known as Blank, their companion Stephanie Dola and others from Disboard, a world where every dispute is settled by games. Each runs only a few minutes and leans on character banter and gags. Madhouse produced them alongside the 12-episode TV series, based on Yuu Kamiya's light novels. They are meant for viewers who have already watched the series. Like the main show, they include fan service.
no-game-no-life-specials.notes: MAL and AniList only describe these as short specials on the Blu-ray/DVD volumes; the summary keeps to that and the shared cast.

fate-extra-last-encore.summary: Inside the Moon Cell, a vast lunar supercomputer, the virtual Tsukumihara Academy serves as the stage for a Holy Grail War between Masters and their Servants. Hakuno Kishinami wakes up wounded with no memories in the academy, where unselected students are being purged, and through sheer refusal to die summons a Servant: Saber, a proud, flamboyant swordswoman. Together they climb the levels of the tournament, facing other Masters while Hakuno tries to understand why he is fighting at all. Shaft produced the series in 2018, with Akiyuki Shinbo as chief director, based on Type-Moon's game Fate/Extra. This Kitsu entry covers the first ten episodes. It contains violence.
fate-extra-last-encore.notes: MAL and Kitsu list 10 episodes; AniList counts 13 by including the later Illustrias Tendousetsu episodes.

oshiete-galko-chan.summary: Galko looks like a flashy gyaru, so classmates assume she is wild and experienced, but she is actually kind, sensible and easily embarrassed. Her best friends are Otako, a sarcastic, plain-looking manga fan, and Ojou, a refined, wealthy girl who tends to drift off. Together the three chat about topics that teenage girls are curious about but rarely discuss openly, especially rumours and myths about the female body, puberty and relationships. Each episode is a few minutes long and mostly made up of short conversations. feel. adapted Kenya Suzuki's manga into 12 short episodes in 2016. Its humour is frank and focused on bodies and sexuality, though it shows little explicitly.

inu-to-hasami-wa-tsukaiyou.summary: Kazuhito Harumi is a high school bookworm who lives for reading. During a robbery at a cafe, he is shot and killed while protecting a stranger, and he comes back to life as a long-haired dachshund. The stranger turns out to be Kirihime Natsuno, a popular novelist with a sadistic streak, and she adopts him, since she is the only person who can hear his thoughts. Kazuhito wants to solve the mystery of his death and read the unreleased novel he was waiting for, while Kirihime keeps him in line with a pair of scissors. Gonzo adapted Shunsuke Sarai's light novels into a 12-episode series in 2013. It is a comedy mystery with fan service.

berserk-ougon-jidaihen-ii-doldrey-kourya.summary: The Battle for Doldrey is the second film in the Berserk: The Golden Age Arc trilogy and continues straight from The Egg of the King. Guts is now one of the most valued fighters in the Band of the Hawk, the mercenary company led by the charismatic Griffith, and the Hawks are winning fame in the Kingdom of Midland's long war with the Tudor Empire. Their next task is one that has defeated every army before them: taking the fortress of Doldrey. Casca, Griffith's devoted second-in-command, also comes to the fore. Studio 4°C released the 2012 film, directed by Toshiyuki Kubooka and based on Kentaro Miura's manga. It contains graphic violence, sexual content and sexual violence.

basilisk-kouga-ninpou-chou.summary: In 1614, the Iga and Koga ninja clans have hated each other for centuries, held back only by a truce imposed by the Tokugawa shogunate. Gennosuke, heir of the Koga, and Oboro, heir of the Iga, are in love and hope their engagement will finally bring peace. Instead, the truce is lifted so the clans can settle a question of shogunal succession: ten elite ninja from each side, each with a bizarre and deadly power, must fight to the death. Gonzo adapted Masaki Segawa's manga, itself drawn from Futaro Yamada's 1958 novel The Kouga Ninja Scrolls, into a 24-episode series in 2005. It contains graphic violence, frequent deaths and sexual content.

utawarerumono.summary: A badly injured man is found in a forest by Eruruu, a young woman from a village whose people have animal ears and tails. He has no memory of who he is and wears a mask he cannot take off. Eruruu's grandmother takes him in, names him Hakuoro, and he settles into village life with Eruruu and her little sister Aruruu. The land, however, suffers under a harsh ruler, and when violence reaches the village, the people turn to Hakuoro to lead them, drawing him into a rebellion and wider war. OLM adapted Leaf's visual novel into a 26-episode series in 2006. It mixes slice-of-life with war drama. It contains battle violence.

arakawa-under-the-bridge-x-bridge.summary: The second season of Arakawa Under the Bridge continues directly from the first. Kou Ichinomiya, a rich young man raised never to owe anyone anything, still lives under a bridge on the banks of Tokyo's Arakawa River with his girlfriend Nino, who insists she is from Venus. The riverside community, run by a village chief in a kappa costume, is as eccentric as ever, and Kou, now nicknamed Recruit, keeps trying to apply his sensible logic to their absurd ways, while new residents and his father's interference complicate things. Shaft produced the 13 episodes in 2010, directed by Akiyuki Shinbo, based on Hikaru Nakamura's manga. It is a deadpan comedy.

shouwa-genroku-rakugo-shinjuu-sukeroku-f.summary: The second season of Showa Genroku Rakugo Shinju returns to the main storyline after the first season's long flashback. Yotaro, the former convict who became an apprentice to the great rakugo performer Yakumo, has now reached the top rank of shin'uchi and taken the name Sukeroku. Yet he still has not found a style of his own, caught between his master's polished performances and memories of the free-spirited original Sukeroku. Meanwhile, rakugo is losing popularity, and Yakumo, Yotaro and Konatsu each face the future of the art and their own past. Studio Deen produced the 12 episodes in 2017, based on Haruko Kumota's manga. Watch the first season before this one.

seiken-no-blacksmith.summary: Forty-four years after a devastating war ended, Cecily Campbell is a third-generation knight in the city of Housman, eager to live up to her family name despite her inexperience. After she is rescued from danger by Luke Ainsworth, a quiet and skilled blacksmith, she is impressed by the katana he forges and asks him to make one for her. Luke, assisted by the young girl Lisa, keeps refusing. As Cecily presses him, she becomes involved in plots that threaten the city and its fragile peace. Manglobe adapted Isao Miura's light novels into a 12-episode series in 2009, directed by Masamitsu Hidaka. It contains violence and fan service.

tenjou-tenge.summary: Souichiro Nagi and his best friend Bob Makihara arrive at Toudou Academy expecting to fight their way to the top of the school. They soon learn that Toudou was founded to revive Japanese martial arts, and their swagger is crushed by upperclassmen Maya Natsume and Masataka Takayanagi of the Juken Club. After a clash with the powerful Executive Council that controls the school, the two join the Juken Club, the last group standing against it, and begin learning real fighting techniques. Madhouse adapted the manga by Oh! great into a 24-episode series in 2004, directed by Toshifumi Kawase. It contains brutal fight violence, nudity and sexual assault themes.

divine-gate.summary: According to an old legend, the Divine Gate merged the realm of the living with heaven and the underworld, and whoever reaches it can change the past and future. People born with elemental powers after that union, called Adapters, are watched over by the World Council, which treats the legend as a myth and trains young Adapters at its academy. Aoto, a withdrawn boy with powerful water abilities and a painful past, refuses invitations to enrol until he is pushed into it by Midori, an upbeat wind user, and Akane, a stubborn fire user. Studio Pierrot produced the 12-episode series in 2016, directed by Noriyuki Abe, based on Acquire's mobile game. It contains violence and dark themes.

onegai-teacher.summary: Kei Kusanagi has a rare condition: under severe emotional stress he falls into a coma-like state called a standstill, and one such episode cost him three years, leaving him older than his classmates. One night by a lake he sees a strange glowing woman, who turns out to be Mizuho Kazami, an alien officer from a galactic federation stationed on Earth. The next day she appears at his school as his new homeroom teacher. When their connection is discovered, the two are pushed into a secret marriage that they must hide from his friends and her superiors. Studio Daume produced the 12-episode original series in 2002, directed by Yasunori Ide and written by Yosuke Kuroda. It includes fan service.

jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-part-6-stone-oc.summary: Stone Ocean adapts the sixth part of Hirohiko Araki's JoJo's Bizarre Adventure manga. In 2011, Jolyne Cujoh, the daughter of Jotaro Kujo, is framed for a crime and sentenced to fifteen years in Green Dolphin Street Prison in Florida. Brash and stubborn, she refuses to accept her fate, and after receiving a gift connected to her father she awakens a Stand of her own, Stone Free, which lets her unravel her body into string. She soon realises her imprisonment is part of a larger plot. David Production released this first batch of 12 episodes on Netflix in December 2021, part of a 38-episode season. It contains violence, gore and sexual content.
jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-part-6-stone-oc.notes: Kitsu entry covers the first 12 episodes released 1 December 2021; MAL lists it as an ONA.

hoshizora-e-kakaru-hashi.summary: Kazuma Hoshino moves with his younger brother Ayumu from the city to the rural town of Yamabiko, hoping the country air will help Ayumu's asthma. The brothers are to stay at a local inn while their parents arrange their new home. Their arrival goes wrong almost immediately: they take the wrong bus, a wild monkey steals Ayumu's hat, and Kazuma, lost in the woods chasing it, has an awkward first encounter with Ui, a spirited local girl. As they settle in, Kazuma gets to know a number of girls around town and school. Doga Kobo adapted Feng's adult visual novel into a 12-episode series in 2011, directed by Takenori Mihara. It is a romantic comedy with fan service.

sakigake-cromartie-koukou.summary: Takashi Kamiyama is a polite honour student who, through an odd chain of events, enrolls at Cromartie High School, a notorious school for delinquents. Rather than run, he decides to fit in and tries to become a model delinquent, approaching gang life with the same seriousness he gives his studies. His classmates are a strange collection: tough guys who are oddly sensitive, a silent man who looks like Freddie Mercury, an obvious robot named Mechazawa whom nobody calls a robot, and even a gorilla. The episodes are short and built on deadpan absurd humour and abrupt cuts. Production I.G adapted Eiji Nonaka's manga into a 26-episode series from 2003 to 2004.

tsuujou-kougeki-ga-zentai-kougeki-de-ni-.summary: Masato Oosuki is a teenager who finds his overly affectionate mother, Mamako, embarrassing. After filling in a puzzling online survey, he is transported inside a fantasy online game, ready to be the hero, only to find Mamako has come along as well. Worse still for his pride, she turns out to be the strongest member of the party, able to strike every enemy twice at once with her twin swords. The two set out to clear the game, recruiting the young merchant Porta and the sharp-tongued sage Wise. J.C.Staff adapted Dachima Inaka's light novels into a 12-episode series in 2019. It is a comedy about family relationships with fan service.

kokkoku.summary: Juri Yukawa is a young woman who has just failed yet another round of job interviews and lives with her struggling family: a mother who works, a laid-off father, a brother who never leaves home and a sister raising her small son Makoto alone. When Juri's brother and nephew are kidnapped and held for ransom, her grandfather reveals the family's secret: a stone that can stop time. Using it, Juri, her father and grandfather enter Stasis, a frozen world where only they can move, and race to rescue their family. They are not alone there, however. Geno Studio adapted Seita Horio's manga into a 12-episode series in 2018. It contains violence and disturbing scenes.

uchiage-hanabi-shita-kara-miru-ka-yoko-k.summary: On one summer day in the seaside town of Moshimo, Norimichi Shimada and his friends argue about whether fireworks look round or flat when seen from the side, and plan to settle it at that night's festival. Meanwhile Nazuna Oikawa, the classmate Norimichi likes, has troubles at home and secretly plans to run away, hoping someone will go with her. When her plan falls apart, a strange glass ball she found offers Norimichi a chance to change what happened. Shaft released the 2017 film, with Akiyuki Shinbo as chief director and Nobuyuki Takeuchi directing, adapted from a live-action TV drama by Shunji Iwai. It is a short summer romance.

made-in-abyss-retsujitsu-no-ougonkyou.summary: Season two of Made in Abyss follows Riko, the robot boy Reg and their companion Nanachi as they continue downward into the Abyss, a giant chasm full of strange creatures and relics where every ascent costs travellers dearly. Having earned the right to go further, they reach the sixth layer, known as the Capital of the Unreturned, where ruins of a fabled golden city lie. There they find a settlement populated by odd creatures called hollows, and the season also tells the story of an expedition that came the same way long before. Kinema Citrus produced the 12 episodes in 2022, adapting Akihito Tsukushi's manga. Watch the first season and film first. It contains graphic body horror and violence.

to-love-ru-ova.summary: These six To Love-Ru OVA episodes were released from 2009 to 2010 with limited editions of the manga. They are standalone comedies outside the TV plot, starring Rito Yuki, a shy high school boy, and Lala, the cheerful alien princess determined to marry him. In one, a gadget Lala invents to enlarge her chest accidentally turns Rito into a girl; another focuses on Rito's younger sister Mikan feeling left out. The rest of the cast from school and space also appear in slapstick situations. Xebec produced them, based on the manga by Saki Hasemi and Kentaro Yabuki. They are best watched after the TV series. They contain heavy fan service and nudity.

chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-lite.summary: Chuni-Shorts is a set of six short episodes of Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!, each about six minutes long, streamed on Kyoto Animation's official YouTube channel in 2012 around the launch of the TV series. They feature Yuta Togashi, a boy trying to forget his embarrassing past as a self-proclaimed dark hero, and Rikka Takanashi, the eyepatch-wearing girl who still believes she has magical powers, along with Dekomori, Nibutani and Kumin. The shorts are light comedy skits playing with the characters' delusions and everyday school life. Kyoto Animation produced them, based on Torako's light novels. They work as a sampler for the series or as extras for fans.

the-legend-of-korra-book-2-spirits.summary: Book 2 of The Legend of Korra begins six months after the first season. Mako now works as a police officer, Asami runs her family's company, Future Industries, and Bolin is struggling with a new pro-bending team. Korra, the Avatar, turns her attention to the Spirit World as a rare planetary alignment called Harmonic Convergence approaches, and looks to her uncle Unalaq, chief of the Northern Water Tribe, to learn about spirits, while her father Tonraq and her cousins Desna and Eska are drawn into events. She also learns about the first Avatar. The American series from creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko aired this 14-episode season on Nickelodeon in 2013. It contains action violence.
the-legend-of-korra-book-2-spirits.notes: American series with no MyAnimeList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia.

dramatical-murder.summary: Midorijima is a small Japanese island where the Toue corporation built Platinum Jail, a walled luxury resort for the very rich, and pushed the original islanders into the run-down Old Residential District. Young people there pass the time with two kinds of fighting: Rib, gang turf battles fought on the streets, and Rhyme, a virtual-reality combat game played with AI companions called All-Mates. Aoba Seragaki works at a junk shop, lives with his grandmother and his little dog-like All-Mate Ren, and wants nothing to do with either. Then he is dragged into a Rhyme match against his will, just as players begin to disappear. NAZ adapted Nitro+chiral's visual novel into 12 episodes in 2014.

bishoujo-senshi-sailor-moon-crystal.summary: Usagi Tsukino is a fourteen-year-old junior high student who cries easily, trips over her own feet and would rather eat sweets than study. Everything changes when Luna, a black cat with a golden crescent on her forehead, gives her a brooch that turns her into Sailor Moon, a warrior in a sailor-suit uniform. Luna wants her to track down her fellow Sailor Guardians, a lost princess and the Legendary Silver Crystal before the Dark Kingdom's Queen Beryl can claim its power. Toei Animation made this 26-episode series, streamed online worldwide from 2014 to 2015, and it follows Naoko Takeuchi's original manga much more closely than the 1990s anime.

aria-the-origination.summary: The third and final TV season of Aria returns to Neo-Venezia, a copy of Venice built on Aqua, the terraformed Mars of the 24th century. Akari, Aika and Alice are still apprentice undines, the gondoliers who row tourists along the city's canals, and each is drawing closer to the day she might be promoted to Prima. Their mentors from three rival companies, gentle Alicia, strict Akira and absent-minded Athena, keep passing on advice as the girls start to find their own styles as guides. As in earlier seasons, episodes are calm and unhurried, built around festivals, weather and small moments in the city. Hal Film Maker made its 13 episodes in 2008 from Kozue Amano's manga.

nurarihyon-no-mago-sennen-makyou.summary: The second season of Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan begins by looking back centuries, to when Rikuo's grandfather Nurarihyon, leader of a vast procession of yokai, fell for a human woman in Kyoto and ran into the menacing fox spirit Hagoromo-Gitsune. In the present day, Rikuo is a middle schooler with yokai blood who has accepted his place as the Nura Clan's future leader while keeping that side of himself hidden from his friends at school. When Hagoromo-Gitsune resurfaces and begins sweeping through Kyoto, Rikuo heads there with his followers to confront an enemy that has a long grudge against his family. Studio Deen made the 24 episodes in 2011 from Hiroshi Shiibashi's manga.

prince-of-tennis.summary: Ryoma Echizen is a gifted young tennis player who has already won junior championships and returns to Japan from America at his father's request. He enrolls at Seishun Academy, a middle school known for its strong boys' tennis club, where first-year students rarely get near the starting lineup. Ryoma is cocky and blunt, but he beats upperclassmen in the club's internal ranking matches and earns a place among the regulars. With him on the team, Seigaku sets out through the district, prefectural and Kanto tournaments in pursuit of the national title, facing rival schools that each play the game in their own way. Trans Arts animated 178 episodes from 2001 to 2005, adapting Takeshi Konomi's manga.

re-hamatora.summary: This second season picks up three months after a crisis in Yokohama. Hamatora is a small detective agency run out of Cafe Nowhere by Nice, one of the Minimum Holders, people born with special abilities that each work in their own peculiar way. Things have calmed down, and Nice's partner Murasaki has started taking cases with their assistant Hajime. Then an unexpected reunion puts Nice face to face with his old friend Art, and their relationship is suddenly on very uncertain footing. Re: Hamatora continues directly from the first season with the same mix of detective work, superpowers and fights. Lerche produced its 12 episodes in 2014 as part of an original mixed-media project. It contains violence.

uta-no-prince-sama-maji-love-1000.summary: Haruka Nanami grew up in the countryside and dreams of writing a song for her favourite idol. She wins a place at Saotome Academy, a performing-arts school whose top graduates can sign with the Shining Agency, and discovers it is a chaotic place: the teachers are working idols, the headmaster is an eccentric former star, and romance between students is strictly banned. Haruka is soon surrounded by talented, very different young men hoping to debut as singers, and writing music for them becomes her goal. A-1 Pictures adapted Broccoli's otome game into 13 episodes in 2011 as Maji Love 1000%, the first of four TV seasons of musical romantic comedy.

inari-konkon-koi-iroha.summary: Inari Fushimi is a shy, clumsy middle school girl in Kyoto who secretly likes her classmate Tanbabashi but is too timid to say so. One day she rescues a fox cub from a river near the local shrine, and the goddess Uka-no-Mitama-no-Kami, known as Uka, thanks her by giving her a piece of divine power. Now Inari can change her appearance into anyone she likes, which she hopes might help her love life, although the ability brings complications of its own. Along the way she becomes close friends with Uka, who knows little about ordinary human life. Production IMS adapted Morohe Yoshida's manga into 10 episodes in 2014, a gentle romantic comedy with a supernatural twist.

isekai-maou-to-shoukan-shoujo-no-dorei-m.summary: In this second season, shut-in gamer Takuma Sakamoto is still living inside the world of his favourite online game as Diablo, the overpowered demon-lord character he played, and still hides his social anxiety behind a theatrical villain act. Travelling through the forest with Rem and Shera, the two girls who summoned him, he rescues a ragged young woman being chased by a powerful paladin. She is Lumachina, a High Priest who believes Diablo is a god and wants his help cleaning up a corrupt church, and new companions join the party along the way. Tezuka Productions and Okuruto Noboru made the 10 episodes in 2021, based on Yukiya Murasaki's light novels. It contains frequent sexual fan service.

vampire-hunter-d-bloodlust.summary: In a distant future where vampire nobles still prey on frightened human settlements, young Charlotte Elbourne is carried off by the vampire lord Meier Link. Her wealthy family hires two rival parties to bring her back: the Marcus brothers, a ruthless gang of hunters, and D, a quiet, sword-carrying dhampir, the son of a human mother and a vampire father, whose left hand hosts a sarcastic talking parasite. The two sides race each other across a dangerous wasteland as Meier heads for the castle of Carmilla. Directed by Yoshiaki Kawajiri at Madhouse, the 2000 film is based on Demon Deathchase, the third novel in Hideyuki Kikuchi's Vampire Hunter D series. It contains graphic violence and gore.

macross-frontier.summary: Decades after humanity was almost wiped out in a war with the giant Zentradi, huge colony fleets carry people through space in search of new homes. On one of them, the Macross Frontier, Alto Saotome is a pilot-course student with a short temper and a flair for aerobatics. During a concert by the galactic pop star Sheryl Nome, insect-like aliens called the Vajra break through the fleet's defences, and Alto ends up in the cockpit of a fighter protecting Ranka Lee, a young girl caught in the chaos. His flying earns him an invitation to S.M.S., a private military company. Satelight made the 25-episode original series in 2008, mixing mecha dogfights, pop songs and a love triangle.

top-wo-nerae.summary: In the near future, as humanity takes its first steps beyond the solar system, it encounters an immense race of insect-like Space Monsters that seem determined to wipe people out. Earth answers with space battleships and giant robots crewed by young pilots drawn from schools across the globe. Noriko Takaya, whose father captained a ship lost in an early battle, enrols at the Okinawa Girls' Space Pilot High School even though her own piloting ability looks doubtful, and is paired with Kazumi Amano, the school's admired star pilot. Gainax released the six-episode original OVA in 1988 and 1989; directed by Hideaki Anno, it treats the time dilation of space travel seriously. It contains brief nudity.

zoku-owarimonogatari.summary: The morning after Koyomi Araragi's high school graduation, he looks into his bathroom mirror, reaches out, and watches his fingers sink straight into the glass. He comes to in a town where everything seems turned around: his sister Karen is suddenly short, the usually blank-faced Yotsugi Ononoki is bursting with emotion, and the ghost girl Mayoi Hachikuji has grown into an adult. Koyomi sets out to understand the rules of this reversed world and find his way back. Shaft adapted this chapter of NisiOisin's light novel series, the Koyomi Reverse arc; it premiered in Japanese cinemas in November 2018 and was then released as six episodes in 2019. It assumes viewers have seen the earlier Monogatari seasons.
zoku-owarimonogatari.notes: Kitsu entry is the 2018 theatrical release; MAL id 36999 lists the same content as the 6-episode 2019 version. Wikipedia has no standalone page, so the Monogatari series article is used.

qualidea-code.summary: Decades ago, beings known as the Unknown ripped open the sky and invaded, and Japan's children were sent into cold sleep to keep them safe. When they woke, many found they had gained supernatural abilities called Worlds. Now teenagers run the country's defence from three cities around Tokyo Bay: Tokyo is led by Ichiya Suzaku and Canaria Utara, Chiba by the siblings Kasumi and Asuha Chigusa, and Kanagawa by Maihime Tenkawa and Hotaru Rindo. The three cities hold off routine attacks but bicker endlessly with one another, and that rivalry becomes a real problem when the invaders step up their assaults. A-1 Pictures made the 12-episode original series in 2016 as part of a wider multimedia project.

tokyo-ghoul-pinto.summary: Some time before the main Tokyo Ghoul story, while he is still in high school, Shuu Tsukiyama is a refined and theatrical ghoul who treats eating people as fine dining. One night his long-awaited first bite is interrupted by a camera flash. The photographer is Chie Hori, an odd, unflappable girl from his own class, and her picture could expose what he is. Rather than silencing her, Shuu becomes curious, and the two begin an uneasy acquaintance as he promises her a better photograph than the one she already holds. Studio Pierrot released this single OVA in December 2015, adapting a story from Shin Towada's spin-off light novels based on Sui Ishida's manga. It contains gore and violence.
