charlotte-special.summary: This single extra episode is a side story to Charlotte, the original series about teenagers who develop strange, limited powers during adolescence. Yuu Otosaka and Nao Tomori of the Hoshinoumi Academy student council are still searching for young ability users before organisations that want to exploit them can step in. This time Takehito Kumagami's clairvoyance points them to Iori Sekiguchi, a girl who can read minds, and that makes simply getting close to her a real puzzle, since she always knows they are coming. P.A. Works released the special in March 2016 as a companion to the 13-episode TV series, which was created by Jun Maeda of the visual novel studio Key.

yozakura-quartet.summary: Sakurashin is a town where humans and yokai, beings who look mostly human but may have animal features and unusual abilities, live together under the protection of seven sacred trees. Keeping the peace is the job of the Hiizumi Life Counseling Office, run by teenager Akina Hiizumi, who has inherited the power of tuning, which sends harmful yokai back to their own world for good. He works alongside Hime Yarizakura, the town's sixteen-year-old mayor; Ao Nanami, a cat-eared telepath; and Kotoha Isone, a half-yokai who can summon objects simply by naming them. Nomad adapted Suzuhito Yasuda's manga into 12 episodes in 2008, a mix of small-town comedy and supernatural action.

pokemon-advanced-generation.summary: After competing in the Johto League, Ash Ketchum sets off for Hoenn, a new region with unfamiliar Pokémon to catch and new gyms to challenge, taking only Pikachu with him. He does not travel alone for long. May, a ten-year-old beginner trainer who mostly wants to see the world, joins him after Pikachu wrecks her bicycle, followed by her little brother Max and Ash's old friend Brock. On the road May discovers Pokémon Contests, competitions that reward style and showmanship rather than raw battling, while Ash works toward the Hoenn League and keeps running into Team Rocket. OLM produced the 192 episodes, based on the Pokémon video games, from 2002 to 2006.
pokemon-advanced-generation.notes: Wikipedia has no standalone article for this series; the main Pokémon TV series article is used.

shingetsutan-tsukihime.summary: Shiki Tohno was badly hurt as a child, and ever since he has seen strange lines running across people and objects; cutting along them destroys whatever they belong to, and only a special pair of glasses keeps them out of sight. After years living away with relatives, he is summoned back to the Tohno family mansion by his sister Akiha, now head of the household. At the same time a series of killings unsettles the town, and Shiki becomes entangled with Arcueid Brunestud, a mysterious vampire woman who wants his help. J.C.Staff adapted Type-Moon's visual novel into 12 episodes in 2003, a slow, moody supernatural mystery with a touch of romance. It contains violence.

midori-no-hibi.summary: Seiji Sawamura is the most feared delinquent at his high school, nicknamed Mad Dog for his fearsome right hand. That reputation scares girls away, and after being turned down twenty times he gloomily jokes that his right hand will have to be his girlfriend. The next morning, it is: his hand has been replaced by a tiny Midori Kasugano, a girl from another school who has quietly loved him for three years. Neither of them knows how it happened or how to undo it, so they keep the strange situation secret while learning to share every part of daily life. Studio Pierrot adapted Kazurou Inoue's manga into 13 episodes in 2004. It contains mild sexual humour and nudity.

mobile-suit-gundam-wing.summary: It is After Colony 195, and the space colonies orbiting Earth have spent decades under the heavy hand of the United Earth Sphere Alliance, and the colonies' leading voice for peace was assassinated long ago. Now rebels launch Operation Meteor, sending five advanced mobile suits called Gundams, each flown by a teenage pilot, down to Earth to strike at the Alliance and its secretive military organisation OZ. One pilot, a cold, single-minded boy who goes by the code name Heero Yuy, crashes into the sea after clashing with OZ's masked ace Zechs Marquise, and is found on the beach by Relena, a politician's daughter. Sunrise produced the 49 episodes from 1995 to 1996.

ghost-in-the-shell-stand-alone-complex-s.summary: Taking place in 2034, two years on from the second Stand Alone Complex season, this feature-length story finds Public Security Section 9 bigger than ever and led by Togusa, because Major Motoko Kusanagi has left the unit. The team is chasing a run of connected incidents, and the evidence keeps pointing to an elite hacker known only as the Puppeteer. Batou, who has been following the case on his own, unexpectedly runs into the Major, who tells him to keep away from something called the Solid State Society. Kenji Kamiyama directed this 2006 Production I.G television film, based on Masamune Shirow's manga, and it works best after both TV seasons. It contains violence.

gintama-porori-hen.summary: Gintama.: Slip Arc steps away from the series' heavy late-story battles and returns to what the Yorozuya, Gintoki Sakata's odd-jobs business in an alien-occupied Edo, mostly does: small jobs, bad ideas and parody. Its 13 episodes adapt comedy chapters of Hideaki Sorachi's manga that the anime had skipped, set before the Shogun Assassination Arc. Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura face problems such as Kagura's father, the space hunter Umibozu, storming back to Edo convinced his daughter has a boyfriend and blaming Gintoki for it. The stories are mostly standalone, packed with crude jokes, references to other anime and the odd sincere moment. Bandai Namco Pictures produced the season, which aired from October to December 2017.

kuroko-no-basket-saikou-no-present-desu.summary: This short bonus episode is set shortly after the Winter Cup, once the basketball season has wound down and everyone has gone back to ordinary school life. It is Tetsuya Kuroko's birthday, and Satsuki Momoi invites him and the five prodigies of the Generation of Miracles, his former teammates from Teiko Junior High, to get together for a casual game like in the old days. Meanwhile, Taiga Kagami and the rest of the Seirin team are quietly preparing a birthday party of their own. Production I.G released the special in December 2015, as an extra to its TV adaptation of Tadatoshi Fujimaki's manga. It is a light, celebratory story intended for viewers who have finished the series.

dantalian-no-shoka.summary: In England shortly after the First World War, Hugh Anthony Disward, known as Huey, inherits the manor and vast book collection of his late grandfather, a renowned collector. The will comes with a condition: he must also take charge of the Bibliotheca Mystica de Dantalian, a hidden library of forbidden knowledge. In the house he meets Dalian, a haughty, sharp-tongued girl who turns out to be the gateway to that library. Using the key he has been given, Huey becomes her keykeeper, and the two investigate incidents caused by Phantom Books, dangerous volumes that give terrible powers to the people who read them. Gainax adapted Gakuto Mikumo's light novels into 12 episodes in 2011. It contains some violence.

yozakura-quartet-hana-no-uta.summary: Rather than continuing the 2008 anime, Hana no Uta starts Yozakura Quartet afresh with the same voice cast and follows Suzuhito Yasuda's manga more closely. Sakurashin is a town where humans and yokai live together, watched over by seven sacred trees and by the Hiizumi Life Counseling Office. Its members are Hime Yarizakura, the town's young mayor; Ao Nanami, a satori who reads minds; Kotoha Isone, a half-yokai who summons objects by naming them; and director Akina Hiizumi, who can send yokai back to their own world. Besides odd jobs and disputes, they deal with Strikes, people who suddenly gain yokai powers and run wild. Tatsunoko Production made the 13 episodes in 2013.

love-live-sunshine.summary: Chika Takami is a second-year student at Uranohoshi Girls' High School, a small seaside school in Uchiura, Numazu, and has always considered herself completely ordinary. A trip to Tokyo introduces her to μ's, the famous school idol group, and convinces her that even a normal girl could shine on stage. Back home she sets out to form an idol group of her own, but student council president Dia Kurosawa refuses to approve the club, and recruiting members proves difficult. Her best hope is Riko Sakurauchi, a gifted pianist who has just transferred from Otonokizaka, the school μ's came from. Sunrise produced the 13 episodes in 2016 as part of the Love Live! multimedia franchise.

arifureta-shokugyou-de-sekai-saikyou-2.summary: The second season continues straight on from the first. Hajime Nagumo, the once-weak student who fought his way up from the depths of a labyrinth armed with guns, alchemy and a ruthless streak, has just helped his former classmates escape a dungeon. Now the healer Kaori Shirasaki joins his party alongside Yue, Shea and Tio, and they set out to take little Myuu home to her mother in Erisen while continuing to clear the great labyrinths, whose magic he needs to get back to Earth. Meanwhile, the hero party summoned with him prepares for an assault by the demon army. Asread and Studio Mother made the 12 episodes in 2022, based on Ryo Shirakome's light novels. It contains violence.

shinreigari-ghost-hound.summary: Suiten is a quiet, isolated town in Kyushu, and three boys there carry painful memories. Taro Komori was kidnapped as a small child and still has nightmares about it, while his schoolmates Makoto and Masayuki have troubled histories of their own. The three discover that they can slip out of their bodies and enter the Unseen World, a spirit realm lying alongside the ordinary one. Meanwhile, odd things are happening around town: a shrine priest's daughter has visions, and spirits appear to be crossing into the waking world. Production I.G made the 22-episode series in 2007 as its 20th-anniversary project, from an original concept by Masamune Shirow. It is a slow-paced psychological ghost story.

midara-na-ao-chan-wa-benkyou-ga-dekinai.summary: Ao Horie is a serious, hard-working high school student with one plan: study hard enough to escape to a school well away from home. The reason is her father, a well-known writer of erotic novels who even gave her a name she finds embarrassing. Ao keeps her distance from everyone so nobody connects her with him, until her easy-going classmate Takumi Kijima confesses that he likes her. Kijima's intentions are innocent, but Ao's imagination keeps running away with her, and his persistence makes studying almost impossible. Silver Link adapted Ren Kawahara's manga into 12 short episodes in 2019. It is a romantic comedy built on sexual innuendo and fan service.

nodame-cantabile-finale.summary: The third and final season of Nodame Cantabile stays in Paris, where both leads are now chasing professional careers. Shinichi Chiaki has become principal conductor of the struggling Roux-Marlet Orchestra and is starting to make his name, while Megumi 'Nodame' Noda keeps working at the piano at the Paris Conservatoire. As Chiaki's success grows, and as he spends time with the young star pianist Rui Son, Nodame starts to feel left behind and pushes to prove herself, against the advice of her teacher Professor Auclair. Friends such as Kuroki, Tanya and Yunlong face turning points of their own. J.C.Staff made the 11 episodes in 2010, completing its adaptation of Tomoko Ninomiya's manga.

nagato-yuki-chan-no-shoushitsu.summary: Spun off from the Haruhi Suzumiya franchise, this series is set in the alternate world from The Disappearance of Haruhi Suzumiya, where Yuki Nagato is not an alien observer but a shy, ordinary high school girl who loves books and video games. She is president of North High's Literature Club, which has only two other members: her protective best friend Ryoko Asakura and Kyon, the boy Yuki has a crush on. Club life gets livelier with visits from Mikuru Asahina and Tsuruya, and then from Haruhi Suzumiya, an energetic girl from another school, and her friend Itsuki Koizumi. Satelight adapted Puyo's manga into 16 episodes in 2015, a gentle romantic comedy.

spy-x-family-season-2.summary: The second season continues the cover story of the Forgers, a family in which nobody is quite what they seem. Loid is secretly Twilight, a master spy working to head off a war between two rival nations; his wife Yor secretly works as the assassin Thorn Princess; their adopted daughter Anya can read minds; and their dog Bond can glimpse the future. Loid needs Anya to do well at the elite Eden Academy so he can get close to his target, a reclusive politician. This season includes a long arc in which Yor takes a job aboard a luxury cruise ship. Wit Studio and CloverWorks made the 12 episodes in 2023, adapting Tatsuya Endo's manga.

fate-kaleid-liner-prisma-illya-2wei.summary: The second season of Prisma Illya, a magical-girl spin-off of Type-Moon's Fate/stay night, picks up after Illyasviel von Einzbern and her friend Miyu have finished collecting the Class Cards. Illya hopes for a quiet summer, but Rin Tohsaka and Luviagelita Edelfelt drag the two girls back to work: the strange disturbance in Fuyuki City's magical energy has not gone away. When Illya and Miyu try to fix it at its source, the spell goes wrong and splits off a dark-skinned double of Illya, who runs loose around town with plans of her own. Silver Link made the 10 episodes in 2014, based on Hiroshi Hiroyama's manga. It contains fan service.

d-n-angel.summary: Daisuke Niwa is a kind, clumsy middle schooler who decides to confess to his crush, Risa Harada, on his fourteenth birthday, and is turned down. That same day he discovers a family secret: whenever his heart races over the girl he loves, he transforms into Dark Mousy, a legendary phantom thief. His mother, who has known all along, is delighted and sends him out to steal valuable artworks, for reasons Daisuke does not understand. Meanwhile his quiet classmate Satoshi Hiwatari, who commands the police operation hunting Dark, seems to be carrying a strange burden of his own. Xebec adapted Yukiru Sugisaki's manga into 26 episodes in 2003, mixing romance, comedy and supernatural action.

yu-gi-oh-duel-monsters-gx.summary: Years after the original Yu-Gi-Oh!, the card game Duel Monsters has its own school: Duel Academy, an island academy founded by Seto Kaiba to train the next generation of duelists. Jaden Yuki, called Judai in Japanese, is a cheerful, reckless boy whose goal is to be crowned the next King of Games. He runs late to his entrance exam, meets a familiar figure who hands him a Winged Kuriboh card, and ends up in Slifer Red, the dormitory for the lowest-ranked students. From there he makes friends and rivals, takes on the elite Obelisk Blue students and faces stranger threats as the years pass. Studio Gallop produced the 180 episodes from 2004 to 2008, based on Kazuki Takahashi's Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise.

mushoku-tensei-isekai-ittara-honki-dasu-.summary: The first part of Mushoku Tensei's second season finds Rudeus Greyrat, a man reborn into a world of magic with his past life's memories, in a dark place. After the long journey home with Eris ends with her leaving him behind, he heads north alone, searching the frozen frontier for his missing mother and drifting through each day without purpose. Working as an adventurer, he falls in with a party called Counter Arrow, and the dangers of the North force him to start pulling himself together. Studio Bind made these 12 episodes in 2023, adapting Rifujin na Magonote's light novels; a second part followed in 2024. It contains violence and sexual content.

hourou-musuko.summary: Shuichi Nitori is a gentle fifth grader, assigned male at birth, who often gets mistaken for a girl and quietly wishes to be one. Her close friend Yoshino Takatsuki, a tall, boyish girl, feels just as uncomfortable being seen as female. They share this secret and find comfort in each other, but moving into middle school brings new classmates, shifting friendships, crushes and the changes of puberty. The story pays close attention to how family, classmates and friends react as the two try to understand who they are. AIC Classic adapted Takako Shimura's manga into 11 broadcast episodes in 2011, a quiet, carefully observed drama about gender identity and growing up.

granblue-fantasy-the-animation.summary: In a world of islands floating in an endless sky, a boy named Gran lives on the island of Zinkenstill with his small winged dragon companion Vyrn. One day an airship of the Erste Empire passes overhead, and Gran meets Lyria, a mysterious girl who has escaped from the Empire's control. To keep her out of its hands, the two set off into the skies, guided by a letter Gran's long-absent father left behind, which says he will be waiting at Estalucia, the Island of Stars. On the way they gather a crew, starting with Katalina, an imperial officer who fled alongside Lyria. A-1 Pictures made the 13 episodes in 2017, based on Cygames' role-playing game.

school-rumble-ni-gakki.summary: School Rumble's second season picks up right where the first ended, and the misunderstandings keep piling up. Tenma Tsukamoto still adores her impossible-to-read classmate Oji Karasuma, who still has no idea. Kenji Harima, the delinquent who is hopelessly in love with Tenma, still cannot get a confession out, especially while he is secretly drawing manga against deadlines with help from Tenma's younger sister Yakumo, which starts rumours that he and Yakumo are dating. Class rivalries, the cultural festival and plenty of absurd side plots fill out the rest. Studio Comet made the 26 episodes in 2006 from Jin Kobayashi's manga, a fast-paced romantic comedy built on running gags.

radiant.summary: In Radiant's world, monsters called Nemeses fall from the sky and destroy whatever they touch. People who survive contact with one become Sorcerers, able to wield magic but carrying an infection that makes ordinary people fear and shun them. Seth, a hot-headed young Sorcerer from Pompo Hills raised by his guardian Alma, dreams of becoming a great Nemesis hunter and sets out to find the Radiant, the legendary place the monsters are said to come from, hoping to wipe it out. On the road he meets fellow Sorcerers such as Mélie, a girl whose temperament flips without warning, and the researcher Doc. Lerche adapted Tony Valente's French comic into 21 episodes between 2018 and 2019; a second season came next.

wotaku-ni-koi-wa-muzukashii-ova.summary: These three original video animations are extra stories for Wotakoi, the comedy about office workers who are also otaku and are trying to date while hiding their hobbies. The first goes back to high school, when Taro Kabakura captained the boys' volleyball team and Hanako Koyanagi, who led the girls' side, forced him to hand over court time after catching proof of his secret otaku interests. The second looks at the friendship between Naoya Nifuji and Ko Sakuragi, and the third covers the company trip from the manga. A-1 Pictures and Lapin Track produced them, and they were released between 2019 and 2021 alongside volumes of Fujita's web manga.

flcl-progressive.summary: Years after the original FLCL, fourteen-year-old Hidomi Hibajiri drifts between school and her mother's cafe with her headphones permanently on, convinced nothing interesting will ever happen to her. Then a reckless new homeroom teacher shows up, a guitar-swinging woman going by Haruko, and before long a robot bursts into Hidomi's room together with her classmate Ko Ide, and something starts growing out of her forehead. Haruko seems much more interested in what lies inside Hidomi than in Hidomi herself. Production I.G and Signal.MD made the six episodes with Adult Swim, which premiered them on its Toonami block in 2018; in Japan they were screened as a film. Like the original, it is loud, chaotic and full of visual gags.
flcl-progressive.notes: Kitsu lists the six-episode TV run; MAL lists the Japanese theatrical version of the same content.

heavy-object.summary: In the future, wars are decided by Objects, colossal spherical weapons that conventional arms cannot seriously damage; whichever side brings the stronger Object wins, and ordinary soldiers have become little more than support crew. Qwenthur Barbotage, a student training to design Objects, and his friend Havia Winchell, a radar analyst from a noble family, serve in a Legitimate Kingdom maintenance battalion that looks after the Object Baby Magnum and its young elite pilot, Milinda Brantini. When a battle goes badly wrong, the two infantrymen end up facing an enemy Object with almost nothing and attempt something nobody believed possible. J.C.Staff adapted Kazuma Kamachi's light novels into 24 episodes from 2015 to 2016. It contains war violence.

tensura-nikki-tensei-shitara-slime-datta.summary: This comedy spin-off of That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime puts the battles aside and looks at everyday life in the Jura Tempest Federation, the monster nation built by Rimuru Tempest, a man reborn in another world as a slime. Between diplomacy and fighting, Rimuru and companions such as Benimaru, Shuna, Shion and the goblin chief Rigurd deal with chores and seasonal events: enlarging the fields under a blazing summer sun, holding festivals, playing games and shovelling snow in winter. Episodes are short, relaxed slice-of-life stories with no major threats. 8bit made the 12 episodes in 2021, adapting a spin-off manga based on Fuse's original novels.
tensura-nikki-tensei-shitara-slime-datta.notes: No standalone Wikipedia page; the TV series article covers this spin-off in its spin-off section.

zettai-karen-children-the-unlimited-hyou.summary: This original spin-off of Takashi Shiina's Zettai Karen Children manga moves the spotlight to the series' antagonist, Kyosuke Hyobu. Betrayed long ago by the people he served, Hyobu is now one of the strongest espers alive and a wanted fugitive who leads P.A.N.D.R.A., an underground group that rescues psychics from mistreatment by ordinary humans, by force when necessary. He looks cold and dangerous, but he is fiercely protective of the people who follow him, and he keeps his enormous power held back by a limiter. When P.A.N.D.R.A. itself comes under threat from a powerful new enemy, he may have to stop holding back. Manglobe made the 12 episodes, which aired in early 2013. It contains violence.

juuni-kokuki.summary: Yoko Nakajima is a timid, obedient high school girl in Japan who tries hard to please everyone and is picked on for her naturally red hair. One day a solemn, blond-haired man named Keiki walks into her classroom, kneels before her and declares that she is his master. Monsters attack moments later, and Yoko, along with two classmates, Asano and Sugimoto, is pulled into another world made up of twelve kingdoms whose rulers are chosen through the will of heaven. Separated from Keiki and lost in a dangerous land, Yoko has to survive and find out why she was brought there. Studio Pierrot adapted Fuyumi Ono's fantasy novels into 45 episodes, broadcast on NHK from 2002 to 2003.

mahouka-koukou-no-rettousei-raihousha-he.summary: The second season of The Irregular at Magic High School adapts the Visitor Arc. Tatsuya Shiba, a First High student whose poor practical grades hide extraordinary abilities, and his sister Miyuki say goodbye to their friend Shizuku, who is leaving on an exchange programme to the USNA. In her place arrives Angelina Kudou Shields, nicknamed Lina, a bright transfer student from America. At the same time, bodies drained of blood are turning up around Tokyo, the work of a so-called vampire, and the USNA is quietly trying to identify a frighteningly powerful magician. 8bit made the 13 episodes in 2020, adapting Tsutomu Sato's light novels.

gintama-shirogane-no-tamashii-hen-2.summary: The second part of the Silver Soul Arc, Gintama's final war, continues straight from the first. The Altana Liberation Army has been pushed out of Kabukicho for now, thanks to a nanomachine virus built by the inventor Gengai Hiraga that disables its weapons, but Gengai is kidnapped and that advantage is suddenly at risk. In orbit, the enemy flagship readies a weapon capable of destroying a planet, and Shinsuke Takasugi's Kiheitai force their way aboard to stop it. Gintoki and his allies have to fight on two fronts at once, in space and on the streets of Edo, with jokes squeezed in between. Bandai Namco Pictures made the 14 episodes in 2018 from Hideaki Sorachi's manga. It contains violence.

overlord-iv.summary: The fourth season continues the story of Ainz Ooal Gown, the undead sorcerer who was once an ordinary player stuck inside a fantasy game world and now rules the newly founded Sorcerer Kingdom. Its capital, E-Rantel, used to be a thriving trading city, but merchants and residents are wary of their monstrous king and supplies are running short, so Ainz sends Albedo to handle the city's diplomacy. Meanwhile, the Slane Theocracy and the Baharuth Empire argue over how to deal with the danger he represents, and the Re-Estize Kingdom remains in his way. Madhouse made the 13 episodes in 2022 from Kugane Maruyama's light novels. It contains graphic violence.

eyeshield-21.summary: Sena Kobayakawa is a small, timid first-year at Deimon High who has spent years running errands for bullies, and all that dodging through crowds has made him astonishingly fast. Yoichi Hiruma, the scheming, devilish captain of the school's tiny American football team, the Deimon Devil Bats, spots that speed and pushes Sena into playing running back. To keep other clubs from poaching him, Hiruma hides Sena's identity behind a tinted visor and the mysterious name Eyeshield 21. With barely enough players to field a team, the Devil Bats set their sights on the Christmas Bowl, the national high school championship game. Studio Gallop adapted Riichiro Inagaki and Yusuke Murata's manga into 145 episodes from 2005 to 2008.

trinity-blood.summary: Long after a catastrophic war called Armageddon, humans share a ruined world with vampires, who call themselves Methuselah and have their own New Human Empire, while humans, whom the vampires call Terrans, look to the Vatican for protection. To deal with vampire-related trouble, Cardinal Caterina Sforza's AX unit at the Vatican sends out agents such as Abel Nightroad, a lanky, clumsy, permanently broke travelling priest. Abel hides a startling secret: he is a Crusnik, a being that feeds on the blood of vampires. Together with a young girl named Esther, he finds himself facing extremists who want to reignite the war. Gonzo adapted Sunao Yoshida's light novels into 24 episodes in 2005. It contains violence.

pokemon-celebi-toki-wo-koeta-deai.summary: Forty years in the past, a boy named Sammy who likes to sketch Pokémon protects the Mythical Pokémon Celebi from a hunter in a Johto forest, and Celebi's power to travel through time carries them both away. They arrive in the present day, where Ash, Misty and Brock happen to be visiting the same forest, and the group sets off to bring the injured Celebi to a lake with healing waters. A ruthless Team Rocket agent called the Iron-Masked Marauder is also hunting Celebi, and Jessie, James and Meowth are never far behind. Directed by Kunihiko Yuyama and animated by OLM, the film was released in Japan in July 2001 as the fourth Pokémon feature.

dragon-ball-kai-2014.summary: The Final Chapters is the remastered, tightened retelling of the Majin Buu saga, the last story arc of Dragon Ball Z, trimmed to follow Akira Toriyama's manga more closely. Years after the battle with Cell, Gohan is a teenager at a city high school, where he meets Videl, while his little brother Goten trains with Vegeta's son Trunks. Goku, who has been living in the afterlife, is allowed to return to Earth for one day to enter a martial arts tournament, but the event draws a mysterious pair intent on reviving an ancient magical creature called Majin Buu. Toei Animation produced it from 2014 to 2015; Japan aired 61 episodes, while the international version runs to 69.

dragon-ball-z-movie-08-moetsukiro-nessen.summary: In the eighth Dragon Ball Z film, a Saiyan named Paragus tracks down Vegeta and invites him to rule as king of a newly founded Saiyan world, New Vegeta. Paragus says a so-called Legendary Super Saiyan is tearing through the southern galaxy and only Vegeta can stop him. Vegeta agrees, and Goku and his friends, who have been looking into the destruction themselves, follow him to the new planet. There they meet Paragus's quiet son, Broly, and start to suspect that Paragus has not told them everything. Directed by Shigeyasu Yamauchi for Toei Animation, the film was released in March 1993 and is based on characters from Akira Toriyama's manga. It contains martial arts violence.

mobile-suit-gundam-seed.summary: In Cosmic Era 71, humanity is split between Naturals, ordinary humans mostly living on Earth, and Coordinators, people genetically enhanced before birth, many of whom live in space colonies, and the two sides are at war. Kira Yamato, a Coordinator studying at a technical college on the neutral colony Heliopolis, is caught up in the conflict when ZAFT, the Coordinators' military, raids the colony to steal five new Earth Alliance mobile suits. With four of them taken, Kira ends up flying the last, the Strike Gundam, to protect his friends, and discovers that his childhood friend Athrun Zala is one of the attackers. Sunrise made the 50 episodes from 2002 to 2003. It contains war violence.

osake-wa-fuufu-ni-natte-kara.summary: Chisato Mizusawa is a 28-year-old office worker who seems composed and serious at work and acts as though she does not care for alcohol. At home it is a different story. Her husband Sora, a part-time bartender who takes care of the cooking and housework, mixes her a cocktail each evening, and after a glass or two Chisato becomes playful and affectionate, a side of her that only he gets to see. Each short episode centres on a particular drink, from Irish coffee to fruity mixes, while the couple enjoy a relaxed evening together. Creators in Pack adapted Crystal na Yosuke's web manga into 13 short episodes in 2017, a light, sweet comedy about married life.

fate-grand-order-first-order.summary: It is 2015, and the Chaldea Security Organization monitors humanity's future through a mix of magic and science and has confirmed that civilisation will last at least another century. Then that future suddenly vanishes from its observations, and the end of the human race is predicted. The cause traces back to the city of Fuyuki in 2004, so Chaldea uses an experimental time-travel technique called Rayshift to send newly arrived recruit Ritsuka Fujimaru and the quiet girl Mash Kyrielight into the past to find out what went wrong. Lay-duce produced this television special, which aired on New Year's Eve 2016 and adapts the prologue of the mobile game Fate/Grand Order. It contains fantasy violence.

tales-of-zestiria-the-x-2.summary: The second half of Tales of Zestiria the X continues Sorey's journey. Raised among the seraphim, spirits that most humans cannot see, Sorey became the Shepherd after pulling a sacred sword from a stone, which gave him the power to purify Hellions, creatures that appear when people and animals are overtaken by a dark force called malevolence. Travelling with his seraph friend Mikleo and a growing band of companions, including the knight princess Alisha and the outspoken Rose, he heads deeper into a world strained by war and corruption while tracing where the spreading malevolence comes from. ufotable made these 13 episodes, aired from January to April 2017, based on Bandai Namco's role-playing game.

kino-no-tabi-the-beautiful-world-the-ani.summary: Kino is a young traveller who travels from country to country on Hermes, a motorcycle that can talk, spending only three days in each so there is always more of the world left to see. Every place has its own odd customs, laws or history, some gentle and some cruel, and Kino observes them with polite detachment while keeping two handguns close for protection. Most episodes are self-contained stories, and a few follow other wanderers on the road, such as the skilled swordsman Shizu. Lerche produced this 12-episode series in 2017, a new adaptation of Keiichi Sigsawa's light novels made separately from the 2003 anime. It contains violence and some disturbing themes.

doukyonin-wa-hiza-tokidoki-atama-no-ue.summary: At 23, mystery novelist Subaru Mikazuki would far rather stay home with his books than deal with people, and since losing his parents he has lived almost entirely alone. While visiting their grave, he comes across a small stray cat and, partly hoping she might inspire his next novel, takes her home and names her Haru. Neither is used to living with anyone: Subaru barely knows how to look after himself, let alone a pet, while Haru, hardened by life on the streets, decides this helpless human needs her protection. Episodes often show the same events twice, once from Subaru's side and once from Haru's. Zero-G adapted Minatsuki and Asu Futatsuya's manga into 12 episodes in 2019.

dragon-ball-z-movie-15.summary: Earth is at peace until Sorbet, commander of what is left of Frieza's army, arrives with his aide Tagoma and forces the Pilaf Gang to hand over the Dragon Balls. Using the eternal dragon Shenron, they bring Frieza back to life, and the tyrant, still furious at the Saiyans who defeated him, decides to train for the first time in his life before taking his revenge. With Goku and Vegeta away training on the god Beerus's planet, Earth's other fighters, including Gohan, Piccolo and Krillin, have to hold the line as Frieza's forces close in. Toei Animation released the film in April 2015, with a story written by series creator Akira Toriyama. It contains martial arts violence.

lucky-star-ova.summary: This single original video animation brings back the girls of Lucky Star for six short, unconnected stories, several of them stranger than anything in the TV series. Konata, the lazy otaku; the twins Kagami and Tsukasa; and the polite, well-off Miyuki carry on in their usual chatty way, while other segments get more surreal: in one, the girls and their teacher Nanako Kuroi play together inside an online role-playing game, and in another Kagami has an embarrassing dream about Konata. Like the TV series, it relies on small talk, pop-culture references and gentle absurdity rather than plot. Kyoto Animation released it in September 2008, after the 24-episode series adapting Kagami Yoshimizu's four-panel comic.

acca-13-ku-kansatsu-ka.summary: The Kingdom of Dowa is divided into thirteen self-governing districts, and for almost a century the peace has been kept by ACCA, a huge national organisation that runs public services across all of them. Jean Otus is the laid-back second-in-command of ACCA's inspection department, nicknamed 'Jean the cigarette peddler' because he is rarely seen without a cigarette. His job takes him on audit trips to each district's branch, where he quietly checks for wrongdoing. But rumours of a planned coup are spreading, and Jean finds himself watched by people on all sides. Madhouse adapted Natsume Ono's manga into 12 episodes in 2017, a slow-burning political mystery.

ao-no-kanata-no-four-rhythm.summary: On a group of four islands south of Japan, anti-gravity shoes called Grav-Shoes let anyone fly, and they have given rise to a popular sport, Flying Circus, in which players score by touching floating buoys or the back of their opponent in mid-air. Asuka Kurashina, a cheerful, rather naive transfer student at Kunahama High School, shows an instinct for flight on her very first try and ends up joining the school's Flying Circus club. Her coach is classmate Masaya Hinata, a former player who quit the sport after a crushing defeat, and teaching her slowly reawakens his own love of the game. Gonzo adapted the visual novel by sprite into 12 episodes in 2016.

yumekui-merry.summary: High school student Yumeji Fujiwara can sense the aura of other people's dreams and guess what they will dream about next, a trick he mostly uses to amuse his classmates. Lately, though, his own nights have been strange, and one afternoon the dream world spills over into the waking one. A dream demon wants to use his body as a vessel to cross into reality, and he is rescued by Merry Nightmare, a girl from the dream world who has somehow ended up stranded in the real one without a host and simply wants to go home. Yumeji decides to help her. J.C.Staff adapted Yoshitaka Ushiki's manga into 13 episodes in 2011, mixing action and comedy.

kore-wa-zombie-desu-ka-ova.summary: These two original video animations are set in the gap between the two TV seasons of Is This a Zombie?, the comedy about Ayumu Aikawa, a high schooler brought back to life as a zombie who also ends up as a frilly-dressed magical 'masou' warrior. Standalone stories follow his chaotic household: Haruna, the self-proclaimed genius magical girl, is put in charge of a shrine festival in spring; the vampire ninja Seraphim tries her hand at cooking; Haruna takes the necromancer Eucliwood to a swimming pool and plans her birthday party; and a school card contest pushes Ayumu to his limits. Studio Deen made them, bundled with volumes of Shinichi Kimura's light novels from 2011 to 2012. They contain fan service.

initial-d-second-stage.summary: After his first string of wins in the mountain passes of Gunma, Takumi Fujiwara, the quiet teenager who learned to drive by delivering tofu for his father, has become street racing's newest name, driving the family's ageing Toyota AE86. Second Stage brings a new kind of challenge: Emperor, a team that races only four-wheel-drive Mitsubishi Lancer Evolutions and makes a point of beating local teams. Its arrogant leader, Kyoichi Sudo, dismisses the AE86 as an outdated machine, and Takumi's unbeaten record is suddenly at risk. Pastel produced the 13 episodes from 1999 to 2000, adapting Shuichi Shigeno's manga about downhill street racing.

ghost-in-the-shell-2-0.summary: This is Mamoru Oshii's 2008 reworking of his 1995 film rather than a new story. In 2029, people with cybernetic bodies and brains wired into the network are everywhere, and Major Motoko Kusanagi of the government's elite Section 9 hunts high-tech criminals. Her team is pursuing the Puppet Master, a mysterious hacker able to rewrite the memories of the people it infiltrates. For this version, Production I.G replaced several scenes with new 3D CG animation, adjusted the colour palette, re-recorded the voices and remixed the sound; it was released in 2008 to tie in with Oshii's The Sky Crawlers. It is based on Masamune Shirow's manga. It contains violence and brief nudity.
ghost-in-the-shell-2-0.notes: Not a compilation of TV episodes but a remastered and partly re-animated version of the 1995 film, so it is summarised. Wikipedia covers it within the 1995 film article.

mahou-shoujo-ikusei-keikaku.summary: In N-City, a free mobile game called Magical Girl Raising Project is rumoured to turn a lucky few players into real magical girls. Koyuki Himekawa, who has always dreamed of becoming one, is chosen and transforms into her avatar, Snow White, joining fifteen other magical girls who quietly help people around town. Then the game's administrators announce that sixteen is too many: each week, the girl with the fewest Magical Candies, earned through good deeds, will lose her powers. The cheerful competition soon turns into something much darker. Lerche adapted Asari Endou's light novels into 12 episodes in 2016. It contains graphic violence, gore and disturbing deaths.

mobile-suit-gundam-00-second-season.summary: Four years after Celestial Being's war against the world's united forces, the new Earth Sphere Federation has created the A-Laws, an independent peacekeeping force that stands above the regular army and stamps out dissent in the name of unity. Setsuna F. Seiei, a Gundam pilot who survived the last conflict, has watched the world grow more oppressive and decides Celestial Being must return. Meanwhile Saji Crossroad, a young civilian now working as a space engineer, is dragged back into the fighting, while Louise Halevy, the girl he once loved, now flies mobile suits for the A-Laws. Sunrise produced the 25 episodes from 2008 to 2009, directed by Seiji Mizushima. It contains war violence.

mashiroiro-symphony-the-color-of-lovers.summary: Two private schools are about to merge: the exclusive Yuihime Girls' Academy and the co-educational Kagamidai Academy. To test the waters, a handful of Kagamidai students, including easy-going Shingo Uryu, are sent ahead to a trial class on the Yuihime campus, where many of the girls want nothing to do with boys. Shingo, who lives with his younger stepsister Sakuno, tries to make the arrangement work and quickly befriends several of his new classmates, but Airi Sena, the principal's proud and stubborn daughter, refuses to accept him or any of the other boys. Manglobe adapted Palette's adult visual novel into a 12-episode romance in 2011. It contains mild nudity.

amagami-ss-plus.summary: This sequel to Amagami SS revisits Junichi Tachibana and each of the girls from the first series, showing what happens after their separate love stories were resolved. As before, the season is split into short arcs, one for each heroine, and each arc stands on its own. Tsukasa Ayatsuji, the seemingly perfect class representative, enters the race to lead the student council; Junichi's childhood friend Rihoko Sakurai is running the tea club with him; Ai Nanasaki wonders what will happen once he leaves for university; and Kaoru Tanamachi, Sae Nakata and Haruka Morishima get new chapters too, while Junichi's little sister Miya keeps scheming in the background. AIC made the 13 episodes in 2012, based on Enterbrain's dating game.

karin.summary: Karin Maaka belongs to a vampire family hiding in plain sight in modern Japan, but she is the odd one out: instead of needing to drink blood, her body produces far too much of it. Every so often she has to bite someone and inject the surplus, or else suffer huge nosebleeds, and her 'victims' wake up oddly cheerful. Karin tries hard to live as an ordinary high school girl, until a new classmate, Kenta Usui, transfers in and her blood starts surging whenever he is near. Worse, he stumbles onto her secret. J.C.Staff adapted Yuna Kagesaki's manga, known in English as Chibi Vampire, into 24 episodes from 2005 to 2006, a romantic comedy with a supernatural twist.

tejina-senpai.summary: At Tanenashi High, every student has to join a club, so an unmotivated first-year boy goes looking for the one that will ask the least of him. He wanders into the magic club's room and finds an older girl practising tricks. She loves stage magic but has terrible stage fright: with even a single person watching, her tricks tend to fall apart, often in embarrassing or revealing ways. Before he quite realises it, he has become a member of the club and her reluctant audience and assistant. Most episodes are short skits built around her latest trick going wrong. LIDENFILMS adapted Azu's manga into 12 short episodes in 2019. It contains frequent fan service.

gekkan-shoujo-nozaki-kun-specials.summary: These six short extras were bundled with the Blu-ray and DVD volumes of Monthly Girls' Nozaki-kun, the comedy about Chiyo Sakura, a high school girl who confesses her feelings to her tall, oblivious classmate Umetaro Nozaki and somehow ends up as an assistant on the shojo romance manga he secretly draws under a pen name. Each special runs about three minutes and adds a quick extra gag featuring the cast, including Nozaki's friends Mikoshiba, Kashima and Hori, in the same deadpan style as the TV series. Doga Kobo produced them between 2014 and 2015 alongside its TV adaptation of Izumi Tsubaki's manga. They are intended for viewers who have already seen the series.
gekkan-shoujo-nozaki-kun-specials.notes: MAL and AniList give no per-episode plots for these mini-specials, so the summary describes the format and the parent series.

samurai-jack.summary: A young prince from feudal Japan sees the shapeshifting demon Aku conquer his father's kingdom and spends his childhood travelling the world to train his body and mind. Returning as a master samurai with his father's magic sword, he challenges Aku, but just before the decisive blow the demon hurls him far into the future, to an Earth that Aku now rules. Taking the name Jack, the samurai wanders this strange world of robots, aliens and bounty hunters, helping the people he meets and searching for a route home to the past. The original American series ran for four seasons, 52 episodes in all, from 2001 to 2004. It contains stylised action violence.
samurai-jack.notes: American series with no MyAnimeList or AniList entry; sources are Wikipedia and Kitsu. Kitsu's entry covers the original four seasons (2001-2004), not the 2017 fifth season.

denpa-kyoushi-tv.summary: Junichiro Kagami had physics papers published in leading journals at seventeen, but after university he turned his back on science and now spends his days unemployed, running an anime blog and doing only what he truly 'yearns to do'. His sister Suzune, fed up with his lifestyle, forces him to take a job as a physics teacher at Ichou Academy, the private high school she attends. Junichiro has no intention of teaching in the usual way, but his odd methods and otaku knowledge turn out to help students with problems no textbook covers. A-1 Pictures adapted Takeshi Azuma's manga into 24 episodes in 2015, an upbeat school comedy.

zoku-sayonara-zetsubou-sensei.summary: The second season of Sayonara, Zetsubou-Sensei brings back Nozomu Itoshiki, a high school teacher so pessimistic that he finds despair in absolutely everything. His class is full of oddballs: Kafuka Fuura, a girl so relentlessly upbeat that she reinterprets every disaster as something cheerful; Matoi Tsunetsuki, who follows him everywhere; Kaere Kimura, a returnee with two personalities; and Chiri Kitsu, a perfectionist who cannot stand anything left untidy. Each episode takes a social habit or trend and spins it into rapid-fire satire, crammed with background jokes, on-screen text and Taisho-era styling. Shaft made the 13 episodes in 2008 from Koji Kumeta's manga. It contains dark humour about suicide and other mature themes.

seitokai-yakuindomo-ova.summary: These eight original video animations extend Seitokai Yakuindomo, the comedy about Takatoshi Tsuda, one of the few boys at a former girls' school that has just gone co-ed. He is vice president of a student council whose president, Shino Amakusa, and treasurer, Aria Shichijo, make dirty jokes at every opportunity, leaving him to play the exasperated straight man. The OVAs keep the same rapid-fire gag style; across them Takatoshi starts his second year and his younger sister Kotomi enrols as a first-year with a curiosity that matches the council's. GoHands produced them between 2011 and 2013 as follow-ups to its 2010 TV adaptation of Tozen Ujiie's four-panel manga. They are built almost entirely on sexual innuendo.

hunter-x-hunter-phantom-rouge.summary: Kurapika, the last known survivor of the Kurta Clan, whose eyes turn scarlet when they feel strong emotion, has been looking into rumours that another member of his clan is still alive. Following the lead with Leorio, he meets a boy he recognises as his childhood friend Pairo, who attacks him and steals his eyes. Gon and Killua rush to help, and through visions seen by his stolen eyes, Kurapika glimpses a man marked with the spider tattoo of the Phantom Troupe, the thieves who wiped out his people. The four set out to track down Pairo and recover the eyes. Madhouse produced this 2013 film, based on Yoshihiro Togashi's manga, with an original story. It contains violence.

bishoujo-senshi-sailor-moon-s.summary: Sailor Moon's third TV season opens with Rei, Sailor Mars, troubled by visions of a coming catastrophe called the Silence. The villains this time, the Death Busters, are hunting for three Talismans hidden inside the pure hearts of certain people, which together can summon the legendary Holy Grail. Usagi and her friends soon learn they are not the only ones searching: two mysterious new Guardians, Sailor Uranus and Sailor Neptune, want the Talismans too and have no interest in working with Sailor Moon. Toei Animation made the 38 episodes from 1994 to 1995, directed by Kunihiko Ikuhara, adapting the Infinity arc of Naoko Takeuchi's manga.

sakura-quest.summary: Yoshino Koharu has just finished college and is desperate to work in Tokyo, but after a long string of job rejections, she accepts what looks like an easy one-day gig: playing 'queen' for a tourism campaign in Manoyama, a fading rural town. When she arrives, she discovers she was hired by mistake, mixed up with someone more famous, and that the contract actually lasts a year. With little choice, she takes the crown and joins the local tourism board, working with four other young women from very different backgrounds to bring visitors back to a town most people have forgotten. P.A. Works produced the 25-episode original series in 2017.

free-dive-to-the-future.summary: In the third season of Free!, Haruka Nanase has moved to Tokyo to study at Hidaka University and continue swimming at a higher level. There he unexpectedly meets Asahi Shiina, a teammate from his middle school days, and soon reconnects with others from that old team, all except Ikuya Kirishima, who still resents how their team broke apart. Haruka resolves to repair the friendship, even if it means rethinking the way he swims, all while facing far stronger swimmers as he aims for the international stage. Kyoto Animation and Animation Do made the 12 episodes in 2018.

kimi-ga-nozomu-eien.summary: Takayuki Narumi is an easy-going high school student who spends his time with his friends Mitsuki Hayase, a lively competitive swimmer, and Shinji Taira. Mitsuki's shy best friend, Haruka Suzumiya, has been in love with Takayuki for a long time, and when she finally confesses, he says yes, while Mitsuki quietly realises her own feelings. Then a sudden tragedy turns all of their lives upside down, and the series follows the painful aftermath years later. Studio Fantasia adapted âge's adult visual novel into 14 episodes from 2003 to 2004, a slow, heavy romantic drama. It contains sexual content and emotionally distressing themes.

free-take-your-marks.summary: Set between Free!: Eternal Summer and Dive to the Future, this special is made up of four short stories about the last summer before the swimmers scatter. Haruka Nanase and Makoto Tachibana search Tokyo for an apartment for Haruka; Aiichiro Nitori and Momotaro Mikoshiba take Rin Matsuoka and Sosuke Yamazaki on a hot-spring trip as a graduation present; Nagisa Hazuki, Rei Ryugazaki and Gou Matsuoka try to make a recruitment video for Iwatobi's swim club; and both swim clubs plan a surprise send-off for Rin before he leaves for Australia. Kyoto Animation and Animation Do released it in Japanese cinemas in October 2017. It is a light, low-stakes companion piece for viewers who know the series.
free-take-your-marks.notes: Kitsu lists it as four specials; MAL lists the same content as a single theatrical film. Both are the same release.

dr-stone-new-world.summary: The first half of Dr. Stone's third season continues the story of Senku Ishigami, the young scientist rebuilding civilisation thousands of years after a mysterious light turned humanity to stone. With the ambitious sailor and heir Ryusui Nanami now on board, Senku's Kingdom of Science is close to finishing a ship that can cross the ocean toward the place where the petrifying light came from. The last preparations include reviving a talented cook to feed the crew and building navigation tools from scratch, until a strange message from an unknown source raises the stakes. TMS Entertainment made these 11 episodes in 2023, adapting Riichiro Inagaki and Boichi's manga; a second part followed later that year.

castlevania-season-2.summary: The second season of Netflix's Castlevania picks up as Dracula, grieving his murdered wife, gathers a war council of vampire generals and human servants in his castle to wipe out humanity in Wallachia. Among them are Hector and Isaac, two human Forgemasters who can raise and command night creatures, and the ambitious vampire Carmilla, who has plans of her own. Trevor Belmont, the last of a disgraced family of monster hunters, Sypha Belnades, a magic-wielding Speaker scholar, and Alucard, Dracula's half-human son, look for a way to reach Dracula's castle and end the war. This eight-episode second season of the American adaptation of the Castlevania video games was released in October 2018. It contains graphic violence and gore.
castlevania-season-2.notes: American Netflix series with no MyAnimeList or AniList entry; sources are Wikipedia and Kitsu.

sengoku-basara.summary: In the Sengoku period, Japan's warlords battle endlessly for control of the country, and Nobunaga Oda, the merciless Demon King of Owari, is closing in on total victory. Two young generals stand out among those who refuse to bow to him: Masamune Date, the cocky One-Eyed Dragon of Oshu who fights with six swords, and Yukimura Sanada, the fiery spear-wielding retainer of Shingen Takeda. The two become intense rivals as soon as they meet, but the growing threat from Nobunaga pushes them and the other warlords toward an uneasy alliance. Production I.G made the 12 episodes in 2009, based on Capcom's action game series, with deliberately over-the-top battles. It contains violence.

freezing-vibration.summary: The second season of Freezing returns to a war against the Nova, alien invaders fought by Pandoras, genetically enhanced young women, and their male partners, Limiters. Satellizer el Bridget, a cold, powerful Pandora, and her Limiter Kazuya Aoi travel with Rana Linchen and others to the Chevalier's base in Alaska, where Pandoras from around the world have gathered for the unveiling of the E-Pandora Project, a plan to give ordinary people Pandora abilities. As the project goes forward, the Pandoras start to suspect that something about it is badly wrong. A.C.G.T. made the 12 episodes in 2013 from Dall-Young Lim and Kwang-Hyun Kim's manga. It contains graphic violence and heavy sexual fan service.

bishoujo-senshi-sailor-moon-r.summary: Sailor Moon's second TV season finds Usagi Tsukino and her friends living ordinary lives with no memory of being Sailor Guardians, until new enemies force their powers and memories back. The first 13 episodes form a self-contained story about two aliens, Ail and An, who drain energy from people to feed the strange tree their lives depend on. After that, a little girl named Chibiusa drops out of the sky, claiming she needs the Silver Crystal, just as the Black Moon Clan arrives from the future with designs of its own on it. Toei Animation made the 43 episodes from 1993 to 1994, with the Black Moon arc adapting Naoko Takeuchi's manga.

cencoroll.summary: A huge, shapeless monster suddenly appears over a Japanese city, and while the army and the public panic, a curious schoolgirl named Yuki has stumbled on a related secret. Her classmate Tetsu has been quietly keeping a creature called Cenco, a soft, shapeshifting being he can control by thought and which can turn itself into almost anything, from a bicycle to something far larger. Yuki is far more interested in Cenco than in Tetsu himself. Then Shu, a stranger who controls a similar creature, takes an unwelcome interest in Cenco, and a fight breaks out. Manga artist Atsuya Uki wrote, designed, directed and animated this short film almost single-handedly; it premiered in 2009.

denki-gai-no-honya-san.summary: Umanohone is a manga and doujinshi shop in a bustling electronics district, and its staff are a close-knit crew of fans who all go by nicknames. Umio is a gentle, rather awkward young man; Hiotan, his slightly older senior on the floor, is clumsy and earnest; and around them are coworkers such as Sensei, a clerk who is also an aspiring manga artist, and the teasing Kantoku, along with the steady stream of devoted customers who keep things interesting. Episodes mix gag comedy with small, sincere moments about work, friendship and unspoken crushes. Shin-Ei Animation adapted Asato Mizu's manga into 12 episodes in 2014.

dungeon-ni-deai-wo-motomeru-no-wa-machig.summary: This single OVA is set just after the events on the dungeon's eighteenth floor in DanMachi's first season. On their way back up to Orario, Bell Cranel, the goddess Hestia, Lilly and their companions are knocked off course while fighting hellhounds and stumble into an uncharted part of the dungeon with a natural hot spring. After everything they have been through, the group decides to take a break and relax in the water, helped along by the god Hermes, who has somehow brought swimsuits for everyone. It soon becomes clear that the spring is hiding something. J.C.Staff released the episode in December 2016, based on Fujino Omori's light novels. It is a fan-service comedy episode.

the-devil-is-a-part-timer-2.summary: The second season returns to Sadao Maou, who was once Satan, the Demon Lord of the world of Ente Isla, until the hero Emilia drove him through a portal to modern Tokyo. Now he works hard at a fast-food restaurant, supports Alciel and Lucifer, his one-time generals, in a cramped apartment, and argues constantly with Emi Yusa, the hero living under a human name. In the middle of one of their quarrels, a portal opens and delivers a strange apple, out of which comes a toddler named Alas Ramus, who immediately decides that Maou and Emi are her parents. Studio 3Hz made the 12 episodes in 2022, based on Satoshi Wagahara's light novels.

garo-honoo-no-kokuin.summary: In the Valiante Kingdom, a land resembling Spain during the Inquisition, the king's adviser launches brutal witch hunts against the Makai Knights and Alchemists, the secret guardians who protect people from Horrors, demons that feed on human darkness. Leon Luis was born as his mother was being burned at the stake and was rescued by his father German, a Makai Knight. Years later, Leon has inherited the golden armour of Garo, but his anger over his mother's death runs deep. Meanwhile Prince Alfonso, driven from the throne, sets out to find the legendary Golden Knight. MAPPA made the 24 episodes from 2014 to 2015, part of Keita Amemiya's Garo franchise. It contains graphic violence and some sexual content.

deadman-wonderland-ova.summary: This single OVA is a prequel to Deadman Wonderland, set two years after a catastrophic earthquake and tidal wave devastated Tokyo. Kiyomasa Senji is a police officer with a Branch of Sin, the power to shape his own blood into a weapon, and he uses it to stop criminals in whatever way works, rules or not. When he saves young Izuru Tsukiyoshi from the violent gang Goreless Peace, his feud with them quickly turns explosive. The story shows who Senji was before he became an inmate at the Deadman Wonderland prison. Manglobe made the episode, released in October 2011 with a volume of Jinsei Kataoka and Kazuma Kondou's manga. It contains graphic violence and gore.
deadman-wonderland-ova.notes: The Wikipedia article covers the franchise and does not describe this OVA; OVA details come from MAL and AniList.

danshi-koukousei-no-nichijou-specials.summary: These six bonus episodes were released with the home video volumes of the deadpan comedy Daily Lives of High School Boys, which follows Tadakuni, Hidenori, Yoshitake and the other students of an all-boys high school. Like the TV series, each one is a collection of quick sketches about the absurd situations the boys create for themselves, with titles such as High School Boys and Hiccups, High School Boys and Zippers and High School Boys and Tricks. The humour comes from overthinking small things, pointless role-playing and misunderstandings with the girls from the nearby school. Sunrise produced them, released between April and September 2012, alongside its 12-episode adaptation of Yasunobu Yamauchi's web manga.

toaru-majutsu-no-index-endymion-no-kisek.summary: Academy City, a city of science where students develop psychic powers, is about to finish Endymion, a space elevator that can carry people into orbit without rockets. Toma Kamijo, a high schooler whose right hand cancels any supernatural power it touches, and Index, a young nun who has memorised a library of forbidden magic books, meet Arisa Meigo, a cheerful singer with no psychic ability and a hazy past. Soon magicians are attacking the city to get to Arisa, and Stiyl Magnus warns Toma that she may be the key to a clash between the worlds of magic and science. J.C.Staff produced the 2013 film from an original story by Kazuma Kamachi. It contains violence.

triage-x.summary: Behind the respectable front of Mochizuki General Hospital operates Black Label, a secret vigilante team that treats criminals beyond the law's reach as cancers to be cut out of society. Its members include hospital staff and students from the nearby high school. Arashi Mikami, a quiet teenager, survived a terrorist bombing that killed his best friend, and he lives thanks to organ transplants and the surgeon who saved him, the hospital's director. Now he works as one of Black Label's assassins, alongside a team of heavily armed young women, taking on arms dealers, corrupt officials and gangsters. Xebec adapted Shouji Sato's manga into 10 episodes in 2015. It contains graphic violence and heavy sexual fan service.

rwby.summary: On the world of Remnant, humanity survives against the Grimm, shadowy monsters drawn to negative emotion, thanks to Dust, a natural energy source that fuels weapons and magic, and to trained warriors called Huntsmen and Huntresses. Ruby Rose, an eager young fighter, enrols at Beacon Academy in the kingdom of Vale, where she is grouped with Weiss Schnee, Blake Belladonna and Yang Xiao Long into a four-girl team named after their initials. Each has her own signature weapon and fighting style, and the team must learn to work together while training, making friends and dealing with trouble in the city. Monty Oum created the American web series; this first volume premiered in 2013 as 16 short chapters.
rwby.notes: American web series with no MyAnimeList or AniList entry for this volume; sources are Wikipedia and Kitsu. Kitsu's entry is Volume 1 (2013).

beatless.summary: In 2105, humanoid robots called hIEs handle much of the work in Japanese society, and most people treat them as appliances. Arato Endo, a kind-hearted high school student, sees them more like people, though he cannot afford one himself. One night he is attacked by a hacked hIE and left close to death, until he is saved by Lacia, an unusual hIE carrying a weaponised coffin, one of five advanced models that have just escaped from a research company. When a hijacked car then bears down on them, Lacia offers him a deal: become her owner, and she will save his life. Diomedéa adapted the novel into 20 broadcast episodes in 2018, with four more following as Final Stage.

angel-s-egg.summary: In a dark, flooded city that seems almost empty, a young girl wanders alone, carrying a large egg she believes will hatch into an angel and collecting water in glass jars. Strange things happen around her: enormous machines roll past with no one inside, and silent fishermen hurl harpoons at the shadows of giant fish that are not there. One day she meets a young man carrying a cross-shaped weapon, who becomes curious about the egg, and the two walk through the ruins together. There is almost no dialogue, and the story is told through slow, symbolic imagery full of biblical references. Mamoru Oshii wrote and directed this 1985 OVA film with artist Yoshitaka Amano; Studio Deen produced the animation.

uchuu-senkan-yamato-2199.summary: In 2199, Earth has been ravaged by planet bombs from the alien Gamilas Empire, its surface poisoned, and the survivors live in underground cities that have perhaps a year left. Then a message arrives from Iscandar, a planet across the galaxy, offering a device that can restore Earth if someone travels there to collect it. Earth pours its last resources into the Yamato, a battleship fitted with a revolutionary Wave Motion Engine, and young officers such as Susumu Kodai and Daisuke Shima join its crew under Captain Okita for the long voyage. Xebec and AIC made this 26-episode remake of the 1974 series, first screened in cinemas from 2012 to 2013. It contains war violence.

heaven-s-lost-property-the-movie-the-ang.summary: This film from the Heaven's Lost Property series centres on Hiyori Kazane, a gentle girl from a farming family who has secretly liked Tomoki Sakurai for a long time. The opening part briefly retells the earlier TV seasons from her point of view: how Tomoki, a boy who only wanted a peaceful life, ended up living with Ikaros and other Angeloids, androids who fell from the sky. Then Hiyori finally decides to get closer to him by joining his New World Discovery Club, despite Tomoki's attempts to scare her off with ridiculous initiation tests. AIC ASTA produced the 2011 film, based on an arc of Suu Minazuki's manga. It contains heavy sexual humour and fan service.
heaven-s-lost-property-the-movie-the-ang.notes: Includes a short recap of the TV seasons but tells a new story, so it is not a compilation film.

astarotte-no-omocha.summary: In the magical realm of Alfheim, succubi must take in the 'life essence' of men to survive, so royal succubi keep harems. Ten-year-old Princess Astarotte, known as Lotte, refuses: bad experiences with the men of her mother’s harem left her hating them. Her attendants find a compromise in the human world, Naoya Tohara, a 23-year-old who seems gentle enough for Lotte to tolerate. Naoya agrees to join her court on one condition: he brings his young daughter Asuha with him. As Lotte grudgingly adjusts to the pair, she starts to realise how lonely her royal life has been. Diomedéa adapted Yui Haga's manga into 12 episodes in 2011. It contains sexual humour and fan service involving young characters.

boku-no-hero-scademia-the-movie-world-he.summary: Tabidachi ('Departure') is a five-minute bonus short linked to the film My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission, in which pro heroes and students from Japan travel abroad to deal with an international crisis. The short follows Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo and Shoto Todoroki, the three U.A. High students who take part in the mission, as they run into the winged pro hero Hawks in an airport terminal before setting off. It adapts the side chapter 'Hawks: SOOTHE' from Kohei Horikoshi's booklet given to cinema audiences. Bones produced it; it was screened briefly with the film in Japan in January 2022 and released on the film's Plus Ultra Blu-ray and DVD edition in February.
boku-no-hero-scademia-the-movie-world-he.notes: The Wikipedia article for the film describes this short in its home media section.

nisekoi-ova.summary: These three original video animations add extra episodes to Nisekoi, the romantic comedy about Raku Ichijo, heir to a yakuza family, who has to pretend to date Chitoge Kirisaki, the hot-tempered daughter of a rival gang's boss, to keep the peace between their families, while he still treasures a promise made to a girl years ago. Each OVA adapts two standalone comedy chapters of Naoshi Komi's manga featuring Raku, Chitoge, the shy Kosaki Onodera, the bodyguard Seishiro Tsugumi and the self-proclaimed fiancée Marika Tachibana, in the same light, teasing style as the TV series. Shaft produced them, bundled with volumes 14, 16 and 17 of the manga and released from 2014 to 2015.

yuyushiki.summary: Yuzuko Nonohara, Yukari Hinata and Yui Ichii are three close friends starting high school together. Yuzuko is quick and silly, Yukari is sweet and spacey, and Yui is the level-headed one who keeps reacting to the other two. Looking for a club, they find the Data Processing Club, which has no members and is about to be closed, and sign up. In practice, club time mostly means looking things up online and then talking about them: odd words, food debates, little games and running jokes, with their homeroom teacher, the club adviser, keeping a patient eye on them. Kinema Citrus adapted the four-panel manga into 12 episodes in 2013, a gentle, dialogue-driven comedy.

uq-holder.summary: Set generations after Negima! in the same world, where magic has become public knowledge, UQ Holder! follows Tota Konoe, a boy living quietly in the countryside with his friends and his teacher Yukihime, who dreams of heading to the capital and climbing Amanomihashira, a giant orbital elevator reaching into space. When a bounty hunter targeting Yukihime leaves Tota mortally wounded, she saves him by turning him into an immortal vampire. Tota leaves home with her and discovers UQ Holder, a secret society of immortals that she leads, where he finds new friends, rivals and dangerous enemies. J.C.Staff adapted Ken Akamatsu's manga into 12 episodes in 2017. It contains violence and fan service.

boku-wa-tomodachi-ga-sukunai-episode-0.summary: Episode 0 is an eleven-minute bonus episode of Haganai, released a few weeks before the TV series began. The series follows Kodaka Hasegawa, a transfer student whose naturally blond hair makes everyone assume he is a delinquent, and Yozora Mikazuki, a sharp-tongued loner he catches chatting with her imaginary friend. Realising neither has any real friends, they start the Neighbours Club, supposedly a place to practise making some, which soon attracts other socially hopeless students such as the wealthy, self-absorbed Sena Kashiwazaki. The short episode offers a quick taste of the club's bickering and comedy. AIC Build produced it, bundled with the seventh volume of Yomi Hirasaka's light novels in September 2011.
boku-wa-tomodachi-ga-sukunai-episode-0.notes: Sources describe this OVA's format and release rather than its plot, so the summary focuses on the premise it shares with the TV series.

brothers-conflict.summary: Ema Hinata has grown up with only her father, an adventurer who is rarely home, and has often felt lonely. When he remarries Miwa Asahina, a successful fashion designer, Ema gives the newlyweds some space and moves into the Sunrise Residence, the apartment building where Miwa's sons live, along with her talking pet squirrel, Juli. She discovers she now has thirteen stepbrothers, from a grown doctor and a monk to a pop idol and a young boy. She hoped for a warm family, but several of the brothers soon show feelings for her that are not exactly brotherly, and Juli is convinced they are all wolves. Brain's Base adapted the novel series into 12 episodes in 2013.

xxxholic-kei.summary: The second season of xxxHolic continues the story of Kimihiro Watanuki, a high school student who has always been able to see spirits and is plagued by them. He still works at a strange shop run by the witch Yuko Ichihara, who grants wishes for anyone who finds the shop, always for a price of equal value, and who has promised to rid Watanuki of his ability once he has worked enough to pay for it. Between cooking and cleaning for the demanding Yuko, he helps her troubled clients alongside his classmates Doumeki and Himawari. As the season goes on, truths about his own everyday life begin to surface. Production I.G made the 13 episodes in 2008 from CLAMP's manga.

clockwork-planet.summary: A thousand years ago the Earth died, and a mysterious genius known only as Y rebuilt the entire planet out of gears and clockwork. Naoto Miura is a high school student in Grid Kyoto who loves machines and can understand any mechanism just by listening to it. One day a crate crashes through the roof of his apartment, and inside is RyuZU, a beautiful automaton built by Y himself that no one has managed to repair for over two centuries. Naoto fixes her, and soon he crosses paths with Marie Bell Breguet, a gifted clockmaker, and her cyborg bodyguard Halter as a crisis looms. Xebec adapted Yuu Kamiya and Tsubaki Himana's light novels into 12 episodes in 2017.

tsugumomo.summary: Tsukumogami are objects that, after many years of use, gain a soul. Kazuya Kagami is an ordinary middle schooler who always carries the obi, a kimono sash, that belonged to his late mother. When he is nearly killed by an amasogi, a malicious spirit born from someone's selfish wish, the obi springs to life as Kiriha, a beautiful, proud tsukumogami in a kimono, who greets him as though they have met before. Kazuya is soon drawn into a world of local gods, spirits and exorcism, with Kiriha training him and moving in with him, to the great confusion of his sister. Zero-G adapted Yoshikazu Hamada's manga into 12 episodes in 2017. It contains frequent sexual fan service.

medaka-box-abnormal.summary: The second season of Medaka Box picks up right after the first, with Hakoniwa Academy's student council, led by the absurdly talented Medaka Kurokami, enjoying a brief moment of peace. It does not last. The council learns of the Flask Plan, a secret project backed by the school's chairman to turn ordinary students into superhumans known as Abnormals. Before they can deal with it, Medaka, her childhood friend Zenkichi Hitoyoshi and the other council members have to face the Thirteen Party, a group of powerful Abnormal students led by the arrogant Oudo Miyakonojou. Gainax made the 12 episodes in 2012 from Nisio Isin and Akira Akatsuki's manga, moving the story firmly into superpowered battles. It contains violence and fan service.

baby-steps.summary: Eiichiro Maruo is a straight-A first-year in high school with meticulous notebooks and a strict routine, but he realises he is badly out of shape and that studying is something he does from habit rather than enjoyment. Hoping to get some exercise, he signs up for a trial at the Southern Tennis Club, where he meets Natsu Takasaki, a classmate who loves tennis and dreams of turning pro. With no experience and little stamina, Ei approaches the game the way he approaches school: he takes detailed notes on every shot and opponent, then trains relentlessly to improve. Studio Pierrot adapted Hikaru Katsuki's manga into 25 episodes in 2014; a second season followed in 2015.

rahxephon.summary: Ayato Kamina is a 17-year-old high school student in Tokyo who likes to paint. One day the city is attacked by strange aircraft, and in the chaos he meets Haruka Shitow, an agent of an organisation called TERRA, who tells him that Tokyo has been sealed off from the rest of the world for years inside a barrier known as Tokyo Jupiter, where time runs differently. Shaken, Ayato runs and follows his classmate Reika Mishima to a mysterious shrine, where he finds himself bound to the RahXephon, an ancient giant robot. Bones animated the 26-episode original series in 2002, created and directed by Yutaka Izubuchi. It is a slow-burning, music-themed mecha mystery.

goblin-slayer-goblins-crown.summary: Goblin Slayer, the grim adventurer who hunts nothing but goblins, has become well known among the guild's adventurers. Then the Sword Maiden passes on a request: find the Noble Fencer, a young noblewoman and adventurer who vanished on a goblin-hunting mission in the snowy northern mountains. He sets out with his party, the Priestess, the High Elf Archer, the Dwarf Shaman and the Lizard Priest, and soon notices that the goblins up north are behaving with unusual organisation. The trail leads to an ancient fortress buried in snow. White Fox produced the 2020 film, based on Kumo Kagyu's light novels. It contains graphic violence, gore and references to sexual assault.

hal.summary: In a quiet Japanese town, Kurumi has shut herself away after her boyfriend Hal was killed in a plane crash. Hoping to help her, her grandfather arranges for Q01, a humanoid robot, to take on Hal's appearance and visit her. At first she wants nothing to do with this copy, but the robot keeps returning day after day, patiently trying to coax her out of her grief and back into the life of the town. Little by little, Kurumi begins to open up. Wit Studio produced the hour-long original film, released in 2013, directed by Ryotaro Makihara with character designs by Io Sakisaka.

ikkitousen.summary: Seven high schools across Kanto are locked in constant street fights for supremacy. Many of their fighters carry magatama, comma-shaped jewels that tie their fates to famous warriors of China's Three Kingdoms era. Hakufu Sonsaku, a cheerful, airheaded girl with remarkable martial arts talent, transfers to Nanyo Academy and moves in with her cousin Koukin Shuuyu, whom her mother has asked to protect her. Hakufu's fate echoes that of the warlord Sun Ce, a destiny that marks her as a target, and when she is pushed too far, a frightening, uncontrolled power takes over. J.C.Staff adapted Yuji Shiozaki's manga into 13 episodes in 2003. It contains graphic violence and frequent nudity.

tate-no-yuusha-no-nariagari-3.summary: Season three picks up with Naofumi Iwatani, the young man summoned to another world as its Shield Hero, just after he has helped fend off the latest wave of disaster. Queen Mirelia informs him that the other three Cardinal Heroes, wielders of the sword, spear and bow, have vanished, and asks him to find them. With no leads, Naofumi first turns to a more immediate problem: the trade in demi-human slaves. He and his companions, including Raphtalia and Filo, travel to Zeltoble, a nation of mercenaries where that trade thrives, hunting for ways to raise money to buy their freedom. Kinema Citrus made the 12 episodes in 2023, based on Aneko Yusagi's light novels.

nanatsu-no-taizai-fundo-no-shinpan.summary: Released in English as Dragon's Judgement, this is the last season of the anime and takes the knights into the final stage of their war with the Demon Clan. Time is running out for Elizabeth, the princess bound to Meliodas by a curse that will soon kill her, so the Sins split up across Britannia. Meliodas and Ban head into the Demon Realm to confront Meliodas's father, the Demon King, while Merlin, Escanor and the archangel Ludociel go after his brother Zeldris, and King, Diane, Gowther and the talking pig Hawk set out to rescue Elizabeth. Studio Deen and Marvy Jack made the 24 episodes in 2021 from Nakaba Suzuki's manga. It contains violence.

hitori-no-shita-the-outcast.summary: Zhang Chulan is an ordinary university student until he returns to his home village and finds that his grandfather's grave has been broken into. In the cemetery he is attacked by jiangshi, hopping corpses, and is saved by Feng Baobao, a strange, sword-carrying girl who seems to know more about his family than he does. It turns out his grandfather secretly trained him in qi techniques, and that hidden practitioners with similar powers exist all over China. Soon Chulan is pulled into their world, along with a company that monitors them. Pandanium made the 12 episodes in 2016 as a Chinese-Japanese co-production based on Dong Man Tang and Mi Er's webcomic Under One Person. It contains violence.

jigoku-shoujo-futakomori.summary: The second season of Hell Girl continues its premise: at midnight, people consumed by a grudge can visit a website called Hell Correspondence and summon Ai Enma, the Hell Girl.
