She hands them a straw doll; pulling its red string will send their tormentor straight to Hell, but in exchange their own soul will go to Hell when they die. Each episode is mostly a standalone story of a different grudge. This season introduces Kikuri, a strange little girl who appears around Ai and her helpers, and a story arc about Takuma Kurebayashi, a boy the townspeople blame for the disappearances happening around him. Studio Deen made the 26 episodes from 2006 to 2007. It contains violence and disturbing themes.

aa-megami-sama-tv.summary: Keiichi Morisato is a kind-hearted but chronically unlucky engineering student. Left alone to mind his dormitory, he tries to phone a senior and instead reaches the Goddess Help Line, and moments later a beautiful goddess named Belldandy steps out of his mirror and offers to grant him one wish. Thinking it is a joke, he asks for a goddess like her to stay with him forever, and the wish is binding. Since women are not allowed in the boys' dorm, the two are thrown out and end up living at a Buddhist temple, where their slow, shy romance begins, soon complicated by Belldandy's sisters. AIC made the 24 episodes in 2005, adapting Kosuke Fujishima's manga.

hakuouki.summary: In 1864, Chizuru Yukimura travels to Kyoto disguised as a young man, searching for her father, a doctor who has stopped writing home. On her first night in the city she is attacked by ronin and then witnesses something worse: white-haired men in a murderous frenzy, cut down by members of the Shinsengumi, the shogunate's special police force. Having seen what she should not have, Chizuru is taken back to their headquarters while they decide what to do with her. When they learn who her father is, the Shinsengumi, who are looking for him as well, keep her close. Studio Deen adapted Idea Factory's otome game into 12 episodes in 2010. It contains graphic violence.

final-fantasy-vii-advent-children-comple.summary: Advent Children Complete is the 2009 extended cut of the 2005 film Advent Children, which takes place two years on from the game Final Fantasy VII. Cloud Strife now runs a delivery service and lives near Tifa Lockhart's bar with two children she looks after, but he has been pulling away from everyone. A mysterious disease called Geostigma is spreading, and a trio of silver-haired young men led by Kadaj begins kidnapping infected children while searching for something they call Mother. This version adds roughly 26 minutes of fresh or lengthened footage, revises many shots and gives more time to Denzel and to the Geostigma. Tetsuya Nomura directed it for Square Enix. It contains action violence.
final-fantasy-vii-advent-children-comple.notes: An extended re-edit of the 2005 film with new footage, not a compilation of TV episodes.

date-a-live-encore-ova.summary: This single OVA is a side story for Date A Live, the series in which high schooler Shido Itsuka must win over Spirits, powerful girls from another world, by dating them so that their powers can be sealed. During the Tanabata summer festival he unexpectedly runs into Kurumi Tokisaki, the unpredictable Spirit nicknamed the Worst Spirit, who asks him out. Nervous, Shido spends the day with her at a planetarium, at festival stalls and even at a mock wedding ceremony, while Tohka, Yoshino and his sister Kotori search for him. Along the way he sees a gentler side of Kurumi. It came out in December 2014 packaged with volume three of Koushi Tachibana's Date A Live Encore short stories.
date-a-live-encore-ova.notes: MAL credits Production IMS and AniList credits AIC Plus+, so no studio is named.

k-on-keikaku.summary: This special episode of K-On!!, the second season of the comedy about the light music club at Sakuragaoka Girls' High School, was included with the ninth Blu-ray and DVD volume. With summer break nearly over, Yui Hirasawa and her Houkago Tea Time bandmates hope to fit in one more trip, which leads to a long debate over where they should go. When they decide to go abroad, they realise they need passports first, and a simple trip to the government office to apply turns into a whole day's adventure. Like the TV series, it is a relaxed slice-of-life story about friendship, snacks and small comic moments. Kyoto Animation released it in March 2011, based on Kakifly's four-panel manga.

junjou-romantica-3.summary: The third season of Junjo Romantica returns to its three couples. Misaki Takahashi, now a university student, has lived with the famous novelist Akihiko 'Usagi' Usami for three years, and while things are going well, a new rival makes Usagi anxious about Misaki's feelings. Publishing executive Ryuichiro Isaka has troubles of his own with his partner and secretary, Kaoru Asahina, who insists on keeping work and private life apart. The season also follows Professor Hiroki Kamijou and Nowaki Kusama of the Egoist storyline, and literature professor Yo Miyagi with his younger lover Shinobu Takatsuki of the Terrorist storyline. Studio Deen made the 12 episodes in 2015 from Shungiku Nakamura's boys' love manga. It contains sexual situations between adult men.

needless.summary: Decades after a devastating Third World War, part of Japan is sealed off as the Black Spot, a contaminated wasteland whose residents were left to fend for themselves. Exposure has given some of them strange powers called Fragments, and these mutants are known as Needless. The Black Spot is controlled by Simeon, a powerful corporation with its own army of Needless, and standing against it is Adam Blade, a brash, foul-mouthed fake priest with huge strength and remarkable healing. Adam and the allies he gathers take on Simeon's fighters in fights as silly as they are violent. Madhouse adapted Kami Imai's manga into 24 episodes in 2009. It contains violence and fan service.

girls-bravo-first-season.summary: Yukinari Sasaki is a small, timid teenager who has been bullied by girls for so long that he has developed an allergy to them: a girl's touch makes him break out in hives. One day he is kicked into his bathtub by his rough neighbour Kirie and comes out in Seiren, a strange world hidden near Earth whose population is overwhelmingly female. There he meets Miharu, a cheerful, clumsy girl whose touch, for some reason, causes him no reaction at all. Miharu soon follows him back to Earth, filling Yukinari's quiet life with more girls than he can handle. AIC Spirits adapted Mario Kaneda's manga into 11 episodes in 2004. It contains frequent nudity and sexual humour.

akane-iro-ni-somaru-saka.summary: Junichi Nagase is a laid-back high school student with a lingering reputation from his delinquent days, who now lives with his younger sister Minato. One day he steps in to rescue a girl being harassed, and the bullies flee as soon as they recognise him. The girl is Yuuhi Katagiri, the sheltered daughter of a powerful family, and she transfers into his class the very next day. A badly timed accident leaves her convinced he is a pervert, so she is far from pleased to learn that their parents have arranged for the two of them to marry. TNK adapted Feng's adult visual novel into 12 episodes in 2008, an all-ages romantic comedy. It contains fan service and mild nudity.

ryuuou-no-oshigoto.summary: Yaichi Kuzuryu won the Ryuo title, one of the most prestigious crowns in professional shogi, at just sixteen, but since then he has slumped badly and critics call him a fluke. Then a nine-year-old girl named Ai Hinatsuru turns up at his apartment, reminding him of a promise he made and begging to become his disciple. Yaichi is reluctant at first, but he is astonished by her raw talent and agrees to teach her, while his sharp-tongued senior Ginko Sora and other players and rivals keep watch. Project No.9 adapted Shirow Shiratori's light novels into 12 episodes in 2018, mixing real shogi strategy with comedy. It contains fan service and jokes involving young characters.

cross-game.summary: Ko Kitamura is the son of a sports shop owner, and his family has long been close to the Tsukishima family, who run a batting centre nearby. He grows up beside their four daughters, especially Wakaba, born on the same day and practically treated as his girlfriend, and Aoba, a year younger and a gifted pitcher who resents how much time Ko spends with her sister. Ko shows little interest in baseball, yet he has quietly been training at the batting centre for years. An event early in the story changes everyone's lives, and the series then follows Ko, Aoba and their friends through high school baseball. SynergySP adapted Mitsuru Adachi's manga into 50 episodes from 2009 to 2010.

burn-the-witch.summary: Dragons cause most of the deaths in London, yet ordinary people cannot see them. Only the residents of Reverse London, a hidden mirror side of the city, can, and a select few become witches and wizards qualified to deal with the creatures. Noel Niihashi, calm and blunt, and Ninny Spangcole, hot-tempered and also part of a pop group, are partners at Wing Bind, an agency that protects and manages London's dragons. Their latest assignment is to look after Balgo Parks, a carefree young man who seems to attract dragons. Set in the same universe as Bleach, this three-part story was made by Studio Colorido and Team Yamahitsuji in 2020 from Tite Kubo's manga.
burn-the-witch.notes: Kitsu and MAL list it as a three-episode ONA; it was also screened in Japan as a film.

date-a-live-mayuri-judgement.summary: After the events of the second season, Shido Itsuka is enjoying a rare stretch of peace with the Spirits whose powers he has sealed by winning their hearts. Then a huge mysterious sphere appears in the sky over Tengu City, giving off spiritual energy, and a strange girl begins appearing around Shido and watching him. To work out who she is and what the sphere wants, Ratatoskr gives Shido his oddest mission yet: date every one of the Spirits again and win each of their hearts a second time. Production IMS released the film in August 2015, directed by Keitaro Motonaga from an original story supervised by Koushi Tachibana, author of the light novels.

mobile-suit-gundam-0079.summary: In the year Universal Century 0079, a group of space colonies calling itself the Principality of Zeon declares independence from the Earth Federation and launches a war, quickly gaining the upper hand with humanoid war machines called mobile suits. Months later, Zeon raids the colony Side 7 just as the Federation is collecting its own prototype, the Gundam. Amuro Ray, a fifteen-year-old civilian, ends up in the cockpit and drives off the attack, and he and other refugees flee aboard the warship White Base with an inexperienced crew. Yoshiyuki Tomino co-created and directed the 43-episode series for Sunrise, aired from 1979 to 1980. It contains war violence.

baka-to-test-to-shoukanjuu-matsuri.summary: At Fumizuki Academy, students are sorted into classes by test scores and can summon fighting avatars whose strength depends on their grades. These two OVAs, released between the first and second TV seasons, return to Class F, home of the school's lowest scorers, including the cheerful idiot Akihisa Yoshii and the class leader Yuji Sakamoto. With their classroom equipment as shabby as ever, the class sets up a stall at the school festival to earn money for better supplies. Akihisa has another reason to try: the father of Mizuki Himeji, the sweet girl he likes, is thinking of moving her to another school. Silver Link made them in 2011, based on Kenji Inoue's light novels.

isuca.summary: Shinichiro Asano is a high school student whose parents have gone off to Europe and left him to fend for himself, so he badly needs work to cover his rent. After losing yet another job, he is attacked one night by a giant centipede-like monster and saved by an archer, Sakuya Shimazu, a beautiful classmate and the head of a family that exorcises and captures supernatural creatures. When his teacher finds him a housekeeping job, his new employer turns out to be Sakuya. When Shinichiro accidentally frees one of her captives, he is drawn into her monster-hunting work. Arms adapted Osamu Takahashi's manga into 10 episodes in 2015. It contains violence and heavy sexual fan service.

honey-and-clover-ii.summary: The second and final season of Honey and Clover picks up as Yuta Takemoto returns to Tokyo from a long solo journey across Japan. Feeling more sure of himself, he finally tells Hagumi 'Hagu' Hanamoto, the small, gifted art student he has loved since they met, how he feels, but Hagu is struggling to understand the eccentric, elusive Shinobu Morita. Meanwhile, Takumi Mayama has started working life and is still bound up with Ayumi Yamada, the potter who loves him while he loves someone else. As the friends approach the end of their student years, each must choose a future. J.C.Staff made the 12 episodes in 2006 from Chica Umino's manga.

mairimashita-iruma-kun-s2.summary: The second season continues the story of Iruma Suzuki, a kind, easy-going human boy whose parents sold him to the demon Sullivan, who adopted him as a grandson and enrolled him at the Babyls School for Demons, where Iruma must keep his human identity secret. Having settled in with friends such as Alice Asmodeus and Clara Valac, Iruma now wants to keep moving up the school's demon ranks. Then his club activities are suspended for a while and he is assigned to help the strict student council, led by his friend Amelie Azazel, which keeps order among the school's unruly students. Bandai Namco Pictures made the 21 episodes in 2021 from Osamu Nishi's manga.

kimi-no-iru-machi.summary: Back in his countryside hometown in Hiroshima, Haruto Kirishima spent a memorable stretch of time with Yuzuki Eba, a girl from Tokyo who stayed with his family and then left just as suddenly as she arrived. Unable to forget her, Haruto later moves to Tokyo, officially to live with his older sister and work toward becoming a cook, but really in the hope of seeing Yuzuki again. His arrival gets off to a bad start when his sister's neighbour, Asuka Mishima, mistakes him for a burglar, and the city brings new relationships and complications. Gonzo adapted the Tokyo arc of Koji Seo's manga into 12 episodes in 2013, a romantic drama. It contains fan service.
kimi-no-iru-machi.notes: The TV series starts with the Tokyo part of the story; the countryside chapters are summarised in its backstory.

hajime-no-ippo-champion-road.summary: This feature-length TV special follows directly on from the first Hajime no Ippo series. Ippo Makunouchi, the shy boy who learned to box after being rescued from bullies by the pro Mamoru Takamura, is now Japan's featherweight champion and preparing for his first title defence. His challenger is Kazuki Sanada, a former junior featherweight champion and medical student who fights with a precise, clinical style built on anatomy, and who is coached by an old rival of Ippo's trainer, Kamogawa. To make things harder, Kumi Mashiba, the nurse Ippo likes, works alongside Sanada at his hospital. Madhouse released the special in 2003, adapting George Morikawa's manga. It contains boxing violence.

hanayamata.summary: Naru Sekiya is a fourteen-year-old who thinks of herself as completely ordinary and loves fairy tales, wishing she could be like their heroines. One moonlit night at a shrine she meets what looks like a fairy dancing on top of a torii gate, who turns out to be Hana N. Fountainstand, an energetic American transfer student who has fallen in love with yosakoi, a lively Japanese festival dance. Hana is determined to start a yosakoi club at their school and immediately wants Naru to join. Hesitant but excited, Naru agrees, and the two set out to recruit enough members, including Naru's childhood friends. Madhouse adapted Sou Hamayumiba's manga into 12 episodes in 2014.

bokutachi-wa-benkyou-ga-dekinai-2.summary: The second season of We Never Learn continues straight from the first. Nariyuki Yuiga, a hard-working senior who needs a university scholarship, has been tutoring three classmates who are geniuses in one area and hopeless in the subjects they want to study: Fumino Furuhashi, a literary talent who aims for science; Rizu Ogata, a maths prodigy who wants to study psychology; and Uruka Takemoto, a star swimmer who struggles with all academics. Their grades are improving, but entrance exams are getting closer and their feelings for him are growing. Teacher Mafuyu Kirisu and Asumi Kominami, a graduate studying for medical school, also become more involved. Studio Silver and Arvo Animation made the 13 episodes in 2019 from Taishi Tsutsui's manga.

senki-zesshou-symphogear-meteoroid-falli.summary: People live in fear of the Noise, mysterious beings that appear without warning and turn anyone they touch to dust. In secret, the idol duo Zwei Wing, Tsubasa Kazanari and Kanade Amou, fight them using Symphogear, armour powered by ancient relics and the singer's own voice. Two years after a Noise attack on one of their concerts left her badly hurt, Hibiki Tachibana is a cheerful first-year at Lydian Music Academy alongside her best friend Miku. When the Noise strike again, Hibiki tries to save a child and suddenly awakens a Symphogear of her own, pulling her into the secret war beside a guarded Tsubasa. Satelight and Encourage Films made the 13-episode original series in 2012. It contains violence.

dears.summary: A year ago a spaceship carrying 150 humanoid aliens crash-landed near Tokyo, and since nobody can repair it, Japan has made the aliens citizens, nicknamed them DearS and begun a homestay programme. High school student Takeya Ikuhara, who has a strong dislike of the DearS, stumbles on a confused, shivering alien girl who fell out of a transport capsule. He feeds and shelters her, names her Ren, and is dismayed when she cheerfully decides he is her master and insists on serving him in every way. Takeya tries to teach her how ordinary life works. Daume adapted Peach-Pit's manga into 12 episodes in 2004. It contains fan service and nudity.

dragon-ball-z-movie-12-fukkatsu-no-fusio.summary: In the afterlife, Goku is competing in a tournament for dead fighters alongside the warrior Pikkon when a careless young ogre lets the machine that purifies evil souls overflow. The spilled evil turns him into Janemba, a monstrous being whose power throws the Other World into chaos. With King Yemma trapped in his checkpoint, Goku and Pikkon go after Janemba, and the crisis also brings Vegeta back into the fight, forcing two rivals who rarely cooperate to find a way to work together. Released in March 1995, it is the twelfth Dragon Ball Z film, made by Toei Animation from Akira Toriyama's characters. It contains martial arts violence.

boku-wa-tomodachi-ga-sukunai-add-on-disc.summary: This single episode belongs to Haganai, the comedy about the Neighbors Club, which Yozora Mikazuki set up so that she, Kodaka Hasegawa and other socially awkward students could practise making friends. Short of ideas for something to do, the members decide to write a relay story together, each person adding the next section in turn. Everyone bends the plot towards their own obsessions, and the tale lurches in a new direction with every hand-off as they try to outdo each other. AIC Build produced the episode, based on Yomi Hirasaka's light novels, and it was released in September 2012 as an extra episode that never aired on TV. It includes fan-service and mild nudity.
boku-wa-tomodachi-ga-sukunai-add-on-disc.notes: Kitsu's 'Add-on Disc' entry is MAL's 'Relay Shousetsu wa Ketsumatsu ga Hanpanai' OVA (unaired 13th episode of season 1).

keppeki-danshi-aoyama-kun.summary: Aoyama is the star of Fujimi High School's soccer club: handsome, talented and so good he plays for Japan's youth side. He is also a severe clean freak. He refuses to head the ball, avoids slide tackles and any physical contact, wears gloves for throw-ins and keeps his kit spotless, yet still runs the game from midfield. His teammates, classmates and a growing fan club admire him while trying to work out how to get close to someone who keeps everyone at arm's length. Studio Hibari's 12-episode gag comedy aired in 2017 and is based on Taku Sakamoto's manga, with most of the humour coming from the oddballs around Aoyama.

rwby-ii.summary: The second volume of RWBY returns to Beacon Academy in the world of Remnant, where young Huntsmen and Huntresses train to fight the monstrous creatures called Grimm. Team RWBY, made up of Ruby Rose, Weiss Schnee, Blake Belladonna and Yang Xiao Long, settles into its second semester as students from other kingdoms arrive for the upcoming Vytal Festival. Between classes and food fights, the four girls start looking into a string of Dust robberies tied to the criminal Roman Torchwick and the White Fang. Created by Monty Oum for Rooster Teeth, this American web series uses 3D animation with an anime-inspired style, and its 12 chapters were released in 2014.
rwby-ii.notes: American web series with no MyAnimeList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia. Volume 2 premise and dates also checked against Wikipedia's List of RWBY episodes.

rdg-red-data-girl.summary: Fifteen-year-old Izumiko Suzuhara has grown up at a remote mountain shrine, painfully shy and unable to use computers or phones without them breaking down at her touch. Hoping to change, she decides to leave the mountains for high school in Tokyo. Her guardian then orders his son, Miyuki Sagara, to become her lifelong protector, which pleases neither of them, since he bullied her when they were children and sees nothing special in her. At their new school they find that Izumiko attracts spirits and people with hidden powers. P.A. Works adapted Noriko Ogiwara's novel series into 12 episodes in 2013, a quiet supernatural drama rooted in Shinto belief.

gantz-2nd-stage.summary: Gantz: Second Stage continues straight on from the first season of Gonzo's Gantz. Kei Kurono and his old classmate Masaru Kato died in a train accident, only to wake in an apartment with a mysterious black sphere that sends recently dead people out to hunt aliens. Back in their everyday lives, they and Kei Kishimoto are pulled into the game again whenever the sphere calls, and a player who earns 100 points is said to be able to leave. Each new mission brings stranger, more dangerous targets and fresh recruits who do not understand the rules. The 13 episodes aired in 2004, adapting Hiroya Oku's manga. Expect graphic gore, nudity and sexual content.

ranpo-kitan-game-of-laplace.summary: Middle schooler Yoshio Kobayashi comes to at his desk to find his teacher's mutilated body in the room and the murder weapon in his own hand. Rather than panic, the detached boy finds the setup quietly exciting, and drags his exasperated friend Hashiba into helping prove his innocence. The case brings him to Kogoro Akechi, a brilliant teenage detective who works with the police, and Kobayashi asks to become his assistant. Together they investigate a series of grotesque killings while a pattern behind them slowly takes shape. Lerche's 11-episode original series aired in 2015 and draws on characters and ideas from Edogawa Rampo's mystery fiction. It contains graphic murders and disturbing imagery.

yuri-kuma-arashi.summary: After a distant planet explodes and its fragments rain down on Earth, bears everywhere rise up and start eating people. Humanity builds a huge wall to keep the two sides apart. At Arashigaoka Academy, Kureha Tsubaki is a girl who hates bears and loves her classmate Sumika Izumino, but two bears disguised as transfer students, Ginko and Lulu, have slipped across the wall and taken a particular interest in her. Meanwhile a group of students called the Invisible Storm enforces conformity at the school. Kunihiko Ikuhara directed this original 12-episode series at Silver Link in 2015, a symbolic, surreal story about love between girls. It includes violence and sexual imagery.

killing-bites.summary: College student Yuya Nomoto agrees to drive some acquaintances around and only realises too late that they are kidnapping a high school girl. The girl, Hitomi Uzaki, tears her abductors apart and makes Yuya take her to a secret arena. She is a Therianthrope, a human with animal genes, in her case those of the honey badger, and she fights in underground death matches called Killing Bites that powerful corporations use to settle their rivalries. Yuya ends up tied to her as her backer. Liden Films adapted the manga by Shinya Murata and Kazuasa Sumita into 12 episodes in 2018. Expect graphic gore, bloody fights and frequent nudity.

senyuu.summary: A thousand years after the hero Creasion sealed away the Demon Lord Rchimedes, a hole opens between the human and demon worlds and monsters pour out. Worried that the Demon Lord is about to return, the king summons the hero's descendants, but so much time has passed that he finds 75 possible candidates. One of them is Alba Fruhling, a weak and unremarkable adventurer, who sets out with Ross, a skilled soldier meant to protect him who prefers to mock and torment him instead. Their journey turns into a run of fantasy parody gags. Ordet and Liden Films adapted Robinson Haruhara's web manga into 13 short episodes of about four minutes each in 2013.

hikaru-no-go.summary: Sixth grader Hikaru Shindo is searching his grandfather's attic when he finds an old Go board and hears a voice. The speaker is Fujiwara no Sai, a long-dead Go master from the Heian era who taught the game at the imperial court and still dreams of playing the perfect game. Sai settles into Hikaru's mind and begs him to play, and Hikaru, who knows nothing about Go, reluctantly places stones as Sai directs. Then he faces Akira Toya, a prodigy his own age, and the game begins to matter to him. Studio Pierrot adapted the manga by Yumi Hotta and Takeshi Obata into 75 episodes between 2001 and 2003.

fate-grand-order-zettai-majuu-sensen-bab.summary: Humanity's history has been burned away, and the agency Chaldea is restoring it by sending agents back in time to repair broken points called Singularities. Chaldea's last remaining Master, Ritsuka Fujimaru, and his partner Mash Kyrielight now travel to the seventh: Mesopotamia in 2655 BC. They arrive to find the city of Uruk, ruled by King Gilgamesh, under siege from swarms of Demonic Beasts and hostile goddesses. Ritsuka and Mash join the king's defence and gather allies among the heroic spirits gathered there. CloverWorks produced the 21-episode series from 2019 to 2020, adapting a chapter of the Type-Moon mobile game Fate/Grand Order. It includes battle violence and some bloodshed.
fate-grand-order-zettai-majuu-sensen-bab.notes: A prologue special, Episode 0: Initium Iter, aired before the series.

mahou-sensei-negima.summary: Negi Springfield is a ten-year-old wizard from Wales who must complete one last assignment to finish his training: teaching English at Mahora Academy, an all-girls school in Japan. He is placed in charge of a lively class of 31 students, and on his first day he manages to anger Asuna Kagurazaka, who also finds out he can use magic, which he is meant to keep secret. Negi now has to manage a classroom full of eccentric girls, keep his magic hidden and deal with the odd supernatural threat. Xebec adapted Ken Akamatsu's manga into 26 episodes in 2005. The comedy relies heavily on fan-service.
mahou-sensei-negima.notes: The 2006 series Negima!? by Shaft is a separate retelling.

hitoribocchi-no-seikatsu.summary: Bocchi Hitori has crippling social anxiety: when she is nervous she cramps up, faints or throws up, and she plans elaborate ways to avoid talking to anyone. Her only friend, Kai, is going to a different middle school, so Kai makes Bocchi promise to befriend every single classmate by graduation and says they cannot be friends again until she does. Starting on her first day, Bocchi forces herself to approach people, one awkward conversation at a time, and gradually gathers a small, odd circle of friends. C2C adapted Katsuwo's four-panel comic into 12 episodes in 2019, a gentle comedy about shyness and making friends.

steven-universe.summary: Steven is a cheerful young boy living in the seaside town of Beach City with the Crystal Gems, Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl, magical alien guardians who protect the Earth from monsters. Half-human and half-Gem, Steven inherited a gem from his mother and is slowly learning how to use the powers that come with it, often by accident. Between missions with the Gems he spends time with his dad Greg, his friend Connie and the townspeople. Created by Rebecca Sugar for Cartoon Network, the American series began in 2013, and this entry covers the first season's 52 short episodes, which ran until March 2015.
steven-universe.notes: American cartoon with no MyAnimeList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia. Kitsu's entry covers season 1 (52 episodes, Nov 2013 to Mar 2015).

senran-kagura.summary: Behind the ordinary front of Hanzo Academy, a few girls secretly train as shinobi. Asuka, granddaughter of a famous ninja, studies alongside her classmates Ikaruga, Katsuragi, Yagyu and Hibari, hoping to become a full ninja. Their training is interrupted by a rival group of girls from Hebijo Academy, a school that trains shinobi for the other side, and the two sides clash in a string of battles. Artland adapted the Marvelous video game franchise created by Kenichiro Takaki into 12 episodes in 2013. The series is known for heavy fan-service, with outfits torn apart in nearly every fight and frequent sexualised nudity.

kara-no-kyoukai-epilogue.summary: This short coda to ufotable's Garden of Sinners films is set in March 1999. On a snowy night, Mikiya Kokutou finds Shiki Ryougi waiting at the very spot where the two of them met four years earlier. They talk about the past and about what has happened between them, but as the conversation goes on, Mikiya realises he is not speaking with the Shiki he knows, but with something else that lives within her. Almost the whole episode is one long, quiet conversation. Based on Kinoko Nasu's novel series, the 33-minute epilogue was released in 2011 and is meant to be watched after the seven main films.

arcane.summary: Piltover is a wealthy city of inventors; beneath it lies Zaun, a polluted undercity where people survive any way they can. Orphaned sisters Vi and Powder grow up in Zaun under the care of a former rebel, while above them the young scientist Jayce and his partner Viktor try to harness magic through a new technology called hextech. As tensions between the two cities rise, the sisters are pulled towards opposite sides. Created by Christian Linke and Alex Yee and set in the world of Riot Games' League of Legends, the French studio Fortiche animated it for Netflix, which released the nine-episode first season in November 2021. It includes violence and drug use.
arcane.notes: Western animation with no MyAnimeList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia. Kitsu's entry covers season 1 (9 episodes, Nov 2021).

gyakuten-saiban.summary: Rookie defence attorney Phoenix Wright, called Ryuichi Naruhodo in the Japanese version, takes his first cases under his mentor Mia Fey. In court the odds are always stacked against him: evidence points squarely at his clients, witnesses change their stories, and the brilliant prosecutor Miles Edgeworth seldom loses. Phoenix must spot contradictions in testimony and evidence, often at the last moment, to find the real culprit. A-1 Pictures adapted Capcom's courtroom adventure game series into 24 episodes in 2016, mostly following the cases from the first two games, mixing murder mysteries with comedy. A second season followed in 2018.

cardcaptor-sakura-movie-2-the-sealed-car.summary: Set after the end of the TV series, this film finds Sakura Kinomoto settled into life with her renamed Sakura Cards, but still unable to answer the boy who confessed his feelings to her months ago. Syaoran and his cousin Meiling arrive from Hong Kong just as Sakura's class rehearses a play for the town's Nadeshiko Festival, and she resolves to tell him how she feels. Before she can, her cards start to vanish and strange things happen around town, pointing to a card that Clow Reed sealed away long ago. Madhouse produced the 82-minute film in 2000, based on CLAMP's manga and directed by Morio Asaka.

danganronpa-3-the-end-of-kibougamine-gak.summary: Hope Arc is the one-episode finale of Danganronpa 3, and it only makes sense after both halves that came before it: Future Arc, a killing game among Future Foundation members, and Despair Arc, the prequel about Hope's Peak Academy's 77th class. It begins where those two stories meet, as Makoto Naegi and the other survivors face one last scheme that would reshape the whole world, with help from people they did not expect to see again. It closes the Hope's Peak storyline from Spike Chunsoft's games. Lerche produced it, and it aired in September 2016 as a single special. It contains violence and dark themes.
danganronpa-3-the-end-of-kibougamine-gak.notes: Watch after both Future Arc and Despair Arc.

higurashi-no-naku-koro-ni-gou.summary: In June 1983, Keiichi Maebara moves to Hinamizawa, a sleepy village in the mountains, and quickly falls in with a lively group of girls at the local school: Rena, Mion, her twin Shion, Satoko and the shrine maiden Rika Furude. Their afternoons are spent playing games with harsh punishments for the loser, and the village's annual Watanagashi festival is drawing near. Under that cheerful surface, though, there are signs of an old grudge in the village, and Keiichi begins to sense his friends are hiding something from him. Passione produced the 24-episode series in 2020 and 2021, based on 07th Expansion's Higurashi visual novels. It contains graphic violence and gore.
higurashi-no-naku-koro-ni-gou.notes: No standalone Wikipedia article for Gou; the franchise article covers it. A follow-up, Higurashi: When They Cry - Sotsu, aired in 2021.

rec.summary: Fumihiko Matsumaru, a young salaryman, is about to bin a pair of movie tickets after his date stands him up when a young woman asks if she can go with him instead. She is Aka Onda, a bubbly aspiring voice actress, and the evening goes better than he expected. They discover they live near each other, but that same night her flat burns down and she loses everything she owns. Fumihiko offers her a place to stay, and the two begin living together while keeping it quiet for the sake of her career. Shaft adapted Q-Taro Hanamizawa's manga into nine short episodes of about 13 minutes in 2006, a light romantic comedy.

hoozuki-no-reitetsu.summary: In the Japanese afterlife, Hell runs like a busy government office, and the one who really keeps it working is Hozuki, the chief aide to King Enma. Stern, unflappable and quietly sadistic, Hozuki handles complaints, staff problems and visitors with the same deadpan efficiency, whether that means dealing with the folk hero Momotaro and his animal companions, arguing with the Chinese beast Hakutaku or hosting delegates from the Western Hell. Each episode is a set of comic sketches drawn from Japanese mythology and folklore, with a lot of office satire. Wit Studio adapted Natsumi Eguchi's manga into 13 episodes in 2014, and a second season followed in 2017.

classroom-crisis.summary: In Fourth Tokyo, a colony on Mars, the giant Kirishina Corporation runs a special high school class called A-TEC, whose students also work as paid engineers and test pilots building advanced spacecraft. Their homeroom teacher is Kaito Sera, a gifted engineer who cares more about rockets than about the company's accounts. When a new transfer student, Nagisa Kiryu, arrives, he turns out to be a member of the family that runs the company, sent to cut costs, and A-TEC is first on his list. Kaito and the class must prove their work is worth keeping. Lay-duce produced the original 13-episode series for Aniplex in 2015.

ao-no-exorcist-kuro-no-iede.summary: This standalone comedy episode of Blue Exorcist centres on Kuro, the two-tailed cat sidhe that lives with Rin Okumura, the son of Satan training to become an exorcist at True Cross Academy. Rin has been too busy with classes and missions to give his familiar much attention, and when the two have a falling out, a sulking Kuro decides to leave and look for a new master. His search takes him around the academy and town, testing whether anyone else could really take Rin's place. A-1 Pictures made the special in 2011, released with the home video of the TV series and based on Kazue Kato's manga.
ao-no-exorcist-kuro-no-iede.notes: Kitsu and MAL list it as a special (a DVD/Blu-ray extra).

kanojo-okarishimasu-2nd-season.summary: The second season of Rent-a-Girlfriend picks up about a year after college student Kazuya Kinoshita first booked Chizuru Mizuhara through a rental girlfriend app. Their fake relationship is still going for the sake of their families, while Chizuru chases her real dream of becoming an actress, and Kazuya's feelings for her keep getting harder to hide. His self-declared girlfriend Ruka, his ex Mami and the shy rental girl Sumi complicate things further, and every lie he tells needs another to cover it. TMS Entertainment produced the 12 episodes, which aired from July to September 2022 and adapt Reiji Miyajima's manga. Season 3 followed in 2023.

noblesse.summary: Cadis Etrama di Raizel, known as Rai, is a Noblesse, the most powerful of an ancient race of nobles, who wakes from a sleep that lasted 820 years into a world he no longer recognises. His loyal servant Frankenstein, now the director of Ye Ran High School in Korea, enrols him as a student so that he can live quietly among humans. Rai makes friends and learns about modern life, but the Union, a secret organisation that has been experimenting on humans, is hunting for him, and his new classmates are soon in danger. Production I.G adapted the Korean webtoon by Son Jeho and Lee Kwangsu into 13 episodes in 2020. It includes bloody fights.

hakata-tonkotsu-ramens.summary: Fukuoka looks like a peaceful city, but its Hakata district is crowded with hitmen, detectives, informants and revenge agents, all working in the shadows. Zenji Banba is a laid-back private detective with a sideline in dealing with killers, while Lin Xianming is a young hitman who dresses as a woman and is fed up with his low pay and his boss. When their paths cross on a job, Lin ends up joining Banba's circle, including the amateur baseball team the city's professionals play for. Satelight adapted Chiaki Kisaki's novel series into 12 episodes in 2018, an ensemble crime story with several cases running at once. It includes violence and killings.

kuromukuro.summary: While the Kurobe Dam was being built in the Japanese Alps, workers unearthed a strange ancient object, and a United Nations research institute was set up beside the dam to study it. Yukina Shirahane, a quiet high school girl whose mother leads the research, accidentally unlocks part of the artifact. Out steps Kennosuke Tokisada Ouma, a warrior who fought in the Sengoku era and has slept inside it for over four centuries and who mistakes Yukina for the princess he once served. Soon afterwards, alien machines attack the facility, and Kennosuke takes control of a giant robot found inside the artifact. P.A. Works made the original 26-episode mecha series in 2016 to mark the studio's 15th anniversary.

dies-irae.summary: On 1 May 1945, as Berlin falls, a group of Nazi officers carries out an occult ritual fuelled by the bloodshed in the city, aiming to summon a band of immortal, superhuman soldiers. Decades later in the Japanese city of Suwahara, high school student Ren Fujii is recovering from a violent fight that ended his friendship with Shirou, his closest friend. Ren tries to hold on to an ordinary life with his childhood friend Kasumi and his senior Rea, but a series of beheading murders breaks out in the city, and Ren keeps dreaming of a guillotine. A.C.G.T. adapted Light's visual novel in 2017. Expect graphic violence, decapitations and Nazi imagery.
dies-irae.notes: MAL counts 11 episodes; AniList counts 12 including an episode 0 prologue, so no episode count is given.

dragon-ball-z-movie-05-tobikkiri-no-saik.summary: Goku is back on Earth after his battle with Frieza and has taken Gohan and Krillin camping in the wilderness. The trip is interrupted when three alien warriors attack, followed by their master, Cooler, Frieza's older brother, who has come to settle the score with the Saiyan who humiliated his family. Goku is badly hurt early in the fight and has to go into hiding while Cooler's squad searches the forest for him, leaving Gohan and the others to hold the line. Toei Animation released the 46-minute film in July 1991, directed by Mitsuo Hashimoto and based on Akira Toriyama's manga. It sits outside the main TV continuity.

hanebado.summary: Third-year Nagisa Aragaki has thrown herself into badminton since losing 21-0 to an unknown junior high player at a national tournament. Her obsession has turned the Kitakomachi High School club into a place of punishing drills, and members are leaving faster than new ones join. The arrival of a new coach, Kentaro Tachibana, a former top player, coincides with that of Ayano Hanesaki, a first-year with startling talent who insists she wants nothing to do with the sport. Liden Films adapted Kosuke Hamada's manga into 13 episodes in 2018, with intense, fast-moving matches and a focus on the players' pressures, rivalries and family baggage.

is-infinite-stratos-encore-koi-ni-kogare.summary: This single episode is a summer holiday side story for Infinite Stratos, the series about Ichika Orimura, the only boy able to pilot the powered armour called IS, and the girls at the academy that trains its pilots. With school out, Charlotte plans to have Ichika to herself by visiting his home, but Cecilia has the same idea, and before long Houki, Lingyin and Laura turn up too. Afterwards Houki lends a hand at a festival held at her family's shrine, where a surprise visitor appears. It is a light romantic comedy with no major battles. 8bit released the 26-minute OVA in 2011, based on Izuru Yumizuru's light novels. It includes fan-service.

initial-d-fourth-stage.summary: Fourth Stage moves Initial D away from Takumi Fujiwara's local mountain road. The tofu shop driver joins Ryosuke Takahashi's new expedition team, Project D, alongside Ryosuke's younger brother Keisuke, with Takumi taking the downhill runs and Keisuke the uphill. The team travels to other prefectures to take on their best street racers on their own home passes, and Ryosuke posts the results online to draw in tougher opponents, partly to test his theories of high-speed driving. Each race turns on car setup, road knowledge and nerve. A.C.G.T. produced the 24 episodes, which aired from 2004 to 2006, adapting Shuichi Shigeno's manga.
initial-d-fourth-stage.notes: Follows Initial D Third Stage (2001 film).

only-yesterday.summary: In 1982, Taeko Okajima is 27, unmarried and working in an office in Tokyo. Wanting a break from the city, she takes her holiday in rural Yamagata to help relatives of her sister's husband with the safflower harvest. On the overnight train, and throughout her stay, memories of her ten-year-old self in 1966 keep returning to her: classroom crushes, family arguments and the small embarrassments of growing up. In the countryside she gets to know Toshio, a young farmer who shows her how the land is worked. Isao Takahata wrote and directed the 1991 Studio Ghibli film, based on the manga by Hotaru Okamoto and Yuko Tone.

boogiepop-phantom.summary: A Japanese city is still uneasy after a string of murders, and among high school students the old rumour of Boogiepop is spreading again: a shinigami who is said to appear to people just before they die. Strange things begin happening to students around Shinyo Academy, as some go missing, some change in unsettling ways and others see things that should not exist. Each episode follows a different character, and the episodes overlap in time, so the full picture only comes together slowly. Madhouse adapted Kouhei Kadono's Boogiepop light novels into 12 episodes in 2000, with muted colours and a dense, unsettling mood. It deals with death, violence and disturbing psychological themes.
boogiepop-phantom.notes: Set after the first Boogiepop novel; a separate 2019 series adapts the novels more directly.

juuou-mujin-no-fafnir.summary: When monsters called dragons appeared around the world, some girls began to be born with their marks and with the power to turn dark matter into weapons. These girls, known as D, are gathered on an island academy called Midgar to train against the dragons. Yu Mononobe, who has served as a soldier, has the same power, and he is sent to Midgar as the only boy among them. There he is reunited with his sister Mitsuki, who leads the school, and meets Iris and the other girls in his class. Diomedea adapted Tsukasa's light novel series into 12 episodes in 2015, a harem action fantasy. It includes fan-service and some nudity.

hoshiai-no-sora.summary: The boys' soft tennis club at a middle school is about to be shut down: it never wins, its members are weak and the girls' team overshadows it. Captain Toma Shinjo is desperate for new players, and when transfer student Maki Katsuragi shows lightning reflexes by catching a stray cat in class, Toma asks him to join. Maki refuses until Toma agrees to pay him. As the team trains, the series looks closely at each boy's home life and the pressures they carry from their families. Kazuki Akane wrote and directed the original 12-episode series, produced by 8bit, in 2019. It deals with child abuse and family dysfunction.

netsuzou-trap.summary: High school girls Yuma Okazaki and Hotaru Mizushina have been best friends since childhood. When shy Yuma gets her first boyfriend, Takeda, she asks Hotaru and her boyfriend Fujiwara to come along on a double date. Instead of helping, Hotaru starts making physical advances towards Yuma whenever the boys are not looking, claiming she is helping her practise for her boyfriend. Yuma is confused by how she feels, and the two begin a secret relationship behind their boyfriends' backs. Creators in Pack adapted Naoko Kodama's yuri manga into 12 short episodes of about nine minutes each in 2017. It contains sexual content and an emotionally manipulative relationship.

la-maison-en-petits-cubes.summary: An elderly man lives alone in a town that is slowly sinking under the sea. Each time the water climbs, he lays another level of bricks on top of his house and moves upstairs, so his home has become a narrow tower rising out of the water. One day his favourite pipe slips through a hatch into the flooded rooms below. Putting on a diving suit to go after it, he sinks down through the old floors one by one, and each room brings back memories of earlier years with the people he loved. Kunio Kato's wordless 12-minute short from 2008 won the Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film.
la-maison-en-petits-cubes.notes: Produced by Robot Communications; MAL credits the animation to Oh! Production.

mushishi-zoku-shou-suzu-no-shizuku.summary: Ginko is a mushishi, a wandering expert in mushi, simple life forms that most people cannot see and that can cause strange afflictions. In this film he climbs a mountain where, years earlier, a boy once heard bells ringing as though for a celebration. Ginko comes across a girl with grass and leaves sprouting from her body, and then meets that boy, Yoshiro, now a grown man, who helps him learn who the girl is and what has happened to her and the mountain. Artland's 47-minute film from 2015 adapts the final story of Yuki Urushibara's manga and follows the second Mushishi Zoku Shou TV season.

mayoi-neko-overrun.summary: High school student Takumi Tsuzuki helps run Stray Cats, a small cake shop owned by Otome, the kind-hearted woman who adopted him and who has a habit of taking in strays of every kind. His days are already crowded: his childhood friend Fumino says the opposite of whatever she feels, and Chise, the spoiled granddaughter of the school's chairman, keeps dragging him into her schemes. Then Otome brings home a quiet, mysterious girl named Nozomi, and the household, along with Takumi's love life, gets busier still. AIC adapted Tomohiro Matsu's light novel series into 13 episodes in 2010, a harem romantic comedy with plenty of slapstick.

brave-10.summary: In Japan's Warring States period, Isanami, a young priestess from Izumo, escapes into the forest after ninja burn down her temple. She is rescued by Saizo Kirigakure, a masterless ninja from Iga, who reluctantly agrees to escort her to Ueda Castle and the warlord Sanada Yukimura. Yukimura takes Isanami in and begins gathering ten skilled warriors to protect her, as it becomes clear that she holds a dangerous power others want. TMS Entertainment and Studio Saki Makura adapted Kairi Shimotsuki's manga, which reimagines the legendary Sanada Ten Braves, into 12 episodes in 2012. It contains frequent bloody sword and ninja fights.

junjou-romantica-2.summary: The second season of Junjo Romantica continues following three male couples. University student Misaki Takahashi lives with Akihiko Usami, a famous novelist who also writes boys' love stories starring the two of them, and their relationship is tested further when Akihiko's older brother Haruhiko takes an interest in Misaki. Alongside them, literature lecturer Hiroki Kamijo and his younger partner Nowaki work around their busy schedules, while professor Miyagi keeps trying to fend off Shinobu, the determined son of his university's dean. Studio Deen produced the 12 episodes in 2008, adapting Shungiku Nakamura's manga. It includes sexual scenes and pushy romantic advances.

toaru-kagaku-no-accelerator.summary: Accelerator is the strongest esper in Academy City, a city of students with superpowers, but since protecting the young girl Last Order he has been left with a brain injury and relies on a special device to think, talk and use his powers. While recovering, he saves the life of a mysterious girl who has a picture of Last Order with her, and is pulled into a new conflict with an organisation called Disciplinary Action, which has its own plans for Last Order. J.C.Staff produced the 12 episodes in 2019, adapting the spin-off manga written by Kazuma Kamachi and drawn by Arata Yamaji. It contains violent fights and some bloodshed.
toaru-kagaku-no-accelerator.notes: Spin-off of A Certain Magical Index; best watched after Index season 1.

psycho-pass-3.summary: In the Japan of Psycho-Pass, the Sibyl System reads each citizen's mental state and flags likely criminals before they act. Psycho-Pass 3 is set after the country has begun accepting immigrants, and it follows two new inspectors in the Public Safety Bureau: Arata Shindo, whose empathy lets him read crime scenes, and his childhood friend Kei Mikhail Ignatov, a former soldier. Their first cases point to a shadowy group called Bifrost, which is quietly influencing events in the city. Production I.G produced the eight hour-long episodes for Fuji TV's Noitamina block in 2019, and the film First Inspector continues the story. It includes graphic violence.

persona-3-the-movie-1-spring-of-birth.summary: Makoto Yuki transfers to Gekkoukan High School and moves into a dormitory in the city. On his first night he learns that a secret extra hour, the Dark Hour, begins at the stroke of midnight, when most people are sealed in coffins and creatures called Shadows hunt anyone still awake. When Shadows attack the dorm, Makoto awakens a Persona, a power shared by the students of SEES, a secret club fighting the Shadows, and he joins them. Directed by Noriaki Akitaya at AIC ASTA, the 2013 film is the first of four adapting Atlus' role-playing game Persona 3. Characters summon Personas by firing gun-like devices at their own heads.

hyakuren-no-haou-to-seiyaku-no-valkyria.summary: Yuto Suoh tags along when his childhood friend Mitsuki wants to test an urban legend at a local shrine, and when he takes a photo of himself with the shrine's sacred mirror, he is pulled into another world. It is a land shaped by Norse myth, split into warring clans, where some women have rune powers and fight as Einherjar. Using what he learned in school and a smartphone he keeps charged with a solar charger, Yuto rises to lead the Wolf Clan that took him in. EMT Squared adapted Seiichi Takayama's light novel series into 12 episodes in 2018, a military fantasy with harem elements. It includes fan-service.

shokugeki-no-souma-ni-no-sara-ova.summary: These two episodes are side stories for Food Wars!, the series about young cook Soma Yukihira at the elite Totsuki culinary academy, and they fit after the second season. In the first, the Polar Star dorm crowd and a few friends head to a hot spring inn to rest after their Stagiaire work placements, only to end up running its kitchen when the staff are put out of action. In the second, Soma, Megumi and the six other first-years who reached the Autumn Election's knockout rounds receive an invitation to the academy's Autumn Leaves Viewing, hosted by the Elite Ten. J.C.Staff released the OVAs in 2017 with volumes of Yuto Tsukuda and Shun Saeki's manga. They include fan-service.

star-driver-kagayaki-no-takuto.summary: One night a boy named Takuto Tsunashi swims to the shore of Southern Cross Isle, an island south of mainland Japan, and is found by Wako Agemaki and her fiance Sugata Shindo. Takuto enrols at the island's academy, a cheerful newcomer who likes to strike a pose. The island hides ancient stone giants called Cybodies, which can only move in a parallel space called Zero Time, and a secret society, the Glittering Crux Brigade, wants to break the seals held by four shrine maidens, Wako among them, to set the giants free. Takuto has his own Cybody to stop them. Bones created the original 25-episode mecha series, which aired from 2010 to 2011.

yarichin-bitch-bu.summary: Takashi Tono transfers midway through the year to Morimori Academy, a remote boys' boarding school up in the mountains, and feels like an outsider until his cheerful classmate Kyosuke Yaguchi befriends him. Every student must join a club, so Tono picks the Photography Club, thinking it will be easy. He soon learns its nickname, the Yarichin Bitch Club, and that its flamboyant members spend their time on sexual exploits rather than photos, with unwelcome expectations for newcomers. The comedy follows Tono and Yaguchi as they try to cope with the club and with their feelings for each other. Grizzly made two OVAs in 2018 and 2019 from Ogeretsu Tanaka's web manga. It contains explicit sexual content.
yarichin-bitch-bu.notes: AniList flags this entry as adult.

the-law-of-ueki.summary: A secret contest is under way to choose the next god of the Heavenly World. One hundred god candidates each give a special power to a middle school student on Earth, and those students battle until one is left; the winner earns the Blank Talent, the right to choose any ability they want. Kosuke Ueki, a laid-back boy with an unshakeable sense of justice, is chosen by his teacher Kobasen, who turns out to be a candidate. Ueki's power lets him turn rubbish into trees, and his classmate Ai Mori is soon caught up in his fights. Studio Deen adapted Tsubasa Fukuchi's manga into 51 episodes between 2005 and 2006.

maou-sama-retry.summary: Akira Ono runs Infinity Game, an online role-playing game he has looked after for fifteen years, and he logs in as its all-powerful Demon Lord for one last time before shutting the servers down. At midnight he finds himself inside the game world in the body of that character, Hakuto Kunai. Almost at once he rescues Aku, a young girl being chased by a monster, but neither she nor the creature are anything he remembers creating, so he begins exploring to find out where he really is. His overwhelming power and frightening looks keep causing misunderstandings. Ekachi Epilka adapted Kurone Kanzaki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2019.

hitorijime-my-hero.summary: Masahiro Setagawa is a weak teenager who runs errands for local delinquents because he has no one to stand up for him. That changes when he meets Kosuke Oshiba, a man feared on the streets as the Bear Killer, who breaks up the neighbourhood gangs. A year later, Masahiro starts high school with Kosuke's younger brother Kensuke and finds that Kosuke is now their maths teacher. Masahiro comes to see Kosuke as his personal hero, and their bond deepens, while Kensuke's relationship with his childhood friend Asaya forms a second story. Encourage Films adapted Memeco Arii's boys' love manga into 12 episodes in 2017. The main romance is between a teacher and his teenage student.

shinrei-tantei-yakumo.summary: University student Haruka Ozawa has a problem no one else can help with: a friend of hers seems to have been possessed after visiting a supposedly haunted building. She is pointed towards Yakumo Saito, an aloof student who lives in a club room on campus and was born with a red left eye that lets him see and talk to the dead. Yakumo reluctantly takes the case, and Haruka keeps coming back with new ones, many of which bring in his police contact, Detective Gotou. Ghost stories here often lead back to very human crimes. Bee Train adapted Manabu Kaminaga's novels into 13 episodes in 2010. It includes murders and suicides.

akiba-s-trip-the-animation.summary: Otaku Tamotsu Denkigai is shopping in Akihabara when the district is overrun by Bugged Ones, monsters that take over people by biting them. He is saved by Matome Mayonaka, a mysterious girl who fights with a baseball bat, but when he is badly hurt protecting her, she saves his life by turning him into a Bugged One like herself. Now strong enough to fight, Tamotsu joins Matome and his cosplay-loving sister Niwaka against the creatures, which can be beaten by stripping off their clothes. Gonzo produced the 13 episodes in 2017, based on Acquire's video game series, and the show is packed with otaku jokes and parody. It includes fan-service and partial nudity.

boku-no-hero-academia-training-of-the-de.summary: This single-episode side story of My Hero Academia is set during the second season, just after the students of U.A. High School's Class 1-A return from their hero internships. Their teacher, Shota Aizawa, sends them straight into another exercise: a survival game alongside four visiting Isamu Academy High School students, played in teams of four where you win by taking out rivals or staying hidden until time runs out. Tsuyu Asui is reunited with an old middle school friend, while Katsuki Bakugo picks a fight with one of the visitors almost at once. Bones released the 25-minute OVA in 2017, bundled with a volume of Kohei Horikoshi's manga.

tales-from-earthsea.summary: Across the world of Earthsea, something is wrong: crops fail, people lose their will, magic is fading and dragons now battle each other in the sky. The wizard Sparrowhawk, the Archmage, sets out to find the cause and is joined by Arren, a troubled young prince who has fled his kingdom and is haunted by a darkness he does not understand. In the port of Hort Town they find shelter with Tenar and a scarred girl named Therru, and come into conflict with Lord Cob, a wizard obsessed with living forever. Goro Miyazaki directed the 2006 Studio Ghibli film, his first, drawing on Ursula K. Le Guin's Earthsea books.

sakurada-reset.summary: Many people in the seaside town of Sakurada are born with some kind of special ability. High school student Kei Asai has a perfect memory that even survives changes to time itself. Misora Haruki, a quiet, expressionless girl, can reset the world back to any point up to three days earlier, but cannot remember anything once she has done it. Together they can undo mistakes, and they join their school's service club to help people in town. Their requests gradually bring them into contact with the Administration Bureau, the mysterious organisation that keeps the town's abilities under control. David Production adapted Yutaka Kono's light novels into 24 episodes in 2017.

konohana-kitan.summary: In a town of spirits that lies between our world and the next, Yuzu, an energetic young fox girl, starts work as an attendant at the Konohanatei, a traditional hot spring inn staffed by fox spirits. She is clumsy and has no training, so the calm head attendant Kiri takes her under her wing, while Yuzu's colleagues, among them the strict Satsuki, are not all sure she belongs there. As the seasons pass, Yuzu's eagerness wins over her colleagues, and the inn's unusual guests bring small, often touching stories. Lerche adapted Sakuya Amano's manga into 12 episodes in 2017, a gentle slice-of-life show with soft yuri undertones.

memories.summary: Memories is an anthology of three unrelated short films, each based on a manga short story by Katsuhiro Otomo, who also served as executive producer. In Magnetic Rose, directed by Koji Morimoto from a script by Satoshi Kon, a deep-space salvage crew follows a distress call to a vast derelict station shaped around the memories of a famous opera singer. Stink Bomb, directed by Tensai Okamura, is a black comedy about a young lab worker who swallows the wrong pills and starts giving off a deadly gas. Otomo's own Cannon Fodder shows one day in a city whose whole life revolves around firing giant cannons. Madhouse and Studio 4C made the 1995 film.

shikabane-hime-aka.summary: Ouri Kagami lives with other orphans at a Buddhist temple and has grown used to the dead. Even so, he is shaken when he sees Makina Hoshimura, a schoolgirl he knows to be dead, come back to life and fight with a pair of submachine guns. She is a Corpse Princess, a girl brought back from the dead and bound to a monk of the Kogon sect, who must destroy 108 shikabane, undead beings who threaten the living, if she hopes to reach heaven. Ouri keeps getting pulled into her fights. Gainax and feel. adapted Yoshiichi Akahito's manga into 13 episodes in 2008, followed by the sequel Kuro. It contains graphic violence and gore.

photokano.summary: High school student Kazuya Maeda feels his life is dull until, just before the end of summer break, his father gives him an old camera. He starts taking photos and soon finds himself photographing a series of girls at school who agree to model for him, from his popular childhood friend Haruka to the softball club's ace Nonoka, the student council president Aki and fellow photography fan Hikari. Each relationship develops in its own way as Kazuya learns to see the people around him through a lens. Madhouse adapted the dating simulation game from Enterbrain into 13 episodes in 2013. It includes fan-service and lingering camera angles on the girls.

kara-no-kyoukai-mirai-fukuin.summary: Future Gospel is a later side story to ufotable's Garden of Sinners films, made up of two linked tales about people who can see the future. In one, Shiki Ryougi, Mikiya Kokutou and their employer Touko Aozaki look into a series of bombings after witnessing an explosion, and the bomber, who can foresee what will happen, decides to get rid of Shiki. In the other, Shizune Seo, who attends Reien Girls' Academy and is on her way home for the summer, keeps having visions of the future that she cannot shake off. The 90-minute film, released in 2013 and directed by Tomonori Sudo, adapts Kinoko Nasu's novella. It includes violence.
kara-no-kyoukai-mirai-fukuin.notes: Best watched after the seven main films.

nodame-cantabile-paris-chapter.summary: The second season of Nodame Cantabile takes its two musicians abroad. Shinichi Chiaki has finally conquered the fear of flying that kept him in Japan, and Megumi Noda, known as Nodame, has earned a place to study piano at a conservatory in Paris, so the two move to France together. Chiaki starts out as a young conductor entering European competitions and building a career, while Nodame studies under a demanding new teacher and struggles with the gap between how she likes to play and what her training asks of her. New friends and rivals fill their Paris apartment block. J.C.Staff produced the 11 episodes in 2008, adapting Tomoko Ninomiya's manga.

inferno-cop.summary: Inferno Cop is a lawman whose head is a burning skull, and he dispenses brutal justice in a city crawling with criminals and demons. His family was murdered by the shadowy organisation Southern Cross, and that grudge drives him through a string of increasingly absurd fights and twists. The show is made in a deliberately cheap motion-comic style, with paper-cutout characters sliding across still backgrounds, and the deadpan dialogue and abrupt plot turns are the joke. Akira Amemiya directed the 13 episodes of about three minutes each, made by Trigger and CoMix Wave Films and released online in 2012 and 2013. It includes cartoonish violence.

code-geass-akito-the-exiled-2-the-torn-u.summary: The second chapter of Akito the Exiled continues the Code Geass side story set in Europe, between the two seasons of Lelouch of the Rebellion, as the Holy Britannian Empire pushes into the continent. Leila Malcal, now a lieutenant colonel, still commands W-0, a unit of young Japanese pilots fighting for the European side. Short of pilots, she recruits three Japanese youths who tried to kidnap a general: Ryo Sayama, Yukiya Naruse and Ayano Kosaka. The unit is then ordered to drop behind enemy lines, and Leila goes with them, while Akito Hyuga struggles with his own violent urges. Sunrise released the 59-minute film in 2013, directed by Kazuki Akane. It contains war violence.

slayers.summary: Lina Inverse is a teenage sorceress with enormous magical power, a short temper and a love of treasure, which she mostly collects by robbing the bandits who are foolish enough to cross her. When a band of thieves ambushes her, a well-meaning swordsman named Gourry Gabriev rushes in, convinced he is saving a helpless child, and appoints himself her bodyguard. The pair soon learn that an object Lina took from the bandits is wanted by some very dangerous people, and they pick up allies such as the brooding Zelgadis and the justice-loving princess Amelia. E&G Films adapted Hajime Kanzaka's light novels into 26 episodes in 1995, a fantasy adventure with lots of slapstick.

walkure-romanze.summary: At Winford Academy, a school in an old English-style town, students train as knights and compete in jousting tournaments. Takahiro Mizuno once trained as a knight, but after an injury he switched to the Begleiter programme, which trains the assistants who help knights prepare and ride. His skill with horses and his experience in the saddle make him the most sought-after Begleiter in school, and several girls, including his childhood friend Mio, ask him to partner them for the upcoming tournament. 8bit adapted Ricotta's adult visual novel into 12 episodes in 2013, combining jousting matches with harem romance. It includes heavy fan-service and nudity.

the-rolling-girls.summary: A decade on from the conflict known as the Great Tokyo War, the country has broken into ten independent states, each controlled by a gang under a superhuman leader, while ordinary people play supporting roles. Nozomi Moritomo is one of those ordinary people, a rookie in the Tokyo gang who looks up to its powerful leader, her childhood idol Masami. When Masami is badly injured, Nozomi decides to take over the jobs people across the country have asked of her. She sets off on a motorbike with three new friends, Yukina, Ai and Chiaya, and the trip takes them through one quarrelling region after another. Wit Studio's original 12-episode series aired in 2015, a colourful road adventure with punk-rock energy.

kakuriyo-no-yadomeshi.summary: College student Aoi Tsubaki can see ayakashi, the spirits of Japanese folklore, a gift she shares with the grandfather who raised her. After he dies, she keeps the hungry spirits at bay with home cooking. One day she gives food to a mysterious ayakashi, who whisks her away to the Hidden Realm and the grand inn Tenjin-ya. Its master, a powerful ogre, tells her that her grandfather ran up a huge debt there and offered her as his bride to settle it. Aoi refuses the marriage and insists on repaying what is owed by running a small restaurant at the inn. Gonzo adapted Midori Yuma's light novels into 26 episodes in 2018.

zetman.summary: Two young men in the same city end up fighting the same monsters for very different reasons. Jin Kanzaki grew up poor, raised by an elderly guardian, and carries a strange power that lets him turn into a superhuman being called ZET. Kouga Amagi is the idealistic grandson of a wealthy industrial family who wants to be a real-life hero and builds an armoured suit to fight as Alphas. Both are drawn into a hidden war against Players, monstrous creatures that prey on people, and their paths keep crossing as they learn where the creatures come from. TMS Entertainment adapted Masakazu Katsura's manga into 13 episodes in 2012. It contains graphic gore, violence and some nudity.

itsuka-tenma-no-kuro-usagi.summary: High school student Taito Kurogane has been sleeping a lot lately, and in his dreams a vampire girl keeps telling him she has left her poison inside him. He sometimes even hears her when he is awake. Then he walks away from an accident that by rights should have ended his life, and the dreams start to make sense: something has made him extremely hard to kill, and it ties him to a promise he made as a child and to a girl he had forgotten. Soon he is caught up in fights with supernatural beings at his school. Zexcs adapted Takaya Kagami's light novels into 12 episodes in 2011. It includes violence and fan-service.

dakaretai-otoko-1-i-ni-odosarete-imasu.summary: Veteran actor Takato Saijo has topped a magazine's poll of the most desirable men in show business for five straight years, and he takes the title as proof of twenty years of hard work. Then Junta Azumaya, a charming newcomer only three years into his career, knocks him off the top spot and lands the lead role in Takato's next drama. Takato is furious, but things get worse when Junta learns an embarrassing secret about him and uses it to pressure him into a physical relationship. CloverWorks adapted Hashigo Sakurabi's boys' love manga into 13 episodes in 2018, and a film covering the Spain arc followed in 2021. It contains sexual content and coercion.

white-album.summary: Touya Fujii is a university student juggling classes and part-time work, and his girlfriend Yuki Morikawa is a young singer whose idol career is just starting to take off. As Yuki gets more television spots and attention, the pair see less and less of each other, and the pressures of her industry, including her rivalry with the established star Rina Ogata, begin to strain the relationship. Meanwhile, Touya grows closer to several other women in his life, and the distance between him and Yuki keeps growing. Seven Arcs adapted the visual novel by Leaf into 13 episodes in 2009, a slow, melancholy romantic drama, and a second season followed later that year.

okusama-ga-seitokaichou-2.summary: This short second season continues My Wife Is the Student Council President!, the comedy about high school student Hayato Izumi, who lost a student council election to the outspoken Ui Wakana, became her vice president and then discovered that their parents had arranged for the two of them to marry. Now living together as husband and wife, they keep the marriage a secret at school while running the council side by side, and their constant misunderstandings at home and at school slowly bring them closer. Studio Seven produced the 12 episodes of about eight minutes each in late 2016, based on Yumi Nakata's manga. It contains heavy sexual humour and nudity.

valkyrie-drive-mermaid.summary: Sixteen-year-old Mamori Tokonome is used to being teased about her surname, which can also be read as a word for virgin. One day she is abducted during gym class and wakes up on Mermaid, an artificial island where girls carrying a strange virus are isolated. Some of them, called Exters, can turn into weapons that other girls wield in battle, and the transformation is triggered by physical arousal. Another newcomer, Mirei Shikishima, helps Mamori survive her first attack, and the two become partners. Arms produced the 12 episodes in 2015 as part of Marvelous' Valkyrie Drive franchise. It contains explicit sexual content and extensive nudity.

kamisama-hajimemashita-kamisama-kekkon-z.summary: This short OVA is the final animated episode of Kamisama Kiss, the romantic comedy about Nanami Momozono, a high school girl who became the land god of the small Mikage Shrine, and her fox spirit familiar Tomoe. With high school graduation approaching, Nanami thinks about what comes next for her and Tomoe, and she, Tomoe, Mizuki and Kurama spend time together before their lives move in new directions. The episode covers the end of the manga's story, so it is best saved until after the TV series and the Past Arc OVAs. TMS Entertainment produced the 12-minute episode, released in December 2016 with an official fanbook for Julietta Suzuki's manga.
kamisama-hajimemashita-kamisama-kekkon-z.notes: Kitsu lists 'Kamisama, Kekkon Zenya' separately, but per Wikipedia and ANN it was the announced title of the OVA released as 'Kamisama, Shiawase ni Naru' (MAL 33323); facts taken from that entry.

uchinoko.summary: Dale Reki is only eighteen, but he is already one of the most respected adventurers working out of Kreuz. While hunting monsters in a forest, he finds a small demon girl named Latina, starving and alone, with one of her horns broken off, a sign that she has been branded a criminal by her own people. Unable to leave her there, Dale takes her home to the inn where he lives and ends up raising her as his daughter. Most of the story follows everyday life as Latina grows up and learns about the world, with Dale's adventuring work in the background. Maho Film adapted Chirolu's light novels into 12 episodes in 2019.

kanojo-to-kanojo-no-neko-everything-flow.summary: Daru is a cat who has shared almost his whole life with his owner, a young woman. Told from his point of view, the series follows a difficult stretch in her life: her roommate Tomoka moves out of their apartment, and to keep it she has to look for a job, facing one rejection after another while dealing with tension at home. Every day Daru waits by the door, watching and worrying about her in the quiet way only a pet can. Liden Films made the four episodes of about seven minutes each in 2016, expanding Makoto Shinkai's 1999 short film She and Her Cat.

toaru-kagaku-no-railgun-t.summary: The third season of A Certain Scientific Railgun opens with the Daihasei Festival, the week-long sports festival in which every school in Academy City, a city of students with psychic powers, competes. Mikoto Misaka, the electricity-wielding star of Tokiwadai Middle School, is expected to dominate, but with outsiders allowed into the city for the event, hidden groups see a chance to move, and some of their plans involve her. Mikoto ends up in an uneasy alliance with her rival Misaki Shokuhou. J.C.Staff produced the 25 episodes in 2020, adapting the manga written by Kazuma Kamachi and drawn by Motoi Fuyukawa. It includes violent fights.

www-working.summary: Daisuke Higashida is a serious, rather humourless first-year at Higashizaka High School. When his father's company goes bankrupt, his allowance, phone bill and train pass all disappear, and his father tells him to find a part-time job. To save himself a long bike ride to school, Daisuke takes a job at a family restaurant close to home, a branch of the Wagnaria chain, only to find that nobody on its staff is remotely normal. The comedy comes from the clash between his stiff manner and his eccentric co-workers. A-1 Pictures produced the 13 episodes in 2016, based on Karino Takatsu's web comic, a separate cast from the original Working!! series.

hataraku-saibou-2.summary: The second season of Cells at Work! returns to the inside of a human body, where trillions of cells are drawn as workers keeping a busy city running. The cheerful but directionless Red Blood Cell AE3803 is still delivering oxygen, the stern White Blood Cell U-1146 is still hunting down invading germs, and the tiny Platelets are still patching up wounds. New episodes bring fresh threats to the body, while showing that even helpful cells can make mistakes and that not every bacterium is an enemy. David Production produced the eight episodes in early 2021, based on Akane Shimizu's manga. Each story explains real biology in a light, comic way.

strike-the-blood-ii.summary: Strike the Blood Second continues the story of Kojou Akatsuki, an ordinary high school student on the artificial island of Itogami City who has become the Fourth Primogenitor, a legendary vampire who is not supposed to exist. Yukina Himeragi, a young sword shaman sent to watch him and to kill him if he ever becomes a threat, still follows him everywhere. This season brings new magical attacks on the island, scheming organisations and more girls who end up entangled in Kojou's life. Silver Link and Connect released the eight OVA episodes between 2016 and 2017, adapting volumes 9, 11 and 12 of Gakuto Mikumo's light novels. It includes fan-service and violence.

kyoukai-no-kanata-shinonome.summary: This prequel episode to Beyond the Boundary takes place three years ahead of the events of the TV series. Hiroomi Nase, son of a powerful family of spirit hunters, is sent to deal with Akihito Kanbara, a boy who is half human and half youmu, a dangerous spirit. Hiroomi's younger sister Mitsuki, curious about the job, insists on tagging along, and that is how the siblings first come face to face with Akihito, just as they realise they are not the only ones looking for him. It shows how the trio's friendship began. Kyoto Animation released the 23-minute special in 2014 with the series' seventh Blu-ray and DVD volume, based on Nagomu Torii's light novels.

nogizaka-haruka-no-himitsu.summary: Haruka Nogizaka is the idol of Hakujo Academy: beautiful, rich, gifted at piano and admired from afar by the entire school. Her classmate Yuto Ayase is an ordinary boy, until the day he runs into her in the school library and discovers her secret: she is a devoted otaku who loves anime, manga and games and would be mortified if anyone found out. Yuto promises to keep quiet, and the two become friends, with Haruka dragging him along on nervous trips to buy the things she loves while he tries to cope with her overprotective family and jealous classmates. Diomedea adapted Yusaku Igarashi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2008.

blade-and-soul.summary: Alka is an assassin from the Clan of the Sword, cold and lethal in battle. Her master, Hon, was killed by a woman named Jin Varel, and Alka sets out across a war-torn land to track her down. Along the way she crosses paths with other skilled female warriors, each with her own aims, and has to wrestle with her master's dying wish that she give up the life of a killer. The world is shaped by a struggle between a rising empire and the old powers it wants to replace. Gonzo produced the 13 episodes in 2014, based on NCSoft's Korean online role-playing game. It contains bloody sword fights and some fan-service.

comic-girls.summary: Kaoruko Moeta, who draws under the pen name Kaos, is a teenage manga artist whose latest work has just finished last in a magazine's reader poll.
