Her editor decides she needs more life experience and sends her to live in a Tokyo dormitory for young female manga artists. Her new housemates are Tsubasa, who draws action manga for boys, Ruki, who draws racy manga for adult readers, and Koyume, an aspiring shojo artist who, like Kaoruko, has not yet had a series published. Together they juggle school, deadlines and self-doubt while cheering each other on. Nexus adapted Kaori Hanzawa's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in 2018, a gentle comedy about creative work.

donten-ni-warau.summary: In 1878, eleven years into the Meiji era, carrying swords has been banned, and bitter former samurai are rising against the new government. To hold the worst of them, the state has built a prison on an island out in Lake Biwa. The three Kumo brothers, easygoing eldest Tenka, serious Soramaru and young Chutaro, run the ferry that carries prisoners there, and they help the police on the side. Their family also has old ties to the legend of Orochi, an ancient demon serpent, and signs of its return are starting to appear. Doga Kobo adapted Kemuri Karakara's manga into 12 episodes in 2014. It includes sword violence.

high-school-dxd-new-ova.summary: This single episode is a bonus for High School DxD New, the second season of the supernatural harem comedy about Issei Hyodo, a lecherous high school boy who is brought back to life as a devil and serves the devil Rias Gremory alongside the members of her Occult Research Club. It never aired on TV; instead it came packaged with the limited edition of the light novel side-story volume High School DxD DX.1 in 2015. Its title roughly means "I'll Wrap Up the Breasts!", and like other DxD extras it is built around fan-service gags rather than plot. It is based on Ichiei Ishibumi's light novels. It contains extensive nudity and sexual humour.
high-school-dxd-new-ova.notes: MAL credits the studio as TNK and AniList as Genco, so no studio is named. No detailed plot summary found in any source.

desert-punk.summary: Far in the future, the Kanto region of Japan has become the Great Kanto Desert, a scorching wasteland of sand and ruins where people scrape by any way they can. Its most famous mercenary is a masked handyman known as Desert Punk, who always finishes the job, whatever it takes. Under the goggles he is short, greedy, lecherous and quite willing to cheat both clients and rivals, but he is also very good at what he does. The episodes follow his jobs, his scrapes with other bounty hunters such as Junko Asagiri, and, later, an apprentice. Gonzo adapted Masatoshi Usune's manga into 24 episodes from 2004 to 2005. It includes violence and crude sexual humour.

to-love-ru-darkness-ova.summary: These six episodes are extras for To Love-Ru Darkness, the sequel to To Love-Ru, the comedy about high school student Rito Yuki, whose home has filled up with alien girls since the runaway princess Lala crash-landed into his life. In Darkness, Lala's younger sister Momo schemes to build a harem around Rito, and the alien assassin Golden Darkness, known as Yami, is still meant to be targeting him. The OVAs are standalone comedy stories built around accidental groping and other fan-service. Xebec produced them between 2012 and 2015, bundled with limited editions of the manga by Saki Hasemi and Kentaro Yabuki. They contain extensive nudity and sexual humour.

umibe-no-etranger.summary: Shun Hashimoto is an aspiring novelist living on a small island in Okinawa, cut off from his family after coming out to them as gay. He keeps noticing a teenage boy who sits alone by the sea every day, and eventually speaks to him. The boy, Mio Chibana, is a reserved orphan, and the two quickly grow close, until Mio has to leave the island for the mainland. Three years later, Mio returns as a young man and tells Shun how he feels, and Shun must decide whether he is ready to accept it. Studio Hibari's 58-minute 2020 film adapts Kanna Kii's boys' love manga. It includes a brief sexual scene.

sasami-san-ganbaranai.summary: Sasami Tsukuyomi is a high school girl who has shut herself away at home and almost never goes out. She lives with her devoted older brother Kamiomi, a teacher at the school she is supposed to attend, and keeps an eye on the outside world through a computer system that mostly lets her watch him. Her quiet life becomes much stranger when the Yagami sisters, a trio of eccentric girls with unusual powers, start showing up, and it turns out Sasami's family has a long connection with the gods of Japanese myth. Akiyuki Shinbo directed the 12 episodes at Shaft in 2013, adapting the light novels by Akira. It has a surreal, playful visual style and some fan-service.

yowamushi-pedal-grande-road.summary: Grande Road is the second season of Yowamushi Pedal and carries on directly with the three-day Inter-High, the national high school road race that the first season left unfinished. Sakamichi Onoda, a cheerful anime fan who discovered he was a natural climber after years of riding a heavy mama-chari bike up a steep hill to Akihabara, rides for Sohoku High School's cycling club. With his teammates he faces the reigning champions Hakone Academy and the aggressive Kyoto Fushimi on long mountain stages where team tactics matter as much as raw strength. TMS Entertainment produced the 24 episodes from 2014 to 2015, adapting Wataru Watanabe's manga.

sin-nanatsu-no-taizai.summary: Lucifer, the proud leader of Heaven's archangels, defies God's will and is cast out. On her way down to Hell she crashes through the roof of a school chapel on Earth, where a gentle student named Maria Totsuka sees her fall. Arriving in Hell stripped of her power, Lucifer joins forces with Leviathan, an excitable admirer who wants to be a demon lord, and sets out to challenge the Seven Sins, the demon rulers of Hell led by Belial. Each sin she confronts brings a new battle. Artland and TNK produced the 12 episodes in 2017, based on Hobby Japan's figure franchise. It contains heavy nudity and explicit sexual content.

senjou-no-valkyria-gallian-chronicles.summary: On the continent of Europa, in a version of the 1930s, the East Europan Imperial Alliance invades the small neutral Principality of Gallia to seize its deposits of ragnite, a valuable mineral. When imperial troops reach the quiet border town of Bruhl, Welkin Gunther, a gentle student of nature and the son of a war hero, joins his adopted sister Isara and the town's militia leader Alicia Melchiott to get the townspeople out. All three end up in the Gallian militia's Squad 7, with Welkin in command of a tank. A-1 Pictures adapted Sega's tactical role-playing game into 26 episodes in 2009. It depicts war violence and ethnic persecution.
senjou-no-valkyria-gallian-chronicles.notes: No separate Wikipedia article for the anime; the franchise article covers it.

chaos-child.summary: Six years ago, a wave of bizarre murders known as the New Generation Madness gripped Tokyo's Shibuya district until a massive earthquake levelled it. Now Shibuya has been rebuilt, and new, grotesque killings have begun. Takuru Miyashiro, the president of his high school's newspaper club, notices that the dates of the new murders match the old ones, and he and his club members start investigating, which draws them into danger and into questions about what is real. Silver Link adapted the visual novel by Mages and Nitroplus in 2017, part of the Science Adventure series and a follow-up to Chaos;Head. It contains graphic murders, gore and disturbing imagery.
chaos-child.notes: MAL counts 12 episodes, AniList 13, so no count is given.

kore-wa-zombie-desu-ka-of-the-dead-ova.summary: This single episode belongs to the second season of Is This a Zombie?, the comedy about Ayumu Aikawa, a high school boy who was killed and brought back as a zombie by the silent necromancer Eucliwood Hellscythe. Since then he has picked up the ability to turn into a Masou Shoujo, a magical warrior girl, which means fighting monsters in a frilly dress, while sharing his house with Eucliwood, the boastful young necromancer Haruna and the vampire ninja Seraphim. The OVA is a standalone comedy story. It never aired on TV; Studio Deen made it as the season's 11th episode and released it in 2012 with a manga volume. It contains fan-service and partial nudity.

yuru-camp-2.summary: The second season of Laid-Back Camp starts just after the friends' first group camp at Christmas. Rin Shima heads off on a solo trip to watch the first sunrise of the new year from the coast, but snow closes the road home, and Nadeshiko arranges for her to spend a few nights at her grandmother's home nearby. Back in Yamanashi, Nadeshiko decides to try solo camping herself, while the Outdoor Activities Club, Chiaki, Aoi and Ena, plan new trips and take on part-time jobs to pay for gear. As before, the show lingers on campsites, cooking and scenery. C-Station produced the 13 episodes in 2021, adapting Afro's manga.

maken-ki-two.summary: Maken-Ki! Two is the second season of the action comedy set at Tenbi Academy, a school where students fight with Maken, weapons that channel their inner energy. Takeru Ohyama, a boy who enrolled mainly because the school had just gone co-ed, is now a member of the academy's Security Committee, which deals with students who misuse their Maken. As the committee takes on new opponents, the girls around Takeru keep competing for his attention while he struggles to rein in his own lechery. Xebec produced the ten episodes in 2014, adapting Hiromitsu Takeda's manga. It contains heavy fan-service, nudity and sexual humour.

itou-junji-collection.summary: Junji Ito Collection is an anthology of horror stories adapted from the work of manga artist Junji Ito, with most episodes containing one or two separate tales. Ordinary people in ordinary towns are overtaken by strange curses and obsessions: a girl whose tongue turns into a slug, a spirit that gives terrible advice at a foggy crossroads, a boy who loves to frighten people, dreams that seem to last for decades. Few stories end well, and many end on an unsettling image rather than an explanation. Studio Deen produced the 12 episodes in 2018, directed by Shinobu Tagashira, along with two OVAs. It contains disturbing body horror, gore and violence.

tsubasa-tokyo-revelations.summary: These three OVAs pick up after the second season of Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle, which follows Syaoran, Princess Sakura, the ninja Kurogane, the magician Fai and the creature Mokona as they travel between worlds collecting the feathers that hold Sakura's lost memories. Their next stop is a ruined Tokyo where acid rain has made clean water the most precious thing there is, and rival groups fight to control it. The episodes are much darker and more violent than the TV series and bring in characters from CLAMP's X. Production I.G released the OVAs in 2007 and 2008, adapting CLAMP's manga. It contains graphic violence and gore.
tsubasa-tokyo-revelations.notes: Continues from Tsubasa Chronicle season 2; followed by the Shunraiki OVAs.

strawberry-panic.summary: Three Catholic girls' schools share the grounds of Astraea Hill, and Nagisa Aoi has just transferred to one of them, St. Miator's Girls' Academy. On her first day she gets lost and runs into Shizuma Hanazono, an elegant older student, and the meeting leaves her dazed enough to need the infirmary. Her friendly roommate Tamao explains how things work on the hill, including the Etoile, a title held by the most admired student representative of all three schools, and that Shizuma currently holds it. Madhouse produced the 26-episode series in 2006, based on Sakurako Kimino's illustrated stories, centred on romance between girls. It includes some mildly sexual scenes.

trinity-seven-movie-eternity-library-to-.summary: This first Trinity Seven film follows on from the TV series about Arata Kasuga, a boy with the potential to become a Demon Lord who studies at Royal Biblia Academy alongside the Trinity Seven, seven gifted female mages. When Arata accidentally touches Hermes Apocrypha, the grimoire belonging to his teacher Lilith, a flash of light leaves a young girl named Lilim standing in front of them, and she insists the pair are her parents. At the same moment the sealed Eternal Library wakes up, along with a powerful being called the White Demon Lord, who sees Arata as a rival. Seven Arcs Pictures released the 55-minute film in 2017. It contains fan-service and nudity.

zan-sayonara-zetsubou-sensei.summary: Zan is the third TV season of Sayonara, Zetsubou-Sensei. Nozomu Itoshiki is a high school teacher who sees the worst in absolutely everything and despairs about it at length, while his class of eccentric students, from the relentlessly positive Kafuka to the order-obsessed Chiri and a girl who follows him everywhere, keeps making things worse. Each episode takes a topic, from social customs to current fads, and satirises it through rapid jokes, wordplay and hidden visual gags packed into the backgrounds. Shaft produced the 13 episodes in 2009, directed by Akiyuki Shinbo and based on Koji Kumeta's manga. Its dark humour includes frequent jokes about suicide.

naruto-takigakure-no-shitou-ore-ga-eiyuu.summary: In this standalone Naruto special, Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno are given what looks like a simple job: escort Shibuki, the timid young leader of the Hidden Waterfall Village, safely home. Their teacher Kakashi Hatake leaves once they arrive, but shortly afterwards rogue ninja attack the village and take its people hostage. The raiders, led by a man named Suien, want the Hero Water, a secret liquid that boosts a ninja's chakra many times over for a short while, and the three young ninja have to protect the village by themselves. Studio Pierrot made the 40-minute special in 2003, based on Masashi Kishimoto's manga.
naruto-takigakure-no-shitou-ore-ga-eiyuu.notes: Set during the original Naruto series; no dedicated Wikipedia article, so the franchise article is cited.

yuru-yuri-3.summary: The third season of YuruYuri returns to Nanamori Middle School and its Amusement Club, which has taken over the old tea ceremony room and exists mostly so its members can hang out. Kyoko Toshino keeps coming up with mischief, Yui Funami keeps sighing at her, Chinatsu Yoshikawa pursues her crushes, and nominal lead Akari Akaza keeps being overlooked. The student council girls drop in often, bringing their own rivalries and crushes into the chaos, from arm-wrestling contests to cooking pancakes. TYO Animations took over from the earlier seasons' studio and produced the 12 episodes in 2015, based on Namori's manga. It is a gag comedy with light girls' love themes.

corpse-party-missing-footage.summary: Corpse Party follows a group of students from Kisaragi Academy who perform a friendship charm with a paper doll after school and find themselves trapped in the ghost of Heavenly Host Elementary, a school that was torn down years ago and is haunted by vengeful spirits. This short OVA steps back to the day before that fateful charm, showing the friends going about their normal lives, with no hint of the horror ahead. Asread produced the 11-minute episode in 2012, released with a limited edition of a Corpse Party game; the franchise began with Makoto Kedoin's horror games. It is much lighter than the main story but includes mild nudity.
corpse-party-missing-footage.notes: Released before the Tortured Souls OVAs; best seen as a light side story.

log-horizon-3rd-season.summary: Six years after the second season, Log Horizon returns to the world of Elder Tale, the online game that thousands of players were pulled into during the event they call the Catastrophe. About a year has passed in the story, and Shiroe, a strategist known for his schemes, helped set up the Round Table, the council that governs the player town of Akiba. Order and prosperity have followed, but political rivalries are now pulling the council apart, and powerful monsters called Geniuses threaten the peace from outside. Shiroe and his guild must try to hold things together. Studio Deen produced the 12 episodes in 2021, adapting Mamare Touno's light novels.

lupin-iii-cagliostro-no-shiro.summary: Gentleman thief Arsene Lupin III and his partner Daisuke Jigen pull off a casino heist, only to find that the money they stole is a perfect forgery. The trail leads them to the tiny European country of Cagliostro, where they rescue a young woman, Clarisse, who is fleeing in a wedding dress from a car full of armed men. She is being forced to marry the scheming Count Cagliostro, who wants control of her family's hidden fortune, and Lupin decides to help her. Old friends and foes, including Goemon, Fujiko and Inspector Zenigata, soon join the chase. Hayao Miyazaki made his feature directing debut with this 1979 Tokyo Movie Shinsha film, based on Monkey Punch's manga.

gochuumon-wa-usagi-desu-ka-2.summary: The second season of Is the Order a Rabbit? returns to a pretty, European-style town and the Rabbit House café, where cheerful Cocoa Hoto lodges and works. Her co-workers are the quiet young Chino Kafu, who keeps a fluffy angora rabbit called Tippy on her head, and Rize Tedeza, a soldier's daughter with a military streak. Their friends Chiya and Sharo work at other cafés nearby, and Chino's classmates Maya and Megu are around more this season. The episodes follow the girls through the seasons with small adventures, school events and café work. White Fox and Kinema Citrus produced the 12 episodes in 2015, adapting Koi's four-panel manga.

tekkon-kinkreet.summary: Treasure Town is a crowded, crumbling city, and its rooftops belong to two orphaned boys known as the Cats. Black is fierce, cynical and violent, while White is younger, dreamy and childlike, and the two look after each other. Their hold on the streets is threatened when the yakuza return and a mysterious businessman plans to turn the old neighbourhood into an amusement park, sweeping away the town as they know it. As the pressure grows, the bond between the two boys is tested. Michael Arias directed the 2006 Studio 4C film, adapting Taiyo Matsumoto's manga with richly detailed city backgrounds. It contains graphic violence.

himegoto.summary: Hime Arikawa is a high school boy whose parents ran up huge debts in his name and then left him to deal with the loan sharks. While being chased by them in a maid outfit they forced him to wear, he is rescued by the student council of Shimoshina High School, who pay off the debt. The price is that Hime must transfer to their school, join the council as its servant and dress as a girl for the rest of his school life. The three council girls tease him endlessly, while other students have their own reasons to cross-dress. Asahi Production adapted Norio Tsukudani's manga into 13 short episodes of about four minutes in 2014. It contains sexual humour.

island-tv.summary: Urashima is a remote island whose people live slow, easy lives, though its three leading families have been dogged by misfortune for the past five years. One night a young man washes up on its shore with no memory of who he is, except a conviction that he has come from the future to save a girl. He is found by Rinne Ohara, heir of one of those families, who gives him the name Setsuna and takes him into her household as a servant. As he gets to know Rinne and the other girls of the island, he tries to piece together his past and his mission. Feel. adapted Frontwing's visual novel into 12 episodes in 2018.

comet-lucifer.summary: On the planet Gift, rare crystals called Giftium lie buried in the ground, and Garden Indigo, a mining town, has grown rich on them. Sogo Amagi, a teenager who got his love of crystals from his mother, a researcher, spends his free time hunting for unusual specimens. After a scuffle with classmates, he tumbles deep into an old mine shaft and finds a giant crystal holding a mysterious red-eyed girl, who comes to life and is soon being chased by soldiers. Sogo takes her under his protection, and a powerful machine seems to guard her as well. Studio 8bit's original 12-episode adventure, directed by Yasuhito Kikuchi, aired in 2015.

juubee-ninpuuchou.summary: In feudal Japan, Jubei Kibagami is a wandering swordsman for hire who wants nothing more to do with the schemes of lords and their factions. He changes his mind after saving Kagero, the last survivor of a ninja team, from a monstrous man whose skin turns hard as stone. Kagero's team had been sent to look into a plague that killed every person in one village, and the trail leads to a band of ninja with grotesque supernatural powers, the Eight Devils of Kimon, who serve a shadowy plot against the shogunate. An old government spy forces Jubei to help. Yoshiaki Kawajiri wrote and directed the 1993 film. It contains extreme gore, nudity and sexual violence.

golden-kamuy-2.summary: The second season of Golden Kamuy continues the hunt for a hoard of Ainu gold in early 20th century Hokkaido. The man who stole it tattooed pieces of a map onto fellow prisoners before they escaped, so the map can only be put together from their skins. Saichi Sugimoto, a Russo-Japanese War veteran nicknamed Sugimoto the Immortal, and Asirpa, a young Ainu hunter, keep travelling in search of the remaining convicts, while the army's 7th Division under the cunning Lieutenant Tsurumi and a group led by the old samurai Hijikata Toshizo pursue the same goal. Geno Studio produced the 12 episodes in 2018, adapting Satoru Noda's manga. It contains graphic violence and nudity.

sora-no-method.summary: Nonoka Komiya returns to the lakeside town of Kiriya after seven years away and finds something she does not remember: a huge flying saucer hovering silently over the lake, which some locals are campaigning to get rid of. She also meets Noel, a cheerful girl in strange clothes who seems to know her, and slowly reconnects with the childhood friends she left behind, including Koharu, Shione and the twins Yuzuki and Souta. Some of them are not pleased to see her, and the saucer turns out to be tied to a wish the group once made together. Studio 3Hz produced the original 13-episode series in 2014, which Naoki Hisaya created and wrote.

dansai-bunri-no-crime-edge.summary: Kiri Haimura has a peculiar obsession: he loves cutting hair. Hearing rumours of a long-haired ghost living in a derelict mansion on a hilltop, he goes to look and finds Iwai Mushanokoji, a girl whose hair cannot be cut because of a family curse. She is the Hair Queen, at the centre of a deadly game: anyone who kills her with one of the Killing Goods, cursed objects once used by famous murderers, will have a wish granted. Their owners are called Authors, and Kiri learns that the scissors he has carried all his life are one of them. Studio Gokumi adapted Tatsuhiko Hikagi's manga into 13 episodes in 2013. It contains violence and fetishistic themes.

digimon-frontier.summary: Takuya Kanbara receives a strange message on his phone telling him to board a train, and follows it to an underground station, where he and four other children, Koji, Zoe, J.P. and Tommy, are carried off to the Digital World. That world is in danger because Cherubimon, one of the three great angel Digimon who once protected it, has turned evil. Unlike the heroes of earlier Digimon series, these children do not get partner Digimon; instead they find the spirits of ancient Legendary Warriors and fuse with them to become Digimon themselves. Toei Animation produced the 50 episodes from 2002 to 2003, the fourth Digimon TV series.
digimon-frontier.notes: Names follow the English dub (Zoe and J.P. are Izumi and Junpei in Japanese).

fate-prototype.summary: Fate/Prototype is a short animated look at Kinoko Nasu's early concept for what later became Fate/stay night. It is set in Tokyo, where a second Holy Grail War, a secret battle between mages and the legendary heroes they summon as Servants, is about to begin. Ayaka Sajyou comes from a family of mages but wants no part in the war that took her father and sister. When she is attacked, she ends up summoning a Servant of her own, a young knight called Saber. Lerche produced the 12-minute OVA, directed by Seiji Kishi, and it was released at the end of 2011 with the third home video volume of Carnival Phantasm.
fate-prototype.notes: A short teaser-like piece rather than a complete story.

kami-nomi-zo-shiru-sekai-yonin-to-idol.summary: This OVA is a side story for The World God Only Knows, the comedy about Keima Katsuragi, a gamer famous online as the God of Conquest for beating any dating sim, who must win the hearts of real girls to drive out runaway spirits hiding inside them, with help from the demon Elsie. Here Elsie and two of Keima's classmates, Chihiro and Miyako, decide to start a band and turn to Keima for help, and along the way they cross paths with the pop idol Kanon. Manglobe produced the episode in 2011, released with the 14th volume of Tamiki Wakaki's manga and adapting two of its early chapters. It is set after the second TV season.

urara-meirochou.summary: Meirocho, a town shaped like a maze, is home to the urara, female fortune-tellers known throughout the land for their skill. Chiya, a wild, barefoot girl who grew up in the mountains surrounded by animals, arrives to train as an urara, hoping one day to use divination to find her missing mother. She is placed at the lowest rank alongside three other apprentices, the studious Kon, the excitable Koume and the shy Nono, and the four share lessons, tests and everyday mishaps as they work to rise through the ranks. J.C.Staff adapted Harikamo's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in 2017, a light comedy with a little fantasy and some fan-service.

udon-no-kuni-no-kiniro-kemari.summary: Souta Tawara works as a web designer in Tokyo and comes back to his hometown in Kagawa Prefecture, famous for its udon, to deal with the family noodle shop his late father ran. In the empty restaurant he finds a little boy asleep in one of the big udon pots. When the boy suddenly sprouts furry ears and a tail, Souta realises he is a tanuki, one of the shapeshifting raccoon dogs of Japanese folklore. With nowhere else for the child to go, Souta names him Poco and starts looking after him, while reconnecting with old friends in town. Liden Films adapted Nodoka Shinomaru's manga into 12 episodes in 2016, a calm, gentle story about family.

shikioriori.summary: Flavors of Youth is an anthology of three short films, each set in a different Chinese city and each about growing up and looking back. In Sunny Breakfast, a young man working in Beijing remembers the bowls of rice noodles from his childhood in the countryside and the people he shared them with. A Small Fashion Show follows two sisters in Guangzhou, one a successful model worried about being replaced by younger faces. Love in Shanghai is about a first love kept alive through an old cassette tape. Japan's CoMix Wave Films and China's Haoliners Animation League co-produced the 2018 film, with Yi Xiaoxing, Li Haoling and Yoshitaka Takeuchi directing.

digimon-adventure-tri-1-saikai.summary: Three years after the way into the Digital World was sealed, Taichi Yagami is now a high school second-year, and the original DigiDestined have drifted apart as they think about their futures, which Taichi still cannot picture. When a wild Kuwagamon suddenly appears in Tokyo and wreaks havoc, Taichi chases after it, and his old Digivice leads him back to his partner Agumon. Soon the rest of the group are reunited with their Digimon, but these new attacks come from Digimon that have been mysteriously infected. Toei Animation released the 89-minute film in 2015, the first of six parts of Digimon Adventure tri., a sequel to Digimon Adventure and Adventure 02 made for the franchise's 15th anniversary.

saenai-heroine-no-sodatekata-episode-0-a.summary: This special aired as episode 0 of Saekano, the comedy about otaku Tomoya Aki and the dating sim he is making with a group of talented girls under the name Blessing Software. It jumps ahead to a point where the team's game is almost finished: to get it over the line, they head to a hot spring town in the countryside on a location-scouting trip. Illustrator Eriri and quiet heroine model Megumi focus on work, while scriptwriter Utaha and musician Michiru have other ideas about how to spend time with Tomoya, and the result is a run of fan-service gags. A-1 Pictures made it in 2015, based on Fumiaki Maruto's light novels. It contains heavy fan-service.
saenai-heroine-no-sodatekata-episode-0-a.notes: Set later than episode 1 and introduces a character the series only brings in later; AniList has no entry for it.

liz-to-aoi-tori.summary: Third-years Mizore Yoroizuka and Nozomi Kasaki play in the concert band at Kitauji High School and have been close since middle school: Mizore is quiet and plays the oboe, while Nozomi is outgoing and plays the flute. For their final competition the band chooses a piece based on a fairy tale about a lonely girl named Liz and a blue bird who comes to live with her, and its third movement hinges on a duet between the two of them. As they rehearse, small cracks in their friendship begin to show. Naoko Yamada directed the 2018 Kyoto Animation film, a spin-off of the Sound! Euphonium novels by Ayano Takeda.

naruto-find-the-crimson-four-leaf-clover.summary: In this short Naruto special, Konohamaru, the Third Hokage's grandson, has fallen for a girl named Kaede, but her family is about to leave the Hidden Leaf Village because of her father's work. Desperate to stop her going, he asks Naruto Uzumaki for help finding a crimson four-leaf clover from local legend, said to grant any wish to whoever holds it. Naruto happily agrees, even though the clover grows somewhere they are forbidden to go, and the two set off on a small but risky adventure of their own. Studio Pierrot made the 17-minute special in 2003, directed by Hayato Date and based on Masashi Kishimoto's manga. It is a light comedy.
naruto-find-the-crimson-four-leaf-clover.notes: No Wikipedia article; sources are MyAnimeList and AniList.

kaichou-wa-maid-sama-omake-dayo.summary: This short extra for Maid Sama! is a comedy about Misaki Ayuzawa, the fierce student council president of a mostly male high school, who secretly works part-time at a maid café to support her family. After tearing her maid uniform at work, Misaki brings it home hoping her mother will mend it, but her younger sister Suzuna fixes it instead and then wants to try it on, much to Misaki's alarm. While Misaki tries to stop things getting out of hand, unexpected visitors turn up at the house. J.C.Staff produced the 13-minute special in 2011 for the series' tenth Blu-ray and DVD volume, based on Hiro Fujiwara's manga.

kill-me-baby.summary: Yasuna Oribe is a cheerful, scatterbrained high school girl, and her best friend Sonya is a professional assassin from abroad. Sonya's training means she reacts to any surprise with violence, so Yasuna's attempts to hug her, sneak up on her or play pranks on her usually end with Yasuna twisted into a painful knot. Agiri, a laid-back ninja who shows off dubious ninja techniques, rounds out the small cast. Episodes are made of quick, repetitive gags in school and around town, with the same jokes coming back again and again. J.C.Staff adapted Kaduho's four-panel manga into 13 episodes in 2012. It is full of slapstick violence.

kurokami-the-animation.summary: In this world, every person has two others who look exactly like them and share a single pool of life energy, called Terra; if one of the three takes too much, the others suffer. High school student Keita Ibuki has watched the people close to him die one after another, so he keeps everyone at a distance, even his childhood friend Akane. One evening at a ramen stand he meets Kuro, a girl with superhuman strength who calls herself a Mototsumitama, and soon he is caught up in her fight against others like her. Sunrise adapted the Korean-Japanese manga by Dall-Young Lim and Park Sung-woo into 23 episodes in 2009. It contains violent fights and some bloodshed.

pokemon-diamond-pearl.summary: After his travels through Hoenn and the Battle Frontier, Ash Ketchum sets out for the Sinnoh region with Pikachu. Before he even arrives, Team Rocket's latest attempt to steal Pikachu leaves it lost in the forest, and Ash's search brings him together with Dawn, a new trainer who wants to become a top Pokemon Coordinator. With his old friend Brock, they travel across Sinnoh, Ash collecting Gym Badges while Dawn competes in Pokemon Contests, and Ash clashes repeatedly with Paul, a cold rival who treats his Pokemon harshly. OLM produced the 191 episodes from 2006 to 2010, based on the Pokemon games, directed by Kunihiko Yuyama.
pokemon-diamond-pearl.notes: Names follow the English dub (Ash, Dawn, Brock and Paul are Satoshi, Hikari, Takeshi and Shinji in Japanese). Covers all Diamond & Pearl seasons.

watashi-ni-tenshi-ga-maiorita.summary: Miyako Hoshino is a painfully shy university student who spends most of her time at home sewing cosplay outfits. When her lively younger sister Hinata, a fifth-grader, brings home a new classmate named Hana Shirosaki, Miyako is instantly smitten with how cute the girl is. Too nervous to talk to her normally, she tries to win Hana over with homemade sweets in exchange for modelling her costumes, which does not make a good first impression. Gradually more girls from Hinata's class join in, and Miyako has to step out of her shell. Doga Kobo adapted Nanatsu Mukunoki's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in 2019. The comedy centres on an adult's crush on a child.

heaven-s-lost-property-ova.summary: This single episode is a bonus for Heaven's Lost Property, the comedy about Tomoki Sakurai, a boy who wants a quiet life but ends up living with Ikaros, a winged girl called an Angeloid who fell from the sky and calls him master. In the OVA the group, including Ikaros, Nymph and Tomoki's childhood friend Sohara, spend a day at an indoor swimming pool, where Tomoki's perverted schemes cause the usual chaos, while Nymph quietly wonders whether to ask him to be her new master. AIC ASTA released the episode in 2010 without airing it on TV, as it was considered too racy, based on Suu Minazuki's manga. It contains heavy nudity and sexual humour.
heaven-s-lost-property-ova.notes: MAL title: Sora no Otoshimono: Project Pink. Set during the first season.

shigurui.summary: In 1629, early in the Edo period, the cruel lord Tokugawa Tadanaga stages a martial arts tournament in which the duels are fought with real swords instead of wooden ones. The first bout pits two crippled swordsmen against each other: the one-armed Gennosuke Fujiki and the blind Seigen Irako, both former students of the great master Kogan Iwamoto. From there the story goes back in time to show how the two came to their injuries and their hatred, inside a dojo ruled by fear and brutality. Madhouse adapted Takayuki Yamaguchi's manga, itself based on a novel by Norio Nanjo, into 12 episodes in 2007. It contains extreme gore, nudity and sexual violence.

fate-kaleid-liner-prisma-illya-2wei-herz.summary: The third season of Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya continues the magical girl spin-off of Fate/stay night, about Illyasviel von Einzbern, an ordinary schoolgirl talked into becoming a magical girl by the meddling magical wand Kaleidostick Ruby. With her partner Miyu and her mischievous double Kuro now part of everyday life, Illya hopes for a quiet summer, but a trip to the beach kicks off a string of comic mishaps involving love potions, magical feuds and more. Then the girls learn of an eighth Class Card, and the story turns more serious. Silver Link produced the ten episodes in 2015, adapting Hiroshi Hiroyama's manga. It includes fan-service.

akkun-to-kanojo.summary: Atsuhiro Kagari, known as Akkun, has the girlfriend he always wanted, the sweet and easygoing Non Katagiri. The problem is that he is so embarrassed by his own feelings that he treats her coldly, insulting her and brushing off any affection in public. In private, though, he is completely devoted to her, secretly photographing her, listening in on her conversations and fretting over every detail of her day. Luckily Non sees through the act and finds his behaviour endearing, while their friends watch on in disbelief. Yumeta Company adapted Waka Kakitsubata's manga into 25 short episodes of about three minutes each in 2018. The comedy plays verbal abuse and stalking for laughs.

samurai-7.summary: Far in the future, after a long war fought by samurai who replaced their bodies with machines, peace has returned, but farming villages are at the mercy of the Nobuseri, mechanised bandits who take their rice and their daughters. The people of Kanna Village decide to fight back. Kirara, the village's water priestess, her little sister Komachi and a young farmer named Rikichi travel to a sprawling city to recruit samurai willing to defend them, able to offer nothing but rice in return. One by one they gather seven warriors, led by the veteran Kambei Shimada. Gonzo produced the 26 episodes in 2004, reimagining Akira Kurosawa's 1954 film Seven Samurai. It includes violence.

dragon-ball-z-movie-10-kiken-na-futari-s.summary: After his defeat by Goku in the film Broly: The Legendary Super Saiyan, the berserker Saiyan Broly crash-landed on Earth in a pod and fell into a long, dormant sleep. Years later, Goten, Trunks and Videl are out hunting for the Dragon Balls when they arrive at a village where a shady shaman is demanding a human sacrifice to calm a so-called monster. The trouble begins when Goten's crying wakes Broly, who mistakes the boy for Goku, the Saiyan he hates above all others, and goes on a rampage. Gohan rushes to help. Toei Animation released the 50-minute film in March 1994, directed by Shigeyasu Yamauchi and based on Akira Toriyama's manga.

dragon-ball-z-movie-06-gekitotsu-100-oku.summary: A huge mechanical mass called the Big Gete Star latches onto New Namek and starts draining the planet's energy. Dende, now Earth's guardian, learns that his people are in danger and asks Goku and his friends for help. When they reach New Namek, they find the Namekians enslaved by an army of robots, and the force in charge turns out to be Cooler, Frieza's older brother, rebuilt and enhanced by the Big Gete Star's technology. Goku and Vegeta face a foe who can repair and copy himself. Toei Animation released the 45-minute film in March 1992, directed by Daisuke Nishio and based on Akira Toriyama's manga. It follows Cooler's Revenge.

pokemon-xy.summary: Ash Ketchum and Pikachu arrive in Lumiose City in the Kalos region, eager to start a new journey and earn new Gym Badges. Ash quickly meets Clemont, a young inventor, and his energetic little sister Bonnie, just as Team Rocket's latest scheme leaves a Garchomp rampaging through the city. Watching the news coverage in her quiet home town, a girl named Serena recognises Ash as a boy she met as a child and sets out to find him, unsure of her own goals. The four travel together across Kalos, where Mega Evolution plays a growing role. OLM produced the 93 episodes from 2013 to 2015, based on the Pokemon X and Y games.
pokemon-xy.notes: Names follow the English dub (Ash, Clemont, Bonnie are Satoshi, Citron, Eureka in Japanese).

konjiki-no-gash-bell.summary: Kiyo Takamine is a 14-year-old genius who has stopped going to school because he cannot get along with anyone. His father, working in England, sends him a strange little boy named Zatch, whom he found in a forest, along with a red book that only Kiyo can read. Zatch is a mamodo, one of 100 demon children sent to Earth to battle each other to decide the next king of their world. Each mamodo needs a human partner who reads spells from its book, and a mamodo whose book is burned is sent home. Toei Animation adapted Makoto Raiku's manga into 150 episodes between 2003 and 2006, directed by Yukio Kaizawa.
konjiki-no-gash-bell.notes: Names follow the English dub (Zatch and Kiyo are Gash and Kiyomaro in Japanese).

mahou-shoujo-lyrical-nanoha.summary: Nanoha Takamachi is a cheerful third-grader with an ordinary life until she takes in an injured ferret she had already seen in a dream. The ferret turns out to be Yuno, a young mage from another world, who admits he accidentally scattered twenty-one dangerous artifacts called Jewel Seeds around her town. Too weak to gather them himself, he hands Nanoha a magical device named Raising Heart, and she discovers a natural gift for spellcasting. The hunt soon brings her face to face with Fate Testarossa, a quiet and formidable girl collecting the same seeds for reasons of her own. Seven Arcs produced this 13-episode original series in 2004, written by Masaki Tsuzuki; it launched a long-running franchise.

hayate-no-gotoku-2.summary: The second Hayate the Combat Butler season returns to Hayate Ayasaki, a hard-luck teenager working as live-in butler and bodyguard to Nagi Sanzenin, a sharp-tongued, reclusive young heiress, to pay off an enormous debt. Between household duties and classes at the demanding Hakuo Academy, he keeps stumbling into trouble, and his kindness keeps winning over girls around him, including the very ordinary Ayumu Nishizawa, without his noticing. Nagi's own feelings for him remain a running thread under the slapstick, alongside the show's habit of parodying other anime and games. J.C.Staff took over from the first season's studio and produced these 25 episodes in 2009, adapting Kenjiro Hata's manga.

love-live-school-idol-project-movie.summary: Set after the second TV season, the film finds Honoka Kosaka and the nine members of the school idol group μ's facing the end of their run, with their senior members graduating. Before they part ways, an unexpected invitation flies them to New York to perform and introduce the city to school idols. Back in Japan, they discover that their fame has grown far beyond anything they imagined, with fans mobbing them in the street, and everyone from the rival group A-RISE to their own school wants them to keep going. Honoka has to weigh what the group owes its supporters against the promise its members made. Sunrise produced the film, which opened in Japanese cinemas in June 2015.

no-guns-life.summary: After a great war, people rebuilt with mechanical bodies, known as Extended, live alongside ordinary citizens, and much of their technology comes from the powerful Berühren Corporation. Juzo Inui is an Extended whose whole head is a giant revolver that only someone standing behind him can fire. He remembers nothing from before the conversion and now makes a living as a Resolver who handles trouble involving other cyborgs. When a runaway Extended bursts into his office with a boy named Tetsuro and begs for his protection, Juzo is dragged into a fight with the corporation. Madhouse adapted Tasuku Karasuma's manga into this 12-episode first season in 2019; a second followed in 2020. It contains frequent gunfights and violence.

miira-no-kaikata.summary: Sora Kashiwagi's adventurer father has a habit of shipping home strange souvenirs from his travels, so when a huge crate arrives from Egypt, the high schooler braces himself for something awful. Instead, out climbs Mii-kun, a mummy small enough to sit in his palm, timid, fragile and hungry for affection. Sora decides to look after him, and caring for such an odd little pet turns out to take real patience. Friends soon turn up with odd creatures of their own, and the cast grows into a small, warm circle. 8bit adapted Kakeru Utsugi's web manga, first published on Comico, into this 12-episode comedy in 2018. Its tone stays gentle, built on small everyday moments rather than adventure.

accel-world-ex.summary: Accel World EX is two short side stories bundled with limited editions of two Accel World games in 2012 and 2013, best watched after the TV series. In the first, an unknown avatar hijacks the school's local network at Umesato and leaves students stripped of their clothing and belongings, so Kuroyukihime rallies Haruyuki Arita and the rest of the Nega Nebulus legion to find the culprit. In the second, Haruyuki has a physical re-examination coming up, and failing it would bench him from territory battles, so his childhood friend Chiyuri Kurashima pushes him into a fitness routine. Sunrise animated both episodes from Reki Kawahara's light novels. Both lean on comedic fan service and partial nudity.

onee-chan-ga-kita.summary: When his father remarries, 13-year-old Tomoya Mizuhara suddenly gains a 17-year-old stepsister, Ichika, who turns out to be far more devoted to him than he would like. She smothers him with attention at every chance, while Tomoya tries to keep some distance and a little dignity. Her friends only make it worse: Ruri enjoys tormenting people with a sadistic streak, and Marina, who is a quarter non-Japanese, brings her own brand of chaos. Each episode runs only about three minutes and is built from quick gags around the household. C2C adapted Riko Anzai's four-panel manga into this 12-episode short series in 2014. The humour leans on the stepsister's obsessive affection and includes mild fan service.

bleach-memories-in-the-rain.summary: Memories in the Rain is a short Bleach special released in 2004, shortly before the TV series premiered, and it retells material from early in the story. Ichigo Kurosaki, a teenager who has taken over the duties of a Soul Reaper from Rukia Kuchiki, is out hunting Hollows, the wandering evil spirits that prey on souls, when he finally comes across the one responsible for his mother's death years earlier. The encounter becomes a personal, angry fight, and Rukia watches to see whether he can keep his head while facing it. Studio Pierrot animated the special from Tite Kubo's manga. Newcomers will get more from it after the opening episodes of the main series. It includes intense supernatural combat.

gakuen-babysitters-ova.summary: This single bonus episode of School Babysitters came with the series' seventh Blu-ray and DVD volume in 2018 and is meant for viewers who have finished the TV run. Exams are coming up, so Ryuichi Kashima steps back from the academy's daycare room to study, and his little brother Kotaro and the other toddlers copy him by practising their own writing. Ryuichi also wants to thank his classmate Saikawa for helping him get through the tests, which means quietly working out what he actually likes. A second segment has the cast performing their own version of Snow White. Brain's Base animated it, as with the 12-episode TV series, from Hari Tokeino's manga. The tone is soft and family-friendly.

saint-seiya.summary: Long ago, warriors called Saints served the goddess Athena, fighting bare-handed with strength drawn from the Cosmos, an energy that lives within each person. In the present day, the orphan Seiya comes home to Japan after six years of brutal training, having earned the Pegasus Cloth, a sacred suit of armour. He hopes to find his missing sister, and the wealthy Saori Kido offers to help if he fights in a tournament against other young Saints. There he meets Shiryu, Hyoga, Shun and Ikki, and they are soon drawn into a far larger struggle. Toei Animation adapted Masami Kurumada's manga into this 114-episode series, broadcast from 1986 to 1989. Its fights are frequent and often bloody.

hunter-x-hunter-the-last-mission.summary: The second Hunter x Hunter film is an original story built around the cast of Madhouse's 2011 TV series. Decades ago, Hunter Association chairman Isaac Netero imprisoned Jed, a Hunter skilled in On, a dark counterpart to the life energy known as Nen. Now Jed's followers resurface at Heavens Arena while Hunters are gathered there, launching an attack meant to wipe the Association out and expose wrongs buried in its past. Gon and Killua are pulled into the fighting and forced to wonder what Netero has been hiding. Madhouse produced the film, released in Japanese cinemas at the end of December 2013, using characters from Yoshihiro Togashi's manga. It is action-heavy, with some violent scenes.

fairy-gone.summary: In a world where fairies live inside animals and give them strange powers, people learned that transplanting a possessed animal's organs into a human lets them summon the fairy as a fighting partner. These Fairy Soldiers fought in a long war that ended with the continent united under one ruler. Nine years later, many veterans have drifted into crime, the mafia or terrorism. Marlya Noel, who is searching for a childhood friend lost to that world, joins Dorothea, a government unit that hunts illegal fairy users, and is paired with the veteran Free Underbar. Fairy Gone is an original P.A. Works series; this first 12-episode cour aired in spring 2019, with a second that autumn. Expect gunfights and violence.

initial-d-third-stage.summary: Initial D Third Stage is a feature film that continues from the Second Stage TV series. Takumi Fujiwara, the quiet teenager who became a mountain-pass legend in his father's Toyota AE86, is still shaken by a loss to Kyoichi Sudo of Team Emperor, which came when his engine gave out. Ryosuke Takahashi of the Akagi RedSuns invites him to join a new racing team built to reach a professional level, but Takumi cannot decide. First he wants a rematch with Sudo, and a fresh challenge comes from Kai Kogashiwa, a young driver whose father was once a rival of Takumi's father, Bunta. Studio Deen made the 104-minute film, released in January 2001, from Shuichi Shigeno's manga.

daitoshokan-no-hitsujikai.summary: Shiomi Academy is home to a library so vast it rivals the national one, and a school rumour holds that a mysterious 'Shepherd' grants the wishes of students who work hard. Kyotaro Kakei, a bookish second-year who would rather read alone, receives a message warning that something is about to change his future. Rushing to a nearby station, he saves fellow student Tsugumi Shirasaki from a train accident, and she joins his Library Club, pulling him into her plan to help classmates with their troubles. More girls join as the club grows. Hoods Entertainment and Felix Film adapted August's visual novel, originally an adult PC game, into this 12-episode romantic comedy in 2014. It includes some fan service.

rakuen-tsuihou-expelled-from-paradise.summary: In the far future, most of humanity has abandoned a ruined Earth to live as digital minds inside DEVA, a virtual paradise aboard an orbiting station where nobody ages or goes hungry. When a hacker calling himself Frontier Setter keeps breaking into DEVA's network, the young officer Angela Balzac is given a cloned organic body and sent down to the planet to track him. On the dusty surface she is paired with Dingo, a laid-back local agent who has never given up his flesh, and the two clash over how a person should live. Directed by Seiji Mizushima from a screenplay by Gen Urobuchi, the 2014 science-fiction film was animated by Graphinica and produced by Toei Animation.

chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-ren-the-ri.summary: The Rikka Wars is an unaired extra episode of the second Chunibyo season, included on its seventh Blu-ray and DVD volume in 2014. On an ordinary school day, Rikka Takanashi spots Makoto Isshiki secretly handing a flash drive to her boyfriend, Yuta Togashi. Convinced Yuta is hiding something, she gets her friends to help find out what is on it, and the answer, photos of an idol he adored in middle school, bothers her far more than it should. Kyoto Animation produced it, as with the rest of the series, from Torako's light novels. It is a light comedy for viewers who have finished that season.
chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-ren-the-ri.notes: Episode plot rests on the MAL synopsis (Kitsu mirrors it); AniList confirms only the release format. Wikipedia link is the franchise article, which does not cover this episode.

tegami-bachi-letter-bee.summary: Amberground is a land of near-permanent darkness lit only by an artificial sun, and its wilds are roamed by huge armoured insects called Gaichuu. Letter Bees are government couriers who brave those roads to deliver letters and parcels. As a small boy, Lag Seeing is himself sent as a parcel and carried by Gauche Suede, a devoted Bee whose courage leaves a lasting mark on him. Years later, Lag sets out to become a Bee himself, accompanied by Niche, his fierce, peculiar partner known as a Dingo, and learns that letters carry people's hearts. Based on Hiroyuki Asada's manga, this 25-episode first season aired from 2009 to 2010 and was followed by Tegami Bachi: Reverse.

sidonia-no-kishi-daikyuu-wakusei-seneki.summary: The second season of Knights of Sidonia picks up after the generation ship narrowly avoids a collision with a massive Gauna, an escape that comes at a heavy cost and leads Captain Kobayashi to tighten her hold on power. She sets Sidonia on a course to destroy the alien Gauna nest in the Lem system, relying on new long-range weapons and on Tsumugi Shiraui, a being part human and part Gauna who fights alongside the Garde pilots. Ace pilot Nagate Tanikaze, meanwhile, is caught between the crew's distrust of Tsumugi and his ties to the people around him. Polygon Pictures produced these 12 episodes in 3D CG in 2015, adapting Tsutomu Nihei's manga. Its battles carry grim casualties.

inazuma-eleven.summary: Raimon Junior High's soccer club barely exists: it has only a handful of members, most of whom would rather not practise, and the school is ready to shut it down. Its captain, goalkeeper Mamoru Endo, refuses to give up, inspired by his late grandfather, a legendary keeper who led the original Inazuma Eleven. When the gifted striker Shuya Goenji transfers to the school having quit the sport, Endo sets out to win him over and rebuild a full squad able to face the country's best teams. Matches are packed with flashy special moves closer to fighting-game attacks than real football. OLM adapted Level-5's video game into this 127-episode series, broadcast from 2008 to 2011.

fune-wo-amu.summary: At the publisher Genbu Shobo, veteran editor Kohei Araki is nearing retirement and desperate to find someone who can carry on the dictionary department's ambitious new project, a dictionary called The Great Passage. He finds an unlikely candidate in Mitsuya Majime, an awkward young salesman who struggles with people but thinks about words with unusual care. Moving to the dictionary team, Majime works alongside the easygoing, sociable Masashi Nishioka and learns that building a dictionary takes years of patience. Away from work he falls for Kaguya, the granddaughter of his landlady. Zexcs adapted Shion Miura's novel into this 11-episode series, which aired on Fuji TV's Noitamina block in 2016. It is a quiet workplace drama with a slow-burn romance.

dagashi-kashi-2.summary: Dagashi Kashi's second season returns to the Shikada family's cheap-sweets shop in a quiet countryside town. Kokonotsu Shikada still wants to become a manga artist instead of inheriting the store from his father, and Hotaru Shidare, the eccentric daughter of a major confectionery company, still drops by to lecture him on dagashi, the inexpensive Japanese snacks children buy with pocket change. His childhood friends, the twins Tou and Saya Endou, are back too, and Saya is still quietly fond of Kokonotsu. Episodes are shorter this time, at about twelve minutes each. Tezuka Productions took over animation from Feel for these 12 episodes in 2018, adapting Kotoyama's manga. Expect light comedy and snack trivia.

shoujo-tachi-wa-kouya-wo-mezasu.summary: Buntaro Hojo has no idea what to do with his life, though he once wrote a well-received script for the drama club. His classmate Sayuki Kuroda, a striking and determined girl, notices that talent and invites him somewhere he assumes is a date. It turns out to be a job interview: she is putting together a team to make a bishoujo romance game and wants him as its scenario writer. With other classmates, they try to turn an amateur idea into a finished product, learning about deadlines and each other. Project No.9 adapted the visual novel, written by Romeo Tanaka, into this 12-episode series in 2016, focused on creative ambition and teenage uncertainty.

dragon-ball-z-movie-03-chikyuu-marugoto-.summary: The third Dragon Ball Z film begins with Gohan, Krillin, Bulma and Oolong on a camping trip, when a crashing pod sets the forest ablaze so the friends wish the trees back with the Dragon Balls. Soon after, a band of space pirates plants a seed at the crash site. It grows into the Tree of Might, which drains the life from a planet to produce fruit that grants enormous power, and its owner is Turles, a Saiyan who looks strikingly like Goku. Goku and his allies race to stop the tree before Earth becomes a wasteland. Toei Animation released this standalone side story in July 1990, based on Akira Toriyama's manga. It is full of martial-arts fights.

dragon-ball-z-movie-01-ora-no-gohan-wo-k.summary: The first Dragon Ball Z film pits Goku against a villain whose grudge is older than he is. Garlic Jr., the son of a demon who long ago lost the role of Earth's guardian to Kami, sends his henchmen to gather the Dragon Balls so he can wish for immortality and take revenge. One of the balls sits on young Gohan's hat, so they ambush Chi-Chi and the Ox-King and carry the boy away. Goku borrows the Dragon Radar and gives chase, with help from an unlikely source. Toei Animation released the film in July 1989, based on Akira Toriyama's manga; it works as a prelude to the TV series, which later gave Garlic Jr. an arc.

tetsuwan-birdy-decode.summary: Birdy Cephon Altera is a hot-headed officer of the Space Federation police who comes to Earth chasing alien fugitives, hiding in plain sight as a rising teen model named Shion Arita. During one chase, an ordinary high school student, Tsutomu Senkawa, is caught in the crossfire and fatally injured. To keep him alive while his body is rebuilt, Birdy takes his consciousness into her own body, so the two must share it, trading control as she hunts criminals and he tries to keep up a normal school life. A-1 Pictures adapted Masami Yuki's manga into this 13-episode series in 2008; a second season, Decode:02, followed in 2009. Action scenes include some violence.

one-piece-2000.summary: The first One Piece film takes place early in the Straw Hat crew's voyage, when the hungry crew of the Going Merry is still sailing the East Blue. According to legend, the Great Gold Pirate Woonan amassed roughly one-third of all the gold in the world before disappearing to a hidden island. When a pirate captain named El Drago robs the Straw Hats on his way to claim that fortune, Luffy and his friends give chase to get their stolen treasure back, and Usopp ends up on the island ahead of the others. Toei Animation released the film in March 2000, based on Eiichiro Oda's manga; it is the only One Piece film made with traditional cel animation.

yamato-nadeshiko-shichi-henge.summary: After a boy she liked called her ugly, Sunako Nakahara retreated into a gloomy world of horror films, anatomical models and darkness, and she now flinches at anything beautiful. Her wealthy, flighty aunt sends her to live in a mansion with four strikingly handsome young men, led by the hot-tempered Kyohei Takano, and strikes a deal with them: they can live there rent-free if they can make Sunako a refined young lady. Sunako has no intention of cooperating, and the boys' efforts keep backfiring in loud, slapstick ways, though the five slowly grow close. Nippon Animation adapted part of Tomoko Hayakawa's manga, also published in English as The Wallflower, into this 25-episode comedy, broadcast from 2006 to 2007.

oushitsu-kyoushi-haine.summary: Heine Wittgenstein is a sharp, unflappable scholar who is constantly mistaken for a child because of his small stature. The king of Glanzreich summons him to the palace for a job that has already defeated several predecessors: teaching the four younger princes, all candidates for the throne. Kai is shy but looks fierce, Bruno is a proud academic, Leonhard is a stubborn boy who hates studying, and Licht is a flirt who spends his evenings working in a cafe. Heine has to earn each one's trust before he can teach them anything, using patience and the occasional well-timed scolding. Bridge adapted Higasa Akai's manga into this 12-episode comedy in 2017. Its humour is gentle and character-driven.

katsugeki-touken-ranbu.summary: In 1863, as Japan's samurai era nears its end, two sword warriors arrive from the future. Izuminokami Kanesada and Horikawa Kunihiro are the human forms of swords once carried by Toshizo Hijikata of the Shinsengumi, and their task is to stop the Time Retrograde Army, invaders who travel back to rewrite key moments of history. Joined by other sword spirits from their citadel, they fight in different eras while Kanesada struggles with the knowledge that protecting history means letting events, including painful ones for his former master, play out. Ufotable produced this 13-episode series in 2017, based on the browser game Touken Ranbu. It has fast, polished sword fights and some bloodshed.

fukigen-na-mononokean.summary: Hanae Ashiya has spent his first week of high school in the infirmary, steadily weakened by a fluffy spirit that latched onto him before term began. Desperate, he follows a flyer to the Mononokean, a tearoom that exists between worlds and is run by a young exorcist named Haruitsuki Abeno. Abeno is irritable, blunt and never hides his annoyance, and after the problem is dealt with Ashiya ends up owing him money and working as his assistant. Together they help lost yokai who have wandered into the human world find their way home, a job that suits Ashiya's soft heart. Pierrot+ adapted Kiri Wazawa's web manga into this 13-episode first season in 2016; a second followed in 2019.

zombie-loan.summary: Michiru Kita can see a 'ring of death' around people's necks that darkens as their death approaches. When two classmates, Chika Akatsuki and Shito Tachibana, turn out to have pitch-black rings, she tries to warn them, and learns that they are already dead. Both are kept walking by a contract with a shady loan company called Zombie-Loan, and they must hunt rogue zombies to pay down a huge debt. Because her sight can spot those targets, Michiru is pulled into their work, whether she likes it or not. Xebec M2 adapted the manga by the duo Peach-Pit in 2007, with eleven episodes broadcast on TV. It contains bloody supernatural violence.

kamigami-no-asobi.summary: Third-year Yui Kusanagi discovers an old sword in her family's storehouse and is suddenly pulled into another world, where she meets Zeus. Worried that the bond between gods and humans is weakening, Zeus has built a school for young gods from several mythologies and wants Yui to teach them what humans mean by love. Her classmates include Apollon, Hades, Loki, Balder, and the Japanese gods Takeru and Tsukito, most of whom have little patience for lessons or for each other, and they cannot leave until they graduate. Yui has to win them over one by one. Brain's Base adapted Broccoli's otome visual novel into this 12-episode romantic fantasy in 2014.

noir.summary: Mireille Bouquet is a skilled assassin-for-hire living in Paris. One day she receives an email from Kirika Yumura, a young Japanese student with no memory of her past, inviting her on 'a pilgrimage to the past', and when it plays a melody Mireille remembers from her childhood, she agrees to meet. Within moments of meeting, the pair are attacked by gunmen, and Kirika reveals frightening skill as a killer. Unsure whether to trust each other, they form a partnership, taking contracts under the name Noir while searching for the link between Kirika's lost memories and Mireille's family. Bee Train produced this 26-episode original series in 2001, created and written by Ryoe Tsukimura. It features frequent gun violence.

pokemon-mizu-no-miyako-no-mamorigami-lat.summary: The fifth Pokemon film takes Ash, Misty and Brock to Alto Mare, a canal city modelled on Venice that is quietly protected by two legendary Pokemon, Latias and Latios. After entering the city's water race, Ash keeps crossing paths with a girl who seems to be two different people. The truth is tied to the city's secret guardians and to the Soul Dew, a jewel that powers an old defence system. Two thieves, Annie and Oakley, want to capture the pair and turn that system into a weapon, putting the whole city in danger. OLM produced the film, released in Japan in July 2002, based on the Pokemon games. Its English version was titled Pokemon Heroes. It suits younger viewers.

speed-grapher.summary: Ten years after a conflict called the Bubble War, Tokyo is ruled by money, and the gap between the rich and everyone else is wider than ever. Tatsumi Saiga, a former war photographer, sneaks into the Roppongi Club, a secret society where the wealthy indulge bizarre fetishes, hoping to photograph its so-called goddess, a 15-year-old girl named Kagura Tennozu. When he is caught and about to be killed, a kiss from Kagura gives him the power to destroy anything he photographs. Saiga goes on the run with her, hunted by the club's elegant enforcer Choji Suitengu and its grotesquely powered members. Gonzo produced this 24-episode original series in 2005. It contains graphic violence, sexual content and nudity.

chaos-dragon-sekiryuu-seneki.summary: In the year 3015, the great powers Donatia and Kouran are locked in a struggle for control of the world, and the small island nation of Nil Kamui has been carved up between them and lost its independence. Worse, the Red Dragon, the island's guardian god, has lost its mind and is laying waste to the land. Ibuki, an exiled prince, joins a fight to free his country alongside allies whose strange powers each come at a heavy price. Silver Link and Connect produced this 12-episode series in 2015, based on Red Dragon, a role-playing project created by writers including Gen Urobuchi, Kinoko Nasu and Ryogo Narita. It contains violence and abrupt deaths.

saki.summary: Saki Miyanaga hates mahjong. Growing up, her family turned games into something unpleasant, and she developed a strange habit of finishing with a score of exactly zero, neither winning nor losing. When a friend drags her to the small mahjong club at Kiyosumi High School, she meets Nodoka Haramura, the reigning national middle school champion, and her even-scoring trick quickly gets noticed. Pushed by the club president, Saki starts playing to win and sets her sights on the national high school tournament, where she hopes to reconnect with someone important to her. Gonzo and Picture Magic adapted Ritz Kobayashi's manga into this 25-episode series in 2009. It treats the game as a dramatic sport, with some fan service.

mai-hime.summary: Mai Tokiha and her frail younger brother Takumi are travelling by ferry to their new school, Fuka Academy, when they pull a girl named Mikoto Minagi out of the sea. Moments later a monster attacks the boat, and Mai discovers she can summon a Child, a powerful creature bound to her. She learns that she is one of twelve HiME, girls with special powers who gather at Fuka Academy to protect the school from monsters called Orphans. Mai would much rather focus on her part-time jobs and looking after Takumi, but the academy's secret soon makes that impossible. Sunrise produced this 26-episode original series from 2004 to 2005. It contains fan service, and its later episodes turn dark and violent.

sankarea-ova.summary: These two original episodes of Sankarea: Undying Love were packaged with limited editions of the manga's sixth and seventh volumes in 2012. The first is a prequel, written by the manga's author, set months before the TV story begins. Chihiro Furuya, the zombie-obsessed teenager at the centre of the series, travels with his family to help sort a relative's huge book collection, and on the trip he has an earlier, forgotten brush with Rea Sanka at an outdoor hot spring. The second follows the TV run, when the Furuya household discovers a strange girl hiding under the family temple. Studio Deen animated both, as with the main series, from Mitsuru Hattori's manga. They contain nudity and fan service.

suzuka.summary: Yamato Akitsuki moves from the countryside to Tokyo for high school, and in exchange for his room he helps run his aunt's bathhouse, which comes with a girls-only dormitory next door. On his way there he is captivated by a girl practising the high jump at a nearby track. She turns out to be Suzuka Asahina, a gifted athlete, and his new neighbour in the dorm. Suzuka is cool and unimpressed by Yamato's aimless attitude, so he joins the track team, hoping to prove himself and get closer to her. Studio Comet adapted Koji Seo's manga into this 26-episode series, broadcast in 2005. It is a slow-moving romance with sports as its backdrop and a love-triangle tone.

alice-to-zouroku.summary: Sana is one of a group of girls who carry a power called Alice's Dream, which lets them make whatever they imagine real. She has spent her life as a research subject in a laboratory, and one day she escapes to see the outside world. In a convenience store she runs into Zoroku Kashimura, a stubborn, old-fashioned florist who believes strictly in right and wrong, and before long her pursuers catch up and pull him into her trouble. Zoroku takes her in, and the gruff old man and the curious, sheltered girl slowly become something like family while others with the same power circle around them. J.C.Staff adapted Tetsuya Imai's manga into this 12-episode series in 2017.

macross.summary: In 1999 a giant alien spaceship crashes on Earth, and the threat it represents pushes humanity to unite under a single government. A decade later, the rebuilt ship, the SDF-1 Macross, is about to launch when an alien fleet, the Zentradi, arrives and attacks. A desperate emergency jump flings the Macross, along with an entire city's civilians, to the far edge of the solar system, and it must fight its way home. Young civilian pilot Hikaru Ichijyo joins the defence force, flying transforming fighter planes, and becomes caught between aspiring singer Lynn Minmay and his superior officer, Misa Hayase. Tatsunoko Production produced this 36-episode original series, created by Shoji Kawamori, from 1982 to 1983. It contains war violence.

the-big-o.summary: Forty years ago, something erased the memories of everyone in Paradigm City, and its people have lived with that blank ever since. Roger Smith is the city's top Negotiator, a smooth, black-suited professional who settles disputes and handles delicate jobs. He lives with a dry-witted android girl named R. Dorothy Wayneright and a butler named Norman. When negotiations fail, Roger calls on Big O, a towering robot left over from the lost past, to fight the giant machines and monsters that keep surfacing. Each case drags him closer to the question of what happened to the city. Sunrise produced the 26-episode original series in two seasons: the first in 1999 and the second, co-funded by Cartoon Network, in 2003.

honzuki-no-gekokujou-shisho-ni-naru-tame.summary: The second season of Ascendance of a Bookworm continues the story of Myne, a book-loving woman reborn as a sickly commoner girl in a world where books are rare. Learning that the temple needs mana for its sacred tools, and longing to read its library, Myne joins as an apprentice shrine maiden. Thanks to her unusually large reserve of mana, she is given the blue robes normally reserved for nobles, an honour that angers some of the temple's privileged members. She has to adjust to strict rules and new attendants while still finding ways to make books for everyone. Ajia-do produced these 12 episodes in 2020, adapting Miya Kazuki's light novels. It is a calm fantasy built on everyday problems.

fairy-tail-x-rave.summary: This crossover special brings together the heroes of Hiro Mashima's two best-known manga. Natsu, Lucy and Happy are on a Fairy Tail job to track down a troublesome mage in an unfamiliar town, but they get separated. At the same time, Haru Glory and Elie from Rave Master have lost track of each other in the same place. Elie happens to run into Lucy and Happy, while Haru stumbles across a seasick Natsu, but Elie also happens to match the description of the mage the guild is hunting, which sets up a misunderstanding. A-1 Pictures animated the single episode, released in 2013. It is a light romp best enjoyed by fans of both series.

concrete-revolutio-choujin-gensou.summary: In an alternate Japan of the late 1960s, during an era called Shinka, superhumans of every kind live side by side with ordinary people: aliens, robots, magical girls, ghosts and monsters. A government office, the Superhuman Bureau, keeps watch over them and steps in when they become a danger. Bureau agent Jiro Hitoyoshi, who carries a secret power of his own, works with Kikko Hoshino, a cheerful magical girl, to protect superhumans and the public, though the line between protection and control keeps blurring. The story jumps between years, gradually showing how Jiro ends up in conflict with the bureau. Bones produced this 13-episode original series, created by Sho Aikawa, in 2015; a second season followed in 2016.

aiura.summary: Aiura follows three high school first-years, Ayuko Uehara and her classmates Amaya and Iwasawa, who have no special talents and no burning ambitions. Uehara first meets the other two when they bump into her at a cafe during spring break, and she soon finds them in her class. Their days are made up of idle chatter, odd bets, trips to the cafe and small arguments about nothing in particular, with a few classmates drifting in and out. The point is the rhythm of ordinary teenage life rather than any plot. Each episode is only a few minutes long. Lidenfilms adapted Chama's four-panel manga into this 12-episode short series in 2013.

days-tv.summary: Tsukushi Tsukamoto has no athletic talent and little confidence, but he is kind, honest and stubborn. One stormy night he meets Jin Kazama, a soccer prodigy who drifts through life on instinct, and the encounter drags him into competitive school soccer. Tsukushi joins the powerhouse team at Seiseki High School as a complete beginner and has to survive brutal training alongside players far more gifted than he is. His willingness to keep running after everyone else stops slowly earns his teammates' respect. MAPPA adapted Tsuyoshi Yasuda's manga into this 24-episode series, which aired in the second half of 2016. It focuses on effort and teamwork rather than flashy special moves.

amanchu.summary: Futaba Ooki, a shy girl who used to live in Tokyo, moves to a coastal town on Izu and spends her days looking at the world through her phone camera. When school starts she catches the eye of Hikari Kohinata, a relentlessly cheerful local girl who loves the ocean and scuba diving. Hikari decides to befriend her, and soon Futaba finds herself joining the school's diving club and learning to dive, even though the idea of going underwater frightens her. Through the sea, small adventures and new friends, she gradually opens up. J.C.Staff adapted Kozue Amano's manga into this 12-episode series in 2016; a second season followed in 2018. The tone is calm and dreamy.

tales-of-the-abyss.summary: The world of Auldrant follows the Score, an ancient prophecy that people treat as an unbreakable plan for the future. Luke fon Fabre, the pampered heir of a powerful noble house in the kingdom of Kimlasca-Lanvaldear, has been confined to his family mansion since a kidnapping seven years ago erased his memory. When a mysterious woman named Tear breaks into the mansion to attack his swordsmanship teacher, a strange reaction sends Luke and Tear far across the world. Forced to travel home through hostile lands, Luke meets a group of companions and learns how little he understands. Sunrise adapted Namco's role-playing game into this 26-episode series, broadcast from 2008 to 2009. It contains battle violence.

bloodivores.summary: Sixty years ago, an insomnia epidemic drove its sleepless victims mad. The medicine developed to cure it had a terrible side effect, turning patients into vampires, and humanity fought a war against the new species and won, though some vampires survived. Mi Liu, born to a human and a vampire and once called 'the child of hope', is arrested after a bank robbery and sent to a special prison run by the National Defense Agency. An escape attempt with fellow inmate Anji brings attacks from strange monsters and the discovery that the prison stands where vampires first emerged. Creators in Pack animated this 12-episode adaptation of Bai Xiao's Chinese webcomic in 2016. It contains bloody violence.

pokemon-advanced-generation-mew-to-hadou.summary: The eighth Pokemon film is set around a palace town that still celebrates Sir Aaron, a legendary knight who long ago gave his life to end a war. Ash wins the town's annual tournament and, as the champion, gets to hold Aaron's staff for a day. Hidden inside it is Lucario, Aaron's loyal Pokemon, who wakes believing he was betrayed by his master centuries ago. When Pikachu is carried off by the playful legendary Pokemon Mew, Ash, his friends and the distrustful Lucario must travel together to the Tree of Beginning to get him back, and Lucario learns more about what really happened. OLM produced the film, released in Japan in July 2005, based on the Pokemon games.

getbackers.summary: Ban Mido and Ginji Amano are the GetBackers, a two-man recovery service that promises to get back anything that has been lost or stolen, and they claim never to have failed. Both are formidable fighters with superhuman abilities, yet the pair are always broke and struggling to pay for their next meal. Their jobs often turn out far more dangerous than promised, pitting them against rival specialists with strange powers and old acquaintances from Ban and Ginji's pasts. Studio Deen adapted the manga written by Yuya Aoki and drawn by Rando Ayamine into this 49-episode series, broadcast from 2002 to 2003. It contains fighting violence.

ookiku-furikabutte.summary: Ren Mihashi was his middle school team's ace, but teammates resented him, believing he only got the spot because his grandfather owned the school. He leaves for Nishiura High School in another prefecture convinced he is a terrible pitcher and planning to give up baseball. Instead, the school's newly formed baseball club, with only first-year players and a young female coach, needs a pitcher and pulls him in. Its catcher, the calculating Takaya Abe, sees that Mihashi has pinpoint control and decides to build their game around it, though communicating with the timid, tearful boy is a challenge of its own. A-1 Pictures adapted Asa Higuchi's manga into this 25-episode first season in 2007; a second followed in 2010.

ushio-to-tora-tv-2.summary: The second season of Ushio & Tora concludes the 2015 to 2016 adaptation of Kazuhiro Fujita's manga, continuing straight on from the first. Ushio Aotsuki, a temple keeper's son, is still bonded to the Beast Spear, an ancient weapon that grants great power but slowly eats away at its wielder's humanity. At his side is Tora, the huge, tiger-like monster he freed from a seal under the family temple, who claims he will devour Ushio when the time comes but keeps fighting alongside him anyway. Their mismatched partnership faces its final challenges as an ancient threat stirs. MAPPA and Studio VOLN produced these last 13 episodes in 2016. It contains intense monster violence.
