ichigo-mashimaro.summary: Strawberry Marshmallow follows four young girls and the bored older sister who keeps an eye on them. Chika Ito is a sensible twelve-year-old who lives with her sister Nobue, a twenty-year-old who smokes, takes part-time jobs and mostly wants to be left alone. Chika's friends include the troublemaking Miu, whose pranks and wild ideas drive most episodes, the shy and gentle Matsuri, and Ana Coppola, a very polite English girl who has recently moved to Japan. Their days are made up of school, sleepovers, holidays and Miu's latest scheme. Daume adapted Barasui's manga into this 12-episode comedy in 2005, and three OVA episodes followed. Its humour comes from deadpan timing rather than big events.

mobile-suit-gundam-iron-blooded-orphans-.summary: The second season of Iron-Blooded Orphans picks up after Tekkadan, the mercenary company of former child soldiers, has made its name. Now formally tied to the powerful Teiwaz conglomerate and backed by a new trade deal, the group is growing fast, taking in new recruits while gaining new allies and enemies. Kudelia Aina Bernstein, working toward Mars's economic independence, starts her own company, Admoss, and hires Tekkadan as its partner, while a power struggle inside the military organization Gjallarhorn intensifies. Orga Itsuka keeps pushing the group toward bigger ambitions, with pilot Mikazuki Augus and the Gundam Barbatos at the front. Sunrise produced these 25 episodes from 2016 to 2017. It contains graphic war violence.

dragon-ball-z-movie-13-ryuuken-bakuhatsu.summary: The thirteenth Dragon Ball Z film opens when Goku's friends are handed a strange music box that no one can open, and they end up using the Dragon Balls to do it. Inside is Tapion, a young warrior from another world who was sealed away together with a monster called Hirudegarn. Once freed, Tapion keeps everyone at a distance, though young Trunks becomes attached to him. When Hirudegarn breaks free and begins tearing apart a city, Goku has to come up with a new technique to stop it. Toei Animation released the film in July 1995, based on Akira Toriyama's manga, and it stands apart from the main TV storyline. It has heavy fighting.

pokemon-advanced-generation-rekkuu-no-ho.summary: The seventh Pokemon film takes Ash, May, Max and Brock to LaRousse City, a high-tech town known for its Battle Tower. There Ash is paired with Tory, a boy who has been terrified of Pokemon since a frightening event four years earlier. That event is tied to Deoxys, a Pokemon from space that has now returned, putting the city under a barrier and making people disappear. The legendary Rayquaza comes down from the sky to fight it, endangering the whole city. While Ash helps protect LaRousse, Tory has to face his fear. OLM produced the film, released in Japan in July 2004, based on the Pokemon games. Its English version is titled Destiny Deoxys.

Solo-Leveling-Season-2-Arise-from-the-Sh.summary: The second season of Solo Leveling continues with Sung Jinwoo, once mocked as the weakest hunter in the world, who now grows stronger every day through a mysterious System only he can see. Hiding that strength gets harder as dungeon incidents pile up and powerful guilds take an interest. Meanwhile, a hunter who vanished ten years ago reappears with a warning about a coming disaster. Throughout, Jinwoo pushes on toward the goal that drives him: curing his mother, who has been trapped in an endless sleep. A-1 Pictures produced these 13 episodes in early 2025, adapting the Korean web novel by Chugong and its webtoon version. It contains graphic violence.

magic-kaito-1412.summary: Kaito Kuroba is a cheeky high school student and talented amateur magician whose father, a famous stage magician, died in an accident eight years ago. Then Kaito finds a secret room in their house and learns that his father was really Kaito Kid, the phantom thief known around the world, and that his death was no accident but the work of a criminal organization hunting a legendary jewel called Pandora. Kaito takes up the white suit himself, stealing famous gems to find Pandora before they do, while dodging police inspector Nakamori, whose daughter Aoko is Kaito's childhood friend. A-1 Pictures adapted Gosho Aoyama's manga into this 24-episode series in 2014 and 2015. Kid also appears in Aoyama's Detective Conan.

hanasaku-iroha-home-sweet-home.summary: The Hanasaku Iroha film returns to Kissuiso, the old hot-spring inn where Ohana Matsumae works under her strict grandmother. Ohana has settled into the job, but she is uneasy that the spark she felt when she first arrived seems to be fading. As the town gets ready for its Bonbori Festival, her friend Yuina comes to the inn as a trainee, and while tidying up behind her, Ohana finds an old logbook kept during her mother Satsuki's youth at Kissuiso. Reading it gives her a new view of the mother she has always clashed with. P.A. Works produced the film, released in March 2013, directed by Masahiro Ando and written by Mari Okada; watch the TV series first.

aria-the-natural.summary: The second season of Aria returns to Neo-Venezia, a recreation of Venice on the terraformed planet Aqua, once known as Mars. Akari Mizunashi is still working toward Prima Undine, the top rank of gondolier guide, and spends her days with Aika and Alice, trainees at rival companies. Episodes drift through the city's seasons and small encounters: festivals, old legends, chance meetings with residents, and quiet moments with the mysterious cat president Aria. There are no villains or high stakes, only the slow pleasure of noticing things and growing up. Hal Film Maker produced these 26 episodes in 2006, adapting Kozue Amano's manga. It continues from Aria the Animation and is followed by a third season.

senryuu_shoujo.summary: Nanako Yukishiro is a calm, sweet high school student who rarely speaks aloud; instead she writes her thoughts as senryu, short poems with a five-seven-five rhythm, on slips of paper she carries. In her school's literature club she meets Eiji Busujima, a former delinquent with a terrifying face who has also discovered a love of senryu and is trying to leave his old reputation behind. The two quickly become close, communicating through their verses as other club members and classmates join in. Each episode is about twelve minutes and light in tone. Connect adapted Masakuni Igarashi's manga into this 12-episode romantic comedy in 2019. Its humour comes from the gap between Eiji's scary appearance and his gentle nature.

hachi-nan-tte-sore-wa-nai-desho.summary: Shingo Ichinomiya, a 25-year-old office worker at a trading company, falls asleep after another exhausting day and wakes as a small child in a fantasy world. He is now Wendelin, youngest of eight sons in an impoverished rural noble house, with no inheritance and few prospects. Wendelin soon discovers that he has a remarkable talent for magic, and with the help of a mentor he starts training in secret, hoping to build a comfortable life for himself instead of relying on his family. A series of adventures gradually leads him toward the nobility and the capital. SynergySP and Shin-Ei Animation adapted Y.A's light novels into this 12-episode series in 2020.

the-melancholy-of-haruhi-chan-suzumiya.summary: The Melancholy of Haruhi-chan Suzumiya is a short comedy spin-off of the Haruhi Suzumiya series, with the whole SOS Brigade redrawn as small, round chibi characters. Haruhi is even louder and bossier than usual, Yuki is now a gamer, Mikuru cries at the slightest pressure, Koizumi's affection for Kyon is played up for laughs, and Kyon remains the tired voice of reason. Each episode lasts only a few minutes and pokes fun at the original series, its characters and the habits of its fans. Kyoto Animation produced the 25 episodes in 2009, based on Puyo's four-panel manga, which itself parodies Nagaru Tanigawa's light novels. It assumes viewers already know the main series.

bleach-the-sealed-sword-frenzy.summary: The Sealed Sword Frenzy is a short Bleach special from 2006 that tells a standalone side story. Long ago, the Soul Society sealed away Baishin, a dangerous Soul Reaper, but he has now escaped and is loose in the human world. Ichigo Kurosaki, a teenager with Soul Reaper powers, runs into him and loses roughly half of his spiritual energy in the encounter, leaving him weakened against an enemy who keeps growing stronger. Ichigo has to work with the Soul Society to stop Baishin before he causes more destruction. Studio Pierrot animated the special from Tite Kubo's manga, featuring the TV series' cast. It is best watched after the first arcs of the series. It includes supernatural combat.
bleach-the-sealed-sword-frenzy.notes: Plot rests on the MAL synopsis, which AniList and Kitsu repeat; Wikipedia link is the TV series article, which does not cover this special.

seikimatsu-occult-gakuin.summary: In 2012, Earth lies in ruins after an alien invasion, and agents are sent back to 1999 to locate the Nostradamus Key, believed to have set the disaster in motion, and destroy it. One of them, the hapless Fumiaki Uchida, lands near Waldstein Academy, a private school devoted to studying the occult. There he meets Maya Kumashiro, daughter of the academy's late headmaster, who has come home for his funeral and plans to close the school because she despises the occult. She and Fumiaki form an uneasy partnership to search for the key among ghosts, aliens and urban legends. A-1 Pictures produced this 13-episode original series in 2010. It mixes comedy with mild horror.

shaman-king-2021.summary: Shamans are people who can see and talk to spirits, and every five hundred years they compete in the Shaman Fight, a tournament whose winner becomes Shaman King and gains the power to reshape the world. Yoh Asakura, an easygoing teenager from a family of shamans, wants that title, though he would rather take life slowly. His classmate Manta Oyamada stumbles into his world one night at a graveyard, and Yoh's partner is Amidamaru, the ghost of a legendary samurai. As the fight begins, Yoh meets rivals and allies from around the world. Bridge produced this 52-episode remake of Hiroyuki Takei's manga, broadcast from 2021 to 2022. It contains supernatural battles and some violence.

trickster-edogawa-ranpo-shounen-tanteida.summary: In the near future, the Boy Detectives Club works under the enigmatic detective Kogoro Akechi, taking on cases of every size. One of its young members, Kensuke Hanasaki, crosses paths with Yoshio Kobayashi, a gloomy boy who cannot die because of a mysterious mist inside his body and who wants nothing more than to end his life. Hanasaki offers him a bargain: join the club, and he will find a way for Kobayashi to die. Their cases soon lead to the master criminal known as the Fiend with Twenty Faces. Shin-Ei Animation and TMS Entertainment produced this 24-episode series, broadcast from 2016 to 2017, loosely based on Edogawa Ranpo's detective stories. It deals with suicidal themes and contains violence.

super-lovers.summary: Haru Kaido rushes to Canada after his mother tells him she is on the verge of death, only to discover it was a trick: she wants him to look after Ren, a boy she adopted, who is wild, distrustful and more at home with dogs than people. Over a summer in the woods, Haru slowly earns Ren's trust. Years later, back in Japan, Ren comes to live with Haru and his younger brothers, and the bond between them deepens into something more complicated. Studio Deen adapted Miyuki Abe's manga into this 10-episode series in 2016, and a second season followed in 2017. It is a boys' love romance between adoptive brothers with a wide age gap.

excel-saga.summary: Il Palazzo, leader of the secretive organization ACROSS, plans to conquer the world, starting with the city of Fukuoka. His agents are Excel, a hyperactive young woman wholly devoted to him, and Hyatt, a gentle girl who keeps fainting and dying, only to recover. Opposing them, more or less, is the city's security department, with its own odd staff and robots, while Excel also tries to keep up with rent and part-time jobs and Menchi, a small dog she treats as emergency food. Each episode parodies a different genre, and the manga's author, Koshi Rikudo, appears to approve the changes. J.C.Staff produced the 26 episodes in 1999 and 2000, directed by Shinichi Watanabe. It contains crude humour and fan service.

girlish-number.summary: Chitose Karasuma is a college student who has just started out as a voice actress, and she is sure she is destined for stardom despite having almost no work to her name. Her older brother Gojo, who manages her at their small agency, knows exactly how lazy and arrogant she can be. When she finally gets a shot at a main role in an upcoming light novel adaptation, she finds a production with plenty of problems and fellow newcomers who each have their own ambitions and worries. Diomedea adapted the project, created by Wataru Watari, into this 12-episode comedy in 2016. It satirizes the Japanese anime and voice-acting industry, from marketing events to rushed scripts.

trinity-seven-ova.summary: This single Trinity Seven OVA came with the limited edition of the manga's eleventh volume in 2015 and is a side story for viewers who know the 2014 TV series. Arata Kasuga, the sole male student at the magic academy Royal Biblia, is suddenly threatened with expulsion. The only way to stay is to study the magical archives in earnest, so the seven powerful female mages of the Trinity Seven take turns tutoring him. The lessons quickly dissolve into misunderstandings and embarrassing situations. Seven Arcs Pictures animated it, as with the TV series, from the manga written by Kenji Saito and drawn by Akinari Nao. It is a light harem comedy with frequent fan service and partial nudity.
trinity-seven-ova.notes: Plot detail is thin in all sources; the expulsion premise and bundling come from MAL and AniList, which share wording.

touhai-densetsu-akagi-yami-ni-maiorita-t.summary: In 1958, a desperate gambler named Nangou bets his life on a mahjong game with the yakuza to escape debts topping three million yen. As he heads toward ruin, a soaked thirteen-year-old boy walks into the parlour out of a stormy night. The boy, Shigeru Akagi, has never played mahjong, yet after learning the rules he reads his opponents with frightening calm and takes the kind of risks nobody else dares. Years later, his legend draws him into ever more dangerous games against the underworld's most ruthless players. Madhouse adapted Nobuyuki Fukumoto's manga, a prequel to his earlier work Ten, into this 26-episode series, broadcast from 2005 to 2006. It contains gambling, menace and some violence.

digimon-adventure-movie.summary: This short 1999 film is the first Digimon story, a prologue to the Digimon Adventure TV series. In a Tokyo apartment, young Taichi Yagami and his little sister Hikari watch a strange egg appear out of their family computer. It hatches into a small creature that keeps growing and changing form, and the children take care of it in secret. One night it turns into a huge dinosaur, and another giant creature appears in the neighbourhood, leading to a battle in the streets that only the two siblings truly understand. Toei Animation produced the roughly twenty-minute film, directed by Mamoru Hosoda, which opened in Japanese cinemas in March 1999. It stands on its own.

yoru-wa-mijikashi-arukeyo-otome.summary: Over one long, strange night in Kyoto, a university student known only as Senpai keeps arranging 'chance' meetings with the black-haired girl he has fallen for, hoping she will finally notice him. She, meanwhile, sets out alone to enjoy the night, drinking her way through the Pontocho district, rescuing a picture book at a second-hand book fair, starring in a guerrilla play at the university festival, and nursing people through a cold epidemic. Their paths keep almost crossing among a cast of eccentrics, from the God of the Used Book Fair to the wealthy, eccentric old Rihaku. Science SARU produced the 2017 film, directed by Masaaki Yuasa and based on Tomihiko Morimi's novel. Its animation is loose, colourful and surreal.

manaria-friends.summary: At Mysteria Academy, a famous school of magic, humans, gods and demons study side by side, though their races are usually at war. Anne, the cheerful and brilliant princess of the Mysteria kingdom, is one of its top students. Grea, a dragon princess born of a dragon and a human, struggles to control her power and keeps to herself because classmates look down on her mixed heritage. Anne refuses to leave her alone, and the series follows their growing closeness through classes, festivals and quiet moments. CygamesPictures produced the 10-episode series in 2019, based on characters from the Rage of Bahamut card game. Episodes run about fifteen minutes.

arslan-senki-tv-fuujin-ranbu.summary: This short second season of The Heroic Legend of Arslan follows on from the first. Prince Arslan and his small band of loyal followers, including the swordsman Daryun and the strategist Narsus, are marching to retake the royal capital Ecbatana from the invading Lusitanians. Before they get far, news arrives that the neighbouring kingdom of Turan has launched an attack on Peshawar Fortress, Arslan's base, forcing the army to turn back and defend it. Arslan must balance war, politics and his own uncertain place as heir while enemies close in from several sides. Liden Films produced these 8 episodes in 2016, based on Hiromu Arakawa's manga version of Yoshiki Tanaka's novels. It contains battlefield violence.

kuuchuu-buranko.summary: Dr. Ichiro Irabu runs the psychiatric ward of his family's general hospital, and he is the strangest psychiatrist imaginable: childish, impulsive, and far too eager to give his patients injections, with help from his nurse Mayumi. Each episode follows a different patient with a crippling problem, including a trapeze artist who can no longer catch his partner, a yakuza terrified of sharp objects, and a businessman with a persistent physical condition. Irabu prods them toward the root of their troubles in unexpected ways. Toei Animation adapted Hideo Okuda's short stories into this 11-episode series in 2009, in a bold, collage-like visual style directed by Kenji Nakamura. It deals frankly with sexual and psychological themes.

druaga-no-tou-the-aegis-of-uruk.summary: Every few years comes the Summer of Anu, when the protection of the sky god weakens the demons inside the great Tower of Druaga. The kingdom of Uruk uses that summer to send its army up the tower, and the climbers who chase glory and treasure follow close behind. Jil, a young, naive climber with more enthusiasm than skill, sets out to reach the top with his small party of companions, though the tower and its rival climbers are full of surprises. Gonzo produced this 12-episode series in 2008 as a new take on Namco's classic Tower of Druaga arcade game, mixing fantasy adventure with game parodies. Its second season, The Sword of Uruk, followed in 2009.

koufuku-graffiti.summary: Ryo Machiko is a middle school student who lives alone in a large apartment, her parents working abroad and her beloved grandmother recently gone. She loves cooking and is very good at it, but lately her meals have lost their taste, because she has nobody to share them with. That changes when her second cousin, Kirin Morino, starts staying with her on weekends while attending a cram school in Tokyo. Kirin eats with obvious delight, and with a friend at the table Ryo's cooking comes back to life. Soon Shiina, a friend from art cram school, joins them at the table. Shaft adapted Makoto Kawai's four-panel manga into this 12-episode series in 2015. Its food scenes are lavish.

saenai-heroine-no-sodatekata-movie.summary: Saekano Fine continues directly from the second TV season, Flat. The doujin circle Blessing Software is racing to finish its new game in time for the winter Comiket, without its former artist Eriri and writer Utaha, who have left for a major professional project. Producer Tomoya Aki and Megumi Kato, the once-unremarkable girl who inspired the game's heroine, push on with new members Izumi Hashima, Michiru Hyodo and Iori Hashima, but Tomoya struggles to write the final heroine's route. Meanwhile, Utaha and Eriri face problems of their own. CloverWorks produced the 2019 film, which adapts the last part of Fumiaki Maruto's light novels and brings the anime to a close. Viewers need both TV seasons first.

nerawareta-gakuen.summary: Kenji Seki is a middle school student in Kamakura who walks his dog along the beach every morning, hoping to see his classmate Kahori Harukawa out on her surfboard. His neighbour and childhood friend, Natsuki Suzuura, quietly likes him, though he does not notice. Their ordinary routine is disrupted when a transfer student, Ryoichi Kyogoku, arrives with the ability to read and influence minds and begins to take control of the school. Kenji and Natsuki realise something is wrong and try to resist. Sunrise produced the 2012 film, based on Taku Mayumura's 1973 science-fiction novel. Its gentle seaside setting and soft lighting give it a dreamy, nostalgic feel.

mobile-suit-gundam-unicorn.summary: In the year U.C. 0096, a few years after Char's last rebellion, Banagher Links is a quiet student living on Industrial 7, a space colony under construction. He meets Audrey Burne, a mysterious girl trying to stop a deal involving Laplace's Box, a secret said to have the power to overturn the Earth Federation. When fighting breaks out in the colony, Banagher ends up piloting the RX-0 Unicorn Gundam, a mobile suit tied to the Box, and is pulled into a struggle between the Federation, the Neo Zeon remnants and powerful families. Sunrise adapted Harutoshi Fukui's novels into this 7-episode OVA series, released from 2010 to 2014, with each episode close to an hour. It contains war violence and casualties.

toaru-hikuushi-e-no-koiuta.summary: Kal-el Albus was once a crown prince, until the Wind Revolution stripped him of everything; he still hates the girl who led it. Now he boards the Isla, a huge floating island setting out to find the 'end of the sky' described in ancient myths. Aboard, he enrolls in the aerial division of Cadoques High School to train as a pilot, makes friends, and falls for a classmate, Claire Cruz, at first sight. Their carefree school days end abruptly when a surprise attack by a mysterious sky people drags the Isla into a brutal war. TMS Entertainment produced this 13-episode series in 2014, adapting Koroku Inumura's light novels. It contains aerial combat and war casualties.

kanojo-to-kanojo-no-neko.summary: She and Her Cat is a black-and-white short of about five minutes, told entirely from the point of view of Chobi, a male cat. On a rainy spring day he is taken in by a young woman living alone in a Tokyo apartment, and he quickly comes to adore her. Over the following seasons he watches her routine, her phone calls and her quiet struggles, understanding only part of her world. The film is built largely from still frames and voice-over, and says a lot with very little. Makoto Shinkai created it almost entirely by himself in 1999, as his first work as a director. It later inspired a 2016 TV series.

blood-the-last-vampire.summary: In 1966 Japan, near a US Air Force base, creatures called Chiropterans hide among humans and feed on their blood. A secret organization hunts them, and its best weapon is Saya, a silent, sword-carrying girl whose own nature is never fully explained. Posing as a student at the base's high school just before Halloween, she is sent to find and kill the creatures hiding there, alongside her handlers. The school nurse soon becomes an unwilling witness to what Saya does. Production I.G made the roughly 48-minute film in 2000, with Hiroyuki Kitakubo directing from Kenji Kamiyama's script, using digital techniques that were new at the time. It contains graphic, bloody violence and horror imagery.

mushishi-zoku-shou-special.summary: Odoro no Michi, or Path of Thorns, is an hour-long special of Mushishi Zoku Shou, broadcast in August 2014 and later included on the series' third Blu-ray and DVD volume. Mushi are strange, primitive life forms behind many unexplained events. Tanyu Karibusa, whose family keeps a dangerous mushi sealed away, asks the travelling mushi master Ginko to accompany Kumado Minai, head of a clan of mushi masters who serve the Karibusa family. Together they investigate a deserted village where dead timber, even whole houses, has started growing back into living plants. Ginko also starts to wonder why the Minai clan is so cold and detached. Artland produced it, adapting Yuki Urushibara's manga. The tone is calm, eerie and meditative.

makai-ouji-devils-and-realist.summary: William Twining is a proud, brilliant student at an elite English boarding school who believes only in science. When his family suddenly goes bankrupt, he searches the family manor for anything to sell and accidentally summons Dantalion, a duke of Hell, who tells him that William is the Elector, the person who chooses who will rule Hell while Lucifer sleeps. William flatly refuses to believe in demons, but Dantalion follows him to school, and rival demons and angels soon arrive to sway his choice. Doga Kobo adapted the manga written by Madoka Takadono and drawn by Utako Yukihiro into this 12-episode series in 2013. It is a light supernatural comedy aimed at an older female audience.

hokuto-no-ken.summary: After a nuclear war, the world has become a desert where gangs and warlords prey on the weak. Kenshiro, master of Hokuto Shinken, a deadly martial art that destroys opponents through their pressure points, wanders this wasteland. Betrayed and left for dead by his rival Shin, who took his fiancee Yuria, he searches for her through village after village of people in need of protection. Along the way he gains young companions and runs into other masters of ancient fighting styles, some of them his own sworn brothers. Toei Animation adapted the manga by Buronson and Tetsuo Hara into this 109-episode series, broadcast from 1984 to 1987. It is extremely violent, with graphic gore.

nobunaga-the-fool.summary: Two planets, the West Star and the East Star, have been at war for ages. Guided by visions of a saviour king, Jeanne Kaguya d'Arc crosses to the East Star with the inventor Leonardo da Vinci. There she meets Nobunaga Oda, the brash heir of a minor lord who has vowed to conquer the world, and decides he is the king she has foreseen. Jeanne pledges herself to him, and with Leonardo's inventions Nobunaga takes to the battlefield in a giant war machine. Satelight produced these 24 episodes in 2014, as part of Shoji Kawamori's franchise that includes a stage play. It contains mecha battles and war violence.

mitsudomoe.summary: Satoshi Yabe is a young, gentle teacher assigned to his first homeroom class, a group of sixth-graders who quickly prove to be a handful. The worst of them are the Marui triplets: Mitsuba, the eldest, is bossy and sadistic; Futaba, the middle one, is cheerful, extremely strong and obsessed with breasts; and Hitoha, the youngest, is quiet, gloomy and often hiding a racy book. Their antics and wild misunderstandings drag Yabe and their classmates into constant embarrassment. Bridge adapted Norio Sakurai's manga into this 13-episode comedy in 2010, and a second season followed in 2011. Much of its humour is crude and sexual in nature, despite the young cast, which some viewers find uncomfortable.

mirai-no-mirai.summary: Four-year-old Kun has always been the centre of attention in his family's unusual house, built around a small garden. When his parents bring home his newborn sister Mirai, he feels pushed aside and throws tantrum after tantrum. Then, in the garden, strange things begin to happen. Kun meets his sister as a teenager, visiting from years ahead, and finds himself travelling through moments from his family's past, meeting relatives at different ages and seeing his parents as children. Mamoru Hosoda wrote and directed the 2018 film for Studio Chizu, and it earned an Academy Award nomination for Best Animated Feature. It is a gentle, family-centred story told from a small child's perspective.

hataage-kemono-michi.summary: Genzo Shibata is a hulking pro wrestler who fights as the tiger-masked Animal Mask, and he loves animals more than anything. In the middle of a title match he is suddenly summoned to another world by a princess who wants him to hunt dangerous beasts. Outraged, Genzo suplexes her and refuses. Instead he decides to open a pet shop in the new world, collecting a strange group of companions, including a werewolf girl and a dragon, while trying to befriend every creature he meets. ENGI produced this 12-episode comedy in 2019, based on the manga written by Natsume Akatsuki, author of KonoSuba. Its humour is loud and slapstick, with some fan service.

orenchi-no-furo-jijou.summary: Tatsumi, a high school boy living alone, finds a beautiful merman named Wakasa collapsed by a lake on his way home. Pollution has made Wakasa's old waters unlivable, so Tatsumi reluctantly lets him move into his bathtub. Wakasa is self-centred, demanding and somewhat childish, while Tatsumi is cool on the surface but cannot help taking care of him. Soon other merfolk start turning up at the house as well. Each episode runs only a few minutes and works through quick domestic gags. Asahi Production adapted Itokichi's four-panel manga into this 13-episode short series in 2014. Its humour has a light boys' love flavour without becoming a romance.

hori-san-to-miyamura-kun-.summary: Kyoko Hori is a popular, outgoing high school student who secretly spends her evenings doing housework and looking after her little brother Sota, since her parents are always at work. Izumi Miyamura is a quiet classmate everyone assumes is a gloomy otaku, but outside school he has several piercings and a large tattoo. When the two stumble onto each other's hidden sides, they become close friends, and their circle of classmates slowly grows. These six short OVA episodes were released from 2012 to 2021 by several studios, including Gonzo and Hoods Entertainment, based on Hero's four-panel webcomic. The same story was later retold in the Horimiya TV series. The tone is light and comedic.

kakumeiki-valvrave-2nd-season.summary: The second season of Valvrave the Liberator continues straight on from the first. The students of Module 77, a space colony that declared its own independence, are still fighting off the military empire of Dorssia, relying on the Valvrave machines that grant their pilots strange powers at a terrible cost to their humanity. Haruto Tokishima, the first pilot, keeps working with L-Elf, a cold Dorssian defector whose past remains unclear, while tension between Haruto, his childhood friend Shoko and the singer Saki keeps growing. As the war spreads, every faction's loyalties are tested, and the mystery of the girl Liselotte comes back into play. Sunrise produced these 12 episodes in 2013. It contains graphic violence and disturbing scenes.

tokyo-mew-mew.summary: On a date with Masaya Aoyama, the boy she adores, schoolgirl Ichigo Momomiya is hit by a strange light and has a vision of a wildcat merging with her. The next day she starts acting like a cat, craving fish and sprouting ears and a tail when she gets flustered. Her genes have been mixed with an Iriomote cat's, and she is one of several girls, each tied to a different endangered animal, chosen to fight aliens who want Earth back. From Cafe Mew Mew, the team's cover, she gathers the others while hiding it all from Masaya. Studio Pierrot adapted the manga by Reiko Yoshida and Mia Ikumi into this 52-episode series in 2002 and 2003.

yuukoku-no-moriarty-2nd-season.summary: Moriarty the Patriot's second part continues with William James Moriarty, a brilliant mathematician in Victorian England who has turned against its cruel class system. With his brothers Albert and Louis and a growing group of allies, he works in secret as the 'Lord of Crime', staging murders and scandals to bring down corrupt aristocrats and push the country toward a fairer society. Now London is gripped by fear of this mysterious mastermind, and the consulting detective Sherlock Holmes, whom William regards as both rival and friend, is getting ever closer to the truth. Production I.G made these 13 episodes in 2021, adapting the manga by Ryosuke Takeuchi and Hikaru Miyoshi. It contains murder and violence.

hakkenden-touhou-hakken-ibun.summary: Five years ago, the village of Otsuka was burned to the ground to stop a deadly epidemic, and only three children came out alive: Shino Inuzuka, Sosuke Inukawa and Hamaji. As they lay dying, a stranger carrying a sword offered them a choice. Now Shino carries the soul of the cursed sword Murasame inside him, and Sosuke can turn into a dog. When the Imperial Church kidnaps Hamaji to force Shino to hand over the sword, the brothers head to the capital to get her back, and start looking for others who bear the same peony-shaped mark. Studio Deen adapted Miyuki Abe's manga, loosely based on the classic novel Nanso Satomi Hakkenden, into this 13-episode first season in 2013.

shokugeki-no-souma-san-no-sara-ova.summary: This Food Wars! bonus episode came with the manga's twenty-ninth volume in 2018 and is set during the third season. After a sudden change in the leadership of Totsuki Culinary Academy, Erina Nakiri runs away from her domineering father and hides out at the Polar Star Dormitory. Used to refinement and control, the elite chef is thrown into a noisy, chaotic household of eccentric students, including Soma Yukihira. With help from the dorm's residents, Erina starts to enjoy small everyday experiences she has never had before, and slowly finds a place among them. J.C.Staff animated it, as with the TV series, from the manga by Yuto Tsukuda and Shun Saeki. Like the series, it contains fan service.

eureka-seven-ao.summary: Eureka Seven AO is a sequel to Eureka Seven, set years later on Iwado, an island in Okinawa where support for independence from Japan is growing. Ao Fukai is a twelve-year-old boy about to start middle school, raised by an old doctor after his mother was taken away when he was little. His childhood friend Naru Arata has an unusual power that awoke in her after an accident. When mysterious beings called Secrets attack the Scub Coral on the island, Ao climbs into a military mecha known as Nirvash to protect his home, and is quickly drawn into a much larger conflict. Bones produced this 24-episode series in 2012. It contains mecha battles and political violence.

squid-girl-2.summary: The second season of Squid Girl brings back Ika Musume, a small, self-proclaimed invader from the sea who plans to conquer humanity as punishment for polluting the oceans. With her tentacle hair and her squid powers restored, she is ready to resume her mission, but she is still stuck working off a debt at the Lemon, a seaside beach house run by the Aizawa sisters, and she keeps getting distracted by everyday life. New problems arise too, including a team of alien-obsessed researchers who want to study her and a girl who is a bit too devoted to her. Diomedea produced these 12 episodes in 2011, adapting Masahiro Anbe's manga. It is an easygoing gag comedy suitable for most ages.

diamond-no-ace-second-season.summary: The second season of Ace of Diamond picks up after the national tournament, as the Seido High School baseball team rebuilds around a new captain, catcher Kazuya Miyuki. Pitcher Eijun Sawamura, loud, stubborn and still learning to control his unusual moving fastball, is fighting for the spot of ace against his rival Satoru Furuya and others. With new faces in the starting lineup and painful defeats still on their minds, the team trains hard for the autumn tournament and the chance to reach the spring national championship at Koshien. Production I.G and Madhouse produced these 51 episodes from 2015 to 2016, adapting Yuji Terajima's manga. It focuses on tactics, effort and rivalry within the team.

otome-youkai-zakuro.summary: In an alternate Japan going through rapid Westernization, humans and spirits live side by side, and the government sets up a Ministry of Spirit Affairs to deal with problems between them. Three army lieutenants, Kei Agemaki, Riken Yoshinokazura and Ganryu Hanakiri, are assigned to work with half-spirit girls in the ministry. Agemaki, whose father is a celebrated general, has an intense fear of spirits that he hides at all costs, and his partner is Zakuro, a sharp-tongued, proud girl who distrusts humans and their foreign customs. The pairs investigate supernatural incidents while slowly learning to respect each other. J.C.Staff adapted Lily Hoshino's manga into this 13-episode romantic fantasy in 2010.

dragon-ball-z-movie-04-super-saiyajin-da.summary: The fourth Dragon Ball Z film begins when Gohan and Piccolo sense something huge approaching Earth. It looks like a meteor on a collision course, and Goku and Krillin's attempt to destroy it fails, but at the last moment the object slows down and lands. Out of the ship march the soldiers of Lord Slug, a Namekian warlord who declares Earth his newest conquest. Goku and his friends try to stop Slug and his fearsome soldiers, while Piccolo has his own reasons to face a fellow Namekian. Toei Animation released the film in March 1991, based on Akira Toriyama's manga. It is a self-contained side story with plenty of fighting.

nanbaka-2-season.summary: Nanbaka's second season returns to Nanba Prison, a supposedly escape-proof facility whose inmates, led by the escape-loving Jyugo, keep breaking out simply to prove they can. Jyugo and his cellmates Uno, Rock and Nico have settled into a strange, almost comfortable routine under their short-tempered guard, Hajime Sugoroku, and the rest of the colourful staff. That routine is upset by Enki Gokuu, a former guard turned prisoner with ties to the senior guard Samon Gokuu, who arrives with plans of his own. The series mixes slapstick comedy with gradual revelations about the inmates' pasts. Satelight produced these 12 episodes in 2017, adapting Sho Futamata's web manga. It contains comedic violence and some darker backstory scenes.

dragon-ball-z-movie-07-kyokugen-battle-s.summary: Movie seven of Dragon Ball Z begins with a computer deep under a ruined laboratory that is still carrying out the plan of the late Dr. Gero to kill Goku. It activates three androids, numbers 13, 14 and 15, who track Goku down while he is out shopping with Chi-Chi and Gohan and attack the city in broad daylight. Goku, Vegeta and Trunks have to fight them together, while the androids reveal there is more to their programming than meets the eye. Toei Animation released the film in July 1992 as a standalone side story, based on Akira Toriyama's manga. Its Japanese title refers to three Super Saiyans. It is a short, fast-paced action film.

kimi-to-boku-2.summary: The second season of Kimi to Boku returns to five teenage boys and their ordinary days. Twins Yuta and Yuki Asaba, the earnest Kaname Tsukahara and the gentle Shun Matsuoka have been friends since kindergarten, and Chizuru Tachibana, a half-Japanese transfer student, has made the group five. Episodes drift through the year: school festivals, part-time jobs, family memories, small arguments and moments of quiet reflection about growing up and what comes next. There is little plot, only the comfortable rhythm of friendship and the occasional flashback to when they were small. J.C.Staff produced these 13 episodes in 2012, adapting Kiichi Hotta's manga. It is calm and reflective.

ao-haru-ride-ova.summary: These two OVA episodes of Ao Haru Ride came with limited editions of the manga in 2014 as TV series companions. The first, Unwritten, goes back to middle school, when Futaba Yoshioka finds most boys loud and annoying, except Kou Tanaka, a quiet boy from the neighbouring class. Through a series of small encounters they exchange shy looks and awkward words, and Futaba starts to wonder what her feelings mean. The second takes place years later at a summer festival, where Yuri Makita wears a yukata to get closer to Kou while Futaba looks on. Production I.G animated both, as with the TV series, from Io Sakisaka's manga.

phi-brain-kami-no-puzzle.summary: Kaito Daimon is a high school freshman who loves solving puzzles more than anything. When he is invited to take a strange test, he realises it is actually a trap set by POG, a secretive organization that builds philosopher's puzzles, elaborate and deadly challenges where losing can mean injury or worse. Solving it earns Kaito the title of Solver and puts him firmly in POG's sights. Together with his childhood friend Nonoha and other gifted Solvers, he takes on POG's puzzles and starts to uncover its true goals. Sunrise produced this 25-episode original series, directed by Junichi Sato, from 2011 to 2012, followed by two more seasons.

noein-mou-hitori-no-kimi-e.summary: In the summer before middle school, Haruka Kaminogi and her friends in Hakodate are planning a test of courage at the local graveyard when Haruka sees a vision of blue snowfall and a mysterious man. Soon she is caught in a war between two other dimensions: La'cryma, a desperate future world fighting for survival, and Shangri-La, which seeks to absorb all of space-time. Soldiers from La'cryma, including a grim young man named Karasu, believe Haruka is the key to the conflict and come to take her. Her friend Yu, crushed by his mother's pressure to study, is drawn in too. Satelight produced this 24-episode original series, directed by Kazuki Akane, from 2005 to 2006. It contains violence.

fortune-arterial-akai-yakusoku.summary: Kohei Hasekura has moved schools many times because of his parents' work, and he has learned not to get attached. His latest transfer takes him to Shuchikan Academy, a prestigious boarding school on Tamatsu Island, which can only be reached by boat. He soon makes friends and, for once, starts to feel at home. Then he stumbles onto a secret: Erika Sendo, a beautiful girl from the class next door, is a vampire. Keeping her secret pulls Kohei deeper into the island's history and the troubles of those around her. Feel. adapted August's visual novel, originally an adult PC game, into this 12-episode series in 2010. It includes some fan service and blood-drinking scenes.

mondaiji-tachi-ga-isekai-kara-kuru-sou-d.summary: This single Mondaiji OVA came with the eighth light novel volume in 2013 as a side story after the TV series. Fleeing a band of thugs through a forest, a girl named Hifumi falls off a cliff and is caught by Izayoi Sakamaki, who is travelling with Asuka Kudo and You Kasukabe. The No Name trio protect her and learn she can find water. A nearby hot-spring village has dried up, and soon the group, joined by Black Rabbit and their friends, is entering a Gift Game to restore it. Diomedea animated it, as with the TV series, from Taro Tatsunoko's light novels. It includes fan service.

luck-logic.summary: In the human world of Septpia, beings from other worlds called Foreigners keep crossing over through gates and attacking. To fight them, the agency ALCA employs Logicalists, people who can form contracts with goddesses from another world and merge with them in a state called trance. Yoshichika Tsurugi is an ordinary young man who supposedly lost his Logic, the power behind abilities and emotions, years ago, and lives quietly with his family. Then, while helping people escape an attack, he meets the goddess Athena and discovers he can enter trance with her. Doga Kobo produced this 12-episode series in 2016 for Bushiroad's Luck & Logic franchise, which includes a card game. It contains battles and some fan service.

maoujou-de-oyasumi.summary: Princess Syalis has been kidnapped by the Demon Lord and locked away in his gloomy castle, while a hero sets out to rescue her. But Syalis is not afraid; she is just annoyed that she cannot sleep comfortably. Determined to get the perfect night's rest, she wanders the castle, raiding monsters for materials to make better pillows and blankets, using spells and demonic weapons for her own comfort, and leaving her captors exhausted and anxious about her safety. The demons end up more worried about her than she is about them. Doga Kobo adapted Kagiji Kumanomata's manga into this 12-episode comedy in 2020. Some of her methods are mildly gruesome.

quan-zhi-gao-shou-2018.summary: These three specials follow the first season of The King's Avatar, the Chinese series about Glory, an online game with a pro esports scene. Ye Xiu, a former top pro player who was pushed out of his club, now works at an internet cafe while building a comeback. When the cafe's owner Chen Guo gets three tickets to the All-Star Tournament, a three-day event where pros and fans meet, Ye Xiu goes along with her and Tang Rou as a spectator. Watching from the stands feels strange, and however quiet he tries to stay, the event may pull him back into the spotlight. Colored Pencil Animation produced the episodes in 2018, based on Hu Dielan's web novel.

prison-school-ova.summary: This OVA of Prison School came with the manga's twentieth volume in 2016 and adapts the Mad Wax arc, set after the TV series. The five boys of Hachimitsu Academy, a former girls' school, have been released from the school's prison and returned to normal classes. Kiyoshi and Shingo have grown close to female classmates, Andre is gaining attention for his masochism, and Gakuto has found a kindred spirit in the clumsy Mitsuko. Joe, however, struggles to fit back in, and his friend's unexpected romantic success leaves him feeling left out and wondering whether life was better behind bars. J.C.Staff animated it, as with the TV series, from Akira Hiramoto's manga. It contains explicit sexual humour, nudity and crude gags.

kono-subarashii-sekai-ni-shukufuku-wo-3.summary: KonoSuba's third season picks up after the trip to the Crimson Demon village. Kazuma Sato, a former shut-in reborn in a fantasy world, is back in the town of Axel with his dysfunctional party: the useless goddess Aqua, the explosion-obsessed wizard Megumin and the masochistic crusader Darkness. As usual, they are deep in debt and stumbling from one mess to the next, and Kazuma would rather avoid any real fight with the Demon King's army. Then an invitation arrives from a young princess who wants to hear about their adventures, and despite Darkness's protests the party heads off to meet royalty. Drive produced these 11 episodes in 2024, adapting Natsume Akatsuki's light novels. It contains comedic fan service.

girls-und-panzer-der-film.summary: The Girls und Panzer film follows the 2012 TV series, in a world where tank combat, called sensha-do, is a traditional sport for young women. Miho Nishizumi's team at Oarai Girls' Academy won the national tournament to save their school, built on a huge carrier ship, from closure. Now the Ministry of Education claims that promise was never binding and moves to shut the school down anyway, scattering its students. Their one chance is a match against a university team made up of the best players in the country, and Oarai is badly outnumbered. Actas produced the 2015 film, with Tsutomu Mizushima directing and Reiko Yoshida writing. Large, detailed tank battles fill most of it.

metropolis.summary: In the vast city of Metropolis, robots live alongside humans as second-class citizens, and unrest is growing. Shunsaku Ban, a detective from Japan, arrives with his young nephew Kenichi to track down Dr. Laughton, a scientist wanted for organ trafficking. Laughton has secretly built Tima, a lifelike android girl, for Duke Red, the city's most powerful man. When Laughton's laboratory goes up in flames, Kenichi rescues a confused Tima and, not knowing what she is, tries to shield her from Rock, Duke Red's ruthless adopted son. Madhouse produced the 2001 film, directed by Rintaro and written by Katsuhiro Otomo, loosely based on Osamu Tezuka's 1949 manga. It contains some violence.

bishoujo-senshi-sailor-moon-sailor-stars.summary: Sailor Stars is the fifth and last season of the original Sailor Moon anime. Its opening arc wraps up an unfinished threat from the previous season and brings back Haruka, Michiru, Setsuna and the reborn Hotaru. After that, Usagi Tsukino says goodbye to her boyfriend Mamoru, who leaves to study in America, and almost immediately the Three Lights, a hugely popular boy band, transfer to her school. The trio hide a secret that ties them to a new enemy, and Usagi and her friends face a threat on a scale far beyond anything before. Toei Animation adapted Naoko Takeuchi's manga into these 34 episodes, broadcast from 1996 to 1997. It continues directly from Sailor Moon SuperS.

aquarion-evol.summary: Aquarion Evol is a sequel to Genesis of Aquarion, set 12,000 years later. On the planet Vega, humanity is under attack from the Abductors, invaders from the sister world Altair who kidnap people. The defence academy Neo-DEAVA trains young pilots to fly Vectors that combine into the giant robot Aquarion, but it strictly separates boys and girls and forbids them from combining with each other. That rule breaks on day one, when the dreamy Amata Sora, who can secretly fly, and the shy Mikono Suzushiro are caught in an attack and accidentally perform a forbidden union. Satelight and 8bit produced these 26 episodes in 2012, created by Shoji Kawamori. It is full of romantic comedy and suggestive humour.

naruto-finally-a-clash-jounin-vs-genin.summary: This short Naruto side story was made for the PlayStation 2 game Naruto: Narutimate Hero 3 and released in 2005. Tsunade, the Fifth Hokage, organizes a village-wide contest in Konoha in which ninja of every rank compete to collect crystals, with the higher-ranked jonin carrying ones worth more points. The winner gets to issue a decree of their own choosing, which excites the young genin eager to beat their superiors. Naruto, however, cares less about points than about finally fighting his teacher, Kakashi, while the others pair off in matches of their own. Studio Pierrot animated it, using characters from Masashi Kishimoto's manga. It is a light, action-filled bonus with no effect on the main story.
naruto-finally-a-clash-jounin-vs-genin.notes: Wikipedia link is the parent TV series article, which only lists this OVA; plot detail comes from MAL and AniList, which agree.

toradora-sos.summary: Toradora! SOS! Hooray for Foodies is a set of four short extras included on the Toradora! DVD volumes in 2009. Each lasts about five minutes and shows the main cast, including Taiga Aisaka, Ryuji Takasu, Minori Kushieda and Ami Kawashima, as small chibi figures sampling and arguing about different foods. There is no story to speak of, only gentle comedy built on each character's familiar quirks, such as Taiga's appetite and Ryuji's love of cooking. J.C.Staff produced the shorts, as with the main series, based on Yuyuko Takemiya's light novels. They are best enjoyed by viewers who already know the characters from the 25-episode TV series.

level-e.summary: Yukitaka Tsutsui, a promising high school baseball player, moves from Tokyo to Yamagata on a sports scholarship and arrives at his new apartment to find a stranger already living there, wearing his clothes. The intruder says he is an alien whose ship crashed. He turns out to be Prince Baka, the brilliant but utterly irresponsible heir of a powerful alien kingdom, who soon proves that his favourite pastime is playing elaborate pranks on everyone around him, including his own long-suffering royal guards. Unknown to most people, Earth is home to many aliens, and the prince drags humans and visitors alike into his schemes. Studio Pierrot and David Production adapted Yoshihiro Togashi's manga into this 13-episode comedy in 2011.

hanbun-no-tsuki-ga-noboru-sora.summary: Yuichi Ezaki is a seventeen-year-old stuck in a hospital in Ise, Mie Prefecture, recovering from hepatitis A. Bored and restless, he keeps sneaking out at night, only to be caught and punished by his short-tempered nurse, Akiko. Then he meets Rika Akiba, a girl his age with a weak heart valve who has spent much of her life in hospitals. She is beautiful but selfish and moody, and she soon has Yuichi running errands for her. As they spend time together, their bond grows into a quiet romance shaped by the limits of her illness. Group TAC adapted Tsumugu Hashimoto's light novels into this 6-episode series in 2006. It deals with serious illness.

kuroko-no-basket-tip-off.summary: Tip Off is an extra episode of the first Kuroko's Basketball season, numbered 22.5 and included on the eighth Blu-ray and DVD volume in 2013. It is set while the tournament clash between Kise and Aomine, two former teammates of Tetsuya Kuroko, is still undecided, and it looks back at Kuroko's middle school days at Teiko, when he played alongside the prodigies known as the Generation of Miracles. The episode fills in background for the rivalries that drive the main series. Production I.G animated it, as with the TV series, from Tadatoshi Fujimaki's manga. It is best watched between episodes 22 and 23 of the first season.
kuroko-no-basket-tip-off.notes: MAL and AniList describe the episode differently (MAL: Teiko flashback; AniList: set during Kise vs. Aomine); summary combines both. Wikipedia link is the franchise article.

a-channel.summary: Tooru Ichii is overjoyed to win a place at the school attended by her childhood friend Run Momoki, who is a year older. Run is cheerful, forgetful and carefree, and Tooru is fiercely protective of her, which makes their first day awkward when she finds Run with another girl, the shy and easily flustered Yuko Ichinose. Along with Yuko's sharp-tongued friend Nagisa Tennoji, the four soon form a close group. Episodes follow their ordinary days: lunches on the school roof, exams, festivals, swimming trips and small misunderstandings. Studio Gokumi adapted bb Kuroda's four-panel manga into this 12-episode slice-of-life comedy in 2011. It has a soft, relaxed tone and pastel visuals.

watashi-nouryoku-wa-heikinchi-de-itta-yo.summary: Misato Kurihara always stood out because of her exceptional abilities, and it cost her friends and an ordinary life. After dying while trying to save a child, she meets a god and asks to be reborn with completely average abilities. She wakes up at ten years old as Adele von Ascham, a noble's daughter in a fantasy world, only to discover that the god's idea of average is the midpoint between the weakest creatures and the most powerful, leaving her absurdly strong. Hiding her power, she runs away to a hunters' school under the name Mile and forms a party of girl adventurers. Project No.9 adapted FUNA's light novels into this 12-episode comedy in 2019. It parodies isekai stories.

shigofumi.summary: Shigofumi are letters from the dead: when someone dies with strong feelings left unsaid, whether love, regret or hatred, they can send one final message to the living. Fumika is a quiet, expressionless girl who delivers these letters, accompanied by Kanaka, a talking staff with a far livelier personality. She makes sure each letter reaches its recipient, even when they do not want to read it, and she often witnesses the painful truths it uncovers. Each case is largely self-contained, but small hints gradually point to a mystery in Fumika's own past. J.C.Staff produced this 12-episode original series in 2008. It deals with death, abuse, suicide and violence, and some scenes are disturbing.

cardcaptor-sakura-clear-card-hen.summary: Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card follows the original series, picking up after Sakura Kinomoto has captured every Clow Card and turned them into her own Sakura Cards. She is now starting middle school, and her happiness doubles when Syaoran Li returns from Hong Kong to live in Tomoeda for good, attending the same school. But a recurring dream of a hooded figure leaves her surrounded by transparent cards, and when she wakes, her Sakura Cards have turned clear and lost their power. With a new key and new magic, Sakura sets out to understand what is happening, supported as always by her friend Tomoyo and the guardian Kero. Madhouse adapted Clamp's manga into these 22 episodes in 2018.

koe-de-oshigoto.summary: On her sixteenth birthday, high school student Kanna Aoyagi gets an unexpected request from her older sister, Yayoi, who works at Blue March, a company that makes erotic computer games. Short of voice actresses, Yayoi pressures Kanna into recording lines for the heroines of their adult games. Kanna, sweet and naive, has no idea how to perform such scenes, but she tries her best to do the job well, which leads to a stream of awkward situations at the studio and at school. Studio Gokumi adapted Azure Konno's manga into this two-episode OVA, released in 2010 and 2011. It contains explicit sexual humour, nudity and fan service centred on a 16-year-old protagonist.

hajime-no-ippo-mashiba-vs-kimura.summary: This Hajime no Ippo OVA follows on from the first TV series and focuses on Tatsuya Kimura, a likeable boxer at the Kamogawa Gym. With gym-mates Ippo Makunouchi and Mamoru Takamura both holding championship belts, Kimura feels left behind and is desperate to prove himself. He finally gets a title shot against Ryo Mashiba, the junior lightweight champion known for his menacing, long-reach 'Hitman' style. To prepare, Kimura trains with Ichiro Miyata, Ippo's rival, who has already lost to Mashiba. Mashiba, meanwhile, has his own reasons for clinging to the belt, including supporting his younger sister Kumi. Madhouse produced the single episode in 2003, adapting George Morikawa's manga. It contains intense boxing violence.

lupin-iii-part-1.summary: Lupin III, grandson of the famous gentleman thief Arsene Lupin, is a master of disguise, escape and audacious heists. He works with Daisuke Jigen, a laconic gunman who never misses, and is constantly charmed and betrayed by the seductive thief Fujiko Mine. Over the series they are joined by Goemon Ishikawa, a stern swordsman whose blade cuts through anything, while Inspector Zenigata of Interpol pursues Lupin around the world. Tokyo Movie produced this 23-episode series, the first Lupin III TV anime, adapting Monkey Punch's manga, in 1971 and 1972. Its first director, Masaaki Osumi, was replaced partway through by Hayao Miyazaki and Isao Takahata, and the tone shifts from dark crime to lighter adventure. It contains violence and sexual themes.

kingdom-2nd-season.summary: Kingdom's second season is set in China's Warring States period, a year after the brutal battle with the state of Zhao at the end of the first. The young king of Qin, Ying Zheng, is still pursuing his dream of unifying the seven warring states under one rule. Qin's next target is the smaller state of Wei, and Xin, the war orphan who dreams of being the greatest general in the land, now commands the Fei Xin unit, grown to 300 men. As Xin seeks new achievements on the battlefield, he faces rival commanders, veteran generals and political intrigue at home. Studio Pierrot produced these 39 episodes from 2013 to 2014, adapting Yasuhisa Hara's manga. It contains graphic battlefield violence.

witch-hunter-robin.summary: Witches, people born with supernatural powers called craft, have always existed in secret, and some use them to commit crimes. The organization SOLOMON hunts them, and its Japanese branch, the STN-J, operates out of Tokyo. Robin Sena, a quiet teenager who can create fire, arrives from Italy, where she was raised by the Catholic Church, to join the team as a replacement hunter. She works with the cold, distant Amon and a small group of colleagues, capturing witches with a special substance called Orbo, but the more she learns, the more she wonders what really happens to those they catch. Sunrise produced this 26-episode original series, directed by Shuko Murase, in 2002. Its tone is dark and slow-burning.

danchigai.summary: Haruki Nakano is a high school boy living in a public housing complex. His parents are away, so he shares two adjoining apartments with his four sisters, who treat him as their personal servant. Mutsuki, the eldest, is lazy and likes sleeping in his bed; Yayoi, a middle schooler, is quick to hit him when something goes wrong; and the elementary school twins, Uzuki and Satsuki, love playing pranks on him. Each very short episode is a small domestic gag about the five of them squabbling, sharing meals and getting on each other's nerves. Creators in Pack adapted Kazusa Yoneda's four-panel manga into this 12-episode short series in 2015. Its humour includes mild fan service.

sola.summary: Yorito Morimiya, a high school student, is fascinated by the sky and spends early mornings photographing sunrises over the bay. One morning he finds a girl struggling with a vending machine that has swallowed her money; he gets her tomato juice out, but she disappears before he can talk to her. Their paths cross again, and he learns her name, Matsuri, along with hints of a secret that ties her to a supernatural world. Soon his life with his older sister Aono and their old friends Mana and Koyori Ishizuki becomes entangled with hers. Nomad produced this 13-episode series in 2007, based on a story conceived by Naoki Hisaya. It is a melancholy, romantic tale with some supernatural violence.

isekai-quartet-2.summary: The second season of Isekai Quartet continues the chibi-style crossover in which the casts of Overlord, KonoSuba, Re:Zero and Tanya the Evil are pulled into another world and enrolled as classmates at the same school. Kazuma, Ainz, Subaru, Tanya and their companions assume their school days are done, but they are still stuck there. This time Naofumi and his party from Shield Hero join them, along with others from Cautious Hero, and the class faces new events, contests and rivalries. Episodes run about eleven minutes. Studio PuYUKAI produced these 12 episodes in 2020. It is a light comedy aimed at fans of the original series.

diabolik-lovers-2nd-season.summary: The second season of Diabolik Lovers continues the story of Yui Komori, a high school girl kept by the six Sakamaki brothers, pureblood vampires who feed on her blood. Troubled by strange dreams, Yui is caught in a car accident and soon falls into the hands of the Mukami brothers, four other vampires named Ruki, Kou, Yuma and Azusa, who have plans of their own for her. As the two groups of brothers clash over her, Yui is drawn deeper into secrets about vampire society and her own origins. Zexcs produced these 12 short episodes in 2015, adapting Rejet's otome game franchise. It depicts frequent biting, abusive behaviour and coercion presented in a sensual way.

break-blade-1-kakusei-no-toki.summary: On the continent of Cruzon, almost everyone can control quartz, which powers machines and daily life. Rygart Arrow is a rare exception, an 'un-sorcerer' with no such ability. Still, he befriended Hodr and Sigyn, now Krisna's king and queen, and Zess, whose brother is a senior official in the rival Athens Commonwealth, during their school days. Years later, as war between Krisna and Athens begins, Rygart visits the capital and discovers that his lack of quartz power lets him pilot an ancient golem no one else can move. When Athens attacks, he must decide whether to fight an old friend. Production I.G and Xebec produced this first of six films in 2010, adapting Yunosuke Yoshinaga's manga. It contains mecha combat.

saraiya-goyou.summary: In Edo-period Japan, Masanosuke Akitsu is a ronin who is skilled with a sword but so timid and awkward that his employers keep firing him. Hungry and out of options, he meets Yaichi, a relaxed, enigmatic man who hires him as a bodyguard almost on a whim. Masanosuke soon learns that Yaichi leads the Five Leaves, a small group that carries out kidnappings for ransom. Though he disapproves, he keeps returning to their company, drawn by the friendship of the gang members and curious about Yaichi's hidden past. Manglobe produced this 12-episode series, adapting Natsume Ono's manga, and it aired on Fuji TV's Noitamina block in 2010. It is quiet and character-driven, with a distinctive art style.

seikon-no-qwaser-ii.summary: The second season of The Qwaser of Stigmata brings back Sasha, the silver-haired Russian boy who can control a single chemical element and draws his strength from a partner known as a Maria. This time he is teamed with a new Maria, Hana, and the pair go undercover at a school for girls, which means Sasha has to pass himself off as a female student. Their target is a Qwaser relic said to have surfaced inside one of the pupils, and rival factions want it too. Hoods Entertainment produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from April to June 2011, adapting the manga by Hiroyuki Yoshino and Kenetsu Sato. The series features heavy fan service, frequent nudity and violent fights.
seikon-no-qwaser-ii.notes: Season 2 premise appears only in the ANN synopsis (reused by MAL and AniList); Wikipedia confirms the season, episode count and dates.

dragon-ball-z-movie-02-konoyo-de-ichiban.summary: The second Dragon Ball Z film is a standalone adventure set apart from the TV continuity. A scientist named Dr. Kochin uses the Dragon Balls to free his master, Dr. Wheelo, whose laboratory lies trapped under the ice of a remote mountain. Wheelo survives only as a brain inside a machine, and he wants a new body: that of the strongest fighter alive. He sends Kochin's Bio-Men to grab the man he believes fits the description, which draws Gohan, Piccolo, Krillin and finally Goku into a rescue mission at the frozen lab. Toei Animation released the film in Japan on 10 March 1990, based on Akira Toriyama's manga.

owari-no-seraph-owaranai-seraph.summary: Owaranai Seraph is a set of nine short bonus episodes that came with the Japanese Blu-ray and DVD volumes of Seraph of the End in 2015. Each lasts a few minutes and is drawn from the extra pages printed in the manga, giving the main cast, including Yuichiro and his squad from the Moon Demon Company, a break from the war against the vampires. The parent series is set after a virus wipes out most adults, leaving vampires to rule over surviving children, and Yuichiro trains with the Japanese Imperial Demon Army to take revenge. Wit Studio produced the shorts, based on the manga by Takaya Kagami and Yamato Yamamoto. They assume viewers know the first season.

ahiru-no-sora.summary: Sora Kurumatani loves basketball, but he is far shorter than nearly everyone who plays it. Determined to prove that size is not everything, he enrolls at Kuzuryu High School to join the boys' team, partly to keep a promise to his mother, only to discover that the club has become a hangout for delinquents who barely touch a ball. Sora sets out to turn this group of unlikely teammates into a real squad, starting with tall, troubled Momoharu Hanazono and his friends. Diomedea adapted Takeshi Hinata's long-running manga into a 50-episode series that aired from October 2019 to September 2020. It is a gritty, underdog sports drama with school-life comedy along the way.

re-zero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu-hy.summary: Frozen Bonds is a prequel to Re:Zero, set long before Subaru arrives in the other world. It tells how Emilia came to live alongside Puck, the cat-like great spirit who later acts as her guardian. Emilia, a half-elf whose silver hair and appearance make people fear her, lives alone in the icy Elior Forest, where the rest of her community has been frozen. The story follows her early days with Puck, her wish to help the people she lost, and the dangers that close in on the forest. White Fox, the studio behind the TV series, released this feature-length OVA in November 2019. It adapts a prequel story by Tappei Nagatsuki that first came with the series' Japanese Blu-ray.

shichisei-no-subaru.summary: When they were children, six friends formed Subaru, the most famous party in the online role-playing game Union. Then one of them, Asahi, died while the game was running, the company pulled the plug, and the group drifted apart. Six years later, Haruto, now a high school student, logs into the game's revived version, Re'Union, and finds a player who looks and talks exactly like Asahi. Wanting to know whether she is really his lost friend, he sets out to bring the old members back together inside the game. Lerche adapted Noritake Tao's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2018. The series mixes game-world action with a melancholy story about grief and friendship.

aki-sora.summary: Aki Sora is a one-episode OVA based on the manga by Masahiro Itosugi. Sora Aoi lives with his older sister Aki and his twin sister Nami. Sora has always been close to his siblings, but after an awkward moment with Aki in the bath he realises that his feelings for her go beyond family love. To his surprise, Aki tells him she feels the same way, and the two begin a relationship that they keep hidden from everyone else. Hoods Entertainment produced the OVA, directed by Takeo Takahashi, as part of a short run of releases tied to the manga's volumes. This OVA contains explicit sexual content and centres on an incestuous relationship between siblings.

scrapped-princess.summary: A prophecy declares that the newborn princess Pacifica will destroy the world on her sixteenth birthday, so the royal family orders her death. She survives, taken in and raised in secret by a commoner family, the Casulls. Years later, Pacifica is a lively fifteen-year-old travelling with her adoptive siblings, Shannon, a skilled swordsman, and Raquel, a gentle wizard. When word spreads that the 'Scrapped Princess' is alive, the church of the god Mauser, the nobility and ordinary villagers all start hunting her. Bones produced the 24-episode series in 2003, adapting Ichiro Sakaki's light novels. It begins as a fantasy road story, gradually reveals science fiction ideas behind its world, and has a wistful tone.

akikan.summary: High school student Kakeru Daichi buys a can of melon soda that turns into a girl. Kakeru calls her Melon, and finds out that she is an Akikan, one of many cans that take human form and fight each other in a contest to decide whether steel cans or aluminium cans are better. Melon is a steel can who needs carbon dioxide to keep going, so she sticks close to Kakeru, which pulls him into the battles whether he likes it or not, and irritates his childhood friend Najimi. Brain's Base adapted Riku Ranjo's light novel series, illustrated by Hiro Suzuhira, into 12 episodes broadcast from January to March 2009. It is a silly ecchi comedy.

rose-of-versailles.summary: The Rose of Versailles takes place in France in the decades before and during the Revolution. Oscar Francois de Jarjayes is the daughter of a noble family, raised as a boy by her father because he wanted a son to inherit his post at the head of the palace guard. As an adult she guards the young Austrian princess Marie Antoinette, who has arrived to marry the future Louis XVI, while Oscar's loyal childhood companion Andre stays at her side. Tokyo Movie Shinsha made the 40-episode series from 1979 to 1980, adapting Riyoko Ikeda's manga, with Tadao Nagahama and then Osamu Dezaki directing. It mixes court intrigue, romance and political upheaval.

kodomo-no-jikan.summary: Daisuke Aoki is 23 and has just started his first teaching job, in charge of a third-grade class at an elementary school. One of his pupils, nine-year-old Rin Kokonoe, decides she is his girlfriend and keeps trying to fluster him with provocative behaviour, while her friends Kuro and Mimi bring their own problems into class. Aoki tries to handle her antics properly while slowly learning about the difficult home life behind them. The 12-episode series aired in Japan from October to December 2007, adapting the manga by Kaworu Watashiya; the TV broadcast was heavily censored. The series is controversial for its sexualised depiction of young children and contains suggestive content involving minors.

sarazanmai.summary: In Tokyo's Asakusa district, three middle school boys, Kazuki Yasaka, his friend Enta Jinnai and the troublemaker Toi Kuji, accidentally break a kappa statue. Keppi, the prince of the Kappa Kingdom, turns them into kappa and tells them they can only change back by fighting zombie creatures born from people's hidden desires and taking the shirikodama, a mythical organ, from them. Each fight forces the boys to reveal secrets about themselves to one another. Kunihiko Ikuhara created and directed this 11-episode original series, produced by MAPPA and Lapin Track and aired on Fuji TV's Noitamina block in spring 2019. It is surreal, heavily symbolic and built around repeated musical sequences.

hidamari-sketch.summary: Yuno has just been accepted into Yamabuki Arts High School and moves into the Hidamari Apartments, a small building across the road where several students live. Her neighbours quickly become her friends: the energetic Miyako, who is in her year, and two older girls, the careful and caring Hiro and the composed Sae. Episodes follow the four as they deal with art assignments, cook together, struggle with money and share small everyday moments. Shaft adapted Ume Aoki's four-panel manga into a 12-episode series that aired in early 2007, and later made several follow-ups. The tone is relaxed and quiet, with playful, experimental visuals.

natsume-yuujinchou-itsuka-yuki-no-hi-ni.summary: Sometime on a Snowy Day is a one-episode OVA of Natsume's Book of Friends, released in February 2014 with the staff and cast of the TV seasons. It is a winter story: while his aunt cooks dinner at home and Nyanko-sensei naps by a heater, Takashi Natsume heads out for a walk in the first snowfall. He meets a small yokai shaped like a snowman, who is looking for something warm and bright but cannot explain exactly what it is. Natsume decides to help it search. Brain's Base produced the OVA, adapting Yuki Midorikawa's manga. Like the TV series, it is a quiet, gentle episode about kindness between humans and spirits, and it is best enjoyed after the earlier seasons.

maou-gakuin-no-futekigousha-shijou-saiky.summary: This first half of the second season continues the story of Anos Voldigoad, a legendary demon king who was reborn 2,000 years after his own era and enrolled at the Demon King Academy, only to be labelled a misfit. With the demon realm at peace, Anos wants a quiet student life, but new threats appear. Talk of a 'Child of God' whose power might match his own leads him to the realm of the spirits, which can only be entered after a series of trials. Silver Link produced these 12 episodes, which began in January 2023 and, after a broadcast delay, finished in September. The series adapts the light novels by Shu, illustrated by Yoshinori Shizuma.

umi-ga-kikoeru.summary: Ocean Waves is a Studio Ghibli television film first broadcast on Nippon TV on 5 May 1993. In the seaside city of Kochi, high school friends Taku Morisaki and Yutaka Matsuno meet Rikako Muto, a clever and athletic transfer student from Tokyo who keeps her classmates at arm's length and soon gets a reputation for being stuck-up. Matsuno is drawn to her straight away, while Taku finds himself tangled up in her problems after she asks him for an unexpected favour during a school trip to Hawaii. The film follows how the three of them affect one another. Tomomi Mochizuki directed this adaptation of Saeko Himuro's novel, a low-key, realistic coming-of-age story built around a love triangle.

ixion-saga-dt.summary: Kon Hokaze is an ordinary gamer playing an online role-playing game when a message from a girl inside the game suddenly pulls him into the world of Mira, chair and all. He arrives just in time to crush an assassin with his swivel chair, saving Princess Ecarlate, whom a militant faction of her own country is trying to capture. With no idea how to get home, Kon joins her escort on a long and eventful journey. Brain's Base produced the 25-episode series, broadcast from October 2012 to the end of March 2013 and based on an online game by Capcom. It is a parody of fantasy adventures, full of crude jokes and running gags.

heroic-age.summary: In the far future, humanity is the Iron Tribe, the last of several races once invited into space by the departed Golden Tribe. The more powerful Silver and Bronze Tribes regard humans as a threat and are hunting them toward extinction. Aboard the ship Argonaut, the young clairvoyant princess Dhianeila follows a prophecy to search for a saviour, and finds Age, a boy with a childlike heart living alone on a half-ruined planet, who turns out to have astonishing abilities. Xebec produced this 26-episode original space opera, conceived by Tow Ubukata, which aired on TV Tokyo from April to September 2007. It mixes mecha battles with a story drawn from Greek myth.

yama-no-susume.summary: Aoi Yukimura loved mountains as a little girl, but a childhood accident left her afraid of heights, and by high school she prefers quiet indoor hobbies and has few friends. Then she runs into Hinata Kuraue, an outgoing girl she climbed with as a child, who is determined to drag her back outdoors and to show her a sunrise from a mountain top. Their first outings are small, beginning with a gentle peak near home, and Aoi slowly rediscovers why she enjoyed hiking. 8bit adapted the manga by Shiro into 12 five-minute episodes broadcast from January to March 2013, the first of several seasons. It is a gentle, relaxed slice-of-life series with practical climbing details.

kemono-no-souja-erin.summary: Erin is a ten-year-old girl in a kingdom divided between a ruler revered as divine and a Grand Duke whose army fights on Toda, huge dragon-like beasts. Her village raises the Toda, and her mother is its chief Toda doctor, so Erin grows up fascinated by animals and asks endless questions about how they live. Her curiosity and her rare bond with creatures will eventually tie her to the kingdom's politics and to the Royal Beasts, rare and majestic creatures linked to the throne. Production I.G and Trans Arts made the 50-episode series for NHK, aired through 2009, from Nahoko Uehashi's novel The Beast Player. It is a slow, thoughtful fantasy suitable for younger viewers.

ansatsu-kyoushitsu-tv-episode-0.summary: Meeting Time is a short 'episode 0' of Assassination Classroom made by Lerche ahead of the TV series and first shown at a Jump event in November 2014. The series is about Class 3-E, a group of junior high students written off by their school, whose new homeroom teacher is Koro-sensei, a super-fast octopus-like being who has promised to destroy the Earth unless his own students manage to kill him first. In this special, Koro-sensei looks back on how he first met Tadaomi Karasuma, the government agent assigned to the class, describing an epic clash between the two. Karasuma, however, remembers it very differently. It is a light comedy piece adapted from Yusei Matsui's manga.

witchblade.summary: This Japanese Witchblade series tells its own story, that only borrows its premise from the American comic book. Masane Amaha is a clumsy, kind-hearted single mother with no job, fighting a child welfare office determined to remove her adopted daughter Rihoko from her care. When a weapon disguised as a human attacks her, a mysterious power on her wrist awakens and transforms her into a powerful warrior.
