The Witchblade makes Masane a target for corporations and government groups with their own plans for it. Gonzo produced the 24 episodes, directed by Yoshimitsu Ohashi and broadcast from April to September 2006. The show contains graphic violence and frequent fan service.

dragon-ball-z-movie-09-ginga-girigiri-bu.summary: The ninth Dragon Ball Z film is set while Goku is gone after the battle with Cell. A wealthy man named Mr. Money organises a grand martial arts tournament for fighters from across the galaxy, with Mr. Satan as the headline act. Gohan, Future Trunks, Piccolo, Krillin, Tien and Yamcha all sign up. What none of them realise is that Bojack, a villain who has broken out of an ancient prison, has entered his own team of brutal fighters, turning the competition into something far more dangerous. Toei Animation released the film on 10 July 1993 at the Toei Anime Fair. It is based on characters from Akira Toriyama's manga.

my-little-monster-ova.summary: My Little Monster: My Little Yakuza is a one-episode OVA that drops the cast of My Little Monster into a period comedy set in old Edo. Shizuku Mizutani and Haru Yoshida become the heads of two rival gangs, while Chizuru Oshima appears as a sweets-loving princess cramming for an English exam, and the shogun has banned all sweets in town to keep her focused. The plot loosely follows the friendships and misunderstandings of the TV series, retold as a costume farce. Brain's Base, the studio behind the 2012 TV anime, produced it, and it was packaged with a special edition of the manga's 12th volume in August 2013. It is aimed at fans of the series.
my-little-monster-ova.notes: Plot of the OVA appears only in the MAL synopsis; AniList confirms the release format and bundling.

flcl-alternative.summary: FLCL Alternative is the third installment of FLCL, a six-episode sequel series that premiered on Adult Swim's Toonami block in September 2018 and was shown in Japanese cinemas as a film. Kana Koumoto is a high school student in a quiet small town who spends her days with her three close friends and worries that nothing exciting will ever happen. While the group plans to build a homemade rocket, things change with the arrival of Haruko Haruhara, the reckless alien from the original series, and the giant robots and strange battles that follow her. Production I.G, NUT and Revoroot produced the animation. It keeps the series' surreal style but focuses more on friendship.

seikaisuru-kado.summary: Kojiro Shindo is a calm, highly skilled negotiator working for Japan's foreign ministry. As he sits on a plane about to leave Tokyo's Haneda Airport, an enormous cube suddenly appears out of nowhere and swallows the aircraft whole. Inside, the passengers are unharmed, and a being who takes the form of a young man, calling himself Yaha-kui zaShunina, asks Shindo to help him communicate with humanity. What zaShunina wants, and what his offers will mean for the world, becomes the centre of a series about diplomacy and first contact. Toei Animation produced the 12-episode original series in CG, broadcast from April to June 2017, with Ako Arisaka designing the characters.

code-geass-akito-the-exiled-3.summary: The Brightness Falls is the third of five parts of Code Geass: Akito the Exiled, a side story set in Europe between the two seasons of Lelouch of the Rebellion, while the Holy Britannian Empire invades the continent. It continues following the W-0 unit, a European force that sends soldiers such as the pilot Akito into battle in Knightmare Frames. After learning who their real enemy is, the squad tries to get back to its base but becomes stranded far from home, while Britannia's forces prepare a new offensive. Sunrise released this part in Japanese cinemas on 2 May 2015, with Kazuki Akane directing. It follows directly from the first two parts.

black-butler-special.summary: This one-episode Black Butler special was released in September 2009, after the first TV season. To celebrate the third anniversary of his company, Funtom, Earl Ciel Phantomhive has organised a performance of Hamlet for children from poor families. When the hired theatre troupe is unable to arrive in time, Ciel orders his butler Sebastian to make sure the play still goes ahead. Sebastian sets about turning the household servants and a crowd of familiar faces from the series into an improvised cast, with chaotic results during rehearsals. A-1 Pictures produced the special, based on Yana Toboso's manga. It is a comedic side story with no bearing on the main plot.

toriko.summary: Toriko takes place in the Gourmet Age, an era when people chase ever more spectacular foods and the world is filled with edible landscapes and monstrous animals that taste incredible. Toriko is a Gourmet Hunter, a muscular adventurer with superhuman senses who tracks down rare ingredients, and he dreams of completing his own perfect full-course meal. He is joined by Komatsu, a nervous young chef eager to get better at his craft, who tags along to see legendary ingredients for himself. Toei Animation adapted Mitsutoshi Shimabukuro's Weekly Shonen Jump manga into 147 episodes from April 2011 to March 2014. It combines monster battles, food and themes of friendship.

adachi-to-shimamura.summary: Sakura Adachi and Hougetsu Shimamura are first-year high school students who both have a habit of skipping class. They keep meeting in the same hidden corner upstairs in the school gym, where they pass the time playing table tennis and chatting. As they spend more time together, Adachi realises that her feelings for Shimamura go beyond friendship, and she struggles to express them, while the easygoing Shimamura simply sees her as a friend. Tezuka Productions adapted the light novels by Hitoma Iruma into 12 episodes broadcast from October to December 2020. It is a quiet, introspective romance that often shows each girl's private thoughts.

adventure-time-2.summary: Season two of Adventure Time, the American cartoon created by Pendleton Ward, ran on Cartoon Network from October 2010 to May 2011. It keeps the format of the first season: short, mostly self-contained stories about Finn, a human boy who longs to be a hero, and Jake, his dog brother and closest companion, who can stretch and change his shape and size. The pair roam the strange, post-apocalyptic Land of Ooo, helping or annoying recurring characters such as Princess Bubblegum, the Ice King and Marceline the Vampire Queen. Episodes run about 11 minutes each, and the show is an absurd, playful series aimed at all ages.
adventure-time-2.notes: Western animation with no MyAnimeList or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia.

one-room.summary: One Room is a short original anime told entirely in the first person: the viewer plays the unseen young man, and each girl talks directly to the camera. The series is split into three separate stories, each set in a small apartment. Yui Hanasaka, a high school girl who has just moved in next door, asks her new neighbour to tutor her for university entrance exams. Natsuki Momohara comes to Tokyo for the summer and stays with her older brother. Moka Aoshima, an aspiring singer, reconnects with a childhood friend who wants to be a novelist. Typhoon Graphics animated the 12 short episodes, broadcast from January to March 2017, with original character designs by Kantoku.

shigatsu-wa-kimi-no-uso-ova.summary: Moments is a one-episode OVA of Your Lie in April that was packaged with a limited edition of the manga's 11th volume in May 2015. It goes back several years before the TV series to show how three young pianists first became tied together. Kosei Arima is a child prodigy whose expressive early playing deeply moves Emi Igawa, while his later, mechanically precise style wins over Takeshi Aiza. Neither Emi nor Takeshi ever tells him how much he shaped them, and each starts preparing performances aimed at reaching him. A-1 Pictures, which made the TV anime, produced the OVA from Naoshi Arakawa's manga. It works best for viewers who have already seen the series.

fate-kaleid-liner-prisma-illya-3rei.summary: The third season of Prisma Illya picks up with Illyasviel von Einzbern stranded in a different version of Fuyuki City, the parallel world that her friend Miyu comes from. Summer snow is falling, the city has a giant crater at its centre, and Illya is alone, without her friends or her talking magical wand Ruby. Miyu has been taken by the powerful Ainsworth family, and Illya sets out to find her and bring her home. Silver Link produced the 12 episodes, aired from July to September 2016, adapting Hiroshi Hiroyama's spin-off manga of Type-Moon's Fate/stay night. It follows directly from the second season.

kono-oto-tomare-2.summary: The second part of Kono Oto Tomare! continues the story of the koto club at Tokise High School, a once-dying club that grew into a tight group around its president Takezo Kurata, former delinquent Chika Kudo and koto prodigy Satowa Hozuki. Having learned hard lessons from their first major competition, the members commit to improving together and set their sights on the national koto championship. Along the way they face stronger rival schools, family pressure and the personal problems each of them carries. Platinum Vision produced these 13 episodes, broadcast from October to December 2019 as a direct continuation of the spring run. The series adapts Amyu's manga and centres on the traditional instrument.

cuticle-detective-inaba.summary: Hiroshi Inaba is a private detective who is part wolf, the result of genetic engineering, and he solves cases by examining, and sometimes tasting, people's hair, which has also given him an odd obsession with it. Running his agency with a cross-dressing secretary and a fairly normal teenage assistant, Inaba spends most of his time chasing Don Valentino, a mafia boss who is actually a goat with a taste for eating money. Each case tends to dissolve into gags, wordplay and characters bickering. Zexcs adapted Mochi's manga into 12 episodes broadcast from January to March 2013. The show is a fast-paced absurdist comedy with only a loose mystery framework.

getsuyoubi-no-tawawa.summary: Tawawa on Monday is a series of very short web episodes based on illustrations that Kiseki Himura posted online every Monday. On his crowded Monday morning train, an office worker keeps running into Ai, a cheerful high school girl, and starts standing guard over her during the commute; the two chat and slowly become friends, and she tries to brighten his start to the week. Other short segments follow other girls and the men around them. Pine Jam animated the 12 episodes, released from October to December 2016. The series consists largely of fan service focused on the bodies of teenage girls.

kage-no-jitsuryokusha-ni-naritakute-2nd-.summary: The second season of The Eminence in Shadow continues the adventures of Cid Kagenou, a young man reborn in a fantasy world who pretends to be an ordinary background character while secretly leading Shadow Garden, a group he thinks he made up. This time he heads to the Lawless City, a dangerous place under a red moon where three powerful rulers hold sway. One of them, the vampire called the Blood Queen, has been asleep in her coffin for ages and is about to wake, and Cid sees a perfect chance to play the mysterious hero. Nexus produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from October to December 2023, adapting Daisuke Aizawa's light novels.

schwarzesmarken.summary: Schwarzesmarken is set in 1983 in an alternate history where alien creatures called the BETA have invaded Earth and are pushing deep into Europe. In East Germany, the 666th Tactical Surface Fighter Squadron, nicknamed Schwarzesmarken, is an elite and feared unit whose pilots fly giant mechs under harsh orders. Second Lieutenant Theodor Eberbach, one of its pilots, has learned to keep his distance from others, with the Stasi, the state secret police, watching everyone. Liden Films and ixtl produced the 12 episodes in early 2016, based on the light novels in the Muv-Luv universe. The series contains graphic violence and bleak political themes.

dragon-ball-z-movie-11-super-senshi-geki.summary: The eleventh Dragon Ball Z film is a standalone side story. Mr. Satan receives a challenge from Jaga Bada, an old rival who has become rich and now wants a rematch on his private island. Trunks and Goten sneak along for fun, and Android 18 follows because Mr. Satan still owes her money. On the island, the group discovers that Jaga Bada's scientists have been running a secret lab where they are trying to bring back Broly, the Legendary Super Saiyan, as a bio-engineered clone. Toei Animation released the film in Japan on 9 July 1994 at the Toei Anime Fair. It is based on Akira Toriyama's manga.

high-school-fleet.summary: In an alternate world where Japan lost much of its land to the sea, coastal cities depend on the ocean, and girls dream of becoming Blue Mermaids, the women who patrol and protect the waters. Akeno Misaki starts at the girls' marine high school in Yokosuka and is made captain of the small destroyer Harekaze, crewed by her fellow first-years. On their very first training voyage, something goes badly wrong, and the crew suddenly find themselves accused of mutiny and on the run. Production IMS produced this 12-episode original series, aired from April to June 2016, directed by Yuu Nobuta with original character designs by Atto. It mixes cute school life with naval action.

kimi-ga-aruji-de-shitsuji-ga-ore-de.summary: After trouble at home, Ren Uesugi and his older sister Mihato run away to the city, where they quickly run out of money. Their luck turns when they find jobs as live-in servants at the mansion of the wealthy Kuonji family, serving three very different sisters: the proud eldest Shinra, the gentle Miyu and the youngest, Yume. Ren has to learn the duties of a butler while dealing with the other staff, the sisters' friends and plenty of comic misunderstandings. A.C.G.T. adapted Minato Soft's visual novel, originally an adult PC game, into 13 episodes broadcast from January to March 2008. The show is a harem comedy with frequent fan service and sexual innuendo.

dance-with-devils.summary: Ritsuka Tachibana is a model student at an elite private academy, so she is shocked when the student council summons her for breaking school rules. Its handsome members, led by president Rem Kaginuki, seem far more interested in her than in any rule. That same day her mother disappears, and Ritsuka learns that devils, vampires and other beings are searching for a forbidden grimoire that grants power over the world, and that they believe she is the key to finding it. Brain's Base produced the 12-episode original series, which aired from October to December 2015. It is a supernatural romance in which characters regularly break into song, much like a stage musical.

guilty-crown-lost-christmas.summary: Lost Christmas is a roughly 15-minute animated side story included with a special edition of Guilty Crown: Lost Christmas, a visual novel spin-off of the Guilty Crown TV series made by Nitroplus. Set in 2029, it follows Scrooge, a man who has been genetically altered in experiments and who escapes from the facility where he was held, using psychic powers against those sent after him. While on the run he meets Carol, another test subject, and when their pursuers close in she asks him to draw a weapon out of her body with his right arm. Production I.G produced it in 2012. It has its own characters and can be watched without the series. It contains violent action.

dr-stone-ryusui.summary: Dr. Stone: Ryusui is a television special that bridges seasons two and three. With the Kingdom of Science now united, Senku Ishigami wants to cross the ocean to find where the mysterious light that turned humanity to stone came from. That means building a ship, and a ship needs a skilled captain. Senku's team revives Ryusui Nanami, the heir to a huge shipping company and an expert on sailing ships, who is thrilled that nothing in this new world has an owner yet. Before he will take the helm, the team must find oil to power the vessel. TMS Entertainment broadcast the special on 10 July 2022, adapting the manga by Riichiro Inagaki and Boichi.

one-piece-strong-world-episode-0.summary: Strong World Episode 0 is a short One Piece OVA made by Toei Animation and given a limited release in 2010, tied to the film One Piece Film: Strong World. It goes back more than twenty years before Luffy's voyage, to the age of the Pirate King, Gol D. Roger. The story centres on Shiki, the 'Golden Lion', a feared pirate captain, and his clash with Roger, while also glancing at events around the world in the period of Roger's execution. It adapts a bonus chapter that Eiichiro Oda drew as background for the film. Viewers will get the most out of it if they already know the main series and the Strong World movie.

dog-days-2.summary: Dog Days' is the second season of Dog Days, the fantasy series about Shinku Izumi, a sporty boy summoned to the world of Flonyard to serve as hero of the Biscotti Republic. In Flonyard, wars between nations follow special rules and nobody dies. Shinku returns for another visit, and this time he is not alone: his close friend Rebecca Anderson becomes the hero of the Principality of Pastillage, while his athletic cousin and rival Nanami Takatsuki is chosen as hero of Galette. Seven Arcs produced the 13 episodes, which aired from July to September 2012, from an original story by Masaki Tsuzuki. It is a light, upbeat adventure.

tsubasa-chronicle-2nd-season.summary: The second season of Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle continues CLAMP's dimension-hopping fantasy. Princess Sakura of the Kingdom of Clow has lost her memories, which were scattered across many worlds in the form of feathers. Syaoran, the young archaeologist who grew up with her, travels between dimensions to recover them, alongside the stern ninja Kurogane, the easygoing magician Fai D. Flowright and the small creature Mokona, who makes the jumps possible. In this season the worlds they visit grow more dangerous and the journey takes a heavier toll on the group. Bee Train animated the 26 episodes, broadcast from April to November 2006 as a follow-up to the first season.

chio-chan-no-tsuugakuro.summary: Chio Miyamo is a first-year high school student who stays up far too late playing Western video games, so she is almost always running late in the morning. Her walk to Samejima Academy turns into a series of absurd challenges as she tries to save time or avoid embarrassment: detours around blocked streets, a run-in with a motorcycle gang and an older student utterly devoted to kabaddi. Her sharp-tongued best friend Manana often joins in. Diomedea adapted Tadataka Kawasaki's manga into 12 episodes, broadcast from July to September 2018. It is a fast-paced gag comedy built around one character's commute.

sword-art-online-progressive-movie-hoshi.summary: Aria of a Starless Night retells the start of Sword Art Online from the point of view of Asuna Yuuki, adapting Reki Kawahara's Progressive novels. Asuna is a model student preparing for high school exams when her friend Misumi 'Mito' Tozawa persuades her to log in to the launch of a new virtual reality game. Once inside, thousands of players learn they cannot log out, and that dying in the game means dying in real life. Asuna, a complete gaming novice, has to learn to fight and survive the first floor of the giant castle Aincrad with Mito's help. A-1 Pictures produced the film, directed by Ayako Kono and released in Japan in October 2021. It has violent combat.

pokemon-advanced-generation-nanayo-no-ne.summary: Jirachi, Wish Maker is the sixth Pokemon film and the first of the Advanced Generation era. Ash, May, Max and Brock arrive at a festival held for a comet that appears once every thousand years and stays visible for seven nights. There they see a show by a stage magician named Butler, who has a strange object from which Max hears a voice calling to him. It turns out to hold Jirachi, a legendary Pokemon that can grant wishes, and soon Max and Jirachi become friends while Butler reveals plans of his own for its power. Kunihiko Yuyama directed the film, which OLM animated and Toho released in Japan on 19 July 2003. It is aimed at families.

haikyuu-lev-genzan.summary: Lev Appears is a short Haikyu!! OVA that turns away from Karasuno to focus on its rival school, Nekoma. The volleyball team gets a new first-year, Lev Haiba, a very tall half-Russian boy who calls himself the future ace but barely knows the basics of the sport. Nekoma's coach puts him into a practice match anyway, which means the quiet setter Kenma Kozume, who hates unnecessary effort, has to find a way to make sets work for an enthusiastic beginner. Production I.G produced it with the TV series staff, based on Haruichi Furudate's manga. It is a light, self-contained side story that works best for viewers who already know the Nekoma team.

yu-gi-oh-5d-s.summary: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's takes place years after the original series, in Neo Domino City, where the most popular form of the card game is Riding Duels, played at high speed on motorcycle-like machines called Duel Runners. The city is sharply divided: the rich live in Neo Domino, while the poor are stuck on Satellite, an island where the city's waste is sent. Yusei Fudo, a calm mechanic from Satellite, builds his own Duel Runner to cross over and confront his old friend Jack Atlas, who took Yusei's prized Stardust Dragon card. Studio Gallop produced the 154 episodes, broadcast from April 2008 to March 2011, as the follow-up to Yu-Gi-Oh! GX.

haruchika-haruta-to-chika-wa-seishun-sur.summary: Chika Homura gives up volleyball when she starts high school and joins the wind instrument club, hoping that playing the flute will help her become more feminine. The club is so small that it is close to being shut down, and she also runs into Haruta Kamijo, her childhood friend, who now plays the French horn. To their annoyance, they are rivals for the affection of the same person: their young music teacher, Shinjiro Kusakabe. While trying to recruit enough members to compete, Chika and Haruta keep stumbling into small puzzles around the school, which Haruta is good at solving. P.A. Works adapted Sei Hatsuno's mystery novels into 12 episodes in early 2016.

bishoujo-senshi-sailor-moon-supers.summary: Sailor Moon SuperS, directed by Kunihiko Ikuhara, is the anime's fourth season. This time the villains are the Dead Moon Circus, who arrive searching for a special Golden Mirror, attacking people to look inside the mirrors of their dreams. At the same time, a mysterious white Pegasus begins appearing in the dreams of Chibiusa, the pink-haired girl from the future, and she forms a special bond with it. Usagi Tsukino and the Sailor Guardians must protect people's dreams while learning more about the creature. Toei Animation produced the 39 episodes, broadcast on TV Asahi from March 1995 to March 1996, adapting the 'Dream' arc of Naoko Takeuchi's manga with a lighter, more comic tone.

Kimetsu-no-Yaiba-Hashira-Geikohen.summary: The Hashira Training Arc is the fourth season of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. After the battles in the swordsmith village, the Demon Slayer Corps knows that a final confrontation with Muzan Kibutsuji is coming. To prepare, the Hashira, its most powerful swordsmen, set up a series of intense training camps for the rank-and-file slayers, each one built around a particular Hashira's specialty. Tanjiro Kamado moves from one camp to the next, while Muzan continues his hunt for Tanjiro's sister Nezuko. Ufotable produced the eight episodes, which aired from May to June 2024 and opened with an hour-long episode, adapting Koyoharu Gotouge's manga. It contains violence.

shinmai-maou-no-testament-ova.summary: This one-episode OVA of The Testament of Sister New Devil came with a volume of the light novels in June 2015. It is made of two comic side stories set during the first season. In one, Maria, the succubus who lives with the family, tries out a new device to record her stepsister Mio's dreams; in the other, Basara Tojo is invited to the apartment of the school nurse, Chisato Hasegawa, for dinner. Production IMS, which made the TV series, produced the OVA, adapting the light novels by Tetsuto Uesu and Nekosuke Okuma. It has no real story progression and exists mainly for fan service. It contains explicit sexual content and nudity.

monster-musume-no-oishasan.summary: Years after a war between humans and monsters ended, the city of Lindworm has become a place where many species live side by side. Glenn Litbeit is a young human doctor who specialises in monster medicine, running a small clinic with his assistant Sapphee, a lamia whose lower body is a snake. His patients include harpies, centaurs, mermaids and other creatures whose bodies work very differently from a human's, and each case calls for careful, sometimes unusual treatment. Arvo Animation adapted Yoshino Origuchi's light novels, illustrated by Z-Ton, into 12 episodes broadcast from July to September 2020. The series contains frequent fan service and suggestive medical examinations.

yami-shibai.summary: Yamishibai is an anthology of very short horror stories drawn from Japanese urban legends and folklore. Each episode begins at dusk, when a man in a yellow mask appears in a playground and tells a story to the children who gather there, using the kamishibai, a traditional paper theatre in which pictures are slid out of a wooden frame one by one. The animation copies that style, with mostly still drawings moved like paper cut-outs, and each tale introduces new characters and a new curse or apparition. ILCA produced the 13 episodes of the first season for TV Tokyo, broadcast from July to September 2013, with further seasons following. It contains unsettling and frightening imagery.

ushinawareta-mirai-wo-motomete.summary: Sou Akiyama belongs to the astronomy club at Uchihama Academy, a small group of friends preparing a planetarium for the school's cultural festival. One evening an unnatural tremor shakes the clubroom, a strange cube begins to glow, and Sou finds an unconscious girl who soon turns up as a new transfer student. From then on the club is pulled into stranger and stranger events, from ghost sightings to quarrels between school clubs, while slowly working out who the newcomer is. Feel adapted the visual novel by Trumple, originally an adult PC game, into 12 episodes broadcast from October to December 2014. It mixes school romance with science-fiction mystery.

berserk-2017.summary: The second season of the 2016 Berserk series keeps following Guts, the Black Swordsman, through a world falling apart. Monsters and spirits now roam the kingdom of Midland openly, and the brand on Guts's neck draws them to him wherever he goes. He is travelling with Casca, his former comrade, who lost her mind and memory in an earlier catastrophe and no longer recognises him, and they head toward Elfhelm, a land of elves said to offer refuge from the demons. Millepensee and GEMBA produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from April to June 2017, adapting part of Kentaro Miura's manga. It contains graphic violence, gore, nudity and sexual violence.

working-lord-of-the-takanashi.summary: Lord of the Takanashi is a special that serves as the final episode of Working!!, broadcast in December 2015 after the third season. It returns to Wagnaria, a family restaurant whose staff are more eccentric than its customers. Sota Takanashi, the young server at its centre, keeps working on his odd relationship with Mahiru Inami, a waitress who punches men out of fear. Meanwhile Aoi Yamada hopes to finally sort things out with her absent mother, and chef Jun Sato still has not told manager Yachiyo Todoroki how he feels. A-1 Pictures produced the special, adapting Karino Takatsu's comedy manga. It is meant for viewers who have watched the TV seasons.

hand-shakers.summary: In a near-future Osaka, Tazuna Takatsuki is a high school student who loves fixing machines. While visiting a university lab, he finds Koyori Akutagawa, a girl asleep in a bed, and when he takes her hand the two are pulled into Ziggurat, a strange alternate space. They have become Hand Shakers: pairs who must keep holding hands to use powers called Nimrods and who fight other pairs for the right to face God, who will grant the winners a wish. Tazuna has his own reason to want that wish, connected to Koyori. GoHands produced this 12-episode original series, broadcast from January to March 2017. Its visuals use heavily saturated colours and unusual camera angles.

zaregoto.summary: The Beheading Cycle adapts the first Zaregoto novel by Nisio Isin. The unnamed narrator, a young man with a detached outlook, accompanies his friend Tomo Kunagisa, a brilliant computer genius, to Wet Crow's Feather Island, a remote private island. Its owner, Iria Akagami, has been exiled there by her wealthy family and passes the time inviting gifted artists, scholars and specialists to stay in her mansion. Soon after the guests arrive, one of them is found murdered, and the narrator is drawn into working out what happened. Shaft produced the eight-episode OVA series, released from October 2016 to September 2017, with character designs based on Take's illustrations. It contains graphic violence and gore.

dead-leaves.summary: Dead Leaves is a short, hyperactive science-fiction film directed by Hiroyuki Imaishi. Two strangers, Retro and Pandy, wake up naked on a future Earth with no memories. They promptly go on a rampage of theft and destruction to get clothes, food and a car, until the authorities catch them and ship them to Dead Leaves, a prison on a half-ruined Moon. There they discover that the prisoners are being used in strange experiments, and plan a break-out. Production I.G produced the roughly 50-minute film, released in 2004. It is relentlessly fast and chaotic, with graphic violence, crude sexual humour and nudity.

aoi-hana.summary: Fumi Manjome and Akira Okudaira were best friends as small children until Fumi's family moved away. Ten years later Fumi comes back to town to start at Matsuoka Girls' High School, while cheerful Akira is beginning at the nearby Fujigaya Girls' Academy, and the two reconnect by chance. Their friendship is not quite what it was, and shy Fumi soon catches the attention of Yasuko Sugimoto, a popular older student at her school. Akira, meanwhile, tries to look after her friend while working out what love means to her. J.C.Staff adapted Takako Shimura's manga into 11 episodes in summer 2009. It is a quiet, realistic drama about first love between girls.

ichigo-100.summary: Junpei Manaka is a middle school boy who dreams of making films. One day on the school roof he sees a beautiful girl fall from above and glimpses her strawberry-patterned underwear before she runs off. Convinced the moment would be perfect for a movie, he sets out to find her. His search connects him with several girls: Aya Tojo, a quiet, bookish classmate with a talent for writing; Tsukasa Nishino, the most popular girl in school; and others he meets later. Junpei's inability to choose between them drives the story. Madhouse adapted Mizuki Kawashita's Weekly Shonen Jump manga into 12 episodes broadcast from April to June 2005. It is a harem romantic comedy with frequent fan service.

emiya-san-chi-no-kyou-no-gohan.summary: Today's Menu for the Emiya Family is a gentle cooking spin-off of Fate/stay night, set in a peaceful Fuyuki City where the Holy Grail War does not hang over anyone. Shirou Emiya, a capable home cook, prepares Japanese meals for his household and friends, including Saber and other familiar faces, and each episode centres on one dish suited to the time of year, with the cooking shown in careful detail. Ufotable produced the 13 short episodes, released online roughly once a month from January 2018 to January 2019, adapting TAa's manga. There is no fighting and no real plot: it is a relaxed food show for fans of the Fate characters.

shirokuma-cafe.summary: Polar Bear's Cafe is run by a polar bear known as Shirokuma, a calm, friendly host whose cafe near the zoo welcomes humans and animals alike. His regulars include Panda, a lazy, self-absorbed giant panda who takes a part-time job at the zoo, and Penguin, a sharp-tongued regular with a crush on a girl he hopes to impress. Each episode is a small slice of everyday life: conversations over coffee, outings around town and mild misunderstandings. Studio Pierrot adapted Aloha Higa's manga into 50 episodes broadcast from April 2012 to March 2013. It is a relaxed comedy suitable for all ages.

yakitate-japan.summary: Countries such as France and Germany have breads known around the world, but Japan has none to call its own. Kazuma Azuma wants to change that. Since childhood he has worked to invent 'Ja-pan', a national bread for Japan, helped by his 'Hands of the Sun', which are unusually warm and make dough rise faster. As a teenager he heads to Tokyo to work at Pantasia, a famous bakery chain, where he meets rival and allied bakers and enters increasingly over-the-top baking contests. Sunrise adapted Takashi Hashiguchi's manga into 69 episodes broadcast on TV Tokyo from October 2004 to March 2006. It is a cooking competition comedy.

bodacious-space-pirates.summary: In a future where humans have settled distant star systems, Marika Kato is an ordinary high school student, a member of her school's space yacht club with a part-time job at a cafe. Then two strangers visit to tell her that her father, whom she never knew, was a space pirate captain and has died. As his only heir, Marika is the one person who can keep his ship, the Bentenmaru, operating legally, if she agrees to become its captain. Satelight produced the 26 episodes, directed by Tatsuo Sato and broadcast from January to June 2012, adapting Yuichi Sasamoto's light novels. It focuses on ship operations and space tactics.

sunoharasou-no-kanrinin-san.summary: Aki Shiina is a middle school boy who is regularly mistaken for a girl because of his delicate looks. Hoping to become more manly and leave the teasing behind, he moves to Tokyo and takes a room at Sunohara-sou, a dormitory run by Ayaka Sunohara, a kind, motherly caretaker who dotes on him at once. Aki quickly develops a crush on her, while the girls from the student council at his new school, who also hang around the dorm, keep teasing him and dressing him in girls' clothes. Silver Link adapted Nekoume's four-panel manga into 12 episodes broadcast from July to September 2018. The series contains frequent fan service and suggestive scenes involving a middle school student.

fractale.summary: Fractale takes place in a future where an all-embracing system called Fractale meets people's needs, and many live in isolation, interacting through holographic avatars known as Doppels. Clain is a boy on a remote island who collects old technology and lives mostly alongside his parents' Doppels. One day he rescues a girl named Phryne, who is fleeing from pursuers. She vanishes the next morning but leaves behind a pendant, which activates a cheerful Doppel girl named Nessa, and Clain sets off with Nessa to find Phryne and learn why she is being hunted. A-1 Pictures and Ordet produced the 11-episode original series for Fuji TV's Noitamina block in early 2011, directed by Yutaka Yamamoto.

jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-1993.summary: This six-episode OVA series from studio APPP adapts the latter half of Stardust Crusaders, the third part of Hirohiko Araki's JoJo's Bizarre Adventure manga. In 1987, high school student Jotaro Kujo, his grandfather Joseph Joestar and their allies are travelling to Egypt to track down the vampire Dio Brando, whose return has awakened a dangerous Stand, a fighting spirit, in Jotaro's mother Holly and put her life at risk. The episodes start partway through the journey with little explanation of what came before, focusing on battles with Dio's Stand-wielding assassins as the group closes in on him. Pony Canyon released the episodes in Japan from 1993 to 1994. They contain graphic violence.

initial-d-fifth-stage.summary: Initial D Fifth Stage follows Project D, a Gunma-based team of amateur street racers. Led by the strategist Ryosuke Takahashi, with Takumi Fujiwara and Ryosuke's brother Keisuke as its drivers, the team has been travelling from region to region challenging local racers on their home mountain passes. Having beaten the best teams in several prefectures, Project D now takes its expedition into Kanagawa, regarded as the heartland of street racing, where three top local teams have prepared a layered defence to stop them. SynergySP produced the 14 episodes, released from November 2012 to May 2013, adapting Shuichi Shigeno's manga. It requires knowledge of the earlier stages.

fukumenkei-noise.summary: As a child, Nino Arisugawa lost two important people in quick succession: Momo, the neighbour she loved and sang with, and Yuzu, a boy who wrote songs for her, both of whom left suddenly. She has kept singing ever since, hoping her voice will somehow reach them. Starting high school, she runs into Yuzu again, now composing for a masked rock band called in NO hurry to shout, and soon learns that Momo is closer than she thought as well. Brain's Base adapted Ryoko Fukuyama's shojo manga into 12 episodes broadcast from April to June 2017. It is a romantic drama centred on a love triangle and the music industry.

dungeon-ni-deai-wo-motomeru-no-wa-machig.summary: The fourth season of Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? opens with Bell Cranel freshly levelled up and his small Hestia Familia trying to close the gap with the stronger Familias of the city of Orario. Before Bell can plan his next expedition, a murder shakes the adventurers' community, and one of his trusted allies falls under suspicion. Bell and his friends set out to clear their friend's name, while a prophetic dream warns that disaster waits for them deep in the Dungeon. J.C.Staff produced these 11 episodes, broadcast from July to October 2022 as the first half of the season, adapting Fujino Omori's light novels.

mikagura-gakuen-kumikyoku.summary: Eruna Ichinomiya is a middle school girl who loves cute girls and doesn't much care where she goes to high school, until she sees a photo of Seisa Mikagura, the beautiful student who represents Mikagura Private Academy. Eruna enrols, only to find that the school has nothing but cultural clubs, that every student must join one, and that club members with special powers fight one another in formal battles that decide the clubs' rankings and privileges. Doga Kobo produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from April to June 2015, based on Last Note's light novels, which grew out of his Vocaloid songs. It is a colourful comedy with light action.

seisen-cerberus-ryuukoku-no-fatalites.summary: The continent of Kuna'anh is shared by three kingdoms whose fragile balance of power could break into war at any moment, while the monstrous dragon Daganzord, which lives only to destroy, threatens them all. Hiiro, whose parents died in a disaster connected to the dragon, was saved as a child by a warrior named Giiru and has trained with the sword ever since to avenge them. Now sixteen, he leaves home with Giiru and gradually gathers companions who share his goal. Bridge produced the 13 episodes, broadcast from April to June 2016, based on a mobile role-playing game by Gree. It is a traditional sword-and-sorcery adventure with frequent battles.

bartender.summary: Tucked away in Tokyo's Ginza is Eden Hall, a small, hard-to-find bar run by Ryu Sasakura, a young bartender said to make the finest cocktails anyone has tasted. According to rumour, people do not find Eden Hall so much as it finds those who need it. Each episode brings in a different guest carrying a private worry, and Ryu listens, then mixes a drink chosen to help them see their situation in a new light, along with the history behind it. Palm Studio adapted the manga by Araki Joh and Kenji Nagatomo into 11 episodes broadcast from October to December 2006. It is a quiet, episodic drama about cocktails and people.

captain-earth.summary: Daichi Manatsu is a high school student who once lived on the island of Tanegashima, where his father worked in space development before dying in an accident. One summer, when he sees a strange ring-shaped rainbow in the sky that he remembers from childhood, he returns to the island alone. There he is drawn into Globe, a secret organisation that recruits him to pilot a giant robot, the Earth Engine Impacter, built to fight alien beings attacking from space. Daichi is soon joined by Teppei Arashi and Hana Mutou, both connected to the enemy in different ways. Bones produced the 25-episode original series, directed by Takuya Igarashi and written by Yoji Enokido, broadcast from April to September 2014.

one-piece-omatsuri-danshaku-to-himitsu-n.summary: The sixth One Piece film begins when the Straw Hat Pirates find an invitation to Omatsuri Island, a resort on the Grand Line that promises food, games and relaxation to any pirate crew. Before they can enjoy it, the island's host, Baron Omatsuri, insists that they pass a series of contests called the Trials of Hell, and Luffy eagerly accepts. As the challenges grow stranger, members of the crew begin to fall out with one another, and the island turns out to be hiding something far more sinister than its cheerful surface suggests. Mamoru Hosoda directed the film, which Toei Animation released in Japan on 5 March 2005. It is darker in tone than most One Piece films.

fushigi-yuugi.summary: Miaka Yuki is a junior high school student who hopes to get into the same high school as her best friend, Yui Hongo. On a visit to the National Diet Library together, Miaka finds an old book called The Universe of the Four Gods and is pulled into its world, a land like ancient China, where she is hailed as the Priestess of Suzaku, a legendary figure who must gather the seven Celestial Warriors of Suzaku to summon a god and receive wishes. One of them, a young fighter named Tamahome, soon matters to her. Studio Pierrot adapted Yuu Watase's manga into 52 episodes broadcast from April 1995 to March 1996. The series contains violence and sexual themes, including assault.

kami-tachi-ni-hirowareta-otoko.summary: Ryoma Takebayashi was a 39-year-old office worker in Japan whose life was mostly hard work and bad luck until he died in his sleep. Three gods take pity on him and send him to a fantasy world as a young boy. Ryoma spends years alone in a forest, studying magic and taming slimes, which turn out to be useful for all sorts of tasks. When he finally meets other people, a warm-hearted family named the Jamils, he starts to rejoin society and finds that his skills, especially his slimes, are in demand. Maho Film adapted the light novels by Roy into 12 episodes broadcast from October to December 2020. It is a gentle, low-stakes fantasy.

sekaiichi-hatsukoi-movie-yokozawa-takafu.summary: This 2014 film is a spin-off of The World's Greatest First Love, centred on a supporting character from the TV series. Takafumi Yokozawa has just had his heart broken. He gets very drunk and wakes up in a hotel room with his co-worker Zen Kirishima, who has an embarrassing photo of him and uses it to pressure him. Their dealings grow more personal as Yokozawa gets to know Kirishima's young daughter, Hiyori. Studio Deen produced the film, written and directed by Chiaki Kon, and it opened in Japan in March. It is a boys' love romance with sexual content.

hataraku-saibou-black-tv.summary: Cells at Work! Code Black is a spin-off of Cells at Work! that takes place inside the body of an adult man with an unhealthy lifestyle. Smoking, drinking, stress and lack of sleep make the cells' jobs exhausting and dangerous. The story follows a newly assigned red blood cell, AA2153, who delivers oxygen through a body that keeps breaking down, and the white blood cell U-1196, who fights off infections and keeps rescuing him. Episodes show real health problems from the point of view of the cells struggling to cope with them. Liden Films adapted the manga by Shigemitsu Harada and Issei Hatsuyoshiya into 13 episodes in early 2021. It contains violence and depicts illnesses including sexually transmitted infections.

green-green.summary: Kanenone Gakuen is an all-boys boarding school deep in the Japanese countryside, with no girls for miles. To test a possible merger with a girls' school, the board arranges a month-long trial in which a group of female students moves into Kanenone. Most of the boys are thrilled, especially the three perverted friends who share a room with the protagonist, Yusuke Takazaki. When the buses arrive, a girl called Midori Chitose jumps out and greets Yusuke as if they already know each other, though he has no memory of her. Studio Matrix adapted Groover's adult PC game into 12 episodes broadcast in summer 2003. It is a crude comedy with frequent nudity and sexual humour.

kurozuka.summary: Kurozuka begins in twelfth-century Japan with Kuro, a swordsman loosely based on the warrior Minamoto no Yoshitsune, fleeing his elder brother's forces together with his loyal servant Benkei. They take shelter in the remote house of Kuromitsu, a beautiful and mysterious woman, and Kuro soon discovers her secret: she is an immortal who feeds on blood. What follows is a story of love and immortality that carries Kuro far beyond his own era, across many centuries of upheaval. Madhouse adapted the novel by Baku Yumemakura, via Takashi Noguchi's manga, into 12 episodes broadcast on Animax from October to December 2008. It contains graphic violence and gore.

muv-luv-alternative-total-eclipse.summary: In an alternate history, Earth has been fighting alien creatures called the BETA for decades, and humanity relies on giant robots known as Tactical Surface Fighters. Yui Takamura, a Japanese pilot who lived through the BETA invasion of her homeland, is assigned to a United Nations test programme in Alaska, where pilots from many countries develop new machines. There she must work with Yuya Bridges, a talented but uncooperative American test pilot of Japanese descent. Satelight and ixtl produced the 24 episodes, broadcast from July to December 2012, based on the light novel spin-off of the Muv-Luv games. It contains graphic violence and fan service.

pokemon-diamond-pearl-dialga-vs-palkia-v.summary: The Rise of Darkrai is the tenth Pokemon film and the first of the Diamond and Pearl era. Ash, Dawn and Brock arrive in Alamos Town, famous for its Space-Time Towers and its gardens, so that Dawn can take part in a Pokemon Contest. A local girl named Alice shows them around. Strange disturbances begin warping the town, and a nobleman, Baron Alberto, blames Darkrai, a shadowy Pokemon said to cause nightmares. The real cause is a clash between the legendary Pokemon Dialga and Palkia, whose battle across dimensions threatens to destroy the town. Kunihiko Yuyama directed the film, which OLM animated and Toho released in Japan on 15 July 2007. It is aimed at families.

nichijou-episode-0.summary: Nichijou Episode 0 is a single OVA that Kyoto Animation released on 12 March 2011, packaged as a DVD with the sixth volume of Keiichi Arawi's manga, a few weeks before the TV series began. Despite the title, which means 'everyday life', the comedy is built on absurd escalation: a principal wrestling a deer, a robot schoolgirl with a roll cake hidden in her arm and other strange incidents, set side by side with ordinary moments like building a house of cards or panicking over a test. The episode introduces the main cast of the show in a string of short sketches and serves as a preview of the TV anime's style of humour.

bokusatsu-tenshi-dokuro-chan-2.summary: This two-episode OVA sequel, released in 2007, continues the slapstick comedy Bludgeoning Angel Dokuro-chan. Middle school boy Sakura Kusakabe still lives with Dokuro, an angel from the future who was originally sent to kill him and instead moved in, and her sister Zakuro. Dokuro shows her affection with her spiked club, Excalibolg, regularly killing Sakura in gruesome ways before casually bringing him back to life. New angels, including Sabato and Zansu, add to the chaos. Hal Film Maker produced the episodes, based on Masaki Okayu's light novels illustrated by Torishimo. The series relies on deliberately over-the-top cartoon gore, and also contains frequent fan service and sexual jokes.

genshiken-2.summary: Genshiken 2 is the second season of Genshiken, about a university club for otaku, the Society for the Study of Modern Visual Culture. Kanji Sasahara, once the shy newcomer, is now club president and determined to make the group produce its own doujinshi, fan-made comics, to sell at the big Comic Festival. The club also gains a new member, Chika Ogiue, a prickly young woman who loudly claims to hate otaku and hides her own fan interests. The season follows the stress of making and selling a comic, along with the members' career worries and relationships. Arms produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from October to December 2007, adapting Shimoku Kio's manga. It is a realistic comedy about fan culture.

ai-yori-aoshi.summary: Kaoru Hanabishi is a university student living on his own after walking away from the wealthy family he was born into. One day at a train station he helps a young woman in a kimono who is lost and looking for an address. She turns out to be Aoi Sakuraba, the daughter of a rich family, who was promised to Kaoru in marriage when they were children. Aoi has spent years preparing for him and has left her own family to be with him. They end up living in a large house, which soon fills up with other young women. J.C.Staff adapted Kou Fumizuki's manga into 24 episodes broadcast in 2002. It contains fan service.

machikado-mazoku.summary: One morning, ordinary high school student Yuko Yoshida wakes up with horns and a tail. Her mother reveals the family secret: they are descendants of a demonic clan, cursed to poverty long ago by their rivals, a line of magical girls. To lift the curse, Yuko must defeat a magical girl. As it happens, one lives in town: Momo Chiyoda, a classmate who is far stronger than Yuko and nowhere near as hostile as expected. The would-be demon's hopeless challenges turn into an odd friendship. J.C.Staff adapted Izumo Ito's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in summer 2019. It is a light comedy.

asagao-to-kase-san.summary: Kase-san and Morning Glories is a 58-minute OVA based on Hiromi Takashima's yuri manga. Yui Yamada is a shy high school girl who spends her time looking after the school's garden. Tomoka Kase is the star of the track team, sporty, boyish and popular. Yamada has always admired her from a distance, and by the time the story begins the two have started dating. The OVA follows their early relationship: awkward first dates, uncertainty about how the other feels, and the question of what will happen after graduation, when they may be heading for different futures. Zexcs produced it, and it was released in Japanese cinemas in June 2018. It is a sweet, low-key romance.

shuumatsu-no-harem.summary: Reito Mizuhara, a young man suffering from a rare and fatal disease, is placed in cryogenic sleep until a cure can be found. He wakes five years on to find that a virus known as MK has killed almost every man on Earth. Reito is one of only a handful of men left, and his new duty, he is told, is to father as many children as he can to save humanity. He is given attractive caretakers, but would rather find the girl he loved before his sleep. Studio Gokumi and AXsiZ produced the 11 episodes, broadcast in early 2022 after a delay, adapting the manga by LINK and Kotaro Shono. The series contains explicit sexual content and nudity.

hetalia-world-series.summary: Hetalia: World Series is the name the Hetalia web anime took on in 2010, covering the very short episodes released online through 2011. Countries are personified as people, and their quirks and relationships are played for comedy based on national stereotypes and real history. The cheerful, pasta-loving North Italy, his strict friend Germany and reserved Japan remain at the centre, joined by a large rotating cast including Hungary, Prussia, Lithuania, Poland and the Nordic countries, as episodes act out events such as the War of the Austrian Succession and the years before the Second World War. Studio Deen produced the 48 episodes, adapting Hidekaz Himaruya's webcomic. It is a gag comedy built on historical in-jokes.

a-day-before-us.summary: A Day Before Us is a South Korean web anime about Ha Eun, a student who is caught in a sudden downpour while waiting at a bus stop. Taking shelter, she recognises a quiet young man named Yeon Woo, but her attempts at friendly conversation are met with short, cold replies. When the awning above her tears, she ends up ducking under his umbrella and grabbing hold of him, which leaves both of them embarrassed. Fate keeps throwing them together after that, and the series follows the slow beginnings of their relationship. LICO and Red Dog Culture House produced the 10 short episodes, released in 2018. It is a gentle, everyday romance.
a-day-before-us.notes: No Wikipedia article exists; sources are MyAnimeList and AniList.

kyou-kara-maou.summary: Yuri Shibuya is an ordinary 15-year-old high school student. When he steps in to help a classmate who is being bullied, the bullies turn on him and shove his head into a toilet, which turns out to be a portal to another world. There he is greeted as the new king of the demons, the ruler of a nation whose people are far from the villains he expected. Accompanied by advisers such as Gunter, the swordsman Conrad and the hot-tempered Wolfram, Yuri tries to rule fairly and to keep peace with the human kingdoms. Studio Deen produced these first 78 episodes, broadcast on NHK from 2004 to 2006, adapting Tomo Takabayashi's light novels.

saint-onii-san-movie.summary: The Saint Young Men film is built on the premise of Hikaru Nakamura's comedy manga: Jesus Christ and Gautama Buddha, wanting a break, come down to Earth and rent a small apartment together in Tachikawa, in the suburbs of Tokyo. Trying to pass as ordinary young men, they discover the pleasures of modern Japanese life, from sales at the shops to amusement parks, while sometimes accidentally revealing their holy powers. The humour comes from their gentle everyday misunderstandings and jokes about religion. A-1 Pictures produced the film, which opened in Japanese cinemas on 10 May 2013, following two earlier OVAs. It is a light, episodic comedy that needs no prior knowledge.

queen-s-blade-rurou-no-senshi.summary: In the world of Queen's Blade, a tournament is held every four years, and the woman who wins becomes queen. Leina, heiress of the noble Vance family, is an inexperienced fighter who, after an early defeat, tires of life at home and sets out to prove herself as a wandering warrior. On the road she meets a wide range of other fighters, many with their own reasons for heading toward the next tournament. Arms produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from April to June 2009, based on Hobby Japan's series of visual combat books. The series is built around fights in which clothing is torn away, and contains constant nudity and sexualised fan service.

pokemon-mewtwo-ware-wa-koko-ni-ari.summary: Mewtwo Returns is a television special that follows on from the first Pokemon film. Mewtwo, the powerful Pokemon created in a lab, has been living in secret with the clone Pokemon it made, hidden in a remote part of the Johto region. Team Rocket's boss, Giovanni, tracks it down and wants it back under his control. Ash and his friends get pulled in while chasing Jessie and James to rescue Pikachu, and are seized by Domino, a newly introduced Rocket agent, while the clones are used as bait. The special turns into a battle of wills between Mewtwo and Giovanni. OLM produced it, and it aired in Japan on 30 December 2000. It is aimed at families.

hatsukoi-monster.summary: Kaho Nikaido comes from a powerful family, and people have always treated her with excessive care. Hoping to be treated normally, she leaves home for high school and moves into a dormitory. On her first day she nearly walks into a truck; the tall, handsome stranger who pulls her back is oddly rude to her. Kaho falls for him at once, confesses, and starts dating Kanade Takahashi, only to learn that he is the landlord's son and a fifth-grade elementary school pupil. The comedy follows her confused feelings. Studio Deen adapted Akira Hiyoshimaru's manga into 12 episodes broadcast from July to September 2016. The series features romantic and suggestive jokes involving a child.

planetarian-chiisana-hoshi-no-yume.summary: Planetarian is set decades after a war has left the world in ruins, with toxic rain falling endlessly and few people left alive. A lone scavenger, known only as the junker, slips into an abandoned city still guarded by automated weapons, looking for anything of value. Inside an old department store he finds a planetarium, and Yumemi Hoshino, a cheerful robot guide who has been waiting there for visitors for thirty years without noticing that the world has changed. She asks him to help fix the broken projector so that she can give him a star show. David Production adapted Key's visual novel into five web episodes released in July and August 2016. It is a quiet, melancholy two-character story.

back-street-girls.summary: Kentaro, Ryo and Kazuhiko are three loyal but hopeless yakuza who have failed their boss once too often. As punishment, he gives them a choice: die and have their organs sold, or undergo sex reassignment surgery in Thailand and return as a pop idol group that will earn money for the gang. After a brutal training period they have become Airi, Chika and Mari, a cute idol trio, but they still think, talk and fight like gangsters whenever the cameras are off. The comedy comes from that gap. J.C.Staff adapted Jasmine Gyuh's manga into 10 episodes broadcast in summer 2018. The show relies on crude humour, violence and jokes about gender and sex.

dragon-ball-z-special-2-zetsubou-e-no-ha.summary: This one-off TV special shows the bleak future Trunks comes from, the timeline he refers to when he first appears in Dragon Ball Z. In this world, Goku is already dead, and two Androids have spent thirteen years destroying cities and killing almost every fighter who stands against them. Gohan, now an adult, is the last warrior still resisting, and he takes the teenage Trunks, son of Bulma and Vegeta, as his student, hoping to give the world a chance. Toei Animation broadcast the special in Japan on 24 February 1993, between regular episodes of the TV series. It is based on a bonus chapter of Akira Toriyama's manga and contains violence.

saikano.summary: Shuji and Chise are high school students in a small coastal town in Hokkaido. Chise is shy, clumsy and not especially good at anything, and their awkward new relationship is the main thing on their minds. Then, during a trip to Sapporo, enemy bombers attack the city, and Shuji sees Chise in the middle of the destruction, transformed by the military into a living weapon fighting back. As a war that no one explains spreads across Japan, the two try to hold on to their relationship while Chise is used more and more in battle. Gonzo adapted Shin Takahashi's manga into 13 episodes broadcast in summer 2002. It is a sad love story that contains graphic war violence.

full-moon-wo-sagashite.summary: Twelve-year-old Mitsuki Koyama wants to become a singer, partly to keep a promise to Eichi Sakurai, the boy she loved, who moved to America. But she has a tumour in her throat that makes singing difficult, and her strict grandmother forbids music altogether. One day Mitsuki is visited by Takuto and Meroko, two shinigami whom only she can see, who have come because her life is running short. Takuto gives her the power to turn into a healthy sixteen-year-old, which lets her start a singing career under the name Full Moon. Studio Deen adapted Arina Tanemura's shojo manga into 52 episodes broadcast from April 2002 to March 2003. It is a bittersweet magical girl drama dealing with illness.

chihayafuru-season-three.summary: The third season of Chihayafuru picks up after the Mizusawa High School karuta club's big success in the team tournament. Chihaya Ayase is aiming to become Queen, the top title for women in competitive karuta, and on defeating the reigning Queen, Shinobu Wakamiya. Her childhood friend Taichi Mashima, who has finally reached the elite level of play, is eager to face their old friend Arata Wataya, and each member of the club chases a personal goal. Madhouse produced the 24 episodes, broadcast from October 2019 to March 2020, adapting Yuki Suetsugu's manga. It assumes familiarity with the first two seasons.

toaru-kagaku-no-railgun-misaka-san-wa-im.summary: This one-episode OVA of A Certain Scientific Railgun is set in Academy City, a city of schools where students develop psychic abilities. It takes place after the Level Upper incident from the first TV season. Mikoto Misaka, a powerful electromaster known as the Railgun, starts suffering from an odd phenomenon her friends call 'Someone's Watching', a sensation that makes the electricity in her body seem to run backwards. Together with her friends Kuroko, Uiharu and Saten, she sets out to find the cause. J.C.Staff produced the OVA in 2010, based on the manga by Kazuma Kamachi and Motoi Fuyukawa. It is a light side story for viewers who know the first season.
toaru-kagaku-no-railgun-misaka-san-wa-im.notes: OVA plot appears in one shared synopsis (MAL, AniList and Kitsu reuse the same text); Wikipedia confirms the 2010 OVA release.

gatchaman-crowds-insight.summary: Gatchaman Crowds Insight is the second season of Gatchaman Crowds. The Gatchaman are a small team of heroes based in Tachikawa who fight using NOTE, a power drawn from their own spirit. A new recruit, Tsubasa Misudachi, an earnest girl from a rural town, joins the team after a spaceship crashes near her home. A peaceful alien emerges from the wreck, and Tsubasa learns the ropes from the cheerful veteran Hajime Ichinose. Meanwhile CROWDS, a technology that lets ordinary people project their will into physical form, is spreading with government backing, until a group called VAPE starts using it to cause havoc and turn public opinion. Tatsunoko Production produced the 12 episodes in summer 2015, directed by Kenji Nakamura.

mardock-scramble-the-first-compression.summary: The First Compression is the first of three films adapting Tow Ubukata's novel Mardock Scramble. In the futuristic Mardock City, Rune Balot is a teenage girl who has survived on the streets, including through prostitution. She is taken in by Shell, a wealthy gambler who seems to give her a new life, but when she starts asking about his past he tries to kill her. Balot is saved by Dr. Easter, who rebuilds her as a cyborg under an emergency law, and she is partnered with Oeufcoque, an artificial intelligence in the form of a mouse. GoHands produced the film, released in 2010. It contains graphic violence, nudity and themes of sexual exploitation.

groove-adventure-rave.summary: Fifty years ago, a war over evil stones called Dark Brings ended in a disaster that wiped out a tenth of the world. Now the criminal organisation Demon Card uses Dark Brings to spread chaos. Haru Glory, a sword-wielding teenager, meets Plue, a strange little dog-like creature, and inherits the role of Rave Master, wielder of the holy stones that can counter the Dark Brings. Haru sets out to find the scattered pieces of Rave, gathering friends such as Elie, a cheerful girl with no memory of her past. Studio Deen adapted Hiro Mashima's manga into 51 episodes from October 2001 to September 2002.

one-piece-dead-end-no-bouken.summary: The fourth One Piece film is set at a port town where pirates gather for an illegal race, the Dead End, with a huge cash prize for the first crew to reach the finish. Nami is delighted, and the Straw Hats sign up. The race attracts all kinds of dangerous crews, and it soon becomes clear that the event is a trap organised by its mysterious sponsor, Gasparde, a former military commander. Konosuke Uda directed the film, which Toei Animation released in Japan on 1 March 2003. It is an action adventure that works without knowledge of the series.

net-juu-no-susume-special.summary: This one-episode special of Recovery of an MMO Junkie was released with the Blu-ray set in December 2017, after the 10-episode TV series. The series follows Moriko Morioka, a 30-year-old who quit her office job to spend her days playing an online game, and Yuta Sakurai, a handsome, socially awkward company employee whose life overlaps with hers both in the game and in real life. In this extra story, Moriko's computer breaks down, and she turns to Sakurai, who knows a lot about computers, for help building a new one. Having him over leads to plenty of nervous, embarrassing moments. Signal.MD produced it, adapting Rin Kokuyo's webcomic. It is meant for viewers who have watched the series.

persona-4-the-golden-animation.summary: Persona 4 the Golden Animation is based on Persona 4 Golden, the expanded PlayStation Vita release of Atlus's role-playing game. Yu Narukami moves to the rural town of Inaba to live with his uncle for a year, just as a string of mysterious murders begins. He and his new friends discover a hidden world and gain the power to summon Personas, which they use to investigate. Rather than retell the whole story again, this version focuses on content added in the Golden edition, especially Marie, a mysterious girl connected to the Velvet Room. A-1 Pictures produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from July to September 2014. It works best for viewers who know the earlier anime or game.

loveless.summary: In the world of Loveless, people are born with cat ears and tails, which they lose when they become sexually active. Twelve-year-old Ritsuka Aoyagi is struggling after the death of his beloved older brother Seimei, two years earlier, and lives with a mother who believes he is not the same son she raised. At his new school he meets Soubi Agatsuma, a twenty-year-old who claims to have been Seimei's friend. Soubi explains that he is a Fighter, half of a pair who battle with spoken spells, and that Ritsuka is now his Sacrifice. J.C.Staff adapted Yun Koga's manga into 12 episodes broadcast in 2005. The series involves child abuse and romantic overtones between an adult and a child.

kure-nai.summary: Sixteen-year-old Shinkuro Kurenai is a high school student who works part-time as a mediator, settling disputes for his employer, the formidable Benika Juzawa. Despite his gentle nature, he is a trained martial artist with a hidden ability. Benika gives him an unusual job: protecting and living with Murasaki Kuhoin, a girl of seven from a powerful and secretive family, who has been taken from her home. The two have to get used to sharing Shinkuro's small room in a run-down apartment building, a world very different from the one Murasaki knows. Brain's Base adapted Kentaro Katayama's light novels into 12 episodes broadcast from April to June 2008. It is mostly a character-driven drama.

super-sonico-the-animation.summary: Super Sonico is the mascot character of the game company Nitroplus, created by artist Tsuji Santa, and this series gives her a gentle everyday story. Sonico is an 18-year-old college student who is kind, a little clumsy and fond of cats. Alongside her studies she works as a model and plays guitar and sings in a rock band, First Astronomical Velocity, with her two friends. Episodes follow her busy schedule, photo shoots, concerts and quiet moments at home with her many cats. White Fox produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from January to March 2014. It is a laid-back slice-of-life show with frequent fan service centred on its heroine.

hakushaku-to-yousei.summary: In nineteenth-century Britain, 17-year-old Lydia Carlton works as a 'fairy doctor', someone who can see and talk to fairies, though most people around her find her claims ridiculous. Her life changes when she meets Edgar J. C. Ashenbert, a charming young man who calls himself the Blue Knight Earl, a title from legend, and his followers. Edgar hires Lydia as his adviser on fairy matters as he tries to obtain a legendary sword that would secure his claim, but she soon suspects that he is hiding a great deal about his past. Her cat fairy, Nico, keeps watch over him. Artland adapted Mizue Tani's light novels into 12 episodes broadcast in autumn 2008. It is a romantic fantasy adventure.

nihon-chinbotsu-2020.summary: Japan Sinks: 2020 updates Sakyo Komatsu's 1973 disaster novel to the present day. Shortly after the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, a massive earthquake strikes Japan, followed by more quakes and the land itself beginning to sink. The Muto family, including 14-year-old track athlete Ayumu and her younger brother Go, who loves video games, are separated in the chaos and then try to escape Tokyo together, joined by other survivors along the way, as the country collapses around them. Science SARU produced the 10 episodes, directed by Masaaki Yuasa with Ho Pyeon-gang, and Netflix released them worldwide on 9 July 2020. The series contains frequent deaths, graphic injuries and scenes of disaster.

inu-x-boku-ss-special.summary: This one-episode special of Inu x Boku SS was released with the seventh Blu-ray and DVD volume in September 2012, after the TV series. It is made up of three short comic stories newly written by the manga's author, Cocoa Fujiwara, who also designed a new character, Hana-chan, for the occasion. The pieces bring back the residents of Maison de Ayakashi, the luxury apartment building where Ririchiyo Shirakiin, a sharp-tongued girl from a powerful family, lives with Soushi Miketsukami, her devoted fox-spirit Secret Service agent, and other part-yokai neighbours. David Production, which made the TV series, produced the special. It is a light, standalone extra for viewers who already know the cast.

cardcaptor-sakura-the-movie.summary: The first Cardcaptor Sakura film is set after the TV series' first season and before its second. Sakura Kinomoto wins a Hong Kong holiday in a shopping-district lottery, and travels there with her best friend Tomoyo, her brother Toya, his friend Yukito and her guardian Kero. While exploring the city, Sakura keeps seeing a mysterious woman in her dreams and is drawn toward a vengeful spirit who was once wronged by Clow Reed, the magician who created the Clow Cards. Her friend Syaoran and his cousin Meiling also become involved. Madhouse produced the film, with Morio Asaka directing, and it opened in Japan on 21 August 1999.

3d-kanojo-real-girl-2.summary: The second season of Real Girl continues the story of Hikari Tsutsui, an anime-loving high school student with few friends, and Iroha Igarashi, the beautiful classmate with a bad reputation who became his girlfriend. Now that they are actually dating, Tsutsui is a little more at ease, but real life keeps testing them. As their relationship deepens, school events, friends' problems and the question of what each of them really wants bring new challenges, and both have to work out how to stay true to themselves while staying together. Hoods Entertainment produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from January to March 2019, adapting Mao Nanami's manga.

top-wo-nerae-2.summary: Diebuster is a six-episode OVA sequel to Gunbuster, made by Gainax to mark the studio's 20th anniversary. Long after the original war, humanity is still fighting Space Monsters, and its defence depends on the Topless, young pilots with special powers who control giant Buster Machines. Nono is a clumsy, cheerful country girl from Mars who dreams of becoming a space pilot. When she meets Lal'C, an elite Topless, she follows her into space and refuses to give up on her dream, even though she seems to have none of the necessary abilities. Kazuya Tsurumaki directed and Yoji Enokido wrote the series, released from 2004 to 2006. It contains fan service and frequent large-scale mecha battles.

noblesse-awakening.summary: Noblesse: Awakening is a 31-minute web anime made by Production I.G in 2016, adapting the opening of the South Korean webtoon Noblesse by Son Jeho and Lee Kwangsu. Cadis Etrama di Raizel, called Rai, is a noble, a member of an ancient race of powerful beings, who wakes up after sleeping for 820 years with no idea how the human world has changed. He tracks down his loyal servant Frankenstein, now the principal of a high school, and enrols there as a student. His quiet new life with his classmates is soon disrupted by a secret organisation called the Union, which has its own interest in nobles. A full TV series followed in 2020. It contains violence.

Mushoku-Tensei-Isekai-Ittara-Honki-Dasu-.summary: The second half of Mushoku Tensei's second season continues the story of Rudeus Greyrat, a man reincarnated as a boy in a world of magic, Following advice from the mysterious god Hitogami, Rudeus has enrolled at a university of magic, where he has reunited with Sylphiette, his childhood friend, and the two have grown close. As he settles into a new kind of life, old companions and unresolved family matters pull him back toward the wider world and its dangers. Studio Bind produced these 12 episodes, broadcast from April to June 2024, adapting the light novels by Rifujin na Magonote. The series contains violence and mature themes.

chain-chronicle-tv.summary: Chain Chronicle: The Light of Haecceitas is set on a remote continent where several kingdoms once kept the peace through a council of kings and a chosen ruler. That balance collapses when the Black Army invades, led by the mysterious Black King, who seizes the capital and part of an ancient book called the Chain Chronicle. A small Volunteer Army led by Yuri fights on despite heavy losses, trying to rally the scattered peoples against the darkness. Telecom Animation Film and Graphinica produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from January to March 2017 while a film trilogy of the same story was in Japanese cinemas. It is based on Sega's mobile role-playing game and contains battle violence.

steins-gate-soumei-eichi-no-cognitive-co.summary: This is a set of four very short web episodes made in 2014 in collaboration with IBM to promote its cognitive computing technology. They use the cast of Steins;Gate in a comic setting with no connection to the time-travel plot. In each short, the members of the Future Gadget Lab, including Rintaro Okabe, Mayuri Shiina, Kurisu Makise and Daru, try out a cognitive computing system housed in one of Mayuri's toys and use it for everyday tasks, such as cooking fried chicken, finding the way, choosing clothes and holding a meeting. White Fox, which made the Steins;Gate TV anime, produced the episodes, each only a few minutes long. They are light promotional pieces for existing fans.

star-vs-the-forces-of-evil.summary: Created by Daron Nefcy, Star vs. the Forces of Evil is a Disney cartoon series. Star Butterfly is the energetic, reckless princess of Mewni, a magical dimension. She has just been given the royal family's powerful magic wand, and after she causes too much trouble her parents send her to Earth to learn some control. In the suburban town of Echo Creek she lives with the Diaz family and becomes friends with their cautious son Marco. Together they attend school, travel between dimensions and fend off Ludo, a small monster who wants the wand. This first season premiered in January 2015 and continued on Disney XD. It is a fast, colourful action comedy for all ages.
star-vs-the-forces-of-evil.notes: Western animation with no MyAnimeList or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia. The Kitsu entry covers the 13 episodes of season one.

shokugeki-no-souma-ova.summary: These two Food Wars! OVAs were packaged with manga volumes 18 and 19 in May and July 2016. Both are light side stories set during the first season, around the summer before the Autumn Elections cooking tournament at the elite Totsuki culinary academy. In the first, Italian chef Takumi Aldini and his brother Isami go sightseeing around Tokyo Tower, run into several classmates, including Megumi Tadokoro, and end up in an unexpected cooking duel at a traditional restaurant. In the second, Erina Nakiri is invited to a public pool by her cousin Alice, while the Polar Star Dormitory residents hold a party by a lake. J.C.Staff produced the OVAs. They contain fan service.
shokugeki-no-souma-ova.notes: Episode plots appear only in the MAL synopsis; AniList and Wikipedia confirm the OVAs and their manga bundling.

kyuukyoku-shinka-shita-full-dive-rpg-ga-.summary: High school student Hiroshi Yuki, who plays as Hiro, escapes a stressful life by losing himself in virtual reality games. When a pretty shop clerk, Reona Kisaragi, talks him into buying Kiwame Quest, a full-dive role-playing game known for its extreme realism, he soon finds out why it flopped: its lifelike characters and senses mean every mistake has lasting consequences, and there are no do-overs. Hiro ends up struggling as much in the game as he does at school. ENGI adapted the light novels by Light Tuchihi into 12 episodes broadcast from April to June 2021. It is a comedy about a game that is harsher than real life.

abenobashi-mahou-shoutengai.summary: Sasshi and Arumi are twelve-year-old childhood friends who grew up in Abenobashi, an old shopping arcade in Osaka that is about to be torn down for redevelopment, and Arumi's family is preparing to move away. After an accident at the arcade, the two find that Abenobashi has been transformed into a fantasy world, and every attempt to get home throws them into a different one: a sword-and-sorcery quest, a science-fiction adventure, a war story and many more, each full of familiar faces from the neighbourhood in strange new roles. Gainax and Madhouse produced the 13-episode original series, directed by Hiroyuki Yamaga and broadcast in spring 2002. It is a fast-paced comedy that parodies one genre after another.

major-s1.summary: Major follows Goro Honda, who grows up idolising his father, Shigeharu, a professional baseball pitcher, and dreams of becoming a pro himself. The first season begins in Goro's early childhood, when his mother has already died and his father is struggling to hold on to his place in the game. Goro's kindergarten teacher, Momoko Hoshino, becomes close to both of them, and over the season Goro grows into a determined young pitcher, eventually forming a Little League team, the Mifune Dolphins, with friends recruited to keep it alive. Studio Hibari produced these 26 episodes for NHK, broadcast from November 2004 to May 2005, adapting Takuya Mitsuda's manga. It is the first of six seasons.

dragon-ball-z-special-1-tatta-hitori-no-.summary: This first Dragon Ball Z TV special is a prequel set before the start of Dragon Ball. Goku's father, Bardock, is a Saiyan warrior of low rank who conquers planets for the tyrant Frieza along with his squad. On one mission, a survivor on the planet Kanassa strikes him with a power that lets him see visions of the future. Bardock begins to foresee the fate of his people and Frieza's plans for the Saiyan homeworld, and he resolves to do something about it.
