Toei Animation broadcast the special on Fuji Television on 17 October 1990, based on Akira Toriyama's manga. It contains violence.

hanamaru-youchien.summary: Anzu is a lively girl at Hanamaru Kindergarten who has decided that she is in love with her new teacher, the kind, earnest Naozumi Tsuchida. Together with her friends, shy Koume and quiet, eccentric Hiiragi, she comes up with endless schemes to win him over and convince him to marry her once she grows up. Tsuchida, meanwhile, is more interested in Nanako Yamamoto, the gentle teacher in charge of the class next door, though he struggles to tell her how he feels. Gainax adapted Yuto's manga into 12 episodes broadcast from January to March 2010. It is a gentle comedy about children's daily life and the adults around them.

kekkaishi.summary: Yoshimori Sumimura and his neighbour Tokine Yukimura are heirs to two rival families of kekkaishi, people who use magical barriers to trap and destroy ayakashi, spirit creatures. For centuries, both families have guarded Karasumori, a site whose power draws ayakashi to it. Today that site lies under the grounds of their school, so every night the two return to campus to fight off intruders. Yoshimori is a high school student who would rather be baking cakes, but he is determined to grow stronger, partly to protect Tokine. Sunrise adapted Yellow Tanabe's manga into 52 episodes broadcast from October 2006 to February 2008. It is a supernatural action series with comedy.

harukana-receive.summary: Haruka Ozora, a cheerful high school girl from the city, moves to Okinawa where she will live with her cousin Kanata Higa and their grandmother. Soon after arriving, she tries beach volleyball for the first time and is hooked, even though she knows nothing about it. Kanata, who once played the sport seriously before suddenly giving it up, agrees to become Haruka's partner. Together they join their school's tiny beach volleyball club, run by the twin sisters Emily and Claire Thomas, and start training for tournaments in which each two-player team relies completely on its partners. C2C adapted Nyoijizai's manga into 12 episodes broadcast from July to September 2018. It is an upbeat sports series about partnership.

peter-grill-to-kenja-no-jikan.summary: Peter Grill has just been crowned the world's strongest warrior, and he hopes the title will finally let him marry his sweetheart Luvelia, despite her father's objections. Unfortunately, the news of his victory spreads quickly, and women from other races, including ogres, elves and goblins, start pursuing him because they want strong offspring. Peter tries desperately to stay faithful to Luvelia while being drawn into one compromising situation after another, all of which he must keep secret from her. Wolfsbane adapted Daisuke Hiyama's manga into 12 short episodes broadcast from July to September 2020. The series is a sex comedy with frequent nudity and sexual content.

infinite-dendrogram.summary: In 2043, Infinite Dendrogram becomes the first full-dive virtual reality game to perfectly reproduce the five senses, promising a world of endless possibilities. Nearly two years after its release, Reiji Mukudori, about to start university, finally logs in under the name Ray Starling, joined by his older brother Shu, an experienced and powerful player. Every player receives an Embryo, a unique partner that grows with them, and Ray's turns out to be Nemesis, a girl who can transform into a weapon. Ray sets out to explore this vast world and its many dangers. NAZ adapted Sakon Kaido's light novels into 13 episodes, broadcast from January to April 2020.

strike-witches-2.summary: The second season of Strike Witches is set in an alternate 1940s where alien machines called the Neuroi have invaded the world, opposed only by young witches who fly with propeller-driven units on their legs. Some time after the first season's battles, Yoshika Miyafuji has returned home to the Fuso Empire. When a massive new Neuroi hive appears and overwhelms Allied forces in Europe, she heads back to the front with Mio Sakamoto to help her friends, and the 501st Joint Fighter Wing is called together again. AIC produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from July to September 2010, with original character designs by Fumikane Shimada. The series contains frequent fan service and mild nudity.

mind-game.summary: Mind Game is the first feature directed by Masaaki Yuasa, adapted from Robin Nishi's manga. Nishi is a young man who dreams of drawing comics. He runs into Myon, the girl he has loved since childhood, and learns that she is engaged. At her family's yakitori restaurant, a pair of yakuza burst in, and an encounter with one of them ends Nishi's life almost at once. Refusing to accept this, he defies God and runs back into the world, and from there the film follows Nishi, Myon and her sister through a surreal, extraordinary adventure. Studio 4°C produced the film, released in Japan in August 2004. It is highly experimental, mixing animation styles, and contains violence, sexual content and nudity.

blazblue-alter-memory.summary: BlazBlue: Alter Memory adapts the fighting games BlazBlue: Calamity Trigger and Continuum Shift. Ragna the Bloodedge, a rebel carrying the largest bounty in history, turns up in Kagutsuchi, the 13th Hierarchical City, intent on destroying the organisation that rules the world. His arrival draws a crowd of fighters to the city: bounty hunters, soldiers and others with their own reasons to find him, including his estranged brother Jin and a young officer, Noel Vermillion. Hoods Entertainment and teamKG produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from October to December 2013. The story assumes some familiarity with the games' large cast and lore, and contains violence.

hyakka-ryouran-samurai-bride.summary: Samurai Bride continues Hyakka Ryoran: Samurai Girls as its second season, set in an alternate modern Japan still ruled by a shogunate. Muneakira Yagyu runs the Yagyu Dojo, and certain girls can become Master Samurai, warriors with legendary samurai powers, by forming a bond with him through a kiss. This season adds new Master Samurai to his circle and a new threat for the dojo to face, while the existing group, including the mysterious Jubei, adjusts to changes in their powers. Arms produced the 12 episodes, broadcast from April to June 2013, based on the light novels by Akira Suzuki. The series contains frequent nudity and sexual fan service.
hyakka-ryouran-samurai-bride.notes: MAL and AniList only say it is the second season; season details come from the Wikipedia article.

high-school-dxd-born-yomigaerarenai-pheo.summary: The Unrevivable Phoenix is a single unaired episode of High School DxD BorN, the third season, released in December 2015 as a bonus with the limited edition of a High School DxD product titled DX.2. It belongs to the story of Issei Hyodo, a lecherous high school student at Kuoh Academy who was killed on his first date and brought back as a devil by Rias Gremory, the club president he now serves along with the other members of the Occult Research Club. TNK, which made the TV seasons, produced the episode, based on Ichiei Ishibumi's light novels. It is meant for viewers who have watched BorN. The series contains explicit nudity and sexual content.
high-school-dxd-born-yomigaerarenai-pheo.notes: No plot synopsis is available on MAL, AniList or Wikipedia; only the release format and bundling are confirmed.

kono-yo-no-hate-de-koi-wo-utau-shoujo-yu.summary: Takuya Arima is a high school student whose father, a historian, disappeared and is presumed dead. During summer vacation, Takuya receives a strange package from him containing a device and a letter explaining that parallel worlds exist and that the device lets him travel between them. He doesn't take it seriously at first, until he finds himself moving between different versions of events, each branching from choices he makes, while trying to uncover what happened to his father and the secrets of his town. Feel adapted ELF's 1996 visual novel into 26 episodes broadcast from April to October 2019. It is a science fiction mystery with romance.

murenase-shiiton-gakuen.summary: At Seton Academy the student body is made up of animals of every kind, from wolves and sloths to koalas and birds. Jin Mazama, one of only a handful of humans enrolled, happens to loathe animals. His hopes for a calm school life fall apart when Ranka Ookami, a small, pushy wolf girl with no pack of her own, decides he should become her first pack member, while Jin only has eyes for Hitomi Hino, the other human he meets there. Much of the comedy is built on real animal behaviour and trivia, played for gags. Studio Gokumi adapted Bungo Yamashita's web manga into 12 episodes in early 2020.

all-out.summary: Kenji Gion is a short, hot-tempered first-year at Kanagawa High School who has never let his size hold him back. On his first day he runs into Sumiaki Iwashimizu, a huge but timid classmate, and the two get pulled into the school's rugby club, a sport Gion barely understands but quickly falls for. The club's mix of beginners and older players, each carrying their own problems, has to learn to trust one another before it can hold together on the pitch. The show takes time to explain rugby's rules and positions along the way. Madhouse and TMS Entertainment adapted Shiori Amase's manga into 25 episodes, broadcast from 2016 to 2017.

koi-kaze.summary: Koshiro Saeki is a 28-year-old wedding planner whose own love life has just collapsed. His parents divorced when he was young, and he has lived with his father ever since, almost out of touch with his mother and younger sister. Soon after his girlfriend leaves him, he has a brief, oddly warm encounter with a high school girl, then learns she is Nanoka, the sister he has not seen in years, who is about to move in with him and their father. The slow, quiet drama follows his struggle with feelings he knows are wrong. A.C.G.T. adapted Motoi Yoshida's manga into 13 episodes in 2004. The story centres on a romantic attraction between an adult man and his teenage sister.
koi-kaze.notes: Wikipedia notes only twelve of the 13 episodes aired on TV Asahi; not stated in summary.

lord-el-melloi-ii-sei-no-jikenbo-rail-ze.summary: Waver Velvet, a decade removed from the Fourth Holy Grail War, now teaches at the Clock Tower in London, the centre of the mages' world, under the title Lord El-Melloi II. The title came with strings attached: he must follow the wishes of Reines, the sharp-tongued young heiress of the El-Melloi family, until she comes of age. Together with Gray, his quiet, hooded apprentice, he is sent to unravel crimes and mysteries among the mage families, solving them by reasoning through how magecraft works. TROYCA's 13-episode series from 2019 adapts Makoto Sanda's light novels in the Fate franchise and is set between Fate/Zero and Fate/stay night.

gin-no-guardian.summary: Suigin Riku attends Shinryou Private Academy, an expensive school for the children of the rich, even though he is completely broke and works several part-time jobs to cover his fees. When he jumps into a pool to rescue his cat despite being unable to swim, he is pulled out by Rei Riku, the school's admired heiress whose father makes games, and falls for her on the spot. His other escape is Dungeon Century, an online game where he has grown close to a girl he has never met in person, and the game soon becomes more important to his real life than he expected. The 12-episode TV series aired in 2017, based on a Chinese web comic.
gin-no-guardian.notes: MAL and AniList disagree on the animation studio (Haoliners Animation vs Studio LAN), so no studio is named.

vividred-operation.summary: In the near future, a power source called the Manifestation Engine, built on an artificial island off Tokyo, has solved the world's energy problems. On nearby Izu Oshima lives Akane Isshiki, a cheerful middle schooler, with her capable little sister Momo and their grandfather Kenjiro, one of the engine's inventors. When strange invaders called the Alone begin attacking the engine and the military cannot stop them, Kenjiro hands Akane a special key that lets her transform and fight back, and she soon learns she will need her friends at her side. A-1 Pictures produced the original 12-episode series in 2013. The camera frequently lingers on its young heroines in fanservice shots.

pale-cocoon.summary: In a far future where the thread of history has snapped, people live inside an endless complex of decaying ruins, and oceans and continents survive only as records in damaged archives. Ura is employed by the Archive Excavation Department, restoring and analysing the scraps of visual data left behind, a job his colleagues increasingly see as pointless. One day he recovers a fragment of footage that unsettles him and makes him wonder what the world outside used to be. This single-episode science fiction OVA, about 23 minutes long, is the work of writer-director Yasuhiro Yoshiura, produced by Studio Rikka. It is quiet, melancholic and almost entirely carried by mood and imagery.

rozen-maiden-traumend.summary: Rozen Maiden: Träumend is the second season of the series and continues from the first. Jun Sakurada, the withdrawn boy who became the partner of Shinku, a living antique doll, has settled into life with her and the other dolls who now share his house, and he is slowly working up the courage to go back to school. Their routine of tea, cartoons and squabbles is broken by the arrival of Barasuishou, a doll who calls herself the seventh Rozen Maiden although none of her sisters have ever met her, and the Alice Game, the dolls' contest to become their maker's ideal girl, starts up again. Nomad produced the 12 episodes in 2005–06, adapting Peach-Pit's manga.

inuyasha-tenka-hadou-no-ken.summary: The third InuYasha film turns to the legacy of the half-demon's late father, the great dog demon, who left behind three swords. Inuyasha carries Tessaiga and his half-brother Sesshomaru holds Tenseiga, but the third blade, So'unga, ended up in the modern era, kept as a treasured relic at Kagome's family shrine. During one of Inuyasha's visits to Kagome's time, the sword awakens and reveals a murderous will of its own that threatens both eras. To stop it, the two brothers, who can barely stand each other, have to fight on the same side. Sunrise released the film in Japan in December 2003, directed by Toshiya Shinohara and based on Rumiko Takahashi's manga.

babylon.summary: Zen Seizaki, a hard-working public prosecutor in Tokyo, is attached to the newly formed Shiniki district. With his assistant Atsuhiko Fumio, he takes on what seems a routine case about a pharmaceutical company that faked clinical data for a new drug. While going through the file of a doctor tied to the fraud, Zen finds a page smeared with blood, hair and skin and covered in the letter F, and the investigation begins pulling him toward something far larger and more political than drug fraud. Revoroot adapted Mado Nozaki's novels into 12 episodes, aired from 2019 into 2020 and streamed on Prime Video. The series deals with suicide and contains graphic, disturbing violence.

kyoukaisenjou-no-horizon-ii.summary: Season two of Horizon in the Middle of Nowhere carries straight on from the first. In a far-future Japan where nations act out humanity's past according to a sacred record called the Testament, Tori Aoi and the students of the flying city-ship Musashi have vowed to recover the emotions of Horizon, the girl he loves, which are scattered across the world. Their next stop is the floating island of England, ruled by the Fairy Queen, just as Tres España prepares an armada for the war history says must take place. Sunrise produced 13 episodes in 2012 from Minoru Kawakami's light novels, and the crowded cast and setting assume you have seen season one.

fate-stay-night-unlimited-blade-works-tv.summary: Sunny Day is a single short bonus episode for the second half of ufotable's Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works, released in October 2015. Rather than adding a new adventure, it returns to the very end of the Fifth Holy Grail War and plays out a different, gentler outcome for one of the main characters than the one shown in the TV series, before looking ahead to a calmer future. Because it depends entirely on how the series ends, it only makes sense once you have finished all of Unlimited Blade Works. Like the TV series, it adapts that storyline from Type-Moon's Fate/stay night game, and is mostly an epilogue for fans.
fate-stay-night-unlimited-blade-works-tv.notes: Contents confirmed from MAL synopsis only; Wikipedia page does not describe the special.

usagi-drop-specials.summary: These four short specials, released alongside Production I.G's Bunny Drop TV series in 2011 and 2012, are small everyday stories about Daikichi Kawachi, a thirty-year-old single office worker, and Rin, the six-year-old girl he chose to raise after his grandfather's funeral. Nothing dramatic happens: Rin starts making fish out of autumn leaves, which leads Daikichi to help her learn about sea life; the two prepare for their first Christmas together and the arrival of Santa; and they go out to see the cherry trees blossoming. Each lasts about five minutes and keeps the warm, low-key mood of the main series, based on Yumi Unita's manga.

asura-cryin.summary: Tomoharu Natsume is an ordinary high school student except for one detail: he is haunted by the ghost of his childhood friend Misao, who died in a plane accident that he barely survived. After moving into the old house left by his older brother, he is handed a locked briefcase with no explanation, and soon several rival groups break in trying to take it from him. The case turns out to be his way into a hidden conflict fought with giant mechanical suits called Asura Machina, and into the company of the girls tangled up in it. Seven Arcs adapted Gakuto Mikumo's light novels, illustrated by Nao Watanuki, into 13 episodes in 2009.

kuroko-no-basket-3rd-season-ng-shuu.summary: These nine short blooper episodes were included with the Japanese Blu-ray and DVD volumes of the third season of Kuroko's Basketball, released between April and December 2015. Each lasts about two minutes and offers animated outtakes rather than story: scenes from the season go wrong, characters fumble lines or moments, and serious matches dissolve into gags. Because the jokes play off specific moments from the third season, they are best watched after it. Production I.G, which animated the TV series from Tadatoshi Fujimaki's manga about a nearly invisible basketball player and his high school team, produced the shorts with the same cast and look.
kuroko-no-basket-3rd-season-ng-shuu.notes: Only MAL/AniList describe the content (as animated bloopers); Wikipedia covers the season itself.

momo-e-no-tegami.summary: Eleven-year-old Momo Miyaura moves from Tokyo to a small island in the Seto Inland Sea with her mother after her father's sudden death. The only thing he left her is an unfinished letter that says 'Dear Momo' and nothing else, and she cannot stop wondering what he meant to tell her. Lonely in an unfamiliar town of old wooden houses and quiet shrines, Momo begins to notice three odd, greedy yokai living in the attic whom no one else can see, and they are clearly there for a reason. Hiroyuki Okiura wrote and directed the film for Production I.G; it premiered in 2011 and mixes grief and family drama with broad comedy.

black-butler-ii-specials.summary: These six bonus episodes were released on the Japanese DVD volumes of Black Butler II between 2010 and 2011, and none of them continues the main story. Two of them recast Ciel, Sebastian and the rest of the cast as characters from Alice in Wonderland; one plays like a dating game in which Elizabeth invites the viewer to a ball at the Phantomhive manor; another is a mock documentary about the 'making' of the second season, with the characters interviewed as if they were actors. The last two follow the reapers William and Grell training new recruits, and the servants of Alois Trancy's household. A-1 Pictures produced them from Yana Toboso's manga.
black-butler-ii-specials.notes: Episode contents come from the official-site listing reproduced on MAL and Kitsu; Wikipedia does not list them.

aico-incarnation.summary: In 2035, an accident at a research facility in Japan's Kurobe Gorge, later called the Burst, releases Matter, a mass of artificial living tissue that keeps spreading and consuming everything around it. Aiko Tachibana, fifteen, whose family was taken from her in the disaster and who now lives under constant medical watch, is told by a transfer student, Yuya Kanzaki, that the truth about her body is connected to the Burst. Alongside a team of armed Divers trained to move through the Matter, she sets out for the centre of the sealed-off zone. Bones produced this original 12-episode science fiction series, which Netflix put out globally in March 2018, with some body horror.

selector-spread-wixoss.summary: Selector Spread WIXOSS is the second season and continues directly from Selector Infected WIXOSS. Girls chosen as Selectors fight battles with living cards called LRIGs, each hoping to win a wish, and Ruko Kominato has learned what that price really is. Together with Yuzuki Kurebayashi and Hitoe Uemura, she wants to stay out of further battles, but others, like the carefree Chiyori, ignore every warning, and Ruko finds that staying on the sidelines will not protect the people she cares about. J.C.Staff produced 12 episodes in 2014, built around Takara Tomy's WIXOSS card game. The tone is dark and psychological, and it needs the first season.

bamboo-blade.summary: Toraji Ishida teaches kendo at Muroe High School and is so broke he can barely feed himself. When his former upperclassman, now coaching another school, proposes a match between their girls' kendo teams with a year of free meals as the prize, Toraji agrees at once, despite having almost no team. His luck turns when he discovers Tamaki Kawazoe, a quiet first-year obsessed with tokusatsu hero shows, who turns out to be an extraordinary swordswoman. With her and a handful of other girls, the club starts to grow. AIC ASTA adapted the manga by Masahiro Totsuka and Aguri Igarashi into 26 episodes, broadcast from 2007 to 2008, balancing sports and comedy.

teekyuu.summary: Teekyu follows the four members of a high school tennis club who almost never play tennis. Kanae Shinjo is easily bored and ignores the laws of physics, Nasuno Takamiya is rich enough to always get her way, Marimo Bando does alarming things without a second thought, and their junior, Yuri Oshimoto, is the only normal one and mostly reacts. Each episode runs about two minutes, and the jokes come so fast that characters talk at breakneck speed as the girls hurtle from one absurd scheme to the next. MAPPA produced this first 12-episode season in 2012, adapting the manga illustrated by Piyo, and further seasons kept the format going until 2017.

blame-movie.summary: Humanity is barely surviving inside the City, a vast structure that keeps building itself without end. People have lost the genetic key that once let them control its systems, and machines called the Safeguard hunt down anyone without it. Zuru, a girl from a small settlement that is running out of food, joins a scavenging party that accidentally triggers the Safeguard's defences. They are rescued by Killy, a silent wanderer carrying a devastating gun, who says he is searching for a human with the Net Terminal Gene. Polygon Pictures made this CG film from Tsutomu Nihei's manga, released on Netflix in May 2017. The fights include violent deaths.

azur-lane.summary: In Azur Lane, naval battles are fought by girls who embody famous warships. When an alien force called the Sirens appeared with technology far beyond humanity's, four nations, the Royal Navy, Eagle Union, Iron Blood and Sakura Empire, joined together as Azur Lane and won the first battles. The alliance did not last: Iron Blood and the Sakura Empire split off to form the Crimson Axis, and the shipgirls of both sides now face each other in the war, with the shadow of the Sirens still looming. Bibury Animation Studios adapted the mobile shooting game into 12 episodes, which began in October 2019 and finished in March 2020 after delays.

gaikotsu-shotenin-honda-san.summary: Honda works at a large bookstore and happens to have a skull for a head, which nobody at work finds worth mentioning. This comedy follows Honda through the daily chaos of the manga section: chasing titles customers can only half-describe, dealing with bonus items that fail to arrive, decoding requests from foreign visitors and working alongside colleagues who also hide their faces, behind a paper bag, a helmet and other odd headgear. The series is based on the author's own time working in a bookshop and doubles as a look at how the trade works. DLE adapted the web manga by Honda into 12 short episodes in 2018, in a simple, flat art style.

inuyasha-kagami-no-naka-no-mugenjo.summary: The second InuYasha film begins with what seems like the end of the story: Inuyasha, Kagome, Miroku, Sango and Shippo finally overcome Naraku and start returning to their ordinary lives. The peace does not last. Naraku's offshoots Kanna and Kagura set about freeing Kaguya, a demon drawn from the old Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, who has been sealed away and wants to plunge the world into an endless night. With Kagome in particular danger, the group has to find a way into Kaguya's castle hidden within a mirror. Sunrise released the film in Japan in December 2002, directed by Toshiya Shinohara and based on Rumiko Takahashi's manga.

break-blade-tv.summary: On the continent of Cruzon, nearly everyone can control quartz with their minds, using it to power tools, buildings and war machines. Rygart Arrow is one of the rare 'un-sorcerers' who cannot, which makes him an outsider in the Kingdom of Krisna, even though its king and queen are his old friends from military academy. When the neighbouring nation of Athens invades, Rygart turns out to be the only person able to pilot an ancient golem dug from the earth, a machine no sorcerer can move, and he is pushed onto the front lines of a war with a friend on the other side. This 12-episode TV version from Production I.G and Xebec aired in 2014, adapting Yunosuke Yoshinaga's manga.
break-blade-tv.notes: The same story was earlier released as six films; this entry is the 2014 TV broadcast.

inugami-san-to-nekoyama-san.summary: Yachiyo Inugami is a bubbly, energetic girl who adores cats, while her classmate Suzu Nekoyama is aloof and reserved and loves dogs, so each of them has the personality of the animal the other one likes. Inugami quickly becomes infatuated with Nekoyama and showers her with attention, which Nekoyama meets with cool, deadpan resistance. Around them, classmates with their own animal-like quirks join in the everyday routine of school, cafés and teasing. Every episode is only a few minutes long and built from short gags. Seven adapted Kuzushiro's four-panel yuri manga into 12 short episodes, aired from April to June 2014.

nagasarete-airantou.summary: After an argument with his father, fourteen-year-old Ikuto Tohoin runs away from home by sea, only for a storm to leave him stranded on Airantou, an island missing from every map. He is found and nursed back to health by Suzu, a kind but naive local girl. The island's village has lived in isolation for generations, and since its men were lost at sea some years ago, it is home only to women and girls, plus a number of talking animals. Ikuto quickly becomes the most sought-after person on the island, while he keeps trying to find a way home. Studio Feel adapted Takeshi Fujishiro's harem comedy manga into 26 episodes in 2007.

rinne-no-lagrange.summary: Madoka Kyono is a cheerful high schooler in the seaside town of Kamogawa and the only member of her school's Jersey Club, which helps anyone who asks for it. One day a mysterious girl named Lan asks for something unusual: that Madoka pilot a giant robot called a Vox to defend Kamogawa from invaders from outer space. Madoka agrees with hardly a second thought and is soon caught in a conflict between alien factions, alongside Lan and another pilot, Muginami. The tone stays bright and summery even in the battles. Xebec produced this original series, whose first 12 episodes aired from January to March 2012, with a second season following that summer.

code-geass-akito-the-exiled-4.summary: The fourth of the five Akito the Exiled episodes continues the story of W-0, a European Union squadron of Japanese-born pilots sent on near-suicidal missions against the Holy Britannian Empire. With some of the unit's key members away from base, commander Leila Malcal and the remaining crew are left surrounded by Britannian Knightmares, led by Shin Hyuga Shaing, who has taken command of the Knights of St. Michael. Leila has to defend her people without the pilots she normally relies on. Sunrise released this instalment in July 2015; it assumes you have seen the earlier parts and, like the series, is set between the two seasons of Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion.

oretachi-ni-tsubasa-wa-nai-under-the-inn.summary: This series follows several young men in the same city whose lives slowly overlap. Takashi Haneda is a quiet student who secretly believes he belongs in another world, yet is tied to this one by his awkward younger sister Kobato and his indifferent girlfriend Asuka Watarai. Shusuke Chitose is a broke freeloader who drifts between part-time jobs until a disastrous first meeting with Hiyoko Tamaizumi. Each storyline mixes romantic comedy with slices of everyday life, with more going on beneath the surface. Nomad adapted Navel's visual novel into 12 episodes in 2011. The broadcast includes frequent sexual humour and nudity.

chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-depth-of-f.summary: These seven short specials were bundled with the Japanese Blu-ray and DVD volumes of the first season of Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!, released between December 2012 and June 2013. Each runs about three minutes and stages an over-the-top battle pitting Sanae Dekomori against Rikka Takanashi, the two girls most devoted to their own imaginary powers, this time as giant-robot combat instead of the everyday school setting of the series. They work as a peek into the girls' shared fantasies and make most sense to viewers who have seen the show. Kyoto Animation, which animated the TV series from Torako's light novels, produced them.
chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-depth-of-f.notes: Content confirmed from MAL/Kitsu description only.

zombieland-saga-revenge.summary: Zombie Land Saga Revenge is the second season of MAPPA's original comedy about Franchouchou, an idol group from Saga Prefecture whose members are all reanimated girls from different eras of Japanese history. After a big concert goes badly wrong, the group ends up deep in debt, forcing its undead members into ordinary day jobs while their loud, secretive manager, Kotaro Tatsumi, falls into a slump. To get back on their feet, the girls must win over Saga again, deal with rival performers and keep their true nature hidden from the public. The 12 episodes aired from April to June 2021 and follow on directly from the first season.

shakugan-no-shana-s.summary: This four-episode OVA series is a set of side stories released between the second and third TV seasons of Shakugan no Shana. In the first, Yuji Sakai accidentally triggers a Treasure Tool that has a strange effect on Shana; in the second, he teams up with the Flame Haze Wilhelmina Carmel to find out why Shana has started keeping secrets. The last two episodes form one story in which Shana tracks a Denizen by searching through the memories of a Torch, the fading remnant of a person who has already died. J.C.Staff produced the OVAs from 2009 to 2010, adapted from Yashichiro Takahashi's light novels, and they assume knowledge of the TV series.

hellsing-the-dawn.summary: Hellsing: The Dawn is a three-part prequel set in September 1944, in the middle of the Second World War. Nazi Germany is experimenting with artificial vampires in occupied Poland, and Sir Arthur Hellsing, head of the Hellsing Organization, sends his two best agents to stop the project: a teenage Walter C. Dornez, the family's butler and a lethal fighter, and the vampire Alucard, who appears in an unexpected form. Each episode lasts about ten minutes; Graphinica animated them, and they were released between 2011 and 2012, adapted from Kouta Hirano's prequel manga. They feature bloody, graphic violence.

h2o-footprints-in-the-sand.summary: Takuma Hirose is a blind high school boy sent to live with his uncle in a rural village, in the hope that country life will help him recover. There he meets several girls, including Hayami Kohinata, whom the villagers openly despise, and Otoha, a strange girl who says she can give him back his sight. Once Takuma can see again, he starts noticing the cruelty around him and the village's buried history, and he cannot just stand by. Zexcs adapted Makura's visual novel into 12 episodes in 2008; what begins as a light romantic comedy turns into a heavy drama. The series depicts bullying and abuse.

r-15.summary: Taketo Akutagawa is a student at Inspiration Academy, a private high school that only admits people with an exceptional talent. His gift is writing, specifically erotic novels, which earns him a dubious reputation among classmates who are geniuses in music, science, sports and computing. Determined to be taken seriously as an author and to reach the top of the school, Taketo keeps getting dragged into comic mishaps and school crises, his overactive imagination usually making things worse. AIC adapted Hiroyuki Fushimi's light novels, illustrated by Takuya Fujima, into 12 episodes in 2011. The show is built around sexual humour and fanservice involving its teenage characters.

sounan-desu-ka.summary: When their plane goes down during a school trip, four high school girls end up stranded on a deserted island. Mutsu Amatani, Shion Kujo and Asuka Suzumori are terrified, but their classmate Homare Onishima stays oddly calm, because she spent her childhood travelling the world with a survivalist father who taught her how to live off the land. Under Homare's blunt instruction, the girls learn to find water, catch and eat whatever the island offers and build shelter, with each episode doubling as a lesson in real survival techniques. Ezo'la adapted the manga by Kentaro Okamoto and Riri Sagara into 12 short episodes in 2019. It includes some fanservice and graphic scenes of preparing animals and insects to eat.

boruto-naruto-the-movie-naruto-ga-hokage.summary: The Day Naruto Became Hokage is a short original video animation bundled with the limited Blu-ray and DVD release of Boruto: Naruto the Movie in 2016. As the title says, it takes place on the day Naruto Uzumaki is due to be formally installed as the Seventh Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village, an occasion he has worked toward his whole life. At home with his wife Hinata and their children, Boruto and Himawari, a small family squabble on the morning of the ceremony spirals out of control, and Naruto ends up missing his own inauguration. Studio Pierrot animated the short, based on Masashi Kishimoto's Naruto, and it is a light family comedy.
boruto-naruto-the-movie-naruto-ga-hokage.notes: Plot point (missing the ceremony) confirmed only by Wikipedia's Boruto film article; MAL/AniList list it only as a bundled special.

natsuyuki-rendezvous.summary: Ryosuke Hazuki has been dropping by a small flower shop nearly every day, not because he likes flowers but because he has fallen for its owner, Rokka Shimao. He finally takes a part-time job there to get closer to her, only to discover that her apartment upstairs is already occupied by the ghost of Atsushi, her late husband, whom Ryosuke can see and Rokka cannot. Atsushi has no intention of letting another man near his wife, and an odd, gentle love triangle forms among the three. Doga Kobo adapted Haruka Kawachi's josei manga into 11 episodes in 2012, a quiet romance about grief and moving on.

shingeki-no-kyojin-the-final-season-part.summary: This feature-length special is the last part of Attack on Titan: The Final Season and the end of the TV anime. It picks up immediately after the Final Chapters Part 1, released earlier in 2023, with the world facing destruction and a small band of survivors, among them Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Connie, Levi and former enemies such as Reiner and Pieck, racing to confront Eren before it is too late. Everything here builds on events from the earlier seasons, so it should only be watched after them. MAPPA produced it from Hajime Isayama's manga, and it aired in Japan in November 2023. Expect large-scale, graphic violence and death.

ansatsu-kyoushitsu.summary: This short special was produced by Brain's Base for the Jump Festa 2013 event, before the Assassination Classroom TV series was made. It adapts the class trip from Yusei Matsui's manga: the pupils of Class 3-E at Kunugigaoka Junior High, whose teacher is a smiling, yellow, octopus-like creature named Koro-sensei who has vowed to destroy the Earth unless they assassinate him first, head to Kyoto. The trip is a chance to plan an attack in unfamiliar territory, but Nagisa, Karma, Kaede and the rest of their group mostly end up enjoying themselves, until trouble from outside the class gets in the way. Koro-sensei is as excitable as ever.
ansatsu-kyoushitsu.notes: The Kitsu slug 'ansatsu-kyoushitsu' maps to this 2013 Jump Festa special (MAL 19759), not the TV series.

steven-universe-season-3.summary: The third season of Rebecca Sugar's Cartoon Network series follows on directly from the second; Wikipedia notes the two were made as one production block and split afterwards. Steven, a half-human boy who carries his mother's gem, still lives in Beach City with the Crystal Gems Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl, but life has grown more crowded and more complicated. Former enemies are now settling in near town and learning to live on Earth, while old threats from the Gem homeworld have not gone away. Steven also keeps uncovering more about his mother, Rose Quartz, and the war she led. The season mixes small-town comedy and music with larger, emotional story arcs.
steven-universe-season-3.notes: American series with no MAL or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia's episode list. Episode count omitted because Kitsu and Wikipedia count it differently.

saint-onii-san.summary: Jesus Christ and Gautama Buddha have taken a holiday on Earth and are sharing a modest apartment in Tokyo. The two founders of world religions are trying to blend in as ordinary young men, which is harder than it sounds: money is tight, their faces are famous, and both keep accidentally performing miracles in public. Most of the humour comes from gentle jokes about Christianity and Buddhism and from their bewilderment at modern Japanese life. These two OVA episodes, produced by A-1 Pictures and released in 2012 and 2013, adapt Hikaru Nakamura's long-running comedy manga; the studio also made a 2013 film.

full-metal-panic-the-second-raid-wari-to.summary: This single bonus episode of Full Metal Panic! The Second Raid sets the war plot aside for a day of comedy aboard the submarine Tuatha de Danaan. Teletha 'Tessa' Testarossa, the young captain of the Mithril vessel, wakes up on her day off slumped in her commander's chair with no memory of the night before, and her favourite stuffed toy is missing. To piece together what happened, she wanders the ship talking to Sousuke, Kurz, Mao and the rest of the crew, each of whom remembers the evening a little differently. Kyoto Animation produced it in 2006, with storyboards by Yasuhiro Takemoto, director of the TV series, based on Shoji Gatoh's light novels.

jahy-sama-wa-kujikenai.summary: Jahy was once the second most powerful being in the Dark Realm, feared and lavishly pampered. Then a magical girl destroyed the giant mana crystal that sustained her world, and Jahy fell to Earth, where she now lives in a tiny, run-down apartment, often stuck in a child-sized body. To survive she works at an izakaya, struggles with rent, hunger and the summer heat, and schemes, without much success, to gather the crystal fragments and rebuild her empire. Her landlady, her kind boss and her loyal former subordinate keep showing her a softer side of everyday life. Silver Link adapted Wakame Konbu's comedy manga into 20 episodes in 2021.

sankarea-wagahai-mo-zombie-de-aru.summary: This bonus episode was included on the sixth Japanese Blu-ray and DVD volume of Sankarea, released in November 2012, and serves as an extra thirteenth episode after the TV series. Chihiro Furuya, a boy obsessed with zombies, and Rea Sanka, the girl who became one, are trying to manage everyday life even as her body slowly decays, and Rea's new abilities turn out to be handy both at school and around the house. Meanwhile Babu, Chihiro's undead cat, takes an interest in a female cat who is very much alive. Studio Deen produced it, as it did the series, from Mitsuru Hattori's manga. It is a light, comic coda best watched after the main show.

goblin-slayer-2nd-season.summary: Goblin Slayer's second season returns to the armour-clad adventurer who takes only one kind of job: killing goblins, whose raids he has hated since childhood. With spring the creatures grow bolder, and he keeps accepting every goblin quest the guild offers, alongside Priestess, High Elf Archer, Dwarf Shaman and Lizard Priest. His single-minded work draws the attention of a short-tempered novice wizard who wants him to teach her, and the party is soon drawn into larger missions. LIDENFILMS produced the 12 episodes in late 2023, adapting Kumo Kagyu's light novels illustrated by Noboru Kannatsuki. The series depicts brutal violence and references sexual assault.

negima.summary: Negima!? is Shaft's alternative retelling of Ken Akamatsu's Negima! Magister Negi Magi, and does not follow on from the earlier TV series. Negi Springfield is a ten-year-old wizard fresh out of magic school whose training assignment is unusual: he must work as a teacher at Mahora Academy in Japan, in charge of a class of 31 girls, while keeping magic a secret. His students quickly drag him into chaos, and the series spins its own original story around familiar faces such as Asuna Kagurazaka and Konoka Konoe. Akiyuki Shinbo directed the 26 episodes, aired from 2006 to 2007, with a heavy dose of comedy and fanservice.

karakuri-circus.summary: Narumi Kato is a martial artist suffering from Zonapha syndrome, a strange illness that leaves him unable to breathe unless he can make the people around him laugh. During a part-time job, he runs into Masaru Saiga, a young boy dragging a huge suitcase and fleeing pursuers who want him dead after he has inherited a fortune. Narumi steps in to protect him, and they are soon joined by Shirogane, a white-haired young woman who fights using marionettes. The three are caught up in a centuries-old war between puppeteers and deadly automatons. Studio VOLN adapted Kazuhiro Fujita's long manga into 36 episodes from 2018 to 2019, with graphic violence.

heaven-s-lost-property-final-eternal-my-.summary: Eternally My Master is the second Heaven's Lost Property film and the conclusion of the anime. Tomoki Sakurai, who only wants a quiet life, has spent his days with Ikaros, the winged 'Angeloid' who fell from the sky and declared herself his servant, together with the other Angeloids and his friends from Sorami. Ikaros is now struggling with emotions she has never experienced before, and she starts to realise that her bond with Tomoki runs deeper than she believed, just as a larger conflict with the world above is coming to a head. Production IMS released the film in April 2014, adapting Suu Minazuki's manga, and it includes the series' trademark fanservice.

gunjou-no-magmell.summary: When a new continent called Magmell suddenly appeared in the middle of the ocean, it opened a new age of exploration, full of untouched resources and creatures no one had seen before. Expeditions into its wilderness are dangerous, so they rely on 'anglers', specialists hired to rescue people who get into trouble there. Inyou is one of the best, a highly capable young angler who handles search-and-rescue jobs with his assistant, Zero. Each case brings him into contact with the continent's mysteries and the people chasing them. Pierrot Plus, since renamed Studio Signpost, adapted the Chinese manhua into 13 episodes in 2019.

mitsuboshi-colors.summary: In Ueno, a lively district of Tokyo, three elementary school girls call themselves the Colors and claim to be the town's protectors. In practice, Yui Akamatsu, the shy and easily flustered leader, Sacchan, the loud and bossy one, and Kotoha, a deadpan girl glued to her handheld game console, spend their days inventing missions, pestering Saito, the local police officer, and roaming the shopping streets and parks of the neighbourhood. The comedy comes from children's logic, their mix of kindness and mischief, and the patient adults who put up with them. Silver Link adapted Katsuwo's manga into 12 episodes, broadcast in early 2018.

ro-kyu-bu.summary: Subaru Hasegawa is a first-year in high school who lives for basketball, until his school's team is suspended for a year after a scandal. With nothing to play for, he is talked by his aunt, Mihoshi Takamura, into coaching the girls' basketball club at Keishin Academy, a private elementary school. The club's five sixth-graders are fighting to keep their team alive, and Subaru gradually finds his own love of the game again while teaching them. Project No.9 adapted Sagu Aoyama's light novels into 12 episodes in 2011. The series contains frequent fanservice involving its elementary school characters.

hinako-note.summary: Hinako Sakuragi grew up in the countryside and gets so nervous around new people that she freezes up like a scarecrow. Hoping to overcome it, she moves to Tokyo to attend Fujiyama High School and join its theatre club, taking a room at Hitotose Manor, a boarding house attached to a bookshop. She soon discovers that the club is on hiatus, so she and the other residents, including Chiaki Hagino, a second-year who runs the manor, decide to form their own troupe and put on plays. Passione adapted Mitsuki's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in 2017, a gentle comedy about friendship, acting and small personal progress, with some light fanservice.

bakuten-shoot-beyblade.summary: In a world where kids battle with high-tech spinning tops called Beyblades, thirteen-year-old Tyson Granger, known as Takao Kinomiya in Japan, dreams of becoming the best blader there is. He forms a team, the Bladebreakers, with the cool, distant Kai Hiwatari, the cheerful Max Tate and the calm Ray Kon, supported by Kenny, a young computer whiz who tracks their stats. Each of their blades is home to a powerful sacred spirit known as a bit-beast, and the team works its way through national, regional and world championships against increasingly strong rivals. Madhouse produced this first 51-episode series in 2001, based on the manga created to sell Takara's tops.

maburaho.summary: Everyone in Maburaho's world can use magic, though only a fixed number of times in a lifetime, and social status depends on how much magic a person has. Kazuki Shikimori is a second-year at the elite magic school Aoi Academy who has just eight spells in him before his body crumbles to ash, making him one of the weakest students there. Then it emerges that famous magicians run in his family and that his child could be extraordinarily powerful, and Yuna Miyama, Rin Kamishiro and Kuriko Kazetsubaki suddenly take a strong interest in him. J.C.Staff adapted Toshihiko Tsukiji's light novels into 24 episodes in 2003–04, with frequent fanservice.

goshuushou-sama-ninomiya-kun.summary: Shungo Ninomiya is an ordinary high school student who lives with his older sister Ryoko, a professional mercenary who is often away. One day a helicopter lands at his school, and Ryoko has sent him two new housemates: Mayu Tsukimura and her brother Mikihiro. Mayu is a young succubus who naturally attracts men but is terrified of them, and she has come to train herself to get over that fear, with Shungo as her practice partner. Ryoko and Mikihiro make sure the two share almost everything, including a room. AIC Spirits adapted Daisuke Suzuki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2007. The romantic comedy contains frequent fanservice and sexual humour.

initial-d-final-stage.summary: Final Stage is the closing chapter of the Initial D anime, adapting the last part of Shuichi Shigeno's street-racing manga in four episodes released in 2014. Project D, the expedition team built around Takumi Fujiwara and Keisuke Takahashi, has beaten every rival crew in its path and faces one last challenge from Kanagawa's Sidewinder team. Takumi, who has never lost a race, finds himself up against Shinji Inui, a seventeen-year-old who knows his home mountain pass intimately and drives the same Toyota AE86 that Takumi does, making it a duel between identical cars. Keisuke has his own fierce downhill battle first. SynergySP animated it, and it follows on from Fifth Stage.

vanitas-no-carte-part-2.summary: The second cour of The Case Study of Vanitas continues the story of Vanitas, a human doctor who uses a mysterious grimoire to 'cure' vampires whose true names have been corrupted, and Noé Archiviste, the earnest young vampire who travels with him in a steampunk version of nineteenth-century France. Part 2 sends them to the region of Gévaudan, where a giant wolf-like Beast has been killing people. Vanitas suspects it is a cursed vampire he can save, but the investigation splits the pair up and pulls Noé into memories from long ago. Bones produced the 12 episodes, aired in early 2022, adapting Jun Mochizuki's manga. It contains violence and blood.

inuyasha-toki-wo-koeru-omoi.summary: The first InuYasha film is set during the search for the scattered fragments of the Shikon Jewel. One of the fragments awakens Menomaru, a powerful demon from China whose father once fought the father of Inuyasha long ago, and he sets his sights on Inuyasha's sword, Tessaiga, as the key to his revenge. To get it, Menomaru turns Kagome into a weapon against Inuyasha, while Miroku, Sango and Shippo try to hold his moth-like demon swarms at bay. The bond between Inuyasha and Kagome sits at the centre of the story. Sunrise released the film in Japan in December 2001, directed by Toshiya Shinohara and based on Rumiko Takahashi's manga.

jigoku-shoujo-mitsuganae.summary: Three Vessels is the third season of Hell Girl. Its premise remains the same: at midnight, anyone consumed by a grudge can log on to the Hell Correspondence website and ask Ai Enma to drag their tormentor to hell, at the cost of their own soul going there after death. After the second season, Ai's assistants Ren Ichimoku, Wanyudo and Hone-onna have been leading quiet lives, until they are called back. Ai now works through the body of Yuzuki Mikage, an ordinary schoolgirl who can see what Ai sees and is drawn into each case. Studio Deen produced the 26 episodes from 2008 to 2009. The anthology deals with bullying, abuse, murder and suicide.

zero-no-tsukaima-princesses-no-rondo-spe.summary: This single bonus episode belongs to Rondo of the Princesses, the third season of The Familiar of Zero, and was released on its Japanese DVD in December 2008; fans often number it 6.5. Saito Hiraga, the ordinary Japanese boy summoned to a fantasy world as the familiar of the hot-tempered noble mage Louise, joins the girls of the Tristain Magic Academy for a trip to the beach. As usual, a seaside outing gives the cast plenty of chances for misunderstandings, jealousy and Louise's explosive temper. J.C.Staff produced it, based on Noboru Yamaguchi's light novels. It is a standalone fanservice episode with frequent swimsuit and suggestive scenes.
zero-no-tsukaima-princesses-no-rondo-spe.notes: Content described only as a DVD beach episode on MAL/AniList; plot details kept general.

kyoukai-no-rinne-tv.summary: Ever since a strange incident in early childhood, Sakura Mamiya can see ghosts, and she would love to grow out of it. Instead, in high school she meets Rinne Rokudo, the classmate who sits next to her but almost never comes to class. Rinne is part human, part shinigami, and spends his time helping lingering spirits move on to the next life, a job that keeps him desperately poor, since every exorcism tool costs money. Sakura, oddly calm about the supernatural, keeps getting drawn into his cases. Brain's Base adapted Rumiko Takahashi's manga into this first 25-episode season in 2015, a light episodic comedy with mild spooky elements.

hatsukoi-limited.summary: To Ayumi Arihara, happiness means being loved, so what she wants most is for a boy to confess his feelings to her. When a confession letter finally arrives, it comes from Misao Zaitsu, a huge, frightening-looking classmate, which is far from what she imagined. That awkward start opens a set of linked stories about the girls around her, including Misao's younger sister, each of them stumbling clumsily through a first crush of her own, with plenty of misunderstandings. J.C.Staff adapted Mizuki Kawashita's romantic comedy manga into 12 episodes in 2009. The comedy includes some fanservice and suggestive scenes.

akagami-no-shirayuki-hime-ova.summary: This single OVA was bundled with a limited edition of the manga's fifteenth volume in Japan in January 2016, after the two TV seasons of Snow White with the Red Hair. It adapts three chapters from Sorata Akizuki's manga. The main story follows Shirayuki, the red-haired herbalist working at the palace of Clarines, and Prince Zen as they slip out together to spend a day in the town below the castle. The other two pieces are side stories: one shows Prince Raji as a child, and another tells how Zen first met his loyal aides, Mitsuhide and Kiki. Bones produced it with the same staff and look as the TV series, and it is a gentle romance best watched afterwards.

magia-record-mahou-shoujo-madoka-magica-.summary: Magia Record is a side story to Puella Magi Madoka Magica. Iroha Tamaki is a kind middle schooler who became a magical girl by striking a deal with the white creature Kyubey, and now fights the witches who prey on people. But she cannot remember what her wish was, and she has a nagging sense that she once had a younger sister no one else recalls. Following rumours that magical girls can be 'saved' in Kamihama City, she travels there and finds its witches far stronger than usual and the city full of strange urban legends. Shaft produced the 13 episodes in 2020, adapting the mobile game. It has dark and violent themes.

seven-seeds.summary: Natsu Iwashimizu, a timid teenage girl, falls asleep one day and wakes on a sinking boat during a violent storm with four strangers, in a world she does not recognise. They gradually learn that they have been cryogenically preserved and revived in the far future, after a disaster has wiped out humanity and the land has filled with strange, dangerous new plants and animals. They are one of several teams selected to restart civilisation, and must learn to survive and trust each other before they can find the others. Gonzo adapted Yumi Tamura's manga into this 12-episode first season, released on Netflix in 2019. It contains violence and some disturbing scenes.

shinigami-bocchan-to-kuro-maid.summary: As a child, a young duke was cursed by a witch so that every living thing he touches dies. Disowned by his family, he lives in a secluded mansion with only a butler, Rob, and a maid named Alice, who has known him since they were children. Alice, playful and quite shameless, delights in teasing her master by getting as close as possible without actually touching him, while the shy duke struggles to hide how much he loves her. Their quiet life is gradually expanded by visitors and a search to break the curse. J.C.Staff adapted Koharu Inoue's web manga into 12 episodes in 2021, with frequent suggestive humour.

nekopara-tv.summary: Kashou Minazuki runs La Soleil, a small patisserie, in a world where people keep catgirls as pets and companions. Living with him and his younger sister Shigure are six of them: Chocola and Vanilla help out in the shop, while Azuki, Coconut, Maple and Cinnamon spend most of their time around the house. The series follows their daily life, from mishaps at work to everyday outings, with small stories about growing up, sibling quarrels and the catgirls' wish to be helpful to their master. Felix Film adapted the visual novels by Neko Works and the artist Sayori into 12 episodes in 2020. The TV version is a gentle comedy, though it includes some fanservice.

tian-guan-ci-fu.summary: Eight centuries in the past, Xie Lian, beloved Crown Prince of Xianle, ascended to heaven as a martial god, then fell from grace. Now he has ascended for a third time, but as a laughing stock: a god with no worshippers and no temple, who scrapes by collecting junk. On his first mission back, a red-clad stranger guides him through a dark forest and then vanishes, and soon afterwards he runs into San Lang, a youth who knows a surprising amount about gods, ghosts and Xie Lian's own forgotten past. Haoliners Animation adapted Mo Xiang Tong Xiu's Chinese web novel into this first season of 11 episodes, released in 2020–21, with horror-tinged violence.

tensei-shitara-slime-datta-ken-3rd-seaso.summary: The third season of That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime picks up after Rimuru Tempest's hard-won victories over the Kingdom of Falmuth and the demon lord Clayman. Rimuru, a former Japanese office worker reborn as a powerful slime, now rules the growing monster nation of Tempest, which is attracting migrants and merchants while it prepares a grand festival to show itself to the world. Not everyone welcomes a monster nation's rise, and powerful humans, including the Western Holy Church and its formidable leader Hinata Sakaguchi, have their own views on Rimuru. 8bit produced the 24 episodes in 2024, adapting Fuse's light novel series.

aggressive-retsuko-ona-2.summary: In the second season of Aggretsuko, Retsuko, a polite red panda accountant who unwinds by screaming death metal at karaoke, is still stuck in the same office job, though her friendships with the confident Gori and the cool Washimi have made life easier. New problems arrive quickly. At work she is put in charge of training Anai, a new employee whose dedication hides something more troublesome. At home, her mother turns up unannounced, determined to see her daughter married, and starts arranging matchmaking meetings. Retsuko also meets someone very unlike the men she has known. Fanworks produced the ten episodes, released by Netflix in June 2019, based on the Sanrio character.

steamboy.summary: In 1866, during the height of Britain's industrial age, Ray Steam is a young boy in Manchester from a family of inventors, working as a mill maintenance boy and tinkering with his own machines. Then a parcel arrives from his grandfather, Lloyd: a metal ball containing steam under immense pressure, with instructions to protect it at all costs. Men from the powerful O'Hara Foundation arrive to seize it, and Ray is swept off to London, where the Great Exhibition is being prepared and where rival visions of how science should be used come into conflict. Katsuhiro Otomo directed and co-wrote the film, produced by Sunrise and released in 2004.

5-toubun-no-hanayome-movie.summary: The Quintessential Quintuplets Movie concludes the anime adaptation of Negi Haruba's romantic comedy, following the two TV seasons. Futaro Uesugi, a poor but brilliant student, was hired as private tutor to the wealthy Nakano quintuplets, five identical-looking sisters who struggled at school. Now their grades are improving and their final school year is ending, and each sister has come to care for Futaro. With the school festival approaching, he can no longer avoid giving them an answer about his own feelings. Bibury Animation Studios produced the feature-length film, released in May 2022; it only makes sense after the series.

afro-samurai-resurrection.summary: Afro Samurai: Resurrection is the sequel to the Afro Samurai anime. Having won the Number One headband, which marks its wearer as the greatest warrior alive, Afro has tried to live quietly, haunted by nightmares of the violence it took. That peace ends when Lady Sio and Jinno, figures from his past, ambush him, take the headband and steal his father's remains, intending to bring him back. To stop them, Afro must set out again in search of the Number Two headband. Gonzo produced the feature-length film, based on Takashi Okazaki's manga, and it aired on Spike TV in January 2009 in English, with Samuel L. Jackson voicing Afro. It contains extreme violence and some sexual content.

blood-c-the-last-dark.summary: Blood-C: The Last Dark is the film sequel to the Blood-C TV series. Saya Kisaragi has escaped the village where she lived and is now in Tokyo, sword in hand, hunting the man responsible for what was done to her there. Her search brings her into contact with an underground group of young hackers who are fighting the same enemy, and who ask for her help. Teaming up with them, Saya moves closer to her target while monstrous creatures known as Elder Bairns keep appearing. Production I.G released the film in June 2012, working with the artist group CLAMP. It follows the TV series' ending and contains gory, graphic violence.

yamada-kun-to-7-nin-no-majo-ova.summary: These two OVA episodes, released in December 2014 and May 2015, came out around the time of the TV series based on Miki Yoshikawa's manga. Ryu Yamada is a lazy second-year delinquent at Suzaku High who sleeps through class and gets terrible grades. When he tumbles down a staircase with Urara Shiraishi, the school's top student, they kiss by accident and swap bodies. They soon discover that kissing triggers the switch again, and that the school hides seven witches with similarly odd powers. As the Japanese subtitle suggests, the OVAs centre on another take on Suzaku High's school festival. LIDENFILMS produced them; expect comedy built on kissing gags.
yamada-kun-to-7-nin-no-majo-ova.notes: Neither MAL, AniList nor Wikipedia describes the OVAs' plot; summary covers the premise and the festival setting implied by the title (Mou Hitotsu no Suzaku-sai).

hiiro-no-kakera.summary: Tamaki Kasuga is an ordinary high school girl who has never believed in gods or spirits. That changes when she moves to the remote village of Kifumura to live with her grandmother and is attacked by strange creatures as soon as she arrives. She learns that the women of her family are descended from the Tamayori Princess, whose duty is to keep the dangerous sword Onikirimaru sealed, and that five young men have been raised as her Guardians. The Guardians are not pleased to discover that their princess knows nothing about her role. Studio Deen adapted Idea Factory's otome visual novel into this first 13-episode season in 2012, with a second season following.

jashin-chan-dropkick.summary: Yurine Hanazono, a young woman interested in the occult, has summoned Jashin-chan, a snake-tailed devil from hell, but has no idea how to send her back. The only way home for Jashin-chan is to kill her summoner, so she spends each day plotting Yurine's murder with traps, ambushes and dirty tricks, which always fail and usually end with Jashin-chan being brutally punished in return. Between attempts, the two share Yurine's small apartment with an assortment of angels and demons who drop by. Nomad adapted Yukiwo's web manga into the first season in 2018. The slapstick includes frequent cartoonish gore and dismemberment.

one-piece-nejimaki-jima-no-daibouken.summary: The second One Piece film is a standalone adventure from the early days of the Straw Hat crew. Monkey D. Luffy, the rubber-bodied captain who wants to become King of the Pirates, watches his ship, the Going Merry, sail off without him after a day at the beach, and while chasing it they lose Nami too. The trail leads to the Trump Siblings, pirates who have taken over Clockwork Island, a strange island held together by a giant key and reached by a trap-filled staircase. With Zoro, Usopp and Sanji, Luffy fights his way to the top to take back his ship and his navigator. Toei Animation released the film in Japan in March 2001, based on Eiichiro Oda's manga.
one-piece-nejimaki-jima-no-daibouken.notes: Wikipedia source is the List of One Piece films page, which covers this film in a section.

mobile-suit-gundam-seed-destiny.summary: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny is the direct sequel to Gundam SEED, set after the war between the Earth Alliance and the space colonies of ZAFT, home to genetically enhanced Coordinators. Shinn Asuka, a young ZAFT pilot whose family was killed during the earlier fighting, carries a deep grudge against those he blames. When a fragile peace collapses after the ruins of a space colony are sent falling toward Earth, Shinn and the crew of the new warship Minerva are thrown into a fresh conflict, crossing paths with Athrun Zala and other veterans of the last war. Sunrise produced the 50 episodes from 2004 to 2005. It includes large-scale war violence.

show-by-rock.summary: Cyan Hijirikawa is a shy girl with real guitar talent who dreams of playing in a band but can never quite take the first step. While playing her favourite rhythm game on her phone, she is suddenly pulled into its world, Midi City, a place where music is power and the best performers can sway the whole city. There she joins the band Plasmagica with Chuchu, Retoree and Moa, while a sinister plot threatens to cover Midi City in darkness. Plasmagica is one of several bands signed to the label Banded Rocking Record. Bones adapted the Sanrio rhythm game into 12 episodes in 2015, with plenty of songs.

uta-no-prince-sama-maji-love-2000.summary: Maji Love 2000% is the second season of Uta no Prince-sama, the idol series based on Broccoli's otome game. Haruka Nanami, a talented young composer, now writes songs for STARISH, the boy group formed by her classmates from the Saotome Academy, which has made its debut. As they work toward bigger stages, the members are each paired with a senior idol from the agency's established group, Quartet Night, who are not at all pleased to be babysitting newcomers. Competition and rivalry add pressure, and Haruka's songs remain at the centre of it all. A-1 Pictures produced the 13 episodes in 2013, with many musical performances.

urusei-yatsura.summary: When the alien Oni arrive to conquer Earth, they agree to settle things with a game of tag, and a computer selects Ataru Moroboshi, a lecherous and spectacularly unlucky high school boy from Tomobiki, to represent humanity. His opponent is Lum, a horned alien girl in a tiger-striped bikini who can fly and shoot electricity. Ataru wins thanks to a careless remark that Lum takes as a marriage proposal, and she moves in with him, convinced she is his wife, and zaps him whenever he chases other girls. A parade of aliens, gods and oddballs follows. Studio Pierrot, then Studio Deen, adapted Rumiko Takahashi's manga into 195 episodes from 1981 to 1986.
urusei-yatsura.notes: This is the 1981 TV series; the 2022 remake is a separate entry.

mobile-suit-gundam-the-08th-ms-team.summary: The 08th MS Team takes place in Universal Century 0079, during the One Year War, far from the space battles of the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Ensign Shiro Amada is sent to the jungles of Southeast Asia to command a small Earth Federation mobile suit platoon, a squad of ground-level soldiers who fight in mud and rain with patched-up machines. Before arriving, he had a chance encounter with Aina Sahalin, a Zeon test pilot, and the two find themselves on opposite sides of a grinding ground war. The series focuses on soldiers rather than heroes. Sunrise released the 12 OVA episodes between 1996 and 1999. It contains wartime violence.

amagi-brilliant-park-special.summary: This unaired episode of Amagi Brilliant Park was bundled with the series' seventh Japanese home video volume in 2015. At the run-down amusement park, Seiya Kanie, the arrogant but capable student brought in to save it, is buried in work, and a workplace mishap forces him to reshuffle the staff into jobs they have never done, with predictable chaos as the park's magical cast struggle outside their usual roles. Meanwhile Moffle, the park's grumpy sheep-like mascot, leads several of the park's performers on an unusual public relations training trip. Kyoto Animation produced it, based on Shoji Gatoh's light novels illustrated by Yuka Nakajima. It is a light standalone comedy.

giniro-no-kami-no-agito.summary: Three centuries before the story begins, a failed genetic experiment caused Earth's forests to mutate into a living force that turned on humanity. People now survive in an uneasy truce with it. Agito, a boy from Neutral City, a settlement carved out of old ruins at the forest's edge where he and his father live, stumbles on a machine where a girl named Toola has been sleeping since the old world, and wakes her. Toola may hold the key to healing the planet, but Shunack, a soldier from her era bent on destroying the Forest, wins her over, and Agito must borrow the Forest's power to bring her back. Gonzo released the film in 2006, directed by Keiichi Sugiyama.

otome-game-no-hametsu-flag-shika-nai-aku.summary: In the second season of My Next Life as a Villainess, Catarina Claes, a noble girl who remembers a past life in Japan and knows she has been reborn as the doomed rival character of the otome game Fortune Lover, has survived every bad ending she knew about. Kind, oblivious and surrounded by friends who adore her, she expects a relaxed life, starting with the school festival. But the game's story is not finished, and new characters arrive with plans of their own, while Catarina has no memory of what comes next. Silver Link produced the 12 episodes in 2021, adapting Satoru Yamaguchi's light novels illustrated by Nami Hidaka.

voltron-legendary-defender.summary: Voltron: Legendary Defender is an American relaunch of Voltron, itself adapted from the Japanese series Beast King GoLion. Five young people from Earth, the pilots Shiro, Keith, Lance, Hunk and Pidge, stumble on a giant robotic lion and are flung across the universe, where they learn they have been chosen as the Paladins of Voltron. Each pilots a lion-shaped ship, and together the five combine into Voltron, the only power capable of standing against the Galra, an empire ruled by Zarkon that has been conquering planets for millennia. DreamWorks and World Events Productions made it with Korea's Studio Mir, and Netflix released the first season in June 2016.
voltron-legendary-defender.notes: American series with no MAL or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia. Kitsu's entry covers the first season (11 episodes).

kimikiss-pure-rouge.summary: Koichi Sanada and Kazuki Aihara are high school friends whose childhood friend Mao Mizusawa returns after several years in France. Because her parents are staying abroad, Mao is moving in with Koichi's family, which unsettles more than just his routine. The series follows the three of them and several other students through the ups and downs of first love, awkward confessions and the meaning of a first kiss, with interlocking storylines that move at a slow, realistic pace. J.C.Staff adapted Enterbrain's dating simulation game into 24 episodes, broadcast from 2007 to 2008, and the anime splits the game's single hero into two characters, Koichi and Kazuki.

black-blood-brothers.summary: In a world where vampires, the Black Bloods, live alongside humans, the Red Bloods, the two once fought side by side against a common enemy. Ten years later, Jiro Mochizuki, a vampire veteran of that war nicknamed the Silver Blade, is travelling with his younger brother Kotaro to the Special Zone, a district of Japan where vampires and humans live under a fragile peace. Along the way he meets Mimiko Katsuragi, who mediates between the two races, and soon the brothers are caught up in a conflict between vampire migrants and the Zone's human forces, with an old enemy stirring. Group TAC and Studio Live adapted Kohei Azano's light novels into 12 episodes in 2006, with violence.

ore-ga-suki-nano-wa-imouto-dakedo-imouto.summary: Yu Nagami wants to be a light novel author and enters writing contests regularly, without winning any. When he checks the results of his latest contest, the big winner is someone called Chikai Towano, and the person behind the pen name turns out to be his younger sister Suzuka, a model student. She cannot let anyone know she wrote it, so she asks Yu to pose as Chikai Towano in public. He agrees on one condition: he will only keep up the act until he publishes a book of his own. NAZ and Magia Doraglier adapted Seiji Ebisu's light novels into 10 episodes in 2018. The comedy relies on heavy fanservice and sibling romance jokes.

ghost-in-the-shell-arise-border-1-ghost-.summary: Ghost in the Shell: Arise reimagines the early career of Motoko Kusanagi, before she founded Public Security Section 9. Border 1 is set in 2027, a year after the fourth non-nuclear world war, in New Port City. A bombing by a self-propelled mine and the shooting of an officer tied to arms bribery set off an investigation. Daisuke Aramaki of Public Security crosses paths with Kusanagi, then a cyborg hacker in the military's 501 Organization, who also owns her body; Batou suspects she is behind the bombing, and Togusa is working related cases. Production I.G released this roughly hour-long first part in 2013, directed by Kazuchika Kise, from Masamune Shirow's manga.
ghost-in-the-shell-arise-border-1-ghost-.notes: Wikipedia says the 501 Organization legally owns her prosthetic body; summary wording reflects that.

youkoso-jitsuryoku-shijou-shugi-no-kyous.summary: The third season of Classroom of the Elite returns to the Advanced Nurturing High School, where students' privileges depend on points earned through exams and special tests. Thanks partly to the quiet scheming of Kiyotaka Ayanokoji, his first-year class has climbed from last-ranked D to C. As the third semester begins, students of every year are thrown together in a mixed training camp where weak groups risk expulsion, and Ayanokoji watches his classmates and new acquaintances carefully while Class A's leader, Arisu Sakayanagi, prepares to target him. Lerche produced the 13 episodes in early 2024, adapting Shogo Kinugasa's light novels illustrated by Shunsaku Tomose.

piano-no-mori-tv.summary: Kai Ichinose grows up on the edge of a red-light district, the son of a woman who works there, and since early childhood he has been playing an abandoned grand piano left in the forest nearby. Shuhei Amamiya, a quiet boy from a family of famous pianists, transfers to his school and is stunned to discover Kai's raw, untaught talent. Their meeting draws in Sosuke Ajino, a former concert pianist now teaching music, who sees what Kai could become. Years later, the two boys follow very different paths toward the same goal: the Chopin Competition in Poland. Gaina adapted Makoto Isshiki's manga for NHK, with this first 12-episode season airing in 2018.

girls-bravo-second-season.summary: Girls Bravo: Second Season continues the harem comedy about Yukinari Sasaki, a small high school boy who has been picked on by girls so much that he breaks out in hives whenever one touches him. Being kicked into the bathtub by his tough neighbour Kirie sends him to Seiren, a world populated almost entirely by women, where he meets Miharu, the one girl whose touch does not affect him. Miharu has since moved into Yukinari's house, and more girls from Seiren keep arriving with their own reasons to stay. AIC Spirits produced these 13 episodes in 2005, following the first season and adapting Mario Kaneda's manga. Expect constant fanservice and nudity.

itai-no-wa-Iya-nano-de-bougyoryoku ni-ky.summary: In the second season of BOFURI, Kaede Honjo continues playing the virtual reality game New World Online as Maple, the character she built by putting every point into defence because she did not want to get hurt. That odd choice has made her almost unkillable and given her a string of bizarre skills. Her small guild, Maple Tree, has earned a fearsome reputation after previous events, and as new floors open in the game, its members set out to find even stronger skills before the next big guild battle. The tone remains light and cheerful. Silver Link produced the 12 episodes in 2023, adapting Yuumikan's light novels illustrated by Koin.

nakanohito-genome-jikkyouchuu.summary: Iride Akatsuki is a high school gamer who unlocks a hidden stage in a mobile game called Nakanohito Genome, and wakes up somewhere he has never seen, kidnapped along with several other young players. Each of them is skilled at a different kind of game, from fighting and puzzle games to life simulations, and they are told they must clear a series of real-life challenges to go home. Their instructions come from a 'teacher' with a llama's head, and the stakes of each stage grow as the players start to wonder why they were chosen. Silver Link adapted Osora's web manga into 12 episodes in 2019, a mix of game challenges and mystery.
nakanohito-genome-jikkyouchuu.notes: No English Wikipedia article; second source is AniList.

aishiteruze-baby.summary: Kippei Katakura is a high school boy known for flirting with every girl he meets and avoiding any kind of responsibility. That changes overnight when his aunt Miyako disappears and her five-year-old daughter Yuzuyu is left with Kippei's family, and Kippei is put in charge of looking after her. He has no idea how to make lunches, do her hair or comfort a child who misses her mother, and Yuzuyu is quietly hurting more than she lets on. As he learns to care for her, his outlook, and his feelings for a classmate, begin to change. TMS Entertainment adapted Yoko Maki's shojo manga into 26 episodes in 2004. It touches on child abandonment.

moyashimon.summary: Tadayasu Sawaki has an unusual gift: bacteria, yeasts and moulds are visible to him without a microscope, and he can even talk to them. To him, the bacteria and moulds around us look like cute, chattering little creatures. When he starts his first year at an agricultural university in Tokyo, he discovers that Professor Keizo Itsuki, an eccentric expert in fermentation who knew his grandfather, already knows about his ability and is eager to put it to use. Tadayasu and his childhood friend Kei are soon pulled into the professor's lab. It doubles as a light lesson in microbes and fermentation. Telecom Animation Film and Shirogumi adapted Masayuki Ishikawa's manga into 11 episodes in 2007.

kuma-miko.summary: Machi Amayadori is a fourteen-year-old shrine maiden in a remote mountain village, where she serves the local god together with Natsu, a large talking bear who has been her closest companion since childhood. Machi has never left the village and has no friends her own age, and she now wants to go to high school in the city.
