Natsu, who is surprisingly well informed about modern life, worries she is not ready and sets her a series of 'tests' of the everyday skills a city girl would need, which usually leave her flustered and in tears. Kinema Citrus and EMT Squared adapted Masume Yoshimoto's manga into 12 episodes in 2016, a gentle rural comedy.

saiunkoku-monogatari.summary: In the empire of Saiunkoku, a land modelled on ancient China, Shurei Hong comes from a noble family that has fallen on hard times. She teaches at a temple school and takes odd jobs to keep the household going, while dreaming of passing the imperial examinations and serving in government, a path closed to women. Then she is offered a large sum to enter the palace as a temporary consort to the young Emperor Ryuki Shi, who has shown no interest in ruling, and teach him to take his duties seriously. With her loyal retainer Seiran at her side, Shurei finds herself drawn into court politics. Madhouse adapted Sai Yukino's light novels into 39 episodes from 2006 to 2007.

vandread.summary: In a far-off star system, the men of the planet Taraak and the women of Mejere have been at war for generations. During a ceremony for a new Taraak warship, a band of female pirates from Mejere attacks, and Hibiki Tokai, a young labourer from Taraak's lower class who happens to be aboard, is caught up in it. When the ship fuses with the pirates' vessel and is flung across the galaxy, Hibiki and the few other men left aboard are stuck with the women, and they must learn to cooperate to get home while a mysterious enemy hunts them. Gonzo produced the original 13 episodes in 2000, mixing CG space battles with comedy and some fanservice.

seitokai-yakuindomo-2nd-season-ova.summary: These ten OVA episodes were released between 2014 and 2020, alongside the second season of Seitokai Yakuindomo, and were mostly bundled with limited editions of the manga. They follow the same formula as the TV series. Takatoshi Tsuda is one of the first boys at Ousai Academy, a former girls' school that has just gone co-ed, and is drafted onto the student council as its vice president. His fellow officers, the elegant president Shino Amakusa, the gentle Aria Shichijo and the tiny, serious Suzu Hagimura, keep up a stream of dirty jokes and innuendo that Tsuda is left to answer with deadpan retorts. GoHands produced them from Tozen Ujiie's four-panel manga, and the humour is relentlessly sexual.

pom-poko.summary: In the late 1960s, the forests and hills of Tama on the outskirts of Tokyo are being bulldozed for a huge new suburban housing development. The tanuki who live there, raccoon dogs that in Japanese folklore can change their shape, decide to fight back. Led by their elders, they revive their almost forgotten transformation skills and launch a campaign of pranks, ghostly illusions and outright sabotage to frighten the builders away, all while arguing among themselves about how far to go. Isao Takahata wrote and directed the film, which Studio Ghibli released in 1994; it mixes folklore and comedy with a serious ecological message, and has some frank folk humour about tanuki anatomy.

full-metal-panic-invisible-victory.summary: Invisible Victory is the fourth Full Metal Panic! series and continues the main story after The Second Raid. Kaname Chidori and Sousuke Sagara, the soldier from the secret mercenary group Mithril who was assigned to protect her, are trying to hold on to ordinary high school life. That peace ends when Amalgam, the shadowy organisation set against Mithril, steps up its hunt for Kaname and the knowledge she carries as a Whispered, with the enigmatic Leonard Testarossa leading the pursuit. The fight reaches their own neighbourhood and then spreads across the world. Xebec produced the 12 episodes in 2018 from Shoji Gatoh's light novels. It contains war violence.

mushibugyou.summary: In an alternate Edo period, giant man-eating insects have been terrorising Japan for a hundred years, and the shogunate relies on the Insect Magistrate's office and its specialist fighters to keep the capital safe. When the office summons the legendary swordsman Genjuro Tsukishima, it is his son Jinbei who arrives instead: a cheerful, earnest young samurai who is not nearly as skilled as his father but refuses to give up. Jinbei joins a squad of eccentric warriors, each with their own fighting style, and sets out to protect Edo's people. Seven Arcs Pictures adapted Hiroshi Fukuda's manga into 26 episodes in 2013, an energetic battle series with violence and fanservice.

hidan-no-aria-aa.summary: Aria the Scarlet Ammo AA is a spin-off set at Tokyo Butei High, a school that trains armed detectives called Butei. Akari Mamiya is a first-year who ranks at the very bottom, an E-rank, but she idolises the S-rank prodigy Aria Holmes Kanzaki and dreams of becoming her partner. To get close to her hero, Akari applies for an Amica, a mentorship pairing between a junior and a senior, and has to prove she is worth Aria's time, while her friends and rivals, especially the fiercely protective Shiho Sasaki, have their own designs on her. Doga Kobo produced the 12 episodes in 2015, based on the spin-off manga. It includes gunfights and fanservice.

kamisama-dolls.summary: Kyohei Kuga has moved from his remote home village to Tokyo for college, determined to leave his past behind. Back home he was a seki, one of the few who can command kakashi, wooden god-idols of great age with terrifying power. That past catches up with him when his younger sister Utao arrives in Tokyo with the kakashi he once controlled, warning that his old friend Aki has come too, and that a string of grisly deaths is connected to him. Kyohei's classmate Hibino, whose own family has ties to the village, is pulled into the conflict. Brain's Base adapted Hajime Yamamura's manga into 13 episodes in 2011. It contains graphic violence and some fanservice.

gunslinger-stratos-the-animation.summary: In 2115, the country once known as Japan exists as two parallel worlds: Frontier S, and a heavily managed district whose citizens trade freedom for a controlled, peaceful life. When the two worlds begin to merge, each government launches Operation Stratos, sending handpicked gunslingers to fight their counterparts from the other world, since only one version of reality can survive. Tohru Kazasumi, a high schooler from the Management District, is drawn into the conflict with his friends Kyoka, Kyoma and Shizune, and soon faces versions of people he knows. A-1 Pictures produced the 12 episodes in 2015, adapting the arcade shooter whose original concept came from Gen Urobuchi.

binan-koukou-chikyuu-bouei-bu-love.summary: The Earth Defense Club at Binan High School has no interest in defending anything: its five members, led by the cheerful first-year Yumoto Hakone, mostly spend their afternoons relaxing at Yumoto's family bathhouse. Then a pink, wombat-like alien appears and hands them bracelets that transform them into the Battle Lovers, magical warriors who fight with the power of love against people driven by hatred. The boys are far from enthusiastic, especially about the frilly costumes and the speeches. Their opponents turn out to be a rival group of students from the same school. Diomedéa produced this original 12-episode comedy in 2015, a parody of the magical girl genre with boys in the lead.

bikini-warriors.summary: Bikini Warriors follows four fantasy heroines who are meant to save the world from darkness: the brave Fighter, the dim-witted Paladin, the timid Mage and the seductive Dark Elf, all equipped with armour that covers almost nothing. Instead of epic quests, each very short episode pokes fun at role-playing game clichés, from grinding for experience and selling loot to rescuing villagers, and nearly always finds a way to put the girls in embarrassing, revealing situations. They rarely get far from the first town. Feel. adapted Hobby Japan's line of figures, designed by several artists, into 12 short episodes in 2015. The series is built entirely on fanservice and sexual humour.

pokemon-sun-moon.summary: Pokemon the Series: Sun & Moon sends Ash Ketchum and Pikachu to the tropical Alola region after his mother wins a holiday there. Instead of travelling from town to town, Ash enrols in the Pokemon School on Melemele Island, run by Professor Kukui, and studies alongside new classmates Lillie, Kiawe, Lana, Mallow and Sophocles. He meets new Pokemon and regional forms of familiar ones, earns a Z-Ring from the island's guardian Tapu Koko, takes on the island trials and keeps clashing with Team Rocket and the gang Team Skull. OLM produced the 146 episodes from 2016 to 2019, based on the Sun and Moon games, in a brighter, more comic art style.
pokemon-sun-moon.notes: Kitsu and MAL treat all 146 Sun & Moon episodes (including Ultra Adventures and Ultra Legends) as one entry.

steven-universe-season-2.summary: The second season of Rebecca Sugar's Cartoon Network series picks up after the first season's finale. Steven Universe, a cheerful half-human boy who inherited his mother's gem, lives in the seaside town of Beach City with the Crystal Gems Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl, magical alien guardians who protect Earth. After a dangerous encounter with Gems from their old homeworld, the team has new problems: a stranded enemy technician, a threat buried deep inside the Earth, and questions about the Gems' own past. Between the bigger story, the season keeps its small-town episodes about Steven's friend Connie, his father Greg and the people of Beach City, with plenty of songs.
steven-universe-season-2.notes: American series with no MAL or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia's episode list. Episode count omitted because season splits differ between sources.

sasaki-to-miyano.summary: Yoshikazu Miyano is a timid first-year at an all-boys high school who secretly loves reading boys' love manga. Shumei Sasaki, a laid-back second-year with a delinquent reputation, first notices him after stepping in to stop some bullying, and keeps showing up wherever Miyano goes. When Sasaki discovers Miyano's hobby, he asks to borrow some of the manga, and their conversations about the books slowly turn into a real friendship and then something more, which Miyano is in no hurry to recognise. Studio Deen adapted Sho Harusono's web manga into 12 episodes in 2022, a gentle, slow-burning romantic comedy with almost no drama.

koutetsujou-no-kabaneri-unato-kessen.summary: The Battle of Unato is a new story set six months after the Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress TV series. Ikoma, the boy who became a Kabaneri, half-human and half-Kabane, and Mumei, the girl who fights at his side, are still travelling with the armoured train Kotetsujo as it carries survivors through a Japan overrun by the undead Kabane. Their journey brings them to Unato, a region devastated by the Kabane, where the creatures have begun attacking in ways no one has seen before, and the crew joins forces with local troops to retake it. Wit Studio released the film in May 2019, as an original work. Expect gory violence.

kaguya-sama-wa-kokurasetai-tensai-tachi-.summary: This single OVA, released in May 2021, offers three more short stories from the Shuchiin Academy student council of Kaguya-sama: Love Is War, between the second and third seasons. After a swim, Chika Fujiwara and Kaguya Shinomiya find themselves in an awkward mishap in the showers involving a dropped bar of soap. Meanwhile, Miyuki Shirogane and Yu Ishigami come across a discarded adult magazine whose models look suspiciously like their council colleagues. Finally, Chika and Miko Iino stage a fried rice cooking contest to decide who is the council's best chef. A-1 Pictures produced it, based on Aka Akasaka's manga, with more risqué humour than usual.

uchi-no-maid-ga-uzasugiru.summary: Misha Takanashi is a Russian eight-year-old who has withdrawn from the world since her mother's death and now lives with her Japanese stepfather. He hires a housekeeper, Tsubame Kamoi, a towering former Japan Self-Defense Forces pilot who is immediately and openly infatuated with Misha. Tsubame cooks, cleans and uses her military training to break down Misha's defences, while Misha does everything she can to get rid of her. Under the gags, the series is about a lonely child slowly opening up again. Doga Kobo adapted Kanko Nakamura's manga into 12 episodes in 2018. Much of the humour rests on an adult's inappropriate attraction to a young girl.

kaguya-sama-wa-kokurasetai-first-kiss-wa.summary: The First Kiss That Never Ends continues directly from the third season of Kaguya-sama: Love Is War. Kaguya Shinomiya and Miyuki Shirogane, the brilliant vice president and president of Shuchiin Academy's student council, have finally shared a first kiss, but neither is sure whether they are now officially a couple, and their old habit of turning feelings into strategy has not gone away. With Christmas approaching and romance in the air at school, the two have to deal with misunderstandings and their own stubbornness. A-1 Pictures adapted the story from Aka Akasaka's manga; it premiered in Japanese cinemas in December 2022 and was later broadcast as four episodes.
kaguya-sama-wa-kokurasetai-first-kiss-wa.notes: AniList lists it as a 4-episode TV release in 2023; MAL lists it as a 2022 film.

etotama.summary: Every sixty years the heavens hold a ritual in which the Eto-musume, spirit girls representing different animals, can challenge the twelve zodiac signs for a place among them. Nya-tan, the cat spirit, has long wanted a place in the zodiac and is determined to collect the twelve seals she needs to join. She is not strong enough on her own, so she needs energy drawn from people's positive feelings, which leads her to move in, uninvited, with Takeru, a young man living alone in Akihabara. Encourage Films and Shirogumi produced this original 12-episode comedy in 2015, with energetic battles and plenty of fanservice.

nobunagun.summary: Shio Ogura is an awkward high schooler obsessed with military history and weapons, and not very good at making friends. During a school trip, she is caught in an attack by enormous monsters, the Evolutionary Invaders, and is revealed to be an E-Gene Holder, a person who carries the genetic legacy of a famous historical figure, in her case the warlord Oda Nobunaga. Her gene lets her summon a massive gun, and she is drafted into DOGOO, an international organisation of E-Gene Holders who fight the invaders with weapons inspired by people like Jack the Ripper and Isaac Newton. Bridge adapted Masato Hisa's manga into 13 episodes in 2014. It contains violence and gore.

monster-musume-no-iru-nichijou-ova.summary: These two OVA episodes, released in 2016 and 2017, add more stories to Everyday Life with Monster Girls. In a Japan where mythical species now live openly under a cultural exchange programme, ordinary young man Kimihito Kurusu hosts a household of monster girls. In the first episode, a health check reveals that the lamia Miia, the centaur Centorea and the mermaid Meroune have put on weight thanks to his cooking, and a trip to a new gym and pool turns competitive. In the second, the spider girl Rachnera hears from the family who once hosted her, and their daughter arrives wanting her back. Lerche produced both, adapting Okayado's manga, with heavy fanservice and nudity.

mary-to-majo-no-hana.summary: Mary Smith is a clumsy, red-haired girl stuck in the English countryside at her great-aunt Charlotte's house, with nothing to do and no friends nearby. Following a strange cat into the woods, she discovers a rare glowing flower called 'fly-by-night', coveted by witches, and an old broomstick. For one night the flower grants her magic, and the broom carries her high above the clouds to Endor College, a grand school for witches, whose staff take her for an exceptionally talented new pupil. Hiromasa Yonebayashi directed the film, Studio Ponoc's first feature, released in 2017 and based on Mary Stewart's 1971 novel The Little Broomstick.

towa-no-quon-1-utakata-no-kaben.summary: The Ephemeral Petal is the first of six films in the Towa no Quon series. In a futuristic Tokyo, a few rare individuals called Attractors have awakened unusual powers, and a secret organisation called Custos hunts them down with cyborg agents before they can disrupt society. From a hideout in the Fantasium Garden amusement park, a group of Attractors led by the ever-hopeful Quon Mitsuchi fights back against Custos's cyborg unit, WTOC, to rescue others like them before they can be eliminated. This opening chapter introduces Quon and the stakes of his fight. Bones released the film in June 2011, directed by Umanosuke Iida, with action-heavy fights.

kino-no-tabi-nanika-wo-suru-tame-ni-life.summary: This roughly thirty-minute film is a prequel to Kino's Journey, telling how the traveller became Kino. A young girl flees the country where she grew up, after and the death of the stranger who helped her get away leads her to take his name, Kino, as her own. With the talking motorcycle Hermes, she finds shelter in a forest with an elderly woman, a former master of firearms, who trains her to shoot, ride and survive on her own. Kino is content there, but the guilt she feels for the man whose name she carries keeps returning. A.C.G.T. released the film in February 2005, based on Keiichi Sigsawa's light novels. It contains gun violence.

higurashi-no-naku-koro-ni-kira.summary: Kira is a four-episode OVA series released in 2011 and 2012 to mark the tenth anniversary of Higurashi When They Cry. Unlike the original murder mystery, it sets aside the horror altogether and drops the familiar cast of Hinamizawa, Keiichi, Rena, Mion, Shion, Satoko and Rika, into a set of comic alternate scenarios built for fun and fanservice. In one, Rika and Satoko become magical girls fighting an evil crime syndicate, backed by a squad of cheerleaders; the other episodes spin similarly silly what-if situations. Studio Deen produced it, based on Ryukishi07's visual novels. It is only for existing fans and leans on suggestive humour.

naruto-shippuden-konoha-gakuen-special.summary: This roughly eight-minute special from 2008 drops the Naruto cast into an alternate universe: Konoha Academy, a strict Japanese high school that prides itself on good manners. Into this orderly world walks transfer student Naruto Uzumaki, who announces that he intends to become the top delinquent boss in all of Japan. He promptly picks fights with nearly every club captain and local troublemaker, but it is his classmate Sasuke Uchiha who makes the strongest impression on him. Studio Pierrot animated the short, a gag parody based on Masashi Kishimoto's Naruto. It has no connection to the main story.
naruto-shippuden-konoha-gakuen-special.notes: Premise comes from MAL (mirrored by Kitsu); Wikipedia does not describe the special.

sabikui-bisco.summary: In a post-apocalyptic Japan, a deadly wind of 'rust' eats away at everything it touches, including people. The government blames the mushroom spores spread by Bisco Akaboshi, a wanted outlaw nicknamed the Man-Eating Mushroom, whose arrows make mushrooms sprout wherever they land. In truth, Bisco is searching for Sabikui, a legendary mushroom said to devour rust, to save his mentor. He rides a giant crab named Akutagawa and soon teams up with Milo Nekoyanagi, a gentle young doctor in the city of Imihama, and the two set out across the wastelands. OZ adapted Shinji Cobkubo's light novels into this first 12-episode season in 2022. It contains action violence.

majimoji-rurumo.summary: Kota Shibaki is an ordinary high school boy who, after an unlucky incident, has been labelled the school pervert, and girls avoid him completely. One day in the library he finds an old book said to summon demons, and tries it out of curiosity. Instead of a demon he gets Rurumo, a young witch-in-training with a deadpan manner who has been sent to grant his wishes using magic tickets. There is a price: every ticket spent takes time off Kota's life. The resulting wishes, which tend toward the embarrassing, drive most of the comedy, while Kota slowly comes to care about Rurumo. J.C.Staff adapted Wataru Watanabe's manga into 12 episodes in 2014, with plenty of fanservice.

love-live-sunshine-2nd-season.summary: Season two of Love Live! Sunshine!! continues the story of Aqours, the nine-girl school idol group from Uranohoshi Girls' High School in the seaside town of Uchiura. Having decided to follow their own path rather than copy the idols who inspired them, the girls hope their performances will attract enough new students to save their tiny school, which is threatened with closure. With an open house and another Love Live tournament coming up, Chika Takami and her friends throw themselves into practice, even as the odds against Uranohoshi grow worse. Sunrise produced the 13 episodes in late 2017, with many original songs.

rewrite-moon-and-terra.summary: The second season of Rewrite completes 8bit's adaptation of Key's visual novel. The first season followed Kotaro Tennouji, a student with unusual powers, as he and five girls from his school's occult research society looked into strange happenings in the green city of Kazamatsuri, where rival factions are quietly preparing for a crisis. This season adapts the game's two final routes, Moon and Terra, which step away from the individual heroines' stories to reveal the truth behind the city, its strange forests and Kotaro's own place in a much larger struggle. Its 11 episodes aired in early 2017, and it needs the first season to make sense.
rewrite-moon-and-terra.notes: MAL and AniList give only that it adapts the Moon and Terra routes; detail kept general.

vampire-hunter-d.summary: In the year 12,090, after a nuclear war, Earth has slipped back into a near-medieval age where mutants, monsters and the vampire aristocracy known as the Nobility rule over frightened human villages. Doris Lang, the orphaned daughter of a werewolf hunter, is bitten by Count Magnus Lee, an ancient vampire lord who decides to make her his bride. Desperate, she hires a mysterious, silent drifter known only as D, a vampire hunter who is himself half-vampire and carries a talking parasite in his left hand. Toyoo Ashida directed this 1985 original video animation, based on Hideyuki Kikuchi's novel with designs drawn from Yoshitaka Amano. It contains graphic violence and brief nudity.

jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-phantom-blood.summary: This 2007 film adapts Phantom Blood, the first arc of Hirohiko Araki's JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. In Victorian England, Jonathan Joestar is the earnest son of a wealthy aristocrat who takes in Dio Brando to repay a debt George Joestar believes he owes to Dio's late father. Dio arrives determined to seize the family's wealth, and the rivalry between the two boys grows from childhood cruelty into a fight with supernatural stakes involving a mysterious stone mask. A.P.P.P. produced the film to mark the series' anniversary, condensing a long arc into a single feature. The 2012 TV series later adapted the same story in full. It contains bloody violence.

blassreiter.summary: In a fictional version of modern Germany, corpses have begun rising as Amalgams, also called Demoniacs: biomechanical monsters that can fuse with machines, motorbikes and weapons, and that attack people savagely. A special police unit, the Xenogenesis Assault Team, or XAT, is formed to fight them, but things grow far more complicated with the appearance of 'amalgamated' humans who keep their minds and are much more dangerous. Among them is Joseph Jobson, a quiet lone warrior who hunts other Amalgams, and whose actions make him a target for XAT. Gonzo and Nitroplus produced this original 24-episode series in 2008, mixing CG motorcycle battles with grim drama. It contains graphic violence and gore.

suki-ni-naru-sono-shunkan-wo-kokuhaku-ji.summary: This second film drawn from HoneyWorks' Kokuhaku Jikkou Iinkai series of Vocaloid songs about young love. Hina Setoguchi, the younger sister of Yu Setoguchi from the earlier film, gets off to a terrible start with her senior, Koyuki Ayase, after she trips him in a school hallway and accuses him of being a pervert. Despite that, his warm smile gradually wins her over, even as she struggles to understand what she is feeling. Around them, friends including Natsuki Enomoto's brother Kotaro have their own unspoken crushes to deal with. Qualia Animation released the film in December 2016, directed by Tetsuya Yanagisawa.

upotte.summary: At Seishou Academy, every student is literally a gun: the girls are personifications of real firearms, sorted into elementary, middle and high school by weapon type and training to become useful weapons one day. Genkoku, a young human teacher, is newly assigned there and has to get used to a class of assault rifles with nicknames such as Funco, the energetic Belgian FN FNC, as well as Ichiroku, Eru and Shigu. Much of the comedy comes from firearms trivia played as personality quirks, along with Funco's growing attachment to her teacher. Xebec adapted Kitsune Tennouji's manga into 10 episodes, streamed online in 2012. The series contains fanservice involving young-looking characters.

koi-to-yobu-ni-wa-kimochi-warui.summary: Ryo Amakusa is a wealthy, handsome businessman who is used to women falling for him. One rainy morning, Ichika Arima, a high school girl, catches him as he slips on a flight of stairs, and that evening he finds her at his own home: she is his younger sister Rio's best friend. When Ichika answers his usual charm with open disgust, Ryo promptly decides he has fallen in love with her, and starts pursuing her with a persistence she finds embarrassing. The comedy follows his attempts to win her over and her attempts to keep him at arm's length. Nomad adapted Mogusu's web manga into 12 episodes in 2021. The romance involves an adult pursuing a high school student.

elemental-gelade.summary: Coud Van Giruet is a young sky pirate who finds an unusual prize in the cargo hold after a raid: Ren, an Edel Raid, one of a rare race of beings who can turn into living weapons when they bond with a human partner. Ren turns out to be even more valuable than anyone thought, and three agents of Arc Aile, an organisation devoted to protecting Edel Raids, arrive to buy her, just as the pirate ship comes under attack. Coud is left in charge of Ren's safety, and the group sets out together for Edel Garden, the legendary land where Edel Raids are said to come from. Xebec adapted Mayumi Azuma's manga into 26 episodes in 2005.

young-black-jack.summary: Set in 1960s Japan, Young Black Jack tells the early story of Osamu Tezuka's outlaw surgeon Black Jack. Kuroo Hazama is a gifted medical student with striking two-tone hair, a body covered in scars and a painful past. Although he is not yet qualified, his remarkable surgical skill draws attention after he completes an operation others thought impossible. Alongside the honest intern Maiko Okamoto and his troubled friend Yabu, Hazama tries to find his place in medicine during a turbulent era of student protests, war and corruption, which keep testing his principles. Tezuka Productions adapted the manga by Yoshiaki Tabata and Yugo Okuma into 12 episodes in 2015. It includes graphic surgery and wartime violence.

buddy-complex.summary: Aoba Watase is an ordinary high school student until, on the first day after summer break, a giant robot drops out of the sky and comes after him. Hina Yumihara, an enigmatic classmate, rescues him in a machine of her own and sends him seventy years into the future to keep him alive. Aoba wakes up piloting a Valiancer named Luxon, caught in a battle between the Free Pact Alliance and the Zogilia Republic, and discovers he can 'couple' with an Alliance pilot, Dio Weinberg, sharing senses and skill. Sunrise produced this original 13-episode mecha series in 2014, with a short follow-up later that year.

chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-ren-lite.summary: Ren Lite is a set of six short episodes, each around six minutes, that Kyoto Animation streamed on its official YouTube channel from December 2013 to March 2014, around the second season of Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!, titled Ren. Like the Lite shorts made for the first season, they are light comic sketches starring Yuta Togashi, Rikka Takanashi, Sanae Dekomori, Shinka Nibutani and the rest of the cast, built around the characters' delusions and everyday school life rather than the main plot. They work as small bonus pieces for viewers who already know the series, which adapts Torako's light novels.
chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-ren-lite.notes: Content described only as YouTube shorts by MAL/AniList; Wikipedia confirms six-minute Lite episodes streamed on YouTube.

fena-pirate-princess.summary: Ten years ago, a shipwreck took Fena Houtman's father from her and separated her from her childhood friend Yukimaru. Since then she has been stuck on an island, raised in a house that sells her company to men. When the night comes for her to be handed over to a client, Fena runs and is rescued by two former knights of her family and a band of hidden warriors, including the now-grown samurai Yukimaru. She learns that her father's last voyage was a search for something called Eden, and that only she can find it. Production I.G produced this original 12-episode adventure in 2021, co-produced with Crunchyroll and Adult Swim. It includes implied sexual exploitation.

r-o-d-ova.summary: Yomiko Readman is a clumsy, short-sighted substitute teacher in Japan who loves books more than anything and spends all her money on them. She is also 'The Paper', a top agent of the British Library's special operations division, with the power to control paper and shape it into shields, blades and gliders. When cloned historical figures with superhuman abilities begin stealing rare books, Yomiko is sent on a mission that grows into a plot of global scale, teamed with Nancy Makuhari, a glamorous fellow agent whose personality clashes with hers at every turn. Studio Deen released the three OVA episodes from 2001 to 2002, directed by Koji Masunari and based on Hideyuki Kurata's novels. It includes action violence.

area-no-kishi.summary: Kakeru Aizawa loves football as much as his older brother Suguru does, but while Suguru has become one of the brightest young talents in Japan, Kakeru lost his nerve on the pitch and settled for being his school team's manager. A sudden tragedy changes that, and Kakeru sets out to play again, aiming all the way for the national team and the World Cup. Pushing him on is his childhood friend Nana Mishima, a gifted player already capped for Japan's women's side. Shin-Ei Animation adapted the long-running sports manga into 37 episodes broadcast from January to September 2012, following school clubs, tournaments and rivalries.

hack-roots.summary: Some years after the original online game The World was shut down, a rebuilt version called The World R:2 has taken its place, and it is a rougher place where player killers roam freely. Haseo, a newcomer, is ambushed and killed for sport within moments of logging in, then helped back on his feet by Ovan, a calm one-armed player, and Shino, a kind cleric. They bring him into the Twilight Brigade, a small guild searching for a legendary item called the Key of the Twilight. Bee Train produced this 26-episode original series in 2006 to lead into the .hack//G.U. games.

jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-2000.summary: Jotaro Kujo, a tough, taciturn high schooler, has shut himself inside a police cell, convinced that an evil spirit is following him around. His grandfather, Joseph Joestar, arrives with his friend Mohammed Avdol and explains that the 'spirit' is a Stand, a fighting power given visible form. The same power then appears in Jotaro's mother, and it is making her ill, a sign an old enemy of the Joestar family has returned. To save her, Jotaro sets off with them on a long trip toward Egypt. Studio A.P.P.P. released these seven OVA episodes from 2000 to 2002 as a prequel to its earlier 1993 OVAs, adapting the start of Stardust Crusaders from Hirohiko Araki's manga. It includes bloody action violence.
jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-2000.notes: MAL/Kitsu entry covers the seven 2000–2002 'Adventure' episodes, which were made later but are set before the 1993 OVAs.

amaenaide-yo.summary: Ikko Satonaka is a sixteen-year-old sent by his parents to train at the Saienji temple, which is run by his grandmother. The temple turns out to be full of young women who are also training as priestesses, and they share his chores, meals and daily life. Ikko is a fairly ordinary trainee except for one thing: when he catches sight of a naked girl, he turns into a powerful super-monk capable of large exorcisms, which proves handy whenever spirits cause trouble. Studio Deen adapted Toshinori Sogabe's manga into 12 episodes in 2005, a broad supernatural comedy. It contains frequent nudity and sexual humour.

mob-psycho-100-dai-ikkai-rei-toka-soudan.summary: In this one-episode Mob Psycho 100 OVA, the Spirits and Such Consultation Office goes on its first company trip. Reigen, Mob, Serizawa, the spirit Dimple and Mob's brother Ritsu head for a hot spring inn in Zebra Prefecture, a holiday paid for by the inn's owner, who in return wants Reigen to look into rumours of strange happenings there. The outing barely begins before Reigen and Serizawa doze off on the train and wake to find themselves stranded in an eerie spirit world. Bones produced it after the second season, and it was released in 2019 following an event screening that summer. It is best watched after season two.

baki-2nd-season.summary: The second Netflix season of Baki opens with its hero in serious trouble. A poison from his last fight is slowly killing Baki Hanma, and no doctor can help him. His friend Retsu Kaioh takes him to China, where the once-a-century Great Raitai Tournament is gathering the country's finest martial artists, and for the first time outsiders are allowed to compete. Baki enters in search of a cure, while his father Yujiro Hanma, the feared 'Strongest Creature on Earth', also turns up. TMS Entertainment released the 13 episodes in June 2020, following the 2018 season and adapting Keisuke Itagaki's manga. It includes brutal, bloody fighting.

re-zero-kara-hajimeru-break-time.summary: Re:Zero Break Time is a set of short comedy episodes that ran alongside the first season of Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World in 2016. Instead of the main series' tension and grim time loops, it puts chibi versions of Subaru, Emilia, Rem, Ram, Beatrice and the rest of the cast into light gags about life in the Kingdom of Lugunica, with Subaru discovering that this fantasy world can be oddly similar to home. There are 11 episodes, produced by Studio PuYUKAI from Tappei Nagatsuki's light novels. The jokes rely on knowing the main characters, so it is best watched alongside or after the first season.
re-zero-kara-hajimeru-break-time.notes: Wikipedia's season 1 article does not cover the shorts; format, episode count and studio confirmed by MAL and AniList.

adventure-time-season-10.summary: This is the tenth and last season of Adventure Time, the American Cartoon Network series created by Pendleton Ward. Finn, a teenage human, and Jake, his shape-shifting dog brother, keep adventuring across Ooo, a strange world rebuilt after an apocalypse, alongside Princess Bubblegum, Marceline the Vampire Queen, the Ice King, BMO and others. The season gathers up longer story threads, including Princess Bubblegum's conflict with her estranged Uncle Gumbald, as the series heads toward its finale. It premiered in September 2017 and ended in September 2018 with the four-part episode 'Come Along with Me'. It is a Western cartoon rather than anime, mixing comedy, odd humour and heavier emotional moments.
adventure-time-season-10.notes: No MyAnimeList or AniList entry (American series); facts from Wikipedia and Kitsu.

senki-zesshou-symphogear-g-in-the-distan.summary: Symphogear G is the second season of the singing-and-fighting series, set three months after the first season's battle. Hibiki Tachibana, Tsubasa Kazanari and Chris Yukine still wear Symphogear armour, powered by song, to fight the Noise, monsters that turn people to dust on contact. During a worldwide broadcast concert that Tsubasa shares with the rising international star Maria Cadenzavna Eve, Noise suddenly appear in the hall, and Maria uses the moment to declare war on the world, revealing that she has a Symphogear of her own. Satelight produced the 13 episodes in 2013. It follows the first season directly and includes action violence.

grisaia-phantom-trigger.summary: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger The Animation is a roughly 90-minute film set after the original Grisaia stories. With the anti-terror organisation CIRS now publicly known, its secret work has been passed to a new agency, SORD, which trains young operatives at special schools. One of them is the reopened Mihama Academy, where a group of misfit schoolgirls are issued real guns and live ammunition and sent on risky, off-the-books missions while still attending classes. Bibury Animation Studios made the film, released in March 2019, adapting the first two volumes of Frontwing's episodic visual novel series. It contains gun violence.

ijiranaide-nagatoro-san-2nd-attack.summary: The second season of Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro picks up with Naoto Hachiouji, a shy second-year who spends his time drawing in the art club room, and Hayase Nagatoro, the first-year girl who has made a hobby of teasing him. By now she drops by more than ever, and Naoto has grown used to her jabs and even started pushing back now and then. Everyone around them can see the two like each other, but neither will say so. OLM took over production from Telecom Animation Film and aired 12 episodes from January to March 2023, adapting Nanashi's web manga. It includes mild suggestive humour.

world-trigger-2.summary: World Trigger's second season returns to the Border Defense Agency, the organisation that protects a Japanese city from invaders called Neighbors. Border is preparing an expedition into the Neighbors' own worlds, and Osamu Mikumo's squad, Tamakoma-2, with the Neighbor Yuma Kuga and Osamu's childhood friend Chika Amatori, is fighting its way up the B-rank team battles to earn a place on it. Then a new enemy ship appears and goes after Border's expedition vessel while many of its fighters are busy with the rank wars. Toei Animation aired the 12 episodes from January to April 2021, adapting Daisuke Ashihara's manga. It follows directly from the first season.

hack-legend-of-the-twilight.summary: Twins Shugo and Rena win a special prize from the company that runs The World, a hugely popular online game: two cute, child-sized player characters modelled on Kite and BlackRose, legendary heroes who once saved the game. Logging in together, they team up with new friends such as Ouka, Mirelle, Hotaru and Sanjuro for quests and events. Then Shugo is handed a mysterious item, the Twilight Bracelet, and unusual monsters begin showing up, ones whose victims fall into comas in the real world. Bee Train adapted the manga by Tatsuya Hamazaki and Rei Izumi into 12 episodes in 2003, lighter in tone than earlier .hack stories.

hetalia-the-beautiful-world.summary: Hetalia turns the world's nations into people. Italy is a cheerful, pasta-loving slacker, Germany is the strict friend who keeps rescuing him, Japan is polite and reserved, and England, America, France, Russia, China and many more each carry the habits and stereotypes of their country. This 2013 web series continues the comedy in short, unconnected episodes in which the countries do everything from running a school newspaper club to hunting for Santa Claus, with jokes drawn from history and culture. Studio Deen produced the 20 episodes, based on Hidekaz Himaruya's webcomic, and newcomers can follow it without seeing the earlier seasons.

a-day-before-us-season-2.summary: A Day Before Us is a South Korean web animation about a circle of university friends and their slow, awkward steps into romance. The first season began when student Ha-eun, sheltering from a downpour, ended up clinging to a quiet young man named Yeon-woo, only to learn he was a childhood friend of her bubbly classmate Yeo-reum, while shy Wook hid his own crush on Yeo-reum. This second season continues their stories, following the couples as they try to work out where they stand with each other. Studio LICO released the 15 episodes online in 2018, and they are best watched after the first season.
a-day-before-us-season-2.notes: No Wikipedia article. Databases describe season 2 only as a continuation; premise taken from the season 1 entries on MAL and AniList.

tsubasa-shunraiki.summary: Tsubasa: Spring Thunder Chronicle is a two-episode OVA that continues Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle after the Tokyo Revelations OVAs. Having escaped Celes, Fai's home country, the travelling group lands in Nihon, the warrior Kurogane's homeland, where he meets again with Princess Tomoyo, who banished him to learn the meaning of true strength. The wizard Fai is still badly hurt from their last ordeal, and Syaoran faces the dangerous hunter Seishiro in a fight for one of Sakura's lost feathers, which hold pieces of her memory. Production I.G released the episodes in 2009, based on CLAMP's manga. It contains violence and is meant only for viewers who have followed the earlier instalments.

break-blade-6-doukoku-no-toride.summary: Broken Blade is set in a world where almost everyone can move quartz with their minds, powering everything from tools to giant war machines. Rygart Arrow is one of the rare 'un-sorcerers' who cannot, but he can pilot an ancient golem nobody else can move, and he is pulled into the defence of the small kingdom of Krisna against the invading Athens Commonwealth, where his old friends Hodr, now king, and Queen Sigyn need him. The Fortress of Lamentation is the sixth and last of the roughly 50-minute films, released in 2011 by Production I.G and Xebec, and it closes the story told in the earlier five. It contains war violence.
break-blade-6-doukoku-no-toride.notes: Databases describe film 6 only as the final film; summary gives the series premise from Wikipedia and the first film's MAL entry. Title translation 'Fortress of Lamentation' is literal.

bakuretsu-tenshi.summary: In near-future Japan, crime has grown so bad that ordinary citizens are allowed to carry guns, and a heavily armed police force, RAPT, deals with criminals by shooting them. Kyohei Tachibana, a gentle culinary student, is saving up to train as a pastry chef in France. After getting caught up in a street shoot-out, he accepts a job as the private cook for four women, Jo, Meg, Amy and Sei, who turn out to be mercenaries working in the shadows of this violent city, with Jo fighting in a large combat robot. Gonzo produced the 24-episode original series in 2004, directed by Koichi Ohata. It includes frequent gun violence.

m3-sono-kuroki-hagane.summary: A region called the Lightless Realm is slowly spreading, and anything it touches is consumed or corrupted by a substance called Necrometal. From it come monsters known as Admonitions, and humanity fights them with large combat robots called Vess. The pilots are a group of teenagers who, as children, were once lost together inside the Lightless Realm. Brought back together years later, they carry their old bonds and private wounds into battle, and things grow worse when a rumour spreads of a 'Corpse Song' said to kill anyone who hears it. Satelight and C2C produced this 24-episode original series in 2014. It includes violence and dark themes.

giant-killing.summary: East Tokyo United, ETU for short, has been scraping by in the top flight of Japanese football for years. A losing streak, dwindling crowds and money troubles have left players and supporters fed up. As a last gamble, the club hires Takeshi Tatsumi as its new coach, a laid-back, unpredictable former ETU star who left the club years earlier and has since made a name managing a small amateur team in England. Tatsumi specialises in 'giant killing', beating far stronger teams, but first he must win over a sceptical squad and angry fans. Studio Deen adapted the manga by Masaya Tsunamoto and Tsujitomo into 26 episodes for NHK in 2010.

nyanko-days.summary: Yuko Konagai is a shy high school girl who struggles to make friends and finds most of school a little lonely. At home, though, she lives with three cats she adores, Maa, Shi and Ro, and in this series they appear as tiny girls with cat ears who can talk, each with her own personality, from a curious, mischievous Munchkin to calmer companions. The short episodes follow their gentle daily routine, along with Yuko's careful first steps toward a real friendship at school. EMT Squared adapted Tarabagani's four-panel manga into 12 short episodes broadcast from January to March 2017.

hakuouki-hekketsuroku.summary: Record of the Jade Blood is the second season of Hakuoki and continues straight from the first. With the shogunate's forces beaten back, Chizuru Yukimura and the surviving Shinsengumi leave Kyoto for Edo as Japan moves toward a new era. With their commander Isami Kondo absent, vice-commander Toshizo Hijikata takes charge, but he is also fighting a growing thirst for blood, and the same curse is spreading among his men while the war with the new government grows desperate. Studio Deen produced the 10 episodes, aired from October to December 2010, based on Idea Factory's otome game. It contains bloody sword violence.

maria-holic-alive.summary: Maria Holic Alive is the second season of the Shaft comedy and picks up the same chaos. Kanako Miyamae transferred to Ame no Kisaki, a Catholic all-girls academy, hoping to find a girlfriend, since she breaks out in hives whenever a man touches her. Instead, the beautiful 'girl' she first fell for, Mariya Shidou, turned out to be a scheming cross-dressing boy, and now he is her roommate and keeps her quiet about his secret, helped by his blunt maid Matsurika. The 12 episodes aired in 2011, based on Minari Endo's manga, and are full of rapid-fire gags and teasing. It includes mild sexual humour.

ghost-in-the-shell-arise-border-2-ghost-.summary: Ghost Whispers is the second of four parts in Ghost in the Shell: Arise, a reimagining of Masamune Shirow's cyberpunk story set before Public Security Section 9 is fully formed. Motoko Kusanagi, now released from the army's 501 Organization, must learn to take orders from Chief Aramaki. When someone hacks the Logicoma robots, Batou recruits former intelligence officer Ishikawa and former artilleryman Borma, while Kusanagi looks to sniper Saito and undercover detective Paz, and the two groups end up competing over a case involving a man with fabricated memories. Production I.G released it in 2013, directed by Kazuchika Kise. It includes gun violence.

dakara-boku-wa-h-ga-dekinai-ova.summary: This one-episode OVA is a bonus story for So, I Can't Play H!, the comedy about Ryosuke Kaga, a high schooler with an unusually strong lustful streak, who strikes a deal with Lisara Restall, a Grim Reaper who feeds on that energy. The school's swimming pool is opening the next day, and Iria seizes the chance to organise a swimsuit contest, entering herself alongside Lisara, Mina and Quele, with predictable embarrassment for everyone involved. Feel produced it in 2013 after the 12-episode TV series, based on Pan Tachibana's light novels. It is a light extra for fans of the series and consists largely of nudity and sexual fanservice.

honobono-log.summary: Honobono Log is a set of very short, gentle vignettes about couples and families. Each episode shows small moments of everyday affection, such as partners comforting each other after a bad day, sudden hugs, playful teasing or quiet time together at home, without a continuing plot or named lead characters, and most last only a couple of minutes. The style is soft and warm, closer to an illustrated picture book than a typical anime. Fanworks produced the 10 short episodes, which aired over a couple of weeks in June 2016, adapted from a book of illustrations by the artist Naka Fukamachi.
honobono-log.notes: No Wikipedia article; facts from MAL and AniList.

is-infinite-stratos-world-purge-hen.summary: This single OVA episode is a side story to the second season of Infinite Stratos, the harem action comedy about Ichika Orimura, the only boy able to pilot the powered suits called IS, who attends an academy full of girl pilots. While Ichika is away visiting a research lab, an unknown attacker hacks into IS Academy's core systems and shuts them down. His sister Chifuyu sends Houki, Cecilia, Lingyin, Charlotte and Laura into the school's network through virtual reality to fight back, where a program called World Purge traps each girl inside her own ideal fantasy. It was released in November 2014, based on Izuru Yumizuru's light novels. It includes fanservice.

uzumaki.summary: Kurouzu-cho is a small, fog-covered coastal town where something is badly wrong. Teenager Kirie Goshima notices it first through her boyfriend Shuichi Saito's father, who has started staring for hours at snail shells and anything else with a spiral in it. Shuichi is convinced the town itself is cursed by the spiral shape, and as townspeople begin falling under its pull in stranger and stranger ways, he wants to take Kirie and leave. This four-episode miniseries adapts Junji Ito's horror manga, directed by Hiroshi Nagahama, and aired on Adult Swim's Toonami block from September to October 2024. It contains graphic body horror and disturbing imagery.

minami-ke-tadaima.summary: Minami-ke Tadaima returns to the three Minami sisters, who live together without their parents. Haruka, the eldest, is a gentle high school student who runs the household; Kana, the middle sister, is loud, energetic and constantly scheming; and Chiaki, the youngest, is deadpan, blunt and devoted to Haruka. Their friends and classmates drift in and out of daily life, from Fujioka, whose crush on Kana she mistakes for a rivalry, to Hosaka, who keeps trying to recruit Haruka into volleyball. Feel produced this fourth TV series in 2013, with 13 episodes based on Koharu Sakuraba's manga. Each episode is a low-key slice-of-life comedy with no overarching plot.

piano-no-mori.summary: Shuhei Amamiya, the son of a famous pianist, has trained in classical piano from a young age and hopes to follow his father. When his family moves from Tokyo to a country town, a classmate dares him to play an old piano abandoned in the forest, which is said to be cursed and to make no sound for anyone who touches it. There he meets Kai Ichinose, a rough boy from the poorer part of town who plays that piano freely, purely by ear, and the two form an unlikely friendship built around music. Madhouse released this feature film in 2007, based on Makoto Isshiki's manga.

karas.summary: In this version of Shinjuku, the human world and the hidden world of yokai, Japanese spirits, overlap, with demons walking unseen among people. Order between the two sides is kept by Yurine, a spirit who appears as a young woman, and her Karas, an armoured crow warrior who can transform into a car or an aircraft and fights with a sword. The latest Karas is Yosuke Otoha, a former yakuza, whose task is to stop his predecessor, Eko, from seizing control of Tokyo. Tatsunoko Production made the six-part OVA from 2005 to 2007 to mark its 40th anniversary, . It contains bloody violence.

maria-sama-ga-miteru.summary: At Lillian Girls' Academy, an old Catholic school in Tokyo, older students may choose a younger girl as their 'petite soeur', giving her a rosary and promising to look after her. Yumi Fukuzawa is a first-year who considers herself completely ordinary, so she is stunned when Sachiko Ogasawara, an elegant and admired second-year in the student council, suddenly takes an interest in her and asks her to become her soeur. The series follows the friendships, misunderstandings and quiet feelings among the student council members. Studio Deen adapted Oyuki Konno's light novels into 13 episodes in 2004, the first of several seasons.

gyo.summary: College student Kaori Sawahara heads to Okinawa for a seaside holiday with her friends Erika and Aki, but a horrible smell soon spreads across the island. Rotting fish begin crawling out of the sea on mechanical legs, followed by larger sea creatures, and whatever drives them can infect people too, turning a disgusting curiosity into a crisis for the whole island. As the invasion spreads, Kaori is caught up in it along with her boyfriend Tadashi. Ufotable adapted Junji Ito's horror manga into a single 2012 film, changing several characters, including adding Aki. It contains graphic body horror, gore and sexual content.

kidou-senkan-nadesico.summary: Earth is at war with alien invaders known as the Jovian Lizards. Akito Tenkawa, a young man who survived the destruction of a colony on Mars and somehow ended up on Earth with no memory of how, only wants to work as a cook, despite having grown up loving the robot anime Gekiganger 3. A chance meeting with Yurika Misumaru, the cheerful, airheaded young captain of the ship, leads him aboard her command, the Nadesico, a private battleship built by the Nergal company and crewed by eccentric civilians, where he is soon pushed into piloting a robot. Xebec produced the 26-episode original series from 1996 to 1997, directed by Tatsuo Sato, mixing comedy, romance and space war.

shiroi-suna-no-aquatope.summary: Fuka Miyazawa has just given up her place in a Tokyo idol group, and instead of going home she boards a flight to Okinawa. Wandering around Nanjo, she comes across Gama Gama, a small, ageing aquarium run with care by Kukuru Misakino, a high school girl who works there as deputy director and loves its sea creatures. The aquarium is losing money and is due to close, so Fuka takes a job there and the two try to keep it open. P.A. Works produced the 24-episode original series in 2021, with a gentle, character-focused tone.

escaflowne-a-girl-in-gaea.summary: This 2000 film retells The Vision of Escaflowne as a separate, darker story. Hitomi Kanzaki is a lonely, depressed Tokyo schoolgirl who wishes she could vanish. After falling out with her only friend, she is pulled into the world of Gaea and wakes inside Escaflowne, an ancient dragon-armour weapon said to come to life only for a prophesied 'wing goddess'. Gaea is being conquered by the Black Dragon Clan, and the rebels, among them Van, an angry young king bent on revenge, decide Hitomi must be that goddess. Bones animated the film for Sunrise, directed by Kazuki Akane. It contains war violence.

nogizaka-haruka-no-himitsu-purezza.summary: Purezza is the second season of Haruka Nogizaka's Secret. Haruka Nogizaka is the most admired girl at her school, rich, graceful and good at everything, but she secretly loves anime, manga and other otaku hobbies, something only her classmate Yuto Ayase knows. Yuto keeps her secret safe and helps her enjoy her hobbies, including drawing manga and going to fan events, but now another girl around him is developing feelings too, and a quiet tug-of-war of emotions begins in their circle of friends. Diomedea produced the 12 episodes from October to December 2009, based on Yusaku Igarashi's light novels. It is a light romantic comedy.

mobile-suit-gundam-0080-war-in-the-pocke.summary: Alfred 'Al' Izuruha is a ten-year-old living on Side 6, a neutral space colony far from the front lines of the Earth Federation's war with Zeon. Like many boys his age he thinks war is thrilling and collects anything military. He does not know that the Federation is secretly testing a new Gundam inside the colony, or that his kind neighbour Christina is involved. When a Zeon commando unit arrives to destroy it, Al befriends Bernie, a young rookie Zeon pilot. Sunrise released the six episodes in 1989 as the first Gundam OVA series, directed by Fumihiko Takayama. It is a smaller, character-focused war story.

appleseed-movie.summary: After a global war has left the world in ruins, Deunan Knute, one of its last surviving soldiers, is still fighting alone in the wasteland when she is rescued and taken to Olympus. The city looks like a utopia, where ordinary humans live alongside bioroids, genetically engineered people bred to be calm and unable to have children, but tensions are building beneath the surface. In Olympus Deunan is reunited with Briareos, her former partner and lover, whose body is now almost entirely cybernetic, and she learns she may hold the key to the city's future. Digital Frontier made the 2004 film, directed by Shinji Aramaki with motion-captured 3D animation and based on Masamune Shirow's manga. It contains action violence.

garo-vanishing-line.summary: Russell City is a booming American metropolis, but monsters called Horrors, born from human darkness, are hiding among its people and possessing them. Secretly fighting them is Sword, a huge, cheerful Makai Knight who carries the title of Garo, wears golden armour and rides a motorbike that transforms along with him. While hunting a Horror, he hears a strange phrase, 'El Dorado', and starts digging into what it means. He soon crosses paths with Sophie, a red-haired orphan teenager searching for her missing brother, whose disappearance seems linked to the same mystery. MAPPA produced this 24-episode original series from 2017 to 2018, the third Garo anime. It contains bloody action violence.

detective-conan-movie-13-the-raven-chase.summary: In the thirteenth Detective Conan film, the Black Organization, the criminal group that shrank high school detective Shinichi Kudo into the child Conan Edogawa, comes closer than ever to his secret. A series of murders across several prefectures has brought detectives from around the country together for a joint investigation, and Conan works out that a member of the Organization, the man known as Irish, has slipped into the police operation in disguise. If he learns who Conan really is, everyone close to him will be in danger. TMS Entertainment released the film in April 2009, based on Gosho Aoyama's manga. It includes murders and gunfights.

urasekai-picnic.summary: College student Sorawo Kamikoshi enjoys exploring abandoned places, and one day a strange door leads her into the Otherside, an eerie parallel world full of creatures straight out of internet ghost stories and urban legends. She nearly dies there, but is saved by Toriko Nishina, a confident young woman who handles guns well, knows the Otherside better than she does and is searching for a missing friend. The two start exploring it together, partly to find that friend and partly to sell the strange objects they bring back. Liden Films and Felix Film adapted Iori Miyazawa's novels into 12 episodes in 2021. It contains horror imagery and violence.

rock-lee-no-seishun-full-power-ninden.summary: This spin-off of Naruto puts the spotlight on Rock Lee, the ninja of the Hidden Leaf Village who cannot use ninjutsu or genjutsu and makes up for it with taijutsu, endless training and boundless enthusiasm. With his loud mentor Might Guy and teammates Neji Hyuga and Tenten, Lee throws himself into missions, training challenges and everyday mishaps, while Naruto and many other familiar characters drop by. Everything is drawn in a cute super-deformed style and played for comedy, without following the main story. Pierrot produced the 51 episodes from April 2012 to March 2013, based on Kenji Taira's spin-off manga.

seikai-no-monshou.summary: When Jinto Linn was a boy, his home planet was taken over by the Abh, a race of genetically engineered humans who rule a vast interstellar empire. His father agreed to hand the world over in exchange for a place among the Abh nobility, so Jinto has grown up being trained in Abh language and customs. Now a teenager, he is sent off to an Abh school and is assigned an escort, Lafiel, an Abh trainee pilot who turns out to be a princess. Their meeting comes just as the empire slides toward war with an alliance of human nations. Sunrise adapted Hiroyuki Morioka's novels into 13 episodes in 1999, a space opera with its own invented language and politics.

yumeiro-patissiere.summary: Fourteen-year-old Ichigo Amano is clumsy and has never been good at anything except eating cakes. During a chance meeting with the famous patissier Henri Lucas, he notices that she has an extraordinary sense of taste and invites her to transfer to St. Marie Academy, a school devoted to making sweets. Ichigo is far behind her classmates, but with the help of three talented boys known as the Sweets Princes and the tiny fairies called Sweets Spirits, she works hard toward becoming a real pastry chef. Studio Hibari adapted Natsumi Matsumoto's shojo manga into 50 episodes broadcast from 2009 to 2010.

digimon-savers.summary: Masaru Daimon is a fourteen-year-old who has never lost a street fight. When he runs into Agumon, a Digimon who has escaped from a secret government agency, the two settle things the only way they know, with their fists, and become friends. The agency, known as DATS (the Digital Accident Tactics Squad), exists to keep peace between the human world and the Digital World and to send stray Digimon back. Impressed by the pair, DATS recruits them alongside its own agents, Yoshino and her partner Lalamon. Toei Animation produced the 48-episode series from 2006 to 2007. It was the fifth Digimon TV series.

otome-wa-boku-ni-koishiteru.summary: Mizuho Miyanokouji is a soft-spoken, very androgynous high school boy, and his late grandfather's will contains a strange request: Mizuho must transfer to the girls' school his mother once attended. With help from his childhood friend Mariya, he gets a full makeover and passes as a girl so well that no one suspects a thing. Soon the gentle and capable new student is admired by the whole school, which only makes keeping his secret harder. Feel adapted the visual novel by Caramel Box into 12 episodes broadcast from October to December 2006. It is a light romantic comedy.

detective-conan-movie-03-the-last-wizard.summary: The phantom thief Kaito Kid sends the police a notice that he will steal a newly discovered Faberge egg made for the Russian imperial family, soon to be displayed at a museum in Osaka. Conan Edogawa, the high school detective trapped in a child's body, joins the chase with Osaka's own teenage detective Heiji Hattori, but Kid is not the only one after the jewelled egg, and the hunt turns deadly as a string of murders follows it. Released in April 1999 by TMS Entertainment and directed by Kenji Kodama, it is the third Detective Conan film and the first to feature Kid, Heiji and Ai Haibara. It includes murders.

bakugan-battle-brawlers.summary: One day strange cards fall from the sky all over the world. Dan and his best friend Shun turn them into a battle game called Bakugan, played with cards and small ball-shaped creatures, and it becomes a craze among kids. Dan forms a team, the Bakugan Battle Brawlers, with friends he meets online, but the game turns out to be tied to Vestroia, the Bakugan's real home, which has been thrown off balance, and Dan's partner, the dragon Drago, is very much alive. TMS Entertainment and Japan Vistec produced the 52 episodes, directed by Mitsuo Hashimoto, as a Japanese-Canadian co-production that aired in Japan from 2007 to 2008.

letter-bee-reverse.summary: Letter Bee Reverse is the second season of Tegami Bachi and picks up right after the first. Its setting is AmberGround, a land of endless night lit only in places by an artificial sun, where Letter Bees deliver mail across dangerous country full of giant armoured insects. Lag Seeing, a young Bee who can see the memories held in letters and people, has learned unsettling things about the group called Reverse and about his missing hero, but he is ordered to keep quiet and is sent back out on the road with his partner Niche. Pierrot+ produced the 25 episodes from 2010 to 2011, adapting Hiroyuki Asada's manga.

terra-formars-revenge.summary: Terra Formars Revenge is the second season of the science fiction action series. Centuries ago, cockroaches were sent to Mars to help make it habitable, and they evolved into huge, powerful humanoids known as Terraformars. The crew of the spaceship Annex I, soldiers surgically given the abilities of insects and other animals, is on Mars searching for a cure for a deadly virus on Earth. Now they must fight not only the Terraformars but also each other, since several national squads are pursuing their own countries' secret goals. Liden Films and TYO Animations produced the 13 episodes in 2016, based on the manga by Yu Sasuga and Kenichi Tachibana. It contains extremely graphic violence.

senyuu-2.summary: The second season of Senyu continues its parody of fantasy quests. A hole has opened in the world and monsters are pouring out, which means the demon lord Rukimedes is due to return, so the kingdom has sent out a steady stream of heroes. Hero number 45, Alba Fruhling, is a decent young man and the show's straight man, and his travelling companion, the royal soldier Ross, spends most of his energy tormenting him. With Ross now stranded in a space between worlds thanks to a magic spell, the pair's adventure goes even further off track. Ordet and Liden Films produced the 13 short episodes in 2013, based on Robinson Haruhara's web manga.

slayers-next.summary: Slayers Next is the second season of the comic fantasy adventure. Lina Inverse, a teenage sorceress famous for her greed, her appetite and her habit of blowing things up, travels with Gourry Gabriev, a skilled but dim-witted swordsman. In the kingdom of Xoana they run into old companions, the brooding Zelgadis Graywords and Amelia, an enthusiastic, justice-loving princess, and soon the group is searching for a legendary magical text called the Claire Bible. A smiling, secretive priest named Xellos also starts turning up along the way. E&G Films produced the 26 episodes in 1996, adapting Hajime Kanzaka's light novels.

fairy-tail-ova-2016.summary: These three short OVA episodes were bundled with special editions of Hiro Mashima's Fairy Tail manga in 2016, and each is a standalone comedy for fans of the guild of wizards. In the first, the guild finally settles a bet left over from the Grand Magic Games: Teams A and B decide the winner with a game of rock-paper-scissors, and the victors get to order the losers around for a day. In the second, Natsu and Erza try to cheer up Mavis, the guild's founder, who has been feeling low. The third is a Christmas party thrown by Lucy for her friends. A-1 Pictures animated all three.
fairy-tail-ova-2016.notes: Episode contents from MAL/AniList descriptions; Wikipedia TV article confirms only the studio and franchise.

major-s5.summary: The fifth season of Major follows Goro Honda, the stubborn, fiercely competitive pitcher whose life the series has followed since early childhood. After a season playing in America, Goro returns to Japan and learns from his childhood friend Toshiya that a Baseball World Cup will soon be held in the United States. Goro badly wants to represent Japan, but the squad has already been chosen without him, so he talks his way in as a practice pitcher, determined to prove to the manager that he belongs on the team. SynergySP produced the 25 episodes in 2009, based on Takuya Mitsuda's manga. It builds on the earlier seasons.

genshiken-ova.summary: The three Genshiken OVA episodes continue the life of the Society for the Study of Modern Visual Culture, a small university club of otaku who spend their time on anime, manga, games and cosplay. A new academic year means recruiting new members, never the club's strong point, and this time they end up with Chika Ogiue, a sharp-tongued first-year from the Manga Club whose first words to them are that she hates otaku, even though she clearly shares many of their interests. Ajia-do produced the episodes from 2006 to 2007, based on Shimoku Kio's manga. They follow the first TV series.

star-vs-the-forces-of-evil-season-2.summary: This is the second season of Star vs. the Forces of Evil, an American animated magical girl series created by Daron Nefcy for Disney. Star Butterfly, the reckless teenage princess and heir to the throne of the magical kingdom of Mewni, has been sent to Earth to calm down and lives as an exchange student with the family of her best friend, Marco Diaz, in the Earth town of Echo Creek. The two keep travelling to other dimensions with a pair of dimensional scissors while dealing with school, crushes and monsters from Mewni. The second season premiered on Disney XD in July 2016. It is a Western cartoon rather than anime.
star-vs-the-forces-of-evil-season-2.notes: No MyAnimeList or AniList entry (American series). Season-specific plot is not described by Kitsu; summary uses the series premise from Wikipedia and the season premiere date from Wikipedia and Kitsu.

code-geass-akito-the-exiled-5-to-those-w.summary: To Beloved Ones is the fifth and last film of Code Geass: Akito the Exiled, a side story set in Europe during the Code Geass war, where the Europa United's W-0 unit sends young Japanese pilot Akito Hyuga and his comrades into battle against the Holy Britannian Empire. Following the fourth film, the remaining Knights of St. Michael regroup for one last attack on Castle Weisswolf, while W-0 and its new ally Ashley Ashra prepare to meet them, and Akito's brother Shin, whose Geass has grown out of control, makes his own move. Sunrise released it in February 2016, directed by Kazuki Akane. It contains war violence and should be watched after the previous four films.

kiba.summary: Zed is a fifteen-year-old living in a city called Calm, restless and convinced there is a fuller life somewhere else. Swept away on the wind, he lands in a war-torn world where magic users called Shard Casters fight with marble-like stones known as Shards, which let them cast spells and summon creatures called Spirits. Zed becomes bound to Amir Gaul, a wild and dangerous Spirit, while his friend Noah, back in Calm, has his own path into this world. Madhouse produced the 51-episode original series from 2006 to 2007, directed by Hiroshi Kojina. It contains violence and dark themes.

naruto-shippuden-jump-super-anime-tour-2.summary: Sunny Side Battle is a short comedy special made for the Jump Super Anime Tour in 2013. In their childhood home, before the tragedies of the main story, Itachi Uchiha decides one morning that he must cook his little brother Sasuke the perfect fried egg. The famously calm and brilliant ninja treats the task with complete seriousness and keeps failing, while Sasuke watches his brother's odd behaviour with growing confusion, gradually realising there may be more going on than breakfast. Studio Pierrot animated the special, based on Masashi Kishimoto's Naruto. It is a light gag piece for fans who already know the brothers.
naruto-shippuden-jump-super-anime-tour-2.notes: Plot from MAL/Kitsu synopsis only; AniList confirms the tour special but not its content. No Wikipedia coverage of the special.

major-s2.summary: The second season of Major jumps ahead a few years. Goro Honda, the baseball-mad boy from the first season, is now in junior high and returns to his old home town, where he joins Mifune East Junior High and reunites with old friends as if he had never left. He still wants nothing more than to pitch, but an injury from his time away gets in the way, and he has to deal with the harsher side of the sport while building a team worth playing on. Studio Hibari produced the 26 episodes, broadcast on NHK from 2005 to 2006, based on Takuya Mitsuda's long-running manga.

nozoki-ana.summary: Tatsuhiko Kido moves to Tokyo to study at an art school, and finds a tiny hole in one wall of his new apartment. Looking through it one night, he sees his next-door neighbour, Emiru Ikuno, in a private moment, and she sees him too. When he goes round to explain, he trips and lands on top of her, and Emiru takes a photo of them that she promises to delete only if he leaves the hole alone and lets her watch him through it in return. Studio Fantasia made this one-episode OVA, released in February 2013 bundled with a limited edition of the last volume of Wakoh Honna's manga. It contains explicit sexual content and nudity.

ikkitousen-dragon-destiny.summary: Dragon Destiny is the second season of Ikki Tousen, a fighting series loosely based on the Chinese classic Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Students at rival high schools in Kanto carry magatama beads that bind them to the spirits of ancient warriors, and they battle for control of the region. Hakufu Sonsaku, a cheerful, carefree fighter at Nanyo Academy, is caught up in the conflict again as the leaders of Kyosho and Seito Academies awaken their inner dragons and a mysterious dragon orb surfaces in China. Arms produced the 12 episodes, broadcast in 2007 and based on Yuji Shiozaki's manga. It contains heavy fanservice, nudity and violence.

Chainsaw-Man--The-Movie-Reze-Arc.summary: This film continues straight from the first season of the Chainsaw Man TV anime. Denji, a teenager with a devil's heart who can turn into the chainsaw-wielding Chainsaw Man and now hunts devils for Public Safety, is still settling into his new life when Makima, the superior he has a crush on, takes him on a date. Soon after, sheltering from a sudden downpour, he meets Reze, a friendly girl who works at a cafe, and his heart is thrown into confusion. MAPPA produced the film, directed by Tatsuya Yoshihara and written by Hiroshi Seko, and Toho released it in Japan in September 2025. It adapts Tatsuki Fujimoto's manga and contains graphic, bloody violence.

lupin-iii-part-iv.summary: Lupin the Third Part IV takes the gentleman thief to Italy and San Marino, now wearing a blue jacket. The series opens with a surprise: Lupin has married Rebecca Rossellini, a celebrated young heiress who runs her own businesses, to the astonishment of his partners Jigen and Goemon and of Fujiko. Inspector Zenigata of Interpol is, as ever, still determined to catch him, and most episodes are built around heists across Italy. This fifth Lupin TV series was made by Telecom Animation Film; it premiered on Italian television in August 2015, two months before its 24-episode Japanese broadcast began.
lupin-iii-part-iv.notes: The wedding premise is from AniList's description; MAL lists Rebecca Rossellini as a main character but its synopsis does not mention the marriage.

sekai-de-ichiban-tsuyoku-naritai.summary: Sakura Hagiwara is a member of the popular idol group Sweet Diva, along with her friend and rival Elena Miyazawa. During a TV shoot, Elena casually claims that pro wrestling is easy, and the wrestler Rio Kazama answers by beating her up in the ring. Furious, Sakura decides to avenge her friend the hard way: she joins a women's pro wrestling team, the Berserk Wrestlers, and starts training to beat Rio herself, learning quickly that the sport is anything but easy. Arms adapted the manga by ESE and Kiyohito Natsuki into 12 episodes broadcast from October to December 2013. It contains frequent fanservice.

persona-4-the-animation-no-one-is-alone.summary: No One is Alone is a bonus episode of Persona 4 the Animation that was included with the tenth Blu-ray volume of the TV series in 2012. Persona 4 follows Yu Narukami, a high school student who spends a year in the small town of Inaba and, with his friends, investigates a string of mysterious murders using Personas, physical forms of their inner selves. According to its release notes, this extra episode adapts the true ending of the original PlayStation 2 game. AIC ASTA produced it, based on Atlus's role-playing game. It is meant only for viewers who have finished the series, since it depends on its final arc.
persona-4-the-animation-no-one-is-alone.notes: Content description from MAL and AniList (both: adapts the game's true ending); kept non-specific to avoid spoilers. Series premise from Wikipedia's Persona 4 article.

sonic-x.summary: Sonic the Hedgehog interrupts Dr. Eggman just as the villain has gathered all seven Chaos Emeralds, and the resulting blast of Chaos Control flings Sonic, his friends and Eggman himself out of their own world and onto Earth. Separated from the others, Sonic is helped by Chris Thorndyke, a lonely twelve-year-old boy, who joins the search for Tails, Knuckles, Amy and the rest, while Eggman sets up a base and resumes his schemes. TMS Entertainment produced the series with Sonic Team, directed by Hajime Kamegaki. 52 episodes aired in Japan from 2003 to 2004, and 26 more were first broadcast abroad.
sonic-x.notes: MAL counts all 78 episodes; AniList lists the 52 Japanese-broadcast episodes.

akebi-chan-no-sailor-fuku.summary: Komichi Akebi has loved sailor uniforms since she was little, and when she wins a place at Robai Academy, the private girls' school her mother once attended, her mother sews her one by hand to wear there. On her first day, Komichi discovers that the school switched to blazers years ago, so she is the only student in a sailor uniform. She wears it anyway, and her bright, open nature soon wins over her new classmates as she throws herself into club activities and new friendships. CloverWorks adapted Hiro's manga into 12 episodes in 2022, a gentle slice-of-life series.

keroro-gunsou.summary: Sergeant Keroro is the leader of an advance platoon from the planet Keron, sent to prepare an invasion of Pekopon, their name for Earth. Unfortunately for him, he is quickly caught by Fuyuki Hinata and his tough older sister Natsumi, and after his army pulls out and leaves him behind he ends up living in their house, doing the chores and spending his free time building Gundam model kits. His scattered squad members gradually turn up, each with their own scheme. Sunrise adapted Mine Yoshizaki's manga into 358 episodes from 2004 to 2011, a long-running comedy full of parodies of anime and pop culture.

mahou-shoujo-tokushusen-asuka.summary: Three years ago, monstrous invaders called the Disas attacked Earth from another dimension, and ordinary weapons could not stop them. Spirits from another world allied with humanity and gave certain girls the power to become magical girls, and the survivors of the war became famous as the Magical Five. Now the team has split up. Its former leader, Asuka Otori, has retired to live as an ordinary high school student, while the others continue in military service. But remnants of the enemy remain, and Asuka is pulled back into combat with a new squad. Liden Films adapted Makoto Fukami and Seigo Tokiya's manga into 12 episodes in 2019. It contains graphic violence and torture.

phantasy-star-online-2-the-animation.summary: In 2027, the online game Phantasy Star Online 2 has become a craze at Seiga Academy, and the school is reviewing whether it is hurting students' grades. Itsuki Tachibana is a well-rounded student who has never played video games, which makes him the perfect test subject for Rina Izumi, the strict student council president who wants to prove the game is harmless. She appoints him vice president and orders him to play while keeping his grades up and reporting back to her every day. Telecom Animation Film produced the 12 episodes, which aired from January to March 2016, based on Sega's online role-playing game.
