zoids.summary: On the desert planet Zi, people and armies use Zoids, giant animal-shaped fighting machines. Van Flyheight, a teenage boy, stumbles into an abandoned facility where he finds a mysterious girl, Fiona, who remembers nothing about herself, and a small dragon-like living Zoid called an Organoid, which he names Zeke. Zeke can merge with other Zoids to make them far stronger, and Van sets out with Fiona to uncover the secrets of her past, only to be caught up when war breaks out again between the Helic Republic and the Guylos Empire. Xebec produced the 67 episodes from 1999 to 2000, the first anime based on TOMY's Zoids model kits.

release-the-spyce.summary: Momo Minamoto is a shy high school girl in Sorasaki City who dreams of protecting people like her police officer father, and she has unusually sharp senses and a talent for deduction. Those abilities catch the eye of Tsukikage, a secret group of teenage girl spies who protect the city from crime syndicates while posing as an ordinary information agency. Recruited into the group, Momo trains under the senior member Yuki Hanzomon, learning to fight and to use specially prepared spices that boost the spies' abilities. Lay-duce produced the 12-episode original series in 2018, with characters designed by Namori. It contains action violence.

gantz-o.summary: Masaru Kato, a kind high school student, is killed in a subway while trying to stop a knife attack. Instead of an afterlife, he wakes up in a Tokyo apartment with a group of strangers and a large black sphere called Gantz, which gives them skin-tight power suits and weapons. Before Kato can make sense of it, the group is teleported to Osaka, which has been overrun by grotesque monsters drawn from Japanese folklore, and the group has a strict time limit to kill every monster in the city or die themselves. Digital Frontier made the fully 3D CG film, released in Japan in October 2016 and based on Hiroya Oku's manga. It contains extreme gore, nudity and sexual content.

recorder-to-randoseru-do.summary: Atsushi Miyagawa is an eleven-year-old schoolboy who looks like a tall adult man, which constantly gets him mistaken for a suspicious grown-up, even when he is just walking to school with his randoseru backpack. Atsumi, his sister, is seventeen and has the opposite problem: she is so small that everyone treats her like a child, even though she is the one looking after him. The short episodes play on the siblings' mismatched looks, the misunderstandings they cause and their friends' reactions. Seven produced the 13 short episodes in early 2012, the first of its seasons, adapting Meme Higashiya's four-panel manga.

vivid-strike.summary: Fuuka Reventon and Rinne Berlinetta grew up together in the same orphanage and were once close, until a quarrel ended with Rinne beating Fuuka badly and the two going separate ways. Since then Fuuka has lived in poverty, getting into fights just to get by. After a run-in with thugs, she is found by Einhart Stratos, a champion of the competitive martial art Strike Arts, who sees real talent in her and offers to train her. Meanwhile Rinne has become a ferocious, merciless fighter at the top of the sport. Seven Arcs Pictures produced this 12-episode spin-off of Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha ViVid in 2016. It contains intense fight violence.

heya-camp.summary: Room Camp is a short side series to Laid-Back Camp, centred on the Outdoor Activities Club of Motosu High School in Yamanashi Prefecture, whose three members, Nadeshiko Kagamihara, Chiaki Ogaki and Aoi Inuyama, usually meet in a corner of a classroom. When the girls start arguing about what makes someone a true Yamanashi local, Chiaki brings up a children's stamp rally that sends visitors to famous spots around the prefecture, and the club sets off to complete it, with plenty of local sightseeing and food along the way. C-Station produced the 12 short episodes, aired from January to March 2020 and directed by Masato Jinbo, based on Afro's manga.

one-piece-episode-of-chopper-plus-fuyu-n.summary: The ninth One Piece film retells the Drum Island story from the TV series with new animation and a reshuffled cast. When navigator Nami falls dangerously ill at sea, Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates land on a snowy island where the only remaining doctor, the eccentric Dr. Kureha, lives on a mountain summit. Luffy and Sanji carry Nami up to her and meet Tony Tony Chopper, a reindeer who can talk and walk like a human, just as the island's tyrannical former ruler, Wapol, returns. Unlike the original arc, the crew includes Robin and Franky and sails the Thousand Sunny. Toei Animation released it in March 2008, based on Eiichiro Oda's manga.
one-piece-episode-of-chopper-plus-fuyu-n.notes: Retelling of an existing arc, not a compilation: it has new animation and a new character (Wapol's brother).

hakumei-to-mikochi.summary: In a forest world where people stand only a few centimetres tall and share their lives with talking animals, two young women share a home inside a tree. Hakumei is a tomboyish, energetic handywoman who takes on all kinds of building and repair jobs, and Mikochi is a calm, refined homebody known for her cooking. The series follows their everyday routines, odd jobs, trips to town and small adventures, riding on birds and bugs and getting to know the other residents of their little world. Lerche adapted Takuto Kashiki's manga into 12 episodes broadcast from January to March 2018, with a relaxed, gentle pace.

detective-conan-movie-01-the-timed-skysc.summary: In the first Detective Conan film, Ran Mori asks Shinichi Kudo to see a movie with her on his birthday, which is a problem, because Shinichi has been shrunk into the child Conan Edogawa and cannot show up as himself. Before the day arrives, a large quantity of explosives is stolen, and a bomber calls with a personal challenge for Shinichi: find the bombs hidden around the city before they go off. Following the caller's clues, Conan races from one target to the next as the threat grows larger. TMS Entertainment released the film in April 1997, directed by Kenji Kodama and based on Gosho Aoyama's manga.

magic-knight-rayearth.summary: Three middle school girls who have never met, the spirited Hikaru Shido, the proud Umi Ryuzaki and the gentle Fuu Hououji, are visiting Tokyo Tower on separate school trips when a flash of light carries them into another world called Cephiro. There the wizard Clef tells them they were called there to become the fabled Magic Knights, and their task is to rescue Princess Emeraude, the Pillar whose prayers hold Cephiro together, from the high priest Zagato. Only then can they go home. Tokyo Movie Shinsha adapted CLAMP's manga into this 20-episode first season from 1994 to 1995, mixing magical girl adventure with sword fights and giant robot-like Rune-Gods.

honzuki-no-gekokujou-shisho-ni-naru-tame.summary: The third season of Ascendance of a Bookworm continues the story of Myne, a book-loving young woman from modern Japan reborn as a sickly girl in a world where books are rare luxuries. Now an apprentice shrine maiden at the temple, she has shown far more mana than anyone expected in front of the Knights' Order, and that has drawn the attention of nobles who would like to use her. The High Priest has her stay at the temple through the winter for her own protection, but Myne is still focused on spreading books, printing and new inventions. Ajia-do produced the 10 episodes in 2022, adapting Miya Kazuki's light novels. Watch after season two.

tayutama-kiss-on-my-deity.summary: Yuri Mito is a high school student whose family runs the local Shinto shrine. While helping with a ritual to move an old relic that seals away supernatural beings called the Tayutai, Yuri and his friends accidentally set them loose, and a goddess appears in the form of a young girl, Mashiro, who promptly announces that she is going to be his bride. Yuri now has to deal with spirits causing trouble around town as well as Mashiro's devotion and his childhood friends' reactions to it. Silver Link adapted Lump of Sugar's visual novel into 12 episodes broadcast from April to June 2009. It is a light romantic comedy.

kenka-banchou-otome-girl-beats-boys.summary: Hinako Nakayama has grown up an orphan in state care, never knowing her family. Just before she starts high school, a boy named Hikaru appears and tells her he is her twin brother, the son of a yakuza family, and he has an outrageous request: she must take his place at Shishiku Academy, a boys' school full of Japan's toughest delinquents, disguised as him, and fight her way to the top. Luckily, Hinako can throw a serious punch. Project No.9 and A-Real produced the 12 short episodes in 2017, adapted from the PlayStation Vita otome game of the same name. It includes comic fight violence.

sekkou-boys.summary: Miki Ishimoto, a fresh art school graduate, starts her first job at an entertainment agency and is immediately made manager of a new idol group. The catch is that the group consists of four plaster busts of the kind used in art classes: the noble Saint Giorgio, the arrogant Medici, the handsome Hermes and the romantic war god Mars. They can talk and have big personalities, but they cannot move, which makes concerts, photo shoots and variety show appearances unusually difficult. Liden Films produced the 12 short episodes, aired from January to March 2016, as an original comedy parodying the idol business.

air-gear-kuro-no-hane-to-nemuri-no-mori-.summary: Air Gear follows Itsuki 'Ikki' Minami, a reckless teenager who throws himself into the street sport of Air Treck, motorised inline skates used for racing, tricks and territorial battles between teams, and who leads his own team, Kogarasumaru. Break on the Sky is a three-episode OVA that picks up material the original TV series never reached, released alongside limited editions of the manga. The episodes adapt later arcs, including Ikki's clash with his childhood friend Ringo and a battle between Kogarasumaru and the elite team Sleeping Forest. Satelight produced the OVAs from 2010 to 2011, directed by Shinji Ishihira. They include action violence and fanservice.
air-gear-kuro-no-hane-to-nemuri-no-mori-.notes: Episode contents (Ikki vs Ringo; Kogarasumaru vs Sleeping Forest) from MAL/AniList only; release details from Wikipedia.

digimon-adventure-tri-2-ketsui.summary: Determination is the second of six films in Digimon Adventure tri., which reunites the original Chosen Children as high schoolers several years after the first two Digimon TV series. Infected Digimon, which suddenly turn violent and grow stronger, keep breaking into the real world while government agents look into them. The group takes a break at a hot spring theme park with their new friend Meiko Mochizuki and her partner Meicoomon, but Joe stays home to study for exams and Mimi clashes with the others over her forthright ideas, until another infected Digimon attacks Odaiba. Toei Animation released it in March 2016. It follows the first film directly.

shijou-saikyou-no-deshi-kenichi-ova.summary: Kenichi Shirahama is a timid high school student who decides he wants to become strong enough to protect himself and others. His classmate Miu Furinji introduces him to Ryozanpaku, a legendary dojo whose six eccentric masters put him through brutal training in several martial arts at once. This 11-episode OVA series, titled The Attack of Darkness, was released between 2012 and 2014 with volumes of Syun Matsuena's manga and continues the story beyond the 2006 TV series, as Kenichi and Miu come up against Yami, a rival organisation of martial artists willing to kill. Brain's Base produced it. It contains martial arts violence and fanservice.
shijou-saikyou-no-deshi-kenichi-ova.notes: MAL/AniList note only the manga bundling; studio, title, dates and recast from Wikipedia. Focus on Yami inferred from Wikipedia's plot summary and the OVA title.

little-busters-ex.summary: Little Busters! EX is a set of eight extra episodes for the Little Busters! anime, released between January and July 2014. They adapt new story routes from Little Busters! Ecstasy, an expanded version of Key's visual novel, centred on three girls who had smaller roles before: Kanata Futaki, Sasami Sasasegawa and Saya Tokido. In Saya's story, Riki Naoe meets a mysterious girl on a school rooftop who may need his help or may be trying to kill him, which draws him into a strange mystery tied to his own past. J.C.Staff produced the episodes. They are set around the events of the second TV season, Refrain, so they are best watched after it.

persona-3-the-movie-3-falling-down.summary: Falling Down is the third of four films adapting the Persona 3 video game. As autumn arrives, Makoto Yuki and the other members of SEES, a school club that secretly fights monsters called Shadows during the hidden Dark Hour, believe they are close to finishing their battle. Then their friend Junpei is kidnapped by Chidori, a member of the rival group Strega, and soon afterwards a charming, flirtatious transfer student, Ryoji Mochizuki, joins Makoto's class. A-1 Pictures produced the film, directed by Keitaro Motonaga and released in Japan in April 2015. It follows the previous film directly and contains violence and emotionally heavy scenes.

jikan-no-shihaisha.summary: Whenever someone longs to rewind time, monsters called Horologues appear and feed on human time. The Chronos Rulers are fighters who battle them using powers that manipulate time. Koyuki Honda, a girl about to graduate with no family left after her older brother died, runs into two Chronos Rulers, the brothers Victo and Kiri, while visiting his grave. Victo looks far younger than his 39 years because of a deal he once made with a Horologue, and the encounter pulls Koyuki into their world. Project No.9 adapted Ponjea's Taiwanese manhua into 13 episodes broadcast from July to September 2017. It contains action violence.

inukami.summary: Keita Kawahira comes from a family that has bonded with inukami, dog spirits who serve as partners, for generations, but he is lazy, easily distracted by girls and was written off by the clan as a failure. Then an inukami named Yoko appears and agrees to become his partner. She is graceful and beautiful, but she is also jealous, mischievous and known for being impossible to control, and Keita soon learns why no one else would take her on. Together they take on jobs dealing with troublesome spirits. Seven Arcs adapted Mamizu Arisawa's light novels into 26 episodes in 2006, a slapstick comedy with frequent fanservice and sexual humour.

nobunaga-concerto.summary: Saburo is a carefree high school student with no interest in Japanese history. Suddenly thrown back in time, he finds himself in the Sengoku period face to face with Nobunaga Oda, the future warlord, who looks exactly like him. The real Nobunaga is sickly, tired of the burden placed on him, and asks Saburo to take his place. Saburo agrees, and armed with nothing but a modern teenager's attitude and a vague memory of history lessons, he starts living as one of the most famous figures in Japanese history. Fuji TV produced the 10-episode adaptation of Ayumi Ishii's manga, broadcast from July to September 2014. It contains war violence.

cheating-craft.summary: In this world, university entrance exams decide everything, and the exam hall has become a battlefield. Students fall into two camps: L, or Learning, types, who study hard to pass honestly, and C, or Cheating, types, who skip the studying and invent ever more elaborate ways to cheat without being caught by the invigilators. The short episodes follow students on both sides as they compete, scheme and sometimes team up during exams, treating cheating techniques like martial arts moves. Blade animated the 12-episode Chinese-Japanese series, based on Gemini Xin Luo's Chinese novel, and it aired alongside To Be Hero from October to December 2016.

shinmai-maou-no-testament-burst-ova.summary: This single OVA episode came packaged with volume seven of the Testament of Sister New Devil manga in January 2016, following the Burst season. The series follows Basara Toujou, a high school boy whose new stepsisters, Mio and Maria, turn out to be a demon lord's heir and a succubus. Here Maria decides that Mio's birthday is the perfect excuse to push her and Basara closer together, and she uses a lust spell to set up a romantic celebration, which goes about as subtly as might be expected. Production IMS produced it, based on Tetsuto Uesu's light novels. It consists largely of sexual situations and nudity.
shinmai-maou-no-testament-burst-ova.notes: Plot (birthday, lust spell) from AniList's description only; MAL notes only the bundling. Release date confirmed by MAL and Wikipedia.

100-man-no-inochi-no-ue-ni-ore-wa-tattei.summary: The second season of I'm Standing on a Million Lives picks up with Yusuke Yotsuya, an antisocial, selfish high schooler, and his companions once again summoned into a game-like fantasy world by a mysterious Game Master. There they must complete quests against strict time limits or face the consequences. This time a new member, Keita Torii, joins the team, and after reuniting with their ally Kahabell they set out on a new quest that takes them deeper into the world and its conflicts. Maho Film produced the 12 episodes, broadcast between July and September 2021, based on Naoki Yamakawa and Akinari Nao's manga. It contains violence.

ninja-slayer-from-animation.summary: In the cyberpunk megacity of Neo-Saitama, salaryman Kenji Fujikido loses his wife and child when they are caught in a turf war between ninja. Near death himself, he is possessed by a mysterious ninja soul called Naraku Ninja and returns as Ninja Slayer, a masked avenger who vows to kill every evil ninja he can find. The source is a series of novels credited to the supposed American writers Bradley Bond and Philip Ninj@ Morzez and translated into Japanese, and the anime keeps their over-the-top tone. Trigger produced the 26 web episodes in 2015, directed by Akira Amemiya. It contains bloody violence.

fudanshi-koukou-seikatsu.summary: Ryo Sakaguchi seems like an ordinary high school boy, but he is a fudanshi, a boy who loves boys' love manga, and he cannot stop imagining romantic storylines between the guys around him. His dearest wish is to find friends who understand this hobby. The short episodes follow his everyday school life as he gradually discovers that more people than he expected share his interest, and that his classmates react in all sorts of ways. Each episode lasts only a few minutes and plays his runaway imagination for laughs. EMT Squared adapted Atami Michinoku's four-panel manga into 12 short episodes in 2016, a light comedy about fandom.
fudanshi-koukou-seikatsu.notes: No Wikipedia article; facts from MAL and AniList.

cheer-danshi.summary: Haruki Bando grew up in a family that runs a judo dojo, but he never truly enjoyed the sport, and after injuring his shoulder in his first year at university he quietly gives it up. To his surprise, his childhood friend Kazuma Hashimoto walks away from the judo club too, and invites Haruki to help him start something new: Breakers, an all-male cheerleading team. Together they set about recruiting an unusual bunch of members and learning stunts from scratch, while Haruki slowly finds a sport he actually wants to do. Brain's Base adapted Ryo Asai's novel into 12 episodes broadcast in 2016.

tamayura-hitotose.summary: Fu Sawatari loved taking photographs with her father, but after he died she found it too painful to look at them. Now ready to start high school, she moves with her mother and younger brother to Takehara in Hiroshima, the seaside town where her father grew up and where they used to visit together. Carrying his old film camera, Fu makes friends with three girls, Kaoru, Norie and Maon, and slowly finds her way back to photography and to happiness. TYO Animations produced the 12-episode series in 2011, created and directed by Junichi Sato and following the original Tamayura OVAs. It is a quiet, gentle slice-of-life story.

accel-world-infinite-burst.summary: Infinite Burst is a 2016 film set some time after the Accel World TV series. Haruyuki Arita, a bullied boy who became a skilled player of Brain Burst, a program that speeds up the mind until time seems to stand still, is fighting alongside Kuroyukihime and their legion, Nega Nebulus. During a territory battle, a destructive in-game storm throws Haruyuki and his friends out of the program, while security cameras across Tokyo begin to malfunction. Suspecting the two are connected, Kuroyukihime sets out to unite the rival legions to find the source and restore their ability to accelerate. Sunrise produced the film from an original story by Reki Kawahara.

kino-no-tabi-the-beautiful-world-byouki-.summary: Kino is a young traveller who rides from country to country on a talking motorcycle named Hermes, staying only three days in each place and observing its customs without judging them. In this roughly 30-minute film, the pair arrive at a gleaming, spotless nation built inside a mountain under an artificial sky, a place obsessed with health and strict hygiene, while the farmland outside lies abandoned and empty. Everything seems perfect, but Kino notices a faint smell in the air and that no birds fly overhead. Shaft produced the film, released in April 2007, adapting a story from Keiichi Sigsawa's light novels. It has a quiet, melancholy tone.

cheat-kusushi-no-slow-life-isekai-ni-tsu.summary: Reiji Kirio worked himself to exhaustion as a corporate employee until, one ordinary morning, he found himself in a forest in another world. His only skills there are Appraise and Drug Discovery, which do not sound impressive, but they let him identify plants and create remarkably effective medicines. Reiji decides to settle down and open a drugstore, helped by Noela, a loyal, childlike werewolf girl, and Mina, a gentle ghost who haunts the shop's house, and soon townspeople and adventurers come to rely on his remedies. EMT Squared adapted Kennoji's light novels into 12 episodes broadcast from July to September 2021, a relaxed slice-of-life fantasy.

cupid-s-chocolates.summary: Jiang Haoyi is an ordinary first-year high school student who prefers to stay out of trouble. One day, a group of girls he has never met surround him and all confess their love at once, causing an uproar in front of the whole school. Just as things get out of hand, time stops, and a young girl in an elaborate dress floats down from the sky, introducing herself as the god of love and offering an explanation for the chaos. What follows is a harem romantic comedy. B.CMAY Pictures produced the 15-episode Chinese web series from 2015 to 2016, based on Vivian Tianzong's web comic.
cupid-s-chocolates.notes: No Wikipedia article. Premise from MAL and AniList; the 'god of love' detail is from AniList's AniDB-sourced description only.

gintama-jump-festa-2005-special.summary: This short Gintama special was made by Sunrise for the Jump Festa Anime Tour in 2005, before the TV series began. Gintama is set in an Edo-period Japan taken over by aliens, where swords are banned and the lazy, sugar-loving former samurai Gintoki Sakata scrapes a living doing odd jobs with his broke sidekicks Shinpachi and Kagura. In this special, the trio are out viewing the spring cherry blossoms when the Shinsengumi police turn up and claim the same spot, and the two groups settle the dispute with an absurd contest. It is a standalone comedy based on Hideaki Sorachi's manga.
gintama-jump-festa-2005-special.notes: Plot from AniList only; MAL's synopsis is a general series premise. Production for Jump Festa confirmed by Wikipedia and MAL.

servamp-specials.summary: These short specials were included with the Blu-ray and DVD volumes of the Servamp TV series. Servamp is about vampires who serve human masters, called Eves, through a blood bond, and centres on Mahiru and his lazy vampire Kuro. Sleepy Life of SERVAMP shows the vampires and their Eves at home between battles, squabbling over small things while Kuro plays video games and naps as usual. Another episode follows Hyde as he remembers how he once used his charm, in the shape of a hedgehog, to trick the piano prodigy Licht into becoming his Eve. Platinum Vision produced them in 2016 and 2017, based on Strike Tanaka's manga.
servamp-specials.notes: Episode contents from MAL only; AniList confirms the specials as BD/DVD extras. MAL lists 4 episodes, Kitsu 3.

ikebukuro-west-gate-park.summary: Makoto Majima is a twenty-year-old who lives in Tokyo's Ikebukuro district and has a reputation as a 'troubleshooter', someone who sorts out problems between the area's rival gangs, yakuza and ordinary residents when the police cannot or will not. He knows every corner of the neighbourhood and often works with the G-Boys, a powerful street gang led by his charismatic, ruthless friend Takashi Ando. Each case drags him into dangerous situations, often against his better judgement, as violence between factions keeps rising. Doga Kobo adapted Ira Ishida's urban mystery novels into 12 episodes in 2020. It contains violence and crime.

to-be-hero.summary: Ossan, as he is called, is a handsome, divorced 38-year-old toilet designer who is a fairly useless father to his teenage daughter, Min-san. One day he is sucked into a toilet and recruited by an alien committee to become Earth's superhero. The catch is that the transformation makes him powerful but turns him into a hideously ugly man, and it brings a stream of bizarre villains and absurd situations into his and his daughter's lives. Studio LAN and Emon produced the 12-episode Chinese-Japanese series, created by Li Haoling, which aired in 2016 alongside Cheating Craft. It is a fast, surreal comedy with crude humour.

code-geass-hangyaku-no-lelouch-picture-d.summary: These nine Picture Drama shorts were included on the DVD volumes of Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion and are told mostly through still illustrations with full voice acting rather than full animation. They show the lighter side of the characters away from the war: the girls of Ashford Academy chatting in the bath, the student council planning a cross-dressing festival that everyone except Lelouch looks forward to, and a trip to a new pool that leaves Cornelia embarrassed. One instalment looks back at Lelouch's royal childhood and his first meeting with Suzaku. Sunrise produced them in 2007. They are best enjoyed after the first season.
code-geass-hangyaku-no-lelouch-picture-d.notes: Episode contents from MAL and AniList (bath scene, Lelouch and Suzaku's meeting); 'still illustrations with voice acting' describes the picture drama format.

kono-minikuku-mo-utsukushii-sekai.summary: Takeru Takemoto is a high school student who works part time delivering packages on a motorbike with his friend Ryo, for Takeru's uncle. One night a strange light sends them crashing into a forest, where they find a beautiful naked girl emerging from a glowing cocoon. Before Takeru can deal with that, an alien creature attacks, and he suddenly transforms into a powerful, monstrous form himself. The girl, who remembers nothing about who she is, is named Hikari and taken in by Takeru, and more mysteries soon follow. Gainax and Shaft produced the 12-episode original series in 2004, from an original concept credited to Shouji Saeki and Hiroyuki Yamaga, and it includes nudity and fanservice.

hybrid-child.summary: Hybrid Children are artificial people, neither quite machines nor dolls, who grow and develop feelings in response to the love their owners give them. This four-episode OVA tells linked stories about them. In the first, Kotaro Izumi, the young heir of a noble family, keeps a discarded Hybrid Child named Hazuki despite his family's disapproval and learns about responsibility as they grow up together. Later episodes follow other owners, ending with Kuroda, the craftsman who designed the Hybrid Children, and the lost love behind his creations. Studio Deen adapted Shungiku Nakamura's one-shot manga from 2014 to 2015. It is a romantic drama with boys' love themes.

sore-ga-seiyuu.summary: Futaba Ichinose is a rookie voice actress who dreams of making it big, but so far she mostly gets small background roles and rejection calls. The series follows her day-to-day work, from auditions and recording sessions to the business side of the industry, alongside her friends Ichigo Moesaki and Rin Kohana, also beginners, who end up forming a unit called Earphones and hosting a web radio show together. Gonzo produced the 13 episodes in 2015, based on a four-panel manga by Masumi Asano, herself a voice actress, with art by Kenjiro Hata. The three leads' voice actresses also perform together as a real unit named Earphones.

air-movie.summary: Centuries ago, a winged princess named Kanna, the last of her kind, was kept prisoner in a castle because the world feared her, until a soldier named Ryuya fell in love with her and tried to grant her wish to see the world. In the present, a travelling performer named Yukito turns up in a sleepy coastal town shortly before its summer festival, hoping to earn some money, and meets Misuzu, an unusual, lonely girl. His mother once told him to watch for the reincarnation of a winged girl and set her free, and Yukito starts to wonder about Misuzu. Toei Animation released this 2005 film, a separate take on Key's visual novel Air.

the-sky-crawlers.summary: In an alternate world at peace, wars have not disappeared but been turned into a business: two private corporations stage real aerial combat to satisfy a public that still needs conflict to feel secure. The pilots who fly these missions are Kildren, genetically engineered young people who never grow older than adolescents. Yuichi Kannami, one of them, arrives at a new air base commanded by Suito Kusanagi and settles into the routines of the pilots' isolated lives, though something about the place, and about time itself, seems off. Production I.G released the film in 2008, directed by Mamoru Oshii and based on Hiroshi Mori's novels. It is slow and contemplative, with aerial combat violence.

fantasy-bishoujo-juniku-ojisan-to.summary: Hinata Tachibana and Tsukasa Jinguji have been friends since childhood and are now ordinary office workers. Jinguji is so handsome that women have always flocked to him, while Tachibana, overshadowed for years, has never had any luck in love. Heading home after a group date, both are suddenly sent to a fantasy world by a mysterious being, and Tachibana arrives transformed into a stunningly beautiful blonde girl. Now the two friends must adventure together while the newly gorgeous Tachibana keeps throwing Jinguji off balance. OLM adapted Yu Tsurusaki and Shin Ikezawa's manga into 12 episodes in 2022. It is a romantic comedy with some fanservice.

one-punch-man-3.summary: The third season of One-Punch Man continues straight on from the second. Saitama, a hero so strong he defeats any enemy with a single punch, is still mostly bored, but the Hero Association's war with the Monster Association is reaching its peak. The dangerous hero hunter Garou remains at large, and the monsters have kidnapped an important hostage, so the Association sends its top heroes on a rescue raid into the monsters' headquarters with a strict deadline. J.C.Staff produced the season, with Shinpei Nagai taking over as director, and the first 12 episodes aired from October to December 2025. It adapts ONE and Yusuke Murata's manga and contains action violence.

kotarou-wa-hitorigurashi.summary: Shin Karino is a lazy but kind-hearted manga artist barely making a living when a new neighbour moves into the apartment next door: Kotaro Sato, a four-year-old boy who lives completely on his own. Kotaro introduces himself by handing over a box of tissues, speaks in an oddly formal, old-fashioned way and insists he can manage by himself. Karino and the building's other residents gradually start looking out for him, while slowly learning more about why such a young child is living alone. Liden Films produced the 10-episode adaptation of Mami Tsumura's manga, released on Netflix in March 2022. It mixes gentle comedy with themes of child abuse.

sengoku-basara-two.summary: Sengoku Basara's second season returns to its wildly exaggerated version of Japan's Warring States period, where historical warlords fight with superhuman powers and outlandish weapons. With the demon king Nobunaga Oda defeated, the struggle for control of Japan continues, as Takeda Shingen's and Uesugi Kenshin's forces clash once more at Kawanakajima while the rival young warlords Date Masamune, in blue, and Sanada Yukimura, in red, are drawn toward their next duel and a new threat rises. Production I.G produced the 12 episodes in 2010, directed by Kazuya Nomura and based on Capcom's video games. It contains large-scale battle violence.

non-non-biyori-vacation.summary: In the Non Non Biyori film, the children of Asahigaoka, a tiny rural village whose school has just five students and one teacher, are making the most of the last days of summer when Suguru wins a lottery prize: a trip to Okinawa. The whole group, including the local candy shop owner, sets off for three days by the sea, where they explore the islands and the beaches and make friends with Aoi, a local girl who helps at her family's inn. Silver Link produced the film, released in August 2018, based on Atto's manga. Like the TV series, it is a calm, gentle comedy about small everyday moments.

attack-on-titan-picture-drama.summary: Fly, Cadets, Fly! is a set of nine short comedy episodes that were included with the Blu-ray and DVD volumes of the first Attack on Titan TV season. Using simple Flash animation and cute chibi versions of Eren, Mikasa, Armin, Levi and the rest of the cast, they replay famous scenes and lines from the series as gags, with each episode containing a few short sketches. The tone is the opposite of the grim main story, so they are meant for viewers who already know the first season. They were released from 2013 to 2014, based on Hajime Isayama's manga.
attack-on-titan-picture-drama.notes: Contents from MAL/Kitsu synopsis; AniList confirms only that they are BD/DVD specials. MAL and AniList disagree on the studio (Studio Moriken vs Wit Studio), so no studio is named.

sukitte-ii-na-yo-ova.summary: This one-episode OVA of Say I Love You was bundled with the limited edition of the manga's eleventh volume in July 2013. Mei Tachibana, a quiet girl who opened up after the popular Yamato Kurosawa entered her life, is baking cookies at home with her friends Aiko, Asami and Nagi, who sends Yamato out of the house to keep him from getting in the way. With time to kill, he goes to meet his old friend Kai at the run-down park where the two first got to know each other. Zexcs produced it after the 2012 TV series, based on Kanae Hazuki's manga. It is a short, low-key side story.

xian-wang-de-richang-shenghuo-2nd-season.summary: The Daily Life of the Immortal King is a Chinese animated series about Wang Ling, a cultivation prodigy who has grown so absurdly powerful that he struggles to keep his strength under control, when all he really wants is an ordinary high school life. In the second season, the level of spiritual power in the world has been falling sharply, a side effect of Wang Ling's earlier meddling with the laws of nature. His spirit sword Jingke tries to fix the problem but overdoes it and tears a crack in space, setting off fresh trouble for Wang Ling and his classmates. Pb Animation produced the 12 episodes from 2021 to 2022, based on Kuxuan's web novel.

dungeon-ni-deai-wo-motomeru-no-wa-machig.summary: This second part of the fourth DanMachi season continues directly from the first. Young adventurer Bell Cranel and his familia have been warned of disaster by their party member Cassandra, who has foreseen it, and it arrives in the Dungeon. Bell is cut off from his party and stranded far deeper than his level should allow, wounded and without proper equipment, with only Ryu Lion beside him, while a monster far beyond their strength hunts them. Their companions above must fight their way down to reach them. J.C.Staff produced the 11 episodes, aired from January to March 2023, from Fujino Omori's light novels. It contains violence and gore.

mars-red.summary: In Tokyo in 1923, vampires have quietly existed for a long time, but their numbers are suddenly rising, helped by the spread of Ascra, an illegal artificial blood source. The Japanese army responds by forming a secret unit called Code Zero, made up largely of vampires, to hunt down others of their kind. Code Zero offers every vampire a choice: register and receive blood and benefits, or be eliminated. As the unit carries out its missions, its members face strange cases that make them question their own identities and purpose. Signal.MD produced the 13-episode series in 2021, based on Bun-O Fujisawa's stage reading play. It contains violence and dark themes.

school-rumble-ichi-gakki-hoshuu.summary: School Rumble is a romantic comedy about Tenma Tsukamoto, a high school girl with a crush on her quiet, strange classmate Oji Karasuma, and the delinquent Kenji Harima, who is hopelessly in love with Tenma. Extra Class is a two-episode OVA released in December 2005, after the first TV season, made up of short comedy segments that fill in gaps between episodes of the series. Among them, Yakumo befriends a foreign student, and class 2-C argues over its seating arrangements. Studio Comet produced it, based on Jin Kobayashi's manga. It is meant for viewers who have watched the first season.

chi-s-sweet-home.summary: A small grey-and-white kitten strays from her mother and littermates during a walk and gets hopelessly lost. A young boy, Yohei Yamada, and his mother find her and take her home and name her Chi. The only problem is that their apartment building does not allow pets, so the Yamadas have to keep her hidden while they look for someone to adopt her, and Chi has a lot to learn about her new home and the world outside. Madhouse produced the 104 episodes, each only a few minutes long, which aired in 2008, adapting Konami Kanata's manga. It is a gentle comedy suitable for all ages.

dragon-ball-gt-goku-gaiden-yuuki-no-akas.summary: A Hero's Legacy is the single TV special made for Dragon Ball GT. It aired in Japan in March 1997, midway through the series' run, though its story takes place a century after the series. All of Earth's old heroes are gone except Pan, Goku's granddaughter, now an elderly woman. Her descendant, Goku Jr., looks just like his famous ancestor but is a timid boy who gets picked on at school. When Pan suddenly falls seriously ill, Goku Jr. sets off to find the four-star Dragon Ball in the hope that it can save her, joined by the boy who usually bullies him, and discovers courage he never knew he had. Toei Animation produced it.

tamayura.summary: Fu Sawatari, nicknamed Potte, often visited Takehara, a scenic old town in Hiroshima on the Seto Inland Sea, with her father when she was small, taking photographs together. Her father has since died, and five years after their last visit Fu moves there with her family to start high school. Carrying his old Rollei 35S film camera, she finds herself photographing the town again and making new friends, gradually coming to terms with her loss. This four-episode OVA series was created and directed by Junichi Sato and produced by Hal Film Maker in 2010. It led to the TV series Tamayura: Hitotose and is a quiet, gentle slice-of-life story.

persona-3-the-movie-4-winter-of-rebirth.summary: Winter of Rebirth is the fourth and final film adapting the Persona 3 video game. Makoto Yuki and the other members of SEES, the group of students who fight Shadows during the hidden Dark Hour, have grown through the friendships and losses of the previous films. As winter sets in, they learn that a far greater catastrophe is approaching, one they are told cannot be stopped, and each must decide whether and why to keep fighting. A-1 Pictures produced the film, directed by Tomohisa Taguchi and released in Japan in January 2016. It follows Falling Down directly and should only be watched after the first three films. It contains violence and themes of death.

major-s3.summary: In the third season of Major, Goro Honda walks away from Kaido High School, a baseball powerhouse, to find a tougher challenge, and returns to his home town. Kaido's assistant coach makes sure no school with a baseball team will take him, so Goro enrols at Seishu High, a former girls' school where Kaoru Shimizu, his childhood friend, is a student and where there is no boys' baseball team at all. Determined to reach the national Koshien tournament and beat Kaido with a team of his own, he sets about building one from scratch out of complete beginners. Studio Hibari produced the 26 episodes in 2007, based on Takuya Mitsuda's manga.

psycho-pass-ss-case-3-onshuu-no-kanata-n.summary: On the Other Side of Love and Hate is the third and last film in Psycho-Pass: Sinners of the System. Former enforcer Shinya Kogami, living as a wandering mercenary far outside the reach of Japan's Sibyl System, is travelling through a war-torn kingdom in the Tibet-Himalaya region. After he saves a bus full of refugees from a guerrilla attack, one of them, a young woman named Tenzing, asks him to train her so she can avenge herself, and Kogami is drawn into the conflict around a local paramilitary commander, Guillermo Garcia. Production I.G released the film in March 2019, directed by Naoyoshi Shiotani. It contains gun violence and war themes.

ao-no-6-gou.summary: In the distant future, the oceans have risen and swallowed most of the world's low-lying land, a disaster caused by the rogue scientist Zorndyke, whose army of half-animal sea creatures attacks what is left of humanity's cities. The remaining nations fight back with the submarines of the Blue fleet. Tetsu Hayami, a gifted former submarine pilot who has walked away from the war, is pushed by his old mentor to rejoin Blue and is assigned to the submarine Blue No. 6. Gonzo produced the four-episode OVA from 1998 to 2000, loosely based on Satoru Ozawa's 1967 manga. It contains war violence.

hakkenden-touhou-hakken-ibun-2.summary: The second season of Hakkenden: Eight Dogs of the East continues directly from the first. Shino Inuzuka and Sosuke Inukawa, two of the three survivors of a plague that wiped out their home village, are still searching for the remaining holders of eight sacred gems. Shino carries the demon blade Murasame inside his body, and the Imperial Church that wants it keeps scheming in the background, while a mysterious woman pursues her own plan involving the gem holders. Studio Deen produced the 13 episodes in 2013, based on Miyuki Abe's manga inspired by the classic novel Nanso Satomi Hakkenden.

detective-conan-movie-04-captured-in-her.summary: In the fourth Detective Conan film, someone is murdering police officers. When another officer is shot in front of Ran Mori, the shock causes her to lose her memory, and she no longer recognises her friends, her family or Conan, the boy detective who is secretly her childhood friend Shinichi Kudo. Because Ran saw the killer, she is now a target herself. Conan has to solve the case and protect her while trying to help her remember who she is. TMS Entertainment released the film in April 2000, directed by Kenji Kodama and based on Gosho Aoyama's manga. It includes murders and gunfire.

thirty-sai-no-hoken-taiiku.summary: Hayao Imagawa is a thirty-year-old office worker who has never had a girlfriend or any romantic experience, and has more or less given up. Then a cupid comes down from the heavens on a single mission: to make sure he finally graduates from virginity. What follows is a romance between Hayao and a woman his own age who is just as inexperienced, while the show doubles as a tongue-in-cheek lesson in dating and relationships. Gathering produced the 12 short episodes, aired from April to June 2011, adapting Mitsuba's guidebook series aimed at inexperienced men in their thirties. It contains frequent sexual humour and frank sexual discussion.
thirty-sai-no-hoken-taiiku.notes: The love interest being an equally inexperienced 30-year-old woman is from MAL/AniList (AniDB) only; premise (cupids, virgin protagonist, guidebook source) confirmed by MAL/AniList and Wikipedia.

flame-of-recca.summary: Recca Hanabishi, the son of a fireworks maker, considers himself a modern-day ninja and has sworn to serve anyone who can beat him in a fight. No one has managed it, but when he meets Yanagi Sakoshita, a kind girl who can heal any wound with her hands, he pledges himself to her as her ninja anyway. Soon he discovers that he can actually create and control fire, and that Yanagi's healing power has made her a target for a wealthy man obsessed with gaining eternal life. Studio Pierrot adapted Nobuyuki Anzai's manga into 42 episodes broadcast on Fuji TV from 1997 to 1998. It contains martial arts violence.

fate-kaleid-liner-prisma-illya-2014.summary: This one-episode OVA is a light school comedy set in the world of Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya, the spin-off in which Illya von Einzbern is an ordinary schoolgirl who becomes a magical girl. Class 5-1 is preparing for the school sports festival: Tatsuko is thrilled about her proposed eel-scooping event, which nobody else likes, while the main attraction is a dance that their teacher Taiga Fujimura says comes with a big reward but needs a lot of practice. So Illya, her friend Miyu and their classmates start rehearsing. Silver Link produced it in 2014, based on Hiroshi Hiroyama's manga. It is a standalone extra for fans of the series.
fate-kaleid-liner-prisma-illya-2014.notes: Episode content from MAL/Kitsu/AniList synopses (all the same text); Wikipedia does not cover this OVA.

macross-plus.summary: Macross Plus takes place thirty years after the original Macross. On the colony planet Eden, the military is testing new transforming fighter planes, and two former childhood friends who now cannot stand each other, the reckless Isamu Dyson and the half-Zentradi Guld Bowman, are chosen to pilot rival prototypes for the same contract. Their old friend Myung Fang Lone also returns as the producer of Sharon Apple, a virtual idol singer whose debut concert is coming to Eden. Triangle Staff produced the four-episode OVA from 1994 to 1995, created by Shoji Kawamori and co-directed by Shinichiro Watanabe. It contains violence.

maison-ikkoku.summary: Yusaku Godai is a broke, unlucky student who rents a cramped room in Ikkoku-kan, a run-down boarding house whose other tenants treat his room as a party venue and his privacy as a joke. He is ready to pack up and leave when the new live-in manager arrives: Kyoko Otonashi, a gentle, quietly stubborn young widow, and he decides to stay. What follows is a slow, often frustrating romance full of misunderstandings, rivals and meddling neighbours, set against everyday life in 1980s Tokyo. Studio Deen adapted Rumiko Takahashi's manga into 96 episodes broadcast between 1986 and 1988.

lupin-the-third-mine-fujiko-to-iu-onna.summary: This 2012 series turns the Lupin III franchise toward Fujiko Mine, the glamorous thief who usually plays rival and partner to Lupin. Working alone, she slips into cults, palaces and criminal organisations to take whatever treasure catches her eye, and in the process meets the people who will become the familiar gang: Lupin himself, the gunman Daisuke Jigen, the swordsman Goemon Ishikawa and the dogged Inspector Zenigata. Running through her heists is a darker thread about her own fragmented memories and where she came from. Sayo Yamamoto directed the 13 episodes at TMS Entertainment, with a moody, sketchy art style. The series includes frequent nudity, sexual themes and violence.

macross-delta.summary: Set eight years on from Macross Frontier, a condition called the Var Syndrome is spreading across the outer reaches of the galaxy, driving people into uncontrollable violence. The only reliable remedy is song: the tactical idol unit Walküre performs live on the battlefield to calm the afflicted, guarded by the Valkyrie fighters of Delta Flight. Freyja Wion, a cheerful girl from a remote planet who dreams of joining Walküre, and Hayate Immelmann, a drifter who ends up in the cockpit, are pulled into this world just as the Kingdom of Windermere's own squadron of knights begins to strike. Satelight produced the 26 episodes in 2016.

masamune-kun-no-revenge-ova.summary: This single OVA, released with a volume of Hazuki Takeoka and Tiv's manga in 2018, collects three short side stories set after the TV series. In the first, Masamune Makabe comes home to find that his young cousin Haruka looks almost exactly like his mother and aunt, and his sister Chinatsu talks all three into a dress-up session. In the second, Aki Adagaki invites Neko, Tae and Kojuro to return to Tsunade Island for more summer fun, while Masamune stays behind after a silly accident. The third gives the hard-working maid Yoshino Koiwai a rare day off and a makeover. SILVER LINK. animated it as a light comedy epilogue.

joshikousei-no-mudazukai.summary: Nozomu Tanaka, Akane Kikuchi and Shiori Saginomiya have been friends since childhood, and high school does nothing to make them more sensible. Tanaka is loud, lazy and hopeless at studying, so she decides to hand out nicknames to everyone around her: she becomes Baka, Kikuchi, an otaku who wants to draw manga, becomes Wota, and the expressionless genius Saginomiya becomes Robo. Episodes follow their pointless conversations, failed schemes and the oddball classmates and teacher who get caught up in them, in the spirit of a sketch comedy about wasting time well. Passione adapted Bino's web manga into 12 episodes in 2019.

kaijuu-no-kodomo.summary: Ruka Azumi is a restless middle schooler whose summer goes wrong when an incident at handball practice gets her shut out of the team. Avoiding her mother at home, she drifts to the aquarium where her estranged father works and meets Umi and his older brother Sora, two boys said to have been raised by dugongs and now studied because their bodies seem made for the ocean. As sea creatures around the world start behaving strangely, Ruka is drawn into a mystery that grows more cosmic and dreamlike. Studio 4°C produced this 2019 film under director Ayumu Watanabe, adapting Daisuke Igarashi's manga.

re-zero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu-3.summary: Re:Zero's third season picks up a year after the trial at the Sanctuary. Subaru Natsuki has been training to be more useful, and things in Emilia's camp have settled into a calmer routine until Anastasia Hoshin, one of Emilia's rivals for the throne, invites her to Priestella, a canal city known as the City of Water Gates. Subaru and the others travel with her, meeting old acquaintances there, and soon find the city at the centre of a large and dangerous incident. White Fox animated the 16 episodes, which aired in two parts from October 2024 to March 2025, adapting Tappei Nagatsuki's light novels. It contains graphic violence and gore.

kiniro-no-corda-primo-passo.summary: Kahoko Hino studies in the general course at Seiso Academy, a school split between ordinary students in grey uniforms and music majors in white. One morning she sees Lili, a tiny fairy who can be seen by very few people, and he chooses her as a participant in the school's prestigious music competition, handing her a magic violin that plays well even for a beginner. Thrown in alongside a group of talented and mostly handsome music students, Kahoko has to keep up, avoid exposing her secret and decide whether she wants to learn to play for real. Yumeta Company adapted Koei's game into 25 episodes in 2006 and 2007.

le-portrait-de-petit-cossette.summary: Eiri Kurahashi is an art student who looks after an antiques shop for his uncle. His friends notice that he has become distracted and withdrawn, and they guess there is a girl involved. They are half right: inside an old Venetian glass from France, Eiri keeps seeing a pale, doll-like young woman named Cossette, apparently trapped in another world, and he becomes obsessed with her and with the history behind the objects connected to her. The story turns into a gothic horror tale about art, longing and old grievances. Daume animated these three OVA episodes for Aniplex in 2004. It contains bloody imagery, self-harm and disturbing scenes.

ibara-no-ou.summary: A virus nicknamed Medusa is spreading across the world, slowly turning its victims to stone, and nobody has a cure. A company called Venus Gate selects 160 people to be placed in cold sleep inside an old castle until a treatment exists. Kasumi Ishiki is one of them, though it means leaving behind her twin sister Shizuku. When she wakes, the facility has been overrun by thorny vines and monstrous creatures, and Kasumi joins a small group of fellow sleepers trying to escape while figuring out how much time has passed. Sunrise made the film, directed by Kazuyoshi Katayama and based on Yuji Iwahara's manga. It contains violence and gore.

one-piece-norowareta-seiken.summary: The fifth One Piece film puts Roronoa Zoro at the centre. While the Straw Hat Pirates visit an island rumoured to hide a priceless sword, Zoro is drawn away by a figure from his past: his childhood friend Saga, who now leads a group of men hunting for the same blade. With the crew split up, Luffy and Usopp wander lost, the others defend a village from attack, and the question becomes why Zoro seems to have chosen his old friend over his captain. The film is a standalone story outside the main storyline. Toei Animation produced it in 2004, directed by Kazuhisa Takenouchi and based on Eiichiro Oda's manga.

bang-dream.summary: As a child camping under the stars, Kasumi Toyama felt a thrilling, rhythmic pulse she calls the Star Beat, and she has been chasing that feeling ever since. Starting out at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School, she tries one club after another without success, until a star-shaped guitar she finds in the storehouse of a pawnshop run by classmate Arisa Ichigaya's family points her toward rock music. With no experience at all, Kasumi sets out to build a band from the girls around her, which will become Poppin'Party. This 13-episode first season, from 2017, launched the anime side of Bushiroad's BanG Dream! franchise and was animated by Xebec and Issen.

strike-the-blood-iii.summary: This third OVA series continues the story of Kojou Akatsuki, an easygoing high school boy on the artificial island of Itogami who is secretly the Fourth Progenitor, the most dangerous vampire alive, and Yukina Himeragi, the young sword shaman sent to watch over him. This time strange events at sea leave the island cut off, Kojou's sister Nagisa is still suffering after-effects from earlier battles, and a terrorist organisation called Tartarus Rapes launches operations on Itogami. Connect animated the ten episodes, released between December 2018 and September 2019, adapting Gakuto Mikumo's light novels with illustrations by Manyako. It contains fan service and violent battles.

konbini-kareshi.summary: Every day on the way home, a group of first-year high school boys stop at the same convenience store, and many of their crushes, friendships and arguments start or end there. Haruki Mishima, a swimming club member, still thinks about Miharu Mashiki, the girl he liked as a child, and a chance meeting at the store brings those feelings back. His best friend Towa Honda falls for their class representative, who wants nothing to do with him. Other boys from different clubs have their own small romances and problems. Pierrot produced the 12 episodes in 2017 for a multimedia project from Kadokawa's B's Log Comic, run in collaboration with the Lawson chain.

demi-chan-wa-kataritai-special.summary: This one-off episode of Interviews with Monster Girls takes place during the summer holidays. Tetsuo Takahashi, the biology teacher fascinated by demi-humans, signs up for patrol duty at the local summer festival and asks Sakie Sato, the succubus who teaches maths, to come along. Meanwhile, his students Hikari the vampire, Kyoko the dullahan and Yuki the snow woman visit the same festival, as does Hikari's sister Himari with her own friends, and when the groups separately wander toward a shrine, everyone gives everyone else a fright. A-1 Pictures released it online in 2017, adapting material from Petos's manga as a gentle comedy epilogue to the TV series.

goku-sayonara-zetsubou-sensei.summary: Goku Sayonara, Zetsubou-Sensei is a three-part OVA that continues the second TV season. Its subject is still Nozomu Itoshiki, a high school teacher who sees despair in absolutely everything, and his class 2-H, a room full of exaggerated misfits, from an obsessive stalker to a girl who insists on perfect order, plus one ordinary student who hates being called ordinary. Each part is a rapid run of sketches that use Nozomu's gloomy outlook to poke fun at Japanese society, media and politics, with dense on-screen jokes. Shaft animated the episodes, released between October 2008 and February 2009 and based on Koji Kumeta's manga. It contains dark humour about suicide.

fushigi-no-umi-no-nadia.summary: In an alternate 1889, Jean, a warm-hearted young French inventor, meets Nadia, a guarded circus acrobat of unknown origins who wears a blue jewel called the Blue Water, which may hold the key to her past. A trio of comical jewel thieves led by Grandis Granva is after the pendant, and soon a far more dangerous group, the Neo-Atlanteans under the masked Gargoyle, comes after Nadia herself. Their flight eventually leads them aboard the submarine Nautilus and its stern Captain Nemo. Gainax made the 39 episodes for NHK in 1990 and 1991, directed by Hideaki Anno and inspired by Jules Verne.

toaru-hikuushi-e-no-tsuioku.summary: Two nations, the Amatsukami Imperium and the Levamme Empire, have been at war for years across a vast sea. When the Levamme crown prince promises to marry Juana del Moral and end the war within a year, enemy forces attack her family's estate. Her side's only option is a desperate one: Charles Karino, a gifted mercenary pilot who is looked down on for his mixed heritage, must fly Juana alone in a two-seat seaplane across 12,000 kilometres of hostile skies to reach the capital. Across the journey, the princess and the pilot learn more about each other. Madhouse produced the 2011 film, directed by Jun Shishido and based on Koroku Inumura's light novel.

reikenzan-hoshikuzu-tachi-no-utage.summary: A prophecy warned that falling comets would bring an age of chaos, but when they pass harmlessly, a boy named Ouriku is born in a remote village. Twelve years later, Ouriku sets off with his servant to sit for the entrance exam of Reikenzan, a mountain sect where disciples train to become immortal sages. He has a soul of a kind said to appear once in a thousand years, but the elegant sage running the exam is famously careless, so the trials are anything but predictable. The result is a comedy that pokes fun at the conventions of Chinese cultivation fantasy. Studio Deen co-produced the 12 episodes with Tencent in 2016, based on a web novel by Guowang Bixia.

endride.summary: Fifteen-year-old Shun Asanaga is a cheerful boy who lives in the shadow of his father, a scientist and businessman. When he touches a strange crystal in his father's office, he is transported to a strange land called Endra. There he meets Emilio, a proud young prince who has just come of age and is determined to take revenge on Delzain, the king who rules the land. Shun and Emilio quickly clash, but they are forced to travel and fight together. Brain's Base and Lapin Track produced the 24 episodes in 2016, with original character designs by Nobuhiro Watsuki and Kazushi Hagiwara.

ginga-eiyuu-densetsu-die-neue-these-kaik.summary: Die Neue These is a new adaptation of Yoshiki Tanaka's novels, and Star-Crossed is its first 12-episode season. For about 150 years, the Galactic Empire, ruled by a kaiser, and the democratic Free Planets Alliance have been fighting an exhausting war. Each side has a young commander who is rising fast: Reinhard, an ambitious imperial officer who wants to bring down the corrupt aristocracy, and Yang Wen-li, a history-loving Alliance tactician who would rather not be a soldier at all. Their stories run in parallel through battles, court politics and military bureaucracy. Production I.G produced the season in 2018; it continues in later seasons.

bungou-stray-dogs-4.summary: The fourth season of Bungo Stray Dogs opens with a long look back to how the Armed Detective Agency began: Yukichi Fukuzawa, a former government swordsman trying to work as a freelance bodyguard, meets a brilliant and obnoxious boy named Ranpo Edogawa, and a strange murder case brings them together. In the present day, Ranpo and the agency, including Atsushi Nakajima and Osamu Dazai, chase a gifted individual who can stage seemingly perfect crimes, and find that the case is part of a wider plan aimed at the agency itself. Bones produced the 13 episodes in 2023, based on Kafka Asagiri and Sango Harukawa's manga. It contains violence.

mahou-shoujo-ore.summary: Saki Uno is fifteen, half of a struggling idol duo, and hopelessly in love with Mohiro, the older brother of her best friend and partner Sakuyo. When a thuggish man turns up at her door, Saki learns that her mother was once a magical girl and that the visitor is in fact a mascot looking for a new recruit. Saki takes on the role to protect Mohiro from demons, only to discover that transforming turns her into a tall, muscular man in a frilly costume. She now has to fight demons, keep her idol work going and somehow get Mohiro to notice her. Pierrot Plus adapted Icchokusen Mokon's manga into 12 comedy episodes in 2018.

toshokan-sensou.summary: In an alternate Japan, a law passed in 1989 allows a government agency to seize and destroy any media it considers harmful. Libraries responded by forming their own armed defence force to protect books and readers. Iku Kasahara joins the Library Defense Force because, as a high school girl, she was protected by an unknown officer while trying to keep hold of a book. She is tall, athletic and reckless, and her strict instructor Atsushi Dojo seems determined to make her life difficult, yet she ends up assigned to the elite Library Task Force. Production I.G adapted Hiro Arikawa's novels into 12 episodes in 2008, mixing military action, workplace comedy and romance.

runway-de-waratte.summary: Chiyuki Fujito grew up around her father's modelling agency and has always wanted to walk at Paris Fashion Week, but she has stopped growing at 158 centimetres, far too short for the runway by industry standards. Ikuto Tsumura, a classmate from a poor family, has a real gift for designing clothes but his family is poor and cannot pay for the training a designer usually needs. When their paths cross, each sees in the other a reason not to give up, and they agree to push into the fashion world on their own terms. Ezo'la adapted Kotoba Inoya's manga into 12 episodes in 2020.

jojo-no-kimyou-na-bouken-part-6-stone-oc.summary: This second batch of Stone Ocean episodes, covering episodes 13 to 24, continues Jolyne Cujoh's fight inside Green Dolphin Street Prison in Florida, where she is serving a sentence for a crime she did not commit. Jolyne, the daughter of Jotaro Kujo, is now trying to track down the user of Whitesnake, a Stand that steals memories and abilities from its victims and has left her father in grave danger. With her fellow inmates and unlikely allies, she runs into a series of strange new Stand users across the prison grounds. David Production released these 12 episodes on Netflix on 1 September 2022, adapting Hirohiko Araki's manga. It contains violence and gore.

soredemo-machi-wa-mawatteiru.summary: Hotori Arashiyama is a high school girl who loves detective stories and lives in a small shopping district where everyone knows everyone. After school she works at Seaside, a modest local cafe that its elderly owner turned into a 'maid cafe' simply by putting the staff in maid outfits, with no real idea what a maid cafe is. Hotori is clumsy, excitable and prone to dramatic misunderstandings, and episodes follow her scrapes with friends, family, neighbours and shopkeepers, occasionally drifting into mysteries, science fiction or something stranger. Shaft adapted Masakazu Ishiguro's manga into 12 episodes in 2010, presented as a loosely connected slice-of-life comedy.

oshi-no-ko-season-2.summary: Oshi no Ko's second season follows Aqua Hoshino and Kana Arima into rehearsals for a stage version of the hit manga Tokyo Blade, produced by Lala Lai Theatrical Company. Aqua's girlfriend, the actress Akane Kurokawa, joins the cast, but she struggles with a character whose role in the original keeps shrinking, and the script's changes upset the manga's author, Abiko Samejima. While the production deals with clashing egos and creative disputes, Aqua is quietly pursuing his own goal: getting closer to the director, Toshiro Kindaichi, to learn what he knows about his late mother, Ai. Doga Kobo produced the 13 episodes in 2024. It deals with dark themes, including violence and trauma.

animegataris.summary: Minoa Asagaya, a first-year at Sakaneko High School, keeps dreaming about a scene from an anime she watched as a child, but she cannot remember what the show was called. Her classmate Arisu Kamiigusa, a wealthy, popular girl who turns out to be a dedicated otaku, cannot identify it either, so the two of them start an anime research club to find people who might know. Soon the club gathers a mix of fans, and Minoa is introduced to the culture, jargon and arguments of anime fandom, with the series poking fun at the medium itself along the way. WAO World produced the 12 episodes in 2017.

black-clover-mahou-tei-no-ken.summary: Set alongside the Black Clover TV series, this 2023 film follows Asta, a boy born without magic who wants to become Wizard King, and his rival Yuno. Their kingdom is shaken when Conrad Leto, a former Wizard King who once had the people's respect, resurfaces carrying the Imperial Sword and a plan to tear down the Clover Kingdom and remake it in the name of equality. Conrad is not alone: other Wizard Kings from the past return with him, and Asta, Yuno and the Magic Knights have to face the most powerful mages in their history. Pierrot produced the film under director Ayataka Tanemura, adapting Yuki Tabata's manga.

break-blade-3-kyoujin-no-ato.summary: The third of six Broken Blade films continues the war between the Kingdom of Krisna and the invading Athens Commonwealth. Rygart Arrow is an 'un-sorcerer', one of the rare people in his world who cannot control quartz, the substance that powers everything from lamps to the giant mecha called golems. Because of that, he is the only person who can pilot an ancient golem found in a mine, and he has reluctantly entered the fighting to protect his old school friends, King Hodr and Queen Sigyn, even though another friend, Zess, now fights for Athens. Production I.G and Xebec released the film in 2010, adapting Yunosuke Yoshinaga's manga. It contains war violence.
break-blade-3-kyoujin-no-ato.notes: MAL, Kitsu and AniList give no film-specific synopsis; summary describes the series setup and the film's place in the six-film run.

sasameki-koto.summary: Sumika Murasame is a tall, capable first-year at a co-ed high school, a top student and a karate expert, and she has quietly fallen for her best friend, Ushio Kazama. Ushio openly likes girls, but only the small, cute kind, so she keeps falling for other girls and getting turned down while never noticing how Sumika feels. Sumika supports her through each heartbreak and keeps her own feelings hidden, while a handful of classmates with their own complicated crushes gather around the two. The tone is gentle and bittersweet, with light comedy. AIC adapted Takashi Ikeda's manga into 13 episodes in 2009.

golden-kamuy-3.summary: The third season of Golden Kamuy follows the hunt for a hidden fortune in Ainu gold, which can only be found by collecting a map tattooed on the skin of escaped convicts. After the events at Abashiri Prison separate them, Saichi Sugimoto, who fought in the Russo-Japanese War, heads north to Karafuto, or Sakhalin, to find the Ainu girl Asirpa, travelling with Tanigaki, the boy Chikapashi and two soldiers of the Seventh Division. Asirpa, meanwhile, is on her own journey to learn about her father's past. Geno Studio produced the 12 episodes in 2020, adapting Satoru Noda's manga. It contains graphic violence and gore.

toji-no-miko.summary: For centuries, sword-wielding shrine maidens called Toji have protected Japan from Aratama, destructive supernatural creatures. Today the Toji work as a special police force and are trained at five schools around the country. Kanami Eto, a cheerful middle schooler who simply loves swordplay, is chosen to represent her school at a national tournament, where she meets Hiyori Juujou, a quiet, intense girl from another academy. When the tournament is thrown into chaos, the two end up on the run together, suspecting betrayal inside the organisation that trained them. Studio Gokumi produced the 24 episodes in 2018 as an original series.

final-fantasy-the-spirits-within.summary: In 2065, Earth has been overrun by Phantoms, ghostly alien beings that kill people simply by touching them, and survivors live in cities protected by energy barriers. Scientist Aki Ross and her elderly mentor, Sid, believe the Phantoms can be defeated without destroying the planet by collecting eight 'spirits' that together form a special energy wave. They are supported by a squad of soldiers led by Captain Gray Edwards, but General Hein wants to use a powerful orbital cannon instead. Square Pictures produced the 2001 film under Hironobu Sakaguchi, who created the Final Fantasy games, and it is known as the first feature to attempt fully photorealistic computer-animated humans. It contains violence and death.

manyuu-hikenchou.summary: In an alternate Edo period, a woman's status depends on the size of her breasts, and the Manyu clan controls the country through secret techniques that can shrink or enlarge them. Chifusa Manyu, the clan head's daughter, rejects what the clan has become, steals the scroll containing its techniques and flees. With her loyal attendant Kaede, she travels the land trying to help women who have suffered under the system, pursued by clan assassins sent to bring the scroll back, including her own sister. Hoods Entertainment adapted Hideki Yamada's manga into 12 episodes in 2011. The series is built around frequent nudity and sexual content.

radiant-2.summary: Radiant's second season picks up after Seth, Doc and Mélie escape from Rumble Town and return to the Artemis Institute. Seth is a horned young Sorcerer, one of the people who survived contact with the Nemeses, monsters that fall from the sky, and gained magic as a result. He learns more about Piodon, a mysterious figure who may be his brother, and sets out again in search of Radiant, the place the Nemeses are said to come from. The journey brings the group to a crumbling realm belonging to the Wizard Knights, while Seth is troubled by visions. Lerche produced the 21 episodes from 2019 to 2020, based on Tony Valente's French comic.

break-blade-4-sanka-no-chi.summary: The fourth Broken Blade film carries on the war between the small Kingdom of Krisna and the much larger Athens Commonwealth. In this world nearly everyone can manipulate quartz, which runs machines and powers the giant combat mecha called golems. Rygart Arrow, a farmer who cannot, turns out to be the only person able to move an ancient golem dug out of a mine, and he fights for Krisna out of loyalty to its king and queen, his friends from military school. The war keeps forcing him to face soldiers from the other side, including those close to his friend Zess. Production I.G and Xebec released the film in 2010, based on Yunosuke Yoshinaga's manga. It contains war violence.
break-blade-4-sanka-no-chi.notes: MAL, Kitsu and AniList give no film-specific synopsis; summary describes the series setup and the film's place in the six-film run.

uchouten-kazoku-2.summary: In modern Kyoto, humans live in the city, tanuki shapeshifters hide among them and tengu rule the skies. The Eccentric Family's second season returns to the four Shimogamo brothers, sons of a great tanuki leader. The eldest wants to lead tanuki society, the second, long stuck as a frog, is starting to change again, and the youngest works at the family's factory. Yasaburo, the carefree third son, simply wants an interesting life, which keeps tangling him with his old tengu teacher Professor Akadama and the beautiful, dangerous Benten. Then Akadama's estranged son, known as Nidaime, returns to Kyoto. P.A. Works produced the 12 episodes in 2017, based on Tomihiko Morimi's novel.

caligula.summary: Ritsu Shikishima is a high school student who likes thinking about psychology and leads a pleasant, uneventful life, until he begins hearing a distorted voice asking for help and noticing things that do not add up. He realises that his world is Mobius, a virtual reality created by μ, a virtual idol whose songs keep people trapped in an idealised version of their lives. As the people around him turn into hostile 'Digiheads', Ritsu teams up with other students who have also woken up, using weapons born from their emotions to fight their way out. Satelight produced the 12 episodes in 2018, adapting the game The Caligula Effect.

kengan-ashura.summary: Since the Edo period, wealthy Japanese businesses have quietly settled disputes through Kengan matches, private fights between hired gladiators where the winner's company takes the deal. Kazuo Yamashita is an ordinary middle-aged salaryman at the Nogi Group whose life changes when he witnesses a street fight won by Ohma Tokita, a young man known as the Ashura. Nogi's chairman wants Ohma as the company's fighter and assigns Kazuo to manage him, dragging him into a huge tournament where the winning company will take control of the Kengan Association itself. Larx Entertainment produced the first 12 episodes for Netflix in 2019, based on Yabako Sandrovich and Daromeon's manga. It contains brutal fighting and gore.

x.summary: In 1999, the fate of the world will be decided by a struggle between two groups of seven people with supernatural powers: the Dragons of Heaven, who want to protect humanity, and the Dragons of Earth, who believe humans must be wiped out to save the planet. Kamui Shiro is the boy whose choice decides which side he will lead. Returning to Tokyo after six years away, at his late mother's request, he reunites with his childhood friends Fuma and Kotori Monou, knowing that whatever he chooses will endanger them. Madhouse produced the 24-episode series in 2001 and 2002, directed by Yoshiaki Kawajiri and based on CLAMP's manga. It contains graphic violence and disturbing scenes.

steven-universe-season-5.summary: The fifth and final season of Steven Universe returns to Steven, a half-human, half-Gem boy who lives in Beach City with the Crystal Gems Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl, magical alien guardians of the Earth. Steven has inherited the gem of his mother, Rose Quartz, who once led a rebellion against the Gem empire, and with it her many unfinished problems. This season moves much of the action away from home as Steven confronts the consequences of his mother's past more directly. This season of Rebecca Sugar's Cartoon Network series aired from 2017 to January 2019 and was followed by a film and an epilogue series.
steven-universe-season-5.notes: American series with no MAL or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia's episode list. Kitsu has no synopsis, so the premise rests mainly on Wikipedia.

shinka-no-mi-shiranai-uchi-ni-kachigumi-.summary: Seiichi Hiiragi is an overweight high school student who is constantly bullied, so when a self-proclaimed god transports his entire school to a fantasy world and tells everyone to form parties, nobody wants him. Left alone in a dangerous forest, he eats a strange fruit that turns out to be the Fruit of Evolution, and his body and abilities start changing at an absurd rate. He also meets Saria, a gorilla monster with a crush on him who soon evolves too, and the two begin an adventure that grows more ridiculous with every encounter. Hotline adapted Miku's light novels into 12 episodes in 2021, playing it as broad comedy with crude humour.

naruto-honoo-no-chuunin-shiken-naruto-vs.summary: This short Naruto Shippuden special is set shortly before the Fourth Great Ninja War. To strengthen the allied shinobi forces, the Hidden Sand Village hosts a special Chunin Exam, and among the entrants are Naruto Uzumaki, now a famous ninja, and Konohamaru Sarutobi, the eager young ninja who has always looked up to him. When the tournament pairs them against each other, Konohamaru sees a chance to prove how far he has come, while the other young ninja from the villages try to make their own mark. Based on Masashi Kishimoto's manga, the special was screened in Japanese cinemas in 2011 alongside the film Blood Prison.

dokyuu-hentai-hxeros.summary: Five years ago, aliens called Kiseichu arrived on Earth and began feeding on human sexual energy, which threatens to leave the species with no interest in reproducing at all. The only weapon against them runs on that same energy, so the HxEros team needs people with plenty of it. High school boy Retto Enjo joins the team with four girls, one of whom is Kirara Hoshino, his childhood friend, who has grown distant after a traumatic Kiseichu attack. To fight the invaders, the team has to build up their H-energy in embarrassing ways. Project No.9 adapted Ryoma Kitada's manga into 12 episodes in 2020. The series is built around constant sexual content and nudity.

miraculous-ladybug-season-2.summary: Season two of Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir returns to Paris, where two teenagers, Adrien Agreste and Marinette Dupain-Cheng, secretly protect the city as the superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir, without knowing each other's identities. Their enemy is still Hawk Moth, a villain who preys on people's negative emotions, using magical butterflies called akumas to turn ordinary Parisians into supervillains. Marinette also has to balance hero work with school, her design ambitions and her crush on Adrien, who is in turn in love with Ladybug. The 26-episode season aired in France from December 2016 to November 2018.
miraculous-ladybug-season-2.notes: French animated series with no MAL or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia. Kitsu has no synopsis, so the premise rests mainly on Wikipedia.

steven-universe-season-4.summary: The fourth season of Steven Universe continues the story of Steven, a young boy who is half human and half Gem, living in Beach City with the Crystal Gems Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl, alien guardians who protect the Earth. He carries the gem of his late mother, Rose Quartz, and much of the season sees Steven trying to understand who she really was and how her choices still shape the lives of the people and Gems around him, alongside smaller episodes about his friends and family in town. This season of Rebecca Sugar's Cartoon Network series aired from 2016 to 2017.
