steven-universe-season-4.notes: American series with no MAL or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia's episode list. Kitsu has no synopsis, so the premise rests mainly on Wikipedia.

harmony.summary: Decades after a catastrophe called the Maelstrom, the world is run by medical authorities that monitor every citizen's body and prevent illness, and kindness and health are treated as public duties. As schoolgirls, Tuan Kirie and her friends rejected this gentle, suffocating society alongside a rebellious girl named Miach Mihie. Years later, Tuan works as an inspector for the World Health Organization, quietly breaking rules where she can, when a sudden wave of mass suicides strikes around the world, and the investigation draws her back to her past. Studio 4°C produced the 2015 film, with Michael Arias and Takashi Nakamura directing, adapting Project Itoh's novel. It deals with suicide and contains violence.

super-lovers-2nd-season.summary: The second season of Super Lovers continues the story of Haru Kaido and Ren, the guarded boy Haru first met at his mother's cabin in the Canadian woods and who later became his adopted younger brother. Ren has moved to Japan to live with Haru and his two other brothers, and is slowly settling in as the youngest of four while Haru gets his new cafe off the ground. Their quiet routine is shaken when their forceful mother, Haruko, turns up with plans of her own for Ren. Studio Deen produced the ten episodes in 2017, adapting Miyuki Abe's boys' love manga. It depicts a romance between adoptive brothers, one of them a teenager.

gun-x-sword.summary: Van is a lanky, apathetic swordsman wandering the Planet of Endless Illusion, a lawless world full of rogues, in search of the man with a clawed right hand who killed his bride. Passing through the town of Evergreen, he meets Wendy Garret, a timid girl searching for her kidnapped older brother, whose trail may lead to the same man. Van reluctantly lets her tag along, and the two cross paths with other travellers who have each lost someone to the Claw, in a western-style adventure with giant robot battles. AIC ASTA produced the 26 episodes in 2005, directed by Goro Taniguchi and written by Hideyuki Kurata.

psycho-pass-ss-case-1-tsumi-to-bachi.summary: The first of the three Psycho-Pass: Sinners of the System films opens in 2117, when a car speeding out of control slams into the headquarters of the Public Safety Bureau. The driver is Izumi Yasaka, a counsellor who fled Sanctuary, a facility in Aomori where latent criminals are isolated. Before she can be properly questioned, the facility demands her return, so Inspector Mika Shimotsuki, finally leading her own case, escorts her back with Enforcers Nobuchika Ginoza and Yayoi Kunizuka, while Akane Tsunemori's team digs into the matter in Tokyo. What they find in the quiet, cheerful-looking facility does not add up. Production I.G released the film in 2019, directed by Naoyoshi Shiotani. It contains violence.

mushoku-tensei-isekai-ittara-honki-dasu-.summary: This standalone special takes place while the adventuring party Dead End is staying in the city of Millishion. The members split up for a day, and while Rudeus Greyrat gets caught up in his own business, Eris Boreas Greyrat, the group's sword fighter, is left bored and decides to fulfil a long-held wish: hunting goblins. At the Adventurers' Guild she runs into Cliff Grimoire, a proud, talented young mage who insists on coming along, and the two venture into the forest together. Studio Bind produced the episode in 2022, alongside the second part of the first season, based on Rifujin na Magonote's light novels.

blackfox.summary: Rikka Isurugi has trained in ninja techniques since childhood under her grandfather, while also following in the scientific footsteps of her father, Allen, a researcher who has built a set of advanced AI-controlled animal drones. Allen wants his work used peacefully, but others want it for something else, and when Rikka's family home is attacked by a hit squad seeking that research, her life changes overnight. Escaping with the drones, she takes on the identity of Black Fox and sets out to track down those responsible, using both her ninja skills and her father's technology. Studio 3Hz produced the original film, released in 2019. It contains violence.

penguin-highway.summary: Aoyama is a fourth grader who knows a great deal for his age, keeps a notebook of everything he learns and has a quiet crush on a friendly young woman who works at the local dental clinic. One morning, penguins start appearing in his suburban neighbourhood, far from any coast, and no one can explain where they came from. Aoyama decides to investigate, and finds that the woman herself seems to be connected to the mystery in a way she does not understand either. With classmates and a stubborn bully also involved, his summer becomes a gentle science fiction puzzle. Studio Colorido produced the 2018 film, directed by Hiroyasu Ishida and based on Tomihiko Morimi's novel.

inuyasha-kuroi-tessaiga.summary: This half-hour special, first shown at a Rumiko Takahashi exhibition in 2008, centres on the rivalry between the half-demon Inuyasha and his elder brother, Sesshomaru. Sesshomaru has always resented that their father left the mighty sword Tessaiga to Inuyasha, while he received the healing blade Tenseiga, and he grows more bitter when he learns that a technique he mastered was meant to pass to Tessaiga too. Their old enemy Naraku senses an opportunity and offers Sesshomaru a way to take Tessaiga's power, setting the brothers against each other once again. Whether Inuyasha can see through Naraku's scheme, and whether his brother will ever accept him, is what the duel comes down to. It is based on Takahashi's manga.

genshiken-nidaime.summary: Genshiken, a university club for otaku of every kind, starts a new term with Chika Ogiue, an aspiring manga artist who draws boys' love comics, among its senior members. Most of the original members have graduated, so the club needs new blood, and the freshmen who join are drawn largely by Ogiue's work, including the energetic fujoshi Yoshitake, the gloomy Yajima and Hato, a boy who prefers to attend in girls' clothing. Ogiue worries the club is turning into a society for boys' love fans, while former members drop in and out. Production I.G adapted Shimoku Kio's manga into 13 episodes in 2013 as a continuation of the earlier Genshiken anime.

ginga-kikoutai-majestic-prince.summary: In the late 21st century, humanity has spread into space and is under attack by an alien race called the Wulgaru. To fight back, genetically enhanced children have been raised as soldiers, and five of them, including the good-natured Izuru Hitachi, a student in the academic city of Grandzehle, make up Team Rabbits. The squad is known for poor teamwork and little common sense, yet they are chosen to test-pilot a new line of combat suits called AHSMB. Doga Kobo and Orange produced the 24 episodes in 2013, as part of a mecha franchise created by FIELDS.

akb0048-first-stage.summary: Far in the future, after war devastated Earth, humanity lives across many planets, and the regime that controls much of the galaxy has banned entertainment as a harmful influence. One group of performers defies the ban: AKB0048, a guerrilla idol troupe that inherits the names of members of the real-world group AKB48 and holds illegal concerts across the galaxy while fighting off the forces trying to shut them down. Nagisa Motomiya and her friends, inspired by a dangerous AKB0048 concert they saw as children, audition to join them as trainees despite their families' objections. Satelight produced these 13 episodes in 2012, with Shoji Kawamori as chief director. A second season followed in 2013.

code-realize-sousei-no-himegimi.summary: In a steampunk version of Victorian London, Cardia Beckford lives alone in an abandoned mansion, keeping a promise to her father, Isaac. Her body carries a poison that melts anything her skin touches, and inside her chest is the Horologium, a device of enormous power that many people want. When the British army comes to take her away, she is snatched by Arsène Lupin, a gentleman thief, who joins her search for her missing father. Along the way they are helped by a group of figures drawn from literature and history, including Victor Frankenstein and Abraham Van Helsing. M.S.C adapted Otomate's otome game into 12 episodes in 2017.

ani-ni-tsukeru-kusuri-wa-nai.summary: Shi Miao is a high school girl who cannot stand her older brother, Shi Fen. He is one grade ahead of her at their school, lazy, rude and constantly in trouble, and she is more than willing to answer his teasing with violence. With no one else at home to rely on, the two live with each other's quirks, squabbling over food, television and everything in between, and Shi Miao often wishes someone would just take him away. Underneath the fighting, though, Shi Fen keeps looking out for his sister in his own clumsy way. Fanworks and Imagineer adapted You Ling's Chinese web comic into 12 short episodes in 2017.

kamisama-hajimemashita-kamisama-shiawase.summary: This OVA, based on Julietta Suzuki's Kamisama Kiss manga, is set as Nanami's high school graduation draws near. Nanami Momozono, a high school girl who became the land god of the Mikage Shrine, and Tomoe, the fox spirit who serves as her familiar, have already been through a great deal together. Now they look back on their adventures and face their biggest question yet: what kind of future the two of them can build together, given the rules that separate gods, spirits and humans, and the conditions laid down by the god Okuninushi. TMS Entertainment released the single episode in December 2016 as a romantic send-off for the couple.

deatte-5-byou-de-battle.summary: Akira Shiroyanagi is a bright high school student who loves games but finds everyday life boring. One morning he wakes up in a strange arena, where a cruel catgirl called Mion explains that he has been chosen for an experiment, granted a special ability and erased from society, and will now have to fight other participants in a series of deadly games. Akira's assigned ability is unusual, and he quickly realises that cunning and bluffing can matter more than raw power, and he resolves to win and take down the organisers. SynergySP and Vega Entertainment adapted Saizo Harawata and Kashiwa Miyako's manga into 12 episodes in 2021. It contains violence.

arte.summary: In early sixteenth-century Florence, Arte is the only daughter of a declining noble family. She has always wanted to be a painter, and after the death of her father, the one person who encouraged her, her mother expects her to marry well instead. Arte refuses and goes from workshop to workshop asking to be taken on as an apprentice, only to be turned away because she is a woman. Finally a gruff young painter named Leo agrees to let her try, and she begins the hard life of an apprentice, earning her place in a city where art is a man's trade. Seven Arcs adapted Kei Ohkubo's manga into 12 episodes in 2020.

mo-dao-zu-shi-2.summary: The second season of the Chinese animated series Mo Dao Zu Shi continues the story of Wei Wuxian, a notorious practitioner of demonic cultivation who has been brought back from the dead in another man's body. Still pretending to be a madman from the Jin family's side branch, he stays at the Cloud Recesses, home of the Lan Clan, with Lan Wangji, a stern former classmate who investigates a dangerous severed arm they have recovered. As they work to contain it, the story also returns to Wei Wuxian's past and how he came to walk his forbidden path. B.CMAY Pictures and Tencent produced the eight episodes in 2019, based on Mo Xiang Tong Xiu's novel.

princess-resurrection.summary: Hiro Hiyorimi moves to a small town to join his older sister, who works as a maid for a mysterious woman known simply as Hime. When he dies pushing Hime out of the way of a speeding car, she revives him, making him a half-living servant who must defend her. Hime is a princess of the monster royal family, competing with her siblings in a deadly struggle for the throne, and her brothers and sisters keep sending werewolves, vampires and stranger creatures after her. With Hime's small but powerful android maid Flandre and others they meet, Hiro is stuck on the front line. Madhouse adapted Yasunori Mitsunaga's manga into 25 episodes in 2007. It contains violence and gore.

magic-kaito.summary: Kaito Kuroba is a high school prankster and gifted amateur magician, the son of a famous stage magician who died during a performance years earlier. When Kaito uncovers his father's secret, he learns that the man secretly worked as Kaitou Kid, an elegant international phantom thief, and that his death may not have been an accident. Kaito takes up the white suit and monocle himself, stealing jewels in spectacular heists while evading the police and searching for the people who wanted his father gone. TMS Entertainment produced these 12 TV specials between 2010 and 2012, based on Gosho Aoyama's manga, which is linked to Detective Conan.

under-the-dog.summary: In 2025, five years after terrorist attacks forced Tokyo to cancel the 2020 Olympic Games, the former Olympic site on Tokyo Bay is under United Nations control and home to an international school. Hana Togetsu, a seventeen-year-old student there, is secretly one of the Flowers, teenagers with special abilities who work for a UN intelligence organisation. Their job is to hunt down and assassinate other young people with similar powers, and with their families held hostage to guarantee obedience, failure is not an option. Kinema Citrus and Orange produced this single OVA, released in 2016, after the project was funded through Kickstarter; it was originally conceived by Jiro Ishii. It contains graphic violence.

one-piece-karakurijou-no-mecha-kyohei.summary: In the seventh One Piece film, the Straw Hat Pirates pull a chest out of a wreck going under and find an old woman inside instead of gold. She offers them a golden crown in exchange for a ride home, saying it is kept on her home of Mecha Island. When they arrive, the island's lord greets them with an attack, then changes his mind and wants the crew's help working out the secret of the Golden Crown, leading them into a castle full of mechanical contraptions. Toei Animation released the film in 2006, based on Eiichiro Oda's manga and set outside the main storyline.

bananya.summary: Bananya is a series of short episodes about a small white cat that lives inside a banana. When no one is watching, it peels back its skin to reveal its head and wanders a quiet kitchen, dreaming of one day being dipped in chocolate. Other bananyas share its world, and each episode, only a few minutes long, follows them as they nap, explore, play and get into minor trouble, while a narrator explains their curious habits. Gathering produced the 13 episodes in 2016 as an original series, and later seasons followed. It is suitable for all ages.

bakuon.summary: Hane Sakura is a cheerful first-year at Okanoue Girls' High School who gets tired of pedalling her bicycle up the steep hill to school each day. When she sees classmate Onsa Amano roar past on a motorcycle, she is hooked, and she joins the school's motorcycle club, run by the mysterious senior Raimu Kawasaki, who never takes off her helmet. Hane has to earn her licence, buy a bike and learn to ride, while the girls go on trips, argue about manufacturers and share their love of motorcycles. TMS Entertainment adapted Mimana Orimoto's manga into 12 episodes in 2016, mixing comedy with plenty of real motorcycle detail.

non-non-biyori-ova.summary: This single OVA, released in 2014, takes the children of the countryside village from Non Non Biyori on a trip. During a summer outing to a department store, Suguru Koshigaya wins a lottery's grand prize: tickets for a trip to Okinawa. Renge, Hotaru, Natsumi and Komari get carried away preparing for their first trip by plane, rehearsing the flight, shopping for travel goods and fretting over details, before setting off for the sunny south. For little Renge, it is a first look at the world beyond Asahigaoka. Silver Link produced the episode as a gentle, comic companion to the first TV season, based on Atto's manga.

paniponi-dash.summary: Rebecca 'Becky' Miyamoto is eleven years old, a genius who graduated from MIT, and has just become homeroom teacher of class 1-C at Momotsuki Academy. Her students are older and taller than her, and they range from dim but eager to gloomy and plotting, while a crew of hapless space aliens keeps watch over her from orbit. Becky struggles to be taken seriously while everyone around her does their best to make the job harder. Shaft produced the 26 episodes in 2005, based on Hekiru Hikawa's manga, and filled the show with rapid-fire jokes, background gags and parodies of other anime and pop culture.

ojisan-to-marshmallow.summary: Hige-san is a big, soft-bodied, rather simple office worker with one passion: Tabekko marshmallows, which he adores. His young colleague Iori Wakabayashi has a crush on him and has noticed this weakness, so she uses it at every turn, eating marshmallows in front of him, buying up the whole stock at the convenience store and finding new ways to make him flustered at work. Hige-san is too sincere and too dense to understand what she is really after, while her friends cannot see what she finds so attractive in him. Creators in Pack adapted Rekomaru Otoi's web manga into 12 short comedy episodes in 2016.

boku-no-hero-academia-7th-season.summary: The seventh season of My Hero Academia opens with Japan still reeling from the war against the Paranormal Liberation Front, and with much of the public no longer trusting its heroes. As the villains All For One and Tomura Shigaraki prepare their next move, All Might calls in help from the United States: Star and Stripe, the country's top hero and reputedly the strongest person alive. All For One, however, wants her power for himself. From there, Izuku Midoriya, his classmates and Japan's remaining heroes prepare for a decisive confrontation with the villains. Bones produced the 21 episodes in 2024, adapting Kohei Horikoshi's manga. It contains intense violence.

voltron-legendary-defender-season-2.summary: Voltron: Legendary Defender's second season continues the war between the Paladins of Voltron and the Galra Empire. Five young pilots from Earth, Shiro, Keith, Lance, Pidge and Hunk, now fly the robotic lions that combine into Voltron, the legendary defender, alongside Princess Allura and her adviser Coran, last survivors of the destroyed planet Altea. Their mission is to free the planets conquered by Emperor Zarkon, but the Paladins are still learning to work as a team while the Galra hunt them across the universe. DreamWorks Animation Television made the series with World Events Productions and the Korean studio Mir, and the 13 episodes premiered on Netflix in January 2017.
voltron-legendary-defender-season-2.notes: American series with no MAL or AniList entry; sources are Kitsu and Wikipedia. Kitsu has no synopsis, so the premise rests mainly on Wikipedia.

wonder-egg-priority-special.summary: This 46-minute special, released in June 2021 after the TV series ended, continues Wonder Egg Priority's story. The series follows Ai Ohto, a withdrawn girl who stopped going to school after her best friend's suicide, and three other girls she met inside a dream world reached by buying mysterious eggs, where they fought monstrous manifestations of trauma in the hope of bringing back the friends they lost. The special picks up from the end of the twelfth episode and deals with what their efforts have actually led to, and whether they should go back into the dream world for answers. CloverWorks produced it, written by Shinji Nojima. It deals with suicide, self-harm and abuse.

saenai-heroine-no-sodatekata-flat-koi-to.summary: This web-only 'episode 0' was released just before the second season of Saekano, Flat, in April 2017. The doujin game circle Blessing Software, led by otaku Tomoya Aki, is working on a pool scene for its game, and Eriri Spencer Sawamura, the team's artist, asks Megumi Kato, the low-key girl who inspired the game's heroine, to pose in a swimsuit as reference. Megumi agrees only if the rest of the team dresses for the occasion too, so the whole group heads to a luxury hotel with hot springs and a pool for some 'research'. A-1 Pictures produced it, based on Fumiaki Maruto's light novels. As its title suggests, it is built around fan service.

k-seven-stories-movie-1.summary: The first of six K: Seven Stories films goes back to the time when Reisi Munakata first became the Blue King. A year after the Blue Clan Scepter 4 disbanded, the Red Clan HOMRA has become the unofficial power dealing with the city's underworld, but its king, Mikoto Suoh, is struggling to keep his destructive strength under control. At the same time, the Dresden Slate chooses Munakata to be the new Blue King, and he sets about rebuilding Scepter 4 according to his own sense of order, putting the two kings and their clans on course to meet. GoHands produced the film in 2018, from an original story by the writers' group GoRA. It contains action violence.

ookami-kakushi.summary: Fifteen-year-old Hiroshi Kuzumi moves with his family to Jouga, a quiet town in the mountains, and is surprised by how warmly his classmates welcome him, especially his clingy neighbour Isuzu Tsumuhana. Not everyone is so friendly: the class representative, Nemuru Kushinada, keeps her distance and warns him to stay away from the old part of town. As Hiroshi learns about local legends involving wolves and notices that people keep vanishing, with others explaining it away, he begins to suspect that Jouga is hiding something. AIC produced the 12 episodes in 2010, adapting a Konami visual novel directed by Ryukishi07, with characters designed by Peach-Pit. It contains violence and disturbing themes.

peach-boy-riverside.summary: In a world where humans, demi-humans and oni live in uneasy tension, Saltherine 'Sally' Aldarake, a sheltered princess, leaves her castle to search for Mikoto Kibitsu, a mysterious young woman she once met. Sally carries a power marked by a peach-shaped sigil that gives her the strength to defeat oni, but she wants to treat all three races fairly and hopes they can live in peace. Mikoto has the same power and far more skill with it, and she is set on wiping out every oni she can find. Their differing ideals shape the story. Asahi Production adapted the manga by Coolkyousinnjya and Johanne into 12 episodes in 2021, broadcast out of chronological order. It contains violence.

ikoku-meiro-no-croisee.summary: In late nineteenth-century Paris, Oscar Claudel returns from a journey to Japan with a surprise: Yune, a polite, soft-spoken young Japanese girl who has offered to work in his family's ironwork shop. The shop sits in the Galerie du Roy, an old shopping arcade, and is run by Oscar's grandson Claude, a moody young craftsman who did not ask for an assistant and struggles to understand her customs. Over time the two learn about each other's ways, while Yune discovers the city, its shops and its people, and the craftsmanship of its old arcades. Satelight adapted Hinata Takeda's manga into 12 calm, slice-of-life episodes in 2011.

to-love-ru-darkness-2nd-ova.summary: These three OVA episodes, released during 2016 with volumes of the To Love Ru Darkness manga, adapt side chapters of the series. Rito Yuki is still a clumsy, kind-hearted high school boy surrounded by girls, including the alien princess Lala and her sisters, the assassin Yami and the self-appointed matchmaker Momo, who is scheming to build him a harem. The episodes are standalone comedies, with stories such as a ghost-story gathering and a visit to a doctor's office, each building to the series' trademark accidents. Xebec produced them, based on the manga by Saki Hasemi and Kentaro Yabuki. They contain frequent nudity and sexual content.

gingitsune.summary: Makoto Saeki is the daughter of the priest at a small Inari shrine, and the fifteenth heir in her family to see Gintaro, the shrine's fox messenger, an old, lazy spirit who has watched over the shrine for centuries. Only one person in each generation can see him, and Makoto inherited the gift when her mother died. With Gintaro's limited ability to glimpse the near future, she helps the classmates and townspeople who come to the shrine with their worries, while things change when another shrine family's son, along with his own fox messenger, comes to live with them. Diomedéa adapted Sayori Ochiai's manga into 12 gentle episodes in 2013.

horimiya-piece.summary: Horimiya: The Missing Pieces is a second Horimiya series that fills in stories the first anime left out. It opens as Kyoko Hori, Izumi Miyamura and the rest of their circle graduate from Katagiri High School, then looks back through their school years in short, mostly self-contained episodes: everyday moments in class, at home with Hori's little brother Sota, at the school festival and with the wider circle of classmates who became their friends. The tone is light, romantic and comic, with little overarching plot. CloverWorks produced the 13 episodes in 2023, adapting side stories from Hero's Horimiya.

mouryou-no-hako.summary: Schoolgirl Yoriko Kusumoto is devoted to her friend Kanako Yuzuki, but their plans for a summer trip end when Kanako falls in front of a train. Detective Shutaro Kiba, who happened to be aboard, begins investigating, and the case leads him to Kanako's sister, an actress, and to an eerie, box-shaped medical facility in the woods where the injured girl is taken for treatment. When Kanako disappears from the facility, and a series of grisly dismemberment murders surfaces elsewhere, the investigation eventually draws in the reclusive Akihiko Chuzenji, known as Kyogokudo. Madhouse produced the 13 episodes in 2008, based on Natsuhiko Kyogoku's novel, with character designs by CLAMP. It contains gore and disturbing content.

high-school-dxd-born-specials.summary: This set of six short specials, each about three minutes long, was included with the home video release of High School DxD BorN, the third season of the series. Each one is a standalone comic sketch about Issei Hyodo and the girls around him: Rias and Akeno competing for his attention, the church trio comparing underwear, Koneko trying a healing technique, Serafall persuading Sona to try a magical-girl costume, an accidental bath encounter with Grayfia and Rossweisse helping Issei study for a test. They are based on Ichiei Ishibumi's light novels and released in 2015 and 2016. The specials consist almost entirely of sexual humour and nudity.

Jujutsu-Kaisen-3.summary: Jujutsu Kaisen's third season picks up after the disaster in Shibuya. Kenjaku, the ancient sorcerer behind that incident, has started the next stage of his plan, a nationwide event called the Culling Game that forces sorcerers into deadly competition. With Satoru Gojo out of action, the higher-ups of the jujutsu world reinstate the death sentence of Yuji Itadori, who is roaming a ruined Tokyo with Choso and exorcising curses. Yuta Okkotsu is put in charge of his execution, while Megumi Fushiguro is named heir to the Zen'in clan. MAPPA produced these 12 episodes, aired from January to March 2026, adapting Gege Akutami's manga. It contains graphic violence and gore.

kenzen-robo-daimidaler.summary: Earth is under attack from the Penguin Empire, a mysterious force of penguins that pilots giant penguin-shaped robots. Opposing them is a secret organisation operating as a beauty salon, Prince, which has built a giant robot called Daimidaler but needs the right pilot. Its power comes from a strange energy that the hot-blooded high school boy Koichi Madanbashi produces in large amounts, specifically by touching women's breasts, so he is recruited by Kyoko Sonan, an operative of Prince. What follows is a deliberately absurd parody of super robot shows. TNK adapted Asaki Nakama's manga into 12 episodes in 2014. It is built around sexual humour and nudity.

da-capo.summary: On Hatsunejima, a crescent-shaped island where cherry trees bloom all year round, some residents have unusual abilities. Junichi Asakura, a student at Kazami Academy, is able to peek into other people's dreams and make Japanese sweets appear from his hands, though he keeps quiet about it. He lives with his adopted sister Nemu and enjoys a comfortable routine with his friends, until his cousin and childhood friend Sakura Yoshino returns from America after six years, intent on keeping promises they made as children. Her arrival sets off changes for Junichi and the girls around him. feel. and Zexcs adapted Circus's visual novel into 26 episodes in 2003.

high-score-girl-ii.summary: The second season of Hi Score Girl jumps to 1996. Haruo Yaguchi, Akira Ono and Koharu Hidaka are now second-year high school students who are as obsessed with games as when they met in the arcades years earlier. Haruo is still a loud, competitive gamer, Akira, the rich girl who barely speaks, still beats him easily, and Koharu has developed feelings that complicate their friendly rivalry, while each of them works out what they really want. The series is packed with real fighting games and arcade culture of the time. J.C.Staff produced the nine episodes in 2019, adapting Rensuke Oshikiri's manga, following the first season from 2018.

lodoss-tou-senki.summary: The island of Lodoss, long troubled by war and legend, is heading for disaster. Parn, a young warrior and son of a disgraced knight, sets out after saving his village from goblins, joined by Etoh, a priest and childhood friend, the wizard Slayn, the dwarf Ghim and the high elf Deedlit. As they investigate the darkness spreading across the land, they run into Ashram, a formidable knight serving the warlord Beld, and discover that the witch Karla may be pulling strings behind the scenes. Madhouse produced this 13-episode OVA series between 1990 and 1991, based on Ryo Mizuno's novels and tabletop role-playing campaigns. It contains fantasy violence.

ulysses-jeanne-darc-to-renkin-no-kishi.summary: During the Hundred Years' War, Montmorency, a nobleman's son, studies magic and alchemy at a knight academy and dreams of uncovering the secret of the Philosopher's Stone. When France's defeat at Agincourt leads to the school being closed, he loses everything and goes into hiding, having only just become an alchemist. In a village he meets a girl named Jehanne, and what he does next ties them together and draws both of them into the war over the French crown. AXsiZ adapted Mikage Kasuga's light novels into 12 episodes in 2018, a fantasy reimagining of the story of Joan of Arc. It contains battle violence.

slow-start.summary: Hana Ichinose is a shy, anxious girl who missed her high school entrance exams after catching mumps and had to wait a year before trying again. Now she has moved to a new town, living in a building run by her cousin, and is starting high school with classmates who are a year younger than she is. Afraid of what they might think, she keeps her age secret while gradually making friends with the bubbly Tamate, the elegant Eiko and the tiny, quiet Kamuri. The series is a gentle, everyday comedy about friendship and fitting in. CloverWorks adapted Yuiko Tokumi's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in 2018.

aki-sora-yume-no-naka.summary: Aki-Sora: Yume no Naka is a two-episode OVA based on Masahiro Itosugi's manga, released in 2010 after an earlier OVA. Sora Aoi is a high school boy whose older sister Aki is the centre of his life, and the two have secretly become a couple. His twin sister Nami, unaware of this, tries to set him up with a classmate, Kana Sumiya, by enrolling him in a fashion club, but her intentions are not what they seem, and the relationships in the household become more tangled. Hoods Entertainment produced the episodes. The OVA consists largely of explicit sexual content between siblings.

ryuu-to-sobakasu-no-hime.summary: Suzu Naito is a shy high school girl in rural Kochi who has been unable to sing since losing her mother as a child. When she joins U, a vast virtual world with billions of users, her avatar Belle finds that she can sing freely, and Belle quickly becomes a sensation. During one of her concerts, a feared, scarred figure known as the Dragon crashes the show while being hunted by the platform's self-appointed police, and Suzu becomes determined to find out who is behind the beast's avatar. Studio Chizu produced the 2021 film, which Mamoru Hosoda wrote and directed, loosely inspired by Beauty and the Beast. It touches on abuse.

kanon.summary: Seven years after his last visit, Yuichi Aizawa moves back to a small snowy northern town to live with his aunt Akiko and his cousin Nayuki while his parents work abroad. Oddly, he remembers almost nothing about the place or the people he used to know there, and Nayuki, his old playmate, feels like a stranger. As he meets several girls around town, each of whom seems linked to his forgotten past, Yuichi starts recovering pieces of what happened years ago, along with hints of something supernatural. Toei Animation adapted Key's visual novel into 13 episodes in 2002; a separate adaptation by Kyoto Animation followed in 2006.

kodomo-no-omocha.summary: Sana Kurata is a hyperactive, cheerful eleven-year-old who stars in a popular children's TV show, lives with her eccentric novelist mother and is looked after by her devoted young manager, Rei. At school, though, her class is in chaos because of Akito Hayama, a sullen boy who leads the other boys in tormenting their teacher. Sana decides to put a stop to it, and in doing so discovers that Akito is dealing with problems of his own. The series mixes loud comedy, music and fast gags with more serious stories about family and growing up. Studio Gallop adapted Miho Obana's manga into 102 episodes between 1996 and 1998.

nana-maru-san-batsu.summary: Shiki Koshiyama is a reserved first-year at Buzo Prefectural High School with no particular plans for club life. Then his classmate Mari Fukami drags him to the school's quiz bowl club, where players race to the buzzer to answer trivia, often before the question has even been fully read. Shiki discovers that he has a real knack for it, and that competitive quiz is a sport of strategy, timing and nerve as much as memory. The club soon sets its sights on tournaments against stronger schools. TMS Entertainment adapted Iqura Sugimoto's manga into 12 episodes in 2017.

tatakau-shisho-the-book-of-bantorra.summary: In this world, people turn into stone books when they die, and anyone who touches one can relive the dead person's memories. The books are kept in the vast Bantorra Library, guarded by the Armed Librarians, a force of fighters with supernatural powers overseen by the library's acting director, Hamyuts Meseta, a formidable fighter with a ruthless streak. Their great enemy is the Shindeki Church, a secretive religious organisation with dark ambitions. Episodes move between librarians, cult members and their victims, gradually revealing a much bigger story. David Production adapted Ishio Yamagata's light novels into 27 episodes from 2009 to 2010. It contains graphic violence.

brotherhood-final-fantasy-xv.summary: Brotherhood is a five-episode web series made as a companion to the 2016 game Final Fantasy XV. Noctis Lucis Caelum, crown prince of Lucis, sets off on a road trip to meet his childhood friend Lunafreya, whom he is to marry, travelling in his father's convertible, the Regalia, with his friends and guards Gladiolus, Ignis and Prompto. Each episode uses moments on the road to look back at the past of one of the four, showing how they came to be at the prince's side and how their friendship was built. A-1 Pictures produced it with Square Enix in 2016, directed by Soichi Masui, and released the episodes online at monthly intervals.

sword-gai-the-animation.summary: Cursed weapons are scattered around the world, possessing anyone who wields them, and a secret organisation called the Shoshidai collects them. Gai Ogata was found as a newborn in the forest clutching one of them, the demonic blade Shiryu, and raised by Amon, a swordsmith. Drawn to the sword for reasons he cannot explain, he trains for years at the forge, until he loses an arm in an accident and ends up with a replacement made from the reforged Shiryu. Now he has to keep its murderous urges in check while another cursed sword is loose and leaving bodies behind it. DLE and LandQ studios produced the 12 episodes for Netflix in 2018. It contains graphic violence.

saint-seiya-the-lost-canvas-meiou-shinwa.summary: Set in eighteenth-century Europe, 243 years before the original Saint Seiya, The Lost Canvas follows three children who grew up together in Italy: the hot-headed orphan Tenma, the gentle young painter Alone and Alone's sister Sasha. Their paths split when Tenma leaves to train as one of Athena's Saints, the warriors who wear armour linked to the constellations, and it soon emerges that each of the three has a very different role to play in the latest holy war between Athena and Hades, god of the underworld. TMS Entertainment produced these 13 OVA episodes between 2009 and 2010, adapting Shiori Teshirogi's spin-off manga of Masami Kurumada's series. It contains violence.

dandadan-2.summary: The second season of Dandadan picks up in the middle of a mission at the family home of Jin 'Jiji' Enjoji, where Momo Ayase and Ken 'Okarun' Takakura have come to deal with whatever is haunting it. Things do not go to plan: Momo narrowly avoids being abducted, while the Kito family, the sinister landlords of the house, ambush Okarun and Jiji, and the three of them are pulled further into the strange legends of the town around it. Ghosts, aliens, teenage romance and loud comedy still mix freely. Science SARU produced the 12 episodes in 2025, directed by Fuga Yamashiro and based on Yukinobu Tatsu's manga. It contains violence and crude sexual humour.

break-blade-5-shisen-no-hate.summary: The fifth of six Broken Blade films continues the conflict between the Kingdom of Krisna and the Athens Commonwealth. In this world, people control quartz to power their tools, weapons and giant golem mecha, but Rygart Arrow cannot, which made him an outsider all his life. That same inability lets him pilot an ancient golem no one else can move, so he fights on the front lines for Krisna, alongside soldiers such as the young knight Narvi, out of loyalty to his old friends King Hodr and Queen Sigyn, while another friend, Zess, serves on the opposing side. Production I.G and Xebec released the film in 2011, based on Yunosuke Yoshinaga's manga. It contains war violence.
break-blade-5-shisen-no-hate.notes: MAL, Kitsu and AniList give no film-specific synopsis; summary describes the series setup and the film's place in the six-film run.

xxxholic-shunmuki.summary: These two OVA episodes continue xxxHOLiC after the events of the second TV season, xxxHOLiC Kei. Kimihiro Watanuki is a high school boy who can see spirits and works at the wish-granting shop of the witch Yuko to pay for his wish to be rid of that ability. Here, Watanuki and Shizuka Doumeki, his friend and rival, eat together with the young Kohane Tsuyuri and the old woman who looks after her, and later Watanuki dreams of Doumeki's grandfather, Haruka, who asks him to look for some things in the temple storeroom. Production I.G released them in 2009 as part of a joint project with Tsubasa, linking the stories of CLAMP's two series.

active-raid-kidou-kyoushuushitsu-dai-hak.summary: In a future Tokyo rebuilt after a disaster, crimes involving powered exoskeletons called Willwear are handled by a special police squad known as Unit Eight. The unit has its own Willwear and a reputation for property damage and ignoring procedure, so the government sends in Asami Kazari, a by-the-book young officer with private instructions from above, to keep an eye on them. She expects incompetence, but instead finds capable, well-meaning officers whose unconventional methods are constantly hampered by red tape. Production IMS produced the 12 episodes in 2016 as an original series, with Goro Taniguchi as chief director; a second season followed the same year.

wake-up-girls.summary: Green Leaves Entertainment is a tiny, struggling talent agency in Sendai, in north-eastern Japan. It forms a local idol group, Wake Up, Girls!, recruiting seven girls, among them Mayu Shimada, a former member of the famous idol group I-1 Club who left under mysterious circumstances. With an inexperienced manager, almost no money and a business full of people ready to take advantage of them, the girls start from nothing: small gigs, cheap costumes and dubious jobs. Ordet and Tatsunoko Production produced the 12 episodes in 2014, directed by Yutaka Yamamoto, and a film, Seven Idols, opened the same day the series began.

kitakubu-katsudou-kiroku.summary: When a classmate asks which club she plans to join, Natsuki Ando jokingly says the 'going home club', meaning none at all, only to discover that her school really has one. Before she knows it, she and another first-year are members, and their seniors turn out to be a handful: Sakura Domyoji, the energetic president, plus a fearless girl who fights bears and a ridiculously wealthy one. The club's actual purpose is to do whatever it likes on the way home, which in practice means pointless games, odd experiments, absurd arguments and plenty of rapid-fire gags. Nomad adapted Kuroha's web manga into 12 episodes in 2013.

arata-kangatari.summary: In the land of Amawakuni, a young man named Arata is forced to stand in for the ailing princess at a sacred ceremony, because the women of the ruling clan have run out of heirs. When the princess is attacked and Arata is framed for it, he ends up swapping places with Arata Hinohara, a high school boy in modern Japan who is being bullied by a boy named Kadowaki. Hinohara wakes up as a fugitive in an unknown world, where he discovers he can wield a Hayagami, a living sword of great power. Satelight and JM Animation adapted Yuu Watase's manga into 12 episodes in 2013. It contains violence.

druaga-no-tou-the-sword-of-uruk.summary: The second season of The Tower of Druaga continues the story of Jil, an earnest young climber who dreams of reaching the top of a giant tower full of monsters and treasure. After the events of the first season, The Aegis of Uruk, he is struggling with what happened and unsure of his goals, when Kai, a girl he knows nothing about, turns up and asks him to take her to the top. With old companions and new ones, Jil sets off up the tower again, though the climb, and the people who want what lies at its peak, are as dangerous as ever. Gonzo produced the 12 episodes in 2009, based on Namco's Babylonian Castle Saga games.

minami-ke-okaeri.summary: Minami-ke Okaeri is the third season of the Minami-ke anime, about the daily lives of three sisters who share an apartment in a slightly unusual household. Haruka, the eldest, is a calm, motherly high school student; Kana, the middle sister, is loud, reckless and full of bad ideas; and Chiaki, the youngest, is blunt, deadpan and devoted to Haruka. Episodes follow small events at home and school, with their friends, classmates and neighbours, including members of another, unrelated Minami family, making things more confusing. Asread produced the 13 episodes in 2009, following its 2008 second season and adapting Coharu Sakuraba's manga.

one-piece-episode-of-alabaster-sabaku-no.summary: The eighth One Piece film is a newly animated, condensed retelling of the Alabasta storyline from the manga. The Straw Hat Pirates reach the desert kingdom of Alabasta to bring home Princess Nefertari Vivi, who has been travelling with them. Her country is on the brink of civil war, stirred up by Baroque Works, a secretive criminal organisation that is after an ancient weapon of mass destruction. Monkey D. Luffy and his crew have to help Vivi stop the conflict before her people tear the country apart. Toei Animation released the film in 2007, based on Eiichiro Oda's manga.

bobobo-bo-bo-bobo.summary: In the year 300X, the world is ruled by the Maruhage Empire, whose hair hunters roam the land shaving people bald under Emperor Tsuru Tsurulina IV. Standing against them is Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo, a man with a towering blond afro who fights using the Super Fist of the Nose Hair. After he rescues a girl named Beauty, she joins him, along with an ever-growing group of bizarre companions such as the unpredictable Don Patch. The story is mostly an excuse for surreal non-sequiturs, sudden parodies and fights that collapse into nonsense. Toei Animation adapted Yoshio Sawai's manga into 76 episodes between 2003 and 2005.

tetsuwan-birdy-decode-02.summary: The second season of Birdy the Mighty: Decode takes place after an incident known as the Ryunka disaster has left Tokyo in turmoil. Birdy Cephon Altera, an officer of the Space Federation, still shares a body with Tsutomu Senkawa, the high school boy she accidentally killed while chasing a criminal, and the two must switch control as circumstances demand. Now the aliens responsible for the disaster have escaped and are hiding on Earth, and Birdy and Tsutomu are assigned to hunt them down while dealing with a world changed by what happened. A-1 Pictures produced the 12 episodes in 2009, adapting Masami Yuki's manga. It contains violence.

kannazuki-no-miko.summary: In the quiet town of Mahoroba, Himeko Kurusugawa is a shy, ordinary student at Ototachibana Academy, while Chikane Himemiya is the school's admired, elegant star; the two share a close, secret friendship and the same birthday. On that birthday, an ancient evil called the Orochi returns, and the girls learn that they are the reincarnations of shrine maidens destined to oppose it. The Orochi's servants pilot giant robots, and some of them turn out to be people the girls know well, which makes every battle more personal. TNK produced the 12 episodes in 2004, based on Kaishaku's manga, mixing yuri romance with mecha action. It contains violence and sexual themes.

miss-monochrome.summary: Miss Monochrome is an android who runs on a single AA battery and wants more than anything to become a top idol. Her sole companion is Ruu-chan, a robot vacuum cleaner, and she keeps having strange dreams about a famous idol named Kikuko, whom she hopes to meet one day. Her approach to stardom is earnest but baffling, from recruiting a manager she finds working at a convenience store to other unlikely schemes, and somehow she always ends up drawing attention. Each episode is only a few minutes long. LIDENFILMS and SANZIGEN produced the 13 episodes in 2013, built around a character created and voiced by Yui Horie.

megami-ryou-no-ryoubo-kun.summary: Twelve-year-old Koushi Nagumo loses everything in one day: his house burns down and his father abandons him. Collapsed in the street, he is taken in by Mineru Wachi, an eccentric woman temporarily in charge of Megami-ryou, a dormitory full of female university students, who offers him the job of live-in dorm mother. Koushi takes his cooking, cleaning and caretaking duties seriously, while the residents, who include the man-fearing Atena Saotome and the tomboyish Kiriya Sensho, constantly cause trouble and embarrass him. Asread adapted Ikumi Hino's manga into ten episodes in 2021. The series contains frequent nudity and sexual humour, much of it involving its twelve-year-old lead.

uzaki-chan-wa-asobitai-2nd-season.summary: The second season of Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! picks up after the summer holidays. Hana Uzaki, a loud, energetic university student, spent much of the break dragging her quiet, solitary senior Shinichi Sakurai along on outings, insisting that someone as lonely as him needs company. Now classes have started again, and her teasing only gets more relentless, while their families, friends and the cafe owner Sakurai works for watch with great interest as the two keep failing to admit how close they have become. ENGI produced the 13 episodes in 2022, adapting Take's manga. It contains fan service.

durarara-x2-shou-watashi-no-kokoro-wa-na.summary: This single special from the Durarara!!x2 era takes place during one evening in Ikebukuro. Mikado Ryugamine accepts an invitation to the apartment of the underground doctor Shinra Kishitani, hoping to catch up with Celty Sturluson, the headless rider, only to find a crowd of the city's most notorious residents gathered for a hot pot party. Over dinner, several guests share stories from the past: Mikado remembers a childhood adventure with Masaomi Kida, Anri Sonohara tells how her friendship with Mika Harima began, and Shizuo Heiwajima looks back on how he came to know Tom Tanaka. Shuka produced the episode in 2015, based on Ryohgo Narita's light novels.

beelzebub-jou-no-okinimesu-mama.summary: In Pandemonium, the realm of fallen angels, Beelzebub is one of the great rulers of Hell and a name meant to inspire fear. Mullin, a serious young demon newly assigned as her assistant, discovers that she is in fact a gentle, clumsy young woman who is a capable leader at work but helpless outside the office, and who adores anything soft and fluffy. Mullin tries hard to stay professional while being privately overwhelmed by how cute she is, and the other high-ranking demons turn out to be just as unexpected. LIDENFILMS adapted matoba's manga into 12 episodes in 2018 as a light romantic comedy.

sansha-sanyou.summary: Yoko Nishikawa used to be a wealthy young lady, but after her father's company went bankrupt she has to live on very little while still trying to act like a princess at school. Eating alone in a nearby wood one day, she meets Futaba Odagiri, a hyperactive transfer student, and Teru Hayama, a sweet-looking girl with a sharp tongue. The three are completely different, but each has the character for 'leaf' in her name, and they become an unlikely group of friends. Episodes follow their everyday school life in short comic sketches. Doga Kobo adapted Cherry Arai's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in 2016.

dog-days-3.summary: In the third season of Dog Days, Cinque Izumi, his cousin Nanami Takatsuki and their friend Rebecca Anderson are heading back to Flonyard, the world where they serve as summoned heroes for the countries of Biscotti, Galette and Pastillage, which settle their disputes through festival-like war games. Their journey goes wrong when lightning throws them off course and into the Dragon Forest, whose guardian, the Dragon Priestess Sharu, warns them that demons are threatening the forest and the whole continent, which means a real fight rather than a game. Seven Arcs Pictures produced the 12 episodes in 2015, created by Masaki Tsuzuki.

jyu-oh-sei.summary: After their parents are murdered, eleven-year-old twins Thor and Rai Klein are taken from their home colony and wake up on Chimaera, a terraformed prison planet ruled by carnivorous plants and extreme weather, where the human population is divided into four rival groups called Rings. They learn that the only way off the planet is to become the Jyu-Oh-Sei, the Beast King who conquers all four Rings. Thor, determined to survive and find out the truth about his parents, is drawn into the planet's power struggles alongside Zagi, a powerful young man. Bones adapted Natsumi Itsuki's manga into 11 episodes in 2006. It contains violence.

dragonaut-the-resonance.summary: Twenty years ago, an asteroid called Thanatos destroyed Pluto and is now drifting on a path toward Earth. To stop it, an international space agency has been working on a project built around dragons hatched from an egg found on the ocean floor. Jin Kamishina, a withdrawn eighteen-year-old whose family died when their shuttle crashed, is drawn in when a dragon-like creature attacks him and a mysterious girl named Toa saves his life. As other dragons and their partners emerge, Jin becomes a pilot in a conflict that is about much more than one asteroid. Gonzo produced the 25 episodes from 2007 to 2008 as an original series. It contains violence.

harmonie.summary: Akio Honjo is a quiet high school student with an unusual gift: he can perfectly recall any music he has heard just once. When he tries to play back a soothing piano melody that unexpectedly came from a classmate's phone, he finds himself drawn to its owner, Juri Makina, a popular girl he has barely spoken to. The short film explores whether two people from very different social worlds can really understand each other, with music as the bridge. Yasuhiro Yoshiura directed it at Studio Rikka with Ultra Super Pictures, and the 25-minute film was released in 2014 as part of Japan's government-funded Young Animator Training Project.

mahoromatic.summary: Mahoro Ando is a powerful combat android who fought for a secret organisation defending Earth against aliens. Her remaining operating time is limited, and she chooses to spend it not in battle but as a maid. Suguru Misato, a high school boy, lives by himself in the big house his late parents left him. After Mahoro rescues him from a bus hijacking, she turns up on his doorstep to look after him. She cooks, cleans and scolds him for his interest in racy magazines, while hiding how little time she has left and why she chose him. Gainax and Shaft adapted Bunjuro Nakayama and Bow Ditama's manga into 12 episodes in 2001. It contains fan service.

Sono-Bisque-Doll-wa-Koi-wo-Suru-Season-2.summary: The second season of My Dress-Up Darling continues the story of Wakana Gojo, a shy high school boy who hopes to become a master craftsman of hina dolls, and Marin Kitagawa, the outgoing classmate who pulled him into making cosplay outfits. Gojo has become more confident in his sewing, and each new costume teaches him something that feeds back into his love of doll-making. Marin, meanwhile, is struggling more and more to keep her feelings for him to herself, and people keep assuming they are a couple, which Gojo finds deeply embarrassing because he thinks they are too different. CloverWorks produced the 12 episodes in 2025, adapting Shinichi Fukuda's manga. It contains some fan service.

ayakashi-japanese-classic-horror.summary: Ayakashi is an anthology series that retells three traditional Japanese ghost stories over its eleven episodes. Yotsuya Kaidan, adapted from Nanboku Tsuruya IV's kabuki classic, follows a woman whose husband turns on her and whose vengeance outlives her. Tenshu Monogatari follows a forbidden love between a human and a goddess who lives in a castle tower. Bakeneko introduces a mysterious medicine seller who confronts a cat spirit with a grudge against one particular family. Toei Animation produced the 11 episodes, broadcast in 2006 in Fuji TV's Noitamina block. It contains violence, gore and disturbing imagery.

togainu-no-chi.summary: After a third world war, Tokyo lies in ruins and is controlled by a crime syndicate called Vischio, which has renamed the city Toshima. In its back streets runs Igura, a deadly fighting game in which players kill one another for the right to challenge its champion, Il-Re. Akira, a quiet young man known for never losing at a weapon-free street fighting game called Bl@ster, is framed for murder and offered a deal by a mysterious woman named Emma: enter Igura and defeat Il-Re, and he will go free. A-1 Pictures produced the 12 episodes in 2010, adapting Nitro+CHiRAL's boys' love visual novel. It contains graphic violence.

komori-san-wa-kotowarenai.summary: Shuri Komori is a fifteen-year-old middle school girl who simply cannot say no. Whatever classmates, teachers or neighbours ask of her, from carrying heavy loads to running errands and covering for others, she agrees, and years of doing favours have left her surprisingly strong. She is still an ordinary teenager, though, with the worries, crushes and minor embarrassments that come with that age, and the series follows her everyday life as her good nature gets her into one awkward situation after another. Each episode runs only about two minutes. Artland adapted Coolkyousinnjya's four-panel manga into 12 short episodes in 2015.

mobile-fighter-g-gundam.summary: In Future Century 60, the nations of Earth have moved to space colonies and settle which of them will rule for the next four years through the Gundam Fight, a tournament in which each colony sends a single champion piloting a giant robot to battle on the abandoned Earth. Domon Kasshu, the hot-headed fighter for Neo Japan, enters with the Shining Gundam, but his real goal is to find his brother Kyoji, accused of murdering their mother and stealing a weapon called the Devil Gundam. Along the way he meets rival fighters who become friends and enemies. Sunrise produced the 49 episodes in 1994 and 1995 as part of the Gundam franchise.

tsuki-ga-michibiku-isekai-douchuu-2.summary: The second season of Tsukimichi continues the story of Makoto Misumi, a teenager summoned to another world and then rejected by its goddess for being too plain. He has since built a community of demi-humans and other beings, and now runs a company that sells their goods and services, hoping to win them a better place among humans. To expand further, he heads to Rotsgard Academy, a major school of magic, where he ends up teaching students of his own and running into new trouble. Meanwhile, the two heroes the goddess summoned after him are making their own mark. J.C.Staff produced the 25 episodes in 2024, based on Kei Azumi's light novels.

city-hunter.summary: Ryo Saeba is a sweeper, a hired troubleshooter working in Tokyo's Shinjuku district, and anyone who needs him writes 'XYZ' on a message board at the station. He is a superb marksman with his Colt Python and takes on bodyguard jobs, rescues and the occasional hit, but when he is not working he chases beautiful women shamelessly. His partner Kaori Makimura keeps him in line, often with a giant hammer, while the cases take them from street crime to international conspiracies. Sunrise adapted Tsukasa Hojo's manga into 51 episodes in 1987 and 1988, the first of several anime series. It contains violence and sexual humour.

steins-gate-0-special.summary: This standalone OVA from the world of Steins;Gate 0 is a light Valentine's Day story. As the holiday approaches, the female members of the Future Gadget Laboratory in Akihabara realise that Kagari has never celebrated it, and they decide to make the day special by making homemade chocolates together. Their various quirks and lack of kitchen skills soon turn the effort into a string of small disasters, while each of them has someone in mind for her chocolates. It takes a break from the main series' darker storyline. White Fox released the episode in December 2018.

sousou-no-frieren-season-2.summary: The second season of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End picks up after the First-Class Mage Exam. Frieren, an elf mage who once helped defeat the Demon King, continues north with her apprentice Fern, now a first-class mage, and the young warrior Stark, gaining entry to the dangerous Northern Plateau on their way to Aureole, where souls are said to rest. Tough opponents test Stark's confidence as the party's frontline fighter, while Frieren keeps revisiting memories of her old companions and trying to better understand people. Madhouse produced the ten episodes, aired from January to March 2026 and directed by Tomoya Kitagawa, adapting the manga by Kanehito Yamada and Tsukasa Abe.

xxxholic-manatsu-no-yoru-no-yume.summary: Kimihiro Watanuki spends his summer holiday working off his debt at the shop of the witch Yuko, who grants wishes for a price. One day Yuko is invited to a mansion by an owner who wants to make use of her powers, and she sets off with Watanuki and his classmate Shizuka Doumeki. There they find other guests, all collectors of rare and strange objects drawn by the promise of adding to their collections. When the collectors start vanishing one by one, Watanuki and the others have to work out what the house wants. Production I.G produced the 2005 film, directed by Tsutomu Mizushima and based on CLAMP's manga.

owari-no-seraph-kyuuketsuki-shahar.summary: Kyuuketsuki Shahar is a single episode of Seraph of the End, released on DVD with volume 11 of the manga in 2016 and set before the Battle in Nagoya storyline. Yuichiro Hyakuya and the rest of the Shinoa squad, young soldiers fighting the vampires who now rule the world, receive an order from their commander Guren Ichinose to bring a human girl named Riko home to her family by freeing her from Shahar, a vampire nobody knows much about. The mission becomes more complicated when the vampire nobles Ferid Bathory and Crowley Eusford also show up. Wit Studio produced it, based on the manga written by Takaya Kagami. It contains violence.

shangri-la.summary: In the late 21st century, global efforts to curb carbon emissions have turned Japan, battered by earthquakes, into a land overrun by jungle, and the economy runs on a market for carbon. The government's answer is Atlas, a gleaming tower city that replaces Tokyo but has room for only a select few, leaving everyone else to live as refugees in the overgrown ruins outside. Kuniko Hojo, a fierce young woman set to inherit the leadership of a renegade town, sets out to challenge Atlas and the people who control it. Gonzo produced the 24 episodes in 2009, adapting Eiichi Ikegami's science fiction novel. It contains violence.

watashi-shain-ryokou-tte-hajimete-na-nod.summary: This single New Game! OVA follows the staff of Eagle Jump, a game development studio, on a company trip. After the release of the latest entry in their Fairies Story series, the team heads to a ski resort to unwind. Aoba Suzukaze, a character designer still new to the job, is thrilled to join her first company trip but worried because she has never been skiing, while her colleagues bring their usual mix of quirks and in-jokes along with them. Doga Kobo produced the episode, released in 2017 and based on Shotaro Tokuno's four-panel manga.
